summary: Tirautel is a nervous marksman stationed on a floating deck, happier cleaning rifles than firing them. When a lone intruder breaks loose he fires once, misses, and decides the sky is the wrong place for him.

feats.scene: Tirautel fires a rifle round that whistles past an intruder's ear and punches through a bulkhead.
Tirautel drops from a low railing onto a cargo net and lies winded but unbroken.
Tirautel bolts along the deck toward the rail with a pack bouncing on his back.

name: Misileo
summary: Misileo is a mountain-pass lookout with sharp eyes and a talent for describing what he sees in dull, exact words. His reports have saved patrols from avalanches more often than from enemies.

feats.scene: Misileo hurls a signal flare across a ravine to mark a landing spot.
Misileo rides out a rockslide curled beneath an overhang, bruised and coughing dust.
Misileo skis the last stretch of slope to deliver his warning ahead of the weather.

name: Serlusvi
summary: Serlusvi tends a damp cellar archive where forgotten dossiers pile up beside leaking pipes. He knows every shelf by smell and treats visitors as a slight inconvenience.

feats.scene: Serlusvi heaves a full box of folders onto a trolley and sends it rattling down the aisle.
Serlusvi is buried under a toppled shelf and crawls out with a sprained wrist.
Serlusvi hurries up the stairs with a rescued ledger held over his head.

name: Tenesama
summary: Tenesama is a quiet tail-watcher who survives by never being noticed, until the one time somebody notices him. His notebooks of overheard talk are tidier than his flat.

feats.scene: Tenesama jabs an elbow into a pursuer's ribs while slipping through a crowded market.
Tenesama is slammed against a brick wall by a startled suspect and shakes it off.
Tenesama darts through an alley to keep a moving car in sight.

name: Iumtarva
summary: Iumtarva is a rifleman who follows orders until the moment they conflict with his conscience. He lowers his weapon, raises his hands, and takes whatever consequence follows.

feats.scene: Iumtarva fires a warning round into a stone floor and chips a crater the size of a plate.
Iumtarva is tackled to the ground by two guards and pinned without lasting harm.
Iumtarva runs from a collapsing doorway into the open air.

name: Niliaaul
summary: Niliaaul is a tunnel raider hired for muscle in a dig beneath an old harbour town. He trusts the crew's plan more than he should and pays for it underground.

feats.scene: Niliaaul swings a pickaxe into a sealed stone door and splits a seam.
Niliaaul is battered by falling masonry and keeps crawling toward the exit.
Niliaaul scrambles along a narrow gallery with a lantern swinging.

name: Amilumar
summary: Amilumar is a wing pilot who prefers to see the evidence with his own eyes before closing a case. His cautious questions irritate commanders and keep his squadron alive.

feats.scene: Amilumar lets off a burst from a cannon pod that shreds an abandoned shed.
Amilumar rides out a hard landing in a cracked cockpit with only a wrenched shoulder.
Amilumar banks his jet low over a burning field at cruising speed.

name: Cousser
summary: Cousser is a violet, shifting creature of living tissue that lends its strength to whichever soldier it clings to. It remembers every previous partner and fights with their stolen skills.

feats.scene: Cousser lashes a barbed tentacle through a parked truck and rips out its engine.
Cousser absorbs a collapsing wall of concrete and reforms its body afterward.
Cousser bounds across rooftops on stretched limbs after a fleeing target.

name: Sorni
summary: Sorni is a veteran door-guard who tries to hold a corridor against someone stronger and more determined. His stubbornness is admirable and his survival rate is poor.

feats.scene: Sorni drives a fist into a charging man's stomach and doubles him over.
Sorni is thrown across a hallway and slides into a wall without breaking anything.
Sorni lunges forward to bar the doorway before it is rushed.

name: Telanior
summary: Telanior is a stern squad member who volunteers first and complains afterward. He drills his team on an old deck until the routines are automatic.

feats.scene: Telanior empties a magazine into a steel plate and leaves it pitted.
Telanior takes a rifle butt to the helmet and keeps marching.
Telanior charges across a platform with his squad close behind.

name: Numsama
summary: Numsama is a background staffer in an underground lighthouse bunker who keeps the lights on and the rota tidy. Nobody remembers her name until the fuses blow.

feats.scene: Numsama throws a heavy breaker switch with both hands and the whole corridor hums.
Numsama is shaken by a rumbling blast down the hall and shields a colleague with her coat.
Numsama dashes between stairwells with a replacement bulb in her fist.

name: Liseoul
summary: Liseoul runs a quiet office that buys and borrows oddities for her employers, and she lectures visiting experts with unusual patience. Her relish for old maps is matched only by her mistrust of mystics.

feats.scene: Liseoul pushes a sliding vault drawer shut so hard it sparks against its rail.
Liseoul is thrown against a map table during an explosion and rises dusty and cross.
Liseoul hurries across a station concourse with a locked case under her arm.

name: Ontil
summary: Ontil is a dogged interrogator whose job is to unmask masked do-gooders. She leans on witnesses hard and relents only when a friend of the suspect walks in.

feats.scene: Ontil slams a flat palm on a metal desk and cracks a coffee cup.
Ontil is knocked backward through a flimsy partition and stands up scowling.
Ontil runs down a hospital hallway after a witness who bolted.

name: Rotelva
summary: Rotelva leads a cell of sneering saboteurs and is sentenced to a swinging blade trial for failing a single task. His rival's skill is the only thing sharper than the blade overhead.

feats.scene: Rotelva slashes a short sword through a rope bridge in a single stroke.
Rotelva is clipped by a swinging blade and keeps his footing for another few seconds.
Rotelva lunges across a pit to meet his opponent.

name: Lonam
summary: Lonam is a turncoat saboteur who slips a spool of film to his old enemies with a launch location on it. He dies on the road before anyone can thank him.

feats.scene: Lonam hurls a sealed film canister across a street into a waiting car window.
Lonam takes a rifle stock across the back and keeps running with the canister.
Lonam bolts through traffic to reach the meeting point.

name: Illonno
summary: Illonno is a government evaluator who studies hired killers for a living and writes cold, accurate verdicts on them. His disapproval reaches the right desks, and he likes it that way.

feats.scene: Illonno strikes a pressure point on a rude guard's neck and drops him on the spot.
Illonno is thrown over a table in a scuffle and straightens his coat afterward.
Illonno strides then sprints across a car park to reach a getaway car.

name: Rnoliu
summary: Rnoliu is a lab technician who has changed employers three times and believes in every one of them. His best moment is also his worst, when he fires a pistol at something much bigger than himself.

feats.scene: Rnoliu empties a pistol at a lumbering target and dents the wall behind it.
Rnoliu is swatted aside into a stack of crates and survives with cracked ribs.
Rnoliu runs to a glowing portal frame with a datapad clutched to his chest.

name: Tumoncor
summary: Tumoncor is a seasoned operative who gives sober advice that officials rarely heed. He prefers patience to confrontation and holds grudges against showy inventors.

feats.scene: Tumoncor shoves a heavy filing cabinet across a floor to block a doorway.
Tumoncor survives a collapsing balcony with a bruised back.
Tumoncor runs out of a shaking tower with a briefcase of notes.

name: Niais
summary: Niais is a duty officer who phones the proper experts the moment a yoga studio smells of something odd. His reputation for excess caution has an excellent record of being right.

feats.scene: Niais kicks a jammed studio door off its hinges.
Niais is pushed over a bench by a surge of light and gets up wheezing.
Niais sprints out to the street with the phone still pressed to his ear.

name: Corenan
summary: Corenan is a sturdy long-haul trucker who works as a secret courier and has a talent for bad luck. He once rode a lifted truck cab to a bone-rattling landing.

feats.scene: Corenan hauls a stubborn trailer latch open with a wrench and a roar.
Corenan crashes in a truck cab dropped from a great height and walks away with minor cuts.
Corenan pushes his truck to a highway sprint with the escort cars lagging behind.

name: Valtete
summary: Valtete is a recruiter with a steady voice and a cheerful way of describing awful assignments. She earns her pay by talking reluctant fighters into the field.

feats.scene: Valtete clubs a stubborn vending machine with her shoulder until it spits out a snack.
Valtete is blown over a railing by a passing shock wave and clambers up grinning.
Valtete races across a prairie road in a borrowed pickup.

name: Rnsole
summary: Rnsole is a bodyguard who follows one calm order and picks up a phone instead of a gun. Callers always find him composed.

feats.scene: Rnsole drives a fist through a rotten fence plank to clear a path.
Rnsole is thrown into a parked car and dents its door with his shoulder.
Rnsole runs down a fire stair to reach a working phone line.

name: Cessesval
summary: Cessesval is a protective escort who walks into a protest of one man and his friend. She never finishes the argument, and the argument finishes her.

feats.scene: Cessesval wrenches a fire door open and yanks a stranger out of a stairwell.
Cessesval is hurled against a stone pillar and clings on for another breath.
Cessesval lunges after a man heading for the door.

name: Ciltusni
summary: Ciltusni is a grey-haired mercenary who plays radio tech during staged raids, warning his crew when sirens approach. His calm voice masks a flat, ruthless streak.

feats.scene: Ciltusni cracks the butt of a pistol across a clerk's jaw during a staged holdup.
Ciltusni is slammed over a counter and rolls off with a split brow.
Ciltusni sprints to the van with his headset dangling.

name: Caltu
summary: Caltu is a space-station officer who is ordered to leave before the alien swarm can follow him out. He obeys at once and mourns the choice for years.

feats.scene: Caltu hauls a pressure door shut by hand and seals the swarm behind it.
Caltu is thrown against a bulkhead by a venting corridor and keeps his grip on a rail.
Caltu dashes to the escape pod bay through a flickering hall.

name: Rnitia
summary: Rnitia is a briefing courier who carries rolled reports between two famous heroes and an enemy's plans. His attention to detail is excellent and he never raises a fist.

feats.scene: Rnitia slams a heavy folder on a table so hard the two listeners jump.
Rnitia is knocked down by a rolling pressure wave and carries on speaking.
Rnitia jogs up the deck to hand off the final page.

name: Ausia
summary: Ausia is a wartime spy who can pass for anyone with enough greasepaint and nerve. Fifteen tongues and a drawer of masks serve a single, doomed mission.

feats.scene: Ausia slugs a sentry in a borrowed uniform and drags him behind a crate.
Ausia is thrown from a moving lorry and rolls to a stop with scraped palms.
Ausia bolts from a barracks in a stolen coat.

name: Liuteo
summary: Liuteo is a loyal officer who chooses the wrong side of a bitter internal dispute. A cloud of poison drifts in during the final week of the argument.

feats.scene: Liuteo fires a pistol at a dummy and splits its head clean off.
Liuteo is thrown across a briefing room by a shouting colleague and brushes himself down.
Liuteo runs through a busy lobby to join the faction's meeting.

name: Niace
summary: Niace is a veteran who fought beside a legendary soldier and finds himself on the opposing side at a forge. His excuse, that he follows orders, comes out flat and sad.

feats.scene: Niace levels a rifle and shatters a window frame with a single shot.
Niace is thrown across the forge floor and slides to a stop against an anvil.
Niace sprints toward the furnace with his weapon raised.

name: Uloli
summary: Uloli is a stealth bomber pilot with steady hands who delivers an unusual passenger over a foreign coastline. He drinks lukewarm tea afterward and says nothing.

feats.scene: Uloli drops a practice bomb that gouges a tidy crater in an empty salt flat.
Uloli rides out a heavy turbulence jolt strapped into his seat with a cracked visor.
Uloli pushes his bomber to cruising speed across open sea in the dark.

name: Oserni
summary: Oserni is a ship crewman who crash-lands on a hostile planet alongside a loyal flying cat and is calm enough to inventory the enemy's arsenal. He reports captured weapons as though they were groceries.

feats.scene: Oserni fires a captured rifle and blows a hole in a thin armoured door.
Oserni survives a hard splinter-craft landing and climbs out of the wreck unhurt.
Oserni runs through a ruined corridor with a heavy crate in his arms.

name: Teorcen
summary: Teorcen is a shadowing operative who trails henchmen through a foreign capital with frayed nerves. She is spotted at last, which is the whole point of the lesson.

feats.scene: Teorcen elbows a rear window out of a parked van to take a peek inside.
Teorcen is hurled onto a pavement by a surprised guard and winces back to her feet.
Teorcen runs down an alley to keep the henchmen in sight.

name: Nuneia
summary: Nuneia is a systems technician who spots something wrong with the network and reports it upward without fuss. His voice shakes, but his data is correct.

feats.scene: Nuneia yanks a jammed server rack drawer out of its rails in a hurry.
Nuneia is flung from his chair by a power surge and lies stunned on the carpet.
Nuneia jogs to the command console with a printout.

name: Lumneo
summary: Lumneo is a bald mercenary whose engineered body knits itself back together after being blown apart. He is cruel with a sample of blood and careless with his own flesh.

feats.scene: Lumneo drives his fist through a car door and drags a driver out by the collar.
Lumneo bursts apart in a violent blast and slowly reassembles on the dirt.
Lumneo runs down a rural road after a speeding sedan.

name: Liaron
summary: Liaron is a young strike team recruit who is picked by a veteran pilot because of an uncanny knack for staying calm. He serves a short season before an artificial mind turns on him.

feats.scene: Liaron fires a rifle round that rings off a steel locker.
Liaron is hurled across a training floor and lands in a roll.
Liaron sprints across a hangar floor with the team at his heels.

name: Tusiaoro
summary: Tusiaoro is a mind-reader pushed far past his limit by a commander who turns out to be a mechanical impostor. He gives everything and ends up empty.

feats.scene: Tusiaoro hurls a pulse of thought that cracks a glass partition between two rooms.
Tusiaoro endures a splitting headache from a mental overload and still stands.
Tusiaoro hurries along a corridor clutching his temples.

name: Rensersan
summary: Rensersan is a federal investigator who reports to a stern supervisor and takes notes in a cramped hand. A quiet career suits him fine.

feats.scene: Rensersan shoulders open a locked door during a raid and stumbles in.
Rensersan is thrown against a van and slides to the ground breathing hard.
Rensersan chases a suspect through a parking structure.

name: Tuiuseo
summary: Tuiuseo is an intelligence officer who works in tandem with a partner to corner a smuggler and use him as leverage. Her deals tend to unravel when decency shows up.

feats.scene: Tuiuseo wrenches a suspect's arm behind his back and clicks on the cuffs.
Tuiuseo is knocked into a street lamp and gets up with a grim smile.
Tuiuseo runs across a plaza to catch her fleeing partner.

name: Coneve
summary: Coneve is a dashing adventurer in crimson who crosses over from a neighbouring reality that is leaking into ours. He duels a rival in an elegant, theatrical manner.

feats.scene: Coneve fires a pistol and shatters a chandelier in one clean shot.
Coneve plunges from a balcony onto a stage and keeps his smile.
Coneve sprints along a gallery as the glass falls behind him.

name: Amall
summary: Amall is an aide who tells his boss that the situation room is ready. It is the only moment anyone ever remembers him.

feats.scene: Amall shoves a heavy conference door wide open to let the director through.
Amall is bowled over by a surging crowd and stands up straightening his tie.
Amall jogs ahead of the entourage to unlock the next hall.

name: Nenam
summary: Nenam is a nervous infiltrator who forges credentials and gasses guards without a word. As the mission unspools he grows afraid of his employers more than his target.

feats.scene: Nenam pops open a cell hatch with a crowbar and a grunt.
Nenam is slammed into a steel door by a startled prisoner and lingers in a daze.
Nenam jogs down a concrete tunnel, whispering excuses.

name: Noleoria
summary: Noleoria is a senior operative who riddles a corpse with bullets just to be sure, then is punished for a different failure. A glass of water ends his career in the most horrible way imaginable.

feats.scene: Noleoria empties an assault rifle into a motionless body in a dusty hangar.
Noleoria crashes through a plywood wall in pursuit and climbs out unscathed.
Noleoria drives a jeep flat out across a dry lake bed.

name: Cautor
summary: Cautor is a grey-haired cyborg who hunts a legendary soldier for an underground movement. His steel limbs are slow but unforgiving.

feats.scene: Cautor swings a steel forearm through a stack of cinder blocks and scatters them.
Cautor takes a speeding car head on and stays on his feet.
Cautor lumbers into a run along a pier after his quarry.

name: Oronti
summary: Oronti is a field officer who spends the aftermath of a monster fight handing a famous brawler a stack of forms. He is perfectly unflappable.

feats.scene: Oronti stamps a form so briskly that the desk shivers.
Oronti is flung back by a tremor and keeps hold of his clipboard.
Oronti hurries through the rubble to catch his signatory.

name: Rinriva
summary: Rinriva is a stockroom keeper entrusted with a dangerously heavy mass of weightless metal and told to hide the label. He does so without asking why.

feats.scene: Rinriva drags a sealed crate onto a lift with a chain and a heave.
Rinriva is pinned briefly against a shelf by a floating pallet and extricates himself.
Rinriva hurries to the vault corridor with the key card ready.

name: Cilrnor
summary: Cilrnor is a tall lawyer turned statesman, said to have been a champion wrestler in his youth. He raised a giant monument to himself that tourists still climb.

feats.scene: Cilrnor flips a burly challenger over his hip at a county fair and wins the purse.
Cilrnor shakes off a hard fall from a hay wagon and tips his hat to the crowd.

name: Lloorn
summary: Lloorn is a shambling undead statesman with an excellent aim and a dry sense of humour. A single shot to a mercenary's head is the story told over drinks.

feats.scene: Lloorn raises a flintlock and fires one shot that spins a jester's hat off his head.
Lloorn keeps walking after a cannonball takes a chunk out of his stovepipe hat.

name: Lisen
summary: Lisen is a bearded leader whose statue was swapped by a time-hopping villain. A giant ape ruins the plot and accidentally saves him from an assassin on a fateful night.

feats.scene: Lisen pounds a lectern with his fist and a candle topples over.
Lisen is knocked off his feet by a crashing ape and gets up brushing off his coat.

name: Ontia
summary: Ontia is a ghostly orator who attends a roast thrown for a loud-mouthed mercenary. Spirits keep better manners than the host, and he leaves the party without a word.

feats.scene: Ontia raps a spectral knuckle on a table and the glasses rattle once.
Ontia shrugs as a thrown bottle passes through his chest and shatters on the wall.

name: Iumiava
summary: Iumiava is a grey-haired deli keeper who lost his shop when a tower was flung into the sky. He shouted at the scientist responsible, who promised to pay for it.

feats.scene: Iumiava slaps a pastrami down on a counter hard enough to split the paper.
Iumiava keeps shouting as the floor tilts and shelves topple around him.

name: Vaell
summary: Vaell was a nineteenth-century local legend of a fishing hamlet, memorialised by a bronze figure leaning on a cane. An alien ruins the memorial, and an orange rock-man uses it as a projectile.

feats.scene: Vaell hauls a net full of herring onto the dock with a single heave.
Vaell, as a bronze likeness, is flung across the square and lands with only a dent.

name: Iumveo
summary: Iumveo is a writer who discovers an old diary at a bookstall and decides to turn it into a novel. His friends laughed with him and later wept over the book.

feats.scene: Iumveo bangs a quill on the desk and a dozen loose pages flutter to the floor.
Iumveo writes through a freezing night in a draughty study and finishes the chapter.

name: Leous
summary: Leous is an elderly scholar-hunter who nearly slew a famed vampire. His descendants inherit the family feud, and the family crest hangs in many a study.

feats.scene: Leous drives a sharpened stake through a coffin lid with one practised thrust.
Leous takes a clawing from a fanged foe and returns to his lecture hall that same evening.

name: Lloaun
summary: Lloaun is a student whose body became a glowing envelope controlling his own bones. When the power faded, nobody knew whether the boy survived the blast on the school bus.

feats.scene: Lloaun flares a halo of light around his ribs and knocks a locker door off its hinges.
Lloaun is jolted by a bus blast and lies motionless for a long while.

name: Rneoli
summary: Rneoli is a blind retiree who once misplaced a briefcase at a diner. A masked helper retrieves his keepsake, and neither of them mentions the missing portrait.

feats.scene: Rneoli taps his cane on the pavement and the sound echoes down the alley.
Rneoli sits through a long hospital night recovering from a sudden stroke.

name: Tutesval
summary: Tutesval is a grey-haired weapons maker and mentor to a half-vampire fighter. Grief drives him to hunt the undead every night from a cluttered workshop of silver and stakes.

feats.scene: Tutesval fires a silver-tipped bolt that pins a fanged prowler to a brick wall.
Tutesval limps through a night of pursuit with a bad leg and never slows his stride.

name: Rnull
summary: Rnull is a boy born on an irradiated island who swells into a clawed green giant when angry. Fury ended the life of his own parent, and the legend lingers among the jungle survivors.

feats.scene: Rnull rips a jungle ridge in half with a single swipe of his claws during a tantrum.
Rnull laughs as a rain of heavy shells bursts across his massive green back.

name: Amniu
summary: Amniu is a mutated slaver whose arms became long squid-like limbs that flay and crush. His bargain with alien masters cost him the loyalty of his crew.

feats.scene: Amniu whips a suckered limb across a cargo crate and cracks it like an egg.
Amniu keeps lashing out after a heavy rifle round tears through his shoulder.

name: Ialameest
summary: Ialameest is the shadow of creation, a many-armed green force that sees perfection in emptiness. Caged by rival powers across every reality, it breaks loose to unmake whole cosmoses.

feats.scene: Ialameest closes six great hands and a sweeping wave collapses a cosmos into silence.
Ialameest stands unmoved while a swarm of rival powers pounds it across a dozen realities.

name: Luscor
summary: Luscor is a living dwarf star with a single scarlet eye. Passengers who pass through his glow reappear wherever they imagine in the void.

feats.scene: Luscor flares his burning body and lights up half a nebula for an entire season.
Luscor drifts through a raging cosmic storm and loses nothing but a little glow.

name: Rniaus
summary: Rniaus is a digital copy of a teenager who hacked her way out of a game. She learns each level so thoroughly that she can bend it, and helps real players escape their prison.

feats.scene: Rniaus rewrites a platform in mid-leap and sends a rogue sprite tumbling into a pit.
Rniaus shrugs off a corrupt data blast that scrambles every pixel around her.

name: Amamarni
summary: Amamarni is a muscular extra on a cinematic battle epic filmed in a dream-studio dimension. Nobody knows if he is native or just an actor on a very long contract.

feats.scene: Amamarni hurls a rubber boulder through a painted fortress wall and the crew cheers.
Amamarni takes a prop cannon blast in a battle scene and gets up for another take.

name: Stama
summary: Stama is the leader of an underground network that smuggles refugees across borders. Charming, shifty and always moving, he vanishes before the authorities arrive.

feats.scene: Stama shoves a barrel across a cellar floor to hide a trapdoor.
Stama crouches in a freezing tunnel for a night and comes out ready to talk.

name: Tetel
summary: Tetel is a rebel chief who finds a gleaming sky-forged blade and declares himself a deity. The energy he absorbs eventually rots his body, and a shield-maiden brings him down.

feats.scene: Tetel drives the blade into a stone wall and a crack races up a whole palace tower.
Tetel absorbs a blast from a swung shield and then falls apart from within.

name: Netumus
summary: Netumus is an eighth-century scholar who tried to build a machine to preserve the world by gathering human wishes. The device failed, and it drained the volunteers who fed it.

feats.scene: Netumus throws a lever and a ring of brass gears bursts into sparks across a vaulted chamber.
Netumus stands at the core of the failing engine as light pours from his robes.

source_title: Abu Mūsā Jābir ibn Hayyān al-Azdi (Earth-616)

name: Orsos
summary: Orsos was a coastal sultan who played both sides in a deal with sea-raiders. His double dealing led to a knife in the dark.

feats.scene: Orsos hurls a purse of coins onto a counting table and the whole court falls quiet.
Orsos staggers up a mosque stair after a stab wound and still delivers his final speech.

name: Rniniu
summary: Rniniu is a genetically hardened gunman immune to poisons, plagues and radiation. A terror cell values him because nothing in the usual arsenal can stop him.

feats.scene: Rniniu empties a magazine into a convoy and wrecks the lead truck.
Rniniu stands calmly in the centre of a bomb crater and walks out of the fallout.

name: Tuleo
summary: Tuleo is a nameless victim of a worldwide plague in a parallel reality. Little survives of him except a line in a roll of the lost.

feats.scene: Tuleo pushes a stuck window open to let in the evening breeze.
Tuleo battles a high fever through a long and silent night.

name: Amcoror
summary: Amcoror is a void predator who devours matter and snuffs out whole realities while crossing between them. He loathes anything solid and hides in the nothing between worlds.

feats.scene: Amcoror opens his jaws and a whole sky of galaxies folds silently into his gullet.
Amcoror shrugs off a bomb dropped through a rift that rips a hole in his chest.

name: Corval
summary: Corval is a conjoined pair with blank faces, reshaped by a reality-twisting storm. Hunted by a secret agency, they flee with a band of kind guardians.

feats.scene: Corval clamp their joined arms around a gatepost and wrench it free of the ground.
Corval shrug off a truncheon strike and run on without breaking step.

name: Valeo
summary: Valeo is a smooth-faced guest at a dream wedding conjured by a sleeping woman. In waking life nobody remembers his name.

feats.scene: Valeo raises a glass of cordial and a toast rings through the dream hall.
Valeo sways through a long dance without a trace of fatigue.

name: Oliosuium
summary: Oliosuium is a trained hunting bird who serves a sorceress queen. It glides over her castle at dawn and brings back mice and rumours.

feats.scene: Oliosuium folds its wings and dives talons-first onto a fleeing rat.
Oliosuium tumbles in a gale, rights itself, and glides home on one worn wing.
Oliosuium stoops from the battlements faster than a galloping horse.

name: Elltia
summary: Elltia is a scaly four-fingered agent with two pistols who chases a mammal terrorist through the primeval ooze. His enemy's plan to push him down the ladder of life shuffles history itself.

feats.scene: Elltia fires both pistols at once and drops a pair of leaping thugs.
Elltia rolls through a hail of darts and keeps his pistols up.

name: Vanau
summary: Vanau is a bush pilot who flew medical runs and befriended a sea captain. Everyone says he could fly through a storm with his eyes shut.

feats.scene: Vanau wrenches a stuck throttle lever free with both hands.
Vanau walks away from a bumpy crash landing with a cracked pair of goggles.

name: Nanrecor
summary: Nanrecor is a high-school senior who hangs out at the soda counter with friends. Crushes, cars and test-day nerves fill his week.

feats.scene: Nanrecor drives a punch into a punching bag at the gym and wheezes proudly.
Nanrecor takes a football to the stomach and still cracks a joke.

name: Aunte
summary: Aunte is a grey-haired ex-con released after a stint for robbery. He teams with a jester to settle a score with a moonlit vigilante.

feats.scene: Aunte swings a crowbar at a padlock and splits the hasp clean through.
Aunte is thrown into a trash heap by a masked foe and crawls out swearing.

name: Cormece
summary: Cormece is a blue-skinned tinkerer from a sunken neighbourhood who swims fast and builds water-saving gadgets. On land he wears a water helmet, since he gets only minutes without it.

feats.scene: Cormece cranks a lever on a homemade pump and sends a jet that knocks a thief flat.
Cormece ignores deep-sea pressure that would crumple a steel diving bell.
Cormece darts through a kelp forest as quick as a motorboat.

name: Rnicauas
summary: Rnicauas is a bull-horned river god who can slip into the shape of a snake. Pressed into service as a bodyguard, he fights for a tyrant and dies in a street brawl.

feats.scene: Rnicauas gores a delivery van with his horns and flips it over a median.
Rnicauas stands in a flood-swollen current that rips a bridge apart and is merely soaked.

name: Rirni
summary: Rirni is a petty crook who dons a winged costume handed over by a crime lord. The costume does not make him brave, and he is jailed after his first heist fails.

feats.scene: Rirni swings a crowbar through a jeweller's window and grabs a tray of rings.
Rirni is flung over a counter by a determined woman and groans into the tiles.

name: Ontteau
summary: Ontteau is a golden warrior whose body was dipped in a legendary river, leaving him impervious save for one weak spot. He commands a loyal troop and meets a poisoned end before the city's high gates.

feats.scene: Ontteau hurls a spear that punches through a siege tower and splinters its frame.
Ontteau stands in a rain of boulders and arrows without so much as a bruise.

name: Levorco
summary: Levorco is a golden-haired soldier of an ancient siege who wins glory and doubts it. A secret friend disguised among the troops keeps him going.

feats.scene: Levorco drives a spear through a shield and the man behind it.
Levorco climbs a ladder under a hail of stones and refuses to retreat.

name: Meocalnan
summary: Meocalnan is a famous warrior rendered unkillable by a magic bath. He died anyway, remembered in verse by a detective riding a time machine.

feats.scene: Meocalnan sweeps a bronze sword through a wall of shields and scatters a dozen men.
Meocalnan walks through a volley of spears and arrows and shakes the dust from his hair.

name: Vauson
summary: Vauson is a young prince and sword fighter who joins a barbarian against a lion-masked tyrant. Surrender earns him no mercy.

feats.scene: Vauson cleaves a rider off his saddle with a single overhand stroke.
Vauson fights on after a mace blow dents his helm and rings his skull.

name: Cortan
summary: Cortan is a street thief who trains orphans to pick pockets. A weather-working girl learns her first lessons from him.

feats.scene: Cortan shoves a fruit cart into a pursuer's path and slips down an alley.
Cortan drops from a rooftop onto a canvas awning and rolls away unhurt.

name: Isinte
summary: Isinte is an armoured automaton that sprays acid to bring down tenements for a crime syndicate. A time-travelling soldier shuts it off.

feats.scene: Isinte sprays a gout of acid across a brick wall and the whole tenement slumps into rubble.
Isinte shrugs off a heavy cannon round that dents only its outer plating.

name: Niaoror
summary: Niaoror is a spy from a collapsed empire who impersonates his target's best friend. A single angry punch from the genuine armoured man ends the masquerade.

feats.scene: Niaoror slips a stolen helmet under his arm and shoves aside a startled guard.
Niaoror reels from a furious armoured punch and lies sprawled and astonished.

name: Isiumnum
summary: Isiumnum was a clan elder in the dawn of farming who chose to appease a meteor-fed hunger. The sacrifice cost him his son's trust and, finally, his own life.

feats.scene: Isiumnum shoves a young man toward a glowing crater with both hands.
Isiumnum survives a drought-stricken season on dust and a handful of dates.

name: Nistel
summary: Nistel is a young street thief and a fast talker. Her stories about growing up are told to a girl who will one day command storms.

feats.scene: Nistel snatches a wallet from a passing trader's belt and darts into the crowd.
Nistel sleeps through a cold night in a crate and wakes sneezing but cheerful.

name: Ellantos
summary: Ellantos is a bald, blue-eyed boy grown in a laboratory nursery. He escapes his captors and wakes a green giant who becomes his protector.

feats.scene: Ellantos tugs a heavy bunker door handle with both small hands until it clicks.
Ellantos crouches through an alarm-blasted corridor and comes out dazed but whole.

name: Enleoti
summary: Enleoti is a capture-team operative from a far-future sprawl who tries to net a fire-wreathed celebrity and fails spectacularly. She laughs about it at the debrief and requests a bigger net.

feats.scene: Enleoti fires a stun net launcher that tears a hole in a billboard.
Enleoti is scorched by a passing flare and tumbles across a rooftop without serious harm.
Enleoti sprints along a skybridge after her target.

name: Nesaus
summary: Nesaus is a black, shifting organism of living tissue that bonds to wounded soldiers and grants them elongated fangs and claws. It has been stranded far from its home reality and fights on borrowed orders.

feats.scene: Nesaus rakes a clawed arm across a bunker door and tears it open.
Nesaus withstands a collapsing gantry and re-forms its body from the rubble.
Nesaus launches across a ravine on stretched limbs.

name: Llestuin
summary: Llestuin is a government investigator posted to a quiet town after a school was attacked by a giant machine. He interviews the staff with great politeness and takes meticulous notes.

feats.scene: Llestuin hammers a stuck window sash open with his palm.
Llestuin is thrown through a classroom door by a tremor and brushes off the plaster.
Llestuin jogs across a football field toward the rubble.

name: Anriatu
summary: Anriatu is a bald hired killer scarred in a ritual by his instructor and sent to claim a fifty-million fee. He treats the work with the pride of a craftsman and falls to someone far stranger.

feats.scene: Anriatu drives a knife through a motel door and pins a lock bolt.
Anriatu is hurled over a bed frame and lands on a night stand.
Anriatu runs down a corridor and kicks in a door.

name: Tututia
summary: Tututia is a bald, scarred mercenary who once weighed more than twice as much as he does today and wears the trace of two borrowed minds. He is flippant in combat and surprisingly sentimental at home on a small island refuge.

feats.scene: Tututia drives a sword through an armoured truck door in a single thrust.
Tututia is crushed beneath a toppled steel shelf and shoulders it off with a laugh.
Tututia sprints along a harbour wall in pursuit of a rival.

name: Osenan
summary: Osenan is a pale, red-eyed scout from a ruined reality who surveys other worlds as candidates for takeover. His ability to ignite the air proves fatal when a balloon full of volatile gas floats overhead.

feats.scene: Osenan ignites the gas of an airship and sets the whole sky alight.
Osenan shrugs off a fall from a swaying gondola onto a wooden deck.
Osenan sprints across a dockyard to board the airship.

name: Anell
summary: Anell is a sharp-tongued neighbour who judges everyone on her stairwell by whether they hold a steady wage. Her scorn is brutal and entirely harmless.

feats.scene: Anell slaps a rolled newspaper onto a banister loud enough to startle a pigeon.
Anell is knocked flat by a swinging door and complains for a week.
Anell hurries downstairs to catch the postman.

name: Lusaul
summary: Lusaul is a wandering warrior from a lofty hall who falls to giants in the snow and whose remains are used to spawn a hateful daughter. In life he could wear the shape of any beast, and soar as a bird.

feats.scene: Lusaul takes the shape of a bear and tears a giant's shield from its arm.
Lusaul is battered by a giant's club blow and rises still fighting.
Lusaul swoops over a frozen valley in the form of a hawk.

name: Aluernal
summary: Aluernal is a towering half-breed monarch of the birds who carries passengers on his back through storm and flame. His feathered legion has raided orchards in search of golden fruit.

feats.scene: Aluernal beats his wings once and flattens a fortress wall with the gust.
Aluernal withstands a pounding storm giant's fist and snaps his beak in answer.
Aluernal dives from the cloud ceiling to snatch a falling rider.

name: Stoani
summary: Stoani is a red-haired spellcaster from a long line of seal-keepers whose ancestors bound something terrible beneath the soil. A crow-shaped fiend ends her life.

feats.scene: Stoani calls up a ring of fire that cracks an old stone altar.
Stoani is flung against a shrine wall and rises, chanting.
Stoani sprints through the crypt toward the last seal.

name: Iulus
summary: Iulus is a proud lunar ruler who orders the murders of rivals' parents to secure his throne. His son's terrible voice dissolves him before he can finish a question.

feats.scene: Iulus slams a gilded staff on the marble and the whole hall falls silent.
Iulus is liquefied in a single hum of sound.
Iulus strides along a terrace to dismiss his court.

name: Rncar
summary: Rncar is a dark-haired worker in a polar toy shop who recruits an unwilling heir to fight a grim rival. He draws a pistol on a plane and tosses a parachute with a bright, reckless grin.

feats.scene: Rncar fires a pistol at a cabin ceiling and punches a hole in it.
Rncar tumbles across the ice after landing and bounces upright.
Rncar sprints over a frozen ridge toward the ruined workshop.

name: Raucorame
summary: Raucorame is a red-haired killer for hire who animates her own hair into whips and snares. She sells her services to a sinister immortal patron.

feats.scene: Raucorame lashes her hair around a pillar and tears the stone loose.
Raucorame is thrown across a hall and spins to land on her feet.
Raucorame vaults along a corridor after a fleeing target.

name: Iummar
summary: Iummar is a violet, shapeshifting organism that passes through many hosts including soldiers, scientists and a hired comic mercenary. It has joined and left a long list of crews and cults.

feats.scene: Iummar punches through a reinforced shutter and lifts a van off its wheels.
Iummar absorbs a cannon volley and closes its torn flesh within seconds.
Iummar bounds across a skyline in great leaping strides.

name: Orvalsiu
summary: Orvalsiu is a living mass whose host was killed so it could be merged into a larger monster. It fights with brute power, quickly knits its wounds, and shrugs off gunfire.

feats.scene: Orvalsiu hurls a parked car across a street at a fleeing guard.
Orvalsiu absorbs a point-blank volley of rifle rounds and shrugs.
Orvalsiu races along a wall on spindly limbs.

name: Luselion
summary: Luselion is a violet predator bonded to a ruthless host who tries to conquer a harbour district. It taunts victims with a sing-song voice before it strikes.

feats.scene: Luselion rakes a claw down a bus and peels it like an orange.
Luselion endures a crushing rooftop collapse and slithers free.
Luselion races across a bridge on all fours.

name: Rialer
summary: Rialer is a small shifting parasite that bonds to a pet gecko and then runs from its siblings. It can grow fangs and a long tongue on demand.

feats.scene: Rialer flicks a long tongue across a counter and knocks a jar to the floor.
Rialer shrugs off a heavy paw and reforms in a heartbeat.
Rialer skitters along a shelf and out of a window.

name: Ranam
summary: Ranam is a weary mother who seizes control of her family's future and is taken over by a violet organism for her trouble. She is then spat out into a test tube.

feats.scene: Ranam breathes a stream of acid across a rack of weapons and melts them into slag.
Ranam is thrown against a laboratory wall and the organism closes her wounds.
Ranam sprints along a warehouse aisle after her children.

name: Rniron
summary: Rniron is a bald, long-lived schemer who conspires with a fellow rebel to oppose the colossal sky-judges. His plot unravels within a few chapters and he pays with his life.

feats.scene: Rniron hurls a bolt of raw force that blasts a hilltop shrine to dust.
Rniron withstands the full weight of a collapsing temple dome.
Rniron streaks across a canyon in a shimmer of light.

name: Onria
summary: Onria is a green-eyed, blond member of an evolved lineage who fights with raw energy beams. Her family brings down jets over a harbour and are surprised that anyone dares to resist.

feats.scene: Onria blasts a squadron of fighter jets out of the sky with a single sweeping beam.
Onria withstands a vault explosion and is rebuilt by her city afterward.
Onria glides over a flooded plain on a column of light.

name: Uresum
summary: Uresum is a dyed-blond roommate, thief and lock-picker who drives his friends cross-country on a hunch. He scatters a pack of demons with nothing but a hatchback.

feats.scene: Uresum slams his hatchback into a snarling demon at full speed.
Uresum is thrown against a steering wheel by the impact and shakes it off.
Uresum pushes his car down a motorway at speed.

name: Ceiasor
summary: Ceiasor is a balding, grey-haired local who celebrates a lunar holiday with a pair of sorcerous neighbours. He is cheerful, slow and entirely ordinary.

feats.scene: Ceiasor clangs a pot lid against a pan to scare off a stray cat.
Ceiasor slips on an icy step and gets up laughing.
Ceiasor shuffles along a pavement toward the festival.

name: Oruluell
summary: Oruluell is a swarm-lord of buzzing insects whose revival goes disastrously wrong when it feeds on a raging powerhouse. The energy within his victim consumes him in an instant.

feats.scene: Oruluell sends a storm of stinging insects that strips the paint from a wall.
Oruluell is annihilated by an overload of absorbed energy that cracks the temple floor.
Oruluell surges across a courtyard as a cloud of wings.

name: Tuosecar
summary: Tuosecar is a nightmare-lord of an underworld whose name is whispered in a forbidden incantation. When the spell finishes, the room fills with cold and ash.

feats.scene: Tuosecar breathes a gust of grave-dust that strips a mountain village to bare stone.
Tuosecar withstands a chorus of blessed blades and wades onward.
Tuosecar streaks out of a rift in the floor.

name: Iuleoeo
summary: Iuleoeo is a physician who idolises a famed surgeon and carries a lucky ring he was never meant to keep. He loses it in a spirit battle and discovers his skill never depended on it.

feats.scene: Iuleoeo shoves a gurney through swinging doors and races it down a ward.
Iuleoeo is knocked flat by an unseen blast and gets up to treat the wounded.
Iuleoeo jogs the length of a hospital hall with a tray.

name: Lloiar
summary: Lloiar is a small shop owner in a quiet district who ends up defending himself in court after a brush with the police. He wins, and his lawyer's famous reputation cannot take credit.

feats.scene: Lloiar slams a shutter down so hard that the whole storefront rattles.
Lloiar is shoved against a counter by a rough officer and bruises a rib.
Lloiar hurries up the courthouse steps with his papers.

name: Ianum
summary: Ianum is an ambitious guard captain in a walled desert town who murders an old seer to seize the throne. A sorcerer then levels the whole place before he can enjoy it.

feats.scene: Ianum slashes a curved sword across a wooden door and splits it in two.
Ianum takes a heavy axe blow on his shield and staggers.
Ianum runs through a market street at the head of his guards.

name: Rasercen
summary: Rasercen is a towering sandstone servant of an ancient conqueror who swells to monstrous size in combat. He tires quickly and is defeated by a team of young heroes.

feats.scene: Rasercen smashes a stone pillar with a single backhand and brings down the ceiling.
Rasercen takes a volley of blasts on his chest and only chips.
Rasercen lumbers across a courtyard in thudding strides.

name: Serstuure
summary: Serstuure is a red-haired rebel leader in a twisted mirror realm who once ruled as a chitinous tyrant. He lost his throne, regained a mortal body and now fights a rival warlord.

feats.scene: Serstuure fires a cannon blast that obliterates a hilltop fortress.
Serstuure survives a collapsing citadel and crawls from the debris.
Serstuure flies across a canyon on insect wings.

name: Niantili
summary: Niantili is a rocky matriarch of a warrior people who named her sons at a great gathering. Her gravel voice carries across valleys.

feats.scene: Niantili hurls a boulder across a valley and shatters a cliff face.
Niantili shrugs off a landslide that buries the road behind her.
Niantili stomps down a mountain trail toward the gathering.

name: Iareaul
summary: Iareaul is a grey-haired, blue-skinned ruler of the waves who is querulous and proud. He commands a kingdom of drowned halls beside his wife.

feats.scene: Iareaul raises a tidal wall that smashes a harbour town to splinters.
Iareaul absorbs a thunderbolt from a rival on the open sea.
Iareaul rides a swell across the ocean at galloping speed.

name: Sernauama
summary: Sernauama is a prince raised in exile who has taken on a knightly guise and a stolen birthright. His power is a family secret he dreads using.

feats.scene: Sernauama unleashes a shout that brings down a palace colonnade.
Sernauama withstands a falling tower and walks out of the dust.
Sernauama leaps across a river gorge in a single bound.

name: Iumnesest
summary: Iumnesest is a young heir who stands beside a giant hound as hideous invaders overrun a hilltop capital. He watches in horror and never lifts a hand.

feats.scene: Iumnesest shoves a heavy gate bolt into place with both hands.
Iumnesest is knocked down by a rush of fleeing townsfolk and stands up pale.
Iumnesest runs along a rampart beside his hound.

name: Letelnes
summary: Letelnes is a six-armed ruler of the sky who beheads rivals and rampages across a harbour district. He travels to a far planet to conquer its swarming inhabitants and is brought low by a brave young heroine.

feats.scene: Letelnes crushes a tower base between four fists and topples the whole spire.
Letelnes shrugs off a barrage of tank shells and keeps climbing.
Letelnes leaps from rooftop to rooftop faster than a train.

name: Sumse
summary: Sumse is a former fisher who now keeps a bar in a seedy harbour and once nursed a wounded winged cat back to health. She hears of a plan to raze her street and passes it along.

feats.scene: Sumse hauls a heavy fishing net out of the water with both arms.
Sumse is knocked over by a swinging boom and spits seawater.
Sumse runs along a pier to wave down a passing boat.

name: Sescen
summary: Sescen is a monarch of a floating realm who raises a young stranger as a warrior and arranges his betrothal to her daughter. An invading sorcerer strikes her down within the hour.

feats.scene: Sescen raps a ceremonial staff against the throne and the hall falls silent.
Sescen is struck by a sorcerer's bolt and falls without a word.
Sescen strides across a courtyard to greet her visitor.

name: Amastan
summary: Amastan is a film producer's daughter who dates a wandering fighter for a few months and goes to the cinema every week. A paid killer shoots her father, and the truth about her boyfriend comes out too late.

feats.scene: Amastan pulls a heavy projector door shut and locks it.
Amastan is shoved against a lamp post by a panicking crowd and bruises an arm.
Amastan hurries down a neon-lit street toward the harbour.

name: Llilustu
summary: Llilustu is a clerk at a desert flight station who is merely listed among the people inside a building. Nobody ever finds out what he does all day.

feats.scene: Llilustu pushes a heavy filing cart across the linoleum.
Llilustu is knocked down by a sliding door and gets up red-faced.
Llilustu hurries along a hallway to reach the mess hall.

name: Rinlum
summary: Rinlum is a green-eyed spy who smuggles a defecting scientist past a frozen border with his partner. He strikes a guard with the man's own gun and pays for it in the snow.

feats.scene: Rinlum clubs a guard on the back of the head with a pistol grip.
Rinlum is tackled into a snowdrift by a pursuing sentry and rolls free.
Rinlum sprints across a snowfield toward the getaway car.

name: Llosia
summary: Llosia is a skateboarding kid who is bumped into traffic during a stranger's brawl and is rescued in the nick of time. He shows no gratitude whatsoever.

feats.scene: Llosia kicks his skateboard hard against a kerb and sends it spinning.
Llosia is clipped by a passing truck's mirror and rolls to a stop on the road.
Llosia rides his board down a hill at full speed.

name: Cenriatel
summary: Cenriatel is a courier who threads a dented cargo bike through rush-hour gridlock and plays loud songs on rooftops after dusk. Years of dodging traffic gave Cenriatel a sharp eye for trouble brewing on the block.

feats.scene: Cenriatel swings a heavy bike lock into the shin of a bat-wielding thug to buy time for the neighbours.
Cenriatel skids across wet asphalt after a bad swerve and gets up with only scraped palms.
Cenriatel sprints a bike down a crowded avenue to deliver a warning before the thugs arrive.

name: Nenlu
summary: Nenlu is a petty burglar who strapped a stolen engine pack to his back and joined a gang of jet-assisted crooks. Nenlu is better at running away than at fighting, and the gang tolerates him for his nerve.

feats.scene: Nenlu lands a rocket-boosted shoulder charge that splinters a warehouse door.
Nenlu crashes through a skylight and shakes off the fall to keep running.
Nenlu streaks over rooftops with the engine pack screaming at full burn.

name: Lusenias
summary: Lusenias is a violet-skinned fate-tinkerer from a workshop world, charged with nudging the life of one earthbound hero by tiny degrees. Lusenias is fond of stray cats and keeps one on the work bench.

feats.scene: Lusenias snaps a thread of probability, flipping a speeding delivery van off its course.
Lusenias absorbs a shockwave from a malfunctioning loom and merely blinks.

name: Amsor
summary: Amsor is a hired gun who wears a light flight harness fitted with twin lasers and small missiles. The harness out-turns most rivals, and grapple lines let Amsor and the crew vanish the moment a job goes wrong.

feats.scene: Amsor fires a missile salvo that turns a parked limousine into scrap.
Amsor's harness plating shrugs off a direct hit from a repulsor blast.
Amsor banks around a tower and outpaces a pursuing armoured flier.

name: Sorrosa
summary: Sorrosa is a blond courtier of a hidden mountain city who serves a scheming lord. Sorrosa greets visiting strangers with polished manners and a careful eye on the exits.

feats.scene: Sorrosa hurls a stone bench at an intruder to cover a retreat.
Sorrosa takes a rampaging guard's club across the back and stays standing.

name: Nanni
summary: Nanni is a runaway kid who can swell the head with light gas until it floats like a balloon. Nanni drifts over rooftops and can haul surprisingly heavy loads while inflated, and is the gentlest of a scrappy gang.

feats.scene: Nanni bumps a pursuer off a fire escape with a soft inflated head-butt.
Nanni bounces off a brick wall and floats upward unharmed.
Nanni drifts across the alley on a gust, towing a crate of stolen goods.

name: Celonlum
summary: Celonlum is an exile from a lantern-lit sister dimension, long mistaken for a wish spirit by the mortals nearby. Celonlum lost a cherished bangle and a way home, and settled into a quiet marriage that ended in violence.

feats.scene: Celonlum bends a wall of tarnished brass into a curling gate with a flick of the wrist.
Celonlum is struck by a collapsing temple roof and brushes off the dust.

name: Rnise
summary: Rnise is a grandmother who carried her family's savings out of a burning city inside hollow bangles. Rnise survived a long train journey on cunning and prayer, and the bangles were passed down through generations.

feats.scene: Rnise shoves a looter aside to keep her bangles from being torn away.
Rnise stumbles in a crowded station and rises without a scratch.

name: Nocelsto
summary: Nocelsto runs a small shop in a busy neighbourhood and asked a strongman for help against extortionists. Nocelsto has steady nerves and the plain stubbornness of someone who will not close up for threats.

feats.scene: Nocelsto slams a till drawer on a thug's fingers.
Nocelsto weathers a shove into a shelf of cans without dropping a stack.

name: Iuteont
summary: Iuteont is a shape-changing elder deity of the high winds who once tended gardens and temples, and who can speak with vast star-born giants. Iuteont has died by fire and by its own hand, and returned each time.

feats.scene: Iuteont drops a gale-driven spear into a cliff face and flattens the ridge behind it.
Iuteont is caught in the full blast of a collapsing peak and rises from the rubble.
Iuteont streaks over an ocean faster than the sound of its own thunder.

name: Olialri
summary: Olialri is a bronze-clad war champion who sailed with a fleet of kings against a walled city. Olialri disgraced himself by violating a sanctuary, and ended with a hunted man's reputation.

feats.scene: Olialri drives a spear through a shield and the man behind it.
Olialri is pelted with a hail of stones and bleeds without falling.
Olialri charges across the beach ahead of the whole line.

name: Iucorlus
summary: Iucorlus is a red-skinned prize fighter from a molten underground race who was forced into service after a crackdown on heroes. Iucorlus brawls for a living and lost a ring bout when a silent monarch stepped in.

feats.scene: Iucorlus hammers an arena pillar until it cracks from top to bottom.
Iucorlus walks out of a magma vent unburnt after a rival's trick.
Iucorlus bursts out of his corner and drives the opponent into the ropes.

name: Saunumnt
summary: Saunumnt is a reclusive hermit whose name sits on a government watchlist of unregistered gifted people. Saunumnt keeps no records of his own and may have slipped away long before any agent arrived.

feats.scene: Saunumnt uproots a fence post and flings it clean across a ditch.
Saunumnt takes a van's glancing blow and shakes it off.

name: Vanen
summary: Vanen is a weaver's granddaughter who was bitten by an arachnid sacred to a desert deity. Vanen now sprouts ghostly extra arms that mend wounds and shield allies, and seeks a cure for a failing elder.

feats.scene: Vanen lashes a ghostly limb across a gunman's chest and drops him flat.
Vanen blocks a pickup truck with spectral limbs and holds it still.

name: Viatorcal
summary: Viatorcal is a blue-skinned stellar sentinel who guards a shard of a sacred gem tree. Viatorcal appears in the dreams of a thief who carries the shard, nudging her toward a nobler path.

feats.scene: Viatorcal cleaves an asteroid in two with a pulse from the shard.
Viatorcal weathers a barrage of meteor fragments without flinching.

name: Niuanses
summary: Niuanses is a grey-haired colonel of a sea-dwelling army stationed at a distant outpost. Niuanses shoots first at anything that crosses sovereign airspace and takes prisoners with stiff formality.

feats.scene: Niuanses fells a guard with a rifle butt strike during a drill.
Niuanses is thrown by a depth charge and rises to bark orders.

name: Nater
summary: Nater is a shadow-cult fighter sent to wear down a rival swordswoman and win her over. Nater strikes quickly with short blades and withdraws the moment the tide turns.

feats.scene: Nater slashes a lantern in half mid-flight with a short blade.
Nater takes a kick through a paper wall and rolls to her feet.
Nater vaults a courtyard wall in one bound.

name: Tumrosiu
summary: Tumrosiu is a masterless blade who came home from a long overseas war to find a family slain. Tumrosiu hunted down every soldier involved and refuses to put down the sword even when the quarrel is settled.

feats.scene: Tumrosiu cuts down a line of spearmen in a single sweeping draw.
Tumrosiu takes an arrow through the shoulder and keeps advancing.
Tumrosiu runs down a fleeing officer through a rice field.

name: Orarn
summary: Orarn is a small boy whose short life was spent on a quiet estate while his father was away at war. Orarn's memory drives a dark crusade long after the estate burned.

feats.scene: Orarn tosses a wooden practice sword and watches it clatter across the floor.
Orarn tumbles from a low branch and laughs it off.

name: Nanvate
summary: Nanvate is a bald king deposed and murdered by a jealous sibling. Nanvate's restless ghost returned to forbid his son's execution, and the curse it spoke unmade the usurper's court.

feats.scene: Nanvate's ghost speaks a curse and the usurper's palace roof collapses in dust.
Nanvate in life is struck down by a blade in the throne room.

name: Cecoium
summary: Cecoium is a shaven-headed fighter of a hill clan who first scoffed at a foreign swordsman's lessons. Cecoium respects strength only when he has felt it in the ring.

feats.scene: Cecoium swings a wooden staff into a post and splits it.
Cecoium absorbs a stranger's body slam and answers with a grin.

name: Riaan
summary: Riaan is a bald cultist who guarded a pulsing relic for a doomsday sect. Riaan misplaced the relic in a swamp and paid for the blunder with his life.

feats.scene: Riaan shoves a canoe from the reeds and pole-vaults over a log.
Riaan is hurled into black water by a blast and surfaces gasping.

name: Orcor
summary: Orcor is a dark-haired spellcaster who wove illusions strong enough to look like a living mother. Orcor passed craft and heartache down to descendants, though few remember her face.

feats.scene: Orcor projects a phantom crowd that sends a pursuing mob running.
Orcor stands unharmed as a shelf of jars shatters around her.

name: Amatirn
summary: Amatirn is a once-celebrated field agent who lost an eye in a prison raid and later received a cybernetic replacement. Amatirn carries the guilt of a team that died because she trusted nobody.

feats.scene: Amatirn drives a bare knuckle into a guard's jaw and drops him.
Amatirn endures weeks in a cage and still walks out under her own power.
Amatirn sprints through a mine tunnel with a prosthetic eye blinking.

name: Tarli
summary: Tarli is a shaven-headed guard captain from an ancient highland kingdom who commands an elite corps of spear women. Tarli expels the headstrong and hires them back when a traitor runs off with a hoard of rare metal.

feats.scene: Tarli plants a spear through a training dummy and the post behind it.
Tarli blocks a falling beam with her forearms and holds her ground.

name: Iumtir
summary: Iumtir is a tyrant who murdered his brother for a throne and then believed flattery that he was divine. Iumtir leapt from a tower to prove he could fly and the cobbles settled the argument.

feats.scene: Iumtir cracks a whip across a servant's back and shatters a clay jug.
Iumtir is struck by a hurled stool during a rebellion and snarls.

name: Onses
summary: Onses is an orphaned girl who survived a destroyed airliner and can lift objects with her mind. Onses fled a faction that wanted to use her as a weapon and begged a wealthy inventor to take her in.

feats.scene: Onses wrenches a metal gauntlet through a screen and the wall behind it.
Onses is thrown clear of a burning wreck and lands on a grassy bank.

name: Steineva
summary: Steineva is a tattooed assassin with bone claws who turned on his own team's leader at the worst possible moment. Steineva's treachery set off a chain of ruin, and nobody knows where he went afterward.

feats.scene: Steineva rakes triple claws through an armoured plate and the man in it.
Steineva takes a thunderous blow to the chest and keeps slashing.
Steineva darts across a tower floor in a blur.

name: Cotuman
summary: Cotuman is a clawed mercenary whose healing gift was turned against him by a death trap that burns the flesh the moment it begins to mend. Cotuman and a companion were caught and could not break free.

feats.scene: Cotuman drives claws through a steel cage panel in a desperate bid to escape.
Cotuman endures flamethrower bursts while his flesh knits and burns again.

name: Orvil
summary: Orvil is a blue-skinned, red-eyed enforcer of a death-herald order who tortured his father for years with borrowed atomic flame. Orvil serves a distant tyrant and holds grudges longer than the sun holds heat.

feats.scene: Orvil hurls a fireball that boils a quarry lake in a single flash.
Orvil walks through a collapsing tower unscathed.

name: Llitortor
summary: Llitortor is a criminal with sharp senses, retractable claws and a body that mends quickly, clearly the child of a famous brawler. Llitortor works for shady syndicates and enjoys the fear he stirs.

feats.scene: Llitortor rakes his claws through a steel locker and the thug inside.
Llitortor is clipped by a speeding truck and heals before the next fight.

name: Liuennen
summary: Liuennen is a claw-fighter who lived in luxury among a ruling clique until a conqueror took a reality-bending glove for himself. Liuennen died quickly when the new master strode in.

feats.scene: Liuennen slashes a marble statue in half during a feast.
Liuennen takes a shotgun blast to the ribs without breaking his smile.

name: Eoull
summary: Eoull is a clawed adventurer adopted into a foreign family who later chased revenge against an absent father. Eoull swapped sides many times and now fights alongside former rivals as a hero.

feats.scene: Eoull rakes three claws through a steel grate to reach a hostage.
Eoull stands through a barrage of gunfire and keeps closing in.

name: Neser
summary: Neser is a mohawked layabout who cashed his elderly father's pension cheques and dumped him in a care home. Neser relocated to a sunny coast when the resident manager seemed to be smothered by a green giant's pillow.

feats.scene: Neser swings a golf club at a seagull and misses by a mile.
Neser is knocked flat by a hurled lawn chair and bounces back.

name: Tentocal
summary: Tentocal is a yellow-eyed, white-haired shinobi who serves a shadow order in an alternate timeline. Tentocal vanishes into the rafters between strikes and favours a precise, quiet finish.

feats.scene: Tentocal pins a guard's sleeve to a pillar with a thrown blade.
Tentocal drops three floors onto tile and rolls clear unhurt.
Tentocal races along a ledge faster than a guard can aim.

name: Alsar
summary: Alsar is a seasoned captain of an elite guard unit who took part in a training patrol against hunting aliens. Alsar was killed on a raid into a sacred mound where the hunters sought precious ore.

feats.scene: Alsar drives a spear through an armoured hunter's plating.
Alsar is slammed against a stone wall and rises to fight on.

name: Rnniuso
summary: Rnniuso is a shadow-order ninja who tried to murder a rival swordswoman and failed. Rnniuso's final lunge was blocked and he paid for the attempt with his life.

feats.scene: Rnniuso lunges with a knife and slices a curtain in two.
Rnniuso takes a hard kick to the ribs and keeps his footing.

name: Sanerntel
summary: Sanerntel is a dark-haired contract soldier who favours a hunting knife and whose reputation was always a notch below his rivals'. Sanerntel was abandoned by a paymaster who judged him worthless.

feats.scene: Sanerntel plunges a knife into a crate to pin a map in place.
Sanerntel is thrown into a harbour wall and gets up cursing.

name: Iasteaun
summary: Iasteaun is a crimson-robed sorcerer counted among the greatest casters of a lost age, who answered a summons of the old mystic powers. Iasteaun lived before the great cataclysm and left scattered lore in dusty tomes.

feats.scene: Iasteaun calls down a lightning storm that flattens a stone fortress.
Iasteaun withstands a rival's roaring inferno behind a shimmering ward.

name: Orosista
summary: Orosista is the late matriarch of a grain-plain estate and grandmother of a legendary freeholder. Orosista outlived a daughter and a grandson, and the estate remembers her as a tough farmer.

feats.scene: Orosista hefts a sack of grain onto a cart in a single swing.
Orosista rides through a dust storm and finishes the harvest.

name: Sororce
summary: Sororce is a blond immortal who woke from a false mortal life and became a servant at a cold northern court. Sororce was crushed by a purple-skinned titan who killed several of her kin in turn.

feats.scene: Sororce brings a stone arch down on pursuers in a flash of pale light.
Sororce resists the first crushing grip of a titan before it overcomes her.

name: Vatiame
summary: Vatiame is a civilised general who despised the wilder clans and plotted to steal a kingdom while travelling south. Vatiame murdered one companion and was struck down by the king he betrayed.

feats.scene: Vatiame hacks through a wicker shield with a heavy blade.
Vatiame is clubbed from his horse and rises with blood on his brow.

name: Tosver
summary: Tosver is a four-armed, face-tattooed fiend who infiltrated a task force sent to stop a rampaging storm-witch. Tosver followed a trapped dark master and was hunted down years later and beheaded.

feats.scene: Tosver hurls four flaming blades at once and cuts a gate off its posts.
Tosver takes a thunderclap at close range and stays on her feet.

name: Orntu
summary: Orntu is a dark-eyed seeress who glimpses short flashes of the future. Orntu stood by a crusading knight on a trading island, helping him dodge ambushes with half-seen warnings.

feats.scene: Orntu shoves a startled soldier off a ledge after foreseeing his strike.
Orntu is thrown against a market stall and walks away shaken.

name: Isntron
summary: Isntron is a four-tentacled visitor who crossed space to recruit road haulers for his people. Isntron staged a friendly race to choose a champion and lifted a whole roadside eatery into orbit as a prize.

feats.scene: Isntron hoists a roadside building off its foundation with a tractor beam.
Isntron takes a meteor graze across the hull of his scout ship.

name: Isontne
summary: Isontne is a fair-haired expatriate who works with a resistance cell in a port city under occupation. Isontne hides refugee children from patrols and takes them to a trusted leader.

feats.scene: Isontne swings a lantern into a patrolman's helmet in an alley.
Isontne is thrown to the cobblestones by an officer and gets up quietly.

name: Vallis
summary: Vallis is a grey-haired barge captain who ferried two fugitives across a harbour at night. Vallis later passed what he knew to a relentless pursuer, driven by money and fear.

feats.scene: Vallis heaves a mooring rope onto a piling with one throw.
Vallis is knocked flat by a swinging boom and gets back to the wheel.

name: Tenanieo
summary: Tenanieo is a black-haired racketeer who ran a bootleg empire from a windy lakeside city. Tenanieo was shot dead by a traveller from the future during a time-hopping errand.

feats.scene: Tenanieo cracks a cane across a defaulter's knuckles.
Tenanieo is shoved into a limousine door and straightens his coat.

name: Leosi
summary: Leosi is a moustached hero of an obscure national circuit who defeated a pompadoured villain, only to see his city wrecked by visiting rogues. Leosi joined a ragtag legion of forgotten champions that proved to be a hoax.

feats.scene: Leosi swings his sword and cuts a banner pole clean in two.
Leosi is thrown through a cafe window and returns, dusting off his cape.

name: Lartor
summary: Lartor is a heavy-set crime lord who ruled a harbour district through bribery and muscle. Lartor was executed one night by a lone gunman and nobody mourned him.

feats.scene: Lartor flips a dining table onto a rival's lap.
Lartor takes a punch from a bodyguard in a test of loyalty and never blinks.

name: Sacos
summary: Sacos is a blond informant who sold a vigilante's location to a crime matriarch. Sacos survives by trading whispers and slipping out of back doors.

feats.scene: Sacos slams a car door on a pursuer's leg and flees.
Sacos is rammed by a delivery cart and limps away.

name: Iasronco
summary: Iasronco is a racketeer in a spider-themed gang who outwitted his own boss with a swapped voodoo doll. Iasronco let the boss throw the wrong effigy out a thirteenth-floor window and watched it all unfold.

feats.scene: Iasronco tips an office chair into a rival's path.
Iasronco is hurled over a desk and shakes out his coat.

name: Auvaloli
summary: Auvaloli is a cheerful morning broadcaster who interviews an unusual guest on a live set. Auvaloli keeps the cameras rolling when everybody else runs for the exits.

feats.scene: Auvaloli taps a prop mallet on the set desk to get attention.
Auvaloli is knocked off a stool by a surprise guest and finishes the segment.

name: Corcaror
summary: Corcaror is a thick-browed, blue-eyed businessman from a small coastal town who shared a brief kiss at a party. Corcaror is an ordinary human with no gifts beyond cheerful good manners.

feats.scene: Corcaror claps a neighbour's shoulder hard enough to rattle his teeth.
Corcaror slips on a garden path and brushes off the grass.

name: Antaam
summary: Antaam is a brown-haired parodist who records comic songs about masked heroes and lets them play on late-night radio. Antaam's catalogue includes an album built entirely around gifted outcasts.

feats.scene: Antaam hammers an accordion bellows to start the chorus.
Antaam is jostled by an excited crowd and keeps singing.

name: Iumnen
summary: Iumnen is a stargazing sage of a remote world who was swallowed by a cosmic devourer along with many other minds. Iumnen's voice still murmurs from inside the beast's chorus of captives.

feats.scene: Iumnen projects a hum of pure thought that cracks a glass dome.
Iumnen survives being absorbed into a devouring colossus.

name: Tarnu
summary: Tarnu is a blue-skinned politician of a militant stellar empire who corners a warlord about a hidden seed. Tarnu works through whispers and veiled threats rather than force.

feats.scene: Tarnu shoves a council chair across the marble floor.
Tarnu is slammed against a wall by a furious warlord and stays standing.

name: Aunvavos
summary: Aunvavos is a pale, white-haired descendant of old aristocrats who defends a vanished world of wealth against a fairer society. Aunvavos can generate blinding beams of light and wields them against any who oppose the old order.

feats.scene: Aunvavos fires a lance of white light that cuts a boulder cleanly in two.
Aunvavos is mauled by a pack of beasts and holds her ground.

name: Renvases
summary: Renvases is a black-haired thief who snatched a legendary relic from its resting place. Renvases gambles that a quick escape is worth any consequence that follows.

feats.scene: Renvases pries a lid off a sarcophagus with a crowbar.
Renvases drops from a rooftop onto a pile of sacks and runs.

name: Tiaon
summary: Tiaon is a smoke-bound wish spirit who answers whoever summons it from an ancient oil lamp. Tiaon has worn many shapes over the centuries, flying through the air and rearranging reality until its master's will is fulfilled.

feats.scene: Tiaon raises a palace from the sand in a night and unmakes it by dawn.
Tiaon shrugs off a barrage of siege rocks hurled from the walls.
Tiaon streaks across the desert as a column of smoke.

name: Vaine
summary: Vaine is a corporate executive of a food conglomerate in a smog-choked future, who tried to burn a crusader with ceiling lasers. Vaine's own protective bubble was dissolved by a vat of hungry bacteria.

feats.scene: Vaine sweeps a laser across a boardroom floor and melts the carpet.
Vaine hits the glass wall of his bubble and the pane holds.

name: Eonnoco
summary: Eonnoco is a tyrannical baron who has kept control of a fiefdom for twelve years by relying on a giant champion. Eonnoco bought a peasant girl as a gift and watched his champion fall in the arena.

feats.scene: Eonnoco cracks a riding crop across a servant's cheek.
Eonnoco is thrown from his horse and brushes off the dust.

name: Rnotasi
summary: Rnotasi is a giant green-haired arachnid of the gulf between worlds, a magical being who weaves living things out of blood. Rnotasi guards an eye that sorcerers borrow for desperate rites of resurrection.

feats.scene: Rnotasi spins a web of blood that forms a living wall across a valley.
Rnotasi stands unharmed in a storm of arcane shrapnel.

name: Niamale
summary: Niamale is a burrowing criminal who dug out an ancient wrist-mounted gravity engine from a buried ruin. Niamale used it to sink a whole prison deep underground and then pull it back up.

feats.scene: Niamale drags a prison block thousands of miles down through the crust and lifts it back.
Niamale is buffeted by a fist in a tunnel and shakes it off.

name: Iumnate
summary: Iumnate is a gas-wielding schemer whose chemists forgot to wear masks and scared themselves to death. Iumnate relies on terror, leaving brutal work to his henchmen.

feats.scene: Iumnate releases a pressurised canister that fogs an alley.
Iumnate is tossed onto a trash heap and crawls free.

name: Neilcor
summary: Neilcor is a bald spy who used occult lore and island superstition to raise the dead with enchanted headbands. Neilcor sent knife-wielding corpses to lure a sea prince into a watery ambush.

feats.scene: Neilcor raises a platoon of corpses that overruns a coastal watchtower.
Neilcor is struck by a hurled stone and carries on chanting.

name: Ntnan
summary: Ntnan is a brown-haired farmer who gave up a computer career for a quiet life on the plains. Ntnan is a married father who prizes rows of corn over screens.

feats.scene: Ntnan swings an axe into a stump and splits it.
Ntnan falls from a hay wagon and stands up laughing.

name: Sersau
summary: Sersau is a brilliant codebreaker and mathematician who laid the groundwork for thinking machines. Sersau's name is honoured by later inventors, and a cybernetic tribe adopted it as a title of reverence.

feats.scene: Sersau slams a chalk board against a desk in frustration.
Sersau takes a hard fall from a bicycle and goes right on calculating.

name: Numaus
summary: Numaus is a wealthy nobleman and famous wanderer who took a blue gem from a dying hermit. Numaus found that the ring rallied good men to his cause, but a crossbow bolt ended his rebellion.

feats.scene: Numaus thrusts a rapier through a leather shield.
Numaus is dragged from his saddle by a charging lancer and fights on.

name: Ticore
summary: Ticore is a proud divine-born warrior who challenged another to a blood duel and lost. Ticore's fall startled the watching hosts and showed how fragile the immortals had become on mortal ground.

feats.scene: Ticore smashes a battle-axe into a boulder and cracks it to dust.
Ticore takes a hammer blow to the helm and keeps swinging.

name: Valtel
summary: Valtel is a stooped mine-dweller who found a nugget of ancient power and forged a circlet that promised dominion over the world. Valtel renounced affection to wield it and drove his people to dig until a pair of heroes seized it.

feats.scene: Valtel unleashes a surge from the circlet that collapses a mine shaft.
Valtel endures a cave-in with the circlet blazing on his brow.

name: Iasrniseo
summary: Iasrniseo is a black-haired android assassin built for fast, brutal killing and recruited into a squad of alternate warriors. Iasrniseo was ripped in two by a bus and still tried to take down a monstrous foe.

feats.scene: Iasrniseo drives a servo-powered fist through a wall of sheet steel.
Iasrniseo is struck by a falling bus and is crushed below the waist.

name: Neleosor
summary: Neleosor is a red-eyed android bristling with six hidden claws, and a defender in a dreamed-up future war. Neleosor fought an ancient monster until a genius armoured in virtual steel finished it.

feats.scene: Neleosor extends six claws and rips through a hovering drone.
Neleosor is blasted by a creature's roar and remains on his feet.

name: Calnes
summary: Calnes is a careful physician who devised a drug cocktail and a skin patch to help a volatile patient. Calnes was rewarded with a cruel costume prank and a fatal beating.

feats.scene: Calnes pushes a heavy medicine cabinet shut with one shoulder.
Calnes is thrown into a gurney by a patient and stands up wincing.

name: Tialonin
summary: Tialonin is a banker who ran a savings firm into bankruptcy and then invested the money with an in-law. Tialonin collects a handsome salary and a bad reputation.

feats.scene: Tialonin slams a ledger on his desk in an angry meeting.
Tialonin trips on an office stair and brushes down his suit.

name: Niateocau
summary: Niateocau is a modest man who shared a history with another version of himself and later chatted with a famous cartoonist. Niateocau lives an unremarkable life that gets a short mention in a magazine.

feats.scene: Niateocau lifts a heavy portfolio onto a studio shelf.
Niateocau hits his head on a low beam and carries on talking.

name: Aunseia
summary: Aunseia is a grey-haired monk and healer, born of an immortal father and a smoke-spirit mother, who tends the sick at a remote mountain temple. Aunseia carries a cold vow that the next touch of death on a certain sibling will be fatal.

feats.scene: Aunseia calls a soundless wave that flings a rampaging beast across a courtyard.
Aunseia shrugs off an avalanche on the temple steps.

name: Maosuri
summary: Maosuri is a balding dimension-hopping entrepreneur who teamed with a counterpart to sell trips into hero bodies. Maosuri's portal business was shut down by an angry lawyer and her friends.

feats.scene: Maosuri opens a shimmering portal that tears a gap in a warehouse wall.
Maosuri is tackled by a customs guard and stumbles back up.

name: Luriama
summary: Luriama is a white-haired android modelled on a celebrated scholar of light and time. Luriama was built for a think tank in the cellar of a small town and learned more of humanity by hiding from the cleaners.

feats.scene: Luriama topples a bookcase onto a pursuing guard.
Luriama is smashed by a thrown shield and rebuilt by a fellow machine.

name: Vaonell
