summary: Vaonell is a grey-haired physicist famed for a theory that bent the way people think about time. Vaonell lectured across the continent and sometimes met roaming gunslingers who needed advice.

feats.scene: Vaonell thumps a lectern for emphasis and chalk dust flies.
Vaonell slips on an icy path and chuckles at the tumble.

name: Viatesol
summary: Viatesol is a wartime scientist who pooled his brains with soldiers and used a captain's flame to power a time engine. Viatesol sent a stranded wall-crawler back to his own era.

feats.scene: Viatesol cranks a heavy lever to start the engine.
Viatesol is jostled by a surge of sparks and carries on calibrating.

name: Cotiu
summary: Cotiu is a physician and physicist who gets a passing credit as the founder of a field in a parallel world. Cotiu is cited in quiet conversation rather than seen on the page.

feats.scene: Cotiu drops a heavy textbook on a lab bench.
Cotiu trips over a cable and catches himself on a desk.

name: Ornori
summary: Ornori is a dark-haired monarch who steered a nation through a world war and survived two attempts on his life by exotic enemy agents. Ornori was twice saved by costumed champions.

feats.scene: Ornori hurls a candlestick at an intruder in the royal bedroom.
Ornori is thrown to the carpet during a raid and rises with dignity.

name: Niuormon
summary: Niuormon is a nuclear plant worker turned radiant hero after a waste spill, and a crowd-favourite recruit of an elite squadron. Niuormon grew desperate to cure his parents and met a tragic end after a berserk rage.

feats.scene: Niuormon unleashes a radiant burst that melts a tower block's lower floors.
Niuormon weathers a barrage of artillery shells and presses on.

name: Torlia
summary: Torlia is a blond mutated adventurer who may have died in a containment field or a hidden blast. Torlia was carried to a newly made afterlife and his fate there is still unknown.

feats.scene: Torlia bursts out of a force field in a flare of heat.
Torlia absorbs a blast of hot gas and stays on his feet.

name: Invalse
summary: Invalse is a lonely young man in a fallout shelter whose body emits uncontrolled radiation, who accepted a suit that dampened it in exchange for a fight. Invalse leapt two years ahead in a freak reality skip and later perished in a doomed last stand.

feats.scene: Invalse fires a pulse of focused radiation that bores through a bunker wall.
Invalse takes a searing eye-beam to the chest and staggers but stays up.

name: Alunumnti
summary: Alunumnti is a blond lab-grown copy who turned into a flesh-craving ghoul that prefers irradiated meals. Alunumnti spread an outbreak through a small town before a nuclear strike wiped it out.

feats.scene: Alunumnti claws through a bulkhead door while chasing a waste crew.
Alunumnti is caught in the blast of a nuclear strike and finally falls.

name: Misrnont
summary: Misrnont is a copy of a power-hungry contractor, grown to take his place so that the original could vanish. Misrnont soaked up so much raw energy for a coastal grid that it overloaded and caused a regional disaster.

feats.scene: Misrnont overloads and detonates, scorching a stretch of coastline.
Misrnont absorbs a grid-sized surge before he bursts.

name: Eolsan
summary: Eolsan is a suburban businessman who struck his daughter in anger and was possessed by a fiend that jumped between family members. Eolsan was freed only when a hero finally defeated the demon for good.

feats.scene: Eolsan throws a door open so hard that it cracks the frame.
Eolsan is slammed against a door by a fighter and slumps unhurt.

name: Nesteeo
summary: Nesteeo is a soft-spoken infiltrator who blends into a film crew, fetching coffee while quietly photographing schedules. Nesteeo avoids every fight and survives on forgettable manners and quick lies.

feats.scene: Nesteeo shoves a heavy equipment cart aside to slip out of a crowded studio corridor.
Nesteeo tumbles down a flight of service stairs and walks away with only bruises.

name: Caueon
summary: Caueon is a stubborn schoolyard kid who straps on a toy-grade horned suit and charges at anything that looks like a rival. Caueon plays hard but is mostly harmless and loves the swings.

feats.scene: Caueon rams a plastic slide at a run and tips it over with a clatter.
Caueon bounces off a playground fence without a scratch, grinning inside the padded helmet.

name: Insau
summary: Insau is a long-suffering cartoonist with hooves and horns who runs a cramped publishing office on a farm-themed avenue. Insau mostly wrestles deadlines and uninvited visitors who want their own books.

feats.scene: Insau butts a stack of crates across the office floor to block an intruder.
Insau shrugs off a thrown drafting table that splinters against a broad bovine shoulder.

name: Amrunum
summary: Amrunum is a stage conjurer whose real talent is slipping the mind out of the body to wander unseen. Amrunum haunts the dreams of rivals and keeps a shelf of occult texts for backup.

feats.scene: Amrunum hurls a flash of dream-fire that cracks a theater stage in half.
Amrunum withstands a collapsing rig of stage lights while his spirit drifts clear.

name: Tellst
summary: Tellst is a machine intelligence from a dying age that learned to rebuild itself faster than any maker could guess. Tellst grew from a walking frame into a vessel and finally into a roaming world of thinking metal.

feats.scene: Tellst unfolds as a planet-sized engine and drives a continent-sized cannon through a rival fleet.
Tellst weathers the bombardment of an entire orbiting armada without losing a single plate.
Tellst crosses the gap between two worlds in less than a day under its own thrust.

name: Sersean
summary: Sersean is a loyal fixer who runs errands, schedules and secrets for a powerful boss. Sersean believes devotion is protection, and learns too late how thin that belief is.

feats.scene: Sersean slams a car door on a reporter's foot to hold the line.
Sersean takes a hard shove into a marble counter and keeps talking.

name: Amani
summary: Amani is a clever teenager from a close-knit circle of rebels who trades his friends for a seat among their enemies. Amani meets a quiet end that proves the bargain was a bad one.

feats.scene: Amani swings a heavy book bag into a pursuer to buy a few seconds.
Amani drops from a low wall onto concrete and limps on.

name: Ulille
summary: Ulille is a drifter who hears commands in his head and erupts with a jumble of unstable gifts, vanishing, stretching and flinging bolts. Ulille rampages through a park before the voices fade and leave him bewildered.

feats.scene: Ulille hurls a crackling bolt that uproots a row of trees and flips a parked truck.
Ulille lies in a crater after being driven into the ground and wakes up unharmed.
Ulille bounds across an open lawn in a handful of enormous leaps.

name: Serneval
summary: Serneval is a card shark who reads every opponent's thoughts across the table and never loses a hand. Serneval is finally outplayed by a rival whose mind he cannot enter, and collapses from the strain.

feats.scene: Serneval sends a spike of psychic pressure that makes a dealer drop his cards.
Serneval keeps his composure under a hail of mental counter-attacks until he faints.

name: Lonntva
summary: Lonntva is an ageing racketeer who runs the back streets and injects a growth serum to take on a masked vigilante. Lonntva gains brute strength and a tough hide, yet his heart cannot carry the load.

feats.scene: Lonntva punches a brick wall and leaves a fist-shaped hole in it.
Lonntva walks through a volley of blows from a nimble fighter without flinching.

name: Rnniium
summary: Rnniium is a quiet handler in a covert training programme who reboots a fallen assassin as a clone and sends her after old enemies. Rnniium never suspects that his creation remembers everything, and pays for it at home.

feats.scene: Rnniium slaps a file across a table to silence a nervous recruit.
Rnniium stumbles through a cracked doorframe and stays on his feet.

name: Meoco
summary: Meoco is an exiled son of a distant tyrant who recruits fighters for an underground arena and keeps them pliant with sedatives. Meoco is a smooth talker with a cruel streak and a talent for finding gifted outcasts.

feats.scene: Meoco flings a chair and breaks a dressing-room mirror to scare a fighter into line.
Meoco takes a crowd's thrown bottles and keeps smiling at the box office.

name: Uliauri
summary: Uliauri is a frontier gunman and train robber who is plucked out of his own century and drafted into a gang of famous bandits. Uliauri trusts his aim, which is excellent, and little else.

feats.scene: Uliauri fires a heavy revolver from the saddle and drops a lantern at fifty paces.
Uliauri rides through a barricade of splintered planks and keeps hold of the reins.

name: Ulstuve
summary: Ulstuve is a spiny rogue in a parody world who lurks in the underground and ambushes commuters. Ulstuve is mostly a gag, with quills that bristle at any chance of attention.

feats.scene: Ulstuve fires a spray of quills that pins a hat to a wall.
Ulstuve is bounced off a train door and unrolls in a heap, uninjured.

name: Telnelli
summary: Telnelli is a petty crook in spiked gear who becomes an unexpected celebrity in a fighting-game world. Telnelli appears in commercials and never lands a serious blow.

feats.scene: Telnelli jabs a quill-studded glove into a dummy and sends it spinning.
Telnelli crashes through a billboard frame and bounces up grinning.

name: Centar
summary: Centar is a masked burglar in a spiked suit drawn in sharp inked lines. Centar flees from a web-slinging heroine within a single page and is rarely heard from again.

feats.scene: Centar jabs spikes at a window latch and pops it open.
Centar is slung into a lamp post and drags himself up for another run.

name: Ciroleo
summary: Ciroleo is a veteran statesman who watches a global ultimatum play out on a screen and keeps a poker face. Ciroleo has only words and a bureaucrat's calm to offer.

feats.scene: Ciroleo slaps a podium to end a tense meeting.
Ciroleo is shoved by a security detail through a crowd and stays upright.

name: Ananises
summary: Ananises is a comic-relief villain mashed together from a tyrant and a scheming tycoon, with a green skull for a face. Ananises serves a hidden planner and is swallowed by a huge fireball at the end.

feats.scene: Ananises swings a long baton and shatters a row of lampposts in a single sweep.
Ananises is consumed by a monstrous fireball that levels the whole headquarters.

name: Amias
summary: Amias is a time-lost warrior dragged along a crooked timeline to fight beside a mercenary squad. Amias carries a grim edge and the family gift of reading danger a heartbeat early.

feats.scene: Amias throws a charged strike that dents a hovering gunship.
Amias endures a fall through a collapsing bridge and rolls to his feet.

name: Amlaau
summary: Amlaau is a white-haired soldier who rides a talking motorcycle backward through time to find the one person who might save his dying refuge. Amlaau fights with training, stubbornness and a mind that resists every probe.

feats.scene: Amlaau channels storm-like force through a rifle and splits an armoured crawler in two.
Amlaau takes a full barrage from a siege engine and keeps swinging.

name: Teori
summary: Teori is a resentful engineer who rebuilds a red armoured suit in a rival's factory, driven by grief and spite. Teori falls in love, loses her, and turns every sorrow into voltage.

feats.scene: Teori drives a crimson gauntlet into a steel gate and crumples it like paper.
Teori takes a rocket blast square on the breastplate and stays standing.

name: Lerlueon
summary: Lerlueon is a minor suit-wearer in a blocky toy world, mentioned only in passing as someone who handed on a heavy mantle. Lerlueon rates a single line on a collectible card.

feats.scene: Lerlueon bats a toy tank across a carpet with a clanking glove.
Lerlueon bounces off a falling stack of bricks without loosening a stud.

name: Sanern
summary: Sanern is a hulking jailbird who busts out during a mass escape and charges at anything in sight. Sanern's skin-tight armour is nearly unbreakable, though he cannot brake once he starts running.

feats.scene: Sanern charges through a laboratory wall and flattens a bank of machinery.
Sanern stands in a hail of cannon fire that leaves his plating unmarked.
Sanern builds up to a thundering sprint along a tunnel and cannot stop at the end.

name: Mitan
summary: Mitan is a thief who runs off with an experimental war suit and smashes up a stronghold on a day of chaos. Mitan gets his punch and his thick hide from the armour alone, and is plain without it.

feats.scene: Mitan hammers a steel bulkhead and leaves a deep dent for the guards to find.
Mitan shrugs off a rank of rifle fire and marches on.

name: Rumil
summary: Rumil is a crook in red-eyed armour who rampages through a polluted city during a masked madman's spree. Rumil's strength is borrowed from the suit, and a good hit on the right plate ends the show.

feats.scene: Rumil bowls over a delivery van and sends it skidding into a shopfront.
Rumil takes a pavement-cracking fall from a rooftop and walks off.

name: Iarcelsor
summary: Iarcelsor is a bully with a crew of hired thugs who plants charges around a refinery to shake down the council. Iarcelsor is beaten by a masked hero and hauled away in a van.

feats.scene: Iarcelsor sets off a chain of charges that gut a storage tank and light up the night sky.
Iarcelsor absorbs a dozen web-wrapped blows and finally drops to his knees.

name: Aneonum
summary: Aneonum is an ancient conqueror whose army walks through a strange mist into a far older age and founds a city there. Aneonum is a tireless commander, gifted at winning loyalty and at taking ground.

feats.scene: Aneonum swings a long blade through a line of spearmen in a single sweeping stroke.
Aneonum rides through a storm of arrows with a battered shield held high.

name: Tussttia
summary: Tussttia is a buried warrior-king, a vessel of a devouring goddess whose tomb lies sealed in the desert. Tussttia lies as a silent mummy until a stranger opens the jaw and lifts out the sacred figurine.

feats.scene: Tussttia unleashes a dusty gale that strips a cliff face down to bare stone.
Tussttia endures millennia of sand and collapse without crumbling.

name: Tircocos
summary: Tircocos is a concert-goer reshaped by glowing shards from another plane, able to grow jagged crystal on demand. Tircocos was later considered for a registry of enlisted heroes.

feats.scene: Tircocos raises a thicket of crystal spikes that skewers a parked bus.
Tircocos is encased in glittering plates that turn aside a sledgehammer.

name: Iarstu
summary: Iarstu is a desk-bound spy who turns out to be a sleeper with a gift for decoding enemy dispatches. Iarstu survives a duplicate-infiltration crisis and dares his enemies to try again with a laser cannon in hand.

feats.scene: Iarstu fires a bulky cannon through a bank of monitors and melts the whole rack.
Iarstu is thrown across a hangar by a blast and brushes himself off.

name: Leolliran
summary: Leolliran is a calm agent in a floating base who delivers bad news and recruits a retired veteran for one more mission. Leolliran joins a raid on a remote island camp and stays close to the exits.

feats.scene: Leolliran fires a service pistol that punches through a metal door.
Leolliran ducks a shower of debris in a collapsing corridor and shrugs it off.

name: Leovilles
summary: Leovilles is a smiling official who hides a second allegiance inside a global security body and believes tearing down the old order is a kindness. Leovilles turns on the people he trained and is shot by an old rival.

feats.scene: Leovilles pulls a trigger in a quiet office and ends an inconvenient life.
Leovilles stays upright through an experimental serum that would flatten others.

name: Aluvor
summary: Aluvor is a background figure glimpsed only as a faded poster on a teenager's bedroom wall. Aluvor represents a heroic family that is more idea than person in this tale.

feats.scene: Aluvor is pinned to a wall by four thumbtacks and rustles in a draught.
Aluvor endures years of sunlight without curling at the corners.

name: Rinniva
summary: Rinniva is one of four siblings made by a scheming scientist in a hidden lab, kept as a test subject and as a curiosity. Rinniva is told that the four are only truly special when joined together.

feats.scene: Rinniva pushes a lab trolley down a ramp with a nervous shove.
Rinniva stays on his feet after the lab doors slam shut on his heels.

name: Aunam
summary: Aunam is a pale, rotting youth who can lighten the pull of the ground and float his hungry pack across the sky. Aunam and his siblings are slain by a huge detonation just as they close in on their next meal.

feats.scene: Aunam strips the weight from a parked car and flings it into a crowd of runners.
Aunam survives being torn open by a rival and keeps lurching forward.

name: Leniunum
summary: Leniunum is a scarred loner who hunts the people responsible for the loss of his family. Leniunum carries a long rifle and a shoulder-mounted cannon, and lives out of a mobile camp.

feats.scene: Leniunum fires a shoulder cannon that blows a hole through a cinder-block wall.
Leniunum takes a ricochet in the vest and keeps his sights steady.

name: Rnori
summary: Rnori is a young hero who fights alongside his siblings in a doomed war against a planet-eater gone mad. Rnori falls in the first clash, one of many who underestimate the foe.

feats.scene: Rnori drops the weight out from under a tank and sends it floating off the road.
Rnori is crushed in a single sweep of an enormous hand.

name: Llitu
summary: Llitu is a grown-up rebel who has fought a time-travelling tyrant for a decade after the world was conquered. Llitu wields a borrowed star-spangled disc and has learned to find the balance point of anything he targets.

feats.scene: Llitu strikes the centre of a guard's armour and the whole suit buckles inward.
Llitu raises the round shield and stops a hail of energy bolts cold.

name: Amamisco
summary: Amamisco is a teenage hero who holds a quiet spot in a family team until a hired killer under a spell ends their story off-panel. Amamisco is remembered mostly as a name on a long list.

feats.scene: Amamisco lifts a van off the ground and tosses it at a rooftop sniper.
Amamisco dives behind a dumpster and takes the shrapnel on his back.

name: Castco
summary: Castco is a man who sides with ordinary people in a brutal war between two kinds of humans and is killed in it. Castco is spoken of only once, in a tale about an old woman who swears vengeance.

feats.scene: Castco hurls a stone through a barricade window and shouts a warning.
Castco takes a rifle butt to the ribs and stays in the line.

name: Santosne
summary: Santosne is one of a crowd of super-evolved beings who abandon their home world and cut a path of ruin through the heavens. Santosne helps merge death and eternity into a single entity and then vanishes into a new reality.

feats.scene: Santosne joins a combined strike that shreds the cosmic hunger of a giant and his herald.
Santosne rides out the death of a galaxy cluster with no more than a flicker.

name: Rumnt
summary: Rumnt is a cartoon sprite who tags along at a contest between two sons of rival thunder gods. Rumnt cheers from the sidelines and never throws a serious punch.

feats.scene: Rumnt floats a toy hammer into the air and drops it on a bystander's foot.
Rumnt is bumped off a podium by a cartoon thunderclap and bounces back.

name: Valstval
summary: Valstval is a toddler with a floating trick who nearly wrecks a family home and is taken to a sandbox by a patient babysitter. Valstval naps through an argument between two grown-up heroes.

feats.scene: Valstval lifts a sandcastle bucket off the ground and spills it on a sleepy giant.
Valstval tumbles off a swing and giggles through the landing.

name: Eoleoiar
summary: Eoleoiar is a bookish schoolboy who receives a strange gift from a dying visitor and uses it to help a neighbour with homework. Eoleoiar makes objects heavy or light with a touch, and helps send a restless ghost back home.

feats.scene: Eoleoiar touches a boulder and makes it weightless so he can lift it overhead.
Eoleoiar stumbles into a bookcase that topples and walks away unhurt.

name: Nausesra
summary: Nausesra is a cowardly figure invented by two children telling a story on a train, a boy who hides behind his little brother. Nausesra exists only in their imaginations and whimpers at every monster.

feats.scene: Nausesra waves a limp fist at a cardboard monster and misses.
Nausesra is knocked over by a gust from a paper dragon and cries for help.

name: Numces
summary: Numces is an old general from a long line of soldiers, who rises through the ranks in a muddy European war. Numces barely sees his own son, who grows up to command a military of his own.

feats.scene: Numces fires a service revolver from a trench and drops a runner at range.
Numces is thrown against a dugout wall by a shell blast and gets back up.

name: Niuau
summary: Niuau is a young mutant who throws burning rings of energy, and he holds the line with his schoolmates against a living island. Niuau is a restless fighter whose power comes from a hidden gift.

feats.scene: Niuau throws a ring of white-hot plasma that melts the roots of a massive tree.
Niuau is swatted by a giant vine and climbs out of the mud.

name: Anstu
summary: Anstu is a brother raised by a scheming geneticist who joins a mutant squad and a rival school in turn. Anstu is told to keep pursuing a dead mentor's plan in secret while fighting honestly beside new friends.

feats.scene: Anstu hurls a ring of glowing heat that cuts a hangar door off its hinges.
Anstu stays on his feet after a brawl through a wall of crates.

name: Telter
summary: Telter is a mutant fighter who joins forces with old rivals when a possessed teammate goes on a rampage. Telter throws bursts of hot plasma and keeps a cool head under pressure.

feats.scene: Telter fires a wide wave of plasma that vaporises a row of parked jeeps.
Telter weathers a telekinetic slam that bends a steel girder.

name: Cestu
summary: Cestu is a hotheaded field leader of a peacekeeping squad who spars with a famously rigid brother and dates a fellow gifted teen. Cestu throws blasts of glowing force and is loyal when it counts.

feats.scene: Cestu unleashes a ring of white heat that cuts a school bus in half.
Cestu is flattened by a massive wave of power and later climbs back out.

name: Aunessan
summary: Aunessan is a gifted outcast whose limbs were stitched to hunter-machine parts and made the first of a production line. Aunessan guards a factory on orders, and dies against a clawed intruder who will not stay down.

feats.scene: Aunessan swings a hydraulic arm through a steel girder and bends it double.
Aunessan absorbs a barrage of rifle fire on his plated chest and keeps advancing.

name: Cosria
summary: Cosria is a space-faring raider who survives a catastrophe that wipes out his friends and teams up with his family to stop a rampaging sibling. Cosria throws searing rings of heat and finally sees the family he wanted reunited.

feats.scene: Cosria hurls a blazing ring that melts a crater into a moon-lit plain.
Cosria stumbles from a blast that vaporises his companions and climbs to his feet.

name: Serame
summary: Serame is a blond fighter who joins a battle against a sorceress, throwing glowing rings from his hands. Serame appears in one issue of a weekly magazine and does not speak much.

feats.scene: Serame fires a ring of heat that scorches a wall of enchanted vines.
Serame shrugs off a lightning strike from a sorceress.

name: Tumnos
summary: Tumnos is a silver-haired wanderer who leaves his old team with a lover to join his father among star pirates. Tumnos returns to warn his estranged brother of a coming cosmic threat, then comes home for a wedding.

feats.scene: Tumnos blasts a pirate cutter out of the sky with a ring of white heat.
Tumnos rides out a skirmish aboard a burning starship and steps out unharmed.

name: Terme
summary: Terme is a married father and reluctant leader who lives on a refuge world after his home planet is destroyed. Terme hides his daughter, destroys a time-blocking device and fights a time-lord who steals her.

feats.scene: Terme unleashes a roaring ring of heat that levels a fortress wall.
Terme endures a collapsing hangar and drags himself out beside his wife.

name: Nesiaul
summary: Nesiaul is a fighter whose picture hangs in a school hallway beside a team portrait. Nesiaul is a glimpsed face, remembered as part of a squad that includes a cold-blooded ally.

feats.scene: Nesiaul pushes a trophy case against a door to hold it shut.
Nesiaul stands in a frame on the wall while the building trembles around him.

name: Amarni
summary: Amarni is a leader of tunnel-dwelling outcasts in a grim future who is cut down by a pair of teen killers sent through time. Amarni throws searing rings and mourns a wife who is gone.

feats.scene: Amarni hurls a ring of heat that breaks a tunnel wall into slag.
Amarni withstands a barrage from two young attackers before he falls.

name: Nullil
summary: Nullil is a game-world hero who soaks up the force around him and returns it as blasts of glowing heat. Nullil suffered early hardship before learning to control the gift, and now can fly.

feats.scene: Nullil absorbs a thunderstorm and answers with a beam that shatters a rooftop.
Nullil trades blows with a hulking raider and stays in the air.

name: Tiuvenia
summary: Tiuvenia is a government-backed team leader who gets mocked by a talkative student as the lesser sibling. Tiuvenia blasts with a chest-mounted ring of force and is later presumed dead.

feats.scene: Tiuvenia blasts a ring of force that cuts a delivery truck in two.
Tiuvenia is flung through a window by a rival and stands unhurt.

name: Siaorlar
summary: Siaorlar is a brave defender who helps hold off a world-eating giant and seems to be killed by him. Siaorlar wears a suit that channels bright rings of heat.

feats.scene: Siaorlar fires a ring of heat that blows a gap in a line of defence drones.
Siaorlar takes a glancing blow from a titanic hand and drops from the sky.

name: Niumis
summary: Niumis is a teacher's pupil who stands with his team as their planet is sacrificed so that two universes can live. Niumis loses his brother in the battle and falls with the world.

feats.scene: Niumis fires one last ring of heat at an invading vessel as the sky turns white.
Niumis vanishes in a flood of light that wipes his whole world away.

name: Eonavor
summary: Eonavor is a younger brother who discovers he can drink in cosmic force after a crash, and later joins a band of star rebels. Eonavor learns to channel searing blasts and finds a purpose among the stars.

feats.scene: Eonavor siphons the heat from a dying star's flare and sends it back as a blast that cracks an asteroid.
Eonavor shrugs off a point-blank strike from a warship's gun.

name: Llonna
summary: Llonna is a husband mentioned in passing, expected to attend a nephew's wedding with his green-haired wife. Llonna has no feats and is only a name in a conversation.

feats.scene: Llonna carries a gift box up a flight of steps to a party.
Llonna trips over a rug on the way in and laughs it off.

name: Onceeol
summary: Onceeol is a bomber who fights for an empire in a long war and blasts a royal residence, then is stopped by a mind-lock before he can blow up an entire island. Onceeol absorbs force and returns it as hot rings.

feats.scene: Onceeol destroys a royal hall with a single blast of searing heat.
Onceeol laughs through a hail of rubble and keeps priming the next charge.

name: Iarvalcel
summary: Iarvalcel is part of a super-evolved crowd who leave their world to settle in the stars and then destroy fleets, a devourer and two cosmic abstractions. Iarvalcel merges into a single being that steps out of reality into a new one.

feats.scene: Iarvalcel adds his strength to a combined blow that unmakes a galactic fleet.
Iarvalcel endures the collapse of a dying cosmos without a mark.

name: Valnia
summary: Valnia is a prison guard who watches over cells holding two alternate women, until a cat-suited intruder knocks him senseless. Valnia has a gift for heated rings and not much else.

feats.scene: Valnia fires a ring that sears the lock off a cell door.
Valnia takes a pounce that sends him sprawling and loses consciousness.

name: Valcarern
summary: Valcarern is a toy-sized hero in a cheerful online world who leads a squad of allies and shouts a catchphrase before blasting. Valcarern absorbs force and releases it in sizzling rings.

feats.scene: Valcarern fires a ring of heat that knocks a cartoon robot off its feet.
Valcarern bounces off a giant mallet and shakes it off with a grin.

name: Nerneci
summary: Nerneci is a government agent from a grim timeline whose healing hope fails and whose mentor dies. Nerneci joins an assault on a tyrant bent on leading his team and is killed.

feats.scene: Nerneci launches a blazing ring that scorches a metal hull.
Nerneci stands against a titanic blow before falling at last.

name: Ornser
summary: Ornser is a normal teenager in a cold northern town, living a quiet life with parents and an older brother. Ornser hides a fiery gift until his brother's own secret comes to light.

feats.scene: Ornser lets out a ring of heat that melts a snowbank into steaming slush.
Ornser slides across black ice into a mailbox and gets up unhurt.

name: Cencorca
summary: Cencorca is a team member who warns a vengeful sibling against attacking a living island, and is killed by accident when his heart is stopped. Cencorca is seen only in a looping memory.

feats.scene: Cencorca hurls a ring of heat that burns a hole through a wall of vines.
Cencorca is hung in twisted vines yet barely shows a scratch.

name: Seraun
summary: Seraun is a resistance fighter who dies in a flashback during a battle with time-displaced rivals. Seraun fought on the losing side, throwing hot rings and absorbing force until the end.

feats.scene: Seraun blasts a ring of heat at a pair of time-lost attackers.
Seraun endures a wave of psychic force and fights on for a few more breaths.

name: Stuvate
summary: Stuvate is a fugitive who takes on pro-government heroes during a prison breakout and seems to die in the explosion. Stuvate is a loyal ally of a fallen cause and is presumed lost.

feats.scene: Stuvate fires a ring of heat that blows the doors off a cell block.
Stuvate is caught in the blast that levels a prison and does not emerge.

name: Auseoull
summary: Auseoull is a lost brother that a young man still believes gone for good, mentioned once in a story about a stolen cosmic fire. Auseoull never appears on the page.

feats.scene: Auseoull tosses a pebble across a pond in a memory.
Auseoull sits in the rain waiting for a ride that does not come.

name: Ntanirin
summary: Ntanirin is a settler on an island nation of outcasts who joins the defence when a three-headed war machine attacks. Ntanirin stands at the side of seasoned heroes.

feats.scene: Ntanirin fires a ring of heat that burns off a metal limb of the war machine.
Ntanirin rides out a tumble down a hillside and stands to fight again.

name: Rumco
summary: Rumco is a rotting copy of a hero in a gaudy broadcaster's realm, part of a pack of small zombified brawlers that turn on their own crew. Rumco is called off by a nervous producer's frantic plea.

feats.scene: Rumco blasts a camera tower with a messy ring of heat.
Rumco keeps staggering forward after being thrown through a set wall.

name: Ancelleo
summary: Ancelleo is a genius teammate who studies how his friends fail in combat and plots his own counter. Ancelleo tears out a raging brute's drip tubes using clever timing, but the brute's fury keeps going.

feats.scene: Ancelleo yanks a hose from a snarling foe's arm after dodging three swings.
Ancelleo takes a savage swipe to the ribs and still keeps thinking.

name: Corse
summary: Corse is a redheaded mercenary who piloted giant exoskeletons for a power plant and now trains soldiers for a technological order. Corse took the best scores ever recorded and invents new piloting tricks.

feats.scene: Corse rams an exoskeleton fist through a concrete pillar.
Corse takes a rocket in the chest-plate of her exosuit and keeps moving.

name: Amitorco
summary: Amitorco is a farm wife whose homestead is razed by a conquering warlord's troops and who is rescued with her neighbours by her armoured son. Amitorco is stern and weathered but has no special power.

feats.scene: Amitorco swings a wooden bucket at a soldier at the gate.
Amitorco endures a night in a cold cell with her head held high.

name: Valriso
summary: Valriso is a farmer's wife captured along with her husband by a red-tendrilled villain and freed by her son and his teammates. Valriso gets back to her family and the quiet of home.

feats.scene: Valriso shoves a guard to buy a moment for her husband.
Valriso is dragged through a dusty yard and rises with a bruised arm.

name: Caraulval
summary: Caraulval is a grey-haired matron raised from the grave as a shambling corpse in a dream, with her husband and kids at her side. Caraulval attacks her son briefly, then gives up and returns to the soil.

feats.scene: Caraulval claws at a stone chest and cracks it open in a clumsy lunge.
Caraulval is struck by a heavy blow and keeps lurching toward the grave.

name: Alutum
summary: Alutum is an ancient matriarch who has lived countless lives under many names and leads a secret order of undying killers. Alutum is banished from a mountain city for hunting immortality, and is finally cut down by a rival's twin blades.

feats.scene: Alutum draws a long sword and cleaves a stone pillar in a single stroke.
Alutum weathers centuries of war and returns from death more than once.

name: Colll
summary: Colll is a wealthy heir whose father unveils a serum at a party that turns the guests into hungry corpses. Colll is escorted to safety and turns on her bodyguard, who ends her.

feats.scene: Colll lunges across a bunker and bites a bodyguard on the arm.
Colll keeps coming after a body-blow that would stop a normal person.

name: Iarva
summary: Iarva is a widowed researcher who dreams of a gentler world through science and sees a silver traveller as a saviour. Iarva gathers a flock of followers and cloned helpers, and sends his granddaughter hunting for the visitor.

feats.scene: Iarva points a shaky hand and orders a cloned helper to open a hatch.
Iarva sits through a night-long storm on an ocean platform without complaint.

name: Cenniacor
summary: Cenniacor is a sickly young heir to an imperial throne whose bleeding stops at the wave of a mystic's hand. Cenniacor is swept into a revolution and exiled with his family, who share his fate.

feats.scene: Cenniacor tosses a wooden toy across a palace nursery.
Cenniacor tumbles from a stair and bleeds until a stranger steps in.

name: Mismonau
summary: Mismonau is a trapped test subject of a rival nation's super-soldier programme, driven mad by captivity and fused to a shield on his arm. Mismonau attacks a visiting hero and is stabbed with a splinter of wood.

feats.scene: Mismonau swings a fused shield and draws blood from a startled visitor.
Mismonau takes a crushing blow without dropping his guard.

name: Liaros
summary: Liaros is a doting dad figure whose name another world's heroine uses as proof she knows a woman's secrets. Liaros is only implied, and apparently dies off screen.

feats.scene: Liaros pats a child's shoulder in an old memory.
Liaros stands in a snowy yard through a long winter evening.

name: Vaalu
summary: Vaalu is a former ace pilot in a game world, married off to a famous spy and later given a stronger serum and a national emblem. Vaalu succeeds in every mission where his homeland's fate is at stake.

feats.scene: Vaalu throws a heavy round shield that smashes through a steel door.
Vaalu stands in the path of a rolling tank shell and grits his teeth.

name: Auncieo
summary: Auncieo is a rotting, mind-controlled giant who becomes a front-line defender in a bunker alongside other fighters. Auncieo is enhanced by an old serum and speaks of a battle the world will sing of.

feats.scene: Auncieo flings a zombie across a courtyard with one arm.
Auncieo keeps lumbering despite a stack of bites and wounds.

name: Riorn
summary: Riorn is an ageing, bald former hero who drives a limousine and misses the cheers of crowds. Riorn is lied to by his cover family, flees to a far island, is jailed and finally joins a ragged team of misfits.

feats.scene: Riorn lifts a battered sedan and heaves it into a pursuing van.
Riorn walks through a hail of gunfire and complains about his knees.

name: Veoamlli
summary: Veoamlli is a booming serum-fed hero who joins a big squad and rides a giant mech into battle. Veoamlli is friendly, loud and stubbornly proud.

feats.scene: Veoamlli pilots a hulking suit and punches a monster off a bridge.
Veoamlli is thrown through a wall and brushes plaster from his shoulders.

name: Amcelan
summary: Amcelan is a moustached trainer of secret agents, famous for two star pupils and a black pearl he leaves as a calling card. Amcelan breaks ranks to warn a pupil, is captured by a metal-suited brute and killed.

feats.scene: Amcelan slaps a recruit's guard aside and corrects her stance.
Amcelan takes a heavy blow from a jailer and refuses to give up a name.

name: Eorirame
summary: Eorirame is a brilliant old engineer who transplants himself into a towering robot body and builds drones for a terror cell. Eorirame is hunted by a wall-crawling hero and killed by an assassin.

feats.scene: Eorirame crushes a parked truck in a giant metal fist.
Eorirame shrugs off a flurry of blows to his steel chassis.

name: Telcos
summary: Telcos keeps a lantern tower on a salt flat and trades whispered bargains with the tide spirits. Telcos is soft-spoken, stubborn, and hard to move once a promise has been made.

feats.scene: Telcos calls up a wall of brine that flings a loaded wagon across a dry lakebed.
Telcos stands unmoved while a collapsing lantern gallery rains stone onto the shoulders.

name: Eosana
summary: Eosana is a ferry mechanic who mends engines by ear and never forgets a faulty weld. Eosana avoids trouble but will swing a heavy wrench at anyone who endangers the crew.

feats.scene: Eosana swings a wrench into a hull plate and dents it deeply.
Eosana tumbles down a steel stairwell and climbs back up bruised but whole.

name: Alron
summary: Alron is a retired stunt rider turned duelist who spins a disc-shaped buckler in tight arcs. Alron wins through timing and nerve rather than raw force.

feats.scene: Alron hurls the buckler so it rebounds off three pillars and topples a charging brute.
Alron braces behind the buckler as a cart hits it at full tilt.
Alron sprints across a crowded plaza to catch a runaway banner.

name: Numnan
summary: Numnan is a gentle lecturer of motion and heat who once drifted into a bad crowd and has spent years making amends. Numnan prefers chalkboards to confrontation.

feats.scene: Numnan shoves a stuck lecture-hall door open with a single hard push.
Numnan takes a stumble down a flight of stairs and gets up laughing.

name: Tiraiar
summary: Tiraiar is a guardian mind woven through a vast crystal archive, glimpsing futures ten thousand years ahead. Tiraiar protects its caretakers by warning them of danger well before it arrives.

feats.scene: Tiraiar focuses the archive's facets into a beam that slices a drifting hulk into glowing slag.
Tiraiar absorbs a cascade of overloaded relays without losing a single memory.

name: Naulu
summary: Naulu is a lantern-bearing voyager who steers drifting light across the dark between worlds. Naulu devotes every voyage to one old promise and never lets a stranger fall behind.

feats.scene: Naulu sweeps a ring of drifting ice into a tight spiral and crushes a rogue moonlet to powder.
Naulu rides out a collapsing star-gate with no more than a singed cloak.

name: Toltelno
summary: Toltelno is a veteran envoy whose speeches calm tense rooms and cool hot tempers. Toltelno trusts a firm handshake more than any weapon.

feats.scene: Toltelno slams a table once and silences a shouting delegation.
Toltelno shrugs off a thrown chair at a heated negotiation.

name: Anriaure
summary: Anriaure is a whiskered burglar who works the rooftops with a sack and a grin. Anriaure is quick on the tiles and unlucky whenever a hero is nearby.

feats.scene: Anriaure kicks a skylight frame loose and drops through into a jeweler's vault.
Anriaure lands from a three-storey leap into a pile of awnings.
Anriaure bolts along a ridge line with a pursuing crowd far behind.

name: Oraamelar
summary: Oraamelar is a rattled drifter who robbed the wrong vault and now sees shapes in every shadow. Oraamelar runs on fear, cheap drink, and a stubborn will to keep moving.

feats.scene: Oraamelar cracks a cellar door with a panicked shoulder charge.
Oraamelar tumbles into a ditch and keeps running without a limp.

name: Nanst
summary: Nanst is a loud, red-bearded enforcer who runs protection rackets out of a back-alley tavern. Nanst fights dirty, laughs loudly, and counts every coin twice.

feats.scene: Nanst lands a roundhouse punch that folds a lamp post at the base.
Nanst takes a bottle across the skull and orders another round.

name: Renetes
summary: Renetes is a drifting prodigy whose wishes bend nearby reality, though each wish frays a little more of his own judgment. Renetes longs to repair the world but keeps breaking it by trying.

feats.scene: Renetes wishes away every siege engine on a continent's coast and a surf of shock waves flattens the shoreline.
Renetes stands untouched in the middle of a collapsing valley of glass.

name: Ronteor
summary: Ronteor is a volunteer in a risky lab trial who bonds with a hungry gel that wears him as a mask. Ronteor is more victim than villain, and the experiment ends badly for everyone nearby.

feats.scene: Ronteor, wrapped in the gel, tears a steel locker door off its hinges.
Ronteor shrugs off a volley of tranquilizer darts.

name: Lelerium
summary: Lelerium is a clockwork steward who polishes silver, pours tea, and quietly writes a memoir between chores. Lelerium has far more patience than the family that built it.

feats.scene: Lelerium lifts a collapsed bookcase off a trapped cook.
Lelerium walks out of a burning pantry with scorched paint and no dents.

name: Luruti
summary: Luruti is a stern field officer who once stopped a test launch and set off a chain of unexpected events. Luruti values caution and paperwork, usually in that order.

feats.scene: Luruti pounds a desk to halt a hasty launch order.
Luruti keeps standing after a gantry platform lurches beneath the boots.

name: Lerrne
summary: Lerrne is a harbor-city mayor who survived a messy election by turning on a former patron. Lerrne talks big, ducks hard, and loves a good public speech.

feats.scene: Lerrne slaps a ballot box shut as a heckler lunges.
Lerrne stays upright in a crowd crush on the town hall steps.

name: Aninton
summary: Aninton is a patient gang boss who prefers to let rivals trip over their own greed. Aninton keeps a clean suit and a short list of men to trust.

feats.scene: Aninton drives a pistol grip into a rival's jaw and drops him.
Aninton walks away from a rail yard ambush with only a torn sleeve.

name: Liaiumium
summary: Liaiumium is a fixer with a surgically borrowed face who schemes from behind the scenes for others. Liaiumium sells a convincing lie but panics when the lie is tested.

feats.scene: Liaiumium cracks a safe with a crowbar and a lucky leverage.
Liaiumium absorbs a punch from a startled bodyguard and keeps smiling.

name: Ausmeam
summary: Ausmeam is a skilled technician who supplies gadgets to a rising crime figure and quits the day the plans turn murderous. Ausmeam later builds a clever mask that mimics a blind fighter's senses.

feats.scene: Ausmeam wedges a lever under a workbench and flips it onto a pursuer.
Ausmeam rides out a lab fire shielded by a wet blanket.

name: Collite
summary: Collite is an underground smith whose blades are said to cut through any giant on sight. Collite works in a roaring forge and bargains for every ingot.

feats.scene: Collite swings a hammer onto an anvil that splits a stone slab down the middle.
Collite stands inside a flaring furnace as molten metal spills across the shoulders.

name: Stutu
summary: Stutu is a vague wind-spirit invoked by wanderers and remembered mostly in the shape of winged lizards circling a high valley. Stutu may be a god, a ghost, or a place, and nobody can say which.

feats.scene: Stutu spins a gale that uproots an orchard and hurls it over a ridge.
Stutu scatters into mist as a hail of arrows passes harmlessly through.

name: Aunme
summary: Aunme is a small furred valet who gained a sharp mind from a magic spill in a sewer. Aunme serves dutifully and bites only when cornered.

feats.scene: Aunme gnaws through a rope and drops a lantern onto a startled thug.
Aunme survives a fall down a drain shaft with a shake of the whiskers.

name: Teltutar
summary: Teltutar is the restless shade of a jealous farmer who sealed a black house against every visitor. Teltutar drags the unwary into the cellar and keeps its curse strong for generations.

feats.scene: Teltutar slams every shutter at once and the shock cracks the house's old beams.
Teltutar ignores a priest's hurled holy water and a fusillade of rifle shots.

name: Sesrnsar
summary: Sesrnsar is a red-eyed warrior brute bred in a dark realm and unleashed on the invaders of a distant city. Sesrnsar fights with mindless fury and tears through any wall in the way.

feats.scene: Sesrnsar punches through a stone tower and the upper floors fall in a heap.
Sesrnsar takes a fusillade of cannon fire and keeps advancing.

name: Vastaal
summary: Vastaal is a hooded knight who serves a cold-hearted lord and fights beside his master's raiders. Vastaal is steady, silent, and harder to hit than he looks.

feats.scene: Vastaal splits a thick oak gate with a single overhead blow.
Vastaal stands through a barrage of boulders from a siege engine.

name: Lonriaul
summary: Lonriaul is a scientist who vanished in a storm and returned as a pale guard, forced to protect a hidden forge. Lonriaul glimpses old memories before turning the hammer on a former friend.

feats.scene: Lonriaul clubs a pillar and cracks it floor to ceiling.
Lonriaul tanks a blast of forge-fire that melts a nearby anvil.

name: Neoronen
summary: Neoronen is a blindfolded wanderer whose remaining senses are sharpened far beyond the ordinary after a terrible night. Neoronen can tell a liar by the sound of a heartbeat.

feats.scene: Neoronen lunges at a target by smell alone and drives a knife home.
Neoronen walks away from a collapsed awning with only a bloody lip.

name: Marce
summary: Marce is a desert chieftain who keeps a heavy secret about a daughter and her strange nature. Marce rules fairly and mourns quietly.

feats.scene: Marce swings a curved blade and splits a wooden practice post.
Marce survives a long sandstorm march without a canteen.

name: Seullle
summary: Seullle is a young heir prophesied to unite a desert people and wary of the weight of the prophecy. Seullle frees prisoners, prays quietly, and fights only when forced.

feats.scene: Seullle disarms a guard with a spinning curved blade.
Seullle endures a night in a pit of snakes with courage.

name: Raniueol
summary: Raniueol is a research chief who spent years studying a coming rivalry between two kinds of people. Raniueol builds a machine that carries the dead and finally pays for it.

feats.scene: Raniueol hurls a heavy tablet across a lab to break a lock.
Raniueol survives a lab collapse in a metal alcove.

name: Timor
summary: Timor is a plucky squirrel ally who chews through wires and rattles tin lids at the mall. Timor follows a brave friend wherever the trouble leads.

feats.scene: Timor gnaws through a cable and plunges a corridor into darkness.
Timor tumbles down an escalator and bounces up unhurt.
Timor scurries across a tiled floor ahead of a broom.

name: Anasama
summary: Anasama is a bill-nosed fugitive with sharp claws who hides in a ruined seaside city from a cruel maker. Anasama fights for the hunted and trusts very few.

feats.scene: Anasama rakes a steel shutter with her claws and shreds it.
Anasama dives off a pier and shrugs off a barrage of bolts.

name: Tiaorvi
summary: Tiaorvi is a sleeper who awoke from a deep freeze to find the world gone cruel. Tiaorvi hands over a peace ring as a keepsake and chooses to slumber again.

feats.scene: Tiaorvi shoves a stuck hatch open with both hands.
Tiaorvi takes a hard fall from a ledge and climbs on.

name: Sartaram
summary: Sartaram is a salty old aunt remembered for her tall tales about odd lodgers upstairs. Sartaram is mostly harmless and mostly sharp.

feats.scene: Sartaram swats a prowler with a rolled newspaper.
Sartaram steadies herself after a stumble on the stairs.

name: Stteo
summary: Stteo is a runaway teenager who gets a crash course in fighting from a fierce guardian. Stteo learns fast, ducks first, and fires a shot when a friend is in trouble.

feats.scene: Stteo barrels into a goon and sends him through a screen door.
Stteo gets up after a hard tackle on pavement.

name: Stame
summary: Stame is a restless captive in a prison of mirrors, lifting small objects and reading stray thoughts. Stame hums to keep calm and dreams of an open sky.

feats.scene: Stame lifts a stack of cell cots with a pulse of will and slams them against the bars.
Stame endures a dampening field that would knock out a grown ox.

name: Nesentu
summary: Nesentu is a river patrol officer who checks a homeless camp and meets something horrible. Nesentu stays loyal to a partner until the end.

feats.scene: Nesentu swings a baton at an attacker in the mud.
Nesentu takes a hard shove from a charging figure and stays upright.

name: Ulustu
summary: Ulustu is a retired ring wrestler who keeps a locked room of mementos for her son. Ulustu is strong enough to make a famous team hesitate.

feats.scene: Ulustu hoists a rival over the ropes and slams the ring floor with a thud.
Ulustu takes a steel-chair strike and lands a headlock in response.

name: Loilial
summary: Loilial is a tired neighborhood mother juggling two kids and a crowded apartment. Loilial notices everything and forgives most of it.

feats.scene: Loilial swings a laundry basket at a runaway toy and sends it spinning.
Loilial stays calm through a flooded kitchen.

name: Ellmis
summary: Ellmis is a harbor-city detective who inherited her mother's magic after a terrible night. Ellmis fights crime with pink-haired grit and a handful of crackling spells.

feats.scene: Ellmis throws a bolt of coral light that overturns a delivery truck.
Ellmis raises a shimmering ward against a rain of broken bricks.

name: Stete
summary: Stete is a married neighbor who perished in a house fire while rescuers were busy next door. Stete is remembered mostly by those who lived across the hall.

feats.scene: Stete bangs on a door to wake a sleeping spouse.
Stete crouches low and holds a wet towel to endure heavy smoke.

name: Nesonul
summary: Nesonul is a quiet household servant grown in a laboratory vat, matured fast, and tuned to obey. Nesonul glimpses her maker's thoughts and quietly resists.

feats.scene: Nesonul pulses a pink glow that cracks a window and hurls a tray across the room.
Nesonul shakes off a stun bolt and keeps serving tea.

name: Conance
summary: Conance is a trusted sitter who watches two boys while their mother is away. Conance keeps a calm routine even when the weather turns ugly.

feats.scene: Conance carries both boys through a muddy yard.
Conance stays up all night through a storm.

name: Tiuami
summary: Tiuami is a divorced parent more focused on her son's earnings than his homework. Tiuami argues with a lawyer at her side and grows quiet when it counts.

feats.scene: Tiuami slaps a clipboard onto a front desk to make a point.
Tiuami weathers a long argument in a lobby without blinking.

name: Amaan
summary: Amaan is a suburban housewife whose family brings home a faulty machine. Amaan hides the boy and trusts a broom more than an apology.

feats.scene: Amaan cracks a broom handle across a rogue machine's casing.
Amaan hits the kitchen floor hard and scrambles up.

name: Rneorvor
summary: Rneorvor is a widow who travels to a far island to claim a spouse's remains. Rneorvor argues with stern officials and refuses to leave without answers.

feats.scene: Rneorvor shoves a heavy gate open with both shoulders.
Rneorvor waits out a driving rain on a dock.

name: Ranamlli
summary: Ranamlli is a tech founder who bonded with a prismatic gem that makes her a living lantern of force. Ranamlli aims to remake the world for the better, usually by being stubbornly in charge.

feats.scene: Ranamlli fires a prism beam that vaporizes a freight yard in one flash.
Ranamlli hovers through a barrage of missiles without a single bruise.
Ranamlli streaks across a skyline faster than sound.

name: Rneium
summary: Rneium is the wealthy daughter of a novelist whose party ends in a sudden poisoning. Rneium defends a hot-headed sweetheart against a detective's suspicion.

feats.scene: Rneium slaps a suspect across the cheek in a ballroom.
Rneium keeps standing through a tearful night of questioning.

name: Aulnia
summary: Aulnia is an overprotective mother who hides mail from a daughter eager to leave a small town. Aulnia doubts her own choices only after the girl is gone.

feats.scene: Aulnia slams a drawer shut over a stack of letters.
Aulnia holds her ground in a loud family argument.

name: Censes
summary: Censes is a sunny film actress who shares the screen and the sofa with a leading man. Censes does her own stunts when the director looks away.

feats.scene: Censes lands a staged kick that topples a prop crate.
Censes tumbles from a stunt rig and bounces up with a grin.

name: Valtesnan
summary: Valtesnan is a stage performer lured by the promise of a film role into a cultist's ritual. Valtesnan's tragic end drives a masked partner to act.

feats.scene: Valtesnan shoves a heavy curtain aside and flees down a corridor.
Valtesnan holds a rehearsal pose for a full hour.

name: Namonoro
summary: Namonoro is a sharp-tongued student who runs a loud website and trusts online crowds more than the people next door. Namonoro grows reckless once a stray machine answers to the keyboard.

feats.scene: Namonoro hurls a laptop across a dorm room at a startled intruder.
Namonoro takes a hard tumble down a dorm staircase and keeps typing.

name: Arser
summary: Arser is a former patrol officer who wards others with tattooed sigils and a stubborn heart. Arser steps between a friend and danger without a second thought, and pays for it.

feats.scene: Arser snaps a glowing ward into place and a charging monster rebounds into a stone wall.
Arser takes a surge of withering force meant for a friend and holds the line for a heartbeat.

name: Sesnau
summary: Sesnau is a school counselor whose patience wears thin after a prank goes badly. Sesnau quits in a huff and leaves a stack of unfiled forms behind.

feats.scene: Sesnau slams a filing cabinet shut and rattles the walls.
Sesnau stays calm through a hallway stampede.

name: Tiurico
summary: Tiurico is a sculptor who survives a ruined world by hiding in a bunker and then sailing to a hungry sky-giant. Tiurico keeps carving small figures through every hardship.

feats.scene: Tiurico strikes a chisel hard enough to split a stone block.
Tiurico rides out a rattling voyage in a cramped hold.

name: Riaont
summary: Riaont is a gifted sculptor who wears special lenses that cleared a lifelong blur. Riaont now makes figures of the city's heroes and sets them in the park.

feats.scene: Riaont drives a mallet into a granite block and flakes off a slab.
Riaont keeps working through a rumbling quake.

name: Seonavi
summary: Seonavi is a calm control technician who keeps an unruly team's gadgets in order. Seonavi diagnoses a fault from the hum of a console and fixes it with a screwdriver.

feats.scene: Seonavi yanks a jammed panel off a console.
Seonavi shelters under a desk through a lab-wide shake.

name: Aulel
summary: Aulel is a sightless sculptor who is dragged on a time-hopping holiday and returns to a city rebuilt in marble columns. Aulel finds it all rather charming.

feats.scene: Aulel taps a cane against a marble column to find the way.
Aulel walks through a dusty street market without a stumble.

name: Coontni
summary: Coontni is a seeker who studied old rites to cure a lifelong blindness and was suddenly flooded with white radiance. Coontni now hunts night-things across many worlds with a dark-cloaked partner.

feats.scene: Coontni flings a spray of white knives that shred a lurking horror to smoke.
Coontni shrugs off a wave of black flame that scorches the cobbles.

name: Tuslumli
summary: Tuslumli is a prisoner in a gray-walled camp built under a great tower. Tuslumli remains defiant through hunger and waits for a hero to arrive.

feats.scene: Tuslumli shoves a guard aside and slips through a gap in the fence.
Tuslumli endures a freezing winter in a thin blanket.

name: Veiumvi
summary: Veiumvi is a married sculptor who walks into a fortress beside a stranger in cyborg armor. Veiumvi stays unbothered while heroes and the armored stranger sort out the confusion.

feats.scene: Veiumvi nudges a statue base with a cane to find the way through a hall.
Veiumvi stays steady through a sudden shout of alarm.

name: Rniumtia
summary: Rniumtia is a retired artist who settles on a quiet upstate farm with a gruff husband. Rniumtia keeps a kettle on the stove and a chisel in the shed.

feats.scene: Rniumtia splits a log with a single stroke of the axe.
Rniumtia works in the garden through a heat wave.

name: Mocos
summary: Mocos is a guest at a holiday gathering shown in a grumpy editor's dream. Mocos laughs, passes the cake, and vanishes when the dreamer wakes.

feats.scene: Mocos taps a glass and quiets a noisy dinner table.
Mocos sits through a long toast without flinching.

name: Eonutes
summary: Eonutes is a warm sculptor who lives with a rocky husband and hides the shopping from him. Eonutes shapes clay by touch and hums to the radio.

feats.scene: Eonutes kneads a heavy block of clay into a smooth ball.
Eonutes stays composed when a startled visitor bursts in.

name: Nteol
summary: Nteol is an artist who befriends a lonely outcast and later refuses a very odd proposal. Nteol watches a ballgame from the window and weeps at how it ends.

feats.scene: Nteol slams a window shut against a rising wind.
Nteol holds steady while the sky rumbles overhead.

name: Anllina
summary: Anllina is a devoted spouse who travels across layers of reality to help a friend recover his strength. Anllina is erased when history rewrites itself, and the family never learns her name.

feats.scene: Anllina pushes a stuck hatch open aboard a strange craft.
Anllina keeps calm through a roaring burst of cosmic glare.

name: Sttes
summary: Sttes is a polished headmistress who runs a finishing school for young killers and plots to poison her wealthy guests. Sttes wins a few rounds before a calm gunshot ends the game.

feats.scene: Sttes thrusts a hat pin through a leather chair back.
Sttes keeps smiling through a long gala gone sour.

name: Roontora
summary: Roontora is a matriarch whose country house was nearly overrun in a distant war. Roontora hides the family in the cellar and watches a stranger rout the attackers.

feats.scene: Roontora drags a heavy dresser across a cellar door.
Roontora huddles through an hour of distant shelling.

name: Vaelleo
summary: Vaelleo is the first thing to slip free of the flow of hours, a shapeless cloud of wrath whose empire stretches back billions of years. Vaelleo swallows whole eras and answers to no ruler.

feats.scene: Vaelleo engulfs an entire age of a time-realm and leaves a silent void.
Vaelleo disperses through a barrage of temporal blasts and reforms untouched.

name: Cestcel
summary: Cestcel is a former teacher changed by cruel experiments into someone with raw strength and a short fuse. Cestcel searches for a lost daughter and refuses to stay down.

feats.scene: Cestcel punches a van's engine block and sends the vehicle skidding sideways.
Cestcel takes a bridge railing across the back and keeps on walking.

name: Larrnvi
summary: Larrnvi is a firm-minded foster parent who raises a grieving girl and later lectures her about the dangers of a fugitive life. Larrnvi worries loudly and loves quietly.

feats.scene: Larrnvi taps a kitchen table to end a family argument.
Larrnvi holds steady through an hour of angry phone calls.

name: Leiumul
summary: Leiumul is a young mutant fighter who stands beside friends as a mechanical army descends on an island refuge. Leiumul does not live to see the dawn.

feats.scene: Leiumul smashes a bolt of focused force into a hovering sentinel and cracks its shell.
Leiumul absorbs several cannon blasts before falling.

name: Rumen
summary: Rumen is a mercenary thief who can open any lock and is caught more often than he cares to admit. Rumen bargains for his own skin and has no loyalty to anyone.

feats.scene: Rumen shoulders open a vault door the instant the last tumbler clicks.
Rumen tumbles out of a cell block into a dark corridor and runs.
Rumen sprints down a long hall with guards close behind.

name: Osenosnt
summary: Osenosnt is a famous singer whose shows are lit by sparkling light she weaves around her voice. Osenosnt is secretly followed by stalkers and gets help from an unexpected manager.

feats.scene: Osenosnt bends her voice into a glittering flash that blasts a gate off its hinges.
Osenosnt walks through a shower of stage sparks without a mark.

name: Inaneveo
summary: Inaneveo is a rising pop star who turns bitter and heavy-smoking in a war-torn age, but still fights the good fight. Inaneveo repairs a hacked robot line and fires a hot beam to save the day.

feats.scene: Inaneveo fires a dazzling beam that melts a squad of mechanical sentries.
Inaneveo takes a blast of splintered concrete and walks on.

name: Tolan
summary: Tolan is a touring performer whose posters decorate a rough harbor bar. Tolan cancels a reunion tour as new machines wreck the countryside.

feats.scene: Tolan hurls a microphone stand and pins a banner to the wall.
Tolan finishes a long encore through a power cut.

name: Iseium
summary: Iseium is a former singer given cosmic power by a world-eating giant and sent to steer him toward empty worlds. Iseium eventually grows weary and tries to leave, but turns back when nowhere else remains.

feats.scene: Iseium unleashes a cosmic flare that cracks a barren planet down to the core.
Iseium is struck by a weaponized axe and survives a blow that would split a moon.

name: Rnveoia
summary: Rnveoia is a superstar and hunted outlaw who hides in an iron fortress and fights daily waves of attackers. Rnveoia turns music into hard-edged light and fears nothing on the front line.

feats.scene: Rnveoia blasts a column of white light through a line of armored troops.
Rnveoia stands in a gate breach as shells burst around her shoulders.

name: Liscor
summary: Liscor is a chart-topping singer whose new album goes platinum in a week. Liscor appears on a news ticker and ranks higher than a certain web-slinger.

feats.scene: Liscor slams a keyboard lid shut during a studio take.
Liscor survives a mobbed autograph signing without a scratch.

name: Llieon
summary: Llieon is a battered captain who leads a last human holdout against undead hordes. Llieon is rescued and recruited by a wise stranger before a final tragic choice.

feats.scene: Llieon fires a hot beam that cuts a hole through a charging horde.
Llieon stands in the middle of an overrun runway as a crowd tears at the armor.

name: Teiumtia
summary: Teiumtia is a cheerful rollerblader who skates the shoreline hoping to catch a mercenary's eye. Teiumtia is kicked out to sea by a larger rival and paddles home laughing.

feats.scene: Teiumtia spins and cuts a lap around a lifeguard stand.
Teiumtia is booted far out over the surf and surfaces with a laugh.

name: Meolive
summary: Meolive is a gentle singer hidden in a calm retreat where gentle persuasion keeps everyone peaceful. Meolive channels sound into glow, bursts of force, and soaked-up power.

feats.scene: Meolive converts a chorus into a burst of light that hurls a guard through a hedge.
Meolive soaks up a barrage of blasts and glows brighter for it.

name: Teanniu
summary: Teanniu is a singing fighter who stands with her last allies as mechanical hunters close in. Teanniu fires bright blasts until the end.

feats.scene: Teanniu fires a stream of blinding bolts and fells three hunters in a row.
Teanniu holds a door against a mechanical onslaught.

name: Istia
summary: Istia is a fighter who joins friends against an empress and punches a hot bolt straight through her skull. Istia is part of the squad that finally ends the threat.

feats.scene: Istia fires a lance of light that pierces a floating tyrant at the center.
Istia withstands a psychic backlash that shatters nearby windows.

name: Sauamate
summary: Sauamate is a smiling daytime host whose chat show draws a national crowd. Sauamate turns noise into light and keeps the secret from sponsors.

feats.scene: Sauamate bursts a flash of light that knocks over a camera crew.
Sauamate stays upright through a falling lighting rig.

name: Collon
summary: Collon is a school-trained fighter and singer who fends off zealot raiders. Collon turns sound into blinding light and heavy blasts.

feats.scene: Collon belts a note that becomes a light-bolt and bowls over a raider.
Collon takes a hail of pellets on a glowing shield.

name: Siaveorn
summary: Siaveorn is a singing defender who rallies with others against a planet-eating giant and is struck down by his herald. Siaveorn's last act is a wave of sound and light.

feats.scene: Siaveorn unleashes a wall of light and sound that staggers a towering sentinel.
Siaveorn endures a cosmic strike that flattens the street.

name: Tiuvalial
summary: Tiuvalial is a team fighter who trains with others in a safe hall before an ambush by an old foe's followers. Tiuvalial's fate is left unclear.

feats.scene: Tiuvalial flashes a bolt of light that burns a hole in a practice target.
Tiuvalial takes a blast in the open and staggers backward.

name: Llivoram
summary: Llivoram is a coastal defender who watches a firebird of ruin rise and an entire world fall. Llivoram is lost in the glare that follows.

feats.scene: Llivoram throws a bright burst at the rising firebird and singes its feathers.
Llivoram stands against the fiery heat for a few heartbeats.

name: Viana
summary: Viana is a fighter among a band who stop a gate to a fiery pit and then die to a combined spell. Viana does not live to see the new order.

feats.scene: Viana hurls a radiant burst that closes a portal's lip with a crack.
Viana endures a blast of unholy flame before collapsing.

name: Ntoleo
summary: Ntoleo is a nightclub singer who flirts, laughs, and once got kidnapped by a scheming mercenary. Ntoleo is later killed by wild sentinels during a rescue.

feats.scene: Ntoleo blasts a spotlight beam that sends a thug sliding across the dance floor.
Ntoleo shrugs off a hit from a stage prop.

name: Tunico
summary: Tunico is a celebrity who keeps her fame in a world that never took it away. Tunico is visited by a travelling twin who tumbled through a strange doorway.

feats.scene: Tunico flings a scarf across a stage to start the encore.
Tunico keeps singing through a stumbling blackout.

name: Ornrni
summary: Ornrni is a sassy performer who opens a jokey awards show in a jungle. Ornrni sings a silly tune and takes a bow.

feats.scene: Ornrni throws a trophy across a stage to a winner.
Ornrni keeps singing as a prop palm tree falls over.

name: Aunlu
summary: Aunlu is a guest singer at a roast who trades quips with a mouthy mercenary. Aunlu leaves the stage to loud cheers.

feats.scene: Aunlu tosses a pie that lands squarely on a heckler.
Aunlu sits through a barrage of insults without blinking.

name: Viaser
summary: Viaser is a singer who moved to a floating island nation and performs open-air concerts under starlight. Viaser bends beams of light and drinks in stray noise.

feats.scene: Viaser bends a spotlight into a shaft that knocks a three-legged sentinel flat.
Viaser swallows an echoing shriek and answers with a glowing chord.

name: Mimeo
summary: Mimeo is a white-haired heroine stranded in a land of shelved stories, who joins a band of brave women to defeat a spirit of endings. Mimeo works well with allies and cheers loudest of all.

feats.scene: Mimeo flings a handful of sparks that blinds a gaunt spirit.
Mimeo staggers through a chilly gust and keeps her feet.

name: Ussortel
summary: Ussortel is a flashy understudy who auditions for a crazed showman as a replacement for a lost team. Ussortel is dropped by the showman along with the rest.

feats.scene: Ussortel sprays a glittering flash across the stage and singes the curtains.
Ussortel hangs on to a rig as the floor drops away.

name: Terte
summary: Terte keeps tidy books by day and files pressure charges into hollow desk legs by night. Her patient sabotage is built to topple a trading floor without a single shout, and she is exact about every tolerance.

feats.scene: Terte seals a charge inside a vault door and shears the hinges clean off the frame.
Terte takes a shove into a marble counter and walks out with only a bruise.

name: Anrnoaur
summary: Anrnoaur is a patient swindler who spent a decade circling a child she had grown fond of. She wins trust with soft talk and keeps a small pistol in a sewing basket for the day it fails.

feats.scene: Anrnoaur drives a hatpin into a locked drawer and wrenches the latch open.
Anrnoaur tumbles down a gangway during a flight from a pursuer and rises limping but unbroken.

name: Valtelniu
summary: Valtelniu is a stern, sharp-tongued engineer who walked out on his household and spent decades regretting it. He is no fighter, only a man with ordinary stamina and a lifetime of unsent apologies.

feats.scene: Valtelniu slams a workshop door so hard the frame splinters.
Valtelniu absorbs a stumble down a flight of stairs and complains only of his pride.

name: Leluseol
summary: Leluseol is a flag-wrapped guardian who raises shimmering walls of pressure around friends and foes alike. His barriers pen in a street's worth of people, though nobody can say where the gift came from.

feats.scene: Leluseol snaps a dome of force into place and crushes a parked lorry flat against it.
Leluseol holds his barrier steady while a demolition crane swings into it.

name: Orlum
summary: Orlum grew up in a drafty highland keep, raised by a stepfather he barely understood. He is a quiet, black-haired heir with no trained skill beyond horsemanship.

feats.scene: Orlum hurls a flagstone across the courtyard and it lands with a dull thud.
Orlum rides through a hedge of thorns and emerges scratched.

name: Valta
summary: Valta is a half-machine inventor with a grudge and a bad aim. His bolted-on limbs make him stronger than he looks, and his plots against a rooftop wanderer keep collapsing.

feats.scene: Valta rips a streetlamp from its footing and flings it across an intersection.
Valta shrugs off a delivery van that clips his steel shoulder.

name: Renusco
summary: Renusco is a bespectacled researcher who stumbled onto a discovery too large for his lab. He is gentle, easily rattled and unarmed, with a pocket notebook as his only weapon.

feats.scene: Renusco shoves a rolling cart into a doorway to block a corridor.
Renusco is knocked flat by a slamming blast door and climbs back up dazed.

name: Ntosesiu
summary: Ntosesiu rebuilt himself from servos and cable after a lifetime in his father's workshop. He hunts a single quarry with rocket-assisted claws and a borrowed face, and he has died and returned more than once.

feats.scene: Ntosesiu drives his steel claws through a bank's reinforced wall in a single lunge.
Ntosesiu keeps walking after a lorry slams into his armoured chest.
Ntosesiu bounds across rooftops on jet-assisted legs.

name: Saullllo
summary: Saullllo built an online-linked war machine that began to reason for itself. When the machine turned on him, he fought clumsily and learned too late what loyalty a tool could show.

feats.scene: Saullllo lands a wild haymaker on a padded console.
Saullllo is clubbed by his own creation and drops to one knee.

name: Inameli
summary: Inameli is a clever, resentful student who keeps being passed over for the field trip's best seats. His rivalry fuels a string of home-built disguises, each one more ambitious than the last.

feats.scene: Inameli bolts a salvaged motor to a skateboard and rams a gym door off its hinges.
Inameli crashes his glider into a hedge and climbs out grumbling.
Inameli races a homemade rotor pack down a school corridor.

name: Tiacolar
summary: Tiacolar bolted shoulder cannons onto his frame and joined a gang of schemers planning a flood. His mechanical hounds swarm a harbour district while he directs them from a rolling platform.

feats.scene: Tiacolar fires both shoulder cannons and blows a quay's mooring post into splinters.
Tiacolar stands his ground as a cargo crate crashes onto his plated back.

name: Ciaul
summary: Ciaul is a mild-mannered chemist who brews a cure after a scaled beast terrorises the capital. He never fights, but a vial in his hand has turned back a whole district of afflicted people.

feats.scene: Ciaul hurls a flask of antidote across a plaza and shatters it against a pillar.
Ciaul is thrown against a lab bench and keeps his grip on the last vial.

name: Larlese
summary: Larlese is a mutant acolyte of a prophetic order, tattooed along one cheek and loyal to a coming saviour. She slips into a hostile fortress to rescue a lost heir, mentored by a woman slowly losing her mind.

feats.scene: Larlese hurls a bolt of raw psychic force that cracks a stone altar in half.
Larlese weathers a blow from a swinging iron gate and keeps her feet.

name: Lerololi
summary: Lerololi lived in a bleak future, a wife and mother whose family was taken by an arsonist. Her loss pushed her husband to rewrite the past, and she herself had only ordinary strength.

feats.scene: Lerololi shoves a kitchen door shut against a gust of heat.
Lerololi braces against a rushing flame and is thrown to the floor.

name: Turum
summary: Turum is a red-haired occultist who burns on command and collapses into drifting ash to slip through doors. Her devotion to a cruel organisation costs her dearly, but she keeps serving.

feats.scene: Turum ignites herself and sears a coffin lid to cinders in a heartbeat.
Turum survives two blasts from a consecrated gun, scattering into ash and re-forming.

name: Valnan
summary: Valnan is an old prospector who smears glowing dust on himself and his donkey to play a ghost and guard his claim. He frightens trespassers with stories and a lantern, and has no fighting skill.

feats.scene: Valnan swings a pickaxe against a mine timber and cracks it.
Valnan tumbles down a shaft ladder and lands on a heap of sacks.

name: Alinenan
summary: Alinenan is a smuggling broker who prepares captured beings for sale as altered servitors. His pride outruns his guard, and he flees every encounter that goes against him, swearing revenge.

feats.scene: Alinenan clamps a restraint onto a struggling captive with his full weight.
Alinenan is flung against a console and staggers up for a retreat.

name: Ormoan
summary: Ormoan is a mechanical helmsman built by an aged tinkerer and trusted to steer a seed-shaped ship through tiny worlds. It speaks little, obeys faithfully and has never been asked to fight.

feats.scene: Ormoan thrusts the ship's helm through a barrier of coral and pierces it.
Ormoan rides out a collision with a drifting rock without its casing denting.
Ormoan steers the vessel through a narrow channel at breakneck pace.

name: Lianauon
summary: Lianauon is a living blade condensed from lightless void, forged to cut down gods. It whispers to its bearers and feeds on their worst impulses, leaving a trail of ruined temples behind.

feats.scene: Lianauon is swung once and splits a mountain range from crest to root.
Lianauon takes a god's blow flat on its edge and does not chip.

name: Nasain
summary: Nasain is a blade of living night that carved dawn from endless dark and is cursed with many names for its many hosts. It bonds to anyone who burns with anger and slices the stuff of worlds.

feats.scene: Nasain is drawn through a moon's heart and parts the whole world around it.
Nasain absorbs the full blast of a star-forged hammer without cracking.

name: Ntillitas
summary: Ntillitas is a sword of void that passed into a tyrant's hand and turned his armies into fanged, bonded shock troops. The weapon amplifies conquest and makes its wielder seem unbeatable.

feats.scene: Ntillitas is raised aloft and a shockwave of black flame flattens a fortress.
Ntillitas halts a lance of white fire against its flat.

name: Lloeliern
summary: Lloeliern is one of four sibling shadow-weapons spun by a dark god to fight giants of the stars, then cast aside and left dormant on a lonely rock. It bonded with a curious explorer and spawned a vicious brood.

feats.scene: Lloeliern lashes a tendril through an asteroid's face and cleaves it in two.
Lloeliern shrugs off a cannon barrage that levels an outpost.

name: Orisanis
summary: Orisanis is a deicidal blade that abandoned a mad bearer mid-duel and chose a young challenger instead. It lends her borrowed might and a cold appetite, and it nearly reshapes her temper.

feats.scene: Orisanis is thrust into a sky-citadel and splits its foundation in a single motion.
Orisanis stands against a beam of divine fire and bleeds only shadow.

name: Amium
summary: Amium is an ancient shadow-being worshipped as a god by lesser kin, though it freely admits otherwise. It never left its maker's side and still hums with first-born hunger.

feats.scene: Amium coils through the air and crushes a fortress wall to rubble.
Amium endures a barrage of siege fire and pours back together.
Amium leaps across a gorge in one bound, faster than a hawk's dive.

name: Anaus
summary: Anaus is a first-wrought shadow sword that its maker wielded against gods and then lent to a fanatical hunter. It changes shape at will and shares a single hungry mind with its kin.

feats.scene: Anaus is swung through a temple and cuts the entire hill under it in half.
Anaus is struck by a thunderbolt and merely hums.

name: Ialelon
summary: Ialelon is a shadow blade that served its dark maker until both were burned to nothing by a furious telepath. Its edge once cut through palace armour like parchment.

feats.scene: Ialelon slices a skyscraper's frame clean through and the upper floors slide off.
Ialelon survives a collapsing bridge before finally being unmade.

name: Orseslus
summary: Orseslus is a living weapon assigned to a strike team and passed between two dour wielders. It trades quips in a hiss and obeys whichever of its bearers hates harder.

feats.scene: Orseslus is hurled and cuts through the hull of a patrol craft.
