Orseslus absorbs a heavy rail shot against its flat.

name: Ranserter
summary: Ranserter calls herself a mother of blades and was born in the skull of a slain giant, which left her dreading flame and loud noise. She is a fanged, eyeballed sword who adores her most compatible partner.

feats.scene: Ranserter is flung across a shattered sky and bisects the whole continent below.
Ranserter withstands a titan's fist without a mark.

name: Niastaco
summary: Niastaco was a shard of void-blade that two stranger bearers wielded, one a giant lizard that ravaged a divine city. It ended when a thunderer's blast turned it to dust.

feats.scene: Niastaco is driven into a hovering citadel and the whole realm lurches.
Niastaco is struck by a storm-god's detonation, which finally shatters it.

name: Eostuseol
summary: Eostuseol is a founding pattern of despair, one of the primal figures that shaped every later champion. It stood in the old cosmos's last battle and afterwards wandered into the great mystery.

feats.scene: Eostuseol exhales a cold wave of hopelessness that dims a distant nebula.
Eostuseol stands in the heart of a collapsing sphere of reality.

name: Corrn
summary: Corrn is a primal pattern of triumph, a figure from an older cosmos that served as the template for later champions. She fought in the final war of that age and afterwards went exploring the great unknown.

feats.scene: Corrn flings a radiant lance through a drifting nebula and lights it from within.
Corrn walks through the crumbling edge of a world unscathed.

name: Terserar
summary: Terserar is a primal pattern of rulership from an older cosmos, a crowned template for every later sovereign. He fought in the great final battle and later wandered with his peers into the unknown.

feats.scene: Terserar raises his hand and a hundred drifting moons fall into orbit around him.
Terserar sits unmoved in the path of a collapsing star-wall.

name: Torsiori
summary: Torsiori is a rich but bored newsman who adopts a masked persona after a scientist is murdered, wielding ice rounds that melt without a trace. His vendetta is cut short by assassins from abroad.

feats.scene: Torsiori fires a rifle of frozen shot and drops a charging brute.
Torsiori takes a heavy truncheon blow to the ribs and keeps standing.

name: Leonam
summary: Leonam is a naval officer turned traitor who joined a radiation-hungry cult. Eventually he and his fellows dissolved into a glowing mass and wandered off to explore other realities.

feats.scene: Leonam rams a bulkhead hatch with his shoulder and bends it.
Leonam shrugs off a heavy fall from a gangway onto a deck.

name: Luorlli
summary: Luorlli was a proud desert lord who mocked a sorcerer's offer and paid with his head, kept in a jar. He ruled a mountain-fringed city and never learned that his prized gem was magic.

feats.scene: Luorlli brings a ceremonial mace down on a wooden table and splits it.
Luorlli takes a sorcerer's slap to the face without moving.

name: Ronrava
summary: Ronrava is a withered, green-haired demon who slips into living bodies to wear them like a coat. Wife to an infernal courtier, she lurks in a cavern and takes teenage hosts at moments of shock.

feats.scene: Ronrava hurls a possessed host through a brick wall and into the street.
Ronrava absorbs a priest's blast of holy fire and howls but remains.

name: Lonvasor
summary: Lonvasor is a test subject raised in a hidden facility, her metabolism boosted until she heals quickly and runs faster than a car. She ran with a handful of fellow subjects and trusted none of them.

feats.scene: Lonvasor sprints into a steel door and dents it before bouncing off.
Lonvasor heals a deep gash across her arm in the time it takes to bandage it.
Lonvasor outpaces a moving train along its track.

name: Iumrius
summary: Iumrius is a grey-skinned scholar who keeps his people's records and teaches the great stranger who rules the world. He has no martial training, only a long memory and quiet patience.

feats.scene: Iumrius slides a heavy stone tablet across his study floor.
Iumrius is jostled by a crowd in the street and keeps his balance.

name: Oriran
summary: Oriran is a family man who sits by the radio on a quiet evening until a threatening broadcast ends his peace. He has no defence against the intruder who steps from the shadows.

feats.scene: Oriran throws a table lamp at a shadow and misses wildly.
Oriran shrugs off a slap during a scuffle.

name: Racoter
summary: Racoter is an infant, a baby boy taken from his flat by cultists and meant for a demon's feast. A swamp-slick guardian bursts in and carries him to safety.

feats.scene: Racoter flails a tiny fist and bats a rattle off its string.
Racoter is cushioned in a fall of sixty feet and cries but is unhurt.

name: Leeolam
summary: Leeolam is an intelligence officer who locks away a ravenous, ageless child in the early fifties. He is a quiet bureaucrat, and his decisions ripple down for generations.

feats.scene: Leeolam slams a filing cabinet drawer shut.
Leeolam takes a hard shove from a hallway guard and keeps his footing.

name: Nianti
summary: Nianti is one half of a conjoined pair of brothers, both hearing a calling in their dreams. When a dark parasite wakes inside them, they fight as a single body against a rampaging killer.

feats.scene: Nianti heaves a hospital gurney across a corridor and into a doorway.
Nianti absorbs a body blow from an armoured foe and keeps swinging.

name: Monon
summary: Monon is a grey-haired bookkeeper who joins a street demonstration on a cold morning. He is a plain citizen with a placard and a stubborn voice.

feats.scene: Monon thumps his placard against a railing.
Monon is jostled by the crowd and holds his ground.

name: Rniseo
summary: Rniseo is a balding financier turned petty ruler who seals a stretch of border to turn away refugees. He rules by paperwork and private guards, with no personal strength worth mentioning.

feats.scene: Rniseo slaps a ledger onto his desk with a crack.
Rniseo is jostled by a protester and loses his balance for a step.

name: Liastacor
summary: Liastacor is a purple-furred gang leader who sneezes dust on rivals and breaks his boss out of prison. He falls to a single punch, but his gang is a nuisance that no one ignores.

feats.scene: Liastacor throws a heavy haymaker at a dumpster and dents it.
Liastacor is flattened by a single punch from a muscular opponent.

name: Rnlorte
summary: Rnlorte is a brown-haired young woman who once dated a brooding drifter. She appears briefly, with no special skills, in a tale of haunted nights.

feats.scene: Rnlorte pushes a stuck window open.
Rnlorte trips on a kerb and gets up with a scraped knee.

name: Teseo
summary: Teseo is a blonde schoolgirl from a comfortable family who teases a new boy and flirts with his rival. She is spoiled, sharp-tongued and entirely ordinary in strength.

feats.scene: Teseo slaps a locker door shut with a bang.
Teseo is knocked down in a playground game and bounces up laughing.

name: Renacor
summary: Renacor is an orange-haired clan leader of a frozen borderland who tries to rally her fellow chiefs in a cellar meeting. She is brave and persuasive, though she carries no magic of her own.

feats.scene: Renacor swings a war axe into a oak post and splits it.
Renacor is engulfed by a sorceress's flame and burns where she stands.

name: Osucolsa
summary: Osucolsa was a weather-caller who summoned gales, monsoon rain and forked lightning before his gift faded. He broke from a sibling's grim doctrine and quietly helped free her prisoners.

feats.scene: Osucolsa calls a lightning storm that strips the roofs from a whole district.
Osucolsa is flung against a stone wall during a skirmish and rises bruised.

name: Tolamleo
summary: Tolamleo is a pale-skinned enforcer who works for a crime boss and once wrenched a rival's shoulder from its socket. He relies on bulk and intimidation instead of any gadget.

feats.scene: Tolamleo wrenches a rival's arm and dislocates her shoulder.
Tolamleo plows through a plate-glass window and keeps going.

name: Ronser
summary: Ronser is a sharp-toothed albino who fell to a plague of hunger and joined a tribe of the ravenous. He pins prisoners down for his chief and lunges for any chance to ambush a foe.

feats.scene: Ronser pins a struggling captive against a wall with one hand.
Ronser is kicked over a railing and lands heavily on another man.

name: Eonamli
summary: Eonamli is a pale hired muscle for a mob family who sends a fake distress message to lure a girl to a subway platform. He backs off when the heroes arrive, then wrestles two opponents before being webbed up.

feats.scene: Eonamli jerks his bound wrist and flings a masked climber into a wall.
Eonamli grapples a hero and a policeman at once and stays upright.

name: Urecor
summary: Urecor is a snow-white crime lord who attends a gathering of rogues in a rented ballroom. He is more schemer than fighter, with a grim reputation for ruthlessness.

feats.scene: Urecor crushes a banquet chair arm in his grip.
Urecor shrugs off a tumble down a staircase.

name: Amrenmar
summary: Amrenmar is a bald, pale bruiser working for a minor racketeer, so tough that it once took six patrolmen to subdue him. He is eventually beaten senseless by a masked vigilante and finished off in a ward.

feats.scene: Amrenmar lifts a patrol officer and drops him over a counter.
Amrenmar absorbs a flurry of blows from six officers before going down.

name: Niater
summary: Niater is a filed-tooth albino with a chemical-warped body who guards a newsroom against intruding champions. He is a boss-level obstacle with a cruel temper and no other tricks.

feats.scene: Niater heaves a steel desk across a newsroom and splinters a pillar.
Niater withstands a barrage of champions' blows and keeps advancing.

name: Enleosiu
summary: Enleosiu is the lone albino of a crowded neighbourhood, scorned by his father and loved by his mother, who becomes a gang boss in a noir-tinged city. A skin disease slowly hardens his body into a stiff shell.

feats.scene: Enleosiu clubs a debtor to the floor with one blow.
Enleosiu takes a cudgel across the back and his hardened skin barely marks.

name: Inento
summary: Inento is a pale mutated crook who appears in a dream-made world as one of many rogues crashing a wedding. He is only a face in the crowd of troublemakers.

feats.scene: Inento flips a banquet table onto the guests.
Inento is dragged through a window and walks it off.

name: Vosonnum
summary: Vosonnum is a sickly mad scientist who steals the might of a giant stone creature and then steers an ancient winged beast. His craving for power leads him to swap minds with a living colossus.

feats.scene: Vosonnum drives a stone titan through a theatre and flattens a whole facade.
Vosonnum survives a tank volley while inside the colossus.

name: Tentnan
summary: Tentnan is a nine-foot artificial being with an enormous head, built in a buried city to make his creator master of everything. He now scouts the stars as a free-minded wanderer.

feats.scene: Tentnan unleashes a pulse from his swollen skull and levels a cavern district.
Tentnan walks unharmed through a cavern collapse.

name: Inteoro
summary: Inteoro is a mutant who rolls back a rival's years until he is a squalling infant. The trick occurs in a brief side mission and is never explained.

feats.scene: Inteoro waves a hand and the rival shrinks into a bawling toddler.
Inteoro shrugs off a stray blow from a stumbling guard.

name: Cestol
summary: Cestol is a blond cyborg mercenary in a gang of four who fight yearly over a power amulet. He is fast, strong and tough, though he loses both arms to an enraged green giant.

feats.scene: Cestol drives a mechanical fist through a casino slot cabinet.
Cestol shrugs off a car's impact on his reinforced torso.
Cestol sprints down a street faster than any athlete.

name: Oramlu
summary: Oramlu is a guardian of a distant timeline, reborn in a ritual of love to defend a besieged citadel. This champion helps hold a line against demon hordes beside other defenders.

feats.scene: Oramlu strikes a demon horde with a shield of light and a hillside is torn up.
Oramlu stands in a demon charge and does not yield a pace.

name: Teiaron
summary: Teiaron is a loyal servant of a royal family who accompanies the nobles on an expedition to a crashed ship. He steps between a warlord and a captive and pays with his life.

feats.scene: Teiaron grabs a fallen strut and swings at the warlord.
Teiaron is hurled to the dust by a single blow and does not rise.

name: Anravi
summary: Anravi is a catfish-faced doorman with pointed ears and spotted arms, hired muscle and sometime killer. He is large and strong, but a lean fighter finally bests him in his boss's compound.

feats.scene: Anravi tosses a bouncer through a swinging door.
Anravi takes a bottle across the skull and keeps swinging.

name: Onvate
summary: Onvate is a rich, grey-haired gentleman of a lakeside city whose pride and harshness cost him his family. He believes the court and shuns a protege who is later cleared by the truth.

feats.scene: Onvate raps a cane on a courtroom floor.
Onvate is shaken by a tumble from a carriage step.

name: Escor
summary: Escor is a bald, grey-bearded politician who takes over as interim leader of a small European state. His strength is paperwork, speeches and a careful reputation.

feats.scene: Escor slaps a treaty onto a polished table.
Escor is jostled by a guard and steadies himself.

name: Ameos
summary: Ameos is a black-haired gangster, locked up in a famous prison, who is tracked down by two masked visitors. He is an ordinary racketeer with no special physique.

feats.scene: Ameos swings a chair and cracks a table.
Ameos is slammed against a cell wall and slides to the floor.

name: Anrin
summary: Anrin is a blond cyborg teen with a brain full of implants, raised as a lab assistant and nicknamed after junk. He keeps two clever lobster friends and fights for a team of young adventurers.

feats.scene: Anrin projects a burst of force from his implants and topples a vending machine.
Anrin is thrown from a fire escape and rolls clear.

name: Teennt
summary: Teennt is a blond cyborg teen preserved for a century inside an enormous shellfish who wakes in a future of crime. He fights alongside two pinching crustacean partners, in a comic-relief twist.

feats.scene: Teennt shatters a car window with a punch assisted by his implants.
Teennt climbs out of a collapsed shell unharmed after a hundred years.

name: Onllean
summary: Onllean is a blue-haired, pointy-eared con artist from a spacefaring empire who rigs a race with a partner. He lives by quick patter and fast exits.

feats.scene: Onllean shoves a rival off a starting platform.
Onllean tumbles out of a speeding sled and bounces up grinning.
Onllean bolts down an alley with a mark's wallet.

name: Corsa
summary: Corsa is the king of a wizardly dimension of beast-riders, fond of crunchy snacks and cruel trials. He retreats from one duel but returns to preside over a tribunal and savour the show.

feats.scene: Corsa hurls a sorcerous bolt that shatters a stone bridge.
Corsa shrugs off a flying blow that would flatten a house.

name: Veleorn
summary: Veleorn is a six-eyed, fanged warlord born with too few arms who slaughters his own kin to win notice. He kills the old ruler barehanded, founds a new empire and seeks to remake his people.

feats.scene: Veleorn tears a rival general in two with his bare hands.
Veleorn survives a barrage of soldiers' fire and keeps hunting.

name: Colelau
summary: Colelau is a pilot from a tiny world menaced by a tyrant, who guides two strangers back in a size-changing craft. He dies in a crash while fleeing a doomed homeland.

feats.scene: Colelau yanks a cockpit lever and the craft lurches.
Colelau is thrown against a bulkhead in the crash.

name: Lemarles
summary: Lemarles is a living moon given a mind by a cosmic experimenter, who meant to pit him against a twin world. He roams the void as a planet-like being, once held in a collector's prison.

feats.scene: Lemarles slams into a rival world and cracks its crust from pole to pole.
Lemarles endures a world's collision without a visible scar.

name: Temeocos
summary: Temeocos is a woman made of living nano-hive, a copy of her creator who splits from him over how to use newly empowered humans. She plots against his hidden empire and wears many names.

feats.scene: Temeocos reshapes her hand into a blade and cuts through a vault door.
Temeocos reassembles after a blast that levels a warehouse.

name: Searis
summary: Searis is a blonde alien who unmasks her people's illusions and turns on their false leader. She helps a lone traveller overthrow a plot to take over a distant planet.

feats.scene: Searis dispels a shimmering illusion and her people appear in their true shapes.
Searis is thrown against a bulkhead and gets back up.

name: Reser
summary: Reser is a sightless woman of ordinary strength who spends fifteen years as a captive and unlikely friend of a murderous mercenary. She hustles a teenager out of harm's way at a resort tournament.

feats.scene: Reser pushes a boy toward a doorway.
Reser is bumped by a runner and holds her footing.

name: Sesnilon
summary: Sesnilon is a black-haired police detective assigned to a task force hunting a monstrous parasite. He is a plain lawman with a notebook and a service pistol.

feats.scene: Sesnilon rams a locked apartment door with his shoulder.
Sesnilon is knocked off his feet by a fleeing suspect.

name: Ontcor
summary: Ontcor is a beat officer who nervously hesitates at a bewildered street scene. He misuses a slur and is promptly corrected by his sergeant.

feats.scene: Ontcor shoulders a stuck gate open.
Ontcor is shoved by a panicked passer-by and keeps his feet.

name: Ntova
summary: Ntova is a heavy-drinking father who lashes out at his family. His eldest son shoves him aside and the man knocks himself out cold on a table.

feats.scene: Ntova swings a drunken fist at the air and hits a cupboard.
Ntova strikes his forehead on a table edge and slumps unconscious.

name: Siarntu
summary: Siarntu is a scholar with many degrees who befriends a silver wanderer and gives his life to save the planet from a cosmic judge. His life force is later captured and he becomes a glowing wraith.

feats.scene: Siarntu releases a burst of nanobot light and fells a hovering warship.
Siarntu endures a cloud of lethal vapour that ends his mortal life.

name: Anioren
summary: Anioren is a down-on-his-luck rogue who lives in a battered car and sells explosive bowling pins for rent money. He hangs out at a bar with friends who cannot read and joins a heist for easy cash.

feats.scene: Anioren hurls an exploding pin that blows a hole in a pawn shop wall.
Anioren slides out of his wrecked car laughing and unhurt.

name: Ntunti
summary: Ntunti is a casino-owning billionaire who tries to cut a deal with a violent intruder and gets nowhere. He leaves the saving to night-time protectors.

feats.scene: Ntunti slams his palm onto a gaming table.
Ntunti is shoved aside by a gunman and loses his footing.

name: Corsome
summary: Corsome is a small blond girl born on a ship among distant stars. Her parents jump back through time to raise her in a quiet suburb after a final mission lasting only minutes.

feats.scene: Corsome tosses a toy against a cabin wall.
Corsome tumbles off a bunk and giggles.

name: Olcos
summary: Olcos is the last highlander of her world, a sword-wielding bodyguard and nanny who was rescued from slavery. She defends two children against gods and machines, her hair turning fiery when she fights.

feats.scene: Olcos cleaves a sentinel machine in half with a single stroke of her blade.
Olcos stands against a war-god's charge and holds the line.
Olcos sprints across a rooftop to catch a falling child.

name: Sarsetus
summary: Sarsetus is a swordswoman in a possible future where a tyrant is hailed as a hero and weds a widow. She helps raise their daughter, survives her allies' deaths and defends a moon colony from invaders.

feats.scene: Sarsetus cuts down an invader's armoured mount in one stroke.
Sarsetus is saved from a fatal blow by a sacrificing friend.

name: Orleocor
summary: Orleocor is a child-prodigy researcher who once dated a brilliant rival and later became a mechanical copy of herself. She keeps urging an adventurer to return to careful, patient science.

feats.scene: Orleocor slams a robotic fist into a lab console and shatters it.
Orleocor takes a blast from a malfunctioning reactor and remains intact.

name: Annannum
summary: Annannum is a research partner who warns that a rushed flight will expose a crew to hazardous radiation, and she is proved right. She afterwards builds a chamber that can switch a rocky colleague's shape back and forth.

feats.scene: Annannum slams a heavy breaker switch and the lab hums.
Annannum is jostled by a flash of sparks and stays upright.

name: Necelrum
summary: Necelrum is a scaly, black-eyed general whose army is flung back in time to a frontier town by a storm. He arms and collars captured locals, then plans a bomb that scorches everything for twenty miles.

feats.scene: Necelrum detonates a single heat bomb and a whole plain is scorched.
Necelrum shrugs off a volley of gunfire against his scaly hide.

name: Eotiuvia
summary: Eotiuvia is a boy genius who can briefly bulk up into a towering, green-skinned brute when he calls on borrowed rage. Tiny and sharp-witted otherwise, he is a prodigy of numbers and strategy.

feats.scene: Eotiuvia leaps from a cliff and smashes a rocky outcrop into powder.
Eotiuvia stands in a collapsing bridge and walks out from the rubble.
Eotiuvia bounds across a valley in a single titanic jump.

name: Ternoleo
summary: Ternoleo is a quiet desk analyst who spends her days cross-referencing sealed files and spotting patterns others miss. A sudden promotion drags her into fieldwork she never trained for, and she copes by out-thinking trouble rather than meeting it head on.

feats.scene: Ternoleo shoves a stack of heavy file boxes into a pursuer's path and sends him sprawling.
She is knocked flat by a thrown chair and stands back up with only bruises.

name: Elsia
summary: Elsia is a cheerful spouse and volunteer who stands at the side of a celebrity cook during a charity cooking contest. She keeps the pans hot, the crowd laughing and the donation jar full.

feats.scene: Elsia swings a heavy skillet onto a countertop hard enough to dent the steel.
She slips on spilled oil, crashes into a shelf of pots and walks away unhurt.

name: Mevia
summary: Mevia is a neighbourhood resident who ducks behind a table during a gang standoff and later tells investigators exactly what she saw. Her calm testimony protects a masked local hero from a smear.

feats.scene: Mevia hurls a ceramic mug across the room to distract a gunman for one crucial second.

name: Nticecil
summary: Nticecil is a medieval transmuter who joins a circle of fellow practitioners to bind a fiendish prisoner beneath the earth. The ritual costs the circle years of effort and holds for centuries.

feats.scene: Nticecil channels a shared rite that collapses a cavern ceiling to seal in a captive demon.
He endures a lashing of scalding smoke while holding the final chalk line.

name: Estau
summary: Estau is a ruthless underworld heiress who leads a sprawling network of conspirators and vows that it will outlive everyone. She trusts poison, bribery and a steady hand with a pistol, and she removes obstacles without remorse.

feats.scene: Estau drives a combat knife through a steel door panel in a single thrust.
She takes a hard kick to the ribs, laughs and answers with a venomous stare.

name: Tussta
summary: Tussta is a name scribbled on a roster of gifted individuals that a shapeshifting infiltrator scrolls past while hunting for a different file. The entry is a passing line in a data list and nothing more.

feats.scene: Tussta, listed only as a row on a glowing screen, survives a flicker of static as the screen is switched off.

name: Vosria
summary: Vosria is a sharp-tongued sibling in a rain-soaked noir city who works alongside a brother and sits across the table from suspects. She is known only for brief scenes of interrogation and quiet menace.

feats.scene: Vosria slams an open palm onto a steel interview table hard enough to make cups jump.

name: Tiustru
summary: Tiustru is a bystander among onlookers who watch a line of costumed champions being led away in chains. The character sees it, says little and carries the memory.

feats.scene: Tiustru slams a fist against a brick wall in helpless anger.

name: Rneotol
summary: Rneotol is a smooth-talking dealer in advanced weaponry who sells crates of prototype gear to gangsters. When rival crews and masked heroes crash the handover, his bodyguards scatter and he runs.

feats.scene: Rneotol fires a sidearm into a crate lock and the burst blows the lid off.
He is slammed into a van door by a shockwave and crawls out alive.

name: Naontium
summary: Naontium is a blade-wielding vigilante who appears on a government watch list during a divisive registration drive. Whether the swordsman complied or vanished is left unsaid.

feats.scene: Naontium cleaves a steel pipe in half with a single practised cut.
The swordsman takes a tonfa blow across the shoulder without dropping the blade.

name: Tervoni
summary: Tervoni is a line in a scrolling list of gifted people reviewed by a shapeshifter in a hurry. The name carries no scenes and no recorded deeds.

feats.scene: Tervoni, merely listed on a monitor, survives a power flicker with no harm done.

name: Orium
summary: Orium is a dour interrogator in a rainy, stylised city who questions a suspect over a murder in the arts district. The character appears for a single tense scene.

feats.scene: Orium slaps a folder against a desk to jolt a sleepy suspect awake.

name: Llcor
summary: Llcor is a bystander who watches costumed champions being rounded up and stays quiet about it. The scene is short and the character leaves unharmed.

feats.scene: Llcor clenches a fist and punches a wall in frustration.

name: Rennen
summary: Rennen is a wealthy aristocrat and a grasping hoarder of rare relics. He travels to a far-off palace to chase a flask said to grant endless life, and the haul is wrecked in a brawl among the greedy.

feats.scene: Rennen lunges and shoves a rival into a marble pillar.
He falls down a flight of stone stairs in the scramble and shakes it off.

name: Amiia
summary: Amiia is a separatist bomber who destroyed a financial building and killed roughly a hundred and fifty people. He flies abroad to broker a biological weapon sale and is killed by an interrogator who loses patience.

feats.scene: Amiia triggers a charge that brings down the front of a bank tower.
He takes a heavy blow to the jaw in a hotel room and still refuses to talk.

name: Nutol
summary: Nutol is a foot soldier embedded in a small nation's army by time-hopping invaders who want to watch their new partners. The posting later puts him on a raid against people with unusual gifts.

feats.scene: Nutol fires a burst of force that rips a door from its frame.
He takes a rubber slug to the ribs and keeps running.

name: Aullum
summary: Aullum is a cold-blooded drug runner and a boss who ordered a killing and carried out a murder in front of a child. The surviving child takes control of a mechanised suit and settles the matter.

feats.scene: Aullum fires a pistol into a stack of crates, splintering the top slats.
He takes a hard punch to the face without going down.

name: Ronti
summary: Ronti is a veteran general in a small tropical republic who reminds two visiting heroes that the crisis in a village is a local matter. His authority carries more weight than any weapon.

feats.scene: Ronti slams a map case onto a table to end an argument.

name: Numoriam
summary: Numoriam is a gifted captive in a fenced detention camp, blamed for the deaths of a pair of guards. Numoriam is shot dozens of times and dies without ever showing what the gift was.

feats.scene: Numoriam stands under a firing line of rifle fire and falls only after sixty hits.

name: Neteser
summary: Neteser is a miserly landlord who turns out a dying tenant and is cursed to suffer ridicule. A stranger with a bargain keeps offering help that only deepens his humiliation.

feats.scene: Neteser slams a cane onto a doorframe while shouting at a tenant.
He is struck by a thrown cobblestone and merely curses louder.

name: Tortelnti
summary: Tortelnti is the head of a secretive occult order and the keeper of a ritual that can call a swarm of hungry insects back from the sky. He uses a gem-based device to try to summon them home.

feats.scene: Tortelnti activates a gem apparatus that tears open a shimmering opening above the mansion roof.
He is knocked into a bookcase by a gust and remains conscious.

name: Centas
summary: Centas is a school instructor who announces visiting lecturers to an assembly and is dragged into a trophy squabble among the students. He is a minor background figure in a teen drama.

feats.scene: Centas lifts a heavy silver cup off a display table and carries it away.

name: Serernan
summary: Serernan is a frontier outlaw and one of three brothers who terrorise a border region. Hunted by a posse, they hide in a cave and fall out over the loot.

feats.scene: Serernan fires a revolver at a lantern and shatters it across a rock wall.
He tumbles off a horse at full gallop and rises with a grunt.

name: Sumvani
summary: Sumvani is a determined legislator who investigates a famed industrialist for supposed leaks. He suspects a frame-up and invites the man to testify, only to see a gigantic machine launched at the capital.

feats.scene: Sumvani bangs a gavel so hard it cracks the sounding block.
He is thrown from his chair by a distant tremor and stands up unhurt.

name: Aulul
summary: Aulul is a college lecturer of paranormal studies who dates a researcher with telekinetic gifts. He offers his parents' ranch as a summer home for her younger siblings and meets two odd visitors from the sky.

feats.scene: Aulul lifts a stack of textbooks and drops it with a thud on a desk.
He stumbles into a barn rail and shrugs it off.

name: Ellorn
summary: Ellorn is the loyal schoolmate of a wealthy winged athlete, caught in an awkward moment when his friend insults the whole team. He is left alone with the speaker as everyone else walks away.

feats.scene: Ellorn throws a ball so hard it dents a locker door.
He is tackled flat on a practice field and bounces up laughing.

name: Nerne
summary: Nerne is an ordinary person who falls to a spreading plague in a parody universe. The name appears in a casualty list and nowhere else.

feats.scene: Nerne holds on through three days of fever before the end.

name: Antoium
summary: Antoium is a small-town resident rescued from a flung truck by an armoured champion. He is a brief face in a crowd during a supervillain assault.

feats.scene: Antoium is pulled from beneath a falling vehicle with a sprained wrist.

name: Autia
summary: Autia is a prejudiced letter writer who sends an angry note to a city newspaper complaining about costumed vigilantes. He speaks in religious language about those who are different, and that is all that is recorded.

feats.scene: Autia slams a typewriter carriage so hard the ribbon jumps.

name: Ortelva
summary: Ortelva is a city mob boss who is wounded in a shootout and forces a doctor to patch him up at gunpoint. Once the bullet is out, he orders his men to silence the doctor, and he regrets it.

feats.scene: Ortelva fires a pistol through a clinic window and blasts out the glass.
He keeps standing and giving orders with a bullet in his shoulder.

name: Veltime
summary: Veltime is a scheming fortune hunter who romances a wealthy heiress in a southern plantation house, planning to marry her and kill her for the inheritance. A rival suitor stands in his way and Veltime turns him into a target.

feats.scene: Veltime shoves a rival through a porch railing in a fit of jealousy.
He tumbles down the porch steps and brushes himself off.

name: Iriar
summary: Iriar is a downcast thirty-something who is turned down at a restaurant proposal and told he has never amounted to anything. He gulps a strange brew handed to him by the waiter, and his evening takes a bizarre turn.

feats.scene: Iriar thumps the table in despair and rattles every teacup.
He topples backward off a chair and bumps his head with no lasting harm.

name: Sorlenia
summary: Sorlenia is a defiant henchwoman who crosses her crime-lord employer and ends up in a cell next to a bird-themed hero. Her loyalties flip once she sees whom she is really working for.

feats.scene: Sorlenia kicks a cell door lock hard enough to crack the bolt.
She is flung against a stone wall by a guard and keeps scheming.

name: Ritete
summary: Ritete is a boy who dies in a house fire and whose death breaks the mind of his father. The child has no deeds of his own beyond being loved.

feats.scene: Ritete holds his breath behind a closed bedroom door as smoke curls under it.

name: Notil
summary: Notil is a loyal ranch hand who stands by his employer when a schemer pushes her to sell up. He is steady and brave, and he fights with fists and a coiled rope.

feats.scene: Notil swings a fence post into an attacker's ribs.
He is thrown from a corral gate and gets up ready for more.

name: Osuro
summary: Osuro is a royal guard in a hidden kingdom, an expert with spear and baton who wears gleaming armour in a sea war. She is devoted to a partner among her sisters in arms.

feats.scene: Osuro hurls a spear across a deck and pins an enemy's shield to the mast.
Her armour turns aside a heavy spear strike during the clash.
She sprints across a pitching deck and vaults a rail.

name: Resin
summary: Resin is a comic-relief royal who is briefly possessed by an extradimensional parasite in a toy-brick adventure. A sorcerer reverses everything at the end of the level.

feats.scene: Resin kicks a plastic crate across a platform.
The figure is knocked apart into pieces and snaps back together.

name: Tarravil
summary: Tarravil is a voiced cartoon royal with a small speaking part in an animated adventure. Nothing about her past is spelled out.

feats.scene: Tarravil slaps a console and the screen flickers back on.

name: Tuorva
summary: Tuorva is a retired covert soldier who runs a bar in a neon-soaked future city. Years of fighting left her able with a gun and her fists, and a suspicious ex-colleague tries to have her killed.

feats.scene: Tuorva puts three rounds through a bottle shelf from the hip.
She takes a thrown bar stool across the arm and sweeps the attacker's legs.

name: Nenttas
summary: Nenttas is a hip-hop star with a royal-sounding nickname, married to another artist and mother of a daughter. She is a satirical celebrity figure with no fighting record.

feats.scene: Nenttas hurls a microphone stand into a speaker stack and topples it.

name: Severeon
summary: Severeon is a small-time criminal in a future timeline who is killed alongside many others by an unhinged strongman after a final battle. She has little role beyond that fall.

feats.scene: Severeon swings a lead pipe into a lamppost and bends it.
She is slammed through a shop window and keeps cursing.

name: Ontntro
summary: Ontntro is a worried parent evacuated from a city district during an outbreak that turns people into spider-like beings. Her daughter stays behind, and she listens in dread on the phone.

feats.scene: Ontntro is shoved by a panicked crowd and does not fall.

name: Stostu
summary: Stostu is a tiny, adorable artificial infant built as a replacement for an earlier batch of toddler troublemakers. The whole brood is blasted away to a distant corner of the cosmos by an angry spiral-fuelled mutant.

feats.scene: Stostu bonks a larger toy over the head with a rattle.
The infant is flung across worlds and lands giggling.

name: Seinanum
summary: Seinanum is a virtual-reality technician at a studio that treats its staff as property. His headset rig is used to trap a green rampager, who wakes up and fights back, leaving the technician in the wreckage.

feats.scene: Seinanum slaps a kill-switch panel and the lights in the studio blink.
He is tossed across a control room by a raging giant and survives.

name: Eorni
summary: Eorni is a police interrogator who presses a young woman about a campus accident and urges federal agents to search her flat. The character leaves her in tears and moves on to other cases.

feats.scene: Eorni slams a clipboard on an interview table to get attention.

name: Vaneaus
summary: Vaneaus is a lowly games-company drone who builds a reality-warping rig and tries to fund her media empire by robbing a bank. A frightened teller pulls an alarm and she turns the building into a dinosaur jungle.

feats.scene: Vaneaus triggers her rig and turns a bank lobby into a jungle full of roaring reptiles.
She is shoved to the floor by a security guard and scrambles up unhurt.

name: Testiaron
summary: Testiaron is a niece mentioned only on a character card in a toy-brick game. She has no deeds and no scenes.

feats.scene: Testiaron, a printed name on a card, is dropped on a floor and scuffed.

name: Vaollis
summary: Vaollis is a fictional athlete name invented by two bickering broadcasters who are padding a made-up skiing report. The name exists only as a joke in a comedy short.

feats.scene: Vaollis plants a pole hard enough to snap it on a pretend slope.

name: Iuaur
summary: Iuaur is a glamorous thief and trained wrestler who answers a summons to a hidden island base. When the plan of a would-be world-sterilising mastermind collapses, she slips away from the heroes.

feats.scene: Iuaur flips a guard over her shoulder and drives him through a table.
She takes a shield bash to the stomach and is back on her feet at once.

name: Iumine
summary: Iumine is a newspaper photographer who catches a smashed china shop and a masked fight on film. Her pictures are later used against a young hero in an arrest.

feats.scene: Iumine wedges her camera strap around a railing and hauls herself over.
She is knocked off her feet by a crowd surge and still holds the camera aloft.

name: Aussiure
summary: Aussiure is a petty crook with two henchwomen who spots a magazine cover and hatches a kidnapping plan. A flying goblin-themed hero spoils the scheme.

feats.scene: Aussiure fires a pistol that chips a concrete wall during the getaway.
She is thrown into a cluster of crates and crawls out dazed.

name: Reoseva
summary: Reoseva is a teenager at a school dance who nudges a shy friend into asking someone to dance. The kindness is a quiet bright spot in a story full of danger.

feats.scene: Reoseva claps a hand on a friend's back and sends her gently across the floor.

name: Liaval
summary: Liaval is a salvage courier who stores sunlight in her bones and vents it as shimmering ribbons of heat. Liaval learned to ride those thermals above rail yards, and the crews below swear her trail smells of baked bread.

feats.scene: Liaval gathered a whole day of stored sunlight into one white column and melted a quarry wall into glass.
Liaval walked out of a collapsing furnace stack with nothing worse than singed boots.
Liaval rode a hot updraft over the freight yards faster than any train below.

name: Tiuva
summary: Tiuva is a tunnel smuggler who turns her own body into a humming oven, cooking locks and chains right off the people she frees. Tiuva keeps a ledger of every name she has led to daylight.

feats.scene: Tiuva overheated a fence line of rusted guard towers until they sagged like warm wax.
Tiuva shrugged off a volley of pellet cannons fired from three paces.

name: Elleon
summary: Elleon is a vast chorus of survivors who outgrew their homeworld and swallowed the ghost of a dying sky-sovereign and a drowned tide-spirit. Elleon drifts between collapsing realities, shaping a fresh cosmos from whatever it digests.

feats.scene: Elleon folded two ancient spirits into itself and the flash lit an entire cluster of galaxies.
Elleon sat untouched at the heart of a collapsing galactic filament.
Elleon crossed the gulf between two suns in a single breath.

name: Rnusor
summary: Rnusor is a drifter who answers every rumor of a feud, hovering on a heat shimmer above the quarrelling crowds. Rnusor carries a thermos of salted tea and refuses to pick a side until someone starts a fire.

feats.scene: Rnusor boiled a stock tank dry from the air in one long exhale of heat.
Rnusor took a thrown anvil on the shoulder and kept hovering.
Rnusor skimmed a ridgeline at highway speed to reach the quarrel first.

name: Ronva
summary: Ronva is a bystander in a comic parody who spends the whole story gaping at a prankster's escalating stunts. Ronva has no powers, only perfect timing for showing up where the nonsense happens.

feats.scene: Ronva swatted a runaway balloon back across the crowded plaza.
Ronva took a cream pie to the face without flinching.
Ronva sprinted after the prankster's wagon and nearly caught it.

name: Nenli
summary: Nenli is a heat-wielding flier recruited into an alliance of heroes after a bruising reunion with a mind-clouded rival. Nenli lights the way for the squad with a steady golden glow, and cools it only when allies need rest.

feats.scene: Nenli blasted a hijacked cargo barge into a spray of molten rivets.
Nenli held a crumbling bridge arch aloft long enough for the crowd to flee.
Nenli streaked across the harbor ahead of a thunderhead.

name: Iueonum
summary: Iueonum is a part-time hero who lends a hand to a wall-climbing friend, warming a stubborn armature until its plating buckles. Iueonum hides a small shaking hand behind a calm grin.

feats.scene: Iueonum scorched the plating off a rolling armature with a focused burst.
Iueonum took a thrown dumpster lid across the ribs and stayed on her feet.

name: Vation
summary: Vation is a heat-slinging flier who swapped her old flame for a clanking mechanical suitor and proposed on a crowded rooftop. Vation fights beside a ragtag squad and has stared down a would-be conqueror with a grin.

feats.scene: Vation superheated a plaza fountain until the steam tore the awnings from three storefronts.
Vation absorbed a conqueror's backhand and climbed straight back up.

name: Isrell
summary: Isrell is a cloned flier on an island refuge, a copy of a copy who burns bright and thinks twice about the family she may never have had. Isrell can hover above the surf and turn driftwood to glowing embers.

feats.scene: Isrell lit a headland of dry scrub and set an entire shoreline alight at once.
Isrell weathered a collapsing sea cave and emerged coughing but whole.

name: Vavor
summary: Vavor is a devoted homemaker who keeps a crowded household running through every storm. Vavor's real power is the pot of stew on the stove and the open door for anyone who needs it.

feats.scene: Vavor swung a wooden spoon and ended a sibling squabble on the spot.
Vavor stood between her kids and a toppling shelf and caught it on her back.

name: Toleo
summary: Toleo is a young girl taken from her family's courtyard on the day of a celebration. Toleo has no powers, but she counts the footsteps of her captors and memorizes every turn the van takes.

feats.scene: Toleo kicked the van door open with both feet during a red light.
Toleo endured a long night on a cold concrete floor without a sound.

name: Moeoleo
summary: Moeoleo is a teenage contract killer with quick hands and too little patience, hired to remove a lawyer. Moeoleo trains alone on rooftops and is sure every rival is slower than her.

feats.scene: Moeoleo drove a thrown blade through a wooden door from across the alley.
Moeoleo took a hard strike to the jaw and tried to stand up anyway.
Moeoleo vaulted three fences in a row to close the distance.

name: Tenumias
summary: Tenumias is a hard-eyed trafficker who runs a border network from a walled villa. Tenumias pays soldiers well and treats loyalty as a line item that can be cut.

feats.scene: Tenumias fired a single rifle shot that dropped a rival lieutenant across a courtyard.
Tenumias endured a long labor alone in an emptied house.

name: Stllo
summary: Stllo is a blond cat burglar hired to lift the prize of a crowded station, with a stun-baton for company. Stllo moves through train concourses like a rumor and leaves only a smell of ozone.

feats.scene: Stllo cracked a glass display case with one precise baton strike.
Stllo rolled off a luggage cart and shook off a hard tumble across tile.

name: Cesmon
summary: Cesmon is a glowing thief made of light, written into a trap by a program-keeper and deleted as soon as she grew inconvenient. Cesmon boasts loudly, as if volume could make her real.

feats.scene: Cesmon brought a boot of hard light down on a fleeing pixel-carrying crate and flattened it.
Cesmon withstood a data-storm that scoured the walls of the simulated alley.
Cesmon sprinted along a rendered boulevard that kept stretching ahead of her.

name: Colva
summary: Colva is a fashionable heiress in a seaside capital whose suitors fight over her. Colva wants none of it, and one night a duel in her honor ends in a death she never asked for.

feats.scene: Colva slapped the dueling pistol out of a suitor's hand.
Colva stood through a long ballroom scandal without losing her poise.

name: Teulivo
summary: Teulivo is a university student worn down by relentless online cruelty who ends up on a roof ledge. Teulivo is saved at the last second by a stranger's leap, and two possible futures branch from that one night.

feats.scene: Teulivo shoved a street tough away and bought a stranger a few seconds.
Teulivo survived a fall from a rooftop ledge, caught in mid-air.

name: Lesanvo
summary: Lesanvo is a nervous mob underling who orders a killing on bad advice from a whispering advisor. Lesanvo spends the rest of his short life regretting how easily he was steered.

feats.scene: Lesanvo fired a pistol across a dim restaurant and missed twice before hitting.
Lesanvo took a hard shove into a marble table and lay winded.

name: Rnitel
summary: Rnitel is a gentle teen with grey, folded skin who is beaten nearly to death by strangers for how he looks. Rnitel is mostly a rumor among friends, and he forgives faster than anyone around him can.

feats.scene: Rnitel threw one wild punch at a bully and bruised his own knuckles.
Rnitel survived a vicious beating in an alley and woke up in a clinic.

name: Eolon
summary: Eolon is a lanky showman whose loose, stretchy hide changes color with his mood. Eolon sulks at a gala for misfits and quietly bests everyone at the pigment-swap game.

feats.scene: Eolon snapped a long arm across a banquet hall and toppled a stack of chairs.
Eolon bounced off a stone pillar and flopped back into shape.

name: Niialeo
summary: Niialeo is a new student at a school for gifted youth, stretching a rubbery frame while a headmaster talks about dreams. Niialeo is shy and tries to hide his strange hide under a hooded coat.

feats.scene: Niialeo whipped a long arm out and swatted a falling lamp aside.
Niialeo took a tumble down a marble staircase and bounced up laughing.

name: Stiumve
summary: Stiumve is a gray-skinned youth held captive aboard a flying prison, then slipped free by a daring friend. Stiumve eventually finds a roof and a bunk at an old school.

feats.scene: Stiumve stretched a wrist through a cell hatch and unhooked a latch.
Stiumve rode a rough prison transport and came out only dizzy.

name: Eosor
summary: Eosor is a short, loose-skinned youth on a team of young prodigies inside a corporate tower after a hostile takeover. Eosor jokes about his own hide and stretches it to carry packages.

feats.scene: Eosor snapped a long arm across a boardroom and swatted a stapler out of the air.
Eosor bounced off a glass partition and rolled to his feet.

name: Eonneron
summary: Eonneron is a synthetic double, one of countless decoys switched on by a scheming mimic and later set loose to break a master brain free. Eonneron blends into the circuitry and is erased in the final tide of metal.

feats.scene: Eonneron punched a hole through a bulkhead door with a servo-assisted fist.
Eonneron stood up after a falling beam crushed its torso and kept moving.
Eonneron bolted down the corridor at machine speed.

name: Tarnos
summary: Tarnos is a pampered son handed a living, snarling suit in an auction and told to make a man of himself. Tarnos is dazzled by his new bite, then abandoned by the suit mid-leap.

feats.scene: Tarnos tore a streetlamp off its base and swung it at a rooftop.
Tarnos took a heavy fall onto a parked van before the suit left him.
Tarnos bounded from awning to awning faster than any sprinter.

name: Seulnum
summary: Seulnum is a rebuilt soldier-of-fortune whose broken body was swapped for metal, and who keeps coming back after being declared dead. Seulnum keeps shifting sides to whoever pays the bills.

feats.scene: Seulnum drove a cybernetic fist through a reinforced door and kept going.
Seulnum was crushed under a toppled gantry and rebuilt himself the next season.
Seulnum launched from a rooftop on a jetpack and outran a patrol boat.

name: Eonmanum
summary: Eonmanum is an aloof crime lord in a smoky harbor city who lets almost nobody within arm's reach. Eonmanum survives on distance and favors, until a rival's men close in at the last dock.

feats.scene: Eonmanum fired a revolver from behind a bodyguard and shattered a lamp.
Eonmanum took a rifle butt to the temple and kept talking.

name: Ustil
summary: Ustil is a cousin mentioned once in a family gossip, an ordinary city dweller of two nations. Ustil bakes for holidays and keeps her door open to relatives.

feats.scene: Ustil rolled out a thick dough sheet with one firm push.
Ustil stood through a loud family argument without raising her voice.

name: Verria
summary: Verria is a widow who can draw story figures off the page into the waking world. Verria assembles a ragged household of heroes and rogues, then accidentally pulls in a real monster who despises her taste.

feats.scene: Verria willed a swashbuckler, a mischievous boy and a patchwork giant out of old paperbacks in one evening.
Verria was knocked across a parlor and rose still holding her book.

name: Seson
summary: Seson is a crimson-skinned tyrant who rules a patchwork planet from a gladiator pit. Seson collects champions like trophies and boasts that his arena has never lost a spectator.

feats.scene: Seson smashed a gate of reinforced alloy with a single swing of his scepter.
Seson took a rampaging beast's charge on his armored chest and held the line.
Seson swept across his arena floor on a hovering throne.

name: Sauriam
summary: Sauriam is a crowned overseer of arena battles who holds a fragment of a legendary weapon and loses it to a band of space rovers. Sauriam bows to the winners and joins their quest.

feats.scene: Sauriam cracked a stone pillar with a swing of his scepter.
Sauriam took a rover's blast on his armored chest and staggered.

name: Lilarle
summary: Lilarle is a green-eyed hunter with orange skin who stalks prey across a scorched moon of caves. Lilarle falls into a snare set by his quarry and is strung up by a thin cord.

feats.scene: Lilarle drove a spear through a cave beast's hide.
Lilarle shrugged off a rockfall that bruised half his ribs.

name: Numausvo
summary: Numausvo is a winged youth who joined a young band of unusual teens and soars above their rooftop hideout. Numausvo is brash and loves a good aerial dive, but is a little too quick to claim credit.

feats.scene: Numausvo dove at a speeding truck and tore off its tailgate with his talons.
Numausvo shook off a fall through a skylight and flapped back upward.
Numausvo stooped from a cloud bank faster than a falling hawk.

name: Niveor
summary: Niveor is a youthful god of affection and spring who rides to war with a legendary blade called the great fury. Niveor feasts at tables in a hidden green country and answers the call when giants raid the villages.

feats.scene: Niveor split a giant's stone barricade with a single stroke of his fabled blade.
Niveor stood beneath a falling cliff face and was only dusted with gravel.
Niveor galloped across a bog in a few heartbeats.

name: Viant
summary: Viant is a quiet farmer whose cattle and chickens suddenly act like caped crusaders. Viant keeps feeding them anyway, and wonders why the barn smells of lightning.

feats.scene: Viant hefted a feed sack and tossed it across the barnyard.
Viant was bowled over by a bellowing cow and got up laughing.

name: Sesam
summary: Sesam is a grey-haired seminary teacher with a gentle voice who once counseled a troubled student about violence. Sesam keeps a small chapel, a reading lamp and a tin box of hard candies for visitors.

feats.scene: Sesam rang the chapel bell by hand until the whole block woke.
Sesam stood in a drafty church through a long winter vigil.

name: Teslor
summary: Teslor is a proud clansman who joins a secret society to exploit a crystal buried under his family's keep. Teslor kidnaps relatives, loses his nerve at a cliff edge and leaps into the sea.

feats.scene: Teslor fired a rifle across a rocky glen and splintered a gatepost.
Teslor fell from a cliff into the surf and was swept away.

name: Vaste
summary: Vaste is a masked wrestler with retractable claws and a tough hide who signed up for a novelty claw-themed contest. Vaste insists on playing the tough guy in every promotional spot.

feats.scene: Vaste slammed an opponent through the ring ropes and into the front row.
Vaste took a folding chair and a top-rope elbow and shook it off.

name: Amvalar
summary: Amvalar is an island goddess of gales, forked lightning and monsoon, who inhabits a mortal host and defends a bustling port. Amvalar answers to ancient names and takes interest in the people who still sing her down.

feats.scene: Amvalar called a storm cell down onto an invading fleet and shredded its masts.
Amvalar stood in the eye of a typhoon she had summoned and was not moved.
Amvalar rode a lightning bolt across the strait and arrived before the thunder.

name: Nauleoran
summary: Nauleoran is a futurist whose divination predicts her husband's descent into vigilantism, so she leaves him and takes their son. Nauleoran reads maps and omens, and always packs a small bag before a quarrel starts.

feats.scene: Nauleoran slammed a ledger shut and ended an argument.
Nauleoran carried a sleeping child through a long night train.

name: Rneol
summary: Rneol is a witch who charms her way onto a throne, bleeds the land dry and bends her husband into a hunched servant. Rneol fears only one stepchild, and it costs her dearly.

feats.scene: Rneol drained the green from an entire valley in a single night.
Rneol took a hard blow from a spear and fell off her airship.

name: Sorve
summary: Sorve is an armored giant raised from a lowly grazing beast, with thick plates on his back and a heavy tail. Sorve serves a band of scaly lords in a jungle valley, swinging his club at any intruder.

feats.scene: Sorve smashed a boulder with his club and sent the shards across the clearing.
Sorve took a barrage of rifle fire on his plates and kept charging.

name: Oriniunan
summary: Oriniunan is a well-off mother in a cold future city who agrees to give up her gifted son to protect the family name. Oriniunan will live with that choice, and she is not a monster, only afraid.

feats.scene: Oriniunan signed the transfer papers with a trembling hand.
Oriniunan sat through a stiff dinner without letting her face crack.

name: Ameiumtol
summary: Ameiumtol is a pilot reshaped by a strange radiance into a being who can turn to green fog and slip into helmets and engines. Ameiumtol tends to sigh and stew in her own mist when her crew bickers.

feats.scene: Ameiumtol seeped into a visor and nearly suffocated her opponent.
Ameiumtol dissolved into mist as a gale scattered her and reformed later.

name: Ulestval
summary: Ulestval is a gas-bodied schemer who seduces a tyrant of a ruined world and poisons him from within. Ulestval is then shattered by an ally who buries her pieces apart.

feats.scene: Ulestval poured into a throne room as vapor and silenced a king in a single breath.
Ulestval was frozen solid and smashed, and the shards still twitched.

name: Ontteva
summary: Ontteva is a life-support officer on a failed experimental flight, now able to take any gaseous shape she can imagine. Ontteva plays a dangerous trick on her enemies with choking clouds and a toothy grin.

feats.scene: Ontteva condensed into a toxic cloud and swept an entire corridor of guards to the floor.
Ontteva scattered under a barrage of pellets and pulled herself back together.

name: Tarcartan
summary: Tarcartan is a blond legislator who chairs a town hall meeting to condemn a rampaging giant. Tarcartan speaks for the grieving crowd and refuses to let the room fall into a mob.

feats.scene: Tarcartan banged a gavel and silenced a roaring hall.
Tarcartan stood at the podium through a tense evening of heckling.

name: Lumlum
summary: Lumlum is a cheerful ad-desk clerk at a big-city newspaper who sells small notices to shopkeepers all day. Lumlum has no gift but a perfect memory for names and a laugh that carries across the newsroom.

feats.scene: Lumlum slammed a filing drawer shut and silenced a noisy office.
Lumlum worked a double shift through a blackout without complaint.

name: Neoor
summary: Neoor is a gag-strip editor who whistles to records, breeds odd puppies and writes a diary no one is meant to read. Neoor exists only to be silly, and the joke lands every time.

feats.scene: Neoor flung a stack of proofs across the office in a fit of laughter.
Neoor took a tumble over a desk and came up whistling.

name: Coalusan
summary: Coalusan is a frontier girl in a dusty cow town whose father frowns on gunslingers. Coalusan sends a letter for help when bandits ride in, then waits on the porch with a rolling pin.

feats.scene: Coalusan swung a rolling pin at an outlaw and cracked his hat brim.
Coalusan was shoved into a hitching post and stood up furious.

name: Amaaman
summary: Amaaman is a sharp-witted lab assistant who ignores everyone who doubts her. Amaaman is flung backward through the ages with her team and has to survive among beasts until a strong rescuer shows up.

feats.scene: Amaaman swung a branch at a raptor and drove it off the camp.
Amaaman survived a long night in the swamp with no shelter.

name: Iumorte
summary: Iumorte is a many-eyed, tentacled horror that conquered its birth reality and now devours the emotions of whole worlds. Iumorte takes shape as a living idea of domination, and is undone by a stronger idea.

feats.scene: Iumorte wrung the thoughts from a ring of enslaved planets and burned them as fuel for a single roar.
Iumorte reformed from shreds after a blast that unmade a nebula.
Iumorte flowed across a star system in a matter of minutes.

name: Ernntiser
summary: Ernntiser is a teenager out for a concert night who is trailed by a private eye and never notices. Ernntiser worries about her friend's strange trance and says so out loud on the train.

feats.scene: Ernntiser tapped a friend's shoulder to pull her out of a daze.
Ernntiser stood on a packed platform through a long delay.

name: Renama
summary: Renama is an elderly woman with a faded number inked on her arm, a survivor of a terrible camp. Renama tells her story to anyone who will listen, so it can never be erased.

feats.scene: Renama hurled a heavy ledger at a vandal and hit him square.
Renama endured years of hunger and labor and refused to forget.

name: Lutarti
summary: Lutarti is a patrol officer with a dry sense of humor and a steady hand. Lutarti once dated a pushy photographer, and still shakes her head at how he got tangled in a villain's scheme.

feats.scene: Lutarti tackled a fleeing suspect and pinned him to the pavement.
Lutarti took a nightstick to the vest and kept her feet.
Lutarti chased a purse snatcher through three city blocks.

name: Meoriaose
summary: Meoriaose is a gray-haired widow in a river city who once was admired and later shut away by those around her. Meoriaose keeps a hard stare and an iron memory, and no power at all.

feats.scene: Meoriaose pounded her cane on the floor until the room fell quiet.
Meoriaose sat through a long winter in an unheated room.

name: Rninia
summary: Rninia is a bishop's daughter whose touch can stop a heart, kept locked in a tower by anxious guards. Rninia bargains with a faerie sovereign for freedom, and the price is her own will.

feats.scene: Rninia pressed a palm to an oak door and the wood withered to grey ash.
Rninia was dragged across the tower stairs in chains and did not cry out.

name: Ennausia
summary: Ennausia is a small-statured physics tutor with a sharp mind and a warm laugh. Ennausia ends up kidnapped by a masked rogue because of whom she dates, and keeps calm until rescue.

feats.scene: Ennausia swung a physics textbook at her captor's knee.
Ennausia was tied to a chair overnight and still solved a problem set in her head.

name: Nacorses
summary: Nacorses is a covert agent raised in a war-torn orphanage and trained by spies who adopted her. Nacorses borrows the strength of anyone she touches and uses it for quick, brutal strikes.

feats.scene: Nacorses borrowed a brawler's might and sent a vault door spinning down the hall.
Nacorses took a point-blank shotgun blast and kept advancing.
Nacorses lifted off a rooftop on borrowed power and cut across the skyline.

name: Aulium
summary: Aulium is a glove-wearing wanderer who can siphon strength, stamina and flight from any person she brushes against. Aulium lives in a drafty school hall and has never been able to hold a hand in comfort.

feats.scene: Aulium siphoned a storm of lightning from a passing tempest and flung it back as a single brilliant bolt.
Aulium took a falling cathedral spire on her shoulders and walked out.
Aulium streaked over a mountain range in a minute.

name: Teslis
summary: Teslis is a newly married wanderer whose borrowed powers spun out of control after a touch of stolen time-energy. Teslis and her partner are chased across the stars and tossed through shifting eras.

feats.scene: Teslis released a surge of stolen time-energy and snapped a space station's ring in half.
Teslis rode out a temporal storm that swallowed a whole island.
Teslis flashed between orbits in an unsteady spiral.

name: Stalar
summary: Stalar is a flier from a doomed offshoot of reality who is glimpsed in a seer's vision, lying still at the feet of a conquering demon queen. Stalar is only ever remembered as a warning.

feats.scene: Stalar tore a wall from a barn with borrowed muscle before the vision faded.
Stalar was battered through a stone arch and rose again briefly.

name: Sosnismar
summary: Sosnismar is a married wanderer in a world where mutants were hunted to extinction by a ruthless machine order. Sosnismar falls in the last purge while her husband fights on alone.

feats.scene: Sosnismar punched through a patrol drone's casing with borrowed might.
Sosnismar absorbed a hailstorm of bolts before collapsing.

name: Alses
summary: Alses is a field commander in a hard, brutal timeline who absorbs memories and might from rivals and is wed to a stern, magnetic tyrant. Alses dies by a clawed hand in the closing hours of a long war.

feats.scene: Alses grabbed a hovering gunship and slammed it into a cliff wall.
Alses shrugged off a salvo of energy lances.
Alses crossed a battlefield on a borrowed gust of power.

name: Vites
summary: Vites is a woman sharing one body with a brash aerial heroine, and the two take turns steering. Vites raises a daughter and lives in a settled patchwork world with an old soldier.

feats.scene: Vites borrowed her flatmate's strength and heaved a collapsed tower off a village.
Vites took a landslide on her back and carried the child out.

name: Natel
summary: Natel is a gloved scavenger in a tunnel-dwelling society who soaks memories out of anyone she touches. Natel is cut down early in a twin siblings' rise to terror, and the memory of her stays with her enemies.

feats.scene: Natel siphoned a rival's strength and shattered a concrete pillar.
Natel took a heavy blow in a flooded passage and spat out blood.

name: Aniles
summary: Aniles is a red-haired woman who works the counter of a family butcher shop. Aniles keeps the shop spotless and her son's picture on the till.

feats.scene: Aniles swung a cleaver and halved a side of beef in one stroke.
Aniles stood at the counter through a long holiday rush.

name: Vionses
summary: Vionses is a caring retired neighbor who sets up a young couple over a plate of cookies. Vionses supports a friend through a rough year with endless pots of tea.

feats.scene: Vionses carried a heavy casserole across the fence to a sick friend.
Vionses sat up all night beside a hospital bed.

name: Neulilon
summary: Neulilon is a friendly matchmaker who nudged two shy neighbors into dinner. Neulilon lives in a quiet borough and loves a long afternoon chat.

feats.scene: Neulilon pushed open a stuck window to air out the parlor.
Neulilon stood through a long church service on a hot day.

name: Usorna
summary: Usorna is a neighbor in a bleak variant of the city who steps off a curb at the wrong moment. Usorna meets a sudden, plain end with no hero to catch her.

feats.scene: Usorna rapped her knuckles on a neighbor's door with a pie in hand.
Usorna stumbled into a lamppost and brushed off the bruise.

name: Ernina
summary: Ernina is a retired neighbor who coaxes two teens toward a school dance. Ernina is a close friend to the household next door and watches a street brawl from the sidewalk with a gasp.

feats.scene: Ernina waved her purse at a pigeon and shooed it from the bench.
Ernina sat through a cold afternoon at a hospital waiting room.

name: Iales
summary: Iales is a gray-haired neighbor drawn in a daily newspaper strip, who reassures a worried friend that nobody could harm a harmless student. Iales waters her window boxes and keeps a firm opinion on everything.

feats.scene: Iales tossed a bag of seed onto the lawn and scattered it wide.
Iales waited out a summer afternoon without fanning herself.

name: Teleos
summary: Teleos is a grey-haired neighbor who sends a young boy to fetch a parcel for a dollar. Teleos is a small part of a childhood tale, and a nice one.

feats.scene: Teleos pushed a dollar bill into a boy's pocket.
Teleos sat on the porch through a thundershower.

name: Valumrn
summary: Valumrn is a grey-haired neighbor who finds a stranger at her door and cannot quite hold a conversation with him. Valumrn serves tea in a quiet house where something about the visitor feels off.

feats.scene: Valumrn closed her front door gently behind a puzzled guest.
Valumrn sat through an awkward silence without spilling her tea.

name: Lusose
summary: Lusose is a thoughtful aunt who helps her friend get proper care after a scare. Lusose goes on a lucky vacation and dies with the rest of her world when it is erased.

feats.scene: Lusose hauled a heavy suitcase onto a train.
Lusose waited at a clinic bench all night.

name: Sasto
summary: Sasto is a gifted coder who repairs a rescued suit of armor and moves overseas to work for a big engineering firm. Sasto is deceived by a smooth-talking warlord, and her honest work is turned to a dark use.

feats.scene: Sasto yanked a failing server cable out of the wall and saved the day.
Sasto pulled an all-nighter at a console and finished the patch.

name: Meoluste
summary: Meoluste is a glove-wearing wanderer in a dismal future of steel hunters who round up her kind. Meoluste is presumed captured, and her name ends up carved on a grave marker.

feats.scene: Meoluste ripped a hatch off a patrol drone with a borrowed grip.
Meoluste stood against a sweep of stun bolts and went down slowly.

name: Saruama
summary: Saruama is a flier and brawler who joins a time-traveler's desperate fight to stop a plague. Saruama dies with the whole team when an ancient overlord finishes the battle in a single move.

feats.scene: Saruama flung a delivery truck through a laboratory wall.
Saruama took a hit from an overlord's fist and rolled through a barricade.
Saruama soared across a lake faster than a jet boat.

name: Anite
summary: Anite is a red-haired child of two heroes who inherits quick reflexes, a danger sense and a wall-crawling grip. Anite loses a parent to a murderous rival and grows up swinging from lamp posts to reach safety.

feats.scene: Anite hurled a parked sedan over a fence in a single throw.
Anite fell six stories onto a car roof and walked away.
Anite raced along an alley wall faster than a sprinting cheetah.

name: Coninto
summary: Coninto is a hero's child hijacked by a hostile alien hive that wants a whole planet for itself. Coninto commands puppet soldiers as a hard-eyed queen, bound to a mind older than the world.

feats.scene: Coninto turned a puppet army against a fortress and flattened its outer wall.
Coninto took a collapsing tower on her back and kept ordering troops forward.
Coninto swung across a canyon on a thread of hive tissue.

name: Orivor
summary: Orivor is a red-haired singer who tends a hotel bar and keeps a tab for stray strangers. Orivor translates for a frightened child, and her singing eases the room.

feats.scene: Orivor shoved a rowdy drunk out of the lounge with both hands.
Orivor sang four long sets with a sprained wrist.

name: Olinen
summary: Olinen is an office worker who watches two brawlers clash outside her window and is then attacked in her own room. Olinen survives a fall and recounts everything to a hero for hire.

feats.scene: Olinen threw a stapler at her attacker and cracked the lens of his goggles.
Olinen fell from a window ledge and survived on an awning.

name: Cevelle
summary: Cevelle is a bright dig-site scholar who loves adventure serials and accidentally wakes a field of undead warriors with a singing statuette. Cevelle insists on joining the warrior who arrives and nearly dies for it.

feats.scene: Cevelle swung a pickaxe at a skeletal raider and shattered its ribs.
Cevelle took a bone-shattering strike and was revived by a sorceress.

name: Oralu
summary: Oralu is a grey-haired empath who bends other people's moods and slips into hiding among outcasts. Oralu is accepted despite her trickery, and her eyes shift color when a strange engine hums nearby.

feats.scene: Oralu soothed a rioting crowd into silence with a quiet look.
Oralu endured a day of shouting without losing her composure.

name: Celis
summary: Celis is an embassy staffer in a cold capital who befriends an enemy agent and quietly helps her defect. Celis is later found murdered, and a loyal friend sets out to find the killer.

feats.scene: Celis stamped a forged pass and slid it under a guard's elbow.
Celis endured a frigid border crossing in a thin coat.

name: Leorir
summary: Leorir is a grey-haired mother who refuses to cash the stolen money her son keeps mailing her. Leorir blames herself for his turn to crime and dies still loving him.

feats.scene: Leorir tore up a stack of money orders and let them drift out the window.
Leorir survived years of bruises from a cruel husband and kept raising her boy.

name: Sesturi
summary: Sesturi is a dark-haired mother whose death leaves a young boy withdrawn into silence. Sesturi lives on only in memory, in a world after a long catastrophe.

feats.scene: Sesturi lifted her toddler onto her hip with one arm.
Sesturi comforted her child through a night of thunderstorms.

name: Ernntone
summary: Ernntone is a worried wife who begs her husband not to rob a payroll and fails. Ernntone watches the consequences and sweeps up the pieces afterward.

feats.scene: Ernntone grabbed her husband's sleeve and held on for three steps.
Ernntone stood at the kitchen window through a long, anxious night.

name: Ciiar
summary: Ciiar is a blonde mission-control operator who barks orders into a headset while a cyborg ally chases a masked acrobat. Ciiar never leaves the console, yet her voice steers the whole chase.

feats.scene: Ciiar slammed a palm on the console to cut off a noisy channel.
Ciiar stayed at her post through a twelve-hour shift.

name: Telell
summary: Telell is a silver-haired director of a cleanup company that repairs cities after heroes wreck them. Telell keeps a spotless ledger and a drawer of confiscated gadgets, and is tough as old boots.

feats.scene: Telell swung a recovered gadget at a thief and sent him sprawling.
Telell was bounced off a boardroom wall by a corporate raider and stood up.

name: Neneva
summary: Neneva is a hospital nurse turned into a mind-controlled bomb-builder by a pulse from the sky. Neneva wakes up in a workshop she does not recognize and recalls nothing of what she built.

feats.scene: Neneva assembled a crude explosive that tore a hole in a loading dock.
Neneva worked through a night of pulses without sleeping.

name: Tusvo
summary: Tusvo is a brisk talent agent at a teen-idol firm who reads fan mail by the crate. Tusvo picks a fair winner for a letter contest and sits through a dinner full of shy giggles.

feats.scene: Tusvo dumped a sack of fan letters onto the desk with a thump.
Tusvo read letters until midnight without a break.

name: Rniareo
summary: Rniareo is the lone survivor of a vanished dimension who joined a band of refugees from other broken worlds. Rniareo drifts through lattice paths with a lantern, guarding the last stories of her people.

feats.scene: Rniareo flung a ring of pale light that blasted a sentry post to cinders.
Rniareo weathered a collapsing portal and stepped out with only scorched sleeves.
Rniareo glided down a glowing lattice path faster than a galloping horse.

name: Allum
summary: Allum keeps order over a drifting research college built on stilts above a tidal flat, trusting radios, rope ladders and a short temper. Chroniclers recall the night a dozen lecture halls went dark and Allum still counted every student out.

feats.scene: Allum drags a steel cabinet across a corridor to seal a doorway before the blast arrives.
Allum rides out a shockwave that hurls a lab bench across the room.

name: Veotor
summary: Veotor runs a dusty cattle yard at the edge of a dry basin and is quick to send for help when a younger sibling rides toward trouble. Locals say the fences around the yard are never rotten and the lantern is never out.

feats.scene: Veotor hauls a bolting horse to a halt by the reins alone.
Veotor is thrown from a saddle, lands hard in the dust and rises to keep working.

name: Tarserrn
summary: Tarserrn is an advocate who briefly shared a body with a hungry living coat from beyond the sky, gaining fangs, hooked fingers and a long tongue. Rumor holds that the coat left bruises on the conscience and none on the court record.

feats.scene: Tarserrn peels a van door off its hinges to reach a trapped passenger.
Tarserrn tumbles through a shattered windshield and stands up unmarked.

name: Estsercel
summary: Estsercel argued cases in a courthouse that exists only in a parallel archive, and the single surviving record of the career is a rumor of its ending. Songs of the bar still cite one divorce settlement as a masterwork of patience.

feats.scene: Estsercel slams a heavy case file onto the counsel table with a thump that silences the room.
Estsercel is knocked flat by a sprung revolving door and finishes the closing argument anyway.

name: Saual
summary: Saual defended a scaly-skinned chemist in a trial that went badly, arguing that the cure was taken to shield others from the lab that made it. Records of the verdict survive only as a brief note beside a prison transfer slip.

feats.scene: Saual shoves open a stuck courtroom door with one shoulder.
Saual absorbs a hard jostle from the crowd gathered on the courthouse steps.

name: Ontse
summary: Ontse is a tall, blue-haired sentinel of a floating fortress who feels the mood of everyone nearby and can twist a mind with a glance. Chroniclers note a heavy rifle always at the hip and a gift for stepping out of danger half a beat early.

feats.scene: Ontse fires a heavy rifle round straight through a hangar door.
Ontse is flung across a corridor when the fortress shudders and keeps both feet.

name: Llose
summary: Llose is a plump, three-fingered counselor in a land of backward rhymes, famous for giving a mayor the worst advice that happened to work. Songs claim a boring storyteller was beaten by nothing more than a spanking and a pair of shiny shoes.

feats.scene: Llose swats a sulking tyrant across the seat of the trousers with a flat palm.
Llose shrugs off a dropped sack of sand that lands squarely on one shoulder.

name: Ontelor
summary: Ontelor sleeps in doorways near a frozen stretch of the avenue and notices everything the patrol officers miss. Locals trust the word of Ontelor over a dozen witnesses.

feats.scene: Ontelor waves down a patrol car with a stiff arm in the falling snow.
Ontelor weathers a night of sleet on a bench without complaint.

name: Liuamni
summary: Liuamni lost a child to a custody ruling and took a bargain from a scheming wizard, who wrapped the worry into scales and wings. Chroniclers record one furious flight across the rooftops that toppled a storage tank and ended only when a child cried.

feats.scene: Liuamni, in scaled form, smashes a rooftop water tank so that it collapses toward the street.
Liuamni takes a knight's heavy blade strikes without slowing the rampage.

name: Vaornll
summary: Vaornll lives alone in a top-floor flat and has an uncanny sense for when a stranger steps through the door. Few neighbors know that the first greeting is always a threat to ring the constables.

feats.scene: Vaornll hurls a heavy telephone at the doorway to scare off the visitor.
Vaornll braces against a startled shove from the hallway.

name: Ontce
summary: Ontce is a time-skipping duelist from a distant age who arrives a century too early and tests a young flier with a surprise ambush. Rumor says the duelist overshot the date by a wide margin and left to look for a better opponent.

feats.scene: Ontce drives a charged blade through a restaurant wall to reach the target.
Ontce rolls clear of a point-blank blast and brushes off the soot.

name: Reste
summary: Reste keeps the calendar at a film production desk and sends gentle messages to a missing boss, then quietly rearranges the day. Colleagues say the texts have saved more productions than any lawyer on the payroll.

feats.scene: Reste slaps a stack of schedules onto the desk to end an argument.
Reste stays on the phone through an hour of shouting without hanging up.

name: Cesneure
summary: Cesneure is a silver-haired relief volunteer and hoarder of curiosities who salvaged a dead machine skull from wreckage and set it on a shelf. Neighbors still talk about the evening it blinked awake beside the television.

feats.scene: Cesneure lifts a heavy crate of donated blankets onto a truck bed.
Cesneure stumbles through falling plaster while hauling the skull to safety.

name: Aulrnal
summary: Aulrnal is the youngest of a doomed family caught between feuding gangs, remembered for a stubborn braid and a bright laugh. Songs from the old neighborhood mark the spot where the family lost its last picnic.

feats.scene: Aulrnal flings a rubber ball hard enough to rattle a garage door.
Aulrnal tumbles from a swing set and gets up laughing.

name: Vilsau
