feats.scene: Lesean turns a laser tower on a hangar and melts its doors.
Lesean shrugs off a thrown shield and cackles into a console.

name: Lustosan
summary: Lustosan is a spoiled heir whose love of toys grew into a deadly obsession, and his funhouse turns captives into playthings. He is short, red-haired, and thoroughly amoral.

feats.scene: Lustosan flips a lever and a spiked ceiling crashes down on a hallway.
Lustosan is thrown into a console and cheerfully brushes off the sparks.

name: Tesnausta
summary: Tesnausta is a brown-haired machine-controller who pouts when a young hero slips out of his snare. He runs his games from a gloomy port district.

feats.scene: Tesnausta commands a crane arm to swat a pursuer across a yard.
Tesnausta flops onto a couch after a rattling tumble.

name: Istir
summary: Istir is a conceited tinkerer who runs a theme park of killer robots and baits a famous scientist into his trap. His own machines are turned back on him, and he ends up in handcuffs.

feats.scene: Istir sets a swarm of robots loose that flatten a row of carnival booths.
Istir is dragged out of a ruined ride and lands on his feet, sulking.

name: Rintetan
summary: Rintetan is a kidnapper who gathers gifted teenagers in an arena and forces them to fight. His crimes are recorded in a single brief paragraph of a thriller.

feats.scene: Rintetan slams a steel gate shut on a captive's heels.
Rintetan endures a scuffle with an escaped captive and recovers his footing.

name: Nanau
summary: Nanau is a prisoner who rebuilds a deadly funhouse on a stolen world and presses kidnapped heroes into combat. A shrunken scientist's insect couriers deliver a toxic payback straight to his bloodstream.

feats.scene: Nanau throws a switch and drops a trapdoor under a dozen captives.
Nanau gasps under a tiny sting and bargains for an antidote.

name: Tuval
summary: Tuval is a red-haired hired killer who pays a brainwashed assassin for his services. The assassin wakes up and settles the account in blood.

feats.scene: Tuval fires a pistol into a wall and chips the plaster.
Tuval takes a heavy shove in a doorway and swears.

name: Civeo
summary: Civeo is a red-haired showman whose amusement hall is pushed on viewers by a shameless ad that cannot be skipped. Its social account is as loud as its traps.

feats.scene: Civeo slaps a button and launches a garish jingle across a screen.
Civeo endures a flood of angry comments without blinking.

name: Cetia
summary: Cetia is a showman villain in a bright alternate world who is one among many foes put down by a patriotic hero. His part is mentioned and then forgotten.

feats.scene: Cetia flings a trick box that bursts into confetti and smoke.
Cetia is flattened in a skirmish and bounces back up groggy.

name: Ulite
summary: Ulite owns a rusted travelling funfair whose rides secretly double as snares, and every game is rigged for the house. Losers find the exits chained until they have worked off what they owe.

feats.scene: Ulite drops a loosened carousel arm across a trespasser's escape route, crushing the cart beneath it.
Ulite walks out of a collapsed ticket booth with nothing worse than bruises.

name: Linosne
summary: Linosne is a reanimated sentry who pours a stored shove into loose objects, then lets them fly like shells. The dead flesh feels nothing, so the sentry simply keeps walking forward through whatever answers back.

feats.scene: Linosne charges a derelict truck with stored momentum and sends it skidding through a barricade of steel drums.
Linosne takes a speeding freight cart square in the chest and rises without a flinch.

name: Sanvos
summary: Sanvos weaves spells out of drifting runes and borrowed starlight, preferring a quiet study to any battlefield. When a frightened government built a weapon to erase gifted people, Sanvos was among those it caught.

feats.scene: Sanvos folds a chorus of runes into a single pulse that flattens a stone farmhouse.
Sanvos stands inside a toppling tower of her own conjuring, sheltered by a braided shell of light.

name: Cesusva
summary: Cesusva is a travelling sorceress whose signature spell swaps places between distant spots in a blink. She tries to talk rivals down before casting, which has cost her more than once.

feats.scene: Cesusva hurls a swapping spell that drops a sea monster and its master a mile inland, cracking a pier on arrival.
Cesusva weathers a cascade of collapsing vault stones behind a thin ward of silver sparks.

name: Amstuser
summary: Amstuser is a squat mechanical pilot built to steer warships, obedient to a fault and wired with a brittle conscience. A single contradictory order is enough to send its circuits into a fatal loop.

feats.scene: Amstuser wrenches a seized cockpit lever until the whole console bursts open.
Amstuser rides out a hard crash landing with only its casing dented.

name: Orriva
summary: Orriva is a feathered figure conjured by a television tyrant to play a cheerful rescuer in a staged rerun. The flight is real even though the performance is not.

feats.scene: Orriva dives from the studio rafters and knocks a prop cannon off its mount.
Orriva tumbles through a painted set wall and bounces up unhurt.

name: Amcil
summary: Amcil patrols a colonial capital on broad metallic wings, a rebel who trusts reflexes over plans. The blue-tinged skin and gleaming feathers make her impossible to mistake in a crowd.

feats.scene: Amcil sweeps a rooftop railing into the street with one beat of her steel wings.
Amcil absorbs a volley from a mounted musket line against her armoured feathers.

name: Rnutannen
summary: Rnutannen is a stunt performer hired to play a winged hero in a film that mashes two wars together. Nobody on set is sure whether Rnutannen was grown in a vat, imported, or simply paid by the day.

feats.scene: Rnutannen swings a prop sabre through a plywood fort wall in one take.
Rnutannen drops from a camera crane onto padded mats and walks away.

name: Viaiasi
summary: Viaiasi is a cautious astronomer who withholds judgement until the data are laid out on the table. Colleagues summon Viaiasi to every disputed finding because the verdict, once given, never shifts.

feats.scene: Viaiasi slams a heavy star atlas shut to end a heated lecture hall argument.
Viaiasi climbs an observatory ladder in a gale and hangs on through the gusts.

name: Rumontam
summary: Rumontam is a small-time blackmailer whose skin hardened into faceted gemstone after a lab accident. The new hide made a coward bolder, though a stray punch from a flying teenager still ends his nights.

feats.scene: Rumontam shatters a parked van's windscreen and dents its roof with a faceted fist.
Rumontam stands unmoved while a swung lamppost bends around his shoulder.

name: Tecenci
summary: Tecenci is a prism-bodied brawler from a parallel strip, bald and sapphire-eyed, who keeps starting fights he can only half finish. Light bends through his limbs when he is angry.

feats.scene: Tecenci punches a vending machine through a shopfront and into the road.
Tecenci laughs off a taxi that clips him at full speed.

name: Aniias
summary: Aniias is a grey-haired colonel who solves problems by phoning the right depot. Old loyalties and a stubborn streak drive a tidy career toward one disastrous order.

feats.scene: Aniias signs the order that sends a single artillery round into a deserted quarry.
Aniias is thrown from a jeep during a rough drill and stands up smiling.

name: Meont
summary: Meont is a retired shopkeeper with a thinning grey crest who walks the same two blocks each morning. A purse snatcher in a feathered costume once spoiled the routine, and the neighbours still talk about it.

feats.scene: Meont swings a rolled umbrella at a pigeon and misses by a foot.
Meont stumbles down a short staircase and rises with a grumble.

name: Nerutol
summary: Nerutol is a laboratory chemist hired by a scheming aristocrat to finish a secret formula. Pay disputes pull Nerutol away and back again, right up to the day the whole workshop is wrecked.

feats.scene: Nerutol opens an overloaded coolant vent that blows a steel hatch across the lab.
Nerutol shelters under a workbench while ceiling tiles rain down.

name: Aunre
summary: Aunre is a hired gun who takes jobs under a flat nickname and wears borrowed faces for access. Bad luck and a mistaken identity keep him from ever collecting a second paycheck.

feats.scene: Aunre squeezes off a rifle round that punches through a stuccoed wall.
Aunre rolls down a fire escape and finishes on his feet.

name: Iarve
summary: Iarve is a heavy green tyrant-lizard from a distant world, jovial, fond of cheap films and badly overfed. Tail, jaws and sheer bulk make him a better fighter than a flat-footed comedian has any right to be.

feats.scene: Iarve tail-whips a hovering truck into a brick wall without losing his grin.
Iarve shrugs off a crashed cargo drone that lands on his back.

name: Iumlumliu
summary: Iumlumliu is a quick-witted pilot who came back from orbit with a body that coils and extends like warm taffy. The new reach is great for dodging but terrible for keeping secrets.

feats.scene: Iumlumliu lashes an extended arm around a flagpole and snaps it free of its base.
Iumlumliu absorbs a collision with a bus by stretching into a loose curve around its bumper.

name: Issor
summary: Issor is a balding golfer and committee regular who helps hold a stranger on the sixth green for an angry lawman. When a fiery wreck rips through the clubhouse lawn, nobody thinks to look for him.

feats.scene: Issor swings a nine iron at a hedge and shears off a branch.
Issor tumbles off a golf cart into a sand trap and laughs.

name: Orlell
summary: Orlell is a political aide with a talent for bad ideas, fond of staging impersonations to embarrass his boss's rivals. He keeps a red notebook of favours owed and pays none of them.

feats.scene: Orlell slams a briefcase onto a conference table and scatters a stack of memos.
Orlell is shoved against a car and stays upright, mostly from stubbornness.

name: Oracal
summary: Oracal is a blue-skinned showman who commands tide, gale, flame and frost as long as his boots touch the ground. His stage act is a hostage situation with applause, and his own ego is the first thing to give out.

feats.scene: Oracal calls a wall of seawater over a crowded plaza and freezes it into a ringing dome.
Oracal stands in a cyclone of his own making and sheds the blow of a falling statue.

name: Tesesnt
summary: Tesesnt is the last of a vanished elder line, a patient liar who wore a dozen borrowed identities across the centuries. Its mirages and snakes of light have toppled kings, and only a determined assassin ever managed to end it.

feats.scene: Tesesnt unravels a mountain village's mirage and brings the real ridge down on a pursuing army.
Tesesnt wades unharmed through a firestorm that turns the surrounding forest to glass.

name: Aluses
summary: Aluses is a half-forgotten wizard who knitted a shimmering span between two far-off realms. The bridge was paid for by a pair of lovers who never met, and the builder never forgave himself.

feats.scene: Aluses lays a span of braided colour across the void between two realms and locks it in place.
Aluses stands in the cold of the gap while the unfinished span trembles around him.

name: Cosose
summary: Cosose is a white-haired sorceress who leads a secretive order from a mountain temple. Her rites draw on old blades and incense smoke, and rivals rarely survive the first chant.

feats.scene: Cosose finishes a chant that detonates a stone gatehouse in a ring of ghostly fire.
Cosose stands calmly inside a ward as a collapsing roof rains rubble around her.

name: Ronnealu
summary: Ronnealu is a purple-haired raider who leads from the front, shaking the ground to throw enemies off balance. A trembling shell around his body slows incoming blasts, though it never quite stops them.

feats.scene: Ronnealu stamps the pavement and a shock wave flings a parked motorbike across the lot.
Ronnealu holds his ground inside the trembling shell as a red beam grinds against it.

name: Lllli
summary: Lllli is a door guard in crimson armour who stands watch outside a ruler's chamber every night. A surprise visitor wearing a familiar smile is the last thing Lllli ever sees.

feats.scene: Lllli drives a short sword through a wooden shield in a single thrust.
Lllli takes a heavy shove into a stone pillar and keeps his stance.

name: Luorros
summary: Luorros is a winged sentinel of the high heavens with a seat on a council of thrones. A quiet cousin to others of his order, he prefers to settle disputes before the host is called.

feats.scene: Luorros brings a shaft of white radiance down on a siege tower and vaporises it.
Luorros hangs in the air through a barrage of fiendish lightning, wings barely singed.

name: Lumvavos
summary: Lumvavos is a green-skinned technician in a floating court who tracks the wear on its foundations. The role is humble, but the whole city depends on his schedule.

feats.scene: Lumvavos pries a corroded panel off a support strut with a pry bar.
Lumvavos hangs from a gantry through a gust and holds on.

name: Ntinelia
summary: Ntinelia is a pale youth sprouting bone-white spikes from every limb, raised in a cloister that hid his gift. He bristles when a sibling is threatened and has no patience for lectures.

feats.scene: Ntinelia bursts a car's frame with an eruption of pale spikes.
Ntinelia stands through a squad's volley as the shards turn aside each round.

name: Reron
summary: Reron is an eight-foot blue warrior from an engineered line, once worshipped by a northern tribe and long since jailed by a jealous king. He carries a tutor's patience and a general's temper in the same broad frame.

feats.scene: Reron shatters a fortress gate with a single two-handed blow.
Reron stands unharmed inside a chamber as its roof beams crash down around him.

name: Sanal
summary: Sanal is a hot-tempered blue officer who fires blasts from his palms and rises through the air to meet an enemy fleet. Grief for fallen comrades pushes him to attack long past the point of good sense.

feats.scene: Sanal pours a ball of pale energy into a landing craft and splits it down the middle.
Sanal takes a hit from a rival's flare and tumbles through the sky still conscious.
Sanal streaks across a battlefield after a fleeing commander.

name: Corva
summary: Corva is a heavy ally in a console brawler who flings blue-white triangles of force at anyone near the player. The character is easy to pick but hard to master, and quickly forgotten once the campaign ends.

feats.scene: Corva throws three spinning triangles that carve a hole in a hangar wall.
Corva stands at the centre of a bomb crater and walks out of it.

name: Soraul
summary: Soraul is a gold-skinned woman made by ritual from a borrowed spark, designed to tempt a silver wanderer from his duty. She was freed from that purpose and now fights alongside strange allies.

feats.scene: Soraul drags a tower of burning light down onto a besieging fleet and sinks it.
Soraul hangs inside a collapsing dimensional fold and steps out untouched.

name: Tassorna
summary: Tassorna is a golden envoy forged by a world-eater to prove a point about humankind. Tenderness derailed the mission, and the maker reclaimed the loan in one cold moment.

feats.scene: Tassorna pours a bar of cosmic radiance across a barren moon and carves a canyon through it.
Tassorna stands inside a collapsing pocket of space until it folds shut around her.
Tassorna crosses a sunlit gulf of space in the span of a single heartbeat.

name: Ialntuvia
summary: Ialntuvia is a green-skinned soldier of a vast armada, trained to copy any shape. A flung metal disc ends his first battle before it truly begins.

feats.scene: Ialntuvia fires a sidearm that scars the wall of the flagship corridor.
Ialntuvia crumples when a thrown disc cracks off his helmet.

name: Rostiuni
summary: Rostiuni is a scarred, restless patron of conflict who thrives wherever a banner is raised. His appetites run through every campaign of the age, and few mortals meet his eyes without flinching.

feats.scene: Rostiuni brings both fists down on a mountain fortress and pulverises its whole summit.
Rostiuni stands in the heart of a siege cannonade while the ramparts melt around him.

name: Ntuneo
summary: Ntuneo is a bearded war deity of a mirror realm, widely feared, and the first of his kin to fall to a family rage. Rivals speak of his strength with a sort of grudging respect.

feats.scene: Ntuneo hurls a spear that splits a crag in two and leaves the plain below ringing.
Ntuneo stands through a barrage of divine lightning before finally crashing to a knee.

name: Amsest
summary: Amsest is a seasoned fighter of the heavenly line who answers an alarm across a crowded metropolis. Perfectly trained with every blade in the armoury, he is nevertheless outmatched by a green rage.

feats.scene: Amsest hurls a bronze spear that punches a hole through a collapsing skyscraper wall.
Amsest tumbles through three storeys of rubble and rises with a scowl.

name: Ausroneo
summary: Ausroneo is a sullen deity of battle recruited to guard a government's flying tower. A scuffle on a remote island and a hungry parasite complicate his first official job.

feats.scene: Ausroneo cleaves a cliff face and sends the shore into the surf in a single swing.
Ausroneo wades through a surge of dark tendrils with his armour smoking.

name: Tesullsum
summary: Tesullsum is a hill-born champion forced to serve a hive-minded conqueror, marching in step with machines. Years of empty drills have dulled his old fire, though a strike still carries weight.

feats.scene: Tesullsum slams a battle axe into a frozen citadel gate and splits it from top to bottom.
Tesullsum shakes off a volley from a patrol of rival lancers.

name: Cororo
summary: Cororo is a brown-haired battle deity pressed into service by a ruthless official and bound to a rogue squad. When the ruler is toppled and the old sky city burns, his fate is left unwritten.

feats.scene: Cororo breaks a siege engine across his knee and hurls the shards into a rival's formation.
Cororo stands beneath a toppling spire as it crumbles into dust around him.

name: Oncorva
summary: Oncorva is a slumming brawler in a lawless casino district, fond of ambushing trespassers. He lurks in the gaming hall and welcomes a good scrap, rarely staying for the finish.

feats.scene: Oncorva flips a roulette table across the hall and shatters a pillar behind it.
Oncorva takes a barrage of pistol fire in the chest without breaking stride.

name: Innesli
summary: Innesli is a black-haired deity of strife who joins a ruler's private guard and sprints to stop an assassin. He arrives a heartbeat too late, and what follows is the first of many disasters.

feats.scene: Innesli kicks open a vault door so hard that the whole corridor collapses behind it.
Innesli staggers out of a blast chamber with his armour glowing but intact.

name: Iumcesau
summary: Iumcesau is a blocky toy-brick version of a fighting deity, wandering a city of plastic skyscrapers. The character matters little to the story but is a joy to smash things with.

feats.scene: Iumcesau topples a stack of plastic towers with one wide swing of a brick hammer.
Iumcesau pops back together after a tumble down a staircase of bricks.

name: Iaameleo
summary: Iaameleo is a tactician in a puzzle-battler whose command of troop movements is unmatched, and whose appetite for combat made him a divisive ally. Matching coloured tiles unleashes his strikes.

feats.scene: Iaameleo aligns four glowing tiles and a spear of fire punches through a fortress wall.
Iaameleo is buried under an avalanche of falling gems and steps out whole.

name: Sestte
summary: Sestte is a deity of conflict who lived in luxury after a usurper bent the world to his will. The luxury ends when a purple tyrant reaches for a glove and strikes Sestte down.

feats.scene: Sestte hurls a javelin that shatters a marble colonnade and the hill beneath it.
Sestte reels from a rain of meteors and stays on his feet until the final blow.

name: Viall
summary: Viall is a stocky, brown-eyed patriarch of a warrior tribe who wiped out the clan that his own daughter led. He then stole a tyrant's seat by deploying lookalike robots, until his granddaughter's avenger came for him.

feats.scene: Viall swings a great axe that flattens an entire hillside fortress.
Viall stands through a blow from his own resurrected kin and shakes it off.

name: Nurumaus
summary: Nurumaus is a red-eyed instructor at a school for young heroes who teaches that a tough day builds character. A sibling's team takes him into a defence against a celestial fleet.

feats.scene: Nurumaus demonstrates a stomp that splits a training field and sends students sprawling.
Nurumaus takes a hit from a conjured queen's army and walks out of the cloud of dust.

name: Mecost
summary: Mecost is a distant war deity glimpsed only by rumour, mistaken by a visiting inventor for a shape-changing impostor. Little is known about the real figure beyond the reputation that goes before him.

feats.scene: Mecost bellows a challenge that cracks the terrace of a mountain temple.
Mecost withstands an avalanche of marble from a ruined colonnade without a mark.

name: Calseo
summary: Calseo is a pocket-sized, cartoonish deity of battle who always shows up when heroes are rallied and then politely declines to fight. The pose is comic, but the power under the tiny armour is real.

feats.scene: Calseo stomps a toy-sized boot and cracks a paved square from corner to corner.
Calseo is flicked across a playground by a tantruming giant and bounces up laughing.

name: Amacomo
summary: Amacomo is a weary patron of conflict who grew bored of the quiet halls above and walked among mortals instead. After years of bloodshed he swapped appetite for duty and now fights to shield rather than conquer.

feats.scene: Amacomo brings a spiked mace down on a rampaging siege colossus and splits it across the middle.
Amacomo plants his feet against a collapsing bridge and holds it up long enough for a crowd to flee.

name: Auncoris
summary: Auncoris is a swaggering brute in a lurid parody of a team of villains, played purely for laughs. A wisecracking mercenary dismantles the whole squad before the first commercial break.

feats.scene: Auncoris punts a rubber car across a sound stage and through the back wall.
Auncoris is flattened by a falling billboard and pops out the other side with his hair on end.

name: Istelsa
summary: Istelsa is a heavyset fighter in a hand-held game who pops up in the middle of a lineup of dubious allies. A short animation, a loud shout and a stiff swing are the whole repertoire.

feats.scene: Istelsa windmills a broadsword and sends three practice dummies through a screen wall.
Istelsa stands up from a flattening ground slam without a scratch.

name: Rnalse
summary: Rnalse is known to the world only as a carved marble head on a shelf of former champions. Whatever battles he fought were lost to the dust of a faraway arena.

feats.scene: Rnalse, in a half-remembered bout, flattens a granite pedestal with a single club.
Rnalse's marble likeness survives a toppled column with only a hairline crack.

name: Covari
summary: Covari is a background extra on a film set run by a capricious studio boss. Nobody can say whether he was drawn from clay, borrowed from elsewhere, or merely hired for the weekend.

feats.scene: Covari swings a rubber lance at a cardboard dragon and snaps the shaft.
Covari is dumped off a rented horse and gets back up on cue.

name: Amtute
summary: Amtute is the lesser of two siblings in a snowbound city of long-lived beings, always compared to a more famous elder. When a cruel conqueror laid waste to the streets, the quiet one was among the first to fall.

feats.scene: Amtute shapes a lance of pale light and pierces a glacier wall to open an escape route.
Amtute stands in a collapsing arcade of ice and walks free of the dust.

name: Oraus
summary: Oraus is a grey-haired tycoon who sold safe berths in a sunken refuge to the rich while the surface went to war. His plot to bottle a sea prince's blood for immortality ends in handcuffs.

feats.scene: Oraus slams a pressure hatch on a rival's hand and warps the frame.
Oraus weathers a lurching floor during a tremor in the deep and keeps his balance.

name: Coornser
summary: Coornser is a boastful half-divine vigilante who joined a veteran team of heroes and lashed out at the mention of an old friend. The hot temper is matched by a hybrid body that few foes can bruise.

feats.scene: Coornser throws a manhole cover that cuts a street lamp in half and lodges in a wall.
Coornser is bowled through a bank wall by a shape-changer and just brushes off the plaster.

name: Sosias
summary: Sosias is a brown-haired warrior with green blood, raised in a distant plane for a single doomed errand. His noble nature was the true weapon his father sent, meant to calm a rampaging machine.

feats.scene: Sosias cuts a ship's mast in two with a single stroke of a glowing sword.
Sosias reels from a dozen strikes by a metal giant and stays on his feet for a full minute.

name: Olcel
summary: Olcel is a young blond ruler in a tiny, glittering world who leads a rebel army against a tyrant. A cruel surgery fuses him with his mount, and a later betrayal proves hollow when the tyrant returns from within him.

feats.scene: Olcel gallops into a patrol line, scattering a squad and cracking a barricade.
Olcel absorbs a hail of lance strikes against his armoured flank and rides through.

name: Siant
summary: Siant is a blue-skinned, black-haired commander of an undersea army, loyal long after loyalty stopped paying. Gills, tough flesh and a sharp eye let him fight in crushing depths that would kill most soldiers.

feats.scene: Siant drives a trident through a reinforced gate and tears it off its hinges.
Siant keeps fighting at crushing depth where hull plates buckle around him.

name: Tastoso
summary: Tastoso is a would-be film director whose lens-eyed vision was a short-lived side effect of an ionic accident. The gift is gone now, and the camera is all he has left to point at the world.

feats.scene: Tastoso, at the height of his gift, bursts a stack of lighting rigs with a flash from his eyes.
Tastoso is thrown from a stage platform and walks off the set with a limp.

name: Lusrnesi
summary: Lusrnesi is a dark-haired biker who enters a charity race with three friends and loses it for the sake of a photograph. A good-natured sprint, though the finish line is nowhere near the front.

feats.scene: Lusrnesi revs a motorcycle and kicks a stand off its post in a staged skid.
Lusrnesi slides across gravel in leathers and bounces back up with a grin.

name: Ellceor
summary: Ellceor is a grey-haired villager in a frozen farming settlement who raised a boy and then buried him. Grief hardened her, and she took in another child in his place.

feats.scene: Ellceor swings an iron poker at a door that has stuck and splits the panel.
Ellceor endures a long night outdoors in a blizzard and returns home unharmed.

name: Iumsorteo
summary: Iumsorteo is a young hero whose entire body is faceted, see-through crystal, glinting in the sun. She started on a regional squad before founding her own band of misfits and trying to claim a famous tower.

feats.scene: Iumsorteo throws a crystal fist through a delivery truck and cracks its engine block.
Iumsorteo stands her ground as a wrecking ball swings into her and rings off her shoulder.

name: Naurnon
summary: Naurnon is a bookshop assistant with an instinct for hidden magic and brief flashes of the future. She warns a customer of his death, and events prove her right a few hours later.

feats.scene: Naurnon snaps a rune-drawn circle shut and throws a snarling spirit into the street.
Naurnon stands through a barrage of toppling shelves, shielded by a glimmering ward.

name: Sauneiu
summary: Sauneiu is a blonde racer in a four-woman team whose entry in a stunt event never leaves the pits. The posing is half the fun, and the charity haul goes where it was meant to.

feats.scene: Sauneiu cranks a throttle and spins a rear tyre until it smokes.
Sauneiu tumbles over her bike's handlebars into a hay bale and waves to the crowd.

name: Seslle
summary: Seslle is a black-haired warrior-healer raised in a coastal stronghold by a mortal father and a grandmother who walked with fae powers. She picked up spellwork like a second language and carried it into a string of monster hunts.

feats.scene: Seslle chants a spell that sends a demon's tower tumbling into the sea.
Seslle holds a ward steady while a rock slide thunders down around her.

name: Arvane
summary: Arvane was taken from his parents as an infant and made into a living lamp, a soldier shaped from converted sunlight. His body gleams yellow now, and he fights with a restless, rueful humour.

feats.scene: Arvane gathers a column of daylight and fires it through a warship's armoured prow.
Arvane scatters into glowing motes when a missile detonates and reforms behind it.

name: Aulaunsau
summary: Aulaunsau is a dark-haired girl from a sterile future whose people cannot survive ordinary germs. She lifts objects with her mind and listens in on thoughts, but she can never touch the past she visits.

feats.scene: Aulaunsau lifts a bench with her mind and sets it on a rooftop.
Aulaunsau shivers through a street full of dust and pollen, weak but unhurt.

name: Sesval
summary: Sesval is an orange-skinned white-haired minstrel of a windy land who travels with three companions to beg a sea king for aid. A tyrant queen crushes the delegation, and the song is left unfinished.

feats.scene: Sesval strikes a chord so sharply that a tavern's window glass bursts.
Sesval is pinned in a net of vines and calmly hums until it loosens.

name: Auntar
summary: Auntar is a blue-scaled young girl whose body shifts skin and colour at will, a trait switched on before she was even born. Kidnappers hunt her for it, and a ragged team of rescuers races to find her.

feats.scene: Auntar stiffens her scaly arm and knocks a toy chest across the nursery.
Auntar changes her skin to stone grey and takes a fall off a play frame without a mark.

name: Sorani
summary: Sorani is a scholarship student who built her own triangular steel shield and appointed herself guardian of the campus. When a rich classmate hurt her best friend, she answered with fists and a lot of stubbornness.

feats.scene: Sorani hurls her steel shield across a quad and drops a bully's thrown football mid-air.
Sorani takes a chair swung by a linebacker and shakes it off.

name: Tannicor
summary: Tannicor is a towering mechanical giant with four arms, laser eyes and a storm engine built into its chest. It flattens installations with spinning tornadoes until a pulse of electromagnetic force switches it off.

feats.scene: Tannicor spins up a roaring funnel that rips the roof off a hangar and flings a tanker truck across the tarmac.
Tannicor shrugs off a sustained volley of armoured-suit blasts without so much as a scorch.

name: Nesliuia
summary: Nesliuia is a red-skinned, horned and hoofed raider who charges first and talks later. He rams forward with his skull down, and the plan rarely extends beyond the next wall.

feats.scene: Nesliuia lowers his horns and rams a sewer grate off its mounting and through a wall.
Nesliuia is clipped by a flying dumpster and keeps charging.
Nesliuia sprints down a tunnel after a fleeing teleporter.

name: Teovalen
summary: Teovalen is a brown-haired exile who commands his own hair like an extra pair of arms. He signs on with an island ruler's cause and discovers too late that collars and cattle cars wait on the far side.

feats.scene: Teovalen whips a bundle of braided strands that lashes a rifle from a guard's hands.
Teovalen is flung against a train wall and rises with only a split lip.

name: Stuleo
summary: Stuleo is a purple-haired ember spirit jailed for pleading for mercy and then raised to rule a frozen kingdom. The look is surprisingly lovely for a creature of cinders, hinting at a more mixed bloodline.

feats.scene: Stuleo opens a vent of molten rock under a siege camp and swallows its catapults.
Stuleo steps through a collapsing ice palace and shakes the frost from her hair.

name: Lusmi
summary: Lusmi is a many-formed lord of chaos, now a black-skinned humanoid, now a seething mass of eyes and quills, now a lizard of thought. The very idea of this entity is a patchwork of overlapping tales, and no single account can pin it down.

feats.scene: Lusmi unfolds into a mass of tentacles and tears a continent-wide crack through the bedrock of a dream.
Lusmi absorbs the combined spells of a council of mages and dissolves them into black mist.

name: Ntaunt
summary: Ntaunt is a colossal armoured judge, patient across ages, who lit the first star and made two lines of servants to guard what slept beneath the world. A single ruling decides if a whole planet gets to live.

feats.scene: Ntaunt ignites a newborn sun with a flick of one gauntlet and sets its orbit.
Ntaunt stands untouched as a swarm of warships erupts against its chest plate.

name: Numcorlum
summary: Numcorlum is a towering armoured arbiter who gives a guardian a chance to repent and then returns for a verdict. A clever trap of runes pins the giant in place while its power is siphoned dry.

feats.scene: Numcorlum lowers a single hand and wipes a drifting moon from the sky.
Numcorlum holds a stance as a ring of runes drags at its core, resisting for a long moment.

name: Vallonin
summary: Vallonin is a vast armoured sentinel from the first age of existence, leader of a host that stands over worlds for generations. A gesture of the hand, up or down, seals the fate of a planet.

feats.scene: Vallonin raises one palm and a whole cluster of galaxies folds into a single point of light.
Vallonin walks through the collapse of a universe that dissolves behind it.

name: Tecoame
summary: Tecoame is a green-haired, black-eyed refugee from a dying sun who was lifted to safety by a silver traveller. A grateful, soft-spoken survivor, she helps her people rebuild far from home.

feats.scene: Tecoame heaves a toppled building beam off a trapped neighbour.
Tecoame shelters in a collapsing tent through a gale of ash.

name: Catia
summary: Catia is a nobleman of an old family who fought at a desert siege, later joined a doomed uprising, and asked a former comrade for a clean death. The swordsman made the stroke quick and said nothing for a long while.

feats.scene: Catia cleaves through a wooden barricade with a heavy sabre.
Catia takes a rock to the shoulder during the rout and fights on.

name: Anrival
summary: Anrival is a fiery bounty hunter and outlaw with no past, hounded by lawmen and gangs alike. Dime novels exaggerate her adventures, though the real ones are wilder.

feats.scene: Anrival fans a revolver and shreds a row of tin cans along a ranch fence.
Anrival tumbles from a runaway wagon into the dust and brushes herself off.

name: Roleoin
summary: Roleoin is a toy-brick gunslinger who rides in with twin pistols and helps rescue a pair of space-faring friends. Her blocky arms pop off and snap back on without complaint.

feats.scene: Roleoin fires both pistols and pops a captain's brick-built hat off his head.
Roleoin is blown into a pile of loose bricks and reassembles herself in a flash.

name: Amren
summary: Amren is a blue-skinned insurgent who pledged himself to a band of zealots plotting a coup. Soldiers like him follow orders into the dark and rarely return.

feats.scene: Amren fires a heavy blaster that blows a hole through a cargo hatch.
Amren is slammed against a bulkhead and gets back on his feet.

name: Luneam
summary: Luneam is a scarred, grey-eyed sleeper agent frozen for decades and woken to finish a task nobody remembers ordering. Cold professionalism marks every move, and a single misstep ends it.

feats.scene: Luneam drives a combat knife through a steel door panel in a single thrust.
Luneam shakes off a grenade blast behind a concrete pillar and keeps moving.

name: Annan
summary: Annan is a young soldier trained by a savage instructor alongside three other recruits. Drill and discipline carry him farther than talent ever would.

feats.scene: Annan empties a rifle magazine into a target silhouette in a heartbeat.
Annan crawls through a mud course under live fire and emerges with scrapes.

name: Siaresor
summary: Siaresor is a pale cyborg tyrant stitched together from cold-war schemes and kept alive in stasis, with tentacles that barely scratch. A lethal aura saps any creature nearby, so even his creators feared him.

feats.scene: Siaresor lashes two metal coils across a stadium wall and brings a stand down.
Siaresor withstands a rain of mutant strikes and keeps draining the air around him.

name: Rauina
summary: Rauina is a blond, grey-eyed warlord in a parallel republic, merciless about threats to the state. His blunt boasts about how he handles enemies end abruptly under a swift blade.

feats.scene: Rauina hurls a statue's severed arm through a palace window and across the courtyard.
Rauina tanks a pistol volley during a coup and laughs through the smoke.

name: Sesvosst
summary: Sesvosst is a chalk-pale agent with glowing eyes, tubing along his cheeks and coils of unstable metal in his arms that conduct a toxic haze. He once chased a rival squad through a secret complex and nearly caught them.

feats.scene: Sesvosst whips a metal coil through a concrete column and brings the ceiling down on a pursuer.
Sesvosst takes a close-range shotgun blast and rises with flesh knitting shut.

name: Numll
summary: Numll is a pale, red-eyed outlaw in a world of divided heroes, with coils of fragile alloy under his skin. The device feeds on stray force, and he uses it to tear through whatever corner of a city he picks.

feats.scene: Numll rakes a metal coil across a parked tram and slices it open.
Numll shakes off a crowd-control cannon and lunges forward.

name: Tumstori
summary: Tumstori is a sickly young offender whose gift is stealing the life force of others, a need that grew worse after cruel experiments. Metal tentacles help him feed, and the hunt for a cure drives every violent step.

feats.scene: Tumstori snaps a metal tentacle around a lamppost and rips it free of the pavement.
Tumstori bounces back from a thrown manhole cover and drains the nearest bystander's warmth to recover.

name: Calaluca
summary: Calaluca is a pale, coil-armed ex-soldier who drains the warmth and strength of anyone his braided metal cords touch. He lives in exile on a frozen plain, fighting only when hunted.

feats.scene: Calaluca lashes a cord through a frozen tree trunk and splits it in a single pull.
Calaluca shrugs off a rolling truck pinning him against a wall.

name: Rosciltel
summary: Rosciltel is a mercenary stitched with tubing and wire, whose arm-coils leak a sweet haze that dulls the will of nearby foes. He sells his services to the highest bidder in cold border towns.

feats.scene: Rosciltel whips both coils together and cracks a concrete pillar clean through.
Rosciltel walks on after being struck by a speeding van.
Rosciltel sprints across a courtyard to reach a fleeing buyer.

name: Tasmarul
summary: Tasmarul is a scarred wanderer who slipped between worlds during a great collapse and now carries stolen metal cords as trophies. He hunts quietly and never stays long.

feats.scene: Tasmarul hurls a metal cord and pins a runaway cart to a barn wall.
Tasmarul survives a tumble down a cliff of broken stone.

name: Telnarne
summary: Telnarne is a long-limbed soldier whose ribbed implants grant tireless endurance and a grip that crushes iron rails. He answers only to a faded oath sworn in a forgotten war.

feats.scene: Telnarne bends a steel gate shut around a pursuing patrol.
Telnarne endures a collapsing watchtower beam across his shoulders.

name: Tiaro
summary: Tiaro is a wiry courier who carries a pair of unstable alloy coils that hum when danger nears. She uses them mostly to snatch parcels from rooftops.

feats.scene: Tiaro snaps a coil across a lamp post and drops it across an alley.
Tiaro lands a three-storey fall onto stacked canvas.
Tiaro dashes along a tiled roof ridge with a parcel in hand.

name: Lentar
summary: Lentar is a grudge-driven brute whose failing implants make him suffer, so he tracks the one who broke his machine across an ocean. Every day his craving grows sharper and his temper shorter.

feats.scene: Lentar tears a dock crane arm free of its mooring in a rage.
Lentar takes a cargo container dropped on him and climbs out coughing.

name: Iumalnes
summary: Iumalnes is a quiet record-keeper in a mountain archive who guards forbidden ledgers with a borrowed sabre. Nobody has ever asked him to fight, and he hopes nobody will.

feats.scene: Iumalnes cuts a rope bridge in one clean sabre stroke.
Iumalnes shakes off a dropped shelf of heavy books.

name: Vernta
summary: Vernta is a pit-fighter with chalk-white skin and a habit of stalling his rivals with a slow, rasping laugh. He wins more by patience than by force.

feats.scene: Vernta drives a single fist through a pine plank wall.
Vernta stands up from a barrel thrown at his ribs.

name: Vaiava
summary: Vaiava is a former test pilot who once wore a hulking, hungry engine-suit and now builds scrap rigs for travelling circuses. Her old harness still sits in a locked crate.

feats.scene: Vaiava overloads the old suit core and blows the roof off a hangar.
Vaiava rides out a crash in the armoured cockpit with only bruises.
Vaiava thunders down a runway in the engine-suit before liftoff.

name: Amatel
summary: Amatel is a barrow-king who commands a restless host of bone-warriors from a hilltop throne. His rule ends where the dawn begins.

feats.scene: Amatel stamps his staff and shatters the cobbles of an entire courtyard.
Amatel absorbs a thrown boulder without so much as stumbling.

name: Sitati
summary: Sitati is a storm-blooded war-chief who wields a hammer cut from a fallen thunderhead. Highland villages sing of the night he held a pass alone.

feats.scene: Sitati swings the hammer and a bolt levels a whole row of stone houses.
Sitati stands through a rockslide that buries a ford.
Sitati vaults down a gorge faster than any horse.

name: Rnnttes
summary: Rnnttes is a drifting ghost-lamp that haunts a harbour town, guiding sailors away from the rocks. Nobody can say who lit it first.

feats.scene: Rnnttes flares white and blinds a smuggler's boat crew.
Rnnttes flickers through a gale without going out.

name: Rnivaron
summary: Rnivaron is a warlord from a dying ring-world who plots to feed his realm's crumbling engines with a terrible flash. He fights on foot with a fierce blade and a larger sense of destiny.

feats.scene: Rnivaron cleaves a siege tower in two with one overhead swing.
Rnivaron is hit by a battering charge that would flatten a hut and keeps walking.
Rnivaron races across a dune on a stampeding mount.

name: Nauveoeo
summary: Nauveoeo is a gilded champion of a lost empire, ruling from a glass tower and treating strangers as pieces on a board. His armour hums with stolen sunlight.

feats.scene: Nauveoeo fires a sun-bright lance that burns a hole through a stone gatehouse.
Nauveoeo weathers a collapsing bridge and strides out of the dust.

name: Misossau
summary: Misossau is a bearded giant exiled from a drowned kingdom, famed for hurling whole tree trunks like spears. He grumbles about the weather more than the enemy.

feats.scene: Misossau flings an oak trunk through a barn wall.
Misossau shrugs off a charging war-elephant.

name: Lertevi
summary: Lertevi is a rubbery stage-creature of uncertain origin who pops up in comedic rivalries at the edge of a studio world. Even its makers cannot agree whether it is real.

feats.scene: Lertevi bounces off a prop and thumps a rival with a foam mallet.
Lertevi is flattened by a falling set piece and pops back up.

name: Ranrniau
summary: Ranrniau is a sea-folk guardsman built for crushing depths, with sharp eyes and strong gills. Out of water he has only minutes before his chest tightens, so he fights quickly.

feats.scene: Ranrniau drives a trident into a steel hull plate and pierces it.
Ranrniau endures a deep-trench pressure that would crush a sub.
Ranrniau cuts through open water at a hunter's pace.

name: Moror
summary: Moror is a gentle apothecary who sells lamp-oil and remedies from a cart on market days. Her only real talent is knowing everybody's name.

feats.scene: Moror swats a thief's hand with a wooden ladle.
Moror holds on to her cart as it bumps down a ditch.

name: Valneo
summary: Valneo is a northern ranger who tracks poachers through snowfields with a patient eye and a short bow. He keeps the peace by being hard to find.

feats.scene: Valneo sends an arrow through a hanging lantern at sixty paces.
Valneo survives a night in a blizzard without a fire.
Valneo sprints over crusted snow to cut off a sled.

name: Leotoseo
summary: Leotoseo is a physicist whose body dissolved into raw radiance after a failed reactor test, so he must live inside a sealed suit. He glows through the seams whenever he is upset.

feats.scene: Leotoseo opens the suit seam and burns a hole through a vault door.
Leotoseo withstands a collapsing lab ceiling and keeps glowing.

name: Estaleol
summary: Estaleol is a one-eyed conqueror's sergeant who follows his lord across cold stars, always a step behind the real danger. He dies far from the soil he guarded.

feats.scene: Estaleol smashes a hatch with an armoured fist and crumples the frame.
Estaleol endures a hull breach blast to his shielded side.

name: Rivaam
summary: Rivaam is a hulking ruler of a harsh home world, proud of a bold son and quick to approve a risky plan. His voice alone ends arguments.

feats.scene: Rivaam backhands a pillar and brings down a corner of his own hall.
Rivaam is struck by a thrown anvil and only scowls.

name: Tiamiser
summary: Tiamiser is an inflatable-looking stage puppet who falls into a world that never quite explains its rules. The audience suspects an actor is hiding inside.

feats.scene: Tiamiser bops a stagehand with a padded fist.
Tiamiser takes a tumble down a rigging ladder and bounces.

name: Larcorsan
summary: Larcorsan is a skilled airship pilot with a small pistol and a talent for tight turns through storm clouds. He flies cargo for anybody who pays fairly.

feats.scene: Larcorsan fires two pistol shots through a rudder cable.
Larcorsan walks away from a hard landing in a field of hay.
Larcorsan banks his craft ahead of a gale front.

name: Cenuame
summary: Cenuame is a nimble burglar who spent his youth tumbling across fairground ropes before turning those skills to theft. He is lighter on his feet than any watchman.

feats.scene: Cenuame kicks off a wall and clips a guard's chin.
Cenuame lands a two-storey drop in a perfect roll.
Cenuame bolts across a rooftop with the loot.

name: Seoarcar
summary: Seoarcar is a quiet field-biologist who studies alien creatures from behind thick glass and carries nothing sharper than a pen. She has never lost her notes.

feats.scene: Seoarcar swings a clipboard and knocks a specimen jar off a ledge.
Seoarcar is thrown across a lab and gets up with bruises.

name: Ullam
summary: Ullam is a hard-hunted fugitive turned grim collector of old debts, whose plans spread tears across a divided country. A hunter in a borrowed iron suit is on his trail.

feats.scene: Ullam fires a rifle at a barricade and splinters its post.
Ullam survives a blast that throws him over a table.

name: Nuretiu
summary: Nuretiu is a dockside bookkeeper who tallies crates and quietly pockets a few coins each week. Nobody has ever raised their voice at him.

feats.scene: Nuretiu slams a ledger on the counter and startles a customer.
Nuretiu trips on a gangplank and catches himself on a rope.

name: Arnivel
summary: Arnivel is a retired wrestler who runs a corner gym and teaches children to fall properly. His old trophies gather dust on a shelf behind the desk.

feats.scene: Arnivel throws a heavy bag off its chain with a single shove.
Arnivel absorbs a full-force tackle from a former rival.

name: Tolviin
summary: Tolviin is a fallen watcher from an ancient tale who taught forbidden crafts to mortals and paid for it with his wings. Only scraps of his legend remain in old songs.

feats.scene: Tolviin calls down a column of white fire onto a ridge and scours it bare.
Tolviin endures a toppled temple spire across his back.
Tolviin dives from a cloud bank like a falling star.

name: Listeco
summary: Listeco is a roaming scrap-sage who stitches together broken machines to answer riddles for travellers. Her wagon rattles louder than her voice.

feats.scene: Listeco wrenches a rusted bolt loose with a pipe.
Listeco braces under a tipped wagon bed and holds it.

name: Iumsesci
summary: Iumsesci is a spring-limbed thinking machine that leaps across roofs in pursuit of runaways, landing with a heavy thud. Its calm voice never changes, even mid-jump.

feats.scene: Iumsesci drops from a lamp post onto a crate and caves it in.
Iumsesci takes a collision with a delivery truck and rights itself.
Iumsesci bounds between rooftops.

name: Lliritar
summary: Lliritar is a round-fisted armoured figure who bounds high into the air and lands on bystanders without any apparent anger. Nobody knows whether a person or a machine lives inside.

feats.scene: Lliritar crashes onto a market stall and smashes it flat.
Lliritar takes a swung plank on the helmet and does not flinch.
Lliritar springs across a square in three leaps.

name: Amiuont
summary: Amiuont is a master smith who forges fearsome plate from the flesh of vanquished sorcerers and can call up infernal helpers with a ritual. He fights with long, savage blades.

feats.scene: Amiuont cuts through a forge anvil with a freshly quenched blade.
Amiuont turns a mace blow aside with his own cruel plate.

name: Onamases
summary: Onamases is a robed zealot who founded a void-cult at a remote station and preaches that all stars must go dark. His followers adore him and few survive his sermons.

feats.scene: Onamases lifts both hands and pulls a docking arm off its mount.
Onamases takes a plasma bolt on the chest and keeps preaching.

name: Rneontser
summary: Rneontser is a wandering potter whose vases sing softly in the wind. People travel for days to buy one.

feats.scene: Rneontser throws a clay pot across a yard.
Rneontser sits through a day-long rainstorm unharmed.

name: Colserteo
summary: Colserteo is a cheerful neighbourhood boy who runs errands for the baker and dreams of sailing. He is faster than he looks.

feats.scene: Colserteo tosses a loaf over a fence.
Colserteo tumbles from a wall and gets back up laughing.
Colserteo races a cart down the lane.

name: Torni
summary: Torni is a heavy-set night watchman who patrols a lumber yard and talks to the owls. He has never once seen a thief.

feats.scene: Torni swings a lantern pole against a loose gate and dents it.
Torni stands up straight after a stack of planks topples on him.

name: Oruni
summary: Oruni is a slight clerk at a river ferry who punches tickets and keeps an eye out for storms. Sailors trust his weather sense above the almanac.

feats.scene: Oruni punches a ticket with an unusually loud clack.
Oruni grips a rail through a violent lurch of the ferry.

name: Lumtu
summary: Lumtu is a mad engineer who transferred his mind into a squat mechanical frame and builds hybrid monsters for a wartime master. His lab smells of oil and wet clay.

feats.scene: Lumtu hammers a stuck gear with a steel arm and shatters the housing.
Lumtu is thrown through a workshop wall and sits up whirring.

name: Rnonto
summary: Rnonto is a hunched inventor in a smoky basement workshop who sells blueprints to anyone sinister enough to ask. His machines never quite work the way he promises.

feats.scene: Rnonto fires a clanking contraption that cracks a barrel.
Rnonto crawls from a sputtering boiler explosion.

name: Ennissi
summary: Ennissi is a wheeled thinking-engine that rolls through a vast archive, cataloguing visitors and warning intruders with polite buzzing. It has never forgotten a face.

feats.scene: Ennissi lowers a security gate onto a trespasser's path.
Ennissi is hit by a thrown stool and keeps cataloguing.

name: Tarti
summary: Tarti is a rumbling, soft-spoken scientist reinvented as a talking screen in a bleak laboratory, keen to explain his work to anyone who lingers. His voice is warm and unsettling.

feats.scene: Tarti flicks open a pressure valve and sprays a corridor with steam.
Tarti sits through a power surge that blanks every other screen.

name: Nirnmi
summary: Nirnmi is a cunning schemer who lives inside a boxy walking frame and plots to splice together armies from salvage. He relishes a good villain's monologue.

feats.scene: Nirnmi punches a steel locker flat with a servo arm.
Nirnmi is knocked down a stairwell and clatters back up.

name: Neone
summary: Neone is a nervous lab assistant who holds the keys to a cramped vault of gadgets, mostly broken. He is more likely to hide than fight.

feats.scene: Neone shoves a cart into an intruder's shins.
Neone shrugs off a fall from a stepladder.

name: Amaelne
summary: Amaelne is a brilliant, ruthless inventor who studies a glowing relic's raw power and builds impractical weapons to harness it. His dreams outrun his workshop.

feats.scene: Amaelne triggers a relic-powered prototype and vaporises a bunker door.
Amaelne is thrown against a wall by the blast and groans.

name: Llureser
summary: Llureser is a quiet hill-farmer who keeps goats and tells slow stories by the fire. Her cheese is legendary across three valleys.

feats.scene: Llureser lifts a full milk churn into a cart.
Llureser hikes through a day-long hailstorm to find a stray kid.

name: Celvaami
summary: Celvaami is a name that surfaces only in a reader's letter, an imagined blend of a ruthless industrialist and a man living a borrowed life. Nobody has ever met him.

feats.scene: Celvaami is imagined swinging a prototype gauntlet through a brick wall.
Celvaami is imagined standing under a falling girder in his harness.

name: Alell
summary: Alell is a bored, extremely wealthy heir who takes over a family firm after its founder vanishes and then hires out as a mercenary in a battle-suit. He calls himself dangerous and means it.

feats.scene: Alell fires the suit's chest cannon and levels a warehouse.
Alell survives a missile salvo inside the armoured shell.
Alell streaks across a bay in a rocket-boosted dash.

name: Tumrn
summary: Tumrn is a brash armoured defender who unleashes a rain of drones to shield crowds, though the ash it leaves behind causes its own trouble. He prefers bold plans to careful ones.

feats.scene: Tumrn launches a drone volley that flattens an empty warehouse.
Tumrn endures a collapsing overpass while sealed in his suit.
Tumrn rockets across a harbour to reach a stranded ferry.

name: Tentan
summary: Tentan is a hard-nosed pilot whose armour provides lift and a rugged shell. Without it he is just another tired professional.

feats.scene: Tentan punches through a reinforced shutter with a gauntlet.
Tentan takes a cannon shell on the shoulder plate and rolls.
Tentan skims a canal at full thrust.

name: Irtuan
summary: Irtuan is a young apprentice cobbler who sings while he works and rarely looks up from the last. His neighbours say he is the happiest person on the street.

feats.scene: Irtuan hammers a nail through a stubborn heel.
Irtuan survives a tumble from a stool.

name: Nevelmor
summary: Nevelmor is a gentle teen forced into hiding who later grows into a towering fighter when his emotions break loose. He wants only to be left alone with the person he loves.

feats.scene: Nevelmor smashes a barn flat in a surge of grief.
Nevelmor stays upright under a landslide of timber.

name: Viasemar
summary: Viasemar is a retired stage conjuror who makes coins vanish at street corners. Nothing more, except a faint hunch for future trouble.

feats.scene: Viasemar flicks a coin hard into a hat.
Viasemar is shoved over a barrel and rolls to his feet.

name: Oriter
summary: Oriter is an exasperated schoolteacher who has memorised every excuse a student can invent. Her chalk always lands on target.

feats.scene: Oriter flings chalk across the room and taps a dozing student.
Oriter keeps teaching through a leaking roof.

name: Eonium
summary: Eonium is a stubborn trucker who hauls grain across three counties and keeps an old shotgun under his seat. He prefers the radio to company.

feats.scene: Eonium fires one slug into a stuck lock.
Eonium walks away from a spun-out cab.
Eonium drives flat out on an empty highway.

name: Cetiulum
summary: Cetiulum is a soft-spoken dockhand who loads barrels onto barges at dawn and hums sea-shanties. Nobody has heard him curse.

feats.scene: Cetiulum heaves a full barrel onto a barge.
Cetiulum slips into cold water and swims out.

name: Lucorlli
summary: Lucorlli is a rotund café owner who serves the best pastries on the avenue and gossips with every customer. She keeps a rolling pin handy.

feats.scene: Lucorlli whacks a pickpocket with a rolling pin.
Lucorlli shrugs off a scalding tray spill.

name: Sorceval
summary: Sorceval is a minor hedge-wizard who bargains with spirits for small favours and cheats on every deal. His lantern burns with a green flame.

feats.scene: Sorceval hurls a green fireball and singes a hedge.
Sorceval brushes off a thrown stool.

name: Coiar
summary: Coiar is a rumpled detective who solves small crimes in a rainy port town with a notebook and stubborn patience. He seldom carries a weapon.

feats.scene: Coiar throws a punch that barely staggers a smuggler.
Coiar takes a beating in an alley and still files his report.

name: Aurtu
summary: Aurtu is a good-natured mechanic who patches engines in a roadside garage and lends his wrench to strangers. The whole town knows his laugh.

feats.scene: Aurtu swings a wrench and shatters a cinder block.
Aurtu is knocked flat by a jack failure and shakes it off.

name: Roniva
summary: Roniva is a bookish surveyor who maps new roads for a growing county. She has strong opinions about straight lines.

feats.scene: Roniva drives a surveying stake into frozen ground.
Roniva slides down a muddy bank and stands up.

name: Meoseor
summary: Meoseor is a young recruit who spots a famous sergeant despite his sudden growth and keeps the secret from everyone. His loyalty outweighs his rank.

feats.scene: Meoseor fires a standard rifle at a training target.
Meoseor crawls out of a muddy trench after a shell lands near.

name: Rosnan
summary: Rosnan is a feathered star-soldier from a proud empire, hardy against vacuum and quick on the wing. He serves a throne that never says thank you.

feats.scene: Rosnan dives and talons through a cargo hatch.
Rosnan endures a hull blast on his armoured back.
Rosnan streaks along a canyon floor.

name: Vortenvia
summary: Vortenvia is a lone sentinel posted at the edge of a quiet canal, watching boats drift by and sharing stale bread with ducks. He has not been relieved in years.

feats.scene: Vortenvia raps a boat hook against a drifting log.
Vortenvia endures a week of drizzle without complaint.

name: Insto
summary: Insto is a distant cousin of a famed warrior line, known only to a handful of chroniclers. He carries a battered shield and an unreasonably long sword.

feats.scene: Insto cleaves a thick wooden post with the long sword.
Insto takes a club on the shield and holds his ground.

name: Cecarnau
summary: Cecarnau is a many-armed horror that nests in cliffside caves and stirs when the tide pulls back. Fishermen leave offerings for it every spring.

feats.scene: Cecarnau drags a fishing galley down with a single coil.
Cecarnau shrugs off a volley of harpoons.

name: Ceaunstu
summary: Ceaunstu is a veteran guide of a forgotten mountain people who carries grim news of an undead host. She walks days without rest to warn the next valley.

feats.scene: Ceaunstu drives a spear through a leather shield.
Ceaunstu pushes on through a thorn thicket and snow.

name: Leometi
summary: Leometi is a surly tavern bouncer who throws rowdy guests into the street with one arm. He folds towels when business is slow.

feats.scene: Leometi hurls a drunk through a swing door.
Leometi takes a bottle to the head and keeps scowling.

name: Telstll
summary: Telstll is a young plains hunter who spends long days alone in a cave seeking a vision and returns altered. His people honour him for what he learned.

feats.scene: Telstll drives a spear through a hide shield in one throw.
Telstll endures days without food in a cold cave.
Telstll sprints across the grass after a herd.

name: Iaamate
summary: Iaamate is a hulking war-automaton that wakes when its inventor gives the word and falls into line against rival machines. Its joints squeal with each step.

feats.scene: Iaamate slams a fist through a droid's chest and into the wall behind.
Iaamate shrugs off a barrage of pulse bolts.
Iaamate thunders across a plaza on jet boots.

name: Coausto
summary: Coausto is a sallow outcast who exhales clouds of poisonous green gas and is shunned in every town he visits. He wishes he could stop.

feats.scene: Coausto breathes out a cloud that kills a hedge in minutes.
Coausto drinks a flask of acid and only coughs.

name: Onannes
summary: Onannes is a carnival strongman turned petty crook who tosses flaming bottles at passers-by. He has trouble with his aim.

feats.scene: Onannes lobs a flaming bottle and chars a signpost.
Onannes drops to the cobbles and rolls away from the flames.

name: Ureell
summary: Ureell is a debonair thief in a flashy jacket who leads a loyal gang of unusual specialists. He steals mostly for the thrill.

feats.scene: Ureell fires a pistol and clips a lock off a chest.
Ureell drops from a balcony and rolls to safety.
Ureell sprints across a bridge ahead of the guards.

name: Teamaan
summary: Teamaan is a polite cat-lover who runs a stationery shop and writes letters for neighbours who cannot. He hates arguments.

feats.scene: Teamaan shoves a heavy door shut against the wind.
Teamaan slips on a wet step and recovers.

name: Iarntros
summary: Iarntros is a cartoonish illustrator who exists only as a passing mention in a joke about deadlines. Nobody has ever seen his drawing table.

feats.scene: Iarntros is mentioned tossing a crumpled sketch at a bin.
Iarntros is mentioned surviving a week without sleep.

name: Nautus
summary: Nautus is a genial ticket-seller at a theatre who knows the plot of every show before curtain. He sneaks sweets to the front row.

feats.scene: Nautus stamps a ticket with surprising force.
Nautus stands through a crowded rush at the door.

name: Leamte
summary: Leamte is a ruthless frontier warden who seizes a stolen time-engine from a band of strangers and plans a hanging. He loses his grip when his own trap turns.

feats.scene: Leamte swings a rifle butt and cracks a saloon table.
Leamte is thrown from his horse and stands up cursing.

name: Tiusemis
summary: Tiusemis is a gaunt prankster who pretends to be a man-eater to scare people away, though he lives on vegetables. His strange gun erases whatever its blast touches.

feats.scene: Tiusemis fires the odd gun and erases a stone wall section.
Tiusemis is kicked across a floor and shrugs.

name: Riteten
summary: Riteten is a cheerful chess instructor who carves her own pieces and teaches in a cold park. Her queen is the star of the set.

feats.scene: Riteten slaps a chess clock with unexpected force.
Riteten sits through a snowfall without a hat.

name: Stoleso
summary: Stoleso is a green-clad archer who shoots from tree limbs and rarely misses a moving target. Her bow is her own work, strung with sinew.

feats.scene: Stoleso puts an arrow through a hanging ring at eighty paces.
Stoleso falls from a branch and lands on her feet.
Stoleso races over mossy roots to a better perch.

name: Tacolon
summary: Tacolon is a plain, unremarkable bookbinder with no unusual talents, though he has the most beautiful stitching in the district. Customers wait weeks for him.

feats.scene: Tacolon presses a heavy cover flat with both palms.
Tacolon survives a tumble down a stair with a stack of books.

name: Llovalsta
summary: Llovalsta is a brutal slaver-chieftain from an iron age kingdom who marches captives across burning plains. His cruelty is matched only by his greed.

feats.scene: Llovalsta swings a broad axe through a wooden gate.
Llovalsta takes a spear thrust on his leather cuirass without a mark.

name: Lorva
summary: Lorva is a patient fisherman who casts nets before sunrise and sells the catch from a stall. His luck has never been better than average.

feats.scene: Lorva hauls a heavy net over the gunwale.
Lorva rows through a squall and returns home.

name: Rnicorrn
summary: Rnicorrn is a restless miller who argues with the wind about the proper way to turn sails. He often wins.

feats.scene: Rnicorrn heaves a sack of flour onto a cart.
Rnicorrn stands under a loose mill sail and pushes it aside.

name: Tariumst
summary: Tariumst is a spirited navigator aboard a star-cruiser, nicknamed by crewmates for his love of dramatic poetry. He keeps a perfect course through asteroid fields.

feats.scene: Tariumst slaps a console and silences an alarm.
Tariumst is thrown across the bridge by a hit and gets up.

name: Toriu
summary: Toriu is a middle-aged train conductor who calls stops in a deep voice and knows the timetable by heart. He has never been late.

feats.scene: Toriu slams a carriage door against the wind.
Toriu steadies himself through a sudden lurch.

name: Tuteni
summary: Tuteni is a vain landowner who hosts grand dinners and holds grudges with equal passion. His fortune is built on forgotten debts.

feats.scene: Tuteni slaps a servant's tray from his hands.
Tuteni trips on his own carpet and grabs a curtain.

name: Oncioro
summary: Oncioro is a dying bard who dreams of a daughter lost among the stars and sings a last song for her. His voice carries on the wind long after he is gone.

feats.scene: Oncioro plucks a lute string and shatters a glass cup.
Oncioro lies in the cold through the night and survives.

name: Eolvate
summary: Eolvate is a retired dancer who teaches village children to waltz and cries at weddings. She still has strong knees.

feats.scene: Eolvate spins a partner across the hall floor.
Eolvate dances through a night without rest.

name: Nesruoru
summary: Nesruoru is a dashing duellist who fights with a pair of borrowed knives and a lively sense of humour. He parries more than he strikes.

feats.scene: Nesruoru cuts a candle in half with a single knife flick.
Nesruoru takes a heavy blow on the crossed blades.
Nesruoru darts through a crowded hall.

name: Rninini
summary: Rninini is an unnamed bystander in an absurd comic scene, assumed by readers to share a name with a counterpart. He is mostly there for the gag.

feats.scene: Rninini waves his arms and knocks over a lamp.
Rninini is bowled over by a runaway cart and stands.

name: Nunaor
summary: Nunaor is a lab-grown soldier made to fly, lift tanks and withstand heavy fire, and is struck down off-screen early in his debut. His makers never explained his purpose.

feats.scene: Nunaor hoists an armoured car over his head and throws it.
Nunaor takes a shell burst to the chest and keeps flying.
Nunaor climbs into a stormy sky at top speed.

name: Aulrn
summary: Aulrn is a quiet night cleaner who mops the floors of an observatory and talks to the telescope. He is rarely noticed.

feats.scene: Aulrn thumps a stuck window open.
Aulrn slips down a flight of steps and stands.

name: Senain
summary: Senain is a bred warrior from a lab programme of ageless makers, built for endurance and strength before being discarded. She holds no grudge.

feats.scene: Senain punches through a concrete bulkhead.
Senain endures a vehicle collision at full speed.

name: Neansi
summary: Neansi is a gregarious baker who wakes at three to knead dough and shares loaves with beggars. His ovens are always warm.

feats.scene: Neansi slams a lump of dough on the counter.
Neansi pulls a tray from a hot oven with bare hands.

name: Llliu
summary: Llliu is a quiet librarian who lends maps to wanderers and writes tiny poems in the margins. Few know how many roads she has walked.

feats.scene: Llliu pushes a heavy shelf an inch.
Llliu keeps reading through a hard rainfall.

name: Tusteni
summary: Tusteni is a bull-headed brute who exists mostly as a daydream, a horned bruiser that charges through stone corridors and shrugs off thrown spears.

feats.scene: Tusteni lowers its horns and rams a wooden gate off its hinges.
Tusteni stands unmoved as a loaded cart rolls into its chest.

name: Larorni
summary: Larorni is a secret beast of the island labyrinth, a horned recluse who only appears in whispered rumour and rarely fights.

feats.scene: Larorni hurls a boulder across a dim maze chamber.
Larorni endures a volley of arrows with barely a scratch.

name: Noestneo
summary: Noestneo is a mortal huntswoman from a hill kingdom, a patient tracker who died quietly offstage and left only a family tree behind.

feats.scene: Noestneo looses a hunting arrow that pins a running stag.
Noestneo takes a hard fall down a rocky slope and walks it off.

name: Laoruel
summary: Laoruel is a winged, clawed horror with a scorpion tail and a swollen chitin arm, able to shift into a darker blazing form that rivals warrior-kings from the stars.

feats.scene: Laoruel drives its chitin fist through a fortress wall and collapses the whole district around it.
Laoruel stands in the blast of a siege cannon battery without flinching.

name: Tiaorce
summary: Tiaorce is a many-eyed demonic servant that sees through any lie, worshipped by a festival of masked villagers and sent on errands by a dark lord.

feats.scene: Tiaorce rakes a stone tower into rubble with one claw sweep.
Tiaorce is hit by a falling tower and keeps hovering.
Tiaorce streaks across a canyon faster than a rifle round.

name: Teoaunte
summary: Teoaunte is a red-haired palace guardswoman who stood her ground against a world-eater and lost, a soldier more brave than strong.

feats.scene: Teoaunte fires a crackling lance bolt that knocks a hover-tank off its path.
Teoaunte survives a collapsing hangar roof before the devourer arrives.

name: Amiuul
summary: Amiuul is a grey-haired warrior of a zealous order who tracked a smuggler by scent across the void and died in a double blast.

feats.scene: Amiuul smashes a cargo hold bulkhead flat with one swing.
Amiuul takes a point-blank detonation on a station deck and is only killed by the second.

name: Soaun
summary: Soaun is a brown-haired star-guard who fought beside a band of adventurers until a psychic tyrant cut her down in a single moment.

feats.scene: Soaun crushes a shuttle hull in one hand.
Soaun shrugs off a falling girder from a collapsing hall.

name: Larnill
summary: Larnill is a red-haired sentinel with blank eyes who lent a hand to a sorcerer against a planet devourer and was swallowed by hunger.

feats.scene: Larnill hammers a drone swarm into scrap with a single sweep.
Larnill holds a crumbling arch up on her shoulders.

name: Sallco
summary: Sallco is a white-eyed guard in a fleet that broke a quarantine wall around a small world, chasing a rumoured power source.

feats.scene: Sallco tears a shield pylon from its mount and hurls it.
Sallco takes a barrage from orbital cannons and keeps advancing.

name: Iumseo
summary: Iumseo is a blonde, blue-eyed girl chosen as a sacrifice on a ringed world, rescued once and killed by a zealot anyway.

feats.scene: Iumseo swings a torch and drives a priest back a step.
Iumseo is dragged through a stone arch and rises dazed but whole.

name: Lelinum
summary: Lelinum is a shapeshifter in service of a world-conquering mutant lord, wearing a borrowed face to snatch a master of magnetism.

feats.scene: Lelinum clubs a guard through a steel door.
Lelinum takes a stray energy bolt in the ribs and still holds the disguise.

name: Iseam
summary: Iseam is a silver-haired snow queen of a polar immortal people, a sorceress who froze her lover in youth and resisted a wizard's torture for years.

feats.scene: Iseam calls a blizzard that buries a whole fortress district in ice.
Iseam endures weeks of spell-lashes and does not break.

name: Tuseo
summary: Tuseo is an ageless wanderer of a long-lived race, a former follower of a conqueror who refused to follow him home and built a quiet colony on a frozen planet.

feats.scene: Tuseo cracks a mountain pass with a pulse of cosmic energy.
Tuseo is buried under a landslide and climbs out unharmed.

name: Larialis
summary: Larialis is a blue-skinned star traveller who lends a singing gem to lost explorers and flies a lonely route between worlds.

feats.scene: Larialis bends a ray from her sceptre and melts a hole through a hull.
Larialis survives a hard crash landing on a barren moon.

name: Coeolmor
summary: Coeolmor is a tiny toy hero who can shrink even smaller and brawls in a cartoon fun-house until a door ends everything.

feats.scene: Coeolmor slaps a toy rival across a shelf.
Coeolmor bounces off a thrown shoe without breaking.

name: Tartesst
summary: Tartesst is a blazing conqueror who raised an island from the sea and wanted to commune with his ancestors through a captured medium.

feats.scene: Tartesst raises a burning island from the seabed in an afternoon.
Tartesst stands in a cavern collapse and walks out.

name: Anine
summary: Anine is a feathered fire spirit with a green torch above his head, a purifier among his siblings who speaks for them at the high council.

feats.scene: Anine ignites a field of purifying flame that scorches a whole valley.
Anine bathes in a furnace of his own making.

name: Iumneorum
summary: Iumneorum is a green, one-eyed raider considered the loveliest of her kind, used as bait in a failed scheme and lost when patrols crushed her crew.

feats.scene: Iumneorum swats a guard to the floor with a spotted hand.
Iumneorum takes a stun volley and stays conscious.

name: Iumtest
summary: Iumtest is a blue-haired mercenary who took hire with a sinister company and died on the job in the sixth issue of her story.

feats.scene: Iumtest empties a rifle clip into a sealed crate.
Iumtest takes a hard hit from a vehicle bumper and keeps fighting.

name: Tesrniam
summary: Tesrniam is a wise war-goddess at a victory banquet, a spear-bearing guest seated among the gods and toasting a spider-masked ruler.

feats.scene: Tesrniam hurls a spear that pierces a hillside.
Tesrniam takes a thunder blast on her shield and does not move.

name: Seovo
summary: Seovo is a cruel desert sorcerer who owned a black glass mirror, and feared by thieves who knew better than to rob his house.

feats.scene: Seovo calls down a cracking bolt that splits a market pillar.
Seovo shrugs off a dagger thrown at his back.

name: Iummalu
summary: Iummalu is a dark-haired sorceress of a black order who bids high at slave sales and summons monsters to punish those who offend her.

feats.scene: Iummalu conjures a snarling beast that wrecks a street stall row.
Iummalu laughs off a thrown cup of wine.

name: Ontellcil
summary: Ontellcil is a bald dolphin mystic who clutched a shard of blood-red gem, seeking never-ending life, and instead had his soul eaten in a ritual that went wrong.

feats.scene: Ontellcil sings a stinging note that cracks a stone altar.
Ontellcil breathes through a ritual fog that kills the others.

name: Situma
summary: Situma is a stagehand-turned-extra on a chaotic film set, hired to play a soldier in a movie that mixes two wars into one.

feats.scene: Situma swings a prop rifle against a cardboard wall.
Situma gets knocked flat by a runaway camera dolly and gets up.

name: Numlar
summary: Numlar is a mountain-hearted sparring partner on a hilltop of gods, fooled by a false attack and flattened by a flying hammer.

feats.scene: Numlar wrestles a boulder the size of a house across a courtyard.
Numlar takes a thrown hammer on the jaw and drops.

name: Tesce
summary: Tesce is a towering titan, a war chief long ago and now an exiled mountain-god who holds the sky on his back and has fathered whole constellations.

feats.scene: Tesce shrugs and sends a mountain range sliding into the sea.
Tesce bears the weight of the heavens on his shoulders for ages.

name: Rnusersan
summary: Rnusersan is a giant who helped a hero in a labour, a fatherly figure in a world of cartoon gods and the carrier of a very heavy ball.

feats.scene: Rnusersan lifts a loaded cart over his head and tosses it.
Rnusersan holds up a cliff that is starting to fall.

name: Iaalu
summary: Iaalu is a small girl made into a cosmic custodian who keeps a family of realities from sliding into the abyss, though her trust in heroes can be mistaken.

feats.scene: Iaalu rewrites a decaying cluster of timelines with a thought.
Iaalu holds a dying set of worlds together by existing.

name: Ontluium
summary: Ontluium is a very small cosmic watcher who senses a conqueror's coming and warns of it from a far-off perch.

feats.scene: Ontluium folds a stray fragment of space shut with a gesture.
Ontluium floats unharmed through a collapsing star.

name: Amsto
summary: Amsto is a brown-haired wrestler of an immortal race who matched a flying champion in a games tournament that a monstrous attack cut short.

feats.scene: Amsto slams a rival onto an arena floor and cracks the stone.
Amsto takes a monster's tail swing and stays standing.

name: Siavi
summary: Siavi is a bald alchemist of a drowned kingdom who forged a cursed crown, killed his own daughter for the spell, and died as the land sank.

feats.scene: Siavi finishes a rite that makes an ancient crown flare and shatter a laboratory.
Siavi stumbles from a spell backlash and stands up shaking.

name: Serstaleo
summary: Serstaleo is a decent old king of a coastal city whose brother sold him out, a man who taught his daughter to sail and was later chained in a deep dungeon.

feats.scene: Serstaleo swings a heavy sword against a palace intruder.
Serstaleo endures years of chains and hunger without breaking.

name: Ronrnro
summary: Ronrnro is a deformed, mute, bald prince fated for sacrifice to a city's divinity, freed at the last moment by a wandering barbarian.

feats.scene: Ronrnro shoves a robed priest and bolts for the door.
Ronrnro is dragged over stone steps and survives.

name: Tosan
summary: Tosan is an ancient turncoat from a sworn order, twenty thousand years old, who blasts with his eyes, ignores disease and merges with objects to make them burst.

feats.scene: Tosan melds into a pillar and makes the whole temple wing explode.
Tosan walks through a collapsing ceiling with hardly a mark.

name: Iumontar
summary: Iumontar is a dark-haired goddess of fate turned terrorist, who controlled a city by a phone app and moves things with her mind.

feats.scene: Iumontar flings a parked truck across a plaza with a flick of her mind.
Iumontar is thrown through a glass wall and rises smiling.

name: Liuoro
summary: Liuoro is a flesh-hungry former fleet captain, now part of a rotting horde that tries to cut a band of survivors off from their refuge.

feats.scene: Liuoro tears a car door off and flings it at the survivors.
Liuoro keeps lurching forward after a heavy impact.

name: Tutecel
