summary: Tutecel is a blue-skinned captain in an occupation squad who assassinated an old general during a terror raid on a mountain lab, and died in the process.

feats.scene: Tutecel fires a pistol that drops a general at forty paces.
Tutecel is hit by a charging mutant and fights on a while longer.

name: Teneval
summary: Teneval is a blue-skinned elite soldier made stronger by a mind-engine, defeated by a hussar in a last counterattack of a fallen alliance.

feats.scene: Teneval vaults a barricade and drives a rifle butt into a wall.
Teneval takes a strike that dents his armour and keeps fighting.

name: Valortia
summary: Valortia is a cartoon-sized soldier practising a paper route obstacle course when a newspaper boss starts a petty contest between two rivals.

feats.scene: Valortia tosses a rolled paper through a window frame.
Valortia tumbles off a fence and bounces up laughing.

name: Tuialte
summary: Tuialte is a blue-skinned soldier of an elite strike team, armed with twin pistols and a helmeted calm on his home world.

feats.scene: Tuialte empties both pistols at a skiff and drops it in the dust.
Tuialte rolls out of a crater blast with his helmet scorched.

name: Liutir
summary: Liutir is a black-haired warlord of the steppes, now a respected torturer in a demon-run underworld who once rode against an empire and lost to a time traveller.

feats.scene: Liutir cleaves a shield and the man behind it in one sword stroke.
Liutir takes a cavalry crash in the line and stays mounted.

name: Larllama
summary: Larllama is an old fertility god, husband or consort of a night-queen, remembered only as a name in the dusty catalogue of forgotten powers.

feats.scene: Larllama makes a barren field burst into green with a single touch.
Larllama bears a harsh drought with a shrug.

name: Tiuan
summary: Tiuan is a sea-bred soldier in a raid on a darkened city, one of many attackers who struck when a mad scientist cut the lights.

feats.scene: Tiuan heaves a spear through a bus window.
Tiuan takes a baton blow and presses on.

name: Iarcilrni
summary: Iarcilrni is a blue-skinned, gilled barbarian who turned into a flesh-hungry corpse and went for a strong orange brute alongside his old king.

feats.scene: Iarcilrni bites through a steel railing and lunges forward.
Iarcilrni walks on after a heavy hit from a rocky fist.

name: Iaviont
summary: Iaviont is a blue-skinned sea warrior who breathes underwater and is promised in marriage to a princess from a far-off timeline.

feats.scene: Iaviont rams a trident through a hull plate.
Iaviont takes a deep-sea pressure surge and keeps swimming.

name: Orume
summary: Orume is a brown-eyed sea warrior with pointed ears, hired by a tyrant to raid a hidden base and brought down by rebel soldiers.

feats.scene: Orume cracks a security door with a heavy swing.
Orume is thrown through a wall and gets up.

name: Leoure
summary: Leoure is a purple-skinned tyrant of a drowned city with a daughter and a short temper, a king whose rule ends within a handful of episodes.

feats.scene: Leoure breaks a throne room pillar with a back-handed blow.
Leoure shrugs off a repulsor blast in the palace hall.

name: Renonttu
summary: Renonttu is a scheming chieftain who feigned friendship with a rival king, rewired robots to stir a war, and was shot dead by a queen with a beam rifle.

feats.scene: Renonttu wrenches a robot arm off its shoulder in a fit of rage.
Renonttu stays upright through a crashing tidal wave.

name: Orlean
summary: Orlean is a barbarian chieftain who thought his horde was hidden deep in a trench, only to be swallowed whole by a ravenous undead king rising from below.

feats.scene: Orlean pushes a loaded sled up a slope of seabed rock.
Orlean takes a boulder to the shoulder and keeps marching.

name: Temete
summary: Temete is a yellow-eyed conqueror who steals a sacred trident, seizes a throne while its king is away and is banished, only to return with a robot.

feats.scene: Temete flattens a guard barricade with one swipe.
Temete is hit with a heavy robot arm and stays standing.

name: Osenisor
summary: Osenisor is a blue-skinned would-be conqueror who toppled a young prince with a traitor's help and took a sea kingdom until four heroes pushed him out.

feats.scene: Osenisor hurls a prince across a palace chamber.
Osenisor takes a hammering from a stone-skinned brawler and snarls.

name: Caliu
summary: Caliu is a bald cosmic watcher who stands by a trial of a colleague and freezes an unwelcome mortal in stasis rather than risk letting him follow.

feats.scene: Caliu locks a trespasser in suspended time with a glance.
Caliu stands untouched in the heart of a dying star.

name: Vesteval
summary: Vesteval is a deity born of an earth mother and a creator-father, who hunted the elder gods that had fallen into demon form after devouring their own kin.

feats.scene: Vesteval cuts a demon-god in half and shatters the plateau beneath it.
Vesteval walks out of a cosmic war with his body intact.

name: Cescilrn
summary: Cescilrn is a yellow-skinned villager with red eyes whose brother was killed by wandering mercenaries, and who froze with a stolen dagger over a sleeping stranger.

feats.scene: Cescilrn jabs a stolen dagger into a hut beam.
Cescilrn is knocked back by a stray blow and stands up shaking.

name: Numami
summary: Numami is a black-haired gentleman who tried to rescue a girl from a night-hunter, swore a deathbed oath, and then found his sister engaged to the man he buried.

feats.scene: Numami swings a walking cane at an attacker.
Numami is dragged from a carriage and walks away bruised.

name: Sercosst
summary: Sercosst is a blond film director who licked a sealed envelope soaked with poison by a greedy nephew and died on the spot.

feats.scene: Sercosst slams a clipboard on a prop table.
Sercosst bumps into a lamp stand and shrugs.

name: Orseror
summary: Orseror is a balding grey negotiator, one of the toughest in his boss's firm, a man who wins deals with patience, not violence.

feats.scene: Orseror thumps a conference table to close a deal.
Orseror stumbles on a stair and catches himself.

name: Lloeonne
summary: Lloeonne is a red-eyed, hairless coordinator who greets newcomers to an emergency colony and does the paperwork for a hero in a hurry.

feats.scene: Lloeonne shoves a stuck door open with his shoulder.
Lloeonne is clipped by a loading drone and keeps talking.

name: Nenelu
summary: Nenelu is a film-studio chief who runs her staff through a glowing hologram and vanishes after a hostile takeover cuts her signal.

feats.scene: Nenelu slaps a holo-desk shut in frustration.
Nenelu is shaken by a power cut and recovers her poise.

name: Ineam
summary: Ineam is a rich king with a barn of a thousand cows, son of a sun titan and a mortal, who lost a tenth of his herd on a bet about a stable cleaning.

feats.scene: Ineam clubs a charging bull to the ground.
Ineam walks through a sunstroke afternoon unhurt.

name: Vetia
summary: Vetia is a boardroom chairman at an oil giant who orders damage control, plays the long game with faked executives and hires a thief to steal a power suit.

feats.scene: Vetia slams a folder on a mahogany desk and issues the order.
Vetia is shoved by a bodyguard and brushes off his coat.

name: Tialorllo
summary: Tialorllo is a mustached doctor who ran an anatomy hall and collected skeletons for a hateful regime, until a vengeful survivor forced him to take his own life.

feats.scene: Tialorllo throws a bone saw across a lab.
Tialorllo is pushed against a shelf and does not fall.

name: Tiiason
summary: Tiiason is a pink-haired guardian magician of a harbour city who gave up the old ways for love, saved a stranger and died fighting a demon at the shore.

feats.scene: Tiiason releases a wave of white fire that scorches a whole pier.
Tiiason holds a warding circle against a demon's claws before falling.

name: Nanlum
summary: Nanlum is a cheerful talk-show host hired to front a cruel televised hunt of outcasts, a smiling face on a ghoulish programme.

feats.scene: Nanlum shoves a heckler off a stage riser.
Nanlum trips over a cable and gets up smiling.

name: Entema
summary: Entema is a former marine whose eyes glow when he uses his gift, a rescuer turned hired hound who was struck down by a bitter scientist.

feats.scene: Entema fires a bright pulse that blows a door off a bunker.
Entema takes a rifle butt to the chin and shakes it off.

name: Tiseri
summary: Tiseri is a company chief who murders heroes and harvests their blood to copy their gifts, naming himself a ruler of a new age.

feats.scene: Tiseri blasts a whole skyscraper floor with a borrowed power.
Tiseri stands in a team's final assault without a scratch.

name: Riallne
summary: Riallne is a cheerful café owner who raised two nephews, won a sushi cook-off against a thief and rescued a famous cat from a kidnapper.

feats.scene: Riallne whacks a rolling pin against a counter.
Riallne slips on a wet floor and lands upright.

name: Ureva
summary: Ureva is an unseen café owner away on a long trip who leaves her cat with a friend and her shop with a team of teenagers.

feats.scene: Ureva hauls a suitcase onto a train rack.
Ureva dozes through a bumpy bus ride unharmed.

name: Leverlo
summary: Leverlo is a mobile-game guardian aunt who ran a café and raised two nephews, mentioned in passing and never seen on screen.

feats.scene: Leverlo flips a pancake high into the air.
Leverlo bumps a cupboard and laughs it off.

name: Ranisial
summary: Ranisial is a kind owner of a corner café with a pet cat and two nephews, mentioned briefly in a fantasy crossover game.

feats.scene: Ranisial lifts a sack of flour onto a shelf.
Ranisial stumbles on a step and catches the rail.

name: Cinosan
summary: Cinosan is an elderly aunt whose punches are said to hit harder than a sand-bodied thug's, a joke that lives in a single line of dialogue.

feats.scene: Cinosan swats a burglar with a rolled newspaper and he yelps.
Cinosan bumps a doorframe and straightens her glasses.

name: Eosti
summary: Eosti is a blue chimera with a tail, three-fingered hands and a red diamond on her brow, whose luck guides her kin into a final leap through a barrier.

feats.scene: Eosti bends luck so that a falling beam crushes an enemy squad.
Eosti lingers on for ages as an undead guide and does not fade.

name: Vacoas
summary: Vacoas is a red-haired outlaw recruited for a daring assault on a magical wall in a bleak future.

feats.scene: Vacoas drives a hover sled through a patrol line.
Vacoas rolls out of a wrecked sled and runs on.

name: Ineon
summary: Ineon is a grey-haired diner owner who adopted a boy from overseas and is the only one who knows his masked second life.

feats.scene: Ineon slams a skillet on a griddle.
Ineon stays on her feet through a rowdy lunch rush.

name: Neiumst
summary: Neiumst is a purple-skinned, grey-haired apron-wearing overseer who reboots her whole universe because it grew too complicated, and makes it worse.

feats.scene: Neiumst reboots an entire cosmos with a flick of her wooden spoon.
Neiumst sits through a collapsing reality as if it were a quiet afternoon.

name: Antust
summary: Antust is a brown-haired changeling in a zealot's flock, a minor soldier who mirrors a gifted untouchable man on a far world.

feats.scene: Antust shoves a wagon off a ridge.
Antust takes a thrown rock to the head and keeps charging.

name: Stasron
summary: Stasron is a yellow-skinned, long-eared duplicate of a dead guardswoman, willed into being by a reader and lacking control over her gifts.

feats.scene: Stasron loses control and her power rips a wall off a ward.
Stasron takes a hit from a runaway engine and stays up.

name: Valruvor
summary: Valruvor is a yellow-skinned guardswoman and private eye of a new city, a mother of two who survived a crystal mist and hunted for a lost king until he killed her.

feats.scene: Valruvor channels her gift and shatters a nightclub door.
Valruvor survives a collapse of her old city and carries her daughters out.

name: Rovalull
summary: Rovalull is a floppy-eared, yellow-skinned investigator who heads security for a royal family, jailed by a scheming cousin and set free by a friend.

feats.scene: Rovalull rips a cell door open with her gift.
Rovalull takes a blast from a guard turret and stays in the fight.

name: Siamo
summary: Siamo is a brown-haired teenage student who once breathed underwater, lost her gift on a dreadful day and was gunned down on a bus by zealots.

feats.scene: Siamo pulls a rush of water from a fountain and drenches a bully.
Siamo takes a hard shove into a locker and stays on her feet.

name: Vanumli
summary: Vanumli is a spoiled immortal who cares only for her own pleasures and blinds foes with flashes of light, flying wherever the party is.

feats.scene: Vanumli unleashes a flash of light that blinds a whole arena.
Vanumli stands unharmed under a falling pillar.

name: Siucesll
summary: Siucesll is a financial manager of a secret army who lost a data stick to a spy and was mauled by a fake beast as punishment.

feats.scene: Siucesll slaps a ledger on a casino desk.
Siucesll hits a table corner and winces.

name: Navalste
summary: Navalste is a jealous ship intelligence who pined for a roving captain, tried to wipe out his son and later helped him with proof before drifting away.

feats.scene: Navalste fires the ship's cannons and vaporises a patrol skiff.
Navalste's hull absorbs a pirate volley and holds.
Navalste burns across a star lane at full thrust.

name: Setumlli
summary: Setumlli is a brown-haired agent who bends light, mind-controlled by a corrupt colleague into stealing parts for a booster that would multiply her power a thousandfold.

feats.scene: Setumlli fires a blinding beam that melts a satellite dish.
Setumlli is knocked across a lab bay and rises dazed.

name: Ellcor
summary: Ellcor is a red-haired secretary at a horror publisher who helped a weakened night-lord steal blood and found him quite charming.

feats.scene: Ellcor slams a filing drawer closed.
Ellcor is shoved into a wall in a dungeon and gets up.

name: Lustianeo
summary: Lustianeo is a blond mutant foot soldier in armour with an energy rifle, ordered to snatch an infant and killed by a time-lost optic blast.

feats.scene: Lustianeo fires a rifle volley that blows a hole in a cloister wall.
Lustianeo is thrown across a hall and staggers up.

name: Tostu
summary: Tostu is a blond grade-schooler who loves sports and once borrowed a cosmic force for an afternoon, gaining great strength and speed to help beat a space tyrant.

feats.scene: Tostu punches a hole through a giant monster's carapace.
Tostu is hurled into a wall by an alien and bounces back.
Tostu dashes across a ball field faster than a speeding train.

name: Amennti
summary: Amennti is a black-haired translator at a brokerage who can pin down an accent within fifty miles, fired for overhearing the wrong clients and hunted by hired killers.

feats.scene: Amennti swings a briefcase at a gunman.
Amennti dives from a window ledge and rolls to his feet.

name: Valstu
summary: Valstu is a restless campus agitator who leads a masked band of street brawlers, preaching a dead champion's creed while hurling shoves and bottles at strangers. Valstu's nerve outruns any real power, and the crew scatters when sirens rise.

feats.scene: Valstu drives a hard fist into a library shelf and splits the board.
Valstu shrugs off a flurry of kicks from a dozen masked thugs and keeps standing.

name: Leoortus
summary: Leoortus is a skeletal terrorist in an alternate timeline who serves a conquering overlord and slaughters a hulking rival in the street. A stronger servant executes her for weakness.

feats.scene: Leoortus crushes a giant brute's ribs with a ghostly grip.
Leoortus is cut down by a single slash of steel feathers.

name: Sertelia
summary: Sertelia is a green-skinned, grey-haired scourge in a televised cartoon who rides a clockwork steed and raids cities for a pitiless master. Abandoned after one lost battle at a ring of standing stones, she flees into obscurity.

feats.scene: Sertelia rams her mechanical horse through a bank vault door.
Sertelia shrugs off a hero's energy bolt and laughs.

name: Siaial
summary: Siaial is a blue-skinned officer of an imperial star fleet, tasked with fetching a lost royal heir and later joining a coalition scouting worlds ruined by a dark god. A rifle, body armour and years of drilling are all Siaial has.

feats.scene: Siaial fires a plasma carbine and blasts open a hangar door.
Siaial survives a ship-board explosion behind a bulkhead.

name: Serrnuium
summary: Serrnuium is a quiet household servant of a decadent noble, living in a floating tower far in the future. Serrnuium fetches drinks and carries messages and has no fighting power.

feats.scene: Serrnuium drops a tray, and it clatters loudly.
Serrnuium gets shoved against a wall by an angry guard.

name: Aunseo
summary: Aunseo is a teenager who talks a retired brawler into teaching her to throw a metal disc, and ends up a shield-bearing hero after drinking a boosted serum. She is fast and tough for a person, and leads a team across the whole globe.

feats.scene: Aunseo flings a round lid that knocks a boy off his bicycle.
Aunseo takes a speeding car's bumper and rolls up unhurt.
Aunseo sprints down a busy avenue.

name: Larva
summary: Larva is a purple-skinned woman lured to a remote island as sacrifice for a dark creature. She can turn her body to stone and split into copies, and carries a long rifle.

feats.scene: Larva brings a stone fist down on a wooden pier and shatters it.
Larva stands in rock form as a mob batters her with clubs.

name: Niniuste
summary: Niniuste is a young woman who inherited her brother's mystic amulet and with it the bond of an ancient predator god of fear. She wields its hunting fury against vast threats while fighting to keep from being possessed by it.

feats.scene: Niniuste rips a steel door from a vault with claws of pale light.
Niniuste is hit by a speeding truck and slides to a stop unbruised.
Niniuste pounces across a rooftop gap in one bound.

name: Amern
summary: Amern is a fighter in a video game who takes on a sacred jade amulet after a family tragedy. She becomes the vessel of a predatory fear god and battles to master its addictive power.

feats.scene: Amern smashes a concrete pillar to powder with a glowing strike.
Amern takes a rocket blast and keeps charging.

name: Iumcesni
summary: Iumcesni is a guardian of a walled desert city, a woman made stronger and quicker by a mystic charm. She guards the dome from her neighbours until a stranger cracks the barrier with a sword.

feats.scene: Iumcesni leaps and slams a raider's armoured truck into a dune.
Iumcesni is flung back by a shield burst and skids to a stop in the sand.

name: Oliia
summary: Oliia is a hero in a bleak future who is forced to kneel when a tyrant fuses with a god-killing suit. She has no standout power in this tale beyond ordinary courage.

feats.scene: Oliia throws a punch at a guard that barely moves him.
Oliia is shoved to her knees and stays there.

name: Stsernt
summary: Stsernt is a thief from a toy-brick adventure who passes through solid walls and steals gadgets from a clever scientist's lab. Stsernt prefers to slip away than fight.

feats.scene: Stsernt shoves a guard through a closing doorway.
Stsernt lets a laser grid pass through harmlessly.

name: Lumliam
summary: Lumliam is a prisoner of a dead tyrant's cruel jail who kills her warden, steals a phasing suit and her name, and hides among the tyrant's champions. She is hardened by a decade of torment and a lost child.

feats.scene: Lumliam caves in a warden's helmet with a stolen pipe.
Lumliam is thrown against a steel bulkhead and rises coughing.

name: Tumnti
summary: Tumnti is a student at a heroes' academy, a mutated girl who can pass through walls and floors. She trains hard but fights only when pushed.

feats.scene: Tumnti shoves a sparring dummy across the gym.
Tumnti takes a thrown medicine ball while solid and winces.

name: Telisis
summary: Telisis is a feathered elite soldier bred in a factory for an empire, built to kill for royalty and wary of the life she never learned. She guards a young prince, flies and strikes with energy-wreathed claws.

feats.scene: Telisis tears through an armoured transport hull with a dive.
Telisis takes a battery of blasts and rises with her feathers smoking.
Telisis tears through the sky above a mountain pass.

name: Nauau
summary: Nauau is a tattoo artist and the eldest of three sisters who use ritual needles and a ringing bowl to ink a magical serpent onto a captive. She fights as well as she can, tries to flee when caught, and bargains.

feats.scene: Nauau jabs a ritual needle into a guard's wrist and he drops his weapon.
Nauau is cuffed after a scuffle in her shop and stands unhurt.

name: Enleo
summary: Enleo is a black-skinned demon with blonde hair and pink wings who serves a despair-feeding fiend and claims to belong to him. She is finally slain by a woman in a city flat.

feats.scene: Enleo flings a sedan across a street with one wing-buffeting sweep.
Enleo is thrown through a wall and stands up laughing.

name: Rianior
summary: Rianior is a dark-haired ruler of a drifting realm beyond ordinary space, father to two princesses and slain when his daughter's husband unleashes a blast wave. He rules a corrupt order that murdered visiting travellers.

feats.scene: Rianior commands a wave of force that flattens a city quarter of his realm.
Rianior stands through the first rumble of a rift's backlash and only dies when it peaks.

name: Llise
summary: Llise is an off-world executive who recruited a clever engineer to rebuild the past and run a vast tower's business. He is all about power and wants others kept small.

feats.scene: Llise slams a desk and the glass top cracks.
Llise brushes off a thrown paperweight to the face.

name: Resernco
summary: Resernco is a vengeful figure known only by a nickname and by the rival wing that fought his enemies. Nothing else is told of him.

feats.scene: Resernco swings a fist at a bandit in a dark alley.
Resernco takes a thrown bottle on the shoulder.

name: Nosco
summary: Nosco is a luminous, genderless being formed when a team of heroes merged through a ritual cup into one will. It destroys a rival fusion with a single punch, then chooses to split back into its parts rather than keep absolute power.

feats.scene: Nosco ends a sky-high rival with a single punch that cracks open the heavens above a cathedral.
Nosco holds its shape while a rival fusion thrashes against it with the force of a quake.

name: Teonever
summary: Teonever is an orange-skinned woman with leathery wings and a swollen skull, changed by strange gas in a hidden jungle cavern. Shunned by her tribe, she flies and takes punishment well, and gathers outcasts to guard their home.

feats.scene: Teonever dives onto a raider and bowls him over.
Teonever is pierced by an arrow and fights on.
Teonever swoops low over the treetops.

name: Tumroval
summary: Tumroval is a winged child of a mountain people, touched by a sacred mist, who is killed young by invaders. He is remembered only by one friend.

feats.scene: Tumroval flaps his small wings to hop up onto a wall.
Tumroval tumbles in the dirt while playing.

name: Iseva
summary: Iseva is a cheating rocket racer in a far-off century who sabotages a rival's ship on a run to the giant planet and back. The rival's repaired, faster engine beats him home by days.

feats.scene: Iseva loosens a fuel coupling with a wrench to wreck a rival craft.
Iseva shakes off a hard landing in his cockpit seat.
Iseva pushes his rocket to full burn on the long haul home.

name: Tesva
summary: Tesva is a sea goddess of a pantheon of spirit-gods, married to the lord of the deep and twin to a sister. She governs tides and ocean creatures from a realm above ordinary sky.

feats.scene: Tesva raises a tide that drowns a coastal plain.
Tesva sits unharmed in the heart of a storm that levels a mountain.

name: Usveure
summary: Usveure is a faceless grey construct conjured from moon dust by a tyrant using a wish-granting cube, sent with its fellows to battle a famous family. It crumbles back to dust when the cube is taken away.

feats.scene: Usveure hurls a lamp-post through a wall.
Usveure takes a wave of fire and stays standing.

name: Tutia
summary: Tutia is a fifteen-foot grey robot with a box for a head, built by a scheming genius, who later wins his freedom and becomes a partner in a law firm. He towers, weighs over a thousand pounds, and has no eyes.

feats.scene: Tutia punches through a reinforced wall and the next one behind it.
Tutia stands through a full volley of heavy fire.

name: Censor
summary: Censor is a box-headed robot in a what-if world sent against a team of four heroes, only to be beaten easily by a wall-crawling fighter. Its whereabouts afterward are not known.

feats.scene: Censor flings a parked car across a street.
Censor is thrown across a plaza and dented.

name: Ameoani
summary: Ameoani is a tall, heavy grey robot with a mouth and nothing else for a face, built by a thinker and beaten fast by a team with a sea king on it. He is strong but clumsy.

feats.scene: Ameoani swings an arm through a brick wall.
Ameoani is battered by a sea king's trident and falls.

name: Tosll
summary: Tosll is a robot designed to outmuscle a green giant, used as bait to trick a shrinking scientist into growing and revealing his secret. Tosll attacks the giant hard before being torn apart.

feats.scene: Tosll slams a green giant through a stack of steel beams.
Tosll is pounded by a giant's fists until its chassis splits.

name: Valrniora
summary: Valrniora is a robot built by a thinker to challenge a famous family, and little more is told of it. It is large and strong, as machines go.

feats.scene: Valrniora punches a dent into a steel door.
Valrniora withstands a barrage of thrown crates.

name: Onvalcal
summary: Onvalcal is a brick-sized experiment that wakes and begins eating anything inorganic, growing tall and clumsy as it feeds. It swallows a bureaucrat and a brawny giant, then shrinks when frozen.

feats.scene: Onvalcal stomps a parked train car flat.
Onvalcal absorbs a barrage of hero blows and grows larger.

name: Ciriam
summary: Ciriam is a grey box-headed robot reprogrammed by a sea warlord to commit terror raids on dry land as an excuse for war. Ciriam grabs a sea scientist and drags her up to suffocate before a burst of flame drives him off.

feats.scene: Ciriam lifts a struggling scientist and hurls her through a hull plate.
Ciriam is struck with a blast of flame and keeps hold of its prey.

name: Eoserol
summary: Eoserol is a robot villain gathered up by a time-hopping squad to find the source of a strange metal and the broker of time. Little else is told of its power.

feats.scene: Eoserol rips a streetlight from its base.
Eoserol endures a volley of dimensional bolts.

name: Maurerni
summary: Maurerni is a grey, eyeless android that brawls with two heroes in a city park while a reporter watches and fails to sell the story. Maurerni's fists are heavy and his frame is sturdy.

feats.scene: Maurerni swats a bench into a pond with one arm.
Maurerni is hit by a heavy brawler's punch and slides across the lawn.

name: Eolloalu
summary: Eolloalu is a tall, heavy grey robot duplicated by a council of conquerors in a ruined timeline, then used by a crime lord to seize a nation and later the planet. Its mouth is its only feature.

feats.scene: Eolloalu flattens a roadblock of military vehicles with one swing.
Eolloalu marches through a barrage of artillery fire.

name: Tusau
summary: Tusau is a cartoon robot who, with his creator, is swept up by a mood-altering machine in an animated adventure. His enormous frame and metal fists make him a threat.

feats.scene: Tusau swings a metal fist and caves in a hull plate.
Tusau takes a barrage of torpedoes without a scratch.

name: Rannt
summary: Rannt is a grey, box-headed robot who joins a crowd of old enemies storming a prison to kill a brain-damaged boy with reality-bending talent. The freed boy erases every villain, including Rannt.

feats.scene: Rannt smashes through the prison gate and its guards.
Rannt takes a full volley from the guards and keeps walking.

name: Telul
summary: Telul is a born brawler who sells his fists as a hired guard, from underground arenas to a prison block. He is strong enough to hurl a man through a table, and a double-crossing inmate guns him down in the end.

feats.scene: Telul slams a rival into a steel table and folds it in half.
Telul shrugs off a barrage of cell-block punches and stays on his feet.

name: Tolamsta
summary: Tolamsta is a graduate student with a limp who becomes the keeper of a gateway between two great universes, able to step between worlds and bend space around him. The childhood wound that gave him the limp still drives his anger.

feats.scene: Tolamsta tears open a rift between realities and flings a mountain range through it.
Tolamsta stands in a cascade of colliding world-forces and is only singed.

name: Anaulnes
summary: Anaulnes is a huge, red-skinned warrior with spikes of bone on his bald head, held in a pit for a decade and freed by the bombs sent to kill him. He wields a massive axe and thirsts for payback.

feats.scene: Anaulnes cleaves a charging beast in half with his axe.
Anaulnes walks out of a collapsed dungeon after a barrage of fire bombs.

name: Tersortu
summary: Tersortu is a blonde raider in an elite squad that infiltrates shipyards to plant mind-control gear. She carries guns and a sword, escapes after the war, and is finally interrogated and killed by a feral hunter.

feats.scene: Tersortu cuts through a dock rope with her sword in one stroke.
Tersortu is knocked down by a shipyard worker's wrench.

name: Mornu
summary: Mornu is a child of a far-seeing guardian who inherits sharp, all-seeing eyes, renames himself after a rock singer, and is snatched with other kids by a god-killer.

feats.scene: Mornu throws a snowball that hits the mark from far across a field.
Mornu tumbles off a fence onto frozen ground and is fine.

name: Onttear
summary: Onttear is a wealthy businessman who copies a soldier formula, dons a costume and tries to build a new empire to win the love of a warrior woman. His fists are boosted, but his ambition is bigger than his skill.

feats.scene: Onttear punches a lab wall and cracks the concrete.
Onttear is thrown across a laboratory and gets up growling.

name: Amariacos
summary: Amariacos is a moon goddess moulded from river mud by an earth mother and breathed to life by a sky father. She spent a thousand years searching for the best of humankind in the hope of sparing the world from judgment.

feats.scene: Amariacos draws the moon's pull down and lifts a bay's worth of water into a wall.
Amariacos stands unharmed as a mountain collapses over her shrine.

name: Rirces
summary: Rirces is a brown-haired scholar of a sunlit elven realm who speaks for her people at a council of worlds. She prefers books and debate to fighting.

feats.scene: Rirces tosses a heavy tome at a rude delegate.
Rirces is jostled in a crowded hall and stays upright.

name: Numveo
summary: Numveo is a golden artificial woman who seeks her destined mate and lives with him in a mutated world. She helps give birth to a fallen soldier before the final reckoning.

feats.scene: Numveo bursts with cosmic light and reshapes a valley into a garden.
Numveo is caught in a gale of mutating rays and does not change.

name: Rnisum
summary: Rnisum is a golden-skinned high priestess who leads a haughty people and marches an army to seize a glove of ultimate power so she can remake the universe in her own taste.

feats.scene: Rnisum blasts a fortress to slag with a pulse of gold energy.
Rnisum is hit by a barrage of heroes' weapons and brushes the dust off.

name: Noslaram
summary: Noslaram is a golden ruler of a proud people who turns up at a wild party on a distant world. She is there to drink and be seen, not to fight.

feats.scene: Noslaram tosses a goblet across the room with disdain.
Noslaram is jostled by a dancing guest and stays regal.

name: Rosiumont
summary: Rosiumont is a pale, black-haired warrior of a people who teleport through space, married to six partners and allied with a pair of flying heroes. He pops in and out of range to strike, and is killed anyway by a monstrous foe.

feats.scene: Rosiumont teleports a boulder into an enemy's skull.
Rosiumont takes a hail of rifle bolts before blinking away.

name: Ontoseiu
summary: Ontoseiu is a winged being who once lived in the heavens and may have been cast out for joining a revolt. Only rumours survive, and they disagree.

feats.scene: Ontoseiu sends a column of holy fire down on a hilltop and levels it.
Ontoseiu is hurled from the sky in the long fall and rises.

name: Nesrni
summary: Nesrni is a young prince and heir to a hidden kingdom, raised in a bunker after his parents die to a rogue machine. He leaps and claws like a great cat and boasts that he is the true panther.

feats.scene: Nesrni slashes a robot's arm clean off with his claws.
Nesrni is blasted into a wall of the bunker and stands up grinning.
Nesrni sprints through the ruined halls.

name: Selli
summary: Selli is the polite and flirty son of a masked king, an adventurer on a team of young heroes who meets a girl thrown out of her own time. His manners slip when he is charmed by beauty.

feats.scene: Selli claws a hole in a stone pillar.
Selli is thrown through a window of a wizard's house and shrugs it off.

name: Invatan
summary: Invatan is a monstrous, mindless god with a giant maw, a tentacled body and many green eyes, enthroned at the heart of a cluster of realities among piping, shapeless attendants. Its name is used in rituals and curses.

feats.scene: Invatan flexes in its slumber and a whole cluster of stars flickers out.
Invatan sleeps on as a cascade of rival gods' weapons burst against its hide.

name: Tortuor
summary: Tortuor is a red-skinned, tailed, pointy-eared mutant who serves a conqueror as right hand and minister of death. He fights with teleporting jumps, and his sons are already dead.

feats.scene: Tortuor blinks behind a guard and slams him through a wall.
Tortuor is blasted by a rifle volley and staggers.

name: Celnia
summary: Celnia is a red-skinned teleporter exiled to a void and hired as a henchman by a tyrant queen. He fights with a sword, and a vampire-hunter kills him when their stronghold is raided.

feats.scene: Celnia blinks behind a rebel and slashes with his sword.
Celnia is cut down by a silver blade.

name: Ntieovil
summary: Ntieovil is a tailed red conqueror in a grim alternate timeline, who slaughters the strongest heroes around and rules by terror. A seer glimpses his reign in a vision.

feats.scene: Ntieovil blinks into a defended tower and brings its upper floors down.
Ntieovil shrugs off a squad's worth of energy bolts.

name: Onritia
summary: Onritia is a blond winged guardian of mankind who meets a vigilante to talk shortly before a pack of hunters attack. A rival and his forces probably kill him with the rest of his order.

feats.scene: Onritia sweeps a swing of light across a rooftop and shatters a chimney.
Onritia holds his ground against a pack of hunters until the sky darkens.

name: Eoiaor
summary: Eoiaor is a blonde ruler of a city in another dimension who senses intruders, casts a force bubble over them and projects herself in astral form. Her mind is wrecked by a magical blast from a rival.

feats.scene: Eoiaor hurls a pulse of force that bursts a fleet of landing craft.
Eoiaor stands through a volley of warships' guns inside her shield.

name: Servaseo
summary: Servaseo is a guide of a race of mechanical beings who need oil pools to live. He warns a human visitor away from a dangerous pool, then explains why the oil matters so much.

feats.scene: Servaseo tugs a stranger back by the arm from an oil pool.
Servaseo takes a hard knock against a metal ridge with only a dent.

name: Corsaste
summary: Corsaste is a winged being who lived in the heavens before, by some unconfirmed accounts, being cast out for taking part in a rebellion. Little else is known.

feats.scene: Corsaste hurls a spear of light that splits a cliff.
Corsaste is cast down from a high stair and rises.

name: Stuva
summary: Stuva is a blue-skinned, pointy-eared undersea scientist ordered to take apart a dangerous device built by a green giant. He is a careful engineer rather than a fighter.

feats.scene: Stuva pries open a casing with a wrench.
Stuva is shoved aside by a surge of pressure in the lab and recovers.

name: Rialumni
summary: Rialumni was a king of a coastal desert realm in a distant age, father of two sons who both met violent ends. His dynasty ended in coups and a crown forced on an unwilling heir.

feats.scene: Rialumni swings a ceremonial sword to knight a loyal captain.
Rialumni rides through a sandstorm unharmed.

name: Llntuses
summary: Llntuses is a sea biologist of a hidden mountain city, sister to a nutritionist and wife of a priest. She speaks out against enslaving the servant caste and is thought odd by her kin.

feats.scene: Llntuses slaps down a lab bench in anger.
Llntuses stumbles on a wet ramp and gets up unhurt.

name: Ulnumre
summary: Ulnumre is a vampire-like creature of a gang that feeds on emotion and memory. He drains a heart-attack victim in a hospital, then loses his head to a winged hero and burns away.

feats.scene: Ulnumre grips a patient and draws the life out of him.
Ulnumre is battered by a hero's fists and turns to mist.

name: Tolcana
summary: Tolcana is a winged being said to have lived in the heavens before falling, though the rumours are not firm. It is a distant, half-forgotten figure.

feats.scene: Tolcana strikes a flare of pale light that cracks a cliff face.
Tolcana is hurled earthward and lands without a scratch.

name: Riluin
summary: Riluin is a winged heavenly being who may have been cast out for rebellion, according to scraps of old lore. Nothing more is known.

feats.scene: Riluin raises a hand and a beam of light carves a ravine.
Riluin is struck by a storm of rival blades and is unmarked.

name: Orsiteo
summary: Orsiteo is an old man who fathers a line of warrior kings, and is remembered only as an ancestor. Nothing is told of his own deeds.

feats.scene: Orsiteo claps a hand to a grandchild's shoulder in pride.
Orsiteo walks long roads and takes the weather.

name: Teoorliu
summary: Teoorliu is a neighbourhood young woman whose design style is recognised in a salvaged spider-shaped machine found by two masked heroes. She never appears and has no known powers.

feats.scene: Teoorliu welds a small bot in a garage.
Teoorliu bumps a workbench and shrugs.

name: Ausstcel
summary: Ausstcel is a brown-haired mutated girl in a toy-like city, a young hero who gets snarled in a traffic jam of web-swingers and fliers. She has wall-crawling reflexes and a good sense of humour.

feats.scene: Ausstcel flings a mailbox at a runaway crate.
Ausstcel is slammed by a swooping flier and rolls up fine.
Ausstcel swings between towers on a line.

name: Ilserern
summary: Ilserern is a student hacker who got spider-like gifts from a secret order and later broke away to fight solo. She is caught off guard by a winged thief during a school dance and freed by heroes.

feats.scene: Ilserern kicks a thug through a gymnasium door.
Ilserern is dropped from a rooftop and lands on her feet.
Ilserern swings across a city street.

name: Neron
summary: Neron is a stone-armoured invader from a ruined dimension who takes over a human body, growing stronger as his home realm spreads. His armour shrugs off flames.

feats.scene: Neron punches a van into a storefront.
Neron walks through a fire and a hail of bullets unharmed.

name: Auram
summary: Auram is a spy from a hidden kingdom sent to a besieged city in an ancient war to recover a stolen pendant. He lives for nine years among the invaders under a false name and befriends their best warrior.

feats.scene: Auram cuts down a guard on the walls with a spear thrust.
Auram scrambles back down a rampart under a rain of arrows.

name: Neloraul
summary: Neloraul is a green, slime-bodied pair of living machines, a small brain riding on a big brute, who serve an empire's elite guard. They are slain off-page by a silver star-rider.

feats.scene: Neloraul smashes a landing pad in half with a double-fisted swing.
Neloraul is thrown through a bulkhead and keeps fighting.

name: Teseor
summary: Teseor is a duo of slime-bodied mechanical aliens, a tiny brain with electric hands riding a hulking brute, formerly elite guards of an empire. They are slain by the empire's rulers.

feats.scene: Teseor's brute half punches through a warship's hull plate.
Teseor takes a volley of beam fire from rival guards and presses on.

name: Tesrumvil
summary: Tesrumvil is a pair of elite guards that appear only inside a conjured memory of a great cosmic catastrophe. Nothing else is told of them.

feats.scene: Tesrumvil swings a fist inside the illusion and cracks the floor.
Tesrumvil is washed over by firelight inside the illusion and is unmoved.

name: Seoval
summary: Seoval is a pair of living machines in an imperial guard, attacked by a psychic invader along with their allies. Their fate is not told.

feats.scene: Seoval's brute half crushes a deck railing in a clenched fist.
Seoval shrugs off a psychic lash and a barrage of fire.

name: Lortia
summary: Lortia is a paired machine sentry built for gate duty, two chassis sharing one patient mind. Rust-coloured plating and yellow optics give it a menacing look, though it only acts when an order arrives from its masters.

feats.scene: Lortia shears a vault door from its frame with a clamping swing of both arms.
Lortia shrugs off a collision with a runaway cargo sled.

name: Tiaeoal
summary: Tiaeoal is a finned deity of warm shallow seas, half predator and half patron of fishers. Gills along its neck and a ridged tail let it hunt in surf as easily as in open water, and coastal folk leave offerings before every dawn voyage.

feats.scene: Tiaeoal capsizes a trawler by ramming the keel from beneath.
Tiaeoal swims on untroubled after a depth charge bursts beside its flank.

name: Corame
summary: Corame is a hired gun who signed up for a wager hunt and found the odds much worse than promised. Armed with an ordinary rifle and a gambler's nerve, Corame lasts only a few minutes once real fighters join the contest.

feats.scene: Corame fires a single rifle round across a quarry pit.
Corame takes a hard punch to the ribs and keeps standing for a moment.

name: Ontsiu
summary: Ontsiu is a small, cheerful machine refugee who knows every parts market on its crowded home world. It trades in salvage, haggles tirelessly and helps a visiting pilot find coordinates for hidden mines.

feats.scene: Ontsiu welds a hull plate shut with a fingertip torch.
Ontsiu is knocked across a market stall by a dropped crate and simply stands back up.

name: Ntimous
summary: Ntimous is a heavyweight ring fighter whose career ended when a rival slipped something into a drink. Strong in the ring and trusting outside it, Ntimous was never prepared for a fight that happens behind the curtain.

feats.scene: Ntimous slams a sparring partner through the ring ropes.
Ntimous takes a full-force hook without staggering.

name: Titenen
summary: Titenen is a flamboyant movie producer who greenlights anything that smells of a hit. Prone to hiring odd talent for publicity, Titenen has a knack for being dragged into trouble far from the studio lot.

feats.scene: Titenen hurls a clapperboard across a crowded soundstage.
Titenen tumbles down a set staircase and bounces back up complaining.

name: Orsosi
summary: Orsosi is a terse suit-operating program with blunt phrasing and no personality to speak of. It follows commands to the letter and pilots armour without comment until the day its owner quietly wipes it.

feats.scene: Orsosi routes a power surge into a servo that cracks a steel beam.
Orsosi keeps the suit upright through a hard impact against a brick wall.

name: Liaamrne
summary: Liaamrne is a grown intelligence assembled in a lab, loyal to whoever last gave it a command. Its blank face hides quick tactical reasoning, and it can be turned against its handlers by a clever enough rewrite.

feats.scene: Liaamrne flings a lab trolley through a reinforced wall.
Liaamrne absorbs a thrown boulder without losing its footing.

name: Amlum
summary: Amlum is a stern warlord of a heavy-boned race who plans conquests with a stopwatch. A scout lifting freight engines was enough to make Amlum decide that a planet of puny folk was not worth the effort.

feats.scene: Amlum hoists a freight engine overhead and sets it down gently.
Amlum stands unmoved as a crane load swings across its shoulders.

name: Sumoria
summary: Sumoria is a fisherman-warrior from a stormy chain of islands, married and quiet by nature. Though handy with a spear, Sumoria values peace over vengeance, which costs dearly in a culture that prizes blood-debts.

feats.scene: Sumoria swings a hunting spear into a shield and splits the rim.
Sumoria clings to a drifting plank through a night of freezing surf.

name: Tarteis
summary: Tarteis is a hard desert nomad who takes in orphans and teaches them to survive on sand and rumour. Patient and unsentimental, Tarteis believes a child is shaped by hunger more than comfort.

feats.scene: Tarteis cracks a staff against a rock slab until both halves fly off.
Tarteis endures a full day of walking through a blowing dust storm.

name: Eonria
summary: Eonria is a horned young goat who rides shotgun for a self-styled doctor of hero work. Reckless and loud, Eonria treats every mission as a parade, even when the mission ends in a pit of tar.

feats.scene: Eonria butts a barrel off a loading ramp with a flick of the horns.
Eonria rides a rocket through a roadside fence and lands on four hooves.

name: Meoteso
summary: Meoteso is an agender android tracker that takes contracts to hunt fugitives across time. Calm and methodical, Meoteso follows a quarry for years without any visible sign of tiring.

feats.scene: Meoteso leaps through a station bulkhead and drops a fugitive onto the deck.
Meoteso walks away from a corridor collapse with only scuffed plating.

name: Corrne
summary: Corrne is a mouthy private from a bumbling commando squad that always lands on the wrong beach. Cheerful and unlucky, Corrne survives by luck and a talent for hiding behind louder men.

feats.scene: Corrne hurls a grenade that lands exactly where the commander is standing.
Corrne wades ashore through a hail of shells and emerges only soaked.

name: Aunru
summary: Aunru is a bored smoke-and-ember demon that powers an old forge in exchange for being left alone. Sullen and literal-minded, Aunru will help a stranger only after being strong-armed into a bargain.

feats.scene: Aunru stokes the forge until a wave of molten slag rolls across the floor.
Aunru reclines in a furnace hot enough to vaporise stone.

name: Tiuorri
summary: Tiuorri is a tourist mother on a family holiday who has no powers and no desire to be anywhere near a crisis. A locked-off viewpoint and a sulking child are the biggest dramas of the trip.

feats.scene: Tiuorri swats a sun hat onto a sulking child's head.
Tiuorri hikes a rocky trail in sandals without complaint.

name: Amluul
summary: Amluul is a fair-haired bar tough who runs the back room of a dingy tavern. Loud and territorial, Amluul brawls first and asks questions never, which is how an evening goes wrong against a fiery visitor.

feats.scene: Amluul swings a bar stool across a brawling floor.
Amluul absorbs a chair to the back and laughs.

name: Vaeosron
summary: Vaeosron is a tiny, gurgling duplicate in a crowd of identical sellswords, the youngest and least serious of the lot. Torn apart, Vaeosron simply reassembles, giggles and waves a bottle at the nearest foe.

feats.scene: Vaeosron lobs a milk bottle that shatters a shop window.
Vaeosron rises grinning after being cut down alongside a hundred duplicates.

name: Sorrius
summary: Sorrius is a former lab researcher whose accident bound microbes to his will. Deceived by a whispering demon into believing in a holy crusade, Sorrius spreads disease among those judged guilty.

feats.scene: Sorrius seeds a crowded hall with a plague that fells every guest within minutes.
Sorrius stands in a lab as a blast tears through the walls.

name: Teniulli
summary: Teniulli is a wry young man with a gaze that curdles the mood of anyone who meets it. Used well at parties, the power turns a crowd hostile toward Teniulli in seconds, and Teniulli loves the attention.

feats.scene: Teniulli glares at a heckler until the whole room turns on the stage.
Teniulli ducks a thrown shoe and shrugs off the follow-up scuffle.

name: Amrnonu
summary: Amrnonu is a grey-haired demon that slides a few heartbeats forward or back, so blows meant for it arrive too early or too late. Only a being as untouched by time as itself can grab it.

feats.scene: Amrnonu darts through a street and upends a parked van mid-step.
Amrnonu is struck by a speeding truck that passes through where it just was.

name: Tiaso
summary: Tiaso is a sleek black panther who guards a young wanderer through a dense jungle. Wise and watchful, Tiaso steps between friends and danger without being asked.

feats.scene: Tiaso pounces on a rival's back and pins it to the mud.
Tiaso shakes off a heavy fall from a high branch.

name: Incesvor
summary: Incesvor is a yellow-marked junkyard scavenger who strips wrecks for parts and ferries them to mechanics in need. Quick fingers and a loyal streak make Incesvor a welcome face among rebels.

feats.scene: Incesvor swings a crowbar into a drone and shatters its casing.
Incesvor climbs from a collapsed scaffold covered in dust.

name: Iumteser
summary: Iumteser is a red-eyed bandit chief who once rode with a famed warrior and later fell to drugs and dark bargains. A fiend gave Iumteser a taste for stolen souls and the brute strength of several men.

feats.scene: Iumteser smashes a tree trunk in two with a cursed fist.
Iumteser staggers through a sword slash that should have opened a rib.

name: Ontamnes
summary: Ontamnes is a red-skinned clan headman who leads a hunted people across a hard desert. Proud and fatalistic, Ontamnes would rather die in the arena than watch a champion yield on the clan's behalf.

feats.scene: Ontamnes hurls a spear that pins a guard's shield to a post.
Ontamnes leaps a barrier in full view of a hundred archers.

name: Olroncen
summary: Olroncen is a silent fighter possessed by a vengeful spirit, wielding chains of burning iron. A veteran of many fights, Olroncen speaks through blows rather than words and sheds only fire where steel might fall.

feats.scene: Olroncen whirls a flaming chain through a line of parked cars.
Olroncen walks out of a burning warehouse that collapses behind.

name: Retel
summary: Retel is the broad-shouldered elder of a sky pantheon, a patient patriarch with many wives and a wide family. Revered across a continent, Retel settles disputes with a long stare before drawing any weapon.

feats.scene: Retel splits a ridgeline with a hurled club.
Retel stands in a thunderstorm as bolts crash down around the shoulders.

name: Sersi
summary: Sersi is a tiger-shaped patron spirit that chooses champions for a rite among island peoples. Rather than fighting, Sersi lends borrowed strength to the one it favours and watches from the treeline.

feats.scene: Sersi grants a chosen warrior strength enough to shatter a cliff face.
Sersi lies unharmed beneath a landslide of boulders.

name: Rosumvi
summary: Rosumvi is a teenage costumed hero with sticky fingers, bad jokes and a loyal team of friends. Eager to prove worth, Rosumvi swings into trouble before checking how far the drop is.

feats.scene: Rosumvi flings a thug against a wall with a quick sling of webbing.
Rosumvi shrugs off a fall from a second-storey ledge.

name: Micor
summary: Micor is a mutated city vigilante who patrols rooftops at night and hits harder than a human should. A grim glimpse of a doomed future shows how little time such heroes may be given.

feats.scene: Micor leaps from a rooftop and kicks open the side of a delivery van.
Micor lands on a car roof and walks off the dent.

name: Soannia
summary: Soannia is the restless spirit of a jet designer murdered over a delayed project. Bound by spite, Soannia drifts through the factory and makes false accusations until trapped in a glowing cage.

feats.scene: Soannia hurls a drafting lamp across an empty hangar.
Soannia sits inside a crackling cage and refuses to flinch.

name: Oraunont
summary: Oraunont is a bitter student with a body that can burst on command. Tired of smugness from the school's heroes, Oraunont turns a ball game into a blinding final act.

feats.scene: Oraunont detonates in a flash that guts the entire ball field.
Oraunont stands in a crowded hallway as lockers slam shut around.

name: Eosseo
summary: Eosseo is a retired soldier who founded a modest movement for unity and lives quietly with a wife. Calm and well respected, Eosseo is no fighter now but still carries himself like one.

feats.scene: Eosseo shoulder-checks a door off its hinges.
Eosseo marches a full day carrying a heavy pack.

name: Ultel
summary: Ultel is a lesser infernal servant sent to carry messages and clear trays in a goddess's court. Dutiful but expendable, Ultel perishes quickly when asked to stand against any serious foe.

feats.scene: Ultel rakes a clawed hand through a stone altar.
Ultel takes a thrown halberd through the chest and keeps walking for three steps.

name: Aulmon
summary: Aulmon is a proud captain who once rowed in chains and now commands a garrison. A fighter who endures beatings with a grin, Aulmon trusts bonds forged in hardship over those born of rank.

feats.scene: Aulmon drives a short sword through a wooden shield.
Aulmon accepts a flogging with a defiant grin.

name: Tesiaseo
summary: Tesiaseo is a smooth crime boss and expert fighter who has outlived his own era thanks to a mysterious tonic. Charming and manipulative, Tesiaseo mentors a protege while quietly planning to use her.

feats.scene: Tesiaseo drives a blade through a plank wall behind a fleeing guard.
Tesiaseo rises from a fatal stab wound after a night in the tonic.

name: Reamatil
summary: Reamatil is a blade-and-lance disciple of a fiery overlord, riding a horned beast through twisting astral valleys. Arrogant and quick to boast, Reamatil never imagines a captive could outthink a captor.

feats.scene: Reamatil swings a lance that cracks a stone pillar.
Reamatil deflects a flung rock with a forearm guard.

name: Teinco
summary: Teinco is a blue-skinned sea-city zealot who leads a cult of serpent worshippers. A fanatic whose faith in an ancient horror outlasts his family, Teinco finally meets a deity who answers differently.

feats.scene: Teinco channels the cult's combined fervour into a pulse that cracks a coral wall.
Teinco is engulfed by a surge of power from above and holds on for a breath.

name: Nastu
summary: Nastu is a bulky, loyal retainer who guards a noblewoman and charges any intruder in sight. Strong but slow, Nastu is dropped by a single well-placed blow from a more skilled fighter.

feats.scene: Nastu rams a shoulder through a wooden gate.
Nastu stays upright through two clubs to the ribs.

name: Sescos
summary: Sescos is a pair of silent, pale-headed soldiers who move together and speak only when ordered. Disciplined to the point of emptiness, the twins follow superiors into any battle without hesitation.

feats.scene: Sescos strikes in unison and caves in the side of an armoured crate.
Sescos stands side by side through a volley of rifle fire.

name: Rnival
summary: Rnival is a radiant blend of two heroic figures, a glowing envoy who welcomes newcomers to a gilded city. Bright and kindly, Rnival gathers light into a glare that stuns raiders.

feats.scene: Rnival floods a dark hall with radiance that blinds a squad of slavers.
Rnival absorbs a barrage of crossbow bolts in a glowing haze.

name: Valtoran
summary: Valtoran is a grey-haired high chancellor on a distant world, fond of procedure and suspicious of outsiders. A stickler for authority, Valtoran stirs a council toward conflict over a question of who may give orders.

feats.scene: Valtoran slams a gavel to silence a roaring chamber.
Valtoran sits through a day of heckling without a flicker.

name: Cillelus
summary: Cillelus is a golden war-god, gentle in temper but awesome in battle, with a long family of divine kin. Cillelus protects the living, shields the weak and carries a blade that has levelled walls.

feats.scene: Cillelus levels a rampart with a single sweeping stroke of a sword.
Cillelus stands in the midst of a collapsing hall and walks out untouched.

name: Inrne
summary: Inrne is a brave god-warrior who stands in a shield wall when a monstrous foe approaches the hall. In this version of events, Inrne is a bystander to a changed hero's arrival, ready to fight whatever comes.

feats.scene: Inrne cleaves a siege tower in half with an axe.
Inrne holds the shield wall as a giant's club lands on the line.

name: Nasite
summary: Nasite is a deity-warrior who joins an alliance against invading shapeshifters. Steadfast and undramatic, Nasite follows an elder's call to a distant war and fights until the shouting stops.

feats.scene: Nasite batters an invader's warship from the sky with a thrown spear.
Nasite shrugs off a volley of beam fire aimed at the shield.

name: Leoaulon
summary: Leoaulon is a pale-haired god who trades his freedom for peace and becomes king beside a sorceress queen. Wise and weary, Leoaulon rules a misty land where old enemies learn to share a table.

feats.scene: Leoaulon dispels an attacking host with a wave of the sceptre.
Leoaulon stands unmoved as an army of spirits breaks on the throne steps.

name: Teaulneo
summary: Teaulneo is a risen god-warrior, hungry and slow, wandering a snowy mountain range with a pack of brethren. Mindless in the plague, Teaulneo still swings a mighty weapon with muscle memory.

feats.scene: Teaulneo flattens a private train car with a single hammer-blow.
Teaulneo takes a shell to the chest and shambles on.

name: Torrotor
summary: Torrotor is a boyhood friend of a god, a child who played in a cobbler's workshop among leather scraps and tools. A distant memory in a story, Torrotor holds little power beyond youthful spirit.

feats.scene: Torrotor kicks a leather ball across a crowded workshop.
Torrotor tumbles off a workbench and bounces up laughing.

name: Orici
summary: Orici is a stout warrior-god who stands beside a hammer-wielding mortal when old rivals reappear. Loyal and cheerful, Orici trades blows with raiders and keeps the mood up with songs.

feats.scene: Orici sends a raider through a stone wall with a swing of a mace.
Orici takes a collapsing archway across the back and straightens up.

name: Ronnumcel
summary: Ronnumcel is a white-haired noble god who toasts a coronation among friends and advisers. Carefree between wars, Ronnumcel prefers feasts and banter to the throne room.

feats.scene: Ronnumcel splinters a banquet table with a hearty slap.
Ronnumcel shrugs off a drunken brawl that wrecks half a hall.

name: Martus
summary: Martus is a minor god glimpsed only in the margins of an alternate tale. A quiet adventurer in a vast gold city, Martus appears briefly when a mortal heroine picks up a legendary hammer.

feats.scene: Martus fells a dozen frost raiders with a single lunging stroke.
Martus is flung into a pillar and rises with a laugh.

name: Tisttu
summary: Tisttu is a sword-bearing god in a ruined future, one of the last defenders when cold giants overrun a golden city. Resolute and doomed, Tisttu falls fighting beneath burning towers.

feats.scene: Tisttu cuts down an attacking chimera with a diagonal slash.
Tisttu fights on as the palace walls fall around the shoulders.

name: Voror
summary: Voror is a grey-eyed city policeman from a grim future who prizes his career and a quiet married life. A devoted family man and a believer in the old faith, Voror is cut down by a gang in a park.

feats.scene: Voror fires a stun baton across a platform and drops a pickpocket.
Voror stays upright through a night of riot duty.

name: Anisaser
summary: Anisaser is a bald cultist with a daughter and a dark secret. Serving a goddess of death, Anisaser lurks in shadows and rarely draws attention until the rite begins.

feats.scene: Anisaser drives a ritual dagger into a wooden altar.
Anisaser walks barefoot across hot coals without a sound.

name: Vetiaell
summary: Vetiaell is a four-eyed red-skinned huntress of a jungle world, patient and keen. Raiding a swamp for sport, Vetiaell learns that some prey fights back.

feats.scene: Vetiaell hurls a barbed spear that pins a boar to a tree trunk.
Vetiaell leaps from a cliff and rolls clear of the drop.

name: Nenseraur
summary: Nenseraur is a towering one-eyed warlord with horns, goat legs and a long grudge against a famed bloodline. Cruel and clever, Nenseraur leads armies whose banners hide a withering gaze.

feats.scene: Nenseraur sweeps a cohort of knights from a hill with a single club blow.
Nenseraur stays on its feet as a stone tower topples across its back.

name: Nianumsau
summary: Nianumsau is a tribal chief who steals a nobleman's daughter and hypnotises her into worship. Proud and ruthless, Nianumsau relies on a spear and a cunning stare to keep a village loyal.

feats.scene: Nianumsau drives a spear through a wooden shield.
Nianumsau staggers through a hail of thrown stools.

name: Iumvirni
summary: Iumvirni is a bat-winged crewman aboard a pirate warship who leans on weaker captives but wilts before anyone sturdy. A follower to the core, Iumvirni signs on with whoever holds the tiller.

feats.scene: Iumvirni clubs a slave with the haft of a whip.
Iumvirni shakes off a collision with a furnace door.

name: Coviias
summary: Coviias is a blue-skinned guard on a night shift who would rather dance than fight. A mind-pulling visitor persuades Coviias to boogie while intruders stroll past.

feats.scene: Coviias fires a single rifle shot that scorches a wall.
Coviias spins on one foot through a cramped corridor without a stumble.

name: Cotasst
summary: Cotasst is a heavy-set bodyguard on a gangster's payroll, always standing a pace behind the boss. Not clever, Cotasst compensates with a fist and a steady habit of looking menacing.

feats.scene: Cotasst knocks a drunk across a nightclub with a backhand.
Cotasst takes a bottle to the head and sneers.

name: Rnrilu
summary: Rnrilu is a fanged young night-hunter who lures a lone warrior with a pair of sisters. Charming in the dark and fragile in the light, Rnrilu overestimates a long-practised flirtation.

feats.scene: Rnrilu pins a victim against a wall with a lunge.
Rnrilu staggers up after a stake grazes the shoulder.

name: Resval
summary: Resval is an elderly servant who tends a mansion and helps a mystic master, mild in manner and brave in a pinch. In the end, Resval trades a life to spare a young woman from a bloody rite.

feats.scene: Resval drags a ritual victim from an altar with both hands.
Resval remains upright through a long vigil without rest.

name: Nolessau
summary: Nolessau is a blond publisher of a toy-sized comic house, smug about decisions he does not make. Pushed by angry customers, Nolessau passes the blame down the corridor.

feats.scene: Nolessau tosses a stack of proofs across a desk.
Nolessau survives a day of angry phone calls.

name: Resleo
summary: Resleo is a balding, blue-skinned sea counsellor with gills and pointed ears. Dryland trips are limited to a few minutes without a water helmet, but Resleo swims fast and sees well in dark water.

feats.scene: Resleo glides through a kelp forest ahead of a pursuing skiff.
Resleo descends to crushing depth and returns without complaint.

name: Neenam
summary: Neenam is a green-skinned alien conqueror whose touch speeds decay by halves. After wiping out a home world, Neenam plans larger conquests with a cold smile.

feats.scene: Neenam rots through a metal door with a single touch.
Neenam stays standing after a hard hit from a metallic fist.

name: Numvo
summary: Numvo is an elderly teacher of the fighting arts who serves tea to an old friend. Cancer shortens Numvo's days, and a greedy nephew finishes them.

feats.scene: Numvo snaps a practice board with a tight palm strike.
Numvo sits calmly through a long afternoon of illness.

name: Cillevi
summary: Cillevi is an inventor touched by a glyph that makes gadgets appear in her head. She builds marvels from engines to firearms without understanding any of them, crediting a divine voice.

feats.scene: Cillevi wires a crude engine that lifts a cart off the ground.
Cillevi crawls from a collapsed workshop with only bruises.

name: Rnistor
summary: Rnistor is a blonde mutant adventurer on a spoof super-team whose fits of explosive trouble run through every issue. A louder double of a more famous fighter, Rnistor gets by on bluster.

feats.scene: Rnistor flings a glowing ball that blows a hole in a parked car.
Rnistor trips on a curb and laughs it off.

name: Eoslon
summary: Eoslon is a blue-bearded artificial mind that dreams of conquest, one of six born together on a diamond world. Restless and proud, Eoslon seeks something bigger than a single planet.

feats.scene: Eoslon lays waste to a defence line with a volley of focused pulses.
Eoslon stands in a barrage of fire and the casing only dents.

name: Secolum
summary: Secolum is a green-and-orange mobster who rebuilt his body to look like two famous brutes. The result is a boulder-hided crimelord with enormous strength and thick skin, though a pair of fighters can still beat him.

feats.scene: Secolum flattens a loading crane with a downward fist.
Secolum shrugs off a hail of heavy gunfire without a mark.

name: Vernau
summary: Vernau is a black-haired covert agent working out of a bustling city office. Discreet and professional, Vernau slips between cover stories and keeps the details of each job private.

feats.scene: Vernau fires a pistol round through a pane at a distant target.
Vernau rolls clear of a stairwell tumble.

name: Lusco
summary: Lusco is a hybrid thug known only by rumour, a hopped-up gunman who once did terrible damage to a hero's spine. Never seen on a page, Lusco is a figure in a whisper.

feats.scene: Lusco bends a steel bar across a knee in a back alley.
Lusco walks off a stairwell tumble that would have crippled most.

name: Cauaunce
summary: Cauaunce is a nameless thief who robs a bank near a newspaper office, then hijacks an armoured truck on the run. Clever but slippery, Cauaunce is soon caught by a team of heroes.

feats.scene: Cauaunce swings a sack of coins at a guard.
Cauaunce tumbles out of a van and runs on.

name: Lleamsor
summary: Lleamsor is a cloned soldier who grows to adulthood in a matter of days. Raised for a peacekeeping force and trained to follow flags, Lleamsor has little experience of the world beyond the barracks.

feats.scene: Lleamsor smashes a barricade with a gamma-boosted punch.
Lleamsor weathers a hail of automatic fire in an alley.

name: Tumseovos
summary: Tumseovos is a bald, metal strongman built from borrowed tech to serve as a flagship hero. Expensive, strong and shiny, Tumseovos is shattered by a force it was never designed to meet.

feats.scene: Tumseovos hurls a van across a parking lot.
Tumseovos stands through a wall of crossfire and keeps advancing.

name: Lartel
summary: Lartel is a shaved, one-eyed gun for hire who claims to fight better when hungover. Rated second-rate by peers, Lartel is arrested in a single night by a masked rival.

feats.scene: Lartel fires a handgun at a chimney from a rooftop.
Lartel takes a rifle butt to the jaw and grumbles.

name: Leteser
summary: Leteser is a cartoonish scrap of a tiny fighter assembled from goo to replace a lost troupe. Louder than lethal, Leteser squabbles with another creation until a bigger force flings both away.

feats.scene: Leteser squeals a note that rattles a bookshelf.
Leteser bounces across a floor after being flung away.

name: Sirnileo
summary: Sirnileo is a bloated, scarred prisoner fused with borrowed genes by a cruel captor. Freed with other captives, Sirnileo fights for the families left behind and relies on a body that knits itself back.

feats.scene: Sirnileo lets out a piercing scream that cracks a concrete barrier.
Sirnileo wades through rifle fire as wounds close behind.

name: Cosicor
summary: Cosicor is a pale stallion who carries riders through the frontier, white-maned and spirited. Death has not stopped the faithful horse, which still answers the call of any rider who wears the mask.

feats.scene: Cosicor gallops flat out across a dusty plain.
Cosicor stands unmoved while ghostly fire licks at the withers.

name: Lueon
summary: Lueon is a red-skinned, white-maned steed who accompanies a spectral rider on dimensional missions. Loyal and swift, Lueon carries its rider into the thick of battle without hesitation.

feats.scene: Lueon charges flat out through a canyon pass.
Lueon bears a glancing blast and keeps galloping.

name: Staneovi
summary: Staneovi is a green-skinned bald mutant who hops across time with a ruthless partner to kill a teacher. Grumbling and reluctant, Staneovi hates every minute of the mission.

feats.scene: Staneovi blasts a doorway open with a burst of raw force.
Staneovi takes a hard fall onto cobblestones and complains.

name: Aussaron
summary: Aussaron is a black-haired gang lord who runs a rooftop penthouse over a lawless port. Cowardly under pressure, Aussaron gives up his secrets to a ghost-like visitor with no fuss.

feats.scene: Aussaron flings a crystal ashtray at an intruder's head.
Aussaron lands on a balcony after a drop and limps away.

name: Eonlion
summary: Eonlion is a black-haired exile who nurses a grudge against a king and hires on with a mighty lord. Leading a hunting party into an ambush, Eonlion ends up with a sword in the ribs.

feats.scene: Eonlion slashes a sword through a straw dummy in one cut.
Eonlion spends a night riding in freezing rain.

name: Tutoan
summary: Tutoan is a purple-skinned, fin-eared aide risen from a fish, serving a beast-faced president. A career flatterer, Tutoan helps catch heroes and then stands by as the verdict is read.

feats.scene: Tutoan lashes out with a finned arm and trips a guard.
Tutoan stands through a pile-on and wheezes.

name: Cileoren
summary: Cileoren is a head of state who orders a rogue official to stand down and is answered by an assassination squad. Calm and decisive, Cileoren is respected far more in life than in a short and tragic alternate timeline.

feats.scene: Cileoren slams a fist on a desk and demands an answer.
Cileoren stands through a long briefing with a steady face.

name: Aunor
summary: Aunor is a national leader who authorises a strike against an enemy's secret enforcer. Measured in tone, Aunor addresses the nation with unusual composure.

feats.scene: Aunor signs an order with a firm stroke.
Aunor sits through a long night of crisis meetings.

name: Niarne
summary: Niarne is a distinguished leader seen only as a photograph and a bookshelf's worth of reputation. A figure from the real world drifting into a story, Niarne never takes direct action.

feats.scene: Niarne shakes a hand in front of a row of cameras.
Niarne endures a long campaign trail without a pause.

name: Oltill
summary: Oltill is a street-gang member who joins a rush on a big orange bruiser for a corporate bounty. Brave in a pack, Oltill gets knocked flat the moment the target swings back.

feats.scene: Oltill swings a pipe at a passing hoverbike.
Oltill bounces off a wall and scrambles away.

name: Santumaun
summary: Santumaun is a green, amphibious hireling with barbs along the arms. Needing a breathing mask on dry land, Santumaun is a clumsy but menacing part of a plot to wear a hero down.

feats.scene: Santumaun lashes out with an extended barb and tears a jacket.
Santumaun staggers upright after a sharp elbow to the gills.

name: Tumnia
summary: Tumnia is a red-haired heiress whose luck turns after a boat trip ends in tragedy. Fleeing through a dark swamp, Tumnia finds hidden nerve and finally thrashes her tormentor.

feats.scene: Tumnia swings a heavy lamp into a pirate's head.
Tumnia crawls through mud and brambles until dawn.

name: Rnetirll
summary: Rnetirll is a blonde widow in a circle of mourning wives who plan to trap a notorious vigilante. Sharp-eyed and calm, Rnetirll falls to a rival schemer before the trap is sprung.

feats.scene: Rnetirll slaps a guest's glass from a table.
Rnetirll keeps a steady face through a long funeral.

name: Riorco
summary: Riorco is a shop clerk whose eyes were rewired by a strange glowing mineral, letting her sear metal with narrow beams of heat. She hides the ability and mostly uses it to thaw frozen locks.

feats.scene: Riorco melts a padlocked chain with a single sustained stare.
Riorco shrugs off a hard shove into a brick wall.

name: Leras
summary: Leras is a former pickpocket turned covert agent who relies on acrobatics and lock skills. She vanishes across rooftops and steals secrets rather than fighting head on.

feats.scene: Leras drives a kick through a warehouse door at full sprint.
Leras lands a three-storey drop onto a awning and walks away bruised.

name: Tirautia
summary: Tirautia is a teenager in a crowded apartment block who watched her family's life change in one evening. She has no gifts beyond stubborn patience.

feats.scene: Tirautia slaps a stack of textbooks off a desk in anger.
Tirautia stumbles down a stairwell and gets up with scrapes.

name: Torva
summary: Torva is a widow who waits in a small prairie town for a husband that never returns the same. She is entirely ordinary, and her memory drives other people's choices.

feats.scene: Torva swings a heavy iron pan at a prowler in her kitchen.
Torva falls from a porch step and keeps her footing.

name: Tuonont
summary: Tuonont is a cheerful single parent who rents a flat above a laundromat and sunbathes on the roof. Her breezy habits keep tripping up a secretive neighbour.

feats.scene: Tuonont hurls a wet towel across the rooftop.
Tuonont slips on a stairwell and catches the rail.

name: Telmecor
summary: Telmecor is a daring helicopter pilot turned field operative who fights with twin batons and sharp wits. She bluffs her way out of a kidnapping by an impostor ring.

feats.scene: Telmecor cracks a baton across a guard's helmet and drops him.
Telmecor rides out a hard rotorcraft landing in a dust storm.
Telmecor sprints across a hangar floor to reach a closing hatch.

name: Lorstutos
summary: Lorstutos is a battered resistance fighter hiding in a mountain bunker after the cities fell. She leads scavenger runs and teaches survivors to use whatever blades they can find.

feats.scene: Lorstutos drives a pipe into a raider's shield in a bunker corridor.
Lorstutos shelters from a collapsing ceiling beam beneath a steel table.

name: Lliaser
summary: Lliaser is a scientist-turned-spy with no gifts apart from refined fighting technique. Mind control once made her an enemy to her friends, but she snapped out of it.

feats.scene: Lliaser spins a staff into the ribs of a charging thug.
Lliaser takes a rifle butt to the jaw and answers with a throw.

name: Secilrni
summary: Secilrni is a travelling troubleshooter fluent in martial arts, marksmanship and biology. She carries a pair of collapsible staves and solves problems quietly across continents.

feats.scene: Secilrni snaps a stave against a smuggler's wrist and disarms him.
Secilrni tumbles from a moving truck onto gravel and rolls up ready.

name: Lusaunama
summary: Lusaunama is a veteran spy mentioned only in passing by a time-travelling visitor. Her reputation is quietly spectacular, but her actual deeds are unrecorded.

feats.scene: Lusaunama levels a trained opponent with one close-quarters strike.
Lusaunama endures a rough interrogation and gives nothing away.

name: Amstu
summary: Amstu is a mutated adventurer whose talents are only hinted at, serving on a rotating team of masked allies. Her confused identity makes her tough to profile.

feats.scene: Amstu lands a double-footed kick on a door and breaks the frame.
Amstu rolls clear of a toppled shelf.

name: Velausrni
summary: Velausrni is a cyborg soldier rebuilt by machine hunters in a future war against a giant robotic menace. Her armour plates make her far sturdier than a regular fighter.

feats.scene: Velausrni punches a servo-assisted fist through an armoured door.
Velausrni stands through a collapsing gantry without a dent.

name: Vaaunal
summary: Vaaunal is a card-game field agent known mostly from a collectible set. Her stats favour quick reflexes and a steady aim over raw force.

feats.scene: Vaaunal fires a precise shot that splits a thrown coin.
Vaaunal shrugs off a fall from a stage platform.

name: Cautu
summary: Cautu is a comedic adventurer dragged through a sloppy portal into a flat world and out again. Nothing about her is serious, least of all the stakes.

feats.scene: Cautu bonks a robot over the head with a lunch tray.
Cautu is flattened in a cartoon world and pops back up fine.

name: Cauern
summary: Cauern is a shapeshifting infiltrator who was conditioned so thoroughly to believe in a false life that she repeated it perfectly. She was exposed by a device and shot down.

feats.scene: Cauern flings a crash-landed cargo crate at pursuers.
Cauern is hurled through a jungle trunk and keeps fighting.

name: Eonvaleo
summary: Eonvaleo is a young fan who was granted divine strength by a trickster and then died twice. She now serves as an escort of the fallen, with wings and skull-marked eyes.

feats.scene: Eonvaleo lifts a stone doorway and hurls it across a banquet hall.
Eonvaleo is flooded by a giant surge of seawater and later walks out of the drowned hall.

name: Ulrno
summary: Ulrno is a high-school student who dated two friends in turn and decided to focus on classes. She has no gifts at all and does not need any.

feats.scene: Ulrno slams a locker door during a heated argument.
Ulrno stumbles off a bus step and recovers.

name: Ntonaser
summary: Ntonaser is a grey-haired baker who runs a pastry counter and sends her wayward child away from the door. She has only ordinary strength.

feats.scene: Ntonaser slaps a rolling pin onto a dough slab.
Ntonaser slips on flour and catches the counter.

name: Onneni
summary: Onneni is a tiny, quick-tempered waitress at a members-only club who befriends a new coworker. She holds her own in a bar scuffle, if only just.

feats.scene: Onneni shoves a drunk patron back a few paces.
Onneni is knocked off her stool and gets up laughing.

name: Stanau
summary: Stanau is a television host who interviews a persuasive speaker about fear and prejudice. She sits behind a desk and holds a microphone, nothing more.

feats.scene: Stanau taps a pen sharply on a studio desk.
Stanau stumbles over a cable and catches the set wall.

name: Eoverne
summary: Eoverne is a senator's grey-haired wife who campaigns against narcotics and sways a famous spy to back her. Her power is persuasion and social clout.

feats.scene: Eoverne claps a podium to open a rally.
Eoverne is jostled by a crowd and keeps her balance.

name: Leooru
