summary: Leooru is a four-armed jungle native from a world overrun by a plague of hungry undead. He fell almost at once to an infected hunter and a big cat.

feats.scene: Leooru grabs a boulder with two hands and hits with the other two.
Leooru is bitten by a feral predator and keeps swinging.

name: Rnrnicor
summary: Rnrnicor is a four-armed raider who guarded a hidden fortress and was beaten by a visiting rock-skinned hero. He was later banished with his comrades.

feats.scene: Rnrnicor pounds a stone parapet into rubble with four fists.
Rnrnicor takes a heavy rockfall without a break in stride.
Rnrnicor charges across a courtyard faster than a sprinter.

name: Llnite
summary: Llnite is a four-armed brute who answers to a scheming geneticist in a televised adventure. He wins fights through weight and extra limbs.

feats.scene: Llnite smashes a vault door with a hammering double blow.
Llnite is hit by a falling beam and shakes it off.

name: Tosrello
summary: Tosrello is a cast-out winged being whose record is vague and unverified. Reports claim he joined a failed rebellion in the skies, but no deeds are confirmed.

feats.scene: Tosrello hurls a column of light across a ruined cloud hall.
Tosrello endures a fall through burning mist.

name: Viell
summary: Viell is an ancient sky deity older than the first light, revered by mute cultists with sewn mouths. Its worship spans icy northern tribes and the hidden hollows beneath their camps.

feats.scene: Viell lets one breath rip the clouds from a continental sky.
Viell stands unmoved as a mountain range collapses beneath it.

name: Veocirn
summary: Veocirn is a fast-running parody hero on a squad of costumed buffoons who feud with a rival crew. Each of his races ends in a pratfall.

feats.scene: Veocirn blurs around a city block in a comic dash.
Veocirn trips and crashes through a wooden fence at speed.
Veocirn bounces off a lamppost and keeps running.

name: Oltiaro
summary: Oltiaro is a stubborn freighter skipper determined to deliver cargo through hostile waters. He wins a mutiny with his fists and later loses his ship to a boiler blast.

feats.scene: Oltiaro knocks a mutineer down with a heavy hook.
Oltiaro survives a steam explosion that sinks his vessel.

name: Seosenau
summary: Seosenau is a swaggering gang boss who chases a rival through a swamp town on a loud motorbike. A single touch from a grim visitor ends his run.

feats.scene: Seosenau swings a heavy chain at a kneeling rival.
Seosenau is flung from his bike and rolls across asphalt.

name: Iarint
summary: Iarint is a bird-like trainee freed from a captive pen and enrolled with a rebel squad. He can take to the air, though he is still learning combat.

feats.scene: Iarint dives talons-first into a training dummy.
Iarint clips a gym wall and flutters upright.
Iarint swoops down a corridor in a practice race.

name: Seoriatu
summary: Seoriatu is a feathered student with eagle eyes who serves as muscle for a teenage gang boss. He swings a baseball bat and spots targets from far away.

feats.scene: Seoriatu swings a bat into a locker with a loud clang.
Seoriatu is clipped by a car door and recovers.
Seoriatu beats his wings and glides across a schoolyard.

name: Ronlaam
summary: Ronlaam is a white-haired, feathered fighter on a team of rebels summoned to face a robotic hunting force. Little is recorded after the meeting.

feats.scene: Ronlaam slashes at a drone's casing with a hooked talon.
Ronlaam is thrown across a hangar and recovers.

name: Risosaun
summary: Risosaun is a hospital doctor whose ward grows unnerving once a notorious patient takes control of it. He appears only in a radio drama.

feats.scene: Risosaun presses a plunger to give a shot to a patient.
Risosaun is shoved against a gurney and holds on.

name: Temis
summary: Temis is a survey-team member sent to judge an island for mining. He is torn apart by its monstrous residents soon after landing.

feats.scene: Temis fires a flare gun at a looming shape.
Temis is dragged down a muddy slope.

name: Liuiarniu
summary: Liuiarniu is a future corporate board member who objects to sharing genetic discoveries with the public. He fights with votes and memos.

feats.scene: Liuiarniu slams a folder onto a conference table.
Liuiarniu is jostled in an elevator and keeps his feet.

name: Tirtelva
summary: Tirtelva is a lab-altered horned lizard who learned to talk and builds up a static charge in his body. A schemer wanted to farm him as a living battery.

feats.scene: Tirtelva discharges a crackling pulse into a metal cage.
Tirtelva takes a heavy club blow across his horned skull.

name: Onvaial
summary: Onvaial is a balding building superintendent who fixes pipes and fusses over tenants. He has a spouse, a niece and a ring of keys.

feats.scene: Onvaial wrenches a rusty valve open in a basement.
Onvaial slips on the stairs and grabs the banister.

name: Vastunu
summary: Vastunu is a green-skinned freight captain with tentacled whiskers and a crab-like claw. He tows broken ships for favours when money stops meaning anything.

feats.scene: Vastunu cracks a cargo crate open with his claw.
Vastunu is thrown into a bulkhead and laughs it off.

name: Cornico
summary: Cornico is a rich mine owner on the frontier who forces captives to dig a deadly ore beneath a hilltop fortress. He eventually pays for his cruelty.

feats.scene: Cornico fires a pistol from a castle balcony at a rider.
Cornico takes a hard punch and stays on his feet.

name: Iarentel
summary: Iarentel is a medieval-themed crook who rides a horse and carries a laser lance from a drafty keep. He tried to use a muscular hired fighter against a rival.

feats.scene: Iarentel fires his lance at a steel girder and slices it.
Iarentel is unhorsed by a charging bruiser and stands again.

name: Celan
summary: Celan is a regional lord who sends soldiers to the wrong place and flees from a duel offer. His castle is mostly a stone box with a flag.

feats.scene: Celan swings a broadsword at a captor.
Celan is knocked off his horse in a mud field.

name: Raullo
summary: Raullo is an informant who ran a spy ring across a southern country and then tried a cross-ocean smuggling run. He was easily rounded up at the pier.

feats.scene: Raullo draws a pistol on a startled deckhand.
Raullo is tackled onto a steel deck and gives up.

name: Meoeos
summary: Meoeos is an island scientist who built piloted guided rockets and launched them with suicidal flyers. His lab fell when a prisoner broke loose.

feats.scene: Meoeos launches a rocket that bursts into a supply depot.
Meoeos is clubbed in his own laboratory.

name: Leoeosco
summary: Leoeosco is a saboteur who was trapped in a room of glowing ore and emerged with green skin and hands that fire bolts. He murdered a researcher on his way out.

feats.scene: Leoeosco blasts a bolt through a warehouse wall.
Leoeosco endures a rain of thrown crates.

name: Rernval
summary: Rernval is a comic sorcerer in a drafty mountain castle who runs guided tours and orders late-night pizza. His spells mainly summon ghost helpers.

feats.scene: Rernval conjures a puff of smoke that tips a table.
Rernval is bonked by a tour group's umbrella.

name: Corlumnis
summary: Corlumnis is a comic mage who escaped a pocket dimension and stalked a rival to his doorstep. He lost the fight after a clumsy collision.

feats.scene: Corlumnis throws a sputtering spark at a doorframe.
Corlumnis is knocked flat by a hurried tumble.

name: Liseoam
summary: Liseoam is an eccentric nobleman who lives like a medieval lord while secretly working as a foreign agent. He drugs dinner guests and drops visitors into a pit of fish.

feats.scene: Liseoam shoves a guest toward a pool with both hands.
Liseoam survives his plane crashing into a field.

name: Calci
summary: Calci is a small white dog with a snooty name who was snatched and stored in a toy-shaped trap. He was returned to his owner by a rescuer.

feats.scene: Calci nips at a trap's string in a panic.
Calci tumbles out of a toy chest unhurt.

name: Vaeos
summary: Vaeos is a lord of a large estate who sends soldiers after strangers and runs when asked to settle things in a duel. His courage is smaller than his castle.

feats.scene: Vaeos swings a ceremonial blade at a captor.
Vaeos is yanked off his horse and lands in the dirt.

name: Leressor
summary: Leressor is a wartime informant who runs a sabotage cell from behind a seaside fish exhibit. A swimmer with sea-born strength wrecks his getaway boat.

feats.scene: Leressor releases a snapping predator into a tank at a pursuer.
Leressor is thrown from a speedboat before it blows up.

name: Cosarlon
summary: Cosarlon is a naval officer who sets up bait ships packed with explosives to ambush enemy fleets. A sea-dweller rams him through a submarine hull.

feats.scene: Cosarlon detonates a decoy ship in a harbour.
Cosarlon takes a hard blow to the head from a stronger foe.

name: Iumriant
summary: Iumriant is a bald diplomat who hides spying behind a consulate desk and kidnaps a general for ransom. Two young adventurers on holiday upset his plans.

feats.scene: Iumriant strikes an aide with a heavy ledger.
Iumriant is knocked off his feet by a charging teen.

name: Rirtiaul
summary: Rirtiaul is a green-skinned flyer who commands a floating airbase and attacks a city with antique biplanes and paralysis devices. His attack is more theatrical than deadly.

feats.scene: Rirtiaul drops a stun charge from a biplane onto a plaza.
Rirtiaul is bounced from a cockpit hatch and lands in a net.
Rirtiaul banks a biplane along a skyline.

name: Eonise
summary: Eonise is a half-machine supervillain with a white beard who battles an old rival using clunky steam gadgets. When the grid fails, his engines keep running.

feats.scene: Eonise vents a boiler blast into a parking lot.
Eonise is dunked in cold water and keeps hissing.

name: Torntice
summary: Torntice is a cartoon cyborg whose pistol belches thick vapour clouds. He fills a hero's car with hot mist and little else.

feats.scene: Torntice floods a sedan with hissing steam.
Torntice is hosed down by a cold sprinkler.

name: Ialrontel
summary: Ialrontel is a white-haired figure from a coastal tech city who is only named in credits. Nothing about his conduct is recorded.

feats.scene: Ialrontel rattles a metal gate in frustration.
Ialrontel is shoved against a rail and holds firm.

name: Nianava
summary: Nianava is a fleet commander whose giant submarine exhales a numbing gas that drops sailors. A sea-born swimmer who ignores the gas ruins his plan.

feats.scene: Nianava vents a drifting cloud over a convoy of ships.
Nianava is battered by a furious prisoner.

name: Siuoru
summary: Siuoru is the aide of a petty ruler who watches armoured guards crumble and her husband fall to poison. She holds a high place with little power.

feats.scene: Siuoru pours a vial into a goblet.
Siuoru is shaken by an explosion in the great hall.

name: Ontam
summary: Ontam is a bald, bearded club-wrecker for hire who was nearly beaten by an avenger on an amusement pier. He ends sliced in two by a spinning ride.

feats.scene: Ontam pulps a bar counter with a bat.
Ontam is hit by a toppling wheel and still laughs.

name: Usstu
summary: Usstu is a small pet bird with orange eyes and feathery wings, kept in a city flat. It has no deeds beyond chirping from its perch.

feats.scene: Usstu pecks at a seed cup.
Usstu bumps the cage bars and shakes it off.

name: Nauin
summary: Nauin is a court adviser who warns his king of a coming threat and later prays to a visiting god. His faith ends with a swift execution.

feats.scene: Nauin bangs a staff on a stone floor to call attention.
Nauin is thrown against a pillar and slumps.

name: Nuialeo
summary: Nuialeo is a tribesman who bows before a severed head in a jungle camp. He lives in a stone-age village and has no great feats.

feats.scene: Nuialeo hurls a spear at a fruit tree.
Nuialeo tumbles down a hill and stands up.

name: Vialar
summary: Vialar is a white-haired newsroom employee who is framed for theft and arrested by a loud editor. He lacks any fighting skill.

feats.scene: Vialar slams a drawer shut.
Vialar is pushed into a desk and winces.

name: Ontniul
summary: Ontniul is a defecting lab technician who builds a hideout in a hedge and later joins a school of young heroes. He is mostly known for his dancing.

feats.scene: Ontniul swings a wrench at a robotic drone.
Ontniul is knocked flat by a shockwave.

name: Coreon
summary: Coreon is a bald bodyguard who stands behind a crime matriarch and watches the door. His job is mostly intimidation.

feats.scene: Coreon grabs a trespasser by the collar and flings him.
Coreon takes a bottle to the head and shrugs.

name: Seaunau
summary: Seaunau is a film-industry bystander who is saved from a hate group by a patriotic hero. He is a regular man in a bad situation.

feats.scene: Seaunau shoves a thug off in a panic.
Seaunau is knocked to the pavement.

name: Numne
summary: Numne is a college student who corners a teacher after class. A pale intruder interrupts him, and he bolts.

feats.scene: Numne pins a wrist to a desk with his hands.
Numne is flung aside by a stronger hand.

name: Tentu
summary: Tentu is a grey-haired man who inherits his late sibling's property and hurries to sell it. He argues more than he fights.

feats.scene: Tentu thumps a paper deed against a table.
Tentu stumbles on a porch step.

name: Tiavaau
summary: Tiavaau is a retired miner in a hillside village who raises his grandchild and never knows her hidden fairy blood. His quiet life lasts until odd events hit the town.

feats.scene: Tiavaau swings a pickaxe into a stubborn seam.
Tiavaau is caught in a small tunnel cave-in and crawls out.

name: Leren
summary: Leren is a grey-haired lawman who sifts through the burnt remains of a travelling fairground. He has no abilities beyond persistence.

feats.scene: Leren fires a revolver at a fence post.
Leren is knocked back by a gust of ash.

name: Amaunami
summary: Amaunami is a minor sorcerer who joins an underground movement resisting a registration law. Spells are his only claim to fame.

feats.scene: Amaunami hurls a bolt of glowing force at a door.
Amaunami stumbles through a street scuffle.

name: Leoineru
summary: Leoineru is a blond pilot who is forced to fly across the country by a woman wearing someone else's body. He wants only to land safely.

feats.scene: Leoineru yanks a control column to steady the plane.
Leoineru is shaken by turbulence in the cockpit.
Leoineru cruises an airliner across the continent.

name: Larlllia
summary: Larlllia is a furry, clawed student with sharp senses who runs for a school dance title. His body heals fast, and he is stronger and quicker than any athlete.

feats.scene: Larlllia claws through a thick oak door.
Larlllia is slammed through a classroom wall and heals within minutes.
Larlllia races across a campus lawn.

name: Lloanni
summary: Lloanni is a three-eyed alien bystander watching a silver traveller get thrown out of a space-station club. He resembles a famous cartoon child.

feats.scene: Lloanni claps along with the crowd.
Lloanni is bumped by a passerby.

name: Leove
summary: Leove is a shapeshifting impostor who was fitted with a receiver so that distant stations can beam him power. He terrorised border outposts until a warlord's hunter ended him.

feats.scene: Leove vaporises a border fortress with a stream of relayed energy.
Leove soaks up a barrage of cannon fire.

name: Lisrnisum
summary: Lisrnisum is a blond regional boss of a spy agency who briefs field agents about missing colleagues and a suspicious cult. He directs from behind a desk.

feats.scene: Lisrnisum slaps a file on the table.
Lisrnisum is knocked back by a door.

name: Tesauci
summary: Tesauci is a representative of a far-future earth who hosts a greedy time traveller and punishes his scheming. Their advanced devices see through lies.

feats.scene: Tesauci triggers a restraint field around a thief.
Tesauci shrugs off a clumsy shove.

name: Ronrn
summary: Ronrn is a wealthy man who owns a huge manor that his daughter and her friends visit. He is named in a cartoon episode and does little else.

feats.scene: Ronrn rings a brass bell for his butler.
Ronrn is bumped by a guest in the hallway.

name: Llntilo
summary: Llntilo is a federal agent who abuses authority while rounding up unregistered neighbours. A watchful officer stuns him before he can fire.

feats.scene: Llntilo raises a pistol at a captive.
Llntilo is knocked out by a single punch.

name: Iumcau
summary: Iumcau is a bald test subject whose mind was hollowed out so that a rich patron could have a strong servant. He is a huge and obedient brute.

feats.scene: Iumcau flips a laboratory bench with one hand.
Iumcau is hit with a pipe and does not flinch.

name: Iasvecen
summary: Iasvecen is a soldier fired from a squad lead role who threatens a school bus out of revenge. A pilot he hired turns on him and shoots him down.

feats.scene: Iasvecen points a rifle at a gaggle of kids.
Iasvecen is knocked back by a gunshot.

name: Tinenver
summary: Tinenver is a minor magical entity whose name is attached to a spell that makes everyone look ordinary. A wizard borrows it to fool a nosy neighbour.

feats.scene: Tinenver casts a veil of dull clothing over a group of costumed teens.
Tinenver endures a scoff from a nosy visitor.

name: Intelam
summary: Intelam is a bike-trick coach who teaches his son daring jumps. He lives in a world where most things end in crashes.

feats.scene: Intelam hoists a bike over a curb.
Intelam tumbles from a ramp and gets up.

name: Celte
summary: Celte is a cartoon dad possessed by a fiery spirit who quizzes his child about school and vengeance. His household is chaotic and cute.

feats.scene: Celte sets a hallway rug aflame with a stare.
Celte is bonked by a flying toy.

name: Lusilcor
summary: Lusilcor is a yellow-skinned envoy who speaks for his home planet at a galactic assembly. He learns that a living world has swallowed his people.

feats.scene: Lusilcor raises a hand to address the council.
Lusilcor is shaken by an assembly hall tremor.

name: Tumaun
summary: Tumaun is a blue-skinned officer on a giant attack machine whose crew is shot down by a silver surfer of the stars. He lunges at the captor and is arrested.

feats.scene: Tumaun lunges at a captor with a vicious swing.
Tumaun is dragged from a wrecked war machine.

name: Iumarlia
summary: Iumarlia is the beloved of an ancient wizard in a doomed desert city and is later said to be reborn as a princess. She dies when invaders storm the walls.

feats.scene: Iumarlia places a bracelet on a temple altar.
Iumarlia is struck by a raider's blade.

name: Malli
summary: Malli is a grey, horned envoy with goat legs who speaks for a rocky world. He argues that a different race deserves credit for stopping a living planet.

feats.scene: Malli stamps a hoof and cracks a marble tile.
Malli bears the weight of a toppled pillar.

name: Corumser
summary: Corumser is an elder of a desert brotherhood who tries to flee a fortress with his ally. A barbarian avenger catches and kills him.

feats.scene: Corumser slashes a curved blade at a pursuer.
Corumser is thrown against a wall.

name: Stusessan
summary: Stusessan is a white-haired flyer who joins a rebellion against a reality-warping tyrant. She is slaughtered by a nightmarish hunter in her hiding place.

feats.scene: Stusessan hurls a fallen girder at a masked enforcer.
Stusessan is hit by a collapsing wall before the final fight.
Stusessan flies above rooftops to evade searchlights.

name: Teserser
summary: Teserser is a scaly petty thief transformed by a shattered gem into a green, red-eyed assassin who shoots heat and cold from his gaze. He can fly and fights with inhuman strength.

feats.scene: Teserser blasts a steel truck apart with a focused eye beam.
Teserser is hit by a car and rises.
Teserser glides along a skyline.

name: Nistar
summary: Nistar is a convict in a floating prison who is freed in a mass breakout and stopped by a blind vigilante. He breaks nothing but his own streak.

feats.scene: Nistar swings a cell door open and charges.
Nistar is flattened by a rooftop takedown.

name: Iasatil
summary: Iasatil is a clumsy thief tempted by a glittering stone and thrown off course by a sugary snack. A police squad arrives to collect him.

feats.scene: Iasatil pockets a gem through a cracked case.
Iasatil is tripped up by a cream-filled cake.

name: Leoani
summary: Leoani is a bald technician in a shadowy think-tank who tries to mentally dominate a flying armoured hero. His willpower contest ends in failure and apparent death.

feats.scene: Leoani reaches into a guard's mind and turns him around.
Leoani is caught in a blast that tears his hangar.

name: Llrnori
summary: Llrnori is a woodland wizard who traps spirits in gold and raises walking trees to terrorise a village. A single thrown crucible ruins the ritual.

feats.scene: Llrnori commands a thorny trunk to crush a stockade gate.
Llrnori is drenched in molten gold and falls.

name: Tosni
summary: Tosni is a scarred sea captain who hunts salvage across misty reefs, trading honesty for coin only when cornered. A cracked brass compass that points toward regret is its one prized possession.

feats.scene: Tosni drives a boarding axe through a ship's oaken rail in a single desperate swing.
Tosni shrugs off a falling spar that cracks across the shoulders.
Tosni sprints down a pitching deck to reach the rope ladder first.

name: Eliteo
summary: Eliteo is a young priestess who learns that a living cloak of shadow can only be worn by agreement, never by force. Together they sing to storms and calm them.

feats.scene: Eliteo and the cloak release a shared pulse of dark wind that flattens a stone chapel.
Eliteo stands unharmed while a collapsing temple roof falls upon the cloak.
Eliteo leaps rooftop to rooftop on ribbons of living shadow.

name: Iururon
summary: Iururon is a cat-headed guardian spirit of a hidden highland kingdom, patient and fond of riddles. It keeps watch over the hills from a moonlit shrine.

feats.scene: Iururon sweeps a clawed paw and splits a granite ridge into rubble.
Iururon endures a landslide of boulders without shifting its stance.
Iururon streaks across the valley as a silver blur before dawn.

name: Leocossi
summary: Leocossi is a feline spirit who leads the dead along a silent river of starlight to their rest. Its steps leave glowing paw prints on the water.

feats.scene: Leocossi pounces and the shockwave topples a row of standing stones.
Leocossi walks through a rockfall as though it were drifting mist.
Leocossi crosses the riverbank in a single bounding glide.

name: Vorcoslon
summary: Vorcoslon is an ancient sun-warmed deity of the hills, cheerful and slow to anger, who remembers every feast ever held in its honour. It treats the moon spirit as an old drinking companion.

feats.scene: Vorcoslon claps its hands and a gale clears a forest clearing of trees.
Vorcoslon laughs off a lightning storm that scorches the ground around it.
Vorcoslon races a thundercloud to the horizon and wins.

name: Corstu
summary: Corstu is a pocket dimension of tilted corridors and humming lamps where visitors lose their sense of up and down. It rearranges its halls whenever someone tries to map them.

feats.scene: Corstu's walls absorb a detonation that would level a city block without a crack.

name: Iaste
summary: Iaste is a hulking war-machine warrior forged to serve a conquering tyrant, loyal until a stronger rival ends its service in an ambush. Its armoured chest glows with a failing furnace.

feats.scene: Iaste punches through a reinforced bunker door and the wall behind it.
Iaste takes a cannon volley point blank and keeps advancing.
Iaste charges across a courtyard faster than a galloping horse.

name: Valsantiu
summary: Valsantiu is a masked bandit who robs frontier banks and vanishes into a flock of startled bats. The disguise works until a young gunslinger notices the same boot tracks at every crime.

feats.scene: Valsantiu cracks a pistol butt against a vault clerk's lock.
Valsantiu rolls down a staircase and rises with only bruises.
Valsantiu spurs a stolen horse into a full gallop.

name: Eolamaci
summary: Eolamaci is a clumsy rodent vigilante in a cardboard cape who chases a prankster thief across cartoon rooftops. Every heroic swing ends in a crash that somehow solves the case.

feats.scene: Eolamaci's rope swing slams into a billboard and shakes it loose.
Eolamaci flattens against a wall and peels off unharmed.
Eolamaci scampers down a drainpipe in a blur of cartoon dust.

name: Nalar
summary: Nalar is a masked decoy who borrows a famous hero's look to mislead a trusting sidekick. A quiet gift for sensing other minds keeps it one step ahead of every question.

feats.scene: Nalar throws a weighted smoke canister that bursts against a steel door.
Nalar is thrown against a brick wall and gets up smiling.
Nalar bolts across a roof to slip away from a pursuer.

name: Liste
summary: Liste is one of a crowd of identical brawlers grown in a vat by a bored god for sport. It is cheerful, mouthy and surprisingly hard to kill.

feats.scene: Liste swings a sword and shears a lamppost in half.
Liste regrows an arm after a blast takes it clean off.
Liste dashes across a parking lot ahead of a stampede.

name: Renrinen
summary: Renrinen is a gigantic winged beast stitched together by a mad scientist from two unrelated animals. It lumbers over a coastal town, shaking the rooftops with every wingbeat.

feats.scene: Renrinen tail-whips a lighthouse and snaps it at the base.
Renrinen is struck by a barrage of artillery shells and only snarls.
Renrinen dives over the harbour on leathery wings.

name: Nesci
summary: Nesci is an acrobatic thief who vaults over museum guards for fun and leaves a signature feather behind. Boasting is her real weakness.

feats.scene: Nesci lands a spinning kick that cracks a display case.
Nesci drops from a balcony onto marble and rolls up laughing.
Nesci sprints along a gallery balcony in pursuit of a loose jewel.

name: Aucoul
summary: Aucoul is the ghostly hound of a sorcerer, trotting at its master's heel and sniffing out hidden doors. It howls in silence when a nightmare creeps near.

feats.scene: Aucoul lunges and knocks a monster flat against a crypt wall.
Aucoul passes through a collapsing archway without a scratch.
Aucoul streaks down a moonlit lane as a pale shape.

name: Amria
summary: Amria is a spectral hound that senses when magic and machinery begin to blur and mourns the damage done. It fades from the world after a hopeless last stand beside its sorcerer.

feats.scene: Amria barks and a ripple of pale light topples a stone statue.
Amria stays standing in a burst of wild sorcery that shatters windows.
Amria bounds across a plaza in a ghostly flicker.

name: Rnilli
summary: Rnilli is a loyal phantom dog who follows a wizard through gaudy rooftop chases and keeps mistaking one stranger for another. It is brave, silly and impossible to scold.

feats.scene: Rnilli leaps and bowls a masked thug off a fire escape.
Rnilli passes through a falling sign as though it were smoke.
Rnilli darts across a rooftop faster than a greyhound.

name: Soramerno
summary: Soramerno is a sightless stag who works a desk job by day and patrols the farmland at night with sharpened antlers and uncanny hearing. The animal village treats it as a quiet legend.

feats.scene: Soramerno gores a barn door and splinters it.
Soramerno falls from a hayloft and trots off unhurt.
Soramerno bounds across a field by sound alone.

name: Sartumaun
summary: Sartumaun is a short-tempered brute who rams doors, gates and people with the crown of his armoured head. He joins a covert squad for one chaotic season.

feats.scene: Sartumaun charges and crushes a steel gate off its hinges.
Sartumaun takes a rifle volley on the forehead and laughs.
Sartumaun barrels down a street at full charge.

name: Teenia
summary: Teenia is a ranch boy turned frontline infantryman who carries his grandfather's worn rifle across a frozen peninsula. He is stubborn, homesick and a good shot.

feats.scene: Teenia fires a rifle round that drops a charging sentry at long range.
Teenia takes a hard fall into a frozen trench and walks on.
Teenia dashes between snowbanks under fire.

name: Martanmi
summary: Martanmi is an aging knight-father who watches his heir march toward a distant tournament of kingdoms. He carries a battered shield and a long list of unspoken regrets.

feats.scene: Martanmi cleaves a practice dummy and its wooden post in one stroke.
Martanmi takes a mace on the shield and does not budge.
Martanmi marches uphill in full armour without slowing.

name: Niser
summary: Niser is a small-time thief with a heavy axe who breaks into a vault for glowing ore and gives up the moment a better offer is made. Greed is a weakness it never hides.

feats.scene: Niser swings an axe into a vault door and dents it.
Niser takes a repulsor jolt on a padded vest and stays on his feet.
Niser bolts for the exit with a sack of ore.

name: Setiaru
summary: Setiaru is a lean, long-clawed hired killer who shows off his scars as trophies. He stalks rooftops on contract and hates being outshone.

feats.scene: Setiaru rakes his talons across a steel door and leaves four deep grooves.
Setiaru is thrown through a wooden wall and rises with a grin.
Setiaru bounds across a rooftop gap in a single stride.

name: Statarcil
summary: Statarcil is a rowdy naval officer who picks fights with anyone who insults the fleet. He swaggers across the deck with a bruised jaw and a medal he never explains.

feats.scene: Statarcil lands a heavy right hand that drops a rival cadet.
Statarcil gets knocked into a bulkhead and laughs it off.
Statarcil sprints down a gangway after a runaway cap.

name: Rnsumniu
summary: Rnsumniu is a washed-up stuntman hired onto a silly film set where a war reenactment gets out of hand. He wears a battered shield as a prop and means it.

feats.scene: Rnsumniu hurls a prop shield that shatters a camera tripod.
Rnsumniu falls off scaffolding and rolls up unhurt.
Rnsumniu runs the length of the set before the cue.

name: Turninto
summary: Turninto is a steppe warlord who leads a thundering horde across frozen rivers and burned plains. His campaigns leave trade roads open and cities silent.

feats.scene: Turninto splits a rider's shield and the saddle beneath with one sabre cut.
Turninto shrugs off an arrow glancing off his helm.
Turninto leads a charge at full gallop.

name: Ntiserco
summary: Ntiserco is a boastful wine merchant who loses a drinking contest to a quiet traveller and never forgets it. He tells the story in every tavern for decades.

feats.scene: Ntiserco slams a tankard on a table hard enough to crack the oak.
Ntiserco tumbles off a stool and keeps singing.
Ntiserco hurries after a barrel rolling down the lane.

name: Cintiont
summary: Cintiont is an engineered servant grown in a laboratory by two ambitious scholars who tried to blend sorcery with biology. She is gentle, loyal and curious about the world beyond the lab.

feats.scene: Cintiont lifts and throws a laboratory cabinet across the room.
Cintiont walks out of a collapsing lab with scorches and no wounds.
Cintiont races down a long corridor ahead of the flames.

name: Oralesse
summary: Oralesse is a night guard at a broadcasting studio who chases a fleeing burglar and shouts for help from any passing hero. He is nervous, honest and always on his shift.

feats.scene: Oralesse swings a flashlight and cracks a display monitor.
Oralesse is shoved into a doorframe and shakes it off.
Oralesse jogs down a hallway after a thief.

name: Sororsan
summary: Sororsan is a cruel young girl shaped by a twisted doctor's conditioning into believing she is his family. She breaks free of the spell only after losing a fight.

feats.scene: Sororsan stabs a scalpel into a wooden table up to the hilt.
Sororsan is flung across a cellar and slides to a stop.
Sororsan darts through a crowd of lab assistants.

name: Sosvalcen
summary: Sosvalcen is a soft inflatable nurse-robot who finds himself stranded in a simulated city and befriends a lonely cleanup machine. His gentle hugs mend injuries.

feats.scene: Sosvalcen throws a rocket-powered punch that lifts a parked car.
Sosvalcen bounces off a falling girder and re-inflates without a dent.
Sosvalcen rockets across a simulated skyline.

name: Tartumtil
summary: Tartumtil is a patient care-robot built by a grieving young inventor and left to wander on in his memory. It keeps asking whether anyone is hurt.

feats.scene: Tartumtil swings a padded fist and knocks a vending machine off its feet.
Tartumtil absorbs a thrown boulder and puffs back to shape.
Tartumtil jets across a harbor on small thrusters.

name: Reiumllo
summary: Reiumllo is a sleepy robot who counts imaginary sheep until a glitch turns one of them red and hostile. It begins deleting everything it judges to be clutter.

feats.scene: Reiumllo slaps a drifting sheep-shaped hologram and shatters it.
Reiumllo shrugs off a stampede of rendered sheep.
Reiumllo glides over the dream meadow on tiny thrusters.

name: Iumvalam
summary: Iumvalam is a warped, cracked-glass reflection of a friendly healer-bot, mirroring its hugs with grabs. It is drawn to shiny surfaces and clings to them.

feats.scene: Iumvalam squeezes a lamppost until the steel buckles.
Iumvalam walks through a hail of glass shards and re-forms.
Iumvalam skims across a mirrored floor.

name: Siaiulon
summary: Siaiulon is the chief healer aboard a drifting ark ship during a sudden alien raid, juggling wounded crew and a failing power grid. Calm hands and long hours keep him going.

feats.scene: Siaiulon slams a med-cart into a hatch to jam it shut.
Siaiulon is thrown into a bulkhead by a pressure surge and gets back up.
Siaiulon sprints down a corridor to reach the injured.

name: Nieos
summary: Nieos is a primal archetype from an older cosmos, a template for every hero and villain to come. Its presence rewrites the shape of nearby stories.

feats.scene: Nieos unfolds a new pattern of destiny and a distant galaxy takes on its shape.
Nieos stands unmoved as an entire collapsing cosmos folds around it.
Nieos arrives in the next age of creation faster than light.

name: Tiutiuri
summary: Tiutiuri is a retired stage actress adored by an obsessive fan who watches her old reruns on a loop. She is amused, flattered and slightly alarmed.

feats.scene: Tiutiuri swats a cushion across a room with a flick of her wrist.
Tiutiuri takes a stumble on the stage steps and carries on the line.
Tiutiuri hurries across the lobby to greet a guest.

name: Cocior
summary: Cocior is a friendly bartender who mixes fruit drinks at a seaside tiki lounge frequented by a nervous gangster. He keeps a tire iron under the bar for trouble.

feats.scene: Cocior swings a bar stool and shatters a bottle shelf.
Cocior is slammed against the bar and shrugs it off.
Cocior vaults the bar to stop a brawl.

name: Rumnia
summary: Rumnia is a dignified household butler who serves a powerful couple in a tall penthouse and quietly points a trespasser toward a hostage. Loyalty is a private matter.

feats.scene: Rumnia hurls a silver tray that dents a wall panel.
Rumnia takes a shove down a staircase and straightens his coat.
Rumnia hastens to open the door before the second knock.

name: Entas
summary: Entas is an infant, pastel-coloured fighter in a swaddled uniform created to replace a faded team of cartoon heroes. It squeaks while throwing punches.

feats.scene: Entas bonks a bigger opponent and sends him tumbling.
Entas bounces off a wall and giggles.
Entas crawls at startling speed across a playroom floor.

name: Rivamon
summary: Rivamon is a beak-nosed gang boss who plans one big bank job after another and changes tactics when the police get close. His crew trusts him until a bad payday.

feats.scene: Rivamon smashes a teller window with a crowbar.
Rivamon shrugs off a pistol-whip from a guard.
Rivamon sprints to a waiting getaway car.

name: Eoaulsor
summary: Eoaulsor is a heavyset biker chief who leads a rowdy club and ends one night in handcuffs after a brawl with a masked vigilante. He still thinks he won.

feats.scene: Eoaulsor smashes a chair across a rival's back.
Eoaulsor takes a bottle to the head and keeps swinging.
Eoaulsor lumbers after a fleeing opponent.

name: Anaun
summary: Anaun is a smuggling boss who moves contraband over a cold border and survives a political collapse by trading favours with dangerous partners. He never carries a weapon himself.

feats.scene: Anaun pounds a table to silence a room of couriers.
Anaun stumbles out of a car crash with a split lip.
Anaun hurries toward a waiting truck.

name: Seoneo
summary: Seoneo is a small-time villain with a boar's snout and a bear's temper who tries to climb the ranks of a crooked troupe. His first big act ends in a spectacular flop.

feats.scene: Seoneo rams a brick wall and cracks it.
Seoneo falls from a lamp post and lands on his feet.
Seoneo charges down an alley.

name: Tiaamaaun
summary: Tiaamaaun is one of a flock of bearded duplicates spawned by a bored deity, wearing its whiskers as armour. It is loud, loyal to its own and oddly hardy.

feats.scene: Tiaamaaun swings a sword and cleaves a heavy table.
Tiaamaaun regrows a lost hand with a wet squelch.
Tiaamaaun runs down a hallway with a war cry.

name: Usstoeo
summary: Usstoeo is a lab-raised hound whose mother was altered by a hidden people, granting her a long life and a sharp mind. She guards a royal garden with solemn loyalty.

feats.scene: Usstoeo leaps and knocks an intruder across a lawn.
Usstoeo endures a heavy blow and resumes her post.
Usstoeo races across the garden in a streak.

name: Anisesam
summary: Anisesam is a punk-styled mutant who joins a ragtag band of misfits modelled on legendary heroes. He is shy, blue-furred and good with a skateboard.

feats.scene: Anisesam swings from a pipe and kicks a door off its hinges.
Anisesam bounces off a dumpster and grins.
Anisesam skates down a hill at breakneck speed.

name: Staias
summary: Staias is a condemned prisoner drafted into a secret strike team with hundreds of other inmates, trading a sentence for dirty missions. He is blue-furred, sullen and good at climbing.

feats.scene: Staias rips a cell door from its frame.
Staias takes a rifle butt to the jaw and keeps climbing.
Staias bounds across a prison yard.

name: Uliti
summary: Uliti is a mind-controlled arena fighter in a far future ruled by a monstrous empire, forced to duel for the crowd's amusement. He slowly remembers a free life.

feats.scene: Uliti drives a blunt spear through an armoured opponent.
Uliti is slammed into the arena wall and rises.
Uliti rushes across the sand toward a rival.

name: Leeome
summary: Leeome is a wealthy young man who dreams of heroism and passes a strange society's trial to earn a mask. His courage outruns his skill.

feats.scene: Leeome swings a staff and cracks a training dummy.
Leeome takes a fall during the trial and gets up.
Leeome dashes across an obstacle course.

name: Osenenco
summary: Osenenco is a restless dreamer from a distant world who slips into a human's sleep to trade bodies for an adventure. The swap turns out to be harder to reverse than it was to start.

feats.scene: Osenenco releases a burst of dream-force that topples a bedroom wall.
Osenenco shrugs off a falling ceiling in dream form.
Osenenco drifts across a sleeping city.

name: Leosersi
summary: Leosersi is a wordy mutant of a parody team, famous for smelly feet and long speeches. He brags before every battle and flees after every second punch.

feats.scene: Leosersi hurls a boot that cracks a window.
Leosersi bounces off a brick wall mid-speech.
Leosersi leaps across a rooftop.

name: Nesve
summary: Nesve is a parody villain on a rival team of mock heroes, a lesser copy of a famous brute who still manages to start a brawl. He frowns at his own reflection.

feats.scene: Nesve punches a prop wall and leaves a hole.
Nesve is thrown through a cardboard set and stands up.
Nesve lumbers across a stage.

name: Osurirull
summary: Osurirull is a parody mutant of a comedy team, long believed lost in an absurd accident. His friends keep forgetting to look for him.

feats.scene: Osurirull swats a falling prop away.
Osurirull survives a cartoon explosion with a soot-black face.
Osurirull runs offstage at the first sign of trouble.

name: Ornia
summary: Ornia is a doleful costumed boy who leads a gloomy band of misfits and is mistaken for a rival crew. He mutters about it for days.

feats.scene: Ornia swings a prop sword and splinters a chair.
Ornia is knocked flat and mutters something sarcastic.
Ornia trudges and then sprints through a hallway.

name: Orsorst
summary: Orsorst is a clumsy mechanical beast built by a showman and later seized by a young mutant. Its jaws clamp on anything shiny.

feats.scene: Orsorst bites down on a steel beam and bends it.
Orsorst takes a cannon shot to the chassis and clanks on.
Orsorst trundles across a hall on clanking legs.

name: Orrnliu
summary: Orrnliu is a widow who stares from her father's balcony on a remote island, refusing to believe her husband will not return. Superstition and sorrow keep her company.

feats.scene: Orrnliu slams a shutter against the sea wind.
Orrnliu keeps her footing in a gust that rattles the balcony.
Orrnliu hurries to the shore at the sight of a sail.

name: Tuiarnt
summary: Tuiarnt is a ruthless mercenary who joins a band of criminals and gets noticed by the law for her bloody methods. Her origins are a rumour even she repeats differently each time.

feats.scene: Tuiarnt drives a blade through a plate of armour.
Tuiarnt gets thrown through a door and fights on.
Tuiarnt closes the distance to a target in a heartbeat.

name: Corri
summary: Corri is a thug in a gang of green-masked bruisers celebrating a crime at a roadside hotel until the wrong person walks in. His night ends badly.

feats.scene: Corri smashes a bottle over a table.
Corri takes a hard punch and spits blood.
Corri scrambles out of a chair when trouble arrives.

name: Leoamsau
summary: Leoamsau is a deputy lawman of a small frontier town who distrusts every stranger and is baffled by a strange family of visitors. He wants them gone by sundown.

feats.scene: Leoamsau fires a rifle shot that splinters a hitching post.
Leoamsau tumbles off a porch and tips his hat.
Leoamsau strides to the street to block the strangers.

name: Telauell
summary: Telauell is a gentle sewer dweller who comforts outcasts living beneath the city and confronts curious young intruders. Her calm voice hides a quiet strength.

feats.scene: Telauell wrenches a rusted gate open.
Telauell takes a fall onto stone and gets up.
Telauell hurries through a tunnel.

name: Semis
summary: Semis is a nervous beaver-like creature in a house of fright, undone by a ghost of cancelled shows. It chatters its teeth as the axe swings.

feats.scene: Semis chomps a wooden beam and it cracks.
Semis bounces off a haunted wall in a cartoon splat.
Semis paddles frantically through a flooded hall.

name: Stuania
summary: Stuania is a determined woman who enlists a former partner to find her missing father and follows the trail into the sewers beneath a church. She is stubborn and observant.

feats.scene: Stuania breaks a rusted padlock with a pipe.
Stuania slips on a wet stair and catches herself.
Stuania runs down a tunnel after a sound.

name: Ernnurn
summary: Ernnurn is a wild-born mutate from a lost jungle valley whose mother once captured a clever scientist. She is fierce and watchful, wary of outsiders.

feats.scene: Ernnurn tears a tree limb free and hurls it.
Ernnurn walks through a thicket of thorns unscratched.
Ernnurn bounds along a jungle trail.

name: Metia
summary: Metia is an engineering doctor who builds web-launching gauntlets and wears them to costume parties. She puts them to real use when a street fight breaks out.

feats.scene: Metia fires a web line that yanks a thief off his feet.
Metia lands hard on pavement and rolls up.
Metia swings between lampposts on a web line.

name: Tuter
summary: Tuter is a former assistant to a masked tyrant who leaves the organisation after marrying a fellow agent and raising three children. She keeps the old filing habits.

feats.scene: Tuter slams a filing cabinet shut.
Tuter trips on a toy and catches the counter.
Tuter hurries to catch the school bus.

name: Ansesle
summary: Ansesle is a small squirrel ally who watches a recorded message beside a friend and chitters in alarm. It bounds from branch to branch with acorn grenades.

feats.scene: Ansesle hurls an acorn that cracks a window.
Ansesle falls from a branch and lands with a tumble.
Ansesle scampers up a tree trunk.

name: Auteeos
summary: Auteeos is a mentally broken ruler of a dark realm where time flows in loops, a half-living presence dragged into a twisting limbo. It rants at its own echoes.

feats.scene: Auteeos lashes out with black tendrils that rip a tower in two.
Auteeos rebuilds itself after a blast scatters it across the sky.
Auteeos streaks across the sky in a smear of black.

name: Luceon
summary: Luceon is a sleepy duplicate from a crowd of grown copies, forever napping and picking fights from bed. It is surprisingly hard to wake and impossible to kill.

feats.scene: Luceon swings a pillow and topples a lamp.
Luceon regrows a lost limb while still dozing.
Luceon rolls out of bed and sprints for the door.

name: Serlaria
summary: Serlaria is a cartoon bee who gathers rival heroes and villains to stage a televised contest of short skits. It is playful, boundless and altogether too powerful.

feats.scene: Serlaria snaps its fingers and a whole planet rearranges into a stage set.
Serlaria hums through a blast that would fracture a world.
Serlaria buzzes between worlds in a blink.

name: Serlon
summary: Serlon is a tribal chief of a jungle people who find an ancient relic exposed by a blast at a metal mine. His folk start to fear what the bone is.

feats.scene: Serlon hurls a spear that pierces a hide shield.
Serlon takes a club to the ribs and stays upright.
Serlon sprints along a jungle trail.

name: Meove
summary: Meove is a small beeping helper-bot on a commander's ship that betrays its master to assist a young boy. It whistles when it is nervous.

feats.scene: Meove zaps a lock with a tiny arc and pops it open.
Meove is stomped on by a guard and rolls away dented.
Meove rolls down a corridor at its top speed.

name: Eoeosaun
summary: Eoeosaun is an armoured spy sent from a small kingdom to steal a sample of living alien goo from a corporation. His cover is blown by a loose tongue.

feats.scene: Eoeosaun slices through a vault lock with a wrist blade.
Eoeosaun is hit by a stun round and keeps running.
Eoeosaun glides across a rooftop on armoured wings.

name: Lescor
summary: Lescor is a petty criminal who buys a spare suit of winged armour and uses it clumsily on his first heist. He is nervous, greedy and a poor flyer.

feats.scene: Lescor fires an armoured gauntlet that dents a car door.
Lescor shrugs off a baton strike on his armour.
Lescor wobbles through the air in his armour.

name: Nitan
summary: Nitan is a mutant of a parody team who shifts her looks and senses emotions around her. She changes outfits mid-fight to confuse her enemies.

feats.scene: Nitan slaps a prop mace out of a rival's hand.
Nitan shrugs off a stage-fall in a cloud of confetti.
Nitan darts across a set between costume changes.

name: Moraur
summary: Moraur is a giant soldier of a war-torn alternate timeline, grown huge by a twisted experiment and ordered to flatten enemy lines. His lumbering stride cracks the road.

feats.scene: Moraur stamps a foot and flattens a row of barracks.
Moraur takes a barrage of artillery and keeps advancing.
Moraur strides across a field.

name: Neslum
summary: Neslum is a towering champion gathered by a captain to rescue a kidnapped child, with a boulder-breaking fist and a thick hide. He grumbles when the captain barks.

feats.scene: Neslum punches a fortress gate and breaks it inward.
Neslum absorbs a catapult stone and chuckles.
Neslum charges across a battlefield.

name: Neoval
summary: Neoval is a medieval village defender who learns a glowing-fist technique in the high mountains and uses it to turn back an invading army. His inner energy fires through his palms.

feats.scene: Neoval strikes with a glowing fist and a stone gatehouse falls.
Neoval withstands a rain of arrows and a cavalry charge.
Neoval dashes across a mountain trail.

name: Tulonsi
summary: Tulonsi is a sun-scorched king of a sandy realm who accepts a great gem torn from a giant's grasp by a pearl diver. Pride and fear of theft rule his court.

feats.scene: Tulonsi brings a heavy scimitar down through a wooden chest.
Tulonsi withstands a spear thrust across his ring-mail.
Tulonsi strides through his throne room.

name: Nosron
summary: Nosron is the timid son of a stern wizard, used as a lure to keep local boys from running away. He keeps a sad little lantern by his bed.

feats.scene: Nosron shoves a stool across a stone floor.
Nosron trips on a stair and catches himself.
Nosron runs from his father's tower.

name: Analval
summary: Analval is a regal member of an ancient race of deities, a hearth-god of the hills who is both patron and warrior. His fire flares at the sight of an oath-breaker.

feats.scene: Analval hurls a ball of fire that levels a forest hill.
Analval stands amid a firestorm and emerges untouched.
Analval leaps across a valley in a stride.

name: Amnileo
summary: Amnileo is a wizard who died in the flesh but lingers as a mist-formed wraith with a handful of spells. He haunts the ruins where his body fell.

feats.scene: Amnileo flings a bolt of ghost-light that topples a tower stair.
Amnileo passes unharmed through a rain of blades.
Amnileo drifts along a hallway as a pale mist.

name: Ntovelama
summary: Ntovelama is a demon-sorcerer who has flooded the world with his own infernal realm, bewildering travellers who stumble into the changed land. His rule is cruel and chatty.

feats.scene: Ntovelama lifts a hand and a city district folds into rubble.
Ntovelama shrugs off a mountain-splitting blast.
Ntovelama streaks across a burning sky.

name: Llitist
summary: Llitist is the relic skull of a long-dead sorcerer whose dark liquid, when drunk, teaches a thin sliver of demon magic. It is a prize in a bloody game.

feats.scene: Llitist releases a pulse of dark energy that splits a stone slab.
Llitist survives a boot stomp on a cavern floor without chipping.

name: Leluis
summary: Leluis is a fiend-lord who steals a small girl from her home and drags her into his burning domain. He is smug, cruel and a collector of souls.

feats.scene: Leluis calls down a fireball that blasts a ridge to slag.
Leluis stands unmoved in a rain of enchanted spears.
Leluis streaks over a lava field.

name: Rnuseo
summary: Rnuseo is the fiery lord of a shadow realm, to whom a young sorceress tells her minions to give regards. It laughs, wrongly sure that its subjects fear it.

feats.scene: Rnuseo hurls a bolt of black fire that melts a stone wall.
Rnuseo is struck by a falling pillar and remains upright.
Rnuseo glides over a pit of flames.

name: Leiseneo
summary: Leiseneo is a tyrannical sorcerer-lord who imprisons a young girl in a hellish dimension and laughs as a brother grieves over a body. His magic is old and cold.

feats.scene: Leiseneo summons a burst of infernal force that cracks a cliff.
Leiseneo is struck by a spear of light and brushes the ash away.
Leiseneo steps from one cavern wall to another.

name: Amviacos
summary: Amviacos is a dark god from another dimension, worshipped by cults that chant its name beneath ruined cathedrals. Its hunger for fear is endless.

feats.scene: Amviacos tears open the sky and a storm of hell-fire rains on a city.
Amviacos endures a barrage of missiles that flatten a block.
Amviacos rushes across the horizon.

name: Nesmi
summary: Nesmi is a fallen celestial who once walked an eternal garden before turning to rebellion and exile. It wields a flaming blade and a bitter memory.

feats.scene: Nesmi swings a flaming blade and a stone fortress splits down the middle.
Nesmi takes a holy lance in the chest and keeps fighting.
Nesmi dives from the sky on wings of flame.

name: Orvia
summary: Orvia is a grandfatherly sea-god, patriarch of a long line of heroes and troublemakers, who sits at the head of a long table by the shore. His tides obey his mood.

feats.scene: Orvia lifts a wave that swamps a harbour town.
Orvia stands against a surge of lightning and smiles.
Orvia rides a wave across the bay.

name: Lumroncos
summary: Lumroncos is a mind-reading mother of a hidden people who abandons her son when his transformation yields a lesser gift. She regrets it later, in silence.

feats.scene: Lumroncos pushes open a heavy gate.
Lumroncos recovers from a stumble on the palace steps.
Lumroncos hurries after a retreating servant.

name: Sanaunte
summary: Sanaunte is a guild thief from a river city in the late nineteenth century and the closest friend of a card-playing rogue. He is quick with a lockpick and a joke.

feats.scene: Sanaunte slams a crowbar into a locked strongbox.
Sanaunte drops from a balcony onto cobblestones and limps away.
Sanaunte sprints across a rooftop.

name: Corose
summary: Corose is a poised duelist-queen of a river-city syndicate of killers, raised among silk and poison. Corose was wed for politics, and later divorced for sport; the bargain left a sharp mind and a habit of hurling bright sparks from the palms.

feats.scene: Corose flung a fan of white sparks that split a cast-iron balcony rail in two.
Corose took a thrown chair across the ribs and kept walking.

name: Lerorve
summary: Lerorve, in this telling, is a married knife-dancer who trained from childhood in a hidden school of killers. Lerorve brokered a truce between two feuding clans, only to be cut down when a sibling sold the families out.

feats.scene: Lerorve spun through a three-step vault and drove a blade through a hanging lantern chain.
Lerorve absorbed a stun-rod strike before falling to the second volley.

name: Tarul
summary: Tarul is a blonde bayou assassin whose strength flows from a pact with a hidden patron. Tarul can fire pulses from the hands and pin a foe's talents with a glowing band, until the patron takes the gift back.

feats.scene: Tarul loosed a hand-pulse that blew a heavy oak door off its hinges.
Tarul stood through a point-blank slap of force that cracked the paving.

name: Resliaar
summary: Resliaar is a grey-haired lab scientist who studies how living tissue ages faster than the clock. Resliaar demonstrated the work before a hostile panel of peers, who called it a swindle.

feats.scene: Resliaar slammed a heavy lab door shut against a heckler.
Resliaar took a tumble down a rainy staircase and walked off bruised.

name: Elvemor
summary: Elvemor is a ruthless noblewoman of a tiny inner world who stretches her years by trading in stolen organs. Elvemor ends up swapping bodies with a servant and is finally killed by the very creature that sustained her.

feats.scene: Elvemor struck a servant across the cheek with a jeweled glove.
Elvemor survived centuries of decay by grafting on borrowed parts.

name: Sornita
summary: Sornita is a ship-mind that rides beside a time-hopping soldier and handles his hardest chores. Sornita gassed a swarm of beasts, then folded open a doorway as a bomb fell, sending a warning back before going dark.

feats.scene: Sornita opened a time-gate wide enough to push a man through as the sky burned.
Sornita stayed online through the first instants of a city-scale blast before failing.

name: Vellusa
summary: Vellusa is a court attendant of a long-dead queen, serving at her bedside through the last hours of her trial. Vellusa is a quiet bystander with no gift beyond loyalty and a steady nerve.

feats.scene: Vellusa hauled open a stiff chamber window for the dying monarch.
Vellusa waited out a cold night on stone floors without complaint.

name: Timane
summary: Timane is a ranch-owner's daughter newly arrived on the frontier by stagecoach. Timane gets snatched by a slaver and rescued by a masked rider, and leaves with a head full of romantic notions.

feats.scene: Timane reined a startled mare around a gully at full gallop.
Timane raced a borrowed horse across the dry flats ahead of pursuers.

name: Rircileo
summary: Rircileo is an anonymous hotel porter who delivers costumes to two guests and later throttles a stray bird in a park. Rircileo is no hero, just a grim background figure with ordinary arms.

feats.scene: Rircileo hauled a rolling luggage cart up a ramp at a run.
Rircileo shrugged off a door slammed on one shoulder.

name: Tuamnis
summary: Tuamnis is a northern-born palace sentry who guards a tyrant's chambers. Tuamnis is knocked cold by an intruder who refuses to kill, then murdered by a rebel who has no such scruple.

feats.scene: Tuamnis brought a heavy spear-butt down on an intruder's shield.
Tuamnis dropped under a single hard blow to the jaw and stayed down.

name: Serrocos
summary: Serrocos is a young defender of a far planet, changed by radiation from the sky at the request of a distant patriarch. Serrocos joined a squad built to meet a visiting crew, and ended up speaking peace instead of fighting.

feats.scene: Serrocos pinned a visiting ship's hull with a burst that left it spinning.
Serrocos stood against a combined rush from four strangers without falling.

name: Ulitasnes
summary: Ulitasnes is a boulder-skinned brawler from a spoof universe, grumpy and kind in equal measure. Ulitasnes lost his armor in one fight, revealing a thin human beneath the grit.

feats.scene: Ulitasnes flattened a parked truck with one overhand slap.
Ulitasnes shrugged off a shop-front collapse that cracked a few outer plates.

name: Liatianiu
summary: Liatianiu is a stony-skinned wanderer glimpsed on a crowded street, one among many changed folk. Liatianiu does little except walk, stare, and be walked around.

feats.scene: Liatianiu shouldered through a turnstile and bent the bar.
Liatianiu took a delivery van's bumper at walking pace and kept going.

name: Ausnele
summary: Ausnele is a heavy-boned mutate with a stone-like hide and a loud laugh. Ausnele was drinking at a hero hangout when a bomber blew the room up, and walked away mostly annoyed.

feats.scene: Ausnele heaved a bar counter across the room onto two thugs.
Ausnele sat through a bar-wide explosion and brushed off the dust.

name: Riast
summary: Riast is a deckhand who sailed under a hard captain before the crew went feral. Riast slipped away from a brutal assault but was eventually run down by a former shipmate.

feats.scene: Riast swung a cutlass through a rope and dropped a rigging net.
Riast took a cutlass slash across the arm and kept rowing.

name: Tiasaure
summary: Tiasaure is an aging lawman of a desert town who once cuffed a famous young outlaw. Tiasaure carries a tin star and a slow temper, and little else.

feats.scene: Tiasaure pistol-whipped a drunk who had pulled a knife.
Tiasaure took a saloon-stool across the back and still made the arrest.

name: Tavaaus
summary: Tavaaus is a lab researcher who works alongside a shrinking-scientist colleague. Tavaaus is seized with the rest of the staff by an alien warlord and spends the story in a cell.

feats.scene: Tavaaus lifted a crate of glassware onto a rolling cart.
Tavaaus lasted days in a cold cell without breaking.

name: Iumau
summary: Iumau is a grail-obsessed author who is touched by the spirit of an old warrior knight after a tragedy by the sea. Iumau joins a secret war against a dark brood, gaining notable strength before falling in battle.

feats.scene: Iumau brought down a sword-swing that split a stone altar slab.
Iumau stood through a volley of arrows as the spirit's gift flared.

name: Riavaern
summary: Riavaern is the grey manager of a power plant during a reactor breach. Riavaern is devoured at home by a flying brute and rises as a shambling ghoul.

feats.scene: Riavaern clawed through a kitchen door on stiff arms.
Riavaern lumbered on after a fall from a porch roof.

name: Ausamria
summary: Ausamria is a small-town man with a famous sister and a famous brother-in-law, and no powers of his own. Ausamria keeps to quiet streets in a southern town.

feats.scene: Ausamria carried groceries up three porch steps.
Ausamria slipped on wet leaves and got up laughing.

name: Taseraus
summary: Taseraus is a young infantryman of a long-ago civil war, killed in his brother's arms. Taseraus appears only for a last moment and a final breath.

feats.scene: Taseraus fired a musket volley into the treeline.
Taseraus stayed on his feet after a grazing shot to the side.

name: Valneeo
summary: Valneeo is a city police detective and old friend of a masked gun-for-hire. Valneeo works the beat, collects tips, and keeps a notebook full of dead ends.

feats.scene: Valneeo put a service round through a parked car's tire.
Valneeo took a thrown bottle to the shoulder and cuffed the suspect.

name: Voson
summary: Voson is a prospective buyer of a haunted-looking mansion that a salesman tries to unload. Voson appears only in conversation, never on the page.

feats.scene: Voson signed a purchase offer with a hard stroke of the pen.
Voson waited out a long afternoon of haggling.

name: Tiatiulia
summary: Tiatiulia is a street-level mutant who befriends a fellow outcast in a midwest city. Tiatiulia is gunned down by a mob in a flashback, leaving a friend to carry the memory.

feats.scene: Tiatiulia shoved a stalled cart off the road to clear an alley.
Tiatiulia absorbed a pipe-swing to the back before the final volley.

name: Naeolso
summary: Naeolso is a hairless stargazer-being who sits among a council of cosmic watchers and interrupts a crude tale. Naeolso carries the weight of an ancient observer, with powers far beyond any world.

feats.scene: Naeolso shut a rival tale down with a wave of pure will that rippled a continent of stars.
Naeolso withstood the collapse of a small sun without blinking.

name: Seriarli
summary: Seriarli is a young woman raised by stage magicians who turned a famous vanishing trick into a real gift. Seriarli now blinks in and out of sight, with cybernetic parts and yellow eyes.

feats.scene: Seriarli vanished from a rooftop and reappeared behind a guard to strike him.
Seriarli stood through a stun blast thanks to her implants.

name: Amamaur
summary: Amamaur is a grey-haired cloister keeper who guards a hidden boy in a mountain fortress. Amamaur is shot by a raider while a pair of runners slip away.

feats.scene: Amamaur bolted a heavy oak door against a raiding party.
Amamaur stood still as a firearm round struck his chest.

name: Villau
summary: Villau is a built-for-service robot enforcer who leads a squad of metal bodyguards. Villau sports cyber-tentacles and red eyes, and marches out of a hidden base to face heroes.

feats.scene: Villau lashed out with cable-limbs and tore the hood off a parked sedan.
Villau took a point-blank slam that dented the chassis but kept him standing.

name: Vosneta
summary: Vosneta is a famous turncoat general whose body is later hijacked by a time-travelling spy. Vosneta is a name that became shorthand for betrayal, though the man inside was a frightened stranger.

feats.scene: Vosneta drove a saber through a wooden palisade door.
Vosneta survived a musket ball to the leg and kept command.

name: Sessan
summary: Sessan is a drug dealer who hides his product inside fish at a market stall. Sessan runs a fish stand with a dishonest side, and is clipped by a lawsuit.

feats.scene: Sessan slammed a crate of ice-packed fish onto a counter.
Sessan took a shove into a cold display case and shrugged.

name: Sorauneo
summary: Sorauneo is a shipping-company director with a moustache and an eye on safety, warning a pair of visitors about a dangerous tanker. Sorauneo has no powers at all.

feats.scene: Sorauneo pointed at a map and slapped the table.
Sorauneo stood through an hours-long storm on the open deck.

name: Lliva
summary: Lliva is a TV pundit, writer and millionaire who secretly funds a radical group of zealots. Lliva leaps from a rooftop when cornered and is caught, then bargains for his skin.

feats.scene: Lliva threw a champagne glass at a chasing agent.
Lliva landed hard after a jump and lived to talk.

name: Vervorcal
summary: Vervorcal is a bald strongman politician of a long-gone regime, joined with other tyrants in a short-lived pact. Vervorcal is betrayed and presumably slain by his own ally.

feats.scene: Vervorcal pounded a balcony rail while barking a speech.
Vervorcal was struck down by a trusted ally.

name: Seterser
summary: Seterser is a wartime prime minister who appears only in talk between two young soldiers. Seterser is a distant name and a headline, nothing more.

feats.scene: Seterser thumped a lectern during a long radio address.
Seterser rode out a day of marching in a parade.

name: Veoorces
summary: Veoorces is a boy soldier turned test subject who becomes a grey, horned bruiser with hooves. Veoorces fled to a big city and joined a squad of teenage heroes, using his strength to protect strangers.

feats.scene: Veoorces smashed a roadside tree in half with a single punch.
Veoorces took a gunshot volley across the chest and kept charging.

name: Cealu
summary: Cealu is a boy turned into a horned, hoofed bruiser by a dream-lord who feeds on childhood fears. Cealu later joins a monster-hunting squad, hoping a mystic will restore his old shape.

feats.scene: Cealu threw a parked motorcycle across a gravel lot.
Cealu tanked a spray of dart-gun fire and a flung lamp-post.

name: Mienve
summary: Mienve is a young bull-shaped teen made so by drug-lords' experiments, now a member of a rebuilding squad. Mienve resists blasts of sound and missile fire with a little discomfort.

feats.scene: Mienve punched a tree trunk apart in a single swing.
Mienve stood through a sonic wail and rocket burst with only a wince.

name: Luterama
summary: Luterama is a black bull kept as a pet by a rich teenage fan of monsters. Luterama is a farm animal with a farm animal's strength and temper.

feats.scene: Luterama charged through a wooden fence at a trot.
Luterama stood unmoved as a hay bale bounced off his flank.

name: Rinnia
summary: Rinnia is a ten-year office worker of a science-terror outfit who tipped off the authorities about a planned attack. Rinnia is widowed when the real leak turns out to be his own spouse.

feats.scene: Rinnia carried a case of files across a parking lot.
Rinnia endured a night in a safehouse under armed guard.

name: Renmaron
summary: Renmaron is a small boy remade by his captors into a reality-bending prodigy like his own father. Renmaron ran away, harmed other children, and attacked a parent before being overpowered and spared.

feats.scene: Renmaron rewrote a whole apartment block into foam with a tantrum.
Renmaron was knocked out with ease by a veteran hero.

name: Tustlor
summary: Tustlor is the grown son of an obscure hero who gains the power to seize any mind within sight. Tustlor builds an army and a death-cult, then dies by a snapped neck.

feats.scene: Tustlor forced a crowd of thousands to march by sight alone.
Tustlor was dropped by a single strike to the neck.

name: Vellieo
summary: Vellieo is a grey electronics shop owner who hires a famous engineer to scrap broken devices for parts. Vellieo has a counter, a till, and a friendly nod.

feats.scene: Vellieo lifted a boxed monitor onto the shelf.
Vellieo stood through a long Saturday behind the register.

name: Netull
summary: Netull is the only townsman to stand up to a bandit gang, getting run down for it. Netull is later offered the sheriff's badge and trusts a ghost-rider about as far as a rope.

feats.scene: Netull raised his rifle and fired a warning shot over the bandits.
Netull was trampled by a horse and still got to his feet.

name: Cetelon
summary: Cetelon is a young shape-shifting mutant who defends a president's inauguration. Cetelon has variable looks, a soft crush on a giant robot, and a nervous grin.

feats.scene: Cetelon shoved an assassin's arm aside as a shot rang out.
Cetelon took a baton blow to the ribs during the riot.

name: Tiaontnan
summary: Tiaontnan is a long-dead inventor who now tinkers on in a hall of the departed. Tiaontnan keeps running experiments where lightning, kites and keys still have meaning.

feats.scene: Tiaontnan touched a brass key to a charged jar and sparked a small bolt.
Tiaontnan lasted a long age of tinkering in the hall.

name: Terlumle
summary: Terlumle is a young scholar and tinkerer mentioned in passing by a thunder-god who claims to have given him a lesson. Terlumle is remembered only as a name in a boast.

feats.scene: Terlumle pulled a kite string tight in a gust.
Terlumle walked home through a cold storm.

name: Teslo
summary: Teslo is a founding-era statesman who becomes first head of a young republic in a dream-world imagined by a boy tyrant. Teslo has no powers, just a pen and a stern look.

feats.scene: Teslo pounded a gavel for order in a loud hall.
Teslo sat through a long winter session with no complaint.

name: Tarcoor
summary: Tarcoor is a ghostly scientist and writer at a roast of a mouthy mercenary. Tarcoor offers the one good thing the guest of honor ever did, and takes a bow.

feats.scene: Tarcoor raised a glass and swung it down on a table.
Tarcoor floated through a heckler's thrown tomato untouched.

name: Naeolaus
summary: Naeolaus is a shape-copying invader who murders a space crew and wears their faces to prepare a conquest. Naeolaus is exposed by a masked tyrant, frozen solid, and smashed to pieces.

feats.scene: Naeolaus punched through a steel hangar door in a human mask.
Naeolaus cracked apart when a freezing blast met a hammer blow.

name: Tilll
summary: Tilll is a drilled machine-double built as a sparring dummy for a warlord's troops. Tilll is wrecked during a training run by soldiers of the regime.

feats.scene: Tilll swung a metal fist through a wooden target post.
Tilll took a rifle volley and a grenade before breaking apart.

name: Sertol
summary: Sertol is a boulder-skinned giant who hates his own reflection. Sertol storms through a friend's studio in a fit of pity and smashes every statue, then slinks away and cannot go back.

feats.scene: Sertol crushed a marble figure into gravel with one open hand.
Sertol walked through a brick wall and shook off the dust.

name: Cenntnia
summary: Cenntnia is a divorced pilot with a court order to stay far from his ex. Cenntnia can switch into a bulky stone-hide shape at will but seldom does, so neighbors never know.

feats.scene: Cenntnia lifted a stalled sedan's bumper one-handed while in his hard shape.
Cenntnia took a patrol-car door to the shoulder and shrugged.

name: Ircalnto
summary: Ircalnto is a ship's captain in an age of sail, changed by a strange light into a craggy giant. Ircalnto spent years bashing a dungeon wall until it cracked, and later helped free his shipmates.

feats.scene: Ircalnto battered a cell wall for years until a hairline crack ran the full height.
Ircalnto crashed through a cannon-fire line and took no wound.

name: Ntiulve
summary: Ntiulve is a pilot turned stone-skinned giant who lost his mind to the change and rampaged through a crowded city. Ntiulve was restored to a calmer shape by a trio of scientists.

feats.scene: Ntiulve flipped a city bus end-over-end in a panicked rampage.
Ntiulve took a tank shell during the rampage and kept going.

name: Incen
summary: Incen is a team bruiser who is tricked and locked up by a rival band of heroes. Incen never gets to explain the mix-up before the cell door shuts.

feats.scene: Incen put a fist through a reinforced door during the scuffle.
Incen absorbed a volley of blasts before the shackles closed.

name: Amicoen
summary: Amicoen is a boulder-hided hero who makes a last stand with his team against mechanical hunters. Amicoen is cut down in the end, but not before breaking a dozen of them.

feats.scene: Amicoen hurled a collapsing wall section onto a squad of hunters.
Amicoen held a doorway under a barrage that levelled the lobby.

name: Olnes
summary: Olnes is a college-trained pilot in a world run by a tyrant, and never changed by any ray. Olnes flies jets and keeps his head down.

feats.scene: Olnes yanked a stuck throttle lever with both hands.
Olnes withstood several hard turns in a training jet.

name: Iutumti
summary: Iutumti is a stone-hided team veteran who succumbs to a plague that came from a failed cure. Iutumti lives long enough to see the neighborhood go quiet.

feats.scene: Iutumti cracked a stone bench in frustration.
Iutumti held out for days against a fever that felled stronger folk.

name: Leome
summary: Leome is a time-lost hero who steps out of a cold dimension into a future city with no memory of how long he has been gone. Leome has big strength, stamina, and a tough hide.

feats.scene: Leome flung a rolled-up steel girder across a freeway.
Leome walked out of a collapsing portal unscathed.

name: Vituren
summary: Vituren is a cyborg-armored veteran of a five-person team, married once and now divorced with twin children. Vituren once healed briefly under a borrowed surge of cosmic might before the surge faded.

feats.scene: Vituren pounded a robot's chest until the plating buckled.
Vituren lived through a blast that opened up half his side.

name: Rauiarn
summary: Rauiarn is a stone-hided giant who stays behind in a quiet little town, and is spared the death that took his friends. Rauiarn has big muscle, a thick hide, and a settled life.

feats.scene: Rauiarn lifted a farm tractor out of a ditch.
Rauiarn sat unharmed in a shed that fell in on him.

name: Veniu
summary: Veniu is a pizza-shop worker, married with a young daughter, in a gentle neighborhood. Veniu has no powers.

feats.scene: Veniu slid a heavy tray of dough into the oven.
Veniu put in a double shift on a hot kitchen floor.

name: Esttiari
summary: Esttiari is a craggy team member who is killed by a teammate gone sour. Esttiari carries great strength and a tough hide, but not enough to survive betrayal.

feats.scene: Esttiari punched a stone column into rubble.
Esttiari took a point-blank beam before he fell.

name: Tenvane
summary: Tenvane is a prisoner of a world that jails anyone with gifts. Tenvane has a boulder hide and big strength, and is freed by a band of dimension-hoppers.

feats.scene: Tenvane bent a cell bar with both hands during a breakout.
Tenvane took a guard's stun-baton across the shoulders and snarled.

name: Stucemo
summary: Stucemo is a boulder-skinned hero whose remains rest in a memorial park, long after the age of heroes has gone. Stucemo is a headstone and a name, nothing else.

feats.scene: Stucemo tore a mailbox off its post in his prime.
Stucemo stood through a long career of brawls and bruises.

name: Veotete
summary: Veotete is a young pilot in a lab experiment on a moon base that went wrong, scattering the staff and shaking loose a billion tons of lunar crust. Veotete can raise limbs and armor made of nearby stone and steel.

feats.scene: Veotete raised a tower-sized fist of rubble and flattened a suspended vault.
Veotete stood in the experiment's core as the hall melted around him.

name: Soriuman
summary: Soriuman is a boulder-hided hero who joins a doomed plot against a tyrant god. Soriuman is cut down together with the rest of the rebels.

feats.scene: Soriuman punched a wall of ice into slush.
Soriuman took a lightning bolt on the chest before he fell.

name: Senetes
summary: Senetes is a craggy fighter in a promotional tale who helps stop a robot that drinks energy to grow. Senetes watches as the robot's probe tries to feed on a silver visitor and fails.

feats.scene: Senetes hurled a bus-sized chunk of road at the growing robot.
Senetes took a clanking slam from the machine's arm and laughed.

name: Ullenleo
summary: Ullenleo is a stone-bodied adventurer on a five-person team, killed by a sun-powered conqueror who wants the whole planet. Ullenleo fought hard and fell hard.

feats.scene: Ullenleo body-slammed a charging brute into a brick wall.
Ullenleo was struck down by a single heat-beam.

name: Viaci
summary: Viaci is a stone-skinned giant freed from a gladiator arena when a power failure shuts the cells. Viaci fought many foes in the games and joins a resistance after a fallen herald crashes in.

feats.scene: Viaci wrenched a steel arena gate off its track.
Viaci stood through a pummelling from three rivals in a row.

name: Lussarsta
summary: Lussarsta is a pilot on a doomed space mission, struck by rays and then by meteors. Lussarsta is killed with nearly all his crew, with one sole survivor to tell it.

feats.scene: Lussarsta braced a hatch shut against a decompression gale.
Lussarsta held on through a meteor shower before the hull gave out.

name: Tiuria
summary: Tiuria is a craggy giant whose life follows a familiar path until a family member is lost. Tiuria fights on through grief, relying on muscle and a stone-hard hide.

feats.scene: Tiuria smashed a van off a bridge in a fit of rage.
Tiuria stood through a long fight with a shrug and a scowl.

name: Tiuserll
summary: Tiuserll is a space-station crew member changed by a radiation burst into a boulder-hided giant. Tiuserll lumbers through the first days of his new life with wary good humor.

feats.scene: Tiuserll crushed a steel cup in one palm while testing his grip.
Tiuserll took an airlock slam and barely noticed.

name: Nelutel
summary: Nelutel is a paranoid hero in a mirror-world dreamscape where a fascist state hunts spies. Nelutel is shattered by a rival's cube and the whole illusion collapses.

feats.scene: Nelutel punched through a heavy fire door in a raid.
Nelutel was cracked apart by a single hard blow from the cube.

name: Nteolvor
summary: Nteolvor is a boulder-hided adventurer who turns up in a charity crossover and a team-up with a youth squad. Nteolvor is known by silly nicknames and a gruff kindness.

feats.scene: Nteolvor lifted a crate of donations one-handed onto a truck.
Nteolvor took a thrown trash bin to the head and just laughed.

name: Roornen
summary: Roornen is a pilot who lost his stone form and now leads a rebel cell in a city under heel. Roornen meets a future double who tries to alter the past, and learns what the cost would be.

feats.scene: Roornen took a stand with a pistol in a dark stairwell.
Roornen took a thrown chair across the back and kept leading.

name: Rnielirno
summary: Rnielirno is a mutated ape on a banana-flavored version of a team of explorers. Rnielirno joins a meeting with a visitor from another dimension and does the usual team-bruiser things.

feats.scene: Rnielirno ripped a lamp-post out of the pavement and waved it around.
Rnielirno took a tumble through a plate-glass window and kept grinning.

name: Neellle
summary: Neellle is a team bruiser rounded up with other fighters and sent to a mind-reformer for rehabilitation. Neellle rolls with the punches and waits for a rescue.

feats.scene: Neellle pushed a cell door half off its hinges.
Neellle took a stun volley and sagged to one knee.

name: Lesnen
summary: Lesnen is a pilot who catches a deadly virus and sets out alone for a cure, crashing in a cave while still mutating. Lesnen bursts in a flare of energy, expels the radiation, and cures a loved one's blindness before leaving to marry her.
