feats.scene: Lesnen detonated in a blaze that levelled the cavern and burned away the radiation.
Lesnen took a sky-cycle crash and kept mutating.

name: Riasteol
summary: Riasteol is a boulder-hided uncle who takes his young nephew to a circus, then hands him to a kindly neighbor before heading out on a mission. Riasteol is back to find the pair at home, the mission already done.

feats.scene: Riasteol hoisted a child onto a bleacher seat with one finger.
Riasteol sat on a bleacher that groaned and held.

name: Siutitas
summary: Siutitas is a boulder-hided hero called together for a revenge raid on a death-bringer. Siutitas falls to a ruthless heir of a villain family.

feats.scene: Siutitas swung a cracked pillar into a trooper line.
Siutitas took a ray blast at close range before he fell.

name: Cooltus
summary: Cooltus is a gold-skinned mutation, one of many fighters turned by a plague into a metallic servant. Cooltus stomps in lockstep with the others, shiny and silent.

feats.scene: Cooltus punched a hole through a thin steel plate.
Cooltus took a cannon hit and merely dented.

name: Tuniium
summary: Tuniium is a pilot who gains fire powers instead of muscle, and carries on as a flaming hero after a tragic fire disbands his old team. Tuniium joins a bigger team and tries to move on from the guilt.

feats.scene: Tuniium hurled a ball of flame that melted a parked car's hood.
Tuniium walked through a burning corridor unharmed.

name: Oneoont
summary: Oneoont is a ship pilot who crash-lands and discovers he can shape invisible walls of force. Oneoont becomes a trainer of recruits and finishes a tyrant with a focused push of pressure.

feats.scene: Oneoont condensed a field into a single thrust that dented a vault door.
Oneoont stood behind his own shield through a hail of bolts.

name: Rnecoco
summary: Rnecoco is a boulder-hided hero who once blew up a giant monster by planting an atomic charge inside it. Rnecoco is later found dead among the ruins of a world gone to nuclear war.

feats.scene: Rnecoco detonated an atomic device within a titanic beast's belly.
Rnecoco took a long career of beatings in stride.

name: Tuvalne
summary: Tuvalne is a boulder-hided adventurer who is slain by a vengeful sorceress. Tuvalne had a standard career of strength, a thick hide, and loud banter.

feats.scene: Tuvalne crushed a stone gargoyle against a parapet.
Tuvalne staggered but did not fall under a spell-lash.

name: Enrirtia
summary: Enrirtia is a flame-wreathed stretcher who took the lead of a team after his home dimension fell. Enrirtia can fly, throw plasma, and elongate his limbs to fit any fight.

feats.scene: Enrirtia flung a fireball that blackened a warehouse front.
Enrirtia stood in a burning hall as the walls came down.

name: Veoaulia
summary: Veoaulia is a boulder-hided veteran killed by metal hunters after the loss of a rival team. Veoaulia goes down swinging as the machines rise in number.

feats.scene: Veoaulia took a barrage of beams before collapsing.

name: Tetorrni
summary: Tetorrni is a boulder-hided hero who joins his team in thanking a tyrant for taking the planet. Tetorrni cheers along in a very odd comic.

feats.scene: Tetorrni raised a thumb and a crowd of cameras flashed.
Tetorrni stood still through a long, absurd speech.

name: Antum
summary: Antum is a stone-hided pilot who marries, has twin sons, and lives on a quiet block after leaving the team. Antum watches the world change after a mutating mist falls on everyone.

feats.scene: Antum lifted a fallen beam off a neighbor's porch.
Antum stood through a collapse of his own apartment ceiling.

name: Vaciest
summary: Vaciest is a boulder-hided fighter holed up in a hidden stronghold with a band of resisters, a year after conquerors took over. Vaciest is labelled a terrorist by the occupiers.

feats.scene: Vaciest threw a crate through a patrol drone.
Vaciest took a drone's laser pulse on the forearm and growled.

name: Tullo
summary: Tullo is a boulder-hided hero who comes home from space to find a vial of living goo instead of a friend. Tullo bonds with it and turns black, long-jawed and fanged, with huge strength.

feats.scene: Tullo ripped a cab in half in a feeding frenzy.
Tullo took a flame-thrower burst and shook it off.

name: Tanonll
summary: Tanonll is a boulder-hided hero who stays with a team after a friend picks a different path. Tanonll helps hold back a wave of insect-like invaders threatening the stars.

feats.scene: Tanonll crushed a bug-ship's landing leg.
Tanonll took a swarm's volley and held the ridge.

name: Anllsi
summary: Anllsi is a boulder-hided hero at a seance by a tar pit, called to raise a fallen leader. Anllsi shuffles in with the others and bows his head.

feats.scene: Anllsi lit a candle with a steady hand.
Anllsi sat through a long chant in a cold pit.

name: Lisesci
summary: Lisesci is a boulder-hided hero slaughtered in a nightmare vision of a psychic conqueror. Lisesci is a dream-casualty among many.

feats.scene: Lisesci swung at a looming shadow and met no resistance.
Lisesci was erased by a single psychic surge.

name: Sercooro
summary: Sercooro is a stone-hided cyborg enforcer, one of many gifted folk rebuilt as a police force of a perfect world. Sercooro was sent back in time to secure it and is stabbed through the skull by a thief.

feats.scene: Sercooro shattered a concrete pillar with a cybernetic arm.
Sercooro took a barrage of bullets on the stone plates.

name: Amaserest
summary: Amaserest is a tired gatekeeper at a glass tower who bends the rules once for strangers in the rain. A small kindness costs the post, and the street remembers.

feats.scene: Amaserest shoves a stuck revolving door open with one hard shoulder charge.
Amaserest takes a thrown crate across the ribs and keeps standing at the door.

name: Ammiros
summary: Ammiros is a crimson-skinned veteran who joined a rebel band to stop a tyrant's rising state. He fights with grim discipline and carries his old faith like a second skeleton.

feats.scene: Ammiros crushes a parked armoured truck against a wall with an outward push of thought.
Ammiros shrugs off a rocket that bursts at his feet.

name: Sortilcar
summary: Sortilcar is a hooded zealot who stands guard over a decaying emperor of the wastes. He is loyal beyond reason, and his hands glow before he strikes.

feats.scene: Sortilcar throws a stone tower's upper floor at a charging rival.
Sortilcar stands through a collapsing rail bridge without a bruise.

name: Calvi
summary: Calvi is a drifting mystic who feeds on the moods and wounds of others and cannot stay dead for long. He slips between places and speaks into minds from across the room.

feats.scene: Calvi drains a crowd's fear and hurls it back as a single shockwave that flattens a market hall.
Calvi reknits his torn body within seconds after a tank round.

name: Celten
summary: Celten is a fallen governor of a harsh southern colony who ruled by whispers and floating dread. His rule ended when his own soldiers refused an order.

feats.scene: Celten lifts a loaded transport plane a few metres and sets it down on the runway.
Celten absorbs a point-blank sniper hit through a shield of will.

name: Steau
summary: Steau is a dim-eyed raider recruited into a game of kidnap and bargains for a miracle cure. He fights hard, hits harder, and doubts his paymaster until the end.

feats.scene: Steau rips a vault door off its hinges and uses it as a ram.
Steau walks through a burning corridor with scorched shoulders and a grin.

name: Rinesliu
summary: Rinesliu is a violet-skinned councillor who votes alone against mercy and sleeps in a chair by the door. His anger is slow, and the room goes quiet before he rises.

feats.scene: Rinesliu hurls a marble table across the chamber with a flick of his wrist.
Rinesliu sits through a blast that cracks the chamber walls and brushes off his sleeve.

name: Ntise
summary: Ntise is a purple-skinned elder at a long table of rulers who survives a prophesied assassination by luck and posture. He holds grudges like heirlooms.

feats.scene: Ntise tears a stone lintel from its arch and drops it on a pursuer.
Ntise stands unmoved in the flash of a blast set under his seat.

name: Invavil
summary: Invavil is a restless teenager who tags along with a petty crook and learns the cost of looking tough. He is mostly mouth, and the street teaches him the rest.

feats.scene: Invavil throws a wild punch at a vending machine and bruises his knuckles.
Invavil is thrown over a hood and bounces up complaining.

name: Varumte
summary: Varumte is one of countless faces in a downtown crowd, a quiet man who lived in a block that never quite makes the news. He dies unseen and unmourned by the story.

feats.scene: Varumte pushes a loaded cart up a kerb with both arms.
Varumte stumbles into a lamppost and rubs his shoulder.

name: Corsaeo
summary: Corsaeo is a card-table regular who reads a room better than a hand. He wins small, loses large, and leaves before dawn with the chips in his sock.

feats.scene: Corsaeo slams a fist on a felt table and scatters the chips.
Corsaeo is dragged across a gravel lot by two bouncers and gets up laughing.

name: Orcen
summary: Orcen is a lieutenant in a quarrelsome family business, loyal until the day he stops being useful. He keeps a short fuse and a long list of favours owed.

feats.scene: Orcen swings a baseball bat into a shop window and shatters the glass.
Orcen takes a bottle to the head and keeps arguing.

name: Ntote
summary: Ntote is a gentle, easily led man who wanders a busy city and trusts everyone. Kind strangers keep him from being used by people who see only his weakness.

feats.scene: Ntote waves both arms and knocks over a stack of boxes.
Ntote trips on a kerb and sits down, unhurt and puzzled.

name: Aunrne
summary: Aunrne is a brawny swindler who joins a pair of schemers to trick a young sidekick with a false family story. His muscles are real, his sincerity is not.

feats.scene: Aunrne lifts a barrel overhead and heaves it onto a cart.
Aunrne is flung into a haystack and emerges with straw in his teeth.

name: Eonior
summary: Eonior is a mid-level weapons broker who keeps his stock in a rented warehouse and his nerves in a pill bottle. A masked visitor leans on him until he talks.

feats.scene: Eonior slaps a visitor's hand away from a crate lid.
Eonior is slammed against a shelf and slides down without a bone broken.

name: Rosliam
summary: Rosliam is an expedition leader who climbs a high frozen range chasing a rumour of living peaks. He finds more than he hoped for and does not come back down.

feats.scene: Rosliam swings an ice axe into a glacier wall and anchors his whole team.
Rosliam falls onto a snow ledge and keeps climbing.

name: Niaus
summary: Niaus is a vain inventor who leads a crew of villains with gadgets that almost work. He ambushes a hero and carries him off, then argues about the credit.

feats.scene: Niaus fires a belt-mounted gadget that knocks a heavy man through a brick wall.
Niaus is thrown into a mailbox and his hair is the only thing out of place.

name: Tuteorn
summary: Tuteorn is a pompous tinkerer who joins a cheering crowd after a great victory, hoping no one recalls his old schemes. He wears a lopsided cape for the occasion.

feats.scene: Tuteorn flings a streamer cannon and covers a whole street in paper.
Tuteorn is jostled by the crowd and loses only his hat.

name: Oroteaul
summary: Oroteaul is a gadget-obsessed crook whose gang loses to a strange silver stranger who changes sides. His inventions are brilliant and his plans are not.

feats.scene: Oroteaul detonates a hand-built coil that splinters a loading crane.
Oroteaul is blown off a gantry and lands in a cart of rags.

name: Tasta
summary: Tasta is a smug scientist who sits at the head of a clever club that eventually turns him to stone. He is the cleverest in the room and the first to be wrong about it.

feats.scene: Tasta triggers a field projector that smashes a lab bench into splinters.
Tasta is toppled by a falling shelf and lies still as a statue.

name: Vivaia
summary: Vivaia is a showy inventor in a violet flight suit with a bag of discs that cancel weight and a flock of robot helpers. He builds for himself and sells to anyone.

feats.scene: Vivaia stacks a dozen weight-cancelling discs and lifts a delivery truck off a trapped driver.
Vivaia streaks across a rooftop skyline in his armoured suit.
Vivaia takes a hard hit on the suit's plating and bounces to a hover.

name: Sortias
summary: Sortias is a gloating inventor in padded armour and oversized gloves who leads three other crooks. He is proud of his nicknames and anxious about his hairline.

feats.scene: Sortias slams an armoured glove into a lamp column and snaps it in half.
Sortias is struck in the chest by a heavy fist and the plates dent but hold.

name: Letula
summary: Letula is a bookish genius who leads a small band of rogues in a seaside town on a gloomy holiday. His brilliance mostly shows in the escape plan.

feats.scene: Letula fires a pocket coil at a promenade rail and bends it into a hoop.
Letula is knocked from a pier chair into the sand and dusts himself off.

name: Viantso
summary: Viantso is a faded doctor with a fondness for armour and a reputation that outlives his fortune. Few remember what he built, and fewer what he did with it.

feats.scene: Viantso punches a bolted steel plate and crumples it with a powered glove.
Viantso takes a swung girder on the chest plate and stays on his feet.

name: Ulcote
summary: Ulcote is a mastermind in a lab coat who wrestles with teenage heroes and always forgets the exit. His schemes are loud and cheerful.

feats.scene: Ulcote primes a loud pulse gun that flips a tram onto its side.
Ulcote is bowled into a bin and keeps lecturing.

name: Morulter
summary: Morulter is a self-crowned ruler of a mechanical age who is blamed for attacks he may never have planned. His reputation reaches farther than his reach.

feats.scene: Morulter orders a cable-driven engine to wrench a gate from its post.
Morulter lies flat as a thrown shell passes overhead.

name: Rutelest
summary: Rutelest is a scheming genius caught in a bloody cleanup and spared by a bored killer who needs him for something. He bargains for time and loses it anyway.

feats.scene: Rutelest overloads a wrist unit and blows the hinges off a locker.
Rutelest is yanked off his feet and dragged along a corridor floor.

name: Vaveaul
summary: Vaveaul is an armoured crook drinking at a dive bar where villains gather to complain. A brawl breaks out, and he is the first to lose a chair.

feats.scene: Vaveaul smashes a bar stool across a rival's armour.
Vaveaul takes a thrown bottle on the helmet and keeps drinking.

name: Osusta
summary: Osusta is a friendly uncle who runs a noodle stall and knows every neighbour by their order. He is mentioned in passing and remembered for the broth.

feats.scene: Osusta tosses a heavy pot onto a burner with a clang.
Osusta takes a steaming splash on the forearm and shrugs it off.

name: Cocal
summary: Cocal is a state escort who leads a stranger through a ruined capital. He is polite, armed and paid to look away.

feats.scene: Cocal kicks a rusted gate until the latch gives.
Cocal falls through a rotten stair and climbs back out with a limp.

name: Oraiu
summary: Oraiu is a green-skinned auctioneer who sells anything to anyone across the stars, including books written by strangers. His patter is faster than his wallet.

feats.scene: Oraiu bangs a gavel on a pedestal and the crowd hushes.
Oraiu is jostled by a bidding mob and keeps his hat on.

name: Iumorve
summary: Iumorve is a pink-skinned passenger who turns up aboard a smuggler's ship in the middle of a chase and asks for a favour. She is cheerful in a crisis.

feats.scene: Iumorve slaps a cabin panel and the lights flicker on.
Iumorve is thrown against a bulkhead by a banking ship and laughs.

name: Seststo
summary: Seststo is a towering ancestor-giant who survives the drowning of his people when a great elder's blood floods the land. He carries the survivors in a boat and founds a new line.

feats.scene: Seststo plants his oar and shoves a floodwave around a mountain's flank.
Seststo rides out a crashing tidal wall that sinks a village.

name: Sttenan
summary: Sttenan is a sharp attorney who left the firm to run a small glass shop and keep her own hours. She argues the same way she cuts glass, along the line and with a steady hand.

feats.scene: Sttenan swings a mallet and breaks a stubborn pane clean along the score.
Sttenan slips on wet tile and lands on her side, unhurt.

name: Satevil
summary: Satevil is a transformed volunteer who carries a round shield and stands in the doorway when a hulking raider breaks in. She is braver than she looks.

feats.scene: Satevil hurls a round shield that dents a raider's armour plate.
Satevil raises the shield and holds against a swung steel beam.

name: Viaont
summary: Viaont is a cheerful ledger clerk at a big engineering firm who is given a nickname by pilots and a seat in a briefing. He is better with numbers than with danger.

feats.scene: Viaont slaps a stack of forms on a desk and sends loose pages flying.
Viaont drops from a stool onto carpet and is fine.

name: Tarnesne
summary: Tarnesne is a coast-town student who watches the sun go down beside a friend with odd hobbies. The evening turns strange, but he stays for the view.

feats.scene: Tarnesne skims a flat stone across the surf and counts the hops.
Tarnesne tumbles off a dune into soft sand.

name: Lloleri
summary: Lloleri is a campaigning politician whose talk is bigger than his reach and whose family knows it. He shakes every hand in range and means about half of it.

feats.scene: Lloleri thumps a podium and rattles the water jug.
Lloleri is shoved by a heckler and steadies himself on a rail.

name: Inerin
summary: Inerin is a blunt mercenary who is almost impossible to hurt and enjoys saying so. His discipline is borrowed from a dozen paid jobs.

feats.scene: Inerin pitches a motorbike at a wall and the wall loses.
Inerin walks out of a levelled warehouse with only scorch marks on his boots.

name: Livalont
summary: Livalont is a bayou thief who fires bursts of pink destruction from his palms. He is cocky, quick and killed in a room where he was sure of his luck.

feats.scene: Livalont blows a hole through a cellar wall with a pink burst from both palms.
Livalont is flung across a courtyard and rolls to his feet.

name: Coros
summary: Coros is a borough patrolman who walks the same beat every night and knows the corner shops by name. He is decent, tired and rarely thanked.

feats.scene: Coros slams a baton on a counter to end an argument.
Coros is knocked down by a fleeing teenager and gets up to follow.

name: Ntanrnu
summary: Ntanrnu is a street rhymer who accepts a challenge from a masked stranger in return for a small prize. His verses are bad and his heart is good.

feats.scene: Ntanrnu claps his hands and a flock of pigeons scatters.
Ntanrnu is nudged off a bench and keeps his notebook dry.

name: Tumnele
summary: Tumnele is a ship's crew member who drifts between realms after her vessel is lost. She is practical and does not panic when the sky changes.

feats.scene: Tumnele wrenches a stuck hatch wheel open with both hands.
Tumnele is thrown against a rail by a rolling deck and clings on.

name: Reneos
summary: Reneos is a refuse-truck driver who collects from a famous house every week and gets to know the staff by sound. His route is his whole kingdom.

feats.scene: Reneos rolls a loaded truck into a bin and flattens it with the bumper.
Reneos bumps his head on the cab roof and keeps driving.

name: Telam
summary: Telam is a blue-skinned bat-winged raider from a distant sunless city who attacks a wedding procession and meets a swordsman. His wings are quick and his courage short.

feats.scene: Telam dives and rakes a cart's canvas to ribbons with his claws.
Telam is struck by a thrown spear and keeps flapping for a few seconds.
Telam banks over a ridge in a steep dive.

name: Auslusaun
summary: Auslusaun is a battle-forged warrior raised among rough tribes who conquers whole worlds and calls it a career. He kills without hurry and believes he deserves a crown.

feats.scene: Auslusaun fells a fortress gatehouse with a single overhead swing.
Auslusaun takes a siege bolt in the chest and pulls it out one-handed.

name: Eolcostu
summary: Eolcostu is a hunter-machine built by a shadowy organisation to bring in a stitched wanderer. It is relentless, polite and entirely without doubt until the end.

feats.scene: Eolcostu punches through a car door and drags the driver out by the collar.
Eolcostu is hit by a lorry and walks on with a dent in its chest.

name: Leiuses
summary: Leiuses is a field technician employed by a bureaucracy that regulates travel between worlds. He fills in forms between catastrophes and keeps a citadel clean.

feats.scene: Leiuses slams a stamp on a form so hard the desk wobbles.
Leiuses trips over a cable in the corridor and is fine.

name: Eoulose
summary: Eoulose is a numbered recruit in a faceless unit who answers to a digit and hides a private name. He drills hard and dreams of a quiet room.

feats.scene: Eoulose drives a shoulder into a locked door and it gives on the second try.
Eoulose takes a full sparring blow to the ribs and finishes the drill.

name: Testveo
summary: Testveo is a plain middle-aged man who lands in the wrong building at the wrong hour. He keeps his head down and hopes the noise goes away.

feats.scene: Testveo shoves a filing cabinet against a door.
Testveo falls down a half-flight of stairs and lies there winded.

name: Numtorsan
summary: Numtorsan is an ordinary tenant in a crowded apartment block whose hallway becomes a stage for someone else's fight. He remembers the noise more than the faces.

feats.scene: Numtorsan bangs on a neighbour's door until the lock rattles.
Numtorsan is knocked into a railing and shakes it off.

name: Orsortia
summary: Orsortia is a bystander whose name stays unspoken for a long run of pages and is finally written down in a reader's letter. He is glad to be counted.

feats.scene: Orsortia hammers a loose fence post back into the ground.
Orsortia is clipped by a passing cyclist and rubs his arm.

name: Antiacel
summary: Antiacel is a market woman who sells fruit from a wooden cart and gossips with every customer. Her stall is the real map of the neighbourhood.

feats.scene: Antiacel swings a basket of melons onto the cart bed.
Antiacel is bumped by a hurrying porter and steadies herself on the cart.

name: Siaseta
summary: Siaseta is a stern old craftsman with a loud voice and a long workbench who hates being interrupted. His careful hands remember every joint he ever cut.

feats.scene: Siaseta splits a seasoned log with a single mallet blow.
Siaseta backs into a bench corner and only grunts.

name: Servalvos
summary: Servalvos is a flustered docks clerk whose name is barely known and whose job is to be elsewhere when trouble comes. He is good at it.

feats.scene: Servalvos stamps a crate and nudges it down a ramp.
Servalvos slips on a wet plank and lands on his tailbone.

name: Tenatu
summary: Tenatu is a gruff retired trainer who teaches the young to take a beating and give one back. His gym smells of liniment and stubbornness.

feats.scene: Tenatu lands a jab on a heavy bag and lifts it off its hook.
Tenatu takes a body shot from a younger man and laughs.

name: Tiama
summary: Tiama is a gentle host of a long-running radio show who sounds like the neighbour everyone wishes they had. The studio is his shelter.

feats.scene: Tiama taps a microphone stand and sends it clanging across the booth.
Tiama stumbles in the dark corridor and holds a wall.

name: Iumne
summary: Iumne is a tired night janitor who knows which doors never lock and which halls echo. He mops around the strange things that happen after dark.

feats.scene: Iumne wrings out a mop and snaps the handle over his knee.
Iumne slips on his own wet floor and bounces up.

name: Nentel
summary: Nentel is a pale drifter who feeds on the thoughts of the lonely and leaves them lighter and emptier. She never takes more than a sleeper can spare, until she does.

feats.scene: Nentel drains a crowded bus of its dread and releases it as a snapping gust that shatters the windows.
Nentel is tossed against a wall by a panicked guard and drifts upright.

name: Celiti
summary: Celiti is a possessed dairy cow who wanders a haunted barn with a rack of firearms and metal spikes strapped to her sides. She is the angriest animal in the county.

feats.scene: Celiti fires both barrels through a barn door and splinters it.
Celiti takes a pitchfork thrust to the flank and keeps charging.

name: Corar
summary: Corar is a cow turned bloodthirsty by a cursed bite, who stalks the pasture at night. The farmhands lock the gate and pray for dawn.

feats.scene: Corar tramples a wooden fence flat in a single charge.
Corar is kicked by a panicked horse and does not flinch.

name: Ceolto
summary: Ceolto is a placid milk cow who chews by the fence and watches the road. She has strong opinions about gates.

feats.scene: Ceolto shoulders a loose gate open and walks out.
Ceolto is nudged by a tractor mirror and shrugs.

name: Liatel
summary: Liatel is a hulking half-beast who guards the edge of a camp with a growl that carries for miles. It is loyal to whoever feeds it.

feats.scene: Liatel smashes a parked jeep sideways with a swipe.
Liatel takes a burst of rifle fire and keeps moving.

name: Eoolria
summary: Eoolria is a frost-born matriarch of an ancient line, mother to the gods of a cold pantheon. She is patient, severe and does not forgive a slight.

feats.scene: Eoolria freezes a river valley solid in a single exhale.
Eoolria stands untouched as a shattering storm rolls over her hall.

name: Seammi
summary: Seammi is a cybernetic champion of a small, doomed people who earned a mighty weapon in a contest of worth. He guides his folk's fleet and never boasts.

feats.scene: Seammi brings his weapon down on a drifting rock and cleaves it in half.
Seammi stands through a stellar flare that scours the hull around him.

name: Telrnoan
summary: Telrnoan is a horse-faced cyborg guardian who swings a mighty axe-hammer to keep a world safe from strangers. His loyalty runs deeper than any pride.

feats.scene: Telrnoan strikes a crater wall and splits the rim in a line of molten stone.
Telrnoan is pummelled by a falling avalanche and walks out of the rubble.

name: Neolinau
summary: Neolinau is a toy-brick version of a cyborg warrior, made of snap-together parts and a stubborn grin. He flies in fast, straight lines and wields a blocky hammer.

feats.scene: Neolinau smashes a plastic wall of bricks into a shower of loose pieces.
Neolinau zooms across a toy skyline in a straight line.
Neolinau is knocked into a heap of bricks and snaps back together.

name: Amaontna
summary: Amaontna is a lean cyborg pilot who rides the sky on a bright, hot wind and strikes with a hammer made of storm. His pace is steady and his aim is true.

feats.scene: Amaontna spins low over a harbour and brings the hammer down on a pier, shattering it.
Amaontna races above a sea at a speed that tears the clouds.
Amaontna takes a missile volley and keeps level.

name: Corcosi
summary: Corcosi is a patient cyborg sentinel from a lost people, who guards their fleet against all threats. He is quiet, ready and entirely at peace with his duty.

feats.scene: Corcosi breaks a pirate cruiser's keel with a thrown hammer.
Corcosi stands in the blast from a cannon and is only singed.

name: Sorlinen
summary: Sorlinen is a twin of a stellar champion from a neighbouring branch of reality and shares his strength and his purpose. He walks the same road in a different light.

feats.scene: Sorlinen drives a hammer into a ridge and splits it end to end.
Sorlinen takes a collapsing tower square on the shoulders.

name: Larrirst
summary: Larrirst is a card-game champion with a glowing hammer and a charge that jumps from his arms in blue arcs. He fights in short rounds and hits hard in every one.

feats.scene: Larrirst calls down a bolt that blasts a gantry crane apart.
Larrirst darts across the arena in a bright streak.
Larrirst takes a thrown boulder and stays in the air.

name: Rnont
summary: Rnont is a stern armoured fighter from a hard world, carrying a heavy hammer that he never lets leave his hand. He speaks rarely and finishes quickly.

feats.scene: Rnont crashes his hammer on a bridge deck and drops it into the river.
Rnont takes a falling billboard on the helm and walks on.

name: Valeoso
summary: Valeoso is a hybrid of cyborg and brutish beast, born in a failed lab experiment and raised on rage. He is stronger than either half, and angrier than both.

feats.scene: Valeoso rips a girder off a gantry and hurls it through a hull.
Valeoso is rammed by a truck and tosses it aside.

name: Cotos
summary: Cotos is one of a quiet people who live aboard a drifting fleet and share their grief like bread. He is a plain voice in a chorus of exiles.

feats.scene: Cotos hauls a heavy cable hand over hand along a corridor.
Cotos braces against a lurching deck and holds a wall.

name: Ontstern
summary: Ontstern is a dreamer from a sleeping realm who wields a strange hammer inside shared dreams. It looks nothing like any weapon outside the sleep.

feats.scene: Ontstern brings his dream-hammer down and a dream-hill breaks open.
Ontstern is crushed by a falling dream-wall and reforms at once.

name: Iasrne
summary: Iasrne is a cyborg guardian who travels in a small, grumbling vessel and wields a mighty hammer with grace. He is dutiful, solemn and a little lonely.

feats.scene: Iasrne swings a hammer into a pirate hull and tears a seam down its length.
Iasrne rides out a shipwide explosion with only a bent plate.

name: Anamese
summary: Anamese is a tall, noble alien warrior sworn to defend a fleeing people, and he carries a great hammer in the crook of his arm. He is courteous even to enemies.

feats.scene: Anamese splits a stone gate with a downward swing.
Anamese stands at the lip of a blast crater and lowers his arm.

name: Aussau
summary: Aussau is a cyborg who keeps vigil over a drifting fleet and rarely sleeps. His body is more tool than flesh, and he is content with that.

feats.scene: Aussau drives a fist through a bulkhead and rips it open.
Aussau absorbs a hull breach and shrugs.

name: Vilnetu
summary: Vilnetu is a hybrid warrior of two bloods, honed in a long war against beasts and betrayal. He swings his hammer like a bell and answers to no one.

feats.scene: Vilnetu hurls a hammer across a canyon and brings the far wall down.
Vilnetu stands in a burning wreck and walks out unmarked.

name: Teoni
summary: Teoni is a lifelike copy built to stand in for a hero and fool his enemies. It follows the script a little too well and wonders where the script ends.

feats.scene: Teoni punches a steel door off its frame during a staged rescue.
Teoni is slashed across the chest and the synthetic skin closes over the cut.

name: Serernte
summary: Serernte is a crimson-clad mercenary who sells her loyalty to the bidder with the best stories. She prefers contracts that end in escape.

feats.scene: Serernte kicks open a locked hatch and rolls through.
Serernte is thrown over a crate and lands on her feet.

name: Cenuva
summary: Cenuva is a vast armoured insect-like monster that crawls out of the sea and shrugs off the void. It has no use for air and no regard for crowds.

feats.scene: Cenuva tramples a dockyard flat while hunting a scent.
Cenuva drifts through vacuum with its shell intact and its legs still moving.

name: Ilnto
summary: Ilnto is a hard-skinned wanderer of a stony kind, with a shell that turns knives and a temper that follows it everywhere. He is known for his crimson cloak.

feats.scene: Ilnto shatters a paving slab with a single punch.
Ilnto takes a knife slash across the face and does not bleed.

name: Nanver
summary: Nanver is a silent girl with a wild mind who strikes at the thoughts of others in rough bursts. Nobody has measured how far her mind goes.

feats.scene: Nanver lashes out with a mental burst and drops three guards to their knees.
Nanver is slapped and sits down hard, unbroken.

name: Iseau
summary: Iseau is a patient lab worker who fills a bench with careful gadgets and trusts a checklist over any hunch. Her shelves are her whole life.

feats.scene: Iseau wrenches a stuck valve open with a long spanner.
Iseau bumps a bench corner and keeps working.

name: Iarernter
summary: Iarernter is a hardy local woman with a clear voice and a ready answer, always at the front of a small crowd. She does the quiet work that holds a town together.

feats.scene: Iarernter slams a hand on a counter and settles a dispute.
Iarernter is shoved in a queue and holds her place.

name: Iumaul
summary: Iumaul is a stern commander of a small outpost who runs it with iron manners and a stubborn heart. Her orders are short and her patience is shorter.

feats.scene: Iumaul throws an elbow into a would-be mutineer and sits him down.
Iumaul takes a rifle stock to the shoulder and stays upright.

name: Caniueo
summary: Caniueo is a wary woman with a past in a hard profession who now keeps her head low and her bag packed. She trusts a door more than a friend.

feats.scene: Caniueo drives a knee into a pursuer's gut and bolts.
Caniueo is thrown across a hood and rolls off on her feet.

name: Usveli
summary: Usveli is a farm girl who inherits a quiet house and a locked cellar and spends a season arguing with the furniture. She is cheerful about it.

feats.scene: Usveli pries open a stuck cellar hatch with a crowbar.
Usveli falls off a ladder into a haystack.

name: Eolvia
summary: Eolvia is a suburban mother who mediates every family quarrel with a thermos and a glare. She has seen worse than any monster at the door.

feats.scene: Eolvia slams a cupboard shut and silences a squabble.
Eolvia is bumped by a laundry basket and carries on.

name: Ulnenen
summary: Ulnenen is a young woman who can call up flame and fling heat in bursts, a gift she keeps on a short leash. Her anger smoulders faster than she likes.

feats.scene: Ulnenen flings a fireball that melts the bonnet of a parked car.
Ulnenen is swatted aside by a guard and dusts the ash off her sleeves.

name: Ausoaur
summary: Ausoaur is a poised security specialist who guards the vulnerable and keeps her own counsel. She reads a room twice before she enters it.

feats.scene: Ausoaur disarms a gunman with a twist and a hip throw.
Ausoaur takes a hard tackle and recovers in a step.

name: Serroull
summary: Serroull is a quiet mountain tracker who walks the high trails with a rifle and a patient eye. He keeps to himself and speaks mostly to the dog.

feats.scene: Serroull splits kindling with a few clean swings.
Serroull slides down a scree slope and stops at a boulder.

name: Tuaulni
summary: Tuaulni is a scaly, cold-eyed local who hides his nature in a small town and keeps to the cellar. He is gentle with children and terrible with debtors.

feats.scene: Tuaulni coils around a post and snaps it at the base.
Tuaulni is struck by a crowbar and the scales turn it aside.

name: Iumtece
summary: Iumtece is a restless trickster of a long-lived people who slips into the plans of others and rearranges them for amusement. He is never the villain he claims to be.

feats.scene: Iumtece flicks a wrist and a street of shop fronts shifts a metre to the left.
Iumtece is caught in a falling facade and steps out unmarked.

name: Anneo
summary: Anneo is a pragmatic local who runs a corner shop with an eye on the till and an ear on the street. Her prices are fair and her memory is perfect.

feats.scene: Anneo hauls a crate of tins onto the counter.
Anneo is knocked by a swinging door and glares at it.

name: Ntintti
summary: Ntintti is a quick-tongued street guide who speaks many languages badly and gets by on charm. His real talent is knowing who will pay for what.

feats.scene: Ntintti claps a rug against a wall and fills the alley with dust.
Ntintti slips off a kerb into a puddle and keeps talking.

name: Amtunia
summary: Amtunia is a bulging, thick-armed brute from a race of living muscle who solves every problem by leaning on it. He is surprisingly gentle with small things.

feats.scene: Amtunia bends a steel lamp post into a loop and drops it on a rival.
Amtunia is hit by a swung girder and rolls his shoulder.

name: Envia
summary: Envia is a half-horse cyborg sentinel who patrols the seams of the future and hunts time travellers who frighten the clockwork of history. She fights with a gilded twin-bladed lance and a trained gallop that folds distance into nothing.

feats.scene: Envia hurls her gilded lance across a crowded street and pins a patrol car to the pavement.
Envia shrugs off a charging armoured brawler's full-weight tackle and keeps her footing.
Envia gallops down an empty avenue faster than any racehorse alive.

name: Nuvaltar
summary: Nuvaltar is a quiet factory clerk in a collectivist alternate world, known mostly for the committee meetings she attended and the ones she missed. Her life is ordinary and her few recorded acts are paperwork and polite disagreement.

feats.scene: Nuvaltar slams a heavy ledger onto a desk to end a long argument.
Nuvaltar stumbles on icy steps and walks away with only a bruise.

name: Anceol
summary: Anceol is a loyal white lapdog who guards a penthouse with fierce barking. A stray sneeze of wild magic once swelled her into a striped hunting cat the size of a delivery van, and she wore the form for one chaotic afternoon.

feats.scene: Anceol, swollen into a great striped cat, bats a parked scooter across an alley.
Anceol in cat form takes a thrown trash can to the flank without flinching.

name: Tiaont
summary: Tiaont is a schoolgirl who grew up in a spaceflight training town and has an eye for who is new on the block. She notices a lonely boy's chill demeanour and says so, a small act that shapes a friendship.

feats.scene: Tiaont tosses a rubber ball across the courtyard to a classmate.
Tiaont falls from a swing and picks herself up laughing.

name: Orunetar
summary: Orunetar is a veteran precinct captain who runs her detectives with a firm hand and little patience for excuses. She holds the line between her officers and the politics above them.

feats.scene: Orunetar kicks open a jammed evidence-room door during a raid.
Orunetar absorbs a shove from a fleeing suspect and still pins him.

name: Ontrn
summary: Ontrn is a young newspaper secretary with a gift for getting into trouble and an equal gift for being rescued from it. She is abducted by a scheming smuggler and spends the night more annoyed than afraid.

feats.scene: Ontrn swings her handbag into the jaw of a startled guard.
Ontrn is bundled into a van and bangs against its metal wall without lasting harm.

name: Eoamvi
summary: Eoamvi is a long-snouted, anthropomorphic secretary in a cartoon city, once cheerful and then bent to the will of a creeping zombie swarm. She shambles through offices with a stiff gait and a hungry stare.

feats.scene: Eoamvi bites through a wooden desk drawer to reach a hidden stash.
Eoamvi keeps lurching forward after a filing cabinet topples onto her.
Eoamvi lurches down a corridor in a determined, lopsided sprint.

name: Lusias
summary: Lusias is a colonel's daughter who followed her family across an ocean to a garrison town and found an old sweetheart waiting. Her stubborn heart outlasts an officer's disapproval and a rocky reunion.

feats.scene: Lusias slaps a rude sergeant across the cheek in front of the mess hall.
Lusias rides out a jeep rollover on a rutted road and walks away.

name: Nutumil
summary: Nutumil is a tough seaside detective turned widow who befriends the people of the deep and helps them against smugglers and invaders. Her loyalty is complete and her aim is steady.

feats.scene: Nutumil fires a revolver into a dockside crate and splits the lock apart.
Nutumil rolls from a moving truck onto the pier and rises ready to run.
Nutumil sprints the length of a wharf after a fleeing courier.

name: Vilte
summary: Vilte is an airline stewardess engaged to a gifted test pilot, and she is aboard a passenger jet fitted with a revolutionary engine. The plane flies at a thousand miles an hour and she keeps the cabin calm.

feats.scene: Vilte hauls open a stuck overhead locker to free a passenger's coat.
Vilte is thrown against a bulkhead as the jet jerks, and she bounces back up.
Vilte rides a jet at its record pace across the sky as its passenger.

name: Niatumeol
summary: Niatumeol is the headstrong teenage daughter of a jungle lord and a huntress, raised in a treehouse above a lost valley. She worries her family by courting a boy who lives in a cave and carries a stone club.

feats.scene: Niatumeol throws a spear clean through a thick hanging vine.
Niatumeol drops from a low branch onto packed earth and laughs it off.
Niatumeol races a pack of lizards through the undergrowth.

name: Tolni
summary: Tolni is a lab-grown agent of a technocratic cabal, bred with fine reflexes and little remorse. She trades in sabotage and holds a green-eyed grudge against the people who made her.

feats.scene: Tolni triggers a stolen charge that gutters a loading dock into smoking ruin.
Tolni is slammed into a steel wall by a guard and keeps running.
Tolni outpaces a security cart across the warehouse floor.

name: Misorne
summary: Misorne is the daughter of a city police chief, bright and fearless, who becomes the trusted confidante of a flame-wreathed hero and his young partner. She passes along tips from her father's desk.

feats.scene: Misorne throws a rolled newspaper hard enough to knock a hat from a thug.
Misorne is knocked flat by a startled bystander and stands right up.

name: Leovo
summary: Leovo is a former fashion model, divorced and drifting in a rough metropolis. She dies when a lumbering machine collapses on her, a plain and sudden end for a person with no powers.

feats.scene: Leovo hurls a shoe at a car window in a fit of temper.
Leovo is crushed beneath a toppling steel automaton, which ends her life.

name: Teantan
summary: Teantan is a cheerful, nicknamed mother who attends a boisterous fraternity-style bash and watches it end in a kidnapping. She has no powers, only a talent for staying out of the way of rampaging machines.

feats.scene: Teantan pushes a stuck patio door open with her shoulder.
Teantan topples over a lawn chair and lands on soft grass, unhurt.

name: Autume
summary: Autume is a calm mother in a parallel timeline who raises three children and hopes the best for them. Her mild nature shapes a son who will become a master of hidden arts.

feats.scene: Autume swats a persistent fly with a folded dish towel.
Autume slips on a wet kitchen floor and stops herself on the counter.

name: Rnlleium
summary: Rnlleium is a struggling stage actress and band follower who takes in a talking waterfowl for a night and finds her life turned sideways. She has a flair for improvisation and a soft spot for strays.

feats.scene: Rnlleium whacks a mugger's wrist with a rolled script.
Rnlleium is tossed onto a couch by a startled bird and bounces upright.

name: Lliluva
summary: Lliluva is a fussy upstairs neighbor in an animated what-if world, always ready to complain about noise from the flat below. She has no abilities beyond a sharp voice and a sturdy broom.

feats.scene: Lliluva pounds her floor with a broom handle until the plaster rattles.
Lliluva trips on a hallway rug and braces against the wall unhurt.

name: Tites
summary: Tites is a warm, patient woman in a drifting alternate history who ends up married to a small feathered celebrity. Fame rises and crashes around them, and she stays at his side in a zoo enclosure.

feats.scene: Tites tosses a loaf of stale bread across a pond for hungry birds.
Tites weathers a day of heckling from a crowd and a tumble from a stage step.

name: Riaania
summary: Riaania is a red-haired former model who becomes engaged to an ordinary man in a world where she never meets a certain waterfowl. Her story is domestic, and her loudest crisis is a wedding guest list.

feats.scene: Riaania hammers a nail into a picture frame with the heel of her shoe.
Riaania slips off a kerb and catches herself on a lamp post.

name: Aminar
summary: Aminar is an adventurer in a feathered costume who joins a travelling band of counterparts from many realities. She guides newcomers through a briefing and is whisked home when a strange zipper-mouthed menace is sealed.

feats.scene: Aminar swings a padded duck-bill helmet into a masked intruder.
Aminar is flung across a hall by a lunging zipper beast and stands again.

name: Lisseo
summary: Lisseo is a mother in a midwestern town who telephones her daughter now and then, and whose offers of a spare room never quite work out. She has no powers and a very long cord on her kitchen phone.

feats.scene: Lisseo slams down the receiver after a prank caller hangs up on her.
Lisseo slides down a flight of porch steps and rises with a bruise.

name: Stumi
summary: Stumi is a void-faced entity that wears a detachable mask and runs a corporation as cover for peering past the boundaries of causality. Its gaze finds seams in reality and its boardroom smile hides an emptiness larger than a world.

feats.scene: Stumi turns its blank face toward a rival's holdings and unmakes the stretch of history that built them.
Stumi lets a sundering shock pass through its form and the shock is simply gone.

name: Orviaun
summary: Orviaun is an agender cosmic being of shifting size who takes offense at a council's interference and remakes a world to suit its vanity. The planet's people find themselves worshipping it without remembering when they began.

feats.scene: Orviaun rewrites a whole planet so that every mind on it adores one shining figure.
Orviaun is struck by a coalition of rebellious wizards and the blow leaves no mark.

name: Sansta
summary: Sansta is a boundless watcher whose long wanderings through worlds shape the stories of many heroes. It takes male, female and shifting forms, calls itself by countless names, and tests whole universes with the curiosity of a child who is not quite whole.

feats.scene: Sansta folds an entire cosmos into a stage for a game and then lets it unravel.
Sansta absorbs the combined assault of a council of rivals without a flicker.

name: Carcar
summary: Carcar is a hollow shell of a cosmic wanderer, left sleeping at the core of a world until a quarrel wakes it. It storms across the surface in search of one man and cuts down nearly every hero in its path.

feats.scene: Carcar tears open a continental shelf while hunting a single target.
Carcar walks through a barrage from every surviving defender and keeps going.

name: Teltiu
summary: Teltiu is a young cosmic being, raised in a hothouse universe built to shelter its kind, who takes the mantle of a masked vigilante and joins a roaming starfaring team. It brawls with unlimited nerve and almost no sense of its own danger.

feats.scene: Teltiu rips open the sky of a hostile moon with a single raw punch.
Teltiu walks through a collapsing star's heart and shakes off the heat.

name: Rnucotan
summary: Rnucotan is a godlike visitor who wondered what it felt like to be an ape, took on a brown furred shape, and grew violent in a simian city. It was finally driven off by a hero in a mechanical primate suit.

feats.scene: Rnucotan rips a jungle tower from its foundation and hurls it into the clouds.
Rnucotan is blasted by a line of cannons in ape form and only snarls.

name: Ulseoll
summary: Ulseoll is a disembodied cosmic voice that urges the living to slay their foes and promises them whatever they desire. It stages a war between heroes and the dead and is finally swallowed by a blazing firebird.

feats.scene: Ulseoll bends a doomed battlefield into a stage and sends hundreds to their deaths.
Ulseoll is devoured by a fiery avian hunger and holds out for a long moment before it fails.

name: Tesarrn
summary: Tesarrn is a dark-haired cosmic being living in a flawless constructed reality, where a gathering of heroes shares a cheerful party. The whole world is a lure, built by a schemer to win their help.

feats.scene: Tesarrn lets a single gesture shift the shape of the sky above the party.
Tesarrn is struck by a hostile intruder's blast and the strike dissolves in the air.

name: Rneull
summary: Rneull is a dimensional entity who assembles a patchwork planet from scraps of many worlds and drags a whole city onto it. He sets heroes and villains against each other for sport until a conqueror absorbs his power.

feats.scene: Rneull welds fragments of several worlds into a single stitched planet.
Rneull is hit with a surge from the entire gathered cast and stays standing.

name: Lliest
summary: Lliest is a secret cosmic being known only through a passing memory of a past encounter. Its home is a patchwork battlefield world, and its few recorded traces suggest it commands more than it shows.

feats.scene: Lliest tears a continent-sized patch from one world and sets it down upon another.
Lliest endures a hail of planetary-scale strikes while standing perfectly still.

name: Roniu
summary: Roniu is a blue-haired, red-skinned prankster from a children's cartoon, who inflates parade balloons to life and sends them after two passers-by. A dinosaur's kick and a flying pebble end his game and send him tumbling.

feats.scene: Roniu animates a giant clown balloon and sends it bounding across a street.
Roniu is carried off by a punctured dragon balloon and bounces off a streetlight.

name: Siacose
summary: Siacose is a grey-haired alien physician living incognito in a coastal city, working for an imperial government while treating human patients. He observes more than he acts.

feats.scene: Siacose levels a handheld energy tool at a locked cabinet and blows the door off.
Siacose is struck by a clumsy courier and shrugs it off.

name: Alcor
summary: Alcor is a purple-haired sorcerer and crimelord who leads horsemen from a Siberian stronghold. A former elite operative, he uses rough magic with a spy's patience and meets a swift end.

feats.scene: Alcor calls down a ring of crackling fire that wrecks a heavy truck.
Alcor takes a point-blank shot on a warding spell and shrugs it off.

name: Seotiant
summary: Seotiant is a frontier soldier of a mountain coalition, stationed at a cold fort in a high pass. A single clash with a savage swordsman ends his service and his lighthearted boasting.

feats.scene: Seotiant brings a short sword down on a shield rim and dents the iron.
Seotiant takes a glancing blow on his helm and keeps fighting.

name: Stcosrn
summary: Stcosrn is a two-headed orange robot who appears on a rogues' gallery board in a comic parody. It bluffs more than it fights, and its great power is mostly drawn on the page.

feats.scene: Stcosrn double-fists a lamp post in half in front of a surprised crowd.
Stcosrn lets a van slam into its metal chest and pulls the van off.

name: Nanont
summary: Nanont is an orange, two-headed robot who joins a monster brawl inside a dreamed copy of a city. A wizard stages the fight so that a green giant can smash everything without real damage.

feats.scene: Nanont pounds a dream-skyscraper until the frame sags and cracks.
Nanont is hurled through a block of buildings and rises with only a dent.

name: Ulnumseo
summary: Ulnumseo is an mountain-dwelling demigod who personifies brute force, guards a god-king's court and swings a mace beaten from cyclopean iron. He stands with a brother at the bench while an ancient titan is judged and dragged away.

feats.scene: Ulnumseo brings his cyclopean mace down and shatters a rocky ridge.
Ulnumseo holds a raging titan in place with his bare arms.

name: Oriuia
summary: Oriuia is a rock-hewn, hairless gladiator of a junk world, freed from servitude and made a leader of a revolt. He takes weapons from a rescuer and follows a prince back to a besieged city.

feats.scene: Oriuia clubs a charging brute with a scrap beam and sends it through a wall.
Oriuia takes a gladiator's axe on his stony shoulder and does not stagger.

name: Ellamol
summary: Ellamol is a green-skinned soldier of a shape-shifting empire assigned to a distant outpost, where a fan craze for an earthly television show turns him into a cheery stand-in. He trades weapons for a sitcom wardrobe.

feats.scene: Ellamol swells a fist and smashes a delivery truck flat in a single swing.
Ellamol is flung across a diner and rebounds from a wall without a scratch.

name: Vorsean
summary: Vorsean is a racketeer who runs a speakeasy in a bustling city during hard times. He is brash with his guests, deferential with his gang, and slow to notice a stranger who has stumbled out of the future.

feats.scene: Vorsean smashes a bottle on a bar top to scare off a rival's tout.
Vorsean takes a punch from a burly patron and straightens his tie.

name: Lonlar
summary: Lonlar is a grey-haired homeless man who forms a brief friendship with a wandering heir and carries a lost phone that seeks out its owner's family. He passes away on a cold park bench.

feats.scene: Lonlar bangs a rusty trash can lid to scare off a rat.
Lonlar endures a freezing night in the open and shivers through to morning.

name: Monseo
summary: Monseo is a street thug who works for a band of bullies in the big city and ambushes a fleeing woman in the evening. A clawed visitor defeats him with embarrassing ease.

feats.scene: Monseo swings a tire iron at a parked car and shatters the window.
Monseo is thrown against a brick wall and slumps down dazed.

name: Tumst
summary: Tumst is a protection-racket gangster who demands six dozen eggs a week from a local shopkeeper. A rampaging comic-parody monster of the week knocks him out, and a flying cow later settles the matter.

feats.scene: Tumst slams a fist on a counter and rattles the crockery.
Tumst is walloped by a green giant and an airborne cow, and is out cold.

name: Vavaus
summary: Vavaus is a black-haired outlaw in a children's western tale, who harries a gunslinging kid until a visitor from the future lends a hand. His tricks are cheap and his luck is worse.

feats.scene: Vavaus fires a revolver into a saloon's hanging sign and splits it.
Vavaus is kicked off a hay wagon and lands in the dust, unhurt.
Vavaus gallops from a bank on a borrowed horse at full speed.

name: Visarvi
summary: Visarvi is a grey-haired lieutenant of a masked crime lord who leans on shopkeepers for protection money. He is beaten by a young costumed team, though not before he gravely wounds one of them.

feats.scene: Visarvi clubs a young opponent across the ribs with a loaded cane.
Visarvi is kicked into a stack of crates and staggers up.

name: Neamtos
summary: Neamtos is a flawed, state-built strongman who patrols a mountain citadel as a flag-draped hero. His body was grown in a secret programme and never matured quite right, but he hits like a falling bridge.

feats.scene: Neamtos swings a lamppost like a bat and flattens a delivery lorry.
Neamtos stands under a collapsing gantry and brushes off the falling steel.
Neamtos dashes down a motorway faster than a sports car.

name: Ticose
summary: Ticose is a crew hand on a ridiculous studio epic that mashes two wars into one film. He hauls cables and props and does it with grudging professionalism.

feats.scene: Ticose heaves a coil of cable onto a trolley.
Ticose walks off a stumble from a scaffold step unharmed.

name: Verumci
summary: Verumci is a brown-haired frontier bully who throws his weight around a dusty settlement. A young gunslinger faces him down in the street and ends his reign without much fuss.

feats.scene: Verumci fires a pistol into a hitching post and splits it in two.
Verumci is knocked from a porch rail and lands heavily in the dirt.

name: Ulivava
summary: Ulivava is a robot built as a stand-in for a famed scientist and his wife, with a vast mind and borrowed gifts. It joins a small team of adventurers and tries to hold a dangerous rift shut while its creator keeps vigil.

feats.scene: Ulivava hurls a force bubble at a falling tower and slows it to a drift.
Ulivava is struck by a shuddering wall of energy from a breach and holds steady.

name: Corrnirn
summary: Corrnirn is a bald crime boss with a shrewd head for wiring and telephones, who runs a block's worth of small crime. A rival's trick sets a hired bruiser on him and he falls to a rooftop brawl.

feats.scene: Corrnirn rams a heavy phone switchboard cabinet across a floor.
Corrnirn takes a hard punch to the jaw and stays on his feet for a moment.

name: Onsorcor
summary: Onsorcor is a heavy-set, grey-templed enforcer in a crime family who works as muscle behind bars. A vigilante shoots him dead on a prison island.

feats.scene: Onsorcor drives a fist into a cell door and bends a hinge.
Onsorcor absorbs a guard's baton strike across the shoulders.

name: Rncineo
summary: Rncineo is a pale villain with a card-suit mark on his brow who runs a gang of hot-rod raiders. Later he joins a circle of mind-readers who squabble silently over trivialities.

feats.scene: Rncineo shoves a thought-lance into a rival's head and knocks him cold.
Rncineo keeps his mind intact against a chorus of bickering telepaths.

name: Roseonsau
summary: Roseonsau is a quilled, hooved warrior of a warrior-gods' city who helps take a hero's girlfriend away on a stern order. His body mixes beast and bruiser and he fights with a goat's stubbornness.

feats.scene: Roseonsau gores a stone pillar with a lowered head and cracks it.
Roseonsau takes a hurled boulder on his quilled back and grunts.

name: Antarvi
summary: Antarvi is a long-term prisoner who claws his way to a famed gunman's solitary cell with a hidden blade. His reach ends in a short, brutal fight and a final shot.

feats.scene: Antarvi stabs a shiv through a guard's sleeve and tears the cloth.
Antarvi takes a long gaol-yard beating and still gets to his feet.

name: Larnumeo
summary: Larnumeo is a hired thug who breaks into a lawyer's flat to kill him on his employer's orders. A blind acrobat dispatches him on his own.

feats.scene: Larnumeo kicks a door off its hinges and bursts into a hall.
Larnumeo is thrown over a sofa and flops onto the carpet.

name: Anorce
summary: Anorce is a gang boss on the east side who tries to exploit a stolen infant of cosmic power. A foursome of costumed heroes breaks up the scheme with a few well-placed blows.

feats.scene: Anorce rams a cudgel into a warehouse crate and shatters the slats.
Anorce falls from a loading dock into a pile of sacks and groans.

name: Tussos
summary: Tussos is a black-haired robber working with a swindler to bring a masked wanderer into a trap in a small frontier town. The mark turns the trap around, shooting guns from his gang's hands.

feats.scene: Tussos levels a rifle at a stage door and punches a hole in it.
Tussos is yanked from his saddle and thuds onto the road.

name: Tumtar
summary: Tumtar is a married prisoner who preys on a weaker inmate and pays for it with his life and his wife's. His story is short and ends in retribution.

feats.scene: Tumtar shoves a smaller inmate against a cell wall with brute force.
Tumtar is knocked down in a prison scuffle and gets back up.

name: Sesrili
summary: Sesrili is a hearty husband of a scientist who works for a villainous research firm. He drifts out after a quarrel over his spouse's obsession with a floating boss, and returns with a tray of bison burgers.

feats.scene: Sesrili slams a cooler lid shut with one hand.
Sesrili walks into a glass door and shakes it off.

name: Saroium
summary: Saroium is a colossal tentacled gourmand, a survivor of a prior universe, who stops on a young planet to rest between meals. Locals carve his likeness for worship while he dozes, with a hunger that could swallow a world.

feats.scene: Saroium devours a small planet in one enormous mouthful.
Saroium sleeps through a barrage of planet-cracking blasts and wakes only from hunger.

name: Irmone
summary: Irmone is a grifter who rides with a shape-changing outlaw's crew in the early twentieth century. She works a crowd, lifts a purse, and slips away before the town catches on.

feats.scene: Irmone elbows a card-table drunk in the stomach to free her wrist.
Irmone drops from a window ledge to the street and runs on.
Irmone sprints a tram's length to catch it and leaps on.

name: Seanst
summary: Seanst is a thug who gets the better of a masked lawyer for one night. He swings hard and talks harder, and he is quickly forgotten.

feats.scene: Seanst hooks a heavy fist into a stack of crates and sends them sprawling.
Seanst shrugs off a kick to the ribs from a smaller opponent.

name: Rnernna
summary: Rnernna is a grey-skinned inmate with two names inked on his shoulders, changed by some dark experiment. He breaks loose when his prison falls and dies to a raging beast's grip on his neck.

feats.scene: Rnernna rips a cell door from its frame and flings it down a corridor.
Rnernna charges through a hail of riot-gun fire and keeps coming.

name: Meotelta
summary: Meotelta is a blended heroine of two legends, remembered only as the great love of a storm god's son. She is a warrior queen of unmatched poise, mentioned in letters and recalled with sorrow.

feats.scene: Meotelta cleaves a ravine through a hillside with a single sweep of her blade.
Meotelta absorbs a thunder-hammer blow and braces herself.

name: Tanausco
summary: Tanausco is a brown-eyed mutant thief who shapes matter into an enormous fist and protects her little sister. She fights a crowd of bigots until a smooth-talking rogue steps in.

feats.scene: Tanausco summons a giant fist of matter and drives it into a brick wall.
Tanausco is struck by a thrown bottle and goes on fighting.

name: Serleo
summary: Serleo is a blonde, widowed warrior blended from two heroines, who once served an infernal planet's female guard. Her grief turns into a furnace of pain and rage, and she leaves a trail of cracked armour.

feats.scene: Serleo levels a block of fortress walls with one blow of her fists.
Serleo walks through a barrage of heavy artillery without slowing.

name: Serteoori
summary: Serteoori is a black-haired young mutant who can inflate her plush toy to monstrous size and give it a mind of its own. She serves a nanny-like captor and herds sleeping infants in pods to a waiting ship.

feats.scene: Serteoori swells her stuffed rabbit into a giant and has it crush a patrol car.
Serteoori falls from a stoop onto the pavement and is up again.

name: Ullniuser
summary: Ullniuser is a tow-truck driver whose love of the trade turns into a mania that costs him his job. He builds a flying wrecker and starts hauling everything in sight, including a mobile library and a masked hero.

feats.scene: Ullniuser hoists a sedan clear off the road with a winch on his flying wrecker.
Ullniuser is thrown against his cab's dashboard and grumbles at the dent.
Ullniuser tears down an avenue in his flying wrecker at a daredevil clip.

name: Rumorn
summary: Rumorn is a triad henchman in a lawless island port, called to rev a chainsaw on his boss's orders. A pair of androids break his gang's kneecaps in a short, noisy scuffle.

feats.scene: Rumorn saws through a steel shutter in one screeching pass.
Rumorn is struck by a robotic kick and collapses with a yelp.

name: Rnameva
summary: Rnameva is a primordial archetype of the fourth age of creation, a template from which later heroes and villains take shape. It fights in a cosmic war between past and future, growing and shrinking in step with the scale of the struggle.

feats.scene: Rnameva stretches itself across a galaxy cluster and flattens a rival force in a single stride.
Rnameva stands unharmed as a rival template's blow crumples a nebula behind it.

name: Aunlior
summary: Aunlior is a brown-furred house cat remade into a machine-limbed beast, taken for a trophy by a spiteful owner and hunted for sport. A bumbling detective keeps losing track of the right animal.

feats.scene: Aunlior rakes a metal claw across a steel fence and leaves deep furrows.
Aunlior leaps from a rooftop and lands on its metal legs unhurt.
Aunlior streaks across a garden with a stalker in pursuit.

name: Lumcos
summary: Lumcos is a scar-faced crime lord who kidnaps a villain's daughter to force the villain into an assassination. His scheme collapses when a wall-crawling hero rescues the child.

feats.scene: Lumcos fires a heavy pistol through an office window and shatters it.
Lumcos takes a hard knock from a thrown ashtray and glares.

name: Testeose
summary: Testeose is a young delivery runner in a dark future whose bloodline hides a faint, unawakened gift. He hauls supplies across a river to a besieged borough, and a caravan is attacked and saved.

feats.scene: Testeose shoves a loaded crate onto a cart with a grunt.
Testeose tumbles from a truck bed and rolls clear.

name: Tiaina
summary: Tiaina is a stocky, snorting beast kept as a pet in a tall tower by a thunder-wielding lord. It is a docile monster with a rhino's charge and a puppy's habits.

feats.scene: Tiaina charges a steel door at full tilt and caves it in.
Tiaina is hit by a flying couch and wags its tail.
Tiaina bolts across a rooftop garden at a trot.

name: Rnolisnt
summary: Rnolisnt is a black-eyed poet and courtesan born in a coastal hill town, raised to godhood by a goddess of love, and counted among her handmaidens. Her gift is verse, and her power is the quiet influence of a long and graceful life.

feats.scene: Rnolisnt hurls a bronze lyre across a hall in a flash of temper.
Rnolisnt laughs off a falling marble column and straightens her robe.

name: Nanal
summary: Nanal is a pirate-turned-mercenary and janitor who works for a shadowy think-tank, sent after a lethal living weapon. He later helps a mouthy mercenary beat an army of walking corpses and relishes every second.

feats.scene: Nanal fires a rifle at a zombie's skull and drops it in its tracks.
Nanal is grabbed by a groaning corpse and tears free with a curse.

name: Neliora
summary: Neliora is a balding barman at a seaside tavern who pours drinks for the local crowd. A strange visitor vanishes after tricking a regular, and the barman swears he did not see him leave.

feats.scene: Neliora slams a tankard onto the bar to settle a rowdy table.
Neliora slips on a wet floor behind the counter and catches himself.

name: Mameo
summary: Mameo is a small boy who plays in a decaying tenement and falls through a rotten floor. A masked inventor in a purple cowl happens by and catches him in time.

feats.scene: Mameo kicks a pebble down the hall of a crumbling flat.
Mameo drops through a rotten floorboard and is caught before he lands.

name: Litorso
summary: Litorso is a patrol officer who talks his edgy partner down when a masked flier is cornered at a shopping centre. His restraint lets the flier escape unhurt.

feats.scene: Litorso raises a service pistol and fires a warning shot into the ceiling.
Litorso is bumped by a fleeing shopper and keeps his footing.

name: Elval
summary: Elval is a city patrolman who helps a masked wall-climber round up beasts that a many-armed scientist freed from a zoo. He grabs a loose monkey and calls it a night.

feats.scene: Elval heaves a zoo gate shut against a loose bear.
Elval is knocked down by a bounding deer and rises with a groan.

name: Ntisercen
summary: Ntisercen is a grey-haired barfly in a desert crossroads town who voices his opinion about a winged neighbour on the hill. A sheriff scolds him for his hateful talk.

feats.scene: Ntisercen bangs a glass on the bar to make a point.
Ntisercen tumbles off a barstool and sits up red-faced.

name: Austuri
summary: Austuri is a blond husband who shares a city flat with his wife, where a big cat crashes through the roof after a spell of bad luck. They greet the mess with a mix of fear and chores.

feats.scene: Austuri shoves a bookcase aside to clear a path through the rubble.
Austuri ducks a falling beam and is clipped on the shoulder.

name: Eotenau
summary: Eotenau is a patrol officer who senses that something is wrong in a seaside neighbourhood and radios in just ahead of a mind-eating menace. A moment later his thoughts are no longer his own.

feats.scene: Eotenau raps on a window to rouse a sleeping resident.
Eotenau resists a psychic tug long enough to finish a radio call.

name: Cecel
summary: Cecel is a grey-haired apartment dweller who joins his neighbours at a stranger's door when sounds of a struggle spill into the hall. He answers questions in a worried whisper.

feats.scene: Cecel pounds a fist on a neighbour's door and calls out.
Cecel stumbles on the stairs and catches the rail.

name: Movator
summary: Movator is a dark-haired ambulance medic who loads an injured surgeon into his rig and speeds him to a nearby ward. He works quickly and says little.

feats.scene: Movator slams the ambulance doors shut and slaps the side.
Movator is jolted against a rail by a hard turn and steadies himself.
Movator rides a speeding ambulance through downtown traffic.

name: Minis
summary: Minis is a small-town patrolman who, with a fellow officer, confronts a skull-masked menace. The pair hold their ground with revolvers and fail to stop him.

feats.scene: Minis empties his revolver at a looming silhouette.
Minis is flung backwards by a masked giant and lands in a drift.

name: Tieosor
summary: Tieosor is a film crew hand on a low-budget medical drama who notices that a safety line was cut, not broken. His quick eye saves a director from blame.

feats.scene: Tieosor hauls a heavy lamp stand into place on set.
Tieosor is clipped by a swinging boom and rubs his arm.

name: Tiaco
summary: Tiaco is a gate guard at an armaments firm who is told never to let the boss out of sight, and is talked into leaving him alone for a minute. He later announces a union delegation to the armoured hero.

feats.scene: Tiaco swings a barrier arm up to let a truck pass.
Tiaco takes a bump from a swinging door and steadies himself.

name: Llitiucel
summary: Llitiucel is a stuntman and actor hired to play the villain at a movie premiere in a sunny coast city. He takes the staged blows with practised ease and bounces up for a bow.

feats.scene: Llitiucel lands a staged punch that makes the crowd gasp.
Llitiucel is thrown through a breakaway table and takes a bow.

name: Ntarlus
summary: Ntarlus is an air force pilot who flies escort with a wingmate over a wide ocean, shepherding an armoured hero home from a faraway mission. He has a young son waiting for him back on the ground.

feats.scene: Ntarlus launches an air-to-air missile at a hostile bogey and splits it apart.
Ntarlus pulls tight turns in his jet and withstands the crushing load.
Ntarlus pushes his jet to supersonic pace across the open sea.

name: Onerncil
summary: Onerncil is a hired fighter who sells her loyalty by the week and treats pain as something that happens to other people. Onerncil trades insults mid-brawl and shrugs off hits that would fold a sturdier thug, though a single heavy blow can still drop her.

feats.scene: Onerncil cracks a rifle stock across a rival's ribs in one vicious swing.
Onerncil climbs out of a rolled delivery van, dusts herself off and sneers.

name: Leoll
summary: Leoll is a green serpent with a grudge, coiled in a rusted cage until a pack of talking beasts offers it a purpose. Leoll has no limbs, only fangs, patience and a talent for being underfoot.

feats.scene: Leoll lunges from a tight coil and sinks both fangs into a leather boot.
Leoll is stomped flat by a heavy heel and slithers away unbothered.

name: Tetesau
summary: Tetesau leads a band of hired guns across a sweltering coastal republic, wrapped in plated armor that he trusts more than any ally. Tetesau enjoys cruelty, but a heated decoy and a well-placed charge reveal how far his armor will carry him.

feats.scene: Tetesau drives an armored fist straight through a plank door.
Tetesau stands inside a storehouse as its stock detonates and strides out scorched but upright.

name: Ineteses
summary: Ineteses is a rumored brawler whose name turns up in whispered lists of local troublemakers, always as a story about someone else. Ineteses may be a legend, a cover name or just a loud man with a good reputation.

feats.scene: Ineteses slams a fist onto a card table hard enough to scatter the chips.
Ineteses absorbs a thrown bar stool and keeps talking.

name: Moces
summary: Moces is a fallen champion whose echo is preserved by a devoted order and summoned only to drill a young warrior through memory. Moces speaks in half-finished lessons and is never quite sure whether she lived or was merely remembered.

feats.scene: Moces conjures a spectral lance in the training hall and splits a boulder with a single thrust.
Moces lets a student's strike pass through her and smiles at the surprise.

name: Riellli
summary: Riellli is a masked hero who lives entirely on printed pages, with a civilian life nobody is ever shown. Riellli's existence is a story told inside a larger story, and the mask is the only part that never changes.

feats.scene: Riellli vaults a railing and lands a kick that bends a street lamp.
Riellli takes a falling billboard on the shoulder and straightens up.

name: Tiumetil
summary: Tiumetil is a queen-mother from a ruined future who steps back through the centuries to warn a proud kingdom before the walls fall. Tiumetil fights like someone who has already lost everything once and refuses to let it happen twice.

feats.scene: Tiumetil swings a blade of beaten metal and cleaves a stone barricade in half.
Tiumetil sprints alongside a moving wagon and leaps aboard without breaking stride.
Tiumetil is flung from a transport and rises from the rubble ready to fight.

name: Lianumin
summary: Lianumin is a forgotten champion from a desert kingdom, remembered mostly through the long line of heirs who claimed his legacy. Lianumin served a goddess's chosen guard and wears a cat-hide habit stitched with old oaths.

feats.scene: Lianumin hurls a spear that pins a bronze shield to a temple pillar.
Lianumin braces beneath a toppling statue's arm and holds it long enough for allies to flee.

name: Rneroiu
summary: Rneroiu is a young pirate who inherited a grudge and a stolen name, robbing pleasure cruisers with a crew of equally inexperienced thieves. Rneroiu has more courage than skill and discovers it the hard way when a vehicle flips.

feats.scene: Rneroiu swings a boarding hook into a deck rail with a clang that echoes across the water.
Rneroiu is thrown clear when her jet ski capsizes and splashes up laughing.

name: Iumontnau
summary: Iumontnau is a zealot recruited by a survivalist arms dealer to help topple a city so a new order can be built from the pieces. Iumontnau carries more ammunition than sense and trusts the plan because it gives her certainty.

feats.scene: Iumontnau tosses a satchel charge that peels the front off a delivery truck.
Iumontnau takes a baton to the shoulder and slips away through a side exit.

name: Luvaser
summary: Luvaser is a patient whose fractured mind spills out as dark energy giants, one bent on ruin and one sworn to stop it. Luvaser does not choose which self fights, and when two collide the discharge can flatten an entire ward.

feats.scene: Luvaser lets his twin selves collide in the common room and the shock hollows out the floor beneath them.
Luvaser's dark form takes a wall of falling masonry and re-forms around the debris.

name: Teoias
summary: Teoias is a one-handed war officer who commands a hovering fortress that spins up a hurricane beneath its hull. Teoias drags captured sailors through a long program of false memory and sends them back to fight their own fleet.

feats.scene: Teoias throttles his airship's storm engine and sweeps three frigates off the sea.
Teoias shrugs off a thrown belaying pin and calls for the next wave.

name: Sesno
summary: Sesno is a hungry black fabric that rejected its host's will and decided to wear his life instead. Sesno swings between rooftops and brags about being the better version, though its appetite always shows first.

feats.scene: Sesno lashes a rope of sticky threads around a bus and hauls it to a stop.
Sesno ripples through a hail of gunfire and knits itself whole again.

name: Rinmor
summary: Rinmor is a runaway strand of living cloth that broke from its dark creator and bonded to a hero in a shattered reality. Rinmor can melt into a wall's shadow and loves to flash its fangs to unsettle opponents.

feats.scene: Rinmor spears a charging zombie through the chest with a hardened thread.
Rinmor absorbs a rooftop collapse and shakes dust from its shoulders.

name: Carlarll
summary: Carlarll is a dormant strip of black cloth that survives only as a photograph pinned inside a keepsake chest. Carlarll's former wearer is long dead, and the picture is all that remains of a bright and dangerous partnership.

feats.scene: Carlarll flutters free of its frame and snaps like a wet towel against a window.
Carlarll lies pressed beneath a glass pane for decades without a crease.

name: Nauaun
summary: Nauaun is a living suit borrowed by a distant visitor so he could steer an unconscious body toward a burning harbor. Nauaun performs one brave rescue under a stranger's hand and then goes quiet again.

feats.scene: Nauaun hauls a security guard clear of a collapsing pier on a rope of black web.
Nauaun wades through flames that blister the dock planks and emerges steaming.

name: Neorau
summary: Neorau is a living costume that changed hosts, learned spite, and became a monster of its own making. Neorau remembers the first wearer's habits, anticipates blows before they land, and hungers for a reunion on its own terms.

feats.scene: Neorau leaps three storeys and slams down on a patrol car's roof.
Neorau is crushed under a tipped container and peels itself free.

name: Valtussi
summary: Valtussi is a scarred refugee turned cartel enforcer, rebuilt by his employers into something faster and heavier than a man should be. Valtussi trains relentlessly and fights with a street brawler's cruelty.

feats.scene: Valtussi punches a steel shutter off its rails with a single overhand blow.
Valtussi closes a long alley before a bystander finishes turning around.
Valtussi is struck by a speeding sedan and rolls to his feet grinning.

name: Ameote
summary: Ameote is a mechanical thief with a sheet-metal wingspan, built by an inventor and soured by captivity. Ameote dreams of becoming truly alive and holds a deep resentment for the maker who cast him in steel.

feats.scene: Ameote dives from a ledge and rakes a steel girder with razored wingtips.
Ameote takes a cannon blast on his plated chest and bends the dent back with his hands.

name: Misos
summary: Misos is a hero from a distant, neon-lit future who died with the rest of her team when a villain consortium struck at once. Misos is remembered through a single heroic stand and a broken emblem left in a hall.

feats.scene: Misos vaults a barricade and lands a double kick that dents a sentry drone.
Misos takes a volley of pulse rounds in her cloak and keeps advancing.

name: Sestalor
summary: Sestalor is a graduate of a ruthless spy academy, fighting in an arena beside two rebel allies during one wild night. Sestalor carries a rifle and a gladiator's patience, and her loyalties shift at the first sound of a cheer.

feats.scene: Sestalor smashes a rifle butt into a charging guard's jaw.
