Sestalor rolls off a tilted bleacher and absorbs the fall without a gasp.

name: Vosneslia
summary: Vosneslia is a trained assassin whose body kept moving after the plague took her. Vosneslia fights in the same sharp style she learned in the academy but without hesitation or fear, and she no longer remembers her own face.

feats.scene: Vosneslia drives a rifle barrel through a barricade of folding chairs.
Vosneslia keeps charging after a cart rolls over her legs.

name: Iumrnor
summary: Iumrnor is a former sleeper agent freed from a tyrant's mental leash, who later turns up in a subterranean fight club wearing steel gauntlets. Iumrnor fights to feel free, which is a different thing from fighting to win.

feats.scene: Iumrnor hammers a gauntleted fist into an opponent's guard and cracks the cage mesh behind him.
Iumrnor eats a spinning kick and answers with a smile.

name: Amiaun
summary: Amiaun is a spy-academy veteran with iron-banded fists, fighting inside an arena crowd beside rebel strangers. Amiaun lets her hands do the talking, and the gauntlets say plenty.

feats.scene: Amiaun drives both gauntlets into a guard's shield and splits it down the middle.
Amiaun hits the arena floor from a high railing and bounces to her feet.

name: Cosani
summary: Cosani is a nightclub performer who put on a famous killer's costume for a client and gradually became convinced the costume was her real self. Cosani silences witnesses with quiet efficiency and has no idea how brittle her disguise has become.

feats.scene: Cosani squeezes a fire-escape rail until her knuckles whiten.
Cosani tumbles down a flight of stairs and gets up with a laugh.

name: Numiasnti
summary: Numiasnti is a government agent whose enhanced strength and reflexes come from a half-finished formula tested in a mountain lab. Numiasnti prefers traditional weapons, and uses them with surgical and quiet competence.

feats.scene: Numiasnti plants a combat knife into a steel locker door through a single lunge.
Numiasnti takes a rifle butt to the skull and notices only the noise.

name: Eostel
summary: Eostel is a palm-sized plush creature that can copy itself into a swarm of identical replicas. Eostel learns tricks by watching others perform them, which has made its crowd both adorable and mildly dangerous.

feats.scene: Eostel bounces off a toy block and sends a tower of cups tumbling.
Eostel is squashed beneath a stack of picture books and puffs back to shape.

name: Amsorte
summary: Amsorte is a gender-flipped counterpart who fights alongside a mirror team in a domain where everything is the other way round. Amsorte welcomes visitors, trades quips, and is always ready for a team meal.

feats.scene: Amsorte lands a flying kick that bursts a banner stand.
Amsorte slams into a food cart and brushes off the spilled sauce.

name: Saranron
summary: Saranron is a sorcerer-king who seized a mountain citadel from his six rivals and rules it with a smile. Saranron's authority rests on rituals he refuses to explain and on an unquestioned belief in his own destiny.

feats.scene: Saranron raises a stunted staff and a gale of black ash bowls over a rank of soldiers.
Saranron lets a spear break against a shimmering ward of smoke.

name: Lleanaus
summary: Lleanaus is a plains warrior who seized the chieftaincy during a crisis and led his people toward war. Lleanaus was deposed when the old chief returned, and paid for his ambition in full.

feats.scene: Lleanaus swings a war club that cracks a hitching post.
Lleanaus tumbles from a galloping horse and sprints back to his feet.

name: Iutor
summary: Iutor is a healer-warrior who woke from a dream convinced of a prophecy involving buffalo and a doomed stranger. Iutor rallies his village to war, and when challenged to a duel, bets everything on a mounted knife fight.

feats.scene: Iutor slashes a hunting knife across a saddle strap and slices it clean through.
Iutor is thrown from his horse and rolls to a crouch with his blade still in hand.

name: Aultoste
summary: Aultoste is a patchwork copy of a mighty king, warped by mist and chained to a scheming sibling's will. Aultoste fires raw sonic blasts like his original but at a fraction of the force, and serves as a slave soldier beside an undead tyrant.

feats.scene: Aultoste bellows and a pulse of sound shreds a wall of loose scaffolding.
Aultoste shrugs off a thrown boulder and shakes his head at the dust.

name: Eolrnst
summary: Eolrnst is a statue carved by a blind sculptor, a hush frozen in stone with a king's pose and quiet menace. Eolrnst draws in stray particles as if remembering a former life, though the stone has never moved.

feats.scene: Eolrnst sheds a thin flake of rock from one finger onto the studio floor.
Eolrnst withstands a sledge swung against his base without a hairline crack.

name: Rniar
summary: Rniar is a monarch who met his end at the hands of a cold-eyed scientist trying to curb a council's ambitions. Rniar's body is all that remains of a timeline that went wrong in a single afternoon.

feats.scene: Rniar swings a heavy scepter and shatters a marble bust.
Rniar absorbs a crashing chandelier on his shoulder.

name: Rontescal
summary: Rontescal is a silent king whose single word can level mountains, forced to rule through gestures and a trusted partner's thoughts. Rontescal is hailed by many names, from tyrant to redeemer, and carries each of them without a sound.

feats.scene: Rontescal lets a whisper slip and a mountain ridge crumbles into dust.
Rontescal stands in the heart of a collapsing citadel and the stone falls around him.
Rontescal crosses a mountain range in the time it takes to draw a breath.

name: Niaucor
summary: Niaucor is a king sent to a savage arena-world and killed by its natives before he could finish a mission. Niaucor's remains lie scattered in a pit among other fallen champions, a footnote in a story told by someone else.

feats.scene: Niaucor swings a gladiator's spear and splinters a wooden barricade.
Niaucor takes a savage blow to the ribs and stays standing for a heartbeat longer.

name: Lisvosam
summary: Lisvosam is a rotting king, one of many bitten and resurrected during a global plague, who still wanders with a vague memory of ruling. Lisvosam drifts in a pack of the dead, hungry and indifferent to old titles.

feats.scene: Lisvosam claws through a boarded door and splinters it into kindling.
Lisvosam keeps shambling after a vehicle drags him fifty paces.

name: Leonial
summary: Leonial is a conscripted warrior drafted into a hive-minded occupation, sent to defend its last stronghold against a returning fleet. Leonial obeys without argument, though a scrap of identity glimmers when orders slip.

feats.scene: Leonial hurls a crate of munitions into a doorway and collapses the lintel.
Leonial takes a burst of rifle fire against his plating and keeps marching.

name: Lonte
summary: Lonte is a golden figure warped by a mutated disease, one of several prime shells whose original minds have been overwritten. Lonte moves with a stiff, mirrored gait and speaks in broken echoes.

feats.scene: Lonte slams a gilded fist into a bunker wall and crushes it inward.
Lonte stands in a rain of collapsing steel and emerges without a scratch.

name: Tellene
summary: Tellene is a battle-hardened royal who joined a hasty alliance against a scheming enchantress in an episode that barely made the ledger. Tellene fights from the second rank, calm and punctual.

feats.scene: Tellene swings a battle-axe that cracks a stone gargoyle at the shoulder.
Tellene takes a flying hammer on the shield and slides back a pace.

name: Rinri
summary: Rinri is a winged defender of a paradise realm, brought back from death by a fallen champion after a cosmic execution. Rinri can still raise a voice that shatters mountains, though he rarely does, and guards the dead in silence.

feats.scene: Rinri lets out a single cry and a mountain face slides into the valley.
Rinri survives the blast of a giant's strike that levels a stretch of coast.

name: Ianes
summary: Ianes is a king of a lunar city who joins a clumsy hunt for a runaway hound. Ianes can unleash a scream that flings a rival across a courtyard, and chases the dog through a puzzled hero squad.

feats.scene: Ianes screams across a plaza and a stone fountain blows apart.
Ianes ignores a thrown boulder that explodes on his shoulder.

name: Serisiu
summary: Serisiu is a quiet monarch who honors a sister's wishes, granting her the right to leave a bad marriage. Serisiu is mentioned only in passing, but the decision changes a royal household forever.

feats.scene: Serisiu slaps a stone table in a council room and the cups jump.
Serisiu bumps against a marble pillar and rubs his shoulder.

name: Aunllist
summary: Aunllist is a monarch whose body was found among a pile of fallen counselors after a ruthless collector hunted every cosmic gem. Aunllist is remembered only through a staged simulation, a king who never saw the end of his own story.

feats.scene: Aunllist slams a heavy scepter into a marble floor and cracks a slab.
Aunllist braces against a toppled column and lets it slide off.

name: Numvateo
summary: Numvateo is a double-headed gestalt formed when two royal lovers were fused by invaders into a single commander. Numvateo vaporizes an intruder with a roar, then turns on a lunar tyrant and the resulting cascade ends the whole world.

feats.scene: Numvateo screams at a throne and the shockwave folds a planet into fragments.
Numvateo stands unmoving inside the first crack of a splitting crust.

name: Llcicor
summary: Llcicor is a silent king whose voice can shake a city, forced to flee his brother's coup with a family of exiles. Llcicor flies, fights, and is knocked out by a hired seeker before the tide turns.

feats.scene: Llcicor lets out a clipped shout and the roof of a warehouse peels away.
Llcicor is clubbed by a hired seeker and slumps to his knees.

name: Letumca
summary: Letumca is a once-royal monster who joined a ravenous pack in an overrun parallel world, devouring the primate locals. Letumca remembers a throne and a crown but cannot hold on to what either meant.

feats.scene: Letumca rakes a rusted door off its hinges and tosses it across a street.
Letumca walks through a hail of arrows and keeps chewing.

name: Riseus
summary: Riseus is a regal alien tucked in a crowd of galactic watchers, witnessing a spectacle where a trophy head is paraded before the stars. Riseus keeps silent, wears a ceremonial suit, and watches the room without blinking.

feats.scene: Riseus raises a ceremonial staff and cracks a gilded banister.
Riseus holds his ground as the crowd stampedes past him.

name: Iaori
summary: Iaori is a ruler who was bested by a rampaging green giant, and whose defeat was meant to be announced live but kept being cut off by commercials. Iaori's loss is a small comedy in a larger war.

feats.scene: Iaori shouts into an arena and a row of stadium seats lifts out of its bolts.
Iaori is flung across a stadium wall and lands in a haze of dust.

name: Llsor
summary: Llsor is a mighty king struck down by a small, armed raider on a campaign to erase an entire cosmos, a victim in an imagined timeline. Llsor falls in a single moment, and the story moves on.

feats.scene: Llsor fires one shout and a crate of fruit bursts open.
Llsor stumbles when a pistol shot grazes his ribs.

name: Ormisco
summary: Ormisco is a king who answered an alliance with sound and fury, personally annihilating missiles launched at a mutant homeland. Ormisco also took on a death-bringing horseman with a single sonic blast.

feats.scene: Ormisco screams skyward and a barrage of nuclear missiles fold into a cloud of dust.
Ormisco stands in the heat flash of a fusion strike and brushes embers off his shoulder.

name: Stnau
summary: Stnau is a king known mostly through a surveillance photo pinned to a spymaster's wall. Stnau keeps to a secluded island and is watched closely by those who fear what he might say.

feats.scene: Stnau flings a goblet across a banquet hall and cracks a wall tile.
Stnau takes a thrown chair across the shoulder without flinching.

name: Rautu
summary: Rautu is a campus-friendly ruler whose mind was hijacked by a scheming sibling until a team of students broke the spell. Rautu eventually helps tackle the usurper and receives a hall pass for his trouble.

feats.scene: Rautu belts out a command and a lecture hall's windows cave outward.
Rautu is slammed into a lockers row and brushes off the dents.

name: Aulum
summary: Aulum is a noble who signed with a tactical reserve organized to oppose a mechanical conqueror from beyond the sky. Aulum speaks his mind by example and lets his sound do the arguing.

feats.scene: Aulum lets out a short shout and a vending machine crumples.
Aulum stands through a drone barrage that chips the tiles around his feet.

name: Lusluval
summary: Lusluval is a quiet king who answers a cosmic call to leave the world, joining a glowing mass of ascended beings headed for deep space. Lusluval abandons his throne without ceremony, wearing an oath and a faint halo.

feats.scene: Lusluval joins the great ascent and a ripple of light splits the cloud layer.
Lusluval drifts through the upper atmosphere unprotected and without complaint.

name: Toram
summary: Toram is a king of a lunar city about to make a point with his voice when a cosmic villain crushes him in his hunt for a golden glove. Toram is also glimpsed in a tour group of an unsuspecting visitor.

feats.scene: Toram draws a sharp breath that rattles a nearby window.
Toram is lifted off his feet and slammed into a wall, with a groan.

name: Sostiia
summary: Sostiia is a queen-like figure who watched a world-eater approach and allied her people with a time-hopping conqueror, then walked away from the pact. Sostiia keeps her family clear of anyone who offers a bargain with a price.

feats.scene: Sostiia hurls a ceremonial lance and pins a banner to a palace gate.
Sostiia holds a collapsing balcony rail while her family climbs past.

name: Eliteell
summary: Eliteell is a king of a lunar city who killed his own parents with a careless word and has been mute ever since. Eliteell rules by gestures, protected by a brother-in-law's cunning and a queen's patience.

feats.scene: Eliteell lets one syllable escape and a cliff face sheds a ledge of stone.
Eliteell is struck in an ambush and spits out a tooth.

name: Taninri
summary: Taninri is a monarch who survived a conqueror's sweep across a universe and joined a resistance of scattered survivors. Taninri was cut down when a plan failed and the swarm closed in on the moon.

feats.scene: Taninri lets out a short shout that scatters a squad of insect soldiers.
Taninri withstands a plasma volley and drops to one knee.

name: Ulorll
summary: Ulorll is a king of a secluded city who welcomed a frost-powered stranger into the fold of his people. Ulorll leads with quiet dignity and a hint of sorrow in his silence.

feats.scene: Ulorll claps once and a banquet table jumps a hand's width.
Ulorll takes a spill from a steep staircase and rises composed.

name: Eoliumaun
summary: Eoliumaun is a king who meets a symbiote-bonded giant lizard alone, silencing it with a savage roar that cracks its hide. Eoliumaun is surprised when the beast heals instantly, and is later wrapped in a cocoon with his queen by a dark god.

feats.scene: Eoliumaun roars at a lumbering monster and the blast shatters its armored hide.
Eoliumaun absorbs a tail sweep that flattens an avenue and gets back up.

name: Ntiias
summary: Ntiias is a fanged, clawed double of a bouncing hero, born of a cosmic cloning accident and killed by a quiet mercenary working through a long list. Ntiias dies before the page turns, with his scowl intact.

feats.scene: Ntiias rakes his claws across a car door and leaves four deep furrows.
Ntiias is thrown through a window and rolls to his feet, snarling.

name: Almaam
summary: Almaam is a grey-skinned chieftain of a frozen underworld, a steadfast ally of its king who stood up to an invading queen. Almaam rallies his clans with a grim speech and meets a quick end at a rival's blade.

feats.scene: Almaam swings a rusted axe and splits an ice pillar in two.
Almaam stands unflinching in a flurry of fire and ash.

name: Iunetu
summary: Iunetu is a demon who tried to drag a city into hell through a great portal and was undone when a burning rider destroyed the amulet. Iunetu offers her a bargain, and dies when she refuses it.

feats.scene: Iunetu tears open a portal over a plaza and flames spill out across the stones.
Iunetu is struck by a burning chain and smirks until the second blow lands.

name: Niuro
summary: Niuro is a fallen corruptor whose powers were stripped away after a crimson brute broke a circle of rivals. Niuro now watches the world from a seat in the dark, bitter and diminished.

feats.scene: Niuro sparks a short flare of infernal fire that scorches a rug.
Niuro is tossed against a wall and slides down it, scowling.

name: Morsan
summary: Morsan is a quilled, tailed prince of a council of infernal peers, seated among them at a ceremony for a new member. Morsan observes in silence, a calm and watchful presence inside a loud parliament.

feats.scene: Morsan flicks a hand and the chandelier overhead melts into a puddle of slag.
Morsan takes a bolt of lightning in the chest and brushes the soot away.

name: Celcel
summary: Celcel is a parody hero in a wartime flight jacket, made for laughs in a magazine that lampooned its rivals. Celcel survives a joke tombstone and a dozen gags, the clown prince of a satirical comic.

feats.scene: Celcel throws a rubber chicken and it bounces off a villain's forehead.
Celcel is flattened by an anvil and peels himself off the pavement.

name: Veauscar
summary: Veauscar is a yellow-skinned street brute with a snout and no nose, who tried to prey on a lone woman and was beaten by a passing soldier. Veauscar lives in a rough neighborhood of a sprawling asylum.

feats.scene: Veauscar swings a thick fist and cracks a plaster wall.
Veauscar is thrown through a doorway and spits out a chipped tooth.

name: Llemiru
summary: Llemiru is a gangster who lured an octopus-armed brute to a river boat under the pretense of repayment, then sprang an ambush by a waiting crew. Llemiru trades in favors and fears the day someone calls them in.

feats.scene: Llemiru swings a bottle across a thug's temple and shatters it.
Llemiru takes a punch on the jaw and spits.

name: Lieoau
summary: Lieoau is a blue-furred rebel with red eyes, wanted by a scrappy pair of space scoundrels and a masked wallcrawler. Lieoau drifts through a half-ruined world and keeps one step ahead of capture.

feats.scene: Lieoau fires a stolen carbine and a fuel drum jumps off the ground.
Lieoau tumbles down a ramp and dusts off his fur.

name: Numtortar
summary: Numtortar is an assassin who fights beside his wife with matching whips, one of them electrified. Numtortar chats with his old comrades like family, which makes his violence more disquieting.

feats.scene: Numtortar lashes an electrified whip and a lamp post spits sparks.
Numtortar drops from a loading dock and shrugs off the landing.

name: Niaen
summary: Niaen is a whip-wielding fighter whose name sits on a government list of unregistered troublemakers, and who may or may not have signed on. Niaen is remembered as a husband and a footnote.

feats.scene: Niaen cracks an electric lash and a street lamp flickers.
Niaen tumbles off a fire escape and bounces to his feet.

name: Telvori
summary: Telvori is a white-skinned half-demon assassin descended from an ancient night-mother, with metal claws and fangs that later grow in naturally. Telvori hunts what his clients ask and hurts what they love without a flicker of guilt.

feats.scene: Telvori rakes his razor claws down a steel door and shears it open.
Telvori is hit by a speeding truck and gets back up with a grin.

name: Liauis
summary: Liauis is a pale half-demon killer who ran with a cabal of mercenaries until a vengeful rider ended them. Liauis dies in one parallel timeline and the world scarcely marks the loss.

feats.scene: Liauis slashes a pair of claws across a rooftop vent and tears it open.
Liauis is thrown through a wall and rises with a sneer.

name: Lusanori
summary: Lusanori is a night-born warrior in the ranks of an infernal host, remembered for felling a man who rode a burning bike. Lusanori exists mostly as a boast in someone else's speech.

feats.scene: Lusanori hurls a spiked chain and wraps a streetlight like a vine.
Lusanori is caught in a car explosion and steps through the fire unhurt.

name: Sesrevi
summary: Sesrevi is a fanged, white-skinned bloodsucker who raided a military fort with a squad of ninja fiends and fled on a stolen jet ski. Sesrevi taunts his pursuer, who in the end puts him down along with his vehicle.

feats.scene: Sesrevi smashes a steel hatch off its hinges with a single kick.
Sesrevi tears across a river on a stolen watercraft, fireworks flaring in his wake.

name: Morir
summary: Morir is a snivelling thief in a wicked desert city who sold out a stranger in a tavern for a handful of coins. Morir has more cunning than courage and a long list of enemies who know it.

feats.scene: Morir thrusts a shortsword at a merchant and clips a barrel instead.
Morir is kicked in the head and drops cold for a minute.

name: Osuval
summary: Osuval is a purple, spiny alien soldier in the guard of a stellar empire, and is able to coax plants into obeying him. Osuval backs a usurper in a coup and loses to loyal veterans who fight with discipline.

feats.scene: Osuval rams a spiked shoulder into a barricade and drives it back a few paces.
Osuval stands before a gun battery and the shells ricochet off his thorns.

name: Saleo
summary: Saleo is a stage magician who performs for crowds and becomes briefly evil after a crook invades his home. Saleo teams up with a wallcrawler to repay the favor, then helps save his little theatre from demolition.

feats.scene: Saleo flings a deck of cards and the top one sticks in a wooden post.
Saleo is tossed into a prop trunk and emerges with a bow.

name: Viatenlu
summary: Viatenlu is an underground fighter on a mutated world, defending his people from a tyrant's soldiers before dying in a failed uprising. Viatenlu earns respect in his short career, hardly more than a name on a grave.

feats.scene: Viatenlu rips a patrol hover-sled from the ground and flips it end over end.
Viatenlu is hit by a laser salvo and keeps firing.

name: Voselneo
summary: Voselneo is a crew member on a ridiculous media production about a war between heroes, run by a tyrant who owns the studio. Voselneo may be an actor, a clone or a lost traveler, and never gets a line to explain.

feats.scene: Voselneo hurls a prop sword across a soundstage and it clatters against a lamp.
Voselneo is knocked flat by a falling set piece and groans.

name: Iavelses
summary: Iavelses is a yellow-eyed, blue-skinned hound who hurls crescent blades of crackling energy, recruited by an ambitious schemer to chase down mutants. Iavelses is a minor figure in a larger cult of pursuit.

feats.scene: Iavelses spins and a boomerang of energy slices through a stone arch.
Iavelses takes a fist to the ribs and trots on.

name: Ausoreli
summary: Ausoreli is a knife-thrower in a traveling frontier carnival, whose blades can pin a gunslinger's sleeve to a post. Ausoreli turns to crime with the troupe and pays the price when the law catches up.

feats.scene: Ausoreli flicks a knife that sticks in a barn door beside a rival's ear.
Ausoreli falls from a wagon and rolls up in the dust.

name: Nesval
summary: Nesval is a feathered, fanged hunter from a town of bird-folk, half duck and half bloodsucker. Nesval finishes off a bat-winged noble while a quacking friend deals with the minions.

feats.scene: Nesval drives a wooden stake into a coffin lid and splinters it.
Nesval is knocked off a rooftop and waddles away from the crater.

name: Tiantni
summary: Tiantni is a framed drifter of the dusty frontier who rides from town to town fixing injustices in secret. Tiantni trusts a fast draw, a braided rope and a loyal grey mare.

feats.scene: Tiantni fires a revolver round clean through a lantern hanging from a saloon rafter.
Tiantni gallops the mare flat out across the salt flats ahead of a posse.

name: Losorco
summary: Losorco is an office worker at a cramped city firm who processes orders and answers phones. Losorco is baffled when a gleaming gadget rolls across the desk and plugs itself into the terminal.

feats.scene: Losorco shoves a rolling chair away from the desk in a startled flinch.
Losorco tumbles off a stool onto the carpet and walks away unhurt.

name: Vaserau
summary: Vaserau is a guard who watches the front gate of a sprawling factory, checking visitors against a clipboard. Vaserau is dutiful but unprepared for a stranger with a briefcase full of sleeping gas.

feats.scene: Vaserau swings a flashlight at a trespasser hopping the turnstile.
Vaserau slumps against the gatehouse wall, gassed but unbroken.

name: Onntu
summary: Onntu is a beat officer with a stubborn streak who distrusts costumed vigilantes and polices a seaside precinct. Onntu protects a stepchild fiercely and will arrest anyone who endangers her.

feats.scene: Onntu tackles a fleeing suspect through a rotting fence.
Onntu takes a baton blow to the vest and keeps the cuffs on.

name: Ntretas
summary: Ntretas is a rebellious young woman whose rage conjures monstrous creatures out of thin air. Ntretas used the beasts to rob, to run from cells and to lure rescuers into traps.

feats.scene: Ntretas calls up a hulking creature that flattens a parked delivery truck.
Ntretas is flung into a billboard post and clambers back up snarling.

name: Tecior
summary: Tecior is a loud online personality who livestreams from business conferences and cheers every corporate announcement. Tecior lives for engagement numbers and has no physical talents at all.

feats.scene: Tecior slaps a podium to punctuate a rant for the camera.
Tecior trips on a stage cable and bounces up still broadcasting.

name: Ntseo
summary: Ntseo is a prosecutor in a rain-slick metropolis, buried in case files and thankless hours. Ntseo is known only as a name on a courthouse door.

feats.scene: Ntseo slams a thick folder onto a judge's desk to make a point.
Ntseo slips on courthouse steps and rises without a scratch.

name: Leosu
summary: Leosu is a hard-eyed street enforcer in a gang that peddles dangerous experimental stimulants out of seized warehouses. Leosu is tough by neighbourhood standards, nothing more.

feats.scene: Leosu cracks a pipe across a rival dealer's shoulder.
Leosu shrugs off a thrown bottle and a boot to the ribs.

name: Ametor
summary: Ametor is a brawny serpent-themed criminal who hurls heavy machinery at her enemies and fights with surprising stamina. Ametor once pitched a loaded commuter train down a tunnel at a thunderous foe.

feats.scene: Ametor hurls a whole subway carriage down the tunnel with a roar.
Ametor is pinned under a collapsing tunnel arch and crawls out cackling.

name: Stnianiu
summary: Stnianiu is a stretchy, sturdy member of a snake-themed crime ring who lengthens both arms to twice their normal reach. Stnianiu is stronger and tougher than any ordinary thug and loses easily to a betrayal from within.

feats.scene: Stnianiu stretches an arm across a rooftop and flips a parked van.
Stnianiu absorbs a full-speed motorcycle crash and gets up grinning.

name: Niuvest
summary: Niuvest is a parody heroine in a wisecracking team of lookalike champions who objects loudly to new recruits. Niuvest settles one rivalry with a canister of depilatory spray.

feats.scene: Niuvest empties a spray can over a furry rival from a ceiling beam.
Niuvest falls from the beam onto a foam mat and keeps quipping.

name: Tiustael
summary: Tiustael is a corner-cutting researcher who built a solar converter on a remote island and ignored every safety margin. Tiustael died trying to wreck the runaway machine that poisoned the shoreline.

feats.scene: Tiustael overloads the converter and a thermal blast scorches the island's dock.
Tiustael is shoved back by a blast wave in the control shed.

name: Sesmar
summary: Sesmar is an unlucky drifter turned burglar after taking a dead inventor's briefcase and a field-projecting belt fused to his belly. Sesmar earned a short crime spree and a smaller redemption.

feats.scene: Sesmar shoves through a bank door while wrapped in a humming bubble of force.
Sesmar stands inside the belt's field as a truck rams him and bounces off.

name: Amtimar
summary: Amtimar is a spoof knight in an empty-faced helm who wanders a satirical city and attends a boisterous holiday party at a local bar. Amtimar has no remarkable skills.

feats.scene: Amtimar swings a plastic sword at a streamer cannon.
Amtimar is bonked by a champagne cork and shrugs it off.

name: Ciracos
summary: Ciracos is a pale-eyed enforcer for a government team that polices a flood of newly powered citizens on the east coast. Ciracos follows orders from a gruff squad leader.

feats.scene: Ciracos kicks in a locked warehouse door during a raid.
Ciracos takes a pistol round to the vest and finishes the arrest.

name: Eolti
summary: Eolti is a stunted, bulb-eyed future mentor who builds gadgets and guides a destined child through a dystopian age. Eolti reads minds a little and coaxes a rebel movement toward freedom.

feats.scene: Eolti detonates a homemade charge to open a collapsed tunnel for fleeing allies.
Eolti is knocked aside by a patrol sled and gets up shaken.

name: Valcili
summary: Valcili is a towering grey-skinned warrior who carries an energy rifle and helps two stranded travellers cross a hostile far future. Valcili's size lends greater muscle than any smaller kinsman.

feats.scene: Valcili sweeps a scrap-metal gate aside and fires a rifle bolt that melts a barricade.
Valcili is struck by a hauler and keeps walking.

name: Lerne
summary: Lerne is a cop who walks a rough beat with a partner and a short temper. Lerne bristles when an old man spits on the pavement and is talked down by a calm friend.

feats.scene: Lerne yanks a stuck van door open during a traffic stop.
Lerne takes a thrown brick to the shoulder and stays on patrol.

name: Cauis
summary: Cauis is a hard-riding gang boss of the old frontier who breaks out of jail with the help of his crew and robs a town bank with dynamite. Cauis is cunning and bold but only human.

feats.scene: Cauis lights a bundle of sticks and the bank vault door blows off its hinges.
Cauis tumbles off a horse into dust and keeps running.

name: Ausnetar
summary: Ausnetar is a hulking dethroned monarch of a hostile alternate dimension who ambushes a resistance with a stadium full of subjects watching. Ausnetar is slain by his former rival in a final betrayal.

feats.scene: Ausnetar levels a district of the stadium city with a thunderous strike.
Ausnetar walks through a collapsing arena without a mark.

name: Ntiaunll
summary: Ntiaunll is a massive grey warlord-king, born to a royal line in a dimension of antimatter, deposed by his own father and later caged in a restraining suit. Ntiaunll loves war for its own sake and bursts like a living bomb.

feats.scene: Ntiaunll unleashes a blast that erases a fortress city in a single flash.
Ntiaunll stands unmoved in the heart of a collapsing citadel.

name: Corll
summary: Corll is a grey-skinned brute from a dimension of negative matter who raids a dam with venomous serpents whose bites turn victims to stone. Corll is beaten by two green giants.

feats.scene: Corll rips a floodgate off a dam wall and hurls it into the canyon.
Corll takes a giant's overhand blow and slides back only a few paces.

name: Iarise
summary: Iarise is a battle-hardened tyrant who joined a final alliance against a world-eating devourer. Iarise perished in the attempt, powerless to slow the colossal enemy.

feats.scene: Iarise hammers the devourer's armour with a blast that cracks a mountain range.
Iarise endures a wave of searing energy for a moment before falling.

name: Aluiumseo
summary: Aluiumseo is a blue-grey conqueror from a hostile dimension, loud and shaggy, who allies with a bug-like tyrant to invade a human city. Aluiumseo blasts with concussive force and resists punishment.

feats.scene: Aluiumseo blasts a tower lobby and its glass front collapses.
Aluiumseo tanks a crushing fall from the tower's upper floors.

name: Telneslo
summary: Telneslo is a grey-skinned lieutenant who serves an insectoid warlord during an invasion of a rival universe. Telneslo captures a rescuer to be used as a living power cell, then perishes when everything is unmade.

feats.scene: Telneslo storms a besieged colony and flattens a barricade with a heavy weapon.
Telneslo is hurled across a dock and rises unharmed.

name: Iatorvor
summary: Iatorvor is a ruling scion of a mutant colony world who flies and sends concussive bursts from both hands. Iatorvor is slain when his planet's people finally revolt.

feats.scene: Iatorvor hurls a burst from above and caves in a plaza pavilion.
Iatorvor is rocked by a rebel cannon and shakes it off.

name: Tosta
summary: Tosta is a faceless robot disguised as a firebrand, controlled by a distant operator or an onboard mind. Tosta breathes flame, jumps across great distances in an instant and incinerates evidence after each raid.

feats.scene: Tosta lets loose a gout of flame and a parked trailer melts down to slag.
Tosta is struck by a barrage of cannon fire and walks forward untouched.

name: Iatilium
summary: Iatilium is a skittish young hoodlum who can make any nearby object burst apart and cannot properly control the talent. Iatilium obeys older friends because they are his only family.

feats.scene: Iatilium panics and a stack of drums beside him detonates.
Iatilium is tossed by his own blast and lands bruised.

name: Asterin
summary: Asterin is a balding fixer who hires out monster hunters to clear creatures from an island borough. Asterin finds his plan wrecked when the wrong mercenary wins the throne of the beasts.

feats.scene: Asterin slaps a ledger onto a counter to demand results.
Asterin is jostled into a lamppost and keeps shouting.

name: Valnton
summary: Valnton is a golden collie who once worked in search and rescue and now keeps a household company. Valnton is fast on four legs and brave around smoke.

feats.scene: Valnton knocks over a stack of crates to free a trapped kitten.
Valnton sprints across a meadow to a lost child.

name: Coriumte
summary: Coriumte is a teenage mutant in a doomed timeline who draws weapons of living energy straight out of his body. Coriumte rides a mechanical steed into skirmishes against hunter machines.

feats.scene: Coriumte pulls a glowing blade from his forearm and cleaves a drone chassis in two.
Coriumte is thrown from the steed and rolls to his feet.

name: Colorvia
summary: Colorvia is a fused hero in a crossover mix of a sprinter, a flame-headed rider and a rhyming demon. Colorvia carries a blazing curse and an unmatched pace.

feats.scene: Colorvia shoots through a brick wall at full tilt and leaves a smoking tunnel.
Colorvia streaks the length of a highway in a few heartbeats.

name: Olilusne
summary: Olilusne is a silent, mock-royal parody of a tragic monarch who appears in a joke advertisement for an inking school. Olilusne is mute and has no combat training whatever.

feats.scene: Olilusne taps a pen against an easel in mime.
Olilusne is bumped by a drawing board and stays standing.

name: Siallul
summary: Siallul is a blue possum in a funny-animal swamp who talks politics until a scheming bird quits the scene in panic. Siallul has no talents beyond a loud voice.

feats.scene: Siallul swats a mosquito with a lily pad.
Siallul falls out of a tree into the mud and shakes it off.

name: Tulli
summary: Tulli is a mutated parody knight in rusted plate who skulks in subway tunnels and joins a pile of villains. Tulli is pinned to a wall by his own lance.

feats.scene: Tulli swings a lance into a tunnel pillar and chips the concrete.
Tulli takes a clout from a rival's mallet through the visor and stays up.

name: Tialesnu
summary: Tialesnu is a plain armoured rider in a goofy wedding-day manhunt, always seen with his devoted warhorse. Tialesnu is competent at jousting and nothing more.

feats.scene: Tialesnu levels a lance at a straw dummy and unseats it.
Tialesnu charges across a meadow on the horse.

name: Eolia
summary: Eolia is a mute caped crumb-fighter who patrols a rotten metropolis with a sidekick and communicates only by scribbled notes. Eolia once subdued a crook using toothpaste.

feats.scene: Eolia squeezes a giant tube onto a crook's feet to glue him down.
Eolia is bowled over by a giant typewriter key and stands up.

name: Staes
summary: Staes is a bleeding phantom born of a broken mind who feels his own wounds as other people's agony. Staes is a voodoo-like projection that haunts a foreign city and stands against rebel minds.

feats.scene: Staes cuts his own palm and every guard in the courtyard falls screaming.
Staes takes a hail of bullets and his only answer is the pain others feel.

name: Seosa
summary: Seosa is a genderless god of a litter-breeding species, honoured for noble ideals and later displayed as a trophy by conquerors. Seosa is believed to be kept as a servant in a foreign pantheon.

feats.scene: Seosa calls down a moon-shadow that ends a drought across a valley.
Seosa endures the invaders' first assault on his temple before falling.

name: Tialltar
summary: Tialltar is a yellow-eyed sentry for a corporate body-shop in orbit who is charmed into letting trespassers through. Tialltar falls in love with a stranger by mind trickery.

feats.scene: Tialltar shoves a pallet of crates across the gantry floor.
Tialltar takes a stun baton to the chest and keeps smiling.

name: Vanial
summary: Vanial is a yellow-skinned guardsman from an empire of the stars whose body is a cloud of light gas sealed in a special suit. Vanial is sent to eliminate a school of rivals.

feats.scene: Vanial inflates inside his suit and bowls over a squad of defenders.
Vanial takes a point-blank cannon shot and his suit holds firm.

name: Vesorrnu
summary: Vesorrnu is a blind sellsword who runs on belief, feeding off his own confidence and the faith of onlookers. Vesorrnu gains strength, toughness, flight and energy blasts as his reputation grows, and senses the world without sight.

feats.scene: Vesorrnu hurls an energy bolt that wrecks a stadium scoreboard.
Vesorrnu endures a punch from a rival hero and brushes it off.

name: Eoleont
summary: Eoleont is a sightless mercenary and assistant to a masked fanatic, carrying a concealed firearm inside a walking stick. Eoleont is cut down by his own employer during a bitter fallout.

feats.scene: Eoleont fires through the cane's tip and drops a streetlamp.
Eoleont is struck by a flung chair and keeps hunting by sound.

name: Anirill
summary: Anirill is a lab-grown pint-sized brawler, one of a batch of cheerful replacements brewed by a scheming tinkerer. Anirill squabbles with a pointy-hatted rival until everyone is thrown to the far edge of a toy dimension.

feats.scene: Anirill bops a rival wizard on the head with a rattle.
Anirill is flung through a wall of a play-castle and bounces up giggling.

name: Nanteo
summary: Nanteo is a green-haired arena fighter and one of three sisters who brawl for spectators in a blood-soaked amphitheatre. Nanteo pummels two intruders before the crowd.

feats.scene: Nanteo drives a spinning kick into an intruder's guard and sends him over the ropes.
Nanteo absorbs a flurry of strikes in the ring and smirks at the crowd.

name: Liale
summary: Liale is a four-armed, spiky, green hired gun who works for a gang of space smugglers. Liale is quick to a fight and dies mid-job.

feats.scene: Liale hammers a bulkhead with all four fists at once.
Liale is thrown into a cargo crate and keeps swinging.

name: Vaiuman
summary: Vaiuman is a predator of the data streams who stalks other netrunners in a far-future virtual world. Vaiuman is erased in a duel with a rival who burns bright.

feats.scene: Vaiuman severs a rival's connection with a hooked data blade.
Vaiuman shrugs off a virus spike in the grid.

name: Ernntooro
summary: Ernntooro is a cold-hearted android built by a frosty tinkerer to retrieve its maker's body and freeze it. Ernntooro charges into a pair of armoured heroes and is wrecked when it finds no corpse.

feats.scene: Ernntooro rams a laboratory door off its frame in pursuit of a corpse.
Ernntooro takes a repulsor volley and keeps walking before it falls.

name: Seaulma
summary: Seaulma is a hybrid carnival strongman born of a mashup of two comic worlds and works in a travelling circus. Seaulma shows up in a clash against a speedy hero.

feats.scene: Seaulma heaves a barbell stack in the big top.
Seaulma is flattened by a trampoline mishap and stands up.

name: Rneellsa
summary: Rneellsa is a brown-haired brawler fused from two heavy hitters, a member of a cabal of mock-divine villains. Rneellsa plows through crowds like an avalanche.

feats.scene: Rneellsa stomps and the street splits like a snapped plank.
Rneellsa walks through a divine thunderclap without slowing.

name: Liuvil
summary: Liuvil is a young mutant on a colony planet who swells to enormous size, gaining proportional might and toughness. Liuvil is one of only nine of his kind on a world of ordinary folk.

feats.scene: Liuvil grows to giant height and punches through a fortress gate.
Liuvil stands in his enlarged form while a cannon salvo bursts across his chest.

name: Rneor
summary: Rneor is a wolfish warrior, one of a pack of lupine creatures that stalks a barren landscape. Rneor is slain by a smaller rival.

feats.scene: Rneor lunges and drags a rival to the ground.
Rneor shakes off a thrown rock and snarls.

name: Eosineti
summary: Eosineti is a pair of furred brothers hired to ambush a green giant and drain his raw energy with a clamp. Eosineti reports back to the employer and is cut off when they ask about pay.

feats.scene: Eosineti pin a giant to a rooftop and clamp a siphon to his back.
Eosineti take a salvo of arrows and hold their grip.

name: Numsorlor
summary: Numsorlor is a pair of tall, scarred, leather-skinned twins who work the door of a crooked auction house on a floating junkyard. Numsorlor tosses rowdy patrons around like laundry.

feats.scene: Numsorlor lift a drunken customer and throw him across the lobby through a table.
Numsorlor take a stun blast and keep blocking the door.

name: Roticor
summary: Roticor is a furry, ridge-browed brute plucked from his home reality by a time-meddling schemer. Roticor is freed later to topple the schemer.

feats.scene: Roticor shoulder-slams a warded gate during the jailbreak.
Roticor shrugs off a net of cables.

name: Sestaleo
summary: Sestaleo is a red-eyed cult chief on a remote island who reads minds to stay ahead of every opponent and strikes at the body's weak points. Sestaleo is killed by a clawed wanderer.

feats.scene: Sestaleo jabs a nerve cluster and a guard drops.
Sestaleo reads a swing before it lands and takes only a graze.

name: Iltaise
summary: Iltaise is a low-rent crook slain by a ritual cult on a bloody rampage across the underworld. Iltaise has no known talents and exists only as a body count.

feats.scene: Iltaise shoves a stack of boxes into a pursuer's path.
Iltaise tumbles down a stairwell and limps away.

name: Tenva
summary: Tenva is a freelance fiend who forces a reaper to harvest souls, then possesses a body to wield a blade. Tenva siphons spiritual force and reanimates the dead, until an exorcism hurls him away.

feats.scene: Tenva pulls a swarm of souls into a corpse and the body tears a steel door off its track.
Tenva is pierced and burned yet only reels before being banished.

name: Larles
summary: Larles is a green-eyed hired soldier with augmented muscle, hardiness and hearing who works for a ruthless tycoon. Larles wields oversized guns and is killed in revenge.

feats.scene: Larles fires a heavy cannon and an armoured door buckles.
Larles absorbs a hit from a tough rival and stays upright.

name: Anriau
summary: Anriau is a crow-masked criminal fused from two dread villains in a crossover, who looms behind a caped detective after he beats a trio of thugs. Anriau has no displayed skills yet.

feats.scene: Anriau steps out of the dark and swings a hooked cane.
Anriau tumbles off a gargoyle and lands on his feet.

name: Cauoli
summary: Cauoli is a bionically boosted tracker from a mountain kingdom, hired to stage a mock embassy assault. Cauoli is slain by his employer to make the show look real.

feats.scene: Cauoli rips a reinforced door from its hinges with a cyber-arm.
Cauoli takes a metal-armoured fist and keeps tracking.

name: Iuvavia
summary: Iuvavia is an ancient mutated warrior of the northern gods, a servant of a slumbering serpent who died in an old assault and rose again. Iuvavia ravages a realm of the dead until sheer dread unmakes the whole band.

feats.scene: Iuvavia shatters a ghostly hall with a swing of a spectral axe.
Iuvavia endures a warrior-goddess's blessing flare and keeps marching.

name: Amantust
summary: Amantust is a loud-mouthed bruiser who muscles for criminals and is one of many small-time villains ritually slain in a killing spree. Amantust is known to the public.

feats.scene: Amantust slugs a shopkeeper who owes protection money.
Amantust withstands a bar-stool blow and laughs.

name: Lenan
summary: Lenan is a never-seen previous tenant of a villain's luxury suite who left the room splattered with evidence of grisly work. Lenan is known only by complaints about the mess.

feats.scene: Lenan drags a heavy bag across a tiled floor.
Lenan slips in his own mess and recovers.

name: Iumlerser
summary: Iumlerser is a red, three-fingered, fanged half-demon personality that surfaced from a tainted cure and seized a doctor's body. Iumlerser rampages through friends' homes until a heavy sedative stops his heart.

feats.scene: Iumlerser rips a hospital bed frame in two and hurls the halves.
Iumlerser is battered by a mystic's spell and shrugs it off for a time.

name: Cinos
summary: Cinos is a vicious warrior among frenzied maidens in the service of an underworld queen, equipped with a rapier. Cinos fences with ruthless poise.

feats.scene: Cinos lunges and pins a cloak to a pillar with the rapier.
Cinos is flung against a brick wall and reorients at once.

name: Vacori
summary: Vacori is a guerrilla fighter of a foreign army in a mountain war who raids supply depots to blow them apart. Vacori is taken prisoner after a child distracts her at the wrong moment.

feats.scene: Vacori plants satchel charges and a supply shed erupts.
Vacori is bowled over by a rifle butt and keeps shouting orders.

name: Tiucovo
summary: Tiucovo is a pale-skinned storm spirit riding a mortal host who claims the whole sky as his domain. Tiucovo whips up winds and flame-fed gales, then escapes a defeat with a captive in tow.

feats.scene: Tiucovo twists a gale into a spinning funnel that tears a barn off its footing.
Tiucovo is caught in a rival's lightning and merely smoulders.

name: Valnto
summary: Valnto is a teenage mutant bully and leader of boys in a cult-run shelter who mocks newcomers and calls on others for help. Valnto vanishes once the cult collapses.

feats.scene: Valnto shoves a smaller boy against a bunk.
Valnto is flung aside by a winged rescuer and gets up crying.

name: Ornva
summary: Ornva is a blue-skinned warlord who took up his fallen father's blade and led an army of a hundred champions into a hellish realm. Ornva built an ivory tower that has never fallen.

feats.scene: Ornva carves a swordstroke through a rampart of demons and the keep behind it.
Ornva stands on the tower wall under a barrage and does not budge.

name: Ellnesten
summary: Ellnesten is a white-haired student of mystic arts who helps guard a sanctum against monsters. Ellnesten casts a containment spell that fails when a huge scaly beast falls on her.

feats.scene: Ellnesten weaves a glowing net that pins a scaled monster for a breath.
Ellnesten is struck by a rebounding spell and staggers.

name: Eolsiure
summary: Eolsiure is a winged young hero summoned along with other children by a bald teacher. Eolsiure is a fan-given nickname for a child of two famous parents and flies on feathered wings.

feats.scene: Eolsiure dives and knocks a kite from a bully's hands.
Eolsiure glides in a steep dive over the courtyard.

name: Valeol
summary: Valeol is a newborn colossal cosmic being, one aspect of a single vast mind spread across many realities, whose purpose is to hold a planet-sized glutton at bay. Valeol joins its elders in a combined onslaught on a still greater creature.

feats.scene: Valeol brings down a world-sized monster with a single crushing grip.
Valeol absorbs the dying blast of a collapsing moon without flinching.

name: Lonmeium
summary: Lonmeium is a young state-sponsored hero who flies on artificial blue wings and carries goggles and a pair of sidearms. Lonmeium helps defend a famous cracked bell from flag-burners.

feats.scene: Lonmeium dives and clips a terrorist's rifle out of his grasp.
Lonmeium banks hard over the city on stiff wings.

name: Eolva
summary: Eolva is a minor member of a swollen team of goofy heroes who introduces himself in a long line of teammates. Eolva has no known powers.

feats.scene: Eolva waves and knocks over a paper cup.
Eolva trips on a cape and bounces.

name: Ntuamalli
summary: Ntuamalli is a blue giant of a cartoonish team who bickers with a red cousin over who can make the larger splash. Ntuamalli loses the contest to a green rival.

feats.scene: Ntuamalli leaps into a lake and sends a wave over the pier.
Ntuamalli is struck by a falling billboard and is only annoyed.

name: Llamtu
summary: Llamtu is a blue-feathered bird-person made in a cruel lab, working as a mail carrier on a copy of a world. Llamtu dies when his home is blown up by its creator.

feats.scene: Llamtu pecks a locked mailbox open with his beak.
Llamtu is bowled over by a parcel cart and stands up.

name: Meotestan
summary: Meotestan is a plotting sorcerer who seized power over one faction of a council of wizards in a distant eastern land. Meotestan perishes in a rival's counter-strike.

feats.scene: Meotestan hurls a ball of azure fire that collapses a tower balcony.
Meotestan survives a rival's lightning bolt for a few breaths.

name: Tiatanaun
summary: Tiatanaun is a defender of a fantasy realm who stays home to guard the borders when a captain assembles a rescue party. Tiatanaun is a counterpart of a gem-themed hero from elsewhere.

feats.scene: Tiatanaun smashes a battering ram with a war-hammer.
Tiatanaun holds a shield wall against a charging horse.

name: Arresli
summary: Arresli is a mind-reaching prisoner who infiltrated a mountain jail with three allies to undermine the guards. Arresli drives one inmate to attack his teammates and blocks others from remembering a simple fix.

feats.scene: Arresli turns an inmate against his allies with a whispered thought.
Arresli is kicked in a scuffle and shakes it off.

name: Iumvaltes
summary: Iumvaltes is a stern parody general who rules a sanitation department of the army and bullies a scientist about smog. Iumvaltes has a daughter who dates the scientist.

feats.scene: Iumvaltes bangs a fist on a desk and a pen jumps.
Iumvaltes falls out of a jeep and brushes off his uniform.

name: Irmar
summary: Irmar is a goo-bodied club bouncer with antennae, pointed ears and reptile feet who leaps long distances and reshapes his arms into guns. Irmar fights a body-hopping killer and loses.

feats.scene: Irmar morphs his arms into cannons and blasts a mutant through a window.
Irmar absorbs a bullet in his gooey chest and keeps standing.

name: Ntuleles
summary: Ntuleles is a short-legged hooligan in a band of oddball outcasts who carries a hooked chain. Ntuleles fights alongside a bandit leader.

feats.scene: Ntuleles whips the hooked chain around a lamp post and yanks it over.
Ntuleles is knocked off a cart and bounces up.

name: Celrni
summary: Celrni is a cheerful, excitable orange-furred alien critter who first served as a mascot to a band of scavengers. Celrni later joins a ragtag team against a mad creator of living experiments.

feats.scene: Celrni bites a guard's boot and tears loose a strap.
Celrni is batted across a corridor and bounces back, wagging.

name: Amorrau
summary: Amorrau is a merc once shaped like a squid-roach alien until a mean enchantress shrank him to a dwarf-sized form. Amorrau moves faster than the eye can follow.

feats.scene: Amorrau streaks past a guard and slashes the strap of his helmet.
Amorrau zips across a courtyard before an alarm finishes ringing.

name: Ororiaull
summary: Ororiaull is a third-eyed resident of a gentle world who planned a wedding and a posting to a defence fleet. Ororiaull is a faithful social-network user who dies when her planet is devoured by a hungry moon.

feats.scene: Ororiaull tosses a bouquet over her shoulder.
Ororiaull tumbles off a stool and laughs.

name: Letiu
summary: Letiu is a red-eyed monarch of a floating wilderness whose body is made of crystal. Letiu raised a son with a mossy swamp-dweller and visits her child's school on festival days.

feats.scene: Letiu clenches a crystal fist and shatters a boulder in her throne room.
Letiu is hit by a collapsing arch and the stones scatter off her facets.

name: Iarliustu
summary: Iarliustu is a red-haired bodyguard and weapons specialist who trusts her crime-lord boss and wields a long staff, a knife and ringed fists. Iarliustu once cut a young sorceress to coax a magic rod out of her.

feats.scene: Iarliustu cracks the staff across a pillar and the plaster flies.
Iarliustu takes a rod blow to the ribs and stays in the fight.

name: Larniri
summary: Larniri is a tough crime boss who drives a heavily armed vehicle he calls a terror machine and carves out a gang's territory. Larniri dies in a clash with a vigilante.

feats.scene: Larniri fires the vehicle's main gun and a block of storefronts collapses.
Larniri sits in the armoured cab as a barrage rattles the hull.

name: Tirruni
summary: Tirruni is a blonde stage performer at a film lot who mistakes a visiting millionaire for her co-star. Tirruni is bubbly and ordinary and never leaves the soundstage.

feats.scene: Tirruni pats a visitor's shoulder with surprising enthusiasm.
Tirruni trips on a prop cable and hops up smiling.

name: Ntiine
summary: Ntiine is a gilded automaton who joined a ragged band of rebels resisting a tyrant ruler millennia from now. Its main contribution is steady marksmanship with a handheld beam weapon.

feats.scene: Ntiine fires a sustained beam that burns through a bulkhead door in a single sweep.
Ntiine shrugs off a ricochet that dents its gold plating without slowing its stride.

name: Tiasan
summary: Tiasan is a night-shift guard in a high-security prison who watches a bank of cell monitors. He is knocked out from afar by a scheming inmate and never gets a chance to fight back.

feats.scene: Tiasan swings a baton at a rattling cell door.
Tiasan collapses to the floor after a remote shock without suffering lasting harm.

name: Ntsose
summary: Ntsose is a burly criminal boss who runs a smuggling ring and trains daily with hired muscle. He is eventually chased down in a wrecked car and hauled off by the law.

feats.scene: Ntsose flattens a sparring partner with a looping right hand.
Ntsose climbs out of a rocket-struck car with scrapes and a bad temper.

name: Lumni
summary: Lumni is a blue-skinned child born into a demonic scheme, used with other infants as a living channel to hold a gateway between realms open. He cannot shut the flow off, and it rattles his small body.

feats.scene: Lumni unwittingly channels a surge that tears a ragged rift in the sky above a crowded square.
Lumni endures the full burn of the rift without a mark on his skin.

name: Nauure
summary: Nauure is a broadcast preacher who whips up crowds against a group he blames for a plague. He has no powers, only a loud voice and an unshakable conviction.

feats.scene: Nauure slams a fist on the pulpit to punctuate a sermon.
Nauure stumbles on a stage step and shakes it off.

name: Tenumrir
summary: Tenumrir is a slight, fair-haired schoolboy who fancies himself an explorer and tags along on small adventures. His talents are limited to sports and persistence.

feats.scene: Tenumrir throws a rock across a creek to land on the far bank.
Tenumrir sprints across a field to beat a closing gate.

name: Valrni
summary: Valrni is the village physician in a decaying future settlement, handed down his post along with a secret about the machine that rules the town. He gradually learns the truth when an outsider opens the townsfolk's eyes.

feats.scene: Valrni shoves a heavy cabinet across a clinic floor to block a door.
Valrni is thrown against a wall by a lurching machine and gets up bruised.

name: Iumvalst
summary: Iumvalst is a soft-spoken minister who gathers neighbours in a church basement to talk through how a masked vigilante has changed their lives. He never raises a hand to anyone.

feats.scene: Iumvalst pushes open a stuck basement door with his shoulder.
Iumvalst trips on a loose stair and lands hard without breaking anything.

name: Eoconum
summary: Eoconum is a timid, divorced handyman who drifts between criminal outfits and odd jobs, usually at the heels of a louder partner. He survives on luck, cowardice and a talent for being underestimated.

feats.scene: Eoconum clumsily lands a punch that sends a guard sprawling.
Eoconum falls from a second-storey window into a hedge and complains about it.

name: Amiontni
summary: Amiontni is a subordinate in a criminal outfit whose members all copy a famous bumbling recruit. He has no abilities beyond following orders.

feats.scene: Amiontni lobs a crate onto a loading dock with a grunt.
Amiontni takes a thrown chair to the back and keeps walking.

name: Limirni
summary: Limirni is a rank-and-file soldier of a global regime, stranded far from his home timeline. He relies on a rifle and drilled discipline.

feats.scene: Limirni empties a rifle clip into a barricade and shreds its planks.
Limirni is thrown from a hovering vehicle and rolls to his feet.

name: Alluco
summary: Alluco is an armed sentry who once served a patriotic militia and now patrols wherever he is posted. Little is known beyond his steady, unremarkable service.

feats.scene: Alluco clubs a trespasser with a rifle butt.
Alluco shakes off a fall from a low wall.

name: Iumoru
summary: Iumoru is an ordinary resident of a sleepy small town who phones in a report after a neighbour dies. He is a bystander in a story that turns eerie around him.

feats.scene: Iumoru slams a phone receiver down in alarm.
Iumoru bumps into a lamppost running home and shrugs it off.

name: Lorvant
summary: Lorvant is a rural lawman who watches a bridge collapse and rushes to help the stranded driver. He is cut down by killers who should not have been able to stand.

feats.scene: Lorvant drags a limp driver clear of twisted metal.
Lorvant is flattened by a flung vehicle and still hauls himself upright.

name: Covean
summary: Covean is a mild bookkeeper who also belongs to a terror outfit, mistaken for a more famous friend by a prisoner on the run. He is silenced before he can raise an alarm.

feats.scene: Covean reaches for an alarm button with a clumsy lunge.
Covean stumbles over a desk during the scramble and keeps going.

name: Iarosan
summary: Iarosan is a famous third baseman who retires from the game to play masked hero, copying a retired legend. His first rooftop swing ends in a wall and a hurt arm.

feats.scene: Iarosan hurls a circular shield and clangs it off a fire escape.
Iarosan slams into a brick wall mid-swing and survives with an injured arm.

name: Amtelor
summary: Amtelor is a neighbour who scoffs at the idea of a miracle diet tonic being cooked up next door. He is an ordinary man in a small-town tale with a twist.

feats.scene: Amtelor waves off a fence post with a casual shove.
Amtelor gets knocked off a porch chair and laughs about it.

name: Tusserro
summary: Tusserro is an agent of a time-policing squad who follows a rogue criminal across timelines. He is brisk, loyal and utterly confident that the cosmos owes his unit a debt.

feats.scene: Tusserro triggers a hand device that tears open a short-lived time gap in an alley.
Tusserro tumbles through a closing gap and lands unharmed.

name: Orsosium
summary: Orsosium is a polite light-projection servant that answered messages and kept a recluse's schedule until he left. It has no body to fight with and nothing to strike.

feats.scene: Orsosium flickers on a lamp and sweeps a bright projected arm across a desk.
Orsosium holds its shape when someone waves a hand straight through it.

name: Rniteo
summary: Rniteo is a green-skinned bruiser who collects rent with her clan by force in a ruined future. Her strength is enormous, but her tactics rely on beating people down.

feats.scene: Rniteo slams her fists on a chassis and caves in a heavy hover wagon.
Rniteo walks through a collapsing wall without losing her stride.

name: Loreo
summary: Loreo is a green-skinned enforcer who leans on a farmer for rent, baby in tow, while her clan watches. She is said to have brute strength matching her relatives.

feats.scene: Loreo drives a tractor-sized wagon through a barn wall with a shove.
Loreo is thrown through a fence and bounces up laughing.

name: Autiate
summary: Autiate is a hotel porter who asks a guest a handful of friendly questions for a quick cash reward. He is unaware he has been working for the very man he was spying on.

feats.scene: Autiate heaves a heavy serving trolley through a service corridor.
Autiate bumps a doorframe hurrying away and feels nothing.

name: Ciresses
summary: Ciresses is a concertgoer who swallows a shape-changing drug and blunders into a brawl. He keeps changing form until he becomes a mouse and is trampled.

feats.scene: Ciresses swells into a lumpy brute and shoves a barrier aside.
Ciresses takes a hard punch to the chest while mid-change.

name: Nurir
summary: Nurir is a low-level crook on a crime lord's payroll who ribs a coworker for a peculiar gift. He is mentioned only in passing.

feats.scene: Nurir shoves a crate of goods onto a delivery van.
Nurir is bowled over by a rolling barrel and grumbles.

name: Ontterau
summary: Ontterau is a small boy at the shore whose parent covers his eyes at a sight she finds improper. He is a passing face in a beach scene.

feats.scene: Ontterau flings a handful of wet sand at a gull.
Ontterau tumbles in the surf and pops up giggling.

name: Revonau
summary: Revonau is a schoolboy who points at a figure overhead and quibbles with a friend over its costume. He is a harmless city onlooker.

feats.scene: Revonau kicks a soda can along a pavement.
Revonau runs after his friend to keep up on the sidewalk.

name: Siarontir
summary: Siarontir is a farm child called home by a worried parent when a rampaging monster approaches. His family is later pulled from a burning house by that very creature.

feats.scene: Siarontir tugs a stubborn gate shut behind his brother.
Siarontir coughs through smoke and keeps running.

name: Elontrnu
summary: Elontrnu is a newborn infant held at gunpoint during a diner robbery. A stranger passing through takes down the gang for him.

feats.scene: Elontrnu kicks a blanket off with tiny feet.
Elontrnu cries but sleeps through the commotion unharmed.

name: Aulorlia
summary: Aulorlia is an asylum attendant who torments a patient with shock equipment, only to be zapped senseless when the tables turn. The patient pictures him as a beast, but he is just a bully.

feats.scene: Aulorlia hauls a restrained patient onto a gurney.
Aulorlia is dropped by a surge of current and wakes later with a headache.

name: Sttetas
summary: Sttetas is a mountain-country police officer posted to guard a summit of diplomats. He keeps order as chaos breaks out and giant robots arrive.

feats.scene: Sttetas fires a service pistol at a charging machine.
Sttetas is thrown by a shock wave and pulls himself up behind cover.

name: Anvel
summary: Anvel is a boy absorbed in a magazine alongside his father while alien impostors swap out the family television. He never notices the change.

feats.scene: Anvel turns a page and tosses the magazine on a couch.
Anvel falls off the couch laughing and is fine.

name: Riuscor
summary: Riuscor is a keen young intern who loves spy stories and uses a hunch to trap a swindler in a back room. He locks the door and waits for a federal agent.

feats.scene: Riuscor shoves a swindler into a storeroom and slams the door.
Riuscor gets shoved against a filing cabinet and holds his ground.

name: Tumsini
summary: Tumsini is a family man with a wife and daughter who is cornered by an assassin and forced to give up a hiding place. His story ends badly a few chapters later.

feats.scene: Tumsini swings a fist wildly at an intruder.
Tumsini is slammed into a kitchen counter and stays conscious.

name: Tiunaiu
summary: Tiunaiu is a blond street thug who works for a politician and joins a pack beating a stranger. A masked climber leaves him unconscious on the pavement.

feats.scene: Tiunaiu lands a punch on a victim's jaw.
Tiunaiu takes a crushing blow to the head and drops.

name: Sertor
summary: Sertor is a young mutant who slips out of his body as a ghostly form and takes over strangers, gaining their memories. He is hired to track a girl and has to fix his mistake.

feats.scene: Sertor possesses a bystander and throws a punch with borrowed muscle.
Sertor is ejected from a host and shakes off the sudden memory loss.

name: Aultuon
summary: Aultuon is one of a gang of runaways who squat in a shuttered bank and shelter a girl from the lab that hurt her. He is brave but entirely ordinary.

feats.scene: Aultuon swings a pipe at a scientist's lock.
Aultuon is shoved down a flight of stairs and gets back up.

name: Lonnoni
summary: Lonnoni is a senior officer who helps plan a clandestine operation to capture a vigilante. Without combat experience, he is gunned down with his colleagues.

feats.scene: Lonnoni bangs a conference table to demand quiet.
Lonnoni falls out of his chair in shock and is uninjured.

name: Caute
summary: Caute leads a small gang of thieves with razor-tipped gloves and a gymnast's agility. Armoured vans are his usual targets until a bowman and a rival crew spoil his luck.

feats.scene: Caute slashes through the side of a canvas mailbag with his glove blades.
Caute vaults a car and dashes away over a rooftop.

name: Luinarni
summary: Luinarni is a talking wildcat who hosts a game show with a gigantic marine mammal for a prop. The entry is a comic parody of a human host.

feats.scene: Luinarni slaps a buzzer to start a round.
Luinarni is hit with a pie and keeps smiling.

name: Iumamavi
summary: Iumamavi is one of a very large family of street gangsters, a brother to many who all end up dead. He is killed by an avenging gunman.

feats.scene: Iumamavi swings a bat into a warehouse crate.
Iumamavi tumbles down a loading ramp and spits out blood.

name: Tiatustil
summary: Tiatustil is a towering, horned divinity of war with many arms and claws, raised in a hidden hall of old deities. His rule over a dark winter makes him as feared as respected.

feats.scene: Tiatustil brings all of his arms down on a battlefield and scatters an army and a hillside.
Tiatustil stands unflinching as a landslide of stone crashes into him.

name: Ransirn
summary: Ransirn is a crimson-skinned fiend shaped by the belief of mortals, possibly an alien rewritten into a legend. It appears to a hero as a nightmare from old tales.

feats.scene: Ransirn smashes a stone bridge in half with one swipe.
Ransirn endures a collapsing tower without a scratch.

name: Enest
summary: Enest is a winged, scaly, beaked creature from a strange realm who robs a corner shop to teach people that life is unpredictable. It helps rehabilitate a fellow thief.

feats.scene: Enest rakes talons across a shop shutter and rips it from the wall.
Enest flaps off with a bag of loot in a swift low glide.

name: Caucor
summary: Caucor is a green-skinned shop-raider who bonds with an alien parasite and gains fangs and claws. He scares trespassers in an abandoned store until a rival impales him.

feats.scene: Caucor rips a steel door from its hinges with his clawed hands.
Caucor shrugs off a swing of a heavy pipe while bonded.

name: Corrnst
summary: Corrnst is a fanged, scaly predator from a strange realm who lunges at shopkeepers in his assigned store. He joins a small group to help reform a fellow raider.

feats.scene: Corrnst bites through a shop counter and shatters its edge.
Corrnst is rammed by a delivery truck and snaps at it.

name: Eosiva
summary: Eosiva is a masked corner-shop thief working in a big city, hiding behind a secret identity. He slips out before the shopkeeper can react.

feats.scene: Eosiva smashes a display case with an elbow.
Eosiva bolts down an alley with a sack of cash.

name: Aunlus
summary: Aunlus is a black-market gun seller in a crowded city who goes looking for a pair of rogue lawmen. A vigilante ends his career for good.

feats.scene: Aunlus slams a crate of weapons shut and kicks it across a floor.
Aunlus is thrown onto a table and splinters it.

name: Tiaortan
summary: Tiaortan is an iron-fisted king of a small mountain realm who hoards riches taken from his subjects. A coup topples his castle, and he is more sour than grateful when rescued.

feats.scene: Tiaortan slaps a servant across the face in a fit of temper.
Tiaortan is hauled from rubble after his keep collapses and is merely bruised.

name: Aussi
summary: Aussi is a gate guard at a research company who is told to watch for a particular visitor. He does little beyond standing at the entrance and radioing ahead.

feats.scene: Aussi shoves a turnstile bar to stop a trespasser.
Aussi is knocked off his stool by a swinging door and shrugs.

name: Rosriasan
summary: Rosriasan is a greedy, tight-fisted aristocrat who tries to cheat his own sibling's funeral. He is torn apart by creatures in a burial vault.

feats.scene: Rosriasan swings a torch at lurching shapes in a crypt.
Rosriasan is flung against a tomb wall and gasps for air.

name: Lenuval
summary: Lenuval is a politician in a besieged future city who helps build mechanical guardians to hold off a tyrant's armies. He argues about strategy with allies and plans a bold strike.

feats.scene: Lenuval pounds a council table to demand a vote.
Lenuval is bowled over by an assassin's blast and rises shaken.

name: Eoorcos
summary: Eoorcos is a ruthless industrialist and engineer who steals a pair of researchers' work for weapons. He sends robots to hunt people marked by a gene, and his scheme backfires.

feats.scene: Eoorcos orders a robot strike that destroys a parked truck.
Eoorcos is thrown across an office and gets up slowly.

name: Soaul
summary: Soaul is the nervous engineer in a team of heroic scientists who always insists their schemes will get everyone killed. He builds a giant fighting machine that fails against a dragon.

feats.scene: Soaul pilots a towering machine whose punch craters a street.
Soaul's machine takes a fiery blast and keeps standing for a moment.

name: Ennisor
summary: Ennisor is a wealthy scientist who warns that a rival kind of people will rise and wipe out the rest, and builds hunter machines to prepare. A shape-changing woman targets him for revenge.

feats.scene: Ennisor orders a prototype to flatten a steel locker with one strike.
Ennisor is shoved to the floor by an attacker and scrambles up.

name: Rnliuull
summary: Rnliuull is an inventor who unleashes killer machines on a group of gifted teens after a cover-up goes wrong. His pursuit is relentless but his own body is plain.

feats.scene: Rnliuull sends his machines to blast a hole through a rooftop.
Rnliuull is knocked from his feet by the shock and stands again.

name: Nustmo
summary: Nustmo is a scholar whose brain is placed into a mutant-hunting machine, later waking and plotting revenge. He spreads a machine-making virus and scorpion-like drones through a school.

feats.scene: Nustmo drives a drone swarm through a laboratory wall in one coordinated rush.
Nustmo's frame withstands a collapsing ceiling before it finally gives way.

name: Ortuses
summary: Ortuses is a pale tinkerer who builds towering hunter robots to purge a minority. He perishes trying to destroy what he made.

feats.scene: Ortuses detonates a charge that buckles a metal gate.
Ortuses survives a close blast long enough to run for the lever.

name: Osuoli
summary: Osuoli is a grey-haired scholar of human origins who meets with officials to debate a strange attack. He insists that the explanation must be natural, not magical.

feats.scene: Osuoli taps a briefing table to make a point.
Osuoli stumbles from a rattling room and brushes himself off.

name: Iaorivia
summary: Iaorivia is a scientist who quits a secret agency and builds a hunting machine for a population he fears, testing it on a captive. Prison and a later pardon follow, then robots fall to a rival.

feats.scene: Iaorivia orders his machine to crush a car door at a single stroke.
Iaorivia is thrown against a cell wall and keeps talking.

name: Stacaltas
summary: Stacaltas is a grey-haired tycoon who steals a cancer-fighting suit to turn into a weapon and sets a hired team on a student. He panics and flees up to a helipad.

feats.scene: Stacaltas shoves a table at a bodyguard in panic.
Stacaltas is swatted aside by a creature and rolls across the helipad.

name: Cesau
summary: Cesau is a bald, black-eyed official who runs a domestic security department and pursues new weapons for use against a group of gifted people. He is cold and procedural.

feats.scene: Cesau slams a folder on a desk to end a meeting.
Cesau walks away from a rattled doorway without a scratch.

name: Leeos
summary: Leeos is the head of a hunter-machine company who is shot in a foreign capital after trying to build a weapons programme. His death helps set the programme in motion.

feats.scene: Leeos orders a prototype to fell a tree with one swing.
Leeos is struck by a thrown object and recovers his footing.

name: Eonsiunt
summary: Eonsiunt is a bald robot built as a copy of a fast hero, programmed with his habits and armed with advanced tech. It defends a capital until a skull-faced invader scraps it.

feats.scene: Eonsiunt blurs through a column and hits it hard enough to crack it in half.
Eonsiunt streaks across a plaza too fast for the eye to track.

name: Amviam
summary: Amviam is a gigantic, ancient being from the earliest age of the cosmos, remembered mainly as an ancestor of heavenly rulers. He appears only in distant lineage.

feats.scene: Amviam hurls a boulder-sized spear that flattens a valley.
Amviam shrugs off the collapse of a mountain ridge on top of him.

name: Ortes
summary: Ortes is a famous kitchen showman with a sharp tongue who sabotages a rival in a secret cooking duel and spoils his own dish. He apologises later.

feats.scene: Ortes chops a melon in half with a flourish.
Ortes slips on a spill and lands on his rear.

name: Llineama
summary: Llineama is a small, blue-eyed robot servant to a villainous machine, a wide-eyed henchbot with no great skill. It tags along for schemes.

feats.scene: Llineama bashes a cardboard stack with a metal arm.
Llineama is knocked flat by a bright pulse and reboots.

name: Tiunior
summary: Tiunior is a test subject in a secret programme that creates gifted fighters, and he gets by on quick reflexes and a name taken from his job. He lives in a hidden compound.

feats.scene: Tiunior throws a trained punch that dents a locker.
Tiunior bounds along a corridor past a pair of guards.

name: Lieoltes
summary: Lieoltes is a knight in a glowing suit of armour that keeps him alive and makes him all but unkillable, though only outside the stronghold. He attacks a fiery heroine on sight.

feats.scene: Lieoltes smashes down a stone wall with a single armoured fist.
Lieoltes stands unharmed in the middle of a blast that levels the street.

name: Onnton
summary: Onnton is a burly professional grappler who takes part in a promotional match and loses to a younger challenger. He is strong but entirely human.

feats.scene: Onnton slams a rival onto the canvas with a bodyslam.
Onnton is thrown against a cage and gets up grinning.

name: Vaianti
summary: Vaianti is a brown-haired mercenary in a hunting party sent after a runaway girl. He is dispatched in a brutal firefight.

feats.scene: Vaianti fires a burst that chews a hole in a door.
Vaianti is flung into a truck and wheezes upright.

name: Seoanter
summary: Seoanter is a terrorist and brainwasher whose legs are replaced by a motorised tread chassis. He is cut down by his former victim.

feats.scene: Seoanter rams a metal gate with his tracked base and rips it off.
Seoanter takes a rifle burst on his plating and keeps rolling.

name: Valllern
summary: Valllern is an orange-haired, partly mechanical brawler who helps an extremist leader in a side-scrolling brawl. He is a regular fixture of an arcade game.

feats.scene: Valllern clubs a crate with a cybernetic fist and splinters it.
Valllern absorbs a heavy kick and slides back a few feet.

name: Rosvaar
summary: Rosvaar is a red-skinned giant with four arms, a belly eye and a mouth in his upper arm who serves a serpent god across ages. He swallows a warrior and is brought down only by a team's combined effort.

feats.scene: Rosvaar pounds the ground with all four arms and opens a pit.
Rosvaar is torn open from inside and keeps fighting.

name: Rnrnma
summary: Rnrnma is a grey, hairless killer for a crime syndicate who gains monstrous strength and a hide that bullets cannot pierce. He is kept under control with drugs and raw food.

feats.scene: Rnrnma drives a fist through a vehicle's roof and crumples its frame.
Rnrnma lets a hail of bullets bounce harmlessly off his body.

name: Aulcoscau
summary: Aulcoscau is an extremely tall, thin carnival boss with strawberry hair who persuades a relative to headline his show. He is cheerful, lanky and fully human.

feats.scene: Aulcoscau pulls a tent pole upright with long arms.
Aulcoscau topples off a stilt and lands on sawdust.

name: Ontamaama
summary: Ontamaama is a champion wrestler on a rookie contest show who is beaten by a mystery contender. He is an experienced pro with a brown beard.

feats.scene: Ontamaama throws a rival over his shoulder in a flipping slam.
Ontamaama is flipped onto the mat and ends the round dazed.

name: Sortiu
summary: Sortiu is a small-time hoodlum who hopes to join a crime family and tails a gunman to an occult sanctum, then gives away the location. He ends up lending his car at gunpoint.

feats.scene: Sortiu slams a car door in a panic.
Sortiu is dragged from a driver's seat and takes the fall.

name: Tolaun
summary: Tolaun is a grey, red-eyed ape who helps track down a warlord's former officers. He is strong for an animal and quiet among the group.

feats.scene: Tolaun hurls a crate across a warehouse.
Tolaun takes a heavy blow to the ribs and growls.

name: Tencen
summary: Tencen is a dark-haired heroine from a bleak alternative ending who is slain along with her whole team. Her body is later put on show by a conquering ruler.
