feats.scene: Tencen throws a blazing strike that scorches a stone wall.
Tencen endures a heavy blast before finally falling.

name: Tiunoaun
summary: Tiunoaun is a blonde woman who hires a fighter as a date for her class reunion, then knocks him out with a chair so an admirer in costume can get away. She is a schemer, not a fighter.

feats.scene: Tiunoaun swings a chair at a head and connects.
Tiunoaun is nudged aside in a scuffle and keeps her balance.

name: Siros
summary: Siros is the head of a violent bayou militia that hunts and tortures gifted people. Her group is wiped out in the swamps by the very man they were paid to catch.

feats.scene: Siros fires a shotgun that splinters a dock post.
Siros wades through a swamp after taking a beating and keeps going.

name: Eolseria
summary: Eolseria is a blond attorney who works for a weapons magnate and handles his legal affairs. He plays no part in the fighting.

feats.scene: Eolseria snaps a briefcase shut and tosses it on a desk.
Eolseria trips in a lobby and brushes off his suit.

name: Numrn
summary: Numrn is a black-haired spellcaster and hired gun who carries a sentient book of spells. He serves a corrupt employer in a four-person crew.

feats.scene: Numrn reads a spell that explodes a parked car.
Numrn is thrown through a window and shakes it off.

name: Lisma
summary: Lisma is a green, paper-eating creature that creeps into reading rooms, classrooms and sweet shops to devour volumes. It escapes before it can be caught.

feats.scene: Lisma chomps through a stack of books in a moment.
Lisma wriggles out of a window ahead of its pursuers.

name: Seren
summary: Seren is a stone-hard alien killer who works with a partner and is sent to a distant planet to avenge a defeat. Both are killed by sniper fire while the enemy bluffs.

feats.scene: Seren punches a hovering barge and tears its hull open.
Seren takes a barrage of cannon fire on his dense hide before a sniper bolt kills him.

name: Aulterin
summary: Aulterin is an orange-skinned outcast and father who can make objects burst just by focusing on them. He lives among a band of rejected misfits.

feats.scene: Aulterin concentrates and a parked truck bursts apart.
Aulterin is thrown across a room and recovers.

name: Niasttas
summary: Niasttas is a former pop singer turned government killer, one of three brothers with gifts. He later leads a secret group that fights a cabal.

feats.scene: Niasttas unleashes a shock that wrecks a stage and shatters its lights.
Niasttas takes a hard hit and stays upright.

name: Nentiaaul
summary: Nentiaaul is a quiet heavenly being who polishes shoes in a city and seems to read minds. When a cruel tycoon refuses to pay, he makes the man's footwear walk off with him.

feats.scene: Nentiaaul sends a pair of shoes marching a customer away down the street.
Nentiaaul takes a shove from an angry customer and does not stumble.

name: Osevos
summary: Osevos is a legendary elder invoked by name only, a storied ancestor whom a descendant calls upon in battle. Little is shown of him directly.

feats.scene: Osevos is said to have cleaved a hill from its base with one blow.
Osevos stood against a storm of fire and hammers without kneeling.

name: Noseoltol
summary: Noseoltol is the half-giant, half-celestial patriarch of a royal house, known only as a parent and a figure from old stories. He is referenced in a fighting game's lore.

feats.scene: Noseoltol hurls a lance that levels a hillside fort.
Noseoltol withstands a fall of burning boulders.

name: Renlltia
summary: Renlltia is an ancient ruler of a sky-city, mentioned only as the parent of a king. His legend is small but his bloodline is mighty.

feats.scene: Renlltia strikes the ground and splits a courtyard.
Renlltia endures a tower's collapse and walks out of the dust.

name: Viran
summary: Viran is a long-dead sovereign recalled in a comic parody as a father of kings. He appears only in a passing line.

feats.scene: Viran swings a great axe and brings down a gatehouse.
Viran stands firm in a rain of stones without flinching.

name: Vinteos
summary: Vinteos is a dead king who once cursed warrior maidens in his service and so created a cursed order of fallen riders. He has a brother and descendants, but his own deeds are known only by rumour.

feats.scene: Vinteos speaks a curse that scorches a line of armoured riders into ash.
Vinteos survives a blast that crumbles his own throne room.

name: Nessista
summary: Nessista is a stern lab director who guards a sprawling hillside estate and a stack of unfinished experiments. Nessista trusts ledgers over people and pays for it in lonely evenings.

feats.scene: Nessista hurls a heavy ledger across the lab and cracks a glass cabinet.
Nessista tumbles down a flight of stairs and walks away bruised.

name: Tirst
summary: Tirst is a rumored patriarch known only through the whispers of descendants who disagree about him. Tirst may never have existed as told, yet every retelling adds another stubborn habit.

feats.scene: Tirst shoves a stuck cart wheel free in a muddy lane.

name: Larvel
summary: Larvel is a street-smart bus-station clerk who left a painful hometown and rebuilt a quiet life among strangers. Larvel keeps a cracked radio on the counter and a spare key under the stamp pad.

feats.scene: Larvel slams a ticket window shut on a pushy customer.
Larvel takes a hard fall on wet concrete and gets up laughing.

name: Stunau
summary: Stunau is a polished dealmaker with a steel arm brace and a grudge she hides behind courtesy. Stunau plays long games with orbiting hideouts and expects everyone to be a pawn.

feats.scene: Stunau snaps a thick conference table edge with the brace in a temper.
Stunau shrugs off a tumbling shelf of ledgers.

name: Tescorntu
summary: Tescorntu is a grey, many-armed brawler who fights like a falling wall. Tescorntu loves collapsing masonry right up until it collapses on him.

feats.scene: Tescorntu punches through a brick wall with two fists at once.
Tescorntu takes a delivery truck in the ribs and keeps swinging.

name: Nestarcor
summary: Nestarcor is a pale, sharp-toothed patient whose rebuilt body keeps betraying the calm behind her eyes. Nestarcor climbs sheer walls at night and heals from wounds that should have kept her down.

feats.scene: Nestarcor tears a steel door from its frame in one pull.
Nestarcor survives a collision with a speeding van and stands up again.
Nestarcor bolts across a courtyard faster than a sprinting horse.

name: Tenieo
summary: Tenieo is a veteran monastery fighter who channels inner breath into quick, precise strikes. Tenieo was undone by a rival from her own circle.

feats.scene: Tenieo drives a palm into a stone pillar and splits it.
Tenieo endures a flaming blow that blackens her robes.

name: Tiuste
summary: Tiuste is an ancient green-skinned warrior covered in thorns who can bruise a storm deity. Tiuste lives for centuries and loves a fair brawl more than any prize.

feats.scene: Tiuste backhands a stone tower and topples its upper floors.
Tiuste lets a lightning-wreathed hammer strike her chest and only smiles.

name: Liuna
summary: Liuna is a small lab monkey who swells into a muscular brute when frightened. Liuna later found peace behind the wheel of a battered riverboat.

feats.scene: Liuna lifts a parked bus over its shoulder and flings it into a ditch.
Liuna shrugs off a crashing cargo crate in its swollen form.

name: Tentce
summary: Tentce is a teenager who vanished from the neighborhood and left only a name on a posted list. Tentce is remembered for loud laughter and mismatched socks.

feats.scene: Tentce throws a rolled newspaper at a barking dog.

name: Siutia
summary: Siutia is a drifter who touched a glowing relic and became the spirit of combat itself. Siutia wades into any fight like a tide and plucks bruisers out of the air.

feats.scene: Siutia drives a fist into a loading crane and folds its arm.
Siutia stands in the center of a collapsing warehouse and brushes off dust.

name: Satusos
summary: Satusos is a green-haired sea goddess who started as a restless sailor and a dancer. Satusos hides shyness behind loud laughter and is dragged into wars by her sibling gods.

feats.scene: Satusos whips a tidal wave over a harbor and flattens its docks.
Satusos takes a falling mast across the shoulders and keeps dancing.

name: Tiumeose
summary: Tiumeose is a scaled, winged giant who refused to be turned back after her captors lost control of her. Tiumeose now sunbathes on a pier and torches anyone who sneers.

feats.scene: Tiumeose exhales a roaring flame that melts a row of parked cars.
Tiumeose bats aside a swinging crane hook with her tail.
Tiumeose glides over a bay on wide membrane wings.

name: Tirul
summary: Tirul is a shy church-goer whose hidden gift for conjuring flame exploded in a pine forest. Tirul learned that candles were never going to be enough.

feats.scene: Tirul ignites a wide ring of pines in a single shuddering burst.
Tirul stands inside her own blaze untouched.

name: Rnetellar
summary: Rnetellar is a purple-haired student with vampire blood and a pet that bites ankles. Rnetellar studies old curses between classes and carries a carved tusk everywhere.

feats.scene: Rnetellar jabs a carved tusk into a training dummy and pins it.
Rnetellar rolls through a thorn hedge and comes out grinning.

name: Titar
summary: Titar is a renowned frontier warrior who prefers traps to open fights and won his bride through patience. Titar feigns illness to lure schemers into an ambush.

feats.scene: Titar sinks a flint blade into a rival with one quiet thrust.
Titar endures a long ride on a bucking mule through thornbrush.

name: Llirnsi
summary: Llirnsi is a feather-winged stallion with a white crest who carries his rider over cloud banks. Llirnsi is proud, quick to bolt, and fiercely loyal.

feats.scene: Llirnsi kicks a fence post clean in half.
Llirnsi sweeps over a valley at full gallop through the air.

name: Anicico
summary: Anicico is a furious half of a split detective who kept the fury and dropped the restraint. Anicico hunts one man across the bayou with sharp nails and no pity.

feats.scene: Anicico smashes a bar counter in two with a single swing.
Anicico takes a car bumper to the hip and keeps walking.

name: Nuoraus
summary: Nuoraus is a green-skinned avenger reborn from a dying cop, wreathed in a toxic haze. Nuoraus claws through enemies and distrusts every offer of help.

feats.scene: Nuoraus rakes a car door off its hinges and crushes it.
Nuoraus walks out of a gas explosion with scorched claws.

name: Rnaulve
summary: Rnaulve is a blacksmith in a dying frozen world who called a legendary hammer and was answered. Rnaulve now carries the weather of a storm deity inside her chest.

feats.scene: Rnaulve brings down a lightning bolt that levels a monster-choked plaza.
Rnaulve stands through a swarm assault and remains unscratched.
Rnaulve soars through the clouds on the hammer's pull.

name: Neliu
summary: Neliu is a sea-bottom colossus kept asleep by a coral token and woken by a thief. Neliu lashes out with crushing limbs and retreats when wounded.

feats.scene: Neliu slams a claw against a seamount and cracks its crown.
Neliu absorbs a barrage of spells and tridents without flinching.

name: Nenta
summary: Nenta is a wide, magenta-haired mercenary and part-time actress with skin as hot as a forge. Nenta melts floors out from under rivals and trades barbs with everyone.

feats.scene: Nenta stomps a hotel floor molten and drops her foe a story.
Nenta takes a car-sized impact and shakes it off.

name: Tentorstu
summary: Tentorstu is a bitter crime boss who resents clever people and loans them money just to break their gadgets. Tentorstu loses badly when a summoned apparition shows up.

feats.scene: Tentorstu slaps a debtor across the face in a smoky office.
Tentorstu takes a hard punch and slumps against his desk.

name: Nesnen
summary: Nesnen is an armored dinosaur sent to guard a multiversal citadel under siege. Nesnen bites through iron and does not retreat.

feats.scene: Nesnen crunches a steel gate in half with a single bite.
Nesnen holds the line against a rush of demons.

name: Meoraren
summary: Meoraren is a balding sharpshooter in a city obsessed with calm who sees a masked intruder and panics. Meoraren fires first and regrets it quickly.

feats.scene: Meoraren fires a pistol round that punches through a wooden door.
Meoraren hits the pavement hard and shrugs it off.

name: Lularil
summary: Lularil is a green-skinned buccaneer with a patch over one eye and a hoarse laugh. Lularil raids slow merchant boats and leaves lanterns burning behind.

feats.scene: Lularil swings a cutlass and chops through a rope the width of an arm.

name: Iseoria
summary: Iseoria is an orange-skinned hired gun who pulls the weight of a planet into her fists. Iseoria's blows hurl a heavy opponent for miles through bulkheads.

feats.scene: Iseoria punches a bulky ally through a series of steel walls.
Iseoria stands up from a hard slap without a mark.

name: Cortancos
summary: Cortancos is a green-haired barfly who flirted badly and later found courage in a tiny rebellion. Cortancos charges into battle behind braver friends.

feats.scene: Cortancos hurls a bar stool at a passing soldier.
Cortancos bounces off a stone floor and stands up shaking.

name: Insetu
summary: Insetu is a former football star who borrowed a dying man's powered suit and used it better than its first owner. Insetu loved his family and hung up the armor reluctantly.

feats.scene: Insetu rams a shoulder through a brick garage wall in the armor.
Insetu tumbles down a fire escape and the armor holds.

name: Esvoseol
summary: Esvoseol is a disciplined tactical agent who hides a second loyalty beneath a crisp uniform. Esvoseol grabs a stolen scepter from a tired colleague and loses it again.

feats.scene: Esvoseol drives a rifle butt into a rival's shield.
Esvoseol falls from a tall loading dock and rolls clear.

name: Teausvo
summary: Teausvo is a sewer-dwelling gang leader who shoots well and brawls dirtier. Teausvo bosses a pack of mismatched outcasts beneath the streets.

feats.scene: Teausvo fires a rifle down a concrete tunnel and shatters a pipe.
Teausvo brushes off a thrown wrench to the shoulder.

name: Nenanon
summary: Nenanon is a scarred mercenary in a mask who robs banks with cheap henchmen and gets chased by toy-colored heroes. Nenanon is persistent and a bit ridiculous.

feats.scene: Nenanon swings a brick-shaped fist at a vault door.
Nenanon is flattened beneath a toppled helicopter and survives with burns.

name: Corel
summary: Corel is a loyal terrorist lieutenant who ambushes rescue teams and kidnaps scientists. Corel is outsmarted by an archer in disguise.

feats.scene: Corel fires a burst from an assault rifle into a transport door.
Corel is thrown through a plastic window and sits up.

name: Iarvalser
summary: Iarvalser is a bald mercenary on a patchwork battlefield who recruits a doomed squad. Iarvalser snipes the one target that matters from a safe ridge.

feats.scene: Iarvalser fires a long rifle shot across a canyon.
Iarvalser takes a stumble down a gravel slope.

name: Iurni
summary: Iurni is a mercenary who bounces between criminal gangs and loses most of his fights. Iurni boasts loudly about his record.

feats.scene: Iurni throws a haymaker at a masked climber and misses the wall by an inch.
Iurni hits a car hood hard and rolls off cursing.

name: Liauli
summary: Liauli is a hired killer who tries to spring a captive from his own cell and is hunted down first. Liauli never finishes a plan.

feats.scene: Liauli drives a combat knife into a locker door.
Liauli falls off a gantry and lands on a crate.

name: Mernaus
summary: Mernaus is a collectible-card mercenary who is only ever seen as a flat illustration. Mernaus brags without ever being tested.

feats.scene: Mernaus swings a gloved fist at a cardboard target.

name: Olior
summary: Olior is a loyal squad commander who follows two spies onto a hijacked ship. Olior takes orders well and keeps his people alive.

feats.scene: Olior fires a pulse rifle at a boarding raider.
Olior is knocked flat by a swinging boom and gets up quickly.

name: Cieoora
summary: Cieoora is a thug lounging in a villain roadhouse when the news turns the whole world upside down. Cieoora spills his drink and loses his nerve.

feats.scene: Cieoora slams a mug on the bar in disbelief.

name: Viernnum
summary: Viernnum is a tattooed enforcer for a conquering regime who ambushes a covert team and gets driven off. Viernnum never lets a stolen cannon go quietly.

feats.scene: Viernnum fires a machine gun at a fleeing van and shreds a tire.
Viernnum is thrown into a tank and cracks the plating.

name: Lltirnau
summary: Lltirnau is a wandering enemy that appears in a map-based street game and attacks whoever walks near. Lltirnau is a recurring annoyance with a loud entrance.

feats.scene: Lltirnau swings a bat at a passing player's phone.

name: Ciauneon
summary: Ciauneon is an arena athlete in a world where combat is a spectator sport. Ciauneon wins bouts by wearing opponents down with stubborn patience.

feats.scene: Ciauneon lands a heavy punch on a sparring pad.
Ciauneon absorbs a flying tackle and stays standing.

name: Seriumval
summary: Seriumval is a refugee soldier who joined a ragged alliance after the world ended. Seriumval sinks with a ship during a last desperate crossing.

feats.scene: Seriumval fires a battered rifle at a looming shadow.
Seriumval is struck by a falling railing and keeps fighting.

name: Telval
summary: Telval is a spiked, clawed zealot summoned into being by a child's wish who believes he is a mercenary turned prophet. Telval preaches in a crumbling chapel.

feats.scene: Telval claws through a steel pew and the floor under it.
Telval shrugs off a swung iron cross.

name: Neinava
summary: Neinava is an undead brute pulled from another timeline to rattle a school full of students. Neinava lumbers and groans without ever tiring.

feats.scene: Neinava slams a rotting fist into a locker bank and dents it deeply.
Neinava takes a hard tackle and does not fall.

name: Teoram
summary: Teoram is a purple-eyed shapeshifter loyal to a hidden homeland movement who steals a man's face and memories. Teoram panics under arrest and cries out that he belongs here.

feats.scene: Teoram shoves a guard aside during a staged distraction.
Teoram is slammed against a patrol car and stays conscious.

name: Ialllum
summary: Ialllum is a bald bar-fight champion who happily claims to be the bravest of all. Ialllum hits like a landslide and brags like one too.

feats.scene: Ialllum swings a fist that cracks a stone banquet table in two.
Ialllum laughs off a hall beam dropped on his back.

name: Iarmor
summary: Iarmor is a grey rock-skinned elder who leads a peaceful tribe and helps a tinkerer forge a stone suit. Iarmor would rather talk than fight.

feats.scene: Iarmor pushes a boulder off a cliff edge with one hand.
Iarmor is struck by a rockslide and shrugs it off.

name: Lusaneos
summary: Lusaneos is a courier who carries bad news through a golden hall and stands quietly while it lands. Lusaneos has few scenes but is always the first to arrive.

feats.scene: Lusaneos knocks a locked door open with a shoulder.
Lusaneos takes a stumble down a marble stair.

name: Loniu
summary: Loniu is a masked courier who skims rooftop cables on a glider frame and rides the wind between towers. Loniu trades favors for fuel and answers to nobody.

feats.scene: Loniu kicks a loose cable into a pursuer's face mid-glide.
Loniu swoops between two tower roofs with the wind at her back.

name: Orsesan
summary: Orsesan is a hopeful hanger-on who claims a talent for being correct twice per day. Orsesan keeps showing up for tryouts and keeps being turned away.

feats.scene: Orsesan flicks a pebble at a closed door as a knock.

name: Tustar
summary: Tustar is a red-skinned, pointy-eared trader behind a cluttered counter in a hollowed-out mining outpost. Tustar knows what everyone owes and who is lying.

feats.scene: Tustar throws a heavy coin pouch at a thief.
Tustar hits the floor behind his counter during a brawl and rises unhurt.

name: Ernleont
summary: Ernleont is a nervous dealer with thick eyebrows who pawns relics for stranded spacers. Ernleont folds the second a blade is drawn.

feats.scene: Ernleont shoves a customer out of his shop door.
Ernleont is thrown into a shelf and stays upright.

name: Rnitelve
summary: Rnitelve is a junkyard salesman who sells a talkative starship at a price that keeps climbing. Rnitelve haggles for fun and takes returns grudgingly.

feats.scene: Rnitelve tosses a salvaged helmet across his yard.

name: Ialeoseo
summary: Ialeoseo is a squat, bearded master smith who hammers legendary weapons in a cavern forge. Ialeoseo values a good weld over a good war.

feats.scene: Ialeoseo brings a forging hammer down on a glowing anvil and splits it.
Ialeoseo stands in a spray of molten metal and keeps working.

name: Leniuul
summary: Leniuul is a forge-hand credited with shaping a famous weapon but never shown at work. Leniuul lives on only as a quiet name in a toolmaker's boast.

feats.scene: Leniuul hammers a bar of iron flat on a stone block.

name: Olite
summary: Olite is an offshore driller who inherited a sliver of old thunder in the family chest. Olite listens to his sister and never opens the chest.

feats.scene: Olite swings a pipe wrench against a rusted valve.
Olite is flung against a derrick leg by a wave and recovers.

name: Aulval
summary: Aulval is a heavy-armored knight in a younger order who swings a mallet-like gauntlet. Aulval quells a rebellion and holds back a ghost army.

feats.scene: Aulval smashes a mallet gauntlet into a hull plate and bursts it.
Aulval takes a wraith volley on the breastplate and presses on.

name: Elorce
summary: Elorce is a masked sorcerer-brother who wields a mace and a living gem and charts invisible walls between realms. Elorce is banished more often than he conquers.

feats.scene: Elorce brings a spell-charged mace down on a hilltop and cracks it open.
Elorce survives the shattering of his own mask and talisman.

name: Vinttus
summary: Vinttus is a shapeshifting farmer whose crops burned and whose prayers to river and mountain taught his people a lesson. Vinttus is a parable more than a person.

feats.scene: Vinttus drives a hoe into dry soil and breaks the crust.

name: Servalnau
summary: Servalnau is a winged, insectoid schoolmate with fangs and a big heart who fights beside friends in a doomed future. Servalnau is gentle until his friends are threatened.

feats.scene: Servalnau slashes a steel bulkhead with a clawed hand.
Servalnau takes a collapsing beam on his shell.
Servalnau flaps over a courtyard on small wings.

name: Covor
summary: Covor is a small-winged, red-eyed student of a famous academy who is whisked away with classmates by a sudden spell. Covor wonders what became of his lessons.

feats.scene: Covor claws a stone desk and leaves four deep furrows.
Covor shakes off a fall from a bell tower.

name: Iumvosseo
summary: Iumvosseo is a technician who maintains a glowing barrier around a besieged district and watches it fail. Iumvosseo splits his time between runes and gauges.

feats.scene: Iumvosseo hurls a spark across a console room to jam a relay.
Iumvosseo ducks behind a table as a wall collapses.

name: Rineoll
summary: Rineoll is a lab-coated insectoid scholar who recites math proofs and debates old masters. Rineoll fights on principle and loses gracefully.

feats.scene: Rineoll hurls a beaker of acid at a painted easel.
Rineoll absorbs a thrown chair and keeps lecturing.

name: Stuvion
summary: Stuvion is a costumed arena performer disguised as something scarier to spice up a televised fight. Stuvion bites hard and gets bitten harder.

feats.scene: Stuvion pounces on a gladiator and pins him to the sand.
Stuvion eats a spiked club to the ribs and snarls.

name: Tesntsum
summary: Tesntsum is the ravenous matriarch of a swarm that nested in a fallen giant and ate entire galaxies. Tesntsum is coming for a blue world with a plan and a patience older than its stars.

feats.scene: Tesntsum cracks a continental plate with a single lash of her brood-mind.
Tesntsum endures a barrage of heavy cannon fire across a thousand ships.

name: Telnerno
summary: Telnerno is a hive monarch who rules an island swarm until a squad of rivals arrives. Telnerno fights with claws and sheer numbers.

feats.scene: Telnerno rips a bunker door off its hinges.
Telnerno survives a crashing cargo plane's wing.

name: Niuiarru
summary: Niuiarru is a fanged, red-eyed monarch who hypnotizes a royal party and plants squirming eggs in the guests. Niuiarru bargains with tyrants and trusts nobody.

feats.scene: Niuiarru snaps a ceremonial chair in half while snarling.
Niuiarru is struck by a yacht door and brushes it off.

name: Numcelleo
summary: Numcelleo is a blonde child at a craft workshop who makes a very green slime. Numcelleo gets a little smug and a little tricked.

feats.scene: Numcelleo pats a lump of slime flat on a table.

name: Orniumcel
summary: Orniumcel is a tall, married stage performer and fashion face with a university degree. Orniumcel appears at galas and charity dances.

feats.scene: Orniumcel tosses a bouquet across a ballroom.

name: Livallu
summary: Livallu is an armored guardian of a sports hall who rose from the floor when a crowd roared. Livallu grows stronger with every cheer and fades when the stands empty.

feats.scene: Livallu dunks a ball so hard the backboard shatters.
Livallu stands unmoved under a pile of cheering fans.

name: Steori
summary: Steori is a bald police veteran who grew up as a wartime mascot and kept the habits of a sidekick. Steori tags along on cases no one invited him to.

feats.scene: Steori swings a nightstick at a fleeing suspect.
Steori rolls off a delivery truck and gets back up.

name: Laranont
summary: Laranont is a hunched grey jester who leans on a cane and mocks a royal court from the edge. Laranont survives by being funny at the right moment.

feats.scene: Laranont raps his cane on a stone dais and chips it.
Laranont absorbs a thrown goblet and a sneer.

name: Tason
summary: Tason is a palace sentry and a doting father of two young mages-in-training. Tason polishes his spear every morning and listens at doors.

feats.scene: Tason drives a spear through a training shield.
Tason stands unmoved before a ram of a charging boar.

name: Toraul
summary: Toraul is a red-eyed helmsman who steers a sorceress through roiling seas to a distant shore. Toraul is a faint sketch in the margins of the voyage.

feats.scene: Toraul hauls on a tiller against a heavy current.

name: Oroiumvo
summary: Oroiumvo is a bald, white-eyed cult leader who chartered a freighter to deliver his prize to a hidden temple. Oroiumvo underestimates the prisoner and begs too late.

feats.scene: Oroiumvo points a dagger at a shackled captive.
Oroiumvo is shoved to the deck and rattled.

name: Aninumlu
summary: Aninumlu is a bear-shaped divine spirit who lends strength and wisdom to a mortal champion. Aninumlu has no body to bruise and follows her into a battle-realm.

feats.scene: Aninumlu rolls a roar across a plain that tilts the grass flat for miles.
Aninumlu absorbs a blast meant for the champion and drifts back unharmed.

name: Rumcor
summary: Rumcor is a stern judge on a shadowy street who sentences travelers to a mind-wiping cure. Rumcor ends up in a hospital ward after his dimension is invaded.

feats.scene: Rumcor bangs a gavel on a bench in a gloomy court.
Rumcor is shoved through a glowing portal and lands on his back.

name: Amrnota
summary: Amrnota is a robed monk who tends a mountain shrine and gossips about the day's visitors. Amrnota is flattened when raiders knock down a wall.

feats.scene: Amrnota sweeps a stone step with a stiff broom.
Amrnota is buried under a collapsed wall of masonry.

name: Oransta
summary: Oransta is a senior monk who shelters a troubled orphan and chases a funfair rescue. Oransta later accepts a street dare in a rattling van.

feats.scene: Oransta wrenches a stuck van door open.
Oransta climbs out of a collapsed van unhurt.

name: Lisni
summary: Lisni is a green-skinned dying monarch who confesses a hidden heir from a doomed prison world. Lisni is cut down before his son can inherit his throne.

feats.scene: Lisni slams a scepter on a stone throne arm.
Lisni endures an assassin's blade for a few breaths.

name: Cenca
summary: Cenca is a cloistered friar ordered to confront a powerful churchman and murdered instead. Cenca is mentioned once and then forgotten.

feats.scene: Cenca drives a candlestick down on a wooden table.

name: Olieo
summary: Olieo is a fair-haired hired soldier who changes names the way others change shirts. Olieo worked beside old comrades and signed on with revolutionaries, then slipped into a secret brotherhood.

feats.scene: Olieo rams a rifle stock into a jungle checkpoint gate.
Olieo is wounded in a desert raid and marches on.

name: Niaenna
summary: Niaenna is a gifted mechanic who can coax life from dead engines and is hired to repair a carnival attraction. Niaenna fixes it into its original, murderous setting.

feats.scene: Niaenna wrenches a bolt loose from a rusted hinge.
Niaenna is struck by a metal fist that obliterates him.

name: Onrosva
summary: Onrosva is a grey shark with forearm blades who fights alongside a mercenary team and loves his sister. Onrosva escapes a swarm of machines by unsheathing the blades at last.

feats.scene: Onrosva slashes through a metal drone with forearm blades.
Onrosva takes a blow from a mechanical fist and keeps swimming.

name: Rncenia
summary: Rncenia is a humanoid shark who nuzzles his partner and returns from a prison cell to help a time-hopping plan. Rncenia is a creature of loyalty.

feats.scene: Rncenia bites down on a steel cage bar and bends it.
Rncenia is flung across a cell and splashes back up.

name: Telnoste
summary: Telnoste is a high-school student mentioned in passing and never shown. Telnoste fills the background of a crowded hallway.

feats.scene: Telnoste slams a locker door and walks away.

name: Esvalau
summary: Esvalau is a green-furred gorilla who surges with strength and gathers a band of ape heroes. Esvalau hunts a traitor with a fury out of a bad dream.

feats.scene: Esvalau pounds a concrete wall into rubble with both fists.
Esvalau barrels through a stack of steel drums without slowing.

name: Siallce
summary: Siallce is a grey-skinned robot copy built by a rogue machine to infiltrate a team of heroes. Siallce has the strength of the original and none of its heart.

feats.scene: Siallce clubs a girder in half with a swing of its arm.
Siallce takes a hail of rounds and keeps advancing.

name: Monisto
summary: Monisto is a towering green clone grown from stem cells who keeps a sharp mind and gains fangs and a throne of the undead. Monisto is a king without rage and loses a duel to a disciplined soldier.

feats.scene: Monisto hurls a pillar into a stone gate and brings the arch down.
Monisto is hit with heavy shells and snarls through the smoke.

name: Neneaun
summary: Neneaun is a celebrated scientist in a world that adores heroes, who changes shape at will when the cameras are on. Neneaun smiles for a magazine cover and flexes for the lens.

feats.scene: Neneaun flattens a parked tank with a single stomp.
Neneaun walks through a wall of shell fire.

name: Rostesren
summary: Rostesren is an obsessed researcher who forced a musician into a monstrous form and then became one himself. Rostesren keeps his captives close and his grudges closer.

feats.scene: Rostesren swats a pickup truck across a parking lot.
Rostesren is hit by a barrage of lightning and grins through it.

name: Leosisi
summary: Leosisi is a one-eyed, cane-bound physicist who bears the weight of a ruined world and a bomb he built. Leosisi hides from a vengeful government and sets out to retrieve exiles.

feats.scene: Leosisi taps his cane on a console to restart a machine.
Leosisi stumbles on a gravel path and catches himself.

name: Eonmarme
summary: Eonmarme is a tattooed punk who swells into a hulking bruiser and backs his band against bigger foes. Eonmarme quit transforming, then came back for one last gig.

feats.scene: Eonmarme hurls a stage amplifier tower through a warehouse wall.
Eonmarme absorbs a hit from a giant mechanical fist.

name: Eostarcen
summary: Eostarcen is a grim scientist working for a besieged human council who turned himself into a grey-green rock brute. Eostarcen switches forms at will and is killed by a feral blade.

feats.scene: Eostarcen pounds a fortress rampart into gravel.
Eostarcen stands in a barrage of siege shells.

name: Cenill
summary: Cenill is a scientist whose therapy session erupts into a tantrum that tears open the dream-plane. Cenill meets the lord of nightmares and is forced to choke himself.

feats.scene: Cenill rips a wide gash through the fabric of a dream with a roar.
Cenill stands unharmed amid the collapse of the dream wall.

name: Maramnum
summary: Maramnum is a famous gamma-changed figure whom reporters mention at a press gathering about a new team. Maramnum is never seen in person.

feats.scene: Maramnum hefts a boulder in a rumor among reporters.

name: Lusoruniu
summary: Lusoruniu is a worn-out ward physician who swells into a towering brute whenever pressure peaks, then returns to a gentle bedside manner. Small promises to the dying matter more to the tale than any brawl.

feats.scene: Lusoruniu hurls a rusted gate off its hinges and across an empty courtyard.
Lusoruniu walks through a volley from a watchtower without slowing his stride.

name: Marlaram
summary: Marlaram was once a mighty green titan until a drifting vapour stripped the power away and left a quiet scholar. Marlaram now stands with ordinary people against a rampaging juggernaut and feels every blow.

feats.scene: Marlaram swings a lab stool with all his might at a charging brute.
Marlaram is thrown across a plaza and gets back up bruised but alive.

name: Llirnucar
summary: Llirnucar is a giant brawler born of a failed experiment, strong enough to bend steel beams yet reliably humbled when two heavy hitters team up. He leaps over rooftops between fights and sulks afterward.

feats.scene: Llirnucar folds a bridge girder in half and flings it down a street.
Llirnucar takes a double tackle from two heavyweights and stays upright for a moment.

name: Tiarnuce
summary: Tiarnuce lives on only as a legend among wilderness survivalists, who worship the primal giant he became. Rumour credits him with shrugging off bullets, mending quickly, and soaking up radiance that would cook anyone else.

feats.scene: Tiarnuce stamps a crater into a highway and tosses the slab aside.
Tiarnuce stands unmarked in a hail of rifle fire as torn skin knits shut.

name: Viati
summary: Viati is a green-haired champion who joins a raid on a planet-eater's flagship. A stray burst from the ship's own guns lays him out before he can make a difference.

feats.scene: Viati rips a hatch off a hovering drone and crushes it flat.
Viati is struck by a ship's gun salvo and is knocked senseless but unbroken.

name: Nentuve
summary: Nentuve is a chunky plastic-brick brawler who joins a toy-box battle staged by a child narrator. His fights end with scattered bricks and a laugh.

feats.scene: Nentuve smashes a brick tower with two clumsy fists.
Nentuve is knocked apart into loose bricks and snaps himself back together.

name: Stutusiar
summary: Stutusiar is a mild nuclear researcher who works beside a famous inventor and never becomes anything monstrous. His workday is chalk dust and coffee.

feats.scene: Stutusiar shoves a heavy cart across a lab floor.
Stutusiar tumbles down a short stair and shakes it off.

name: Tever
summary: Tever exists only as a passing comparison, a byword for a body that mends itself at astonishing speed. Others borrow his name when they want to describe a sturdy recovery.

feats.scene: Tever drives a fist through a plank door in a remembered tale.
Tever walks away from a crashed cart in a story told around a fire.

name: Iasveo
summary: Iasveo is a huge, clever prisoner locked in a high-security block after a purge of the gifted. A band of reality-hopping rescuers frees him, and nothing is known of his later days.

feats.scene: Iasveo tears a vault door from its frame and bends it into a ring.
Iasveo endures a cell-block sweep of stun cannons without a stumble.

name: Roviall
summary: Roviall is a hundred-foot tailed conqueror with claws and a bony jaw, once a bound spirit in service to a dark sorcerer. His rage rolled across the world after a machine of ruin went wrong.

feats.scene: Roviall brings a skyscraper down with a single sweep of his tail.
Roviall stands in the shockwave of a collapsing power plant and does not budge.

name: Nesseo
summary: Nesseo is a mighty green giant remembered long after his time, a name painted on walls in a far-future city. His strength and enormous leaps are folklore, and no one knows how his story ended.

feats.scene: Nesseo punches a hole through a reinforced wall.
Nesseo shrugs off a tank shell with a grunt.

name: Orias
summary: Orias is a green defender recruited to stop a pharaoh-like tyrant, and he dies for it. When the prize is claimed, the death is quietly undone along with the rest of the harm.

feats.scene: Orias slams both fists down and splits a stone pavilion in two.
Orias holds his ground against a god-king's first lashing blast.

name: Netum
summary: Netum is a physicist caught in a warlord's attack on a base, who calmly defuses a bomb and is left behind by the team. Later he turns into a hulking fighter, tries haiku therapy, and joins a great many wars.

feats.scene: Netum lifts a sunken turret and hurls it at an advancing robot line.
Netum is battered by a king-sized blast and stands up again.

name: Oricel
summary: Oricel is a bald, grey, enormous sage who preaches peace backed by force and sits on a council of world-makers. His strength was called the strongest there is, until a cousin ended him.

feats.scene: Oricel clenches one fist and brings down a mountain ridge in a rolling slide.
Oricel weathers a city-wrecking barrage while he keeps talking.

name: Reinalum
summary: Reinalum is a rotting, white-eyed giant who shambles through a ruined street in search of fresh meat. His flesh sags, yet his fists still hit like falling stone.

feats.scene: Reinalum caves in a car roof with a lazy swing.
Reinalum is shot at point-blank range and keeps staggering forward.

name: Ontna
summary: Ontna is a furred, fanged predator who joins a pack of ruined champions and eats whatever he catches. The pack devours a cosmic giant and then hunts a new victim.

feats.scene: Ontna claws a rooftop open and drags out a screaming prey.
Ontna takes a chainsaw to the ribs and snarls through it.

name: Ornst
summary: Ornst is a widowed engineer who turns into a hulking brute, with a ledger of cruel nicknames for it. He once tangled with a masked detective and a caped alien in a crossing of worlds.

feats.scene: Ornst lifts a parked bus and slams it into a wall of crates.
Ornst takes a rocket volley and keeps walking toward the shooter.

name: Voser
summary: Voser is a distant rumour, a green creature named in passing by a nervous witness who has not seen him. Nothing else is recorded.

feats.scene: Voser is said to have knocked a fence post flat.
Voser is reported to have walked off a crash unharmed.

name: Leoservor
summary: Leoservor is a conquered giant pressed into service as a shock trooper for an invading hive. When a rescue fleet lands, Leoservor is sent to hold a stronghold with the other forced fighters.

feats.scene: Leoservor tosses a hover-tank into a parapet.
Leoservor stands in the fire of a landing party and does not flinch.

name: Celsoeos
summary: Celsoeos got his green bulk from a blast on a test field and spends his days looking for a cure that never works. His fights tend to end in a draw before shadowy captors drag him off.

feats.scene: Celsoeos clubs a heavy walker off its feet with a single punch.
Celsoeos is battered by a cyborg team and still stands.

name: Seteal
summary: Seteal turns into a slow-witted, immensely strong green brute when anger or stress grips him. A trickster's decoy makes him run, and he stays a poster for a young hero.

feats.scene: Seteal flips a food truck onto its roof with one hand.
Seteal shakes off a fall from a movie-set crane.

name: Rniiaten
summary: Rniiaten is a pixel-built champion pulled into a shady virtual reality that lets paying players kill heroes for sport. Little else of the original is known.

feats.scene: Rniiaten swings at a player avatar and splinters a simulated door.
Rniiaten resets after a mock execution and reappears at the start.

name: Lucornen
summary: Lucornen is a gold-skinned titan twisted by a spreading plague into one of its shining primes. His size shifts from moment to moment as the infection works.

feats.scene: Lucornen swats a squad of soldiers across a parking lot.
Lucornen's golden skin turns aside a barrage of grenades.

name: Llvos
summary: Llvos is a childlike green giant who weeps when a flying knight punches him by surprise. He later proves to be a mere toy of a prankster and is wiped away, perhaps remade afterward.

feats.scene: Llvos lifts an overturned truck and sets it down as if it were a toy.
Llvos is hit by a planet-eater's gaze and fades without a scratch before it ends.

name: Nismo
summary: Nismo is a rebel giant fighting a masked queen's regime alongside a cloaked master of magnets. A blast flings him over a wall and into a stranger's garden.

feats.scene: Nismo storms a gate and rips the barrier free.
Nismo is blasted a mile through the air and lands upright.

name: Llliant
summary: Llliant is a green giant lost when armies of programmed sentries sweep the land hunting every gifted person. He falls in the opening purge.

feats.scene: Llliant breaks a sentry in half over his knee.
Llliant endures a volley from a sentry squad until it overwhelms him.

name: Oramall
summary: Oramall is a pale, hardened giant who returns from a godly war unconscious, clutching a fallen god's mace. His loyalties turn, and a self-destructing hero ends him in a terrible flash.

feats.scene: Oramall swings a borrowed mace and levels a rank of battle machines.
Oramall absorbs a burst of released energy for several heartbeats before collapsing.

name: Cevane
summary: Cevane is a grey, immense refugee who hides on a blue-lit moon with other humans fleeing a mutant overlord. He is a gentle shield for the weak.

feats.scene: Cevane tears open a sealed crater door so a family can reach air.
Cevane blocks a patrol blast with his back to shelter a child.

name: Alsieo
summary: Alsieo is a colonel whose test accident left him with migraines and a rage that eventually births a glowing, childlike being. The army fires on it, and it flees in confusion.

feats.scene: Alsieo flares into a glowing form and scatters a convoy.
Alsieo's glowing body takes a volley of shells without a mark.

name: Leroan
summary: Leroan is a displaced giant who kills a tyrant from the future before drifting between timelines. He fights a counterpart, then fades home, weak to any shortage of his own fuel.

feats.scene: Leroan drives a fist through a tyrant's armoured chest.
Leroan trades blows with his double without giving ground.

name: Tesvel
summary: Tesvel loses his wife and tries to end his own life, but his other half refuses. He learns to change shape with his mind intact, too late to save what mattered.

feats.scene: Tesvel pounds a rooftop to rubble in his grief.
Tesvel stands unmoved before a vehicle crash.

name: Usreseol
summary: Usreseol is an ocean-city champion in a world where a certain starship never flew and the sea king conquered the surface. He serves the new order as a muscled doctor.

feats.scene: Usreseol punches through a sea wall and floods a dock.
Usreseol soaks a depth charge without a flinch.

name: Ntstli
summary: Ntstli is a grey, black-haired brute who fights soldiers loyal to a long-dead empire inside a hidden facility. His smash leaves the complex half wrecked.

feats.scene: Ntstli slams a steel bulkhead flat and scatters a platoon.
Ntstli ignores machine-gun fire in a narrow corridor.

name: Ellaninan
summary: Ellaninan is a horned, red-eyed warrior turned monstrous by a swarm of ancient horrors that rule a twisted cosmos. He is killed and revived to help them seize a new dimension.

feats.scene: Ellaninan slams a pillar of black rock into a battleship hull.
Ellaninan walks through a barrage of cosmic fire.

name: Sorstnt
summary: Sorstnt is a green gladiator exiled to a far world, forced to fight in the pits, and then crowned. He leads a rebellion that topples the old king.

feats.scene: Sorstnt crushes a gladiator tank and tosses it over the arena rim.
Sorstnt takes a blow that cracks the arena floor and keeps fighting.

name: Valine
summary: Valine is a veteran green giant who joins a war against possessed armoured foes until they are banished. His part is brief but decisive.

feats.scene: Valine drives a possessed war machine into the dirt.
Valine bears the weight of a collapsing hangar on his shoulders.

name: Aseorn
summary: Aseorn is a space-roaming herald who bears cosmic power after a catastrophe breaks his will. After a city dies in a blast he caused, he serves a world-eater and wanders the stars.

feats.scene: Aseorn splits a moon-sized rock in half with a single cosmic blow.
Aseorn is hit by an orbital laser and stands in the crater.

name: Reium
summary: Reium is a green teenager from a comedic pastiche, awkward, hopeful, and hopelessly sweet on a neighbour's daughter. His bulk shows up mostly at school dances.

feats.scene: Reium accidentally snaps a school locker door off its hinge.
Reium shrugs off a thrown book bag and grins.

name: Analrin
summary: Analrin is a white-haired world conqueror who once aided the grown children of fallen heroes. He rules with force and dies at the end of a long war.

feats.scene: Analrin hammers a siege tower into a heap of splinters.
Analrin tanks a barrage from three war machines and keeps advancing.

name: Rumtel
summary: Rumtel is a grey wanderer who lost his bride and now smashes unthinkingly, always calmed by friendlier heroes. Nothing about him is sure.

feats.scene: Rumtel bowls over a row of market stalls in a blind rage.
Rumtel is struck by a thrown boulder and shrugs.

name: Nurnti
summary: Nurnti is a grey-skinned fighter who is manipulated into battle by a mind-twisting trickster and captures a rival before a swamp monster knocks him out. A strange device ends his run.

feats.scene: Nurnti seizes a rival and hauls her off a rooftop.
Nurnti survives a swamp creature's smash and a lightning burst.

name: Rniorll
summary: Rniorll is a bald, green brute who lifts a fallen god's hammer and joins a pack of cursed champions serving a dark serpent. His fists land on two lithe fighters before the serpent falls.

feats.scene: Rniorll brings the hammer down and shatters a hillside.
Rniorll takes a god's counter-blow and does not give an inch.

name: Netest
summary: Netest is a gentle, hollow-eyed patient with a scar through his thinking, lost in a hospital hall. He does little but sit and watch the light move.

feats.scene: Netest taps a spoon against a tray.
Netest bumps into a wall and does not notice.

name: Oraalnes
summary: Oraalnes is a cartoon green giant on a theatre poster for a stage musical that never opens. That is the whole record.

feats.scene: Oraalnes is painted mid-punch across a faded poster.
Oraalnes is untouched by rain streaking down his poster.

name: Anron
summary: Anron is a high-school student who carries a green hand-puppet everywhere, part of a dream shared by two sleeping heroes. His class goes on as normal.

feats.scene: Anron punches a locker with the puppet on his hand.
Anron shrugs off a spitball with a puppet-voiced quip.

name: Raucoser
summary: Raucoser is a green giant whose trousers tear at the seams, leaving him in a very public embarrassment. His chief battle is with a seam.

feats.scene: Raucoser flexes and bursts his belt across an alley.
Raucoser shrugs off a slap from a startled bystander.

name: Marvalel
summary: Marvalel is a green giant who sits on a roster of heroes next to an octopus-limbed scientist and mourns a lost marriage. His role is quieter than his size suggests.

feats.scene: Marvalel hoists a shattered pylon and braces a collapsing tunnel.
Marvalel takes a robot's punch squarely on the jaw.

name: Niiumori
summary: Niiumori is a doctor and giant who helps build a world-wrapping shield against a godlike executioner. The shield buckles under the strikes, and the world is lost.

feats.scene: Niiumori hauls a generator core up a tower stair.
Niiumori stands beneath a raining shockwave until the sky burns white.

name: Ulntles
summary: Ulntles is a holiday-grumbling green giant who wins a day off with his teammates, only to see the whole planet blown up an hour later by shapeshifting invaders. He is a comedic footnote.

feats.scene: Ulntles stomps a tinsel-draped stage flat while complaining about overtime.
Ulntles stays standing in the first flash of the planetary blast before it consumes him.

name: Niasa
summary: Niasa is a scientist rescued from a bad accident by a masked monarch, who builds him a suit to hold back the glow inside. He later turns on his saviour and shuts down a time engine.

feats.scene: Niasa releases a field generator and frees a hammer from its pin.
Niasa's suit holds against a stray repulsor shot.

name: Leosiure
summary: Leosiure is a green-eyed hero who helps three others bring down a power-drunk master of magnets, after he has killed a girl and swallowed her power. The victory costs Leosiure his life.

feats.scene: Leosiure lands a stunning punch on a maddened tyrant.
Leosiure stands through a storm of cosmic fire for a long beat.

name: Iasvarn
summary: Iasvarn is a hollowed-out giant who can be set off only by an implant, with the remote passed round among his teammates. He later becomes an unwilling tyrant in a strange new world.

feats.scene: Iasvarn smashes a robot nest after a thumb presses the trigger.
Iasvarn stumbles through a rain of autonomous gunfire.

name: Steaunmeo
summary: Steaunmeo is a fan-fiction hero written by a teenager, who helps a team rescue a toy planet from a space beast. He exists only on the page.

feats.scene: Steaunmeo punches a papier-mache monster through a cardboard moon.
Steaunmeo is hit by a crayon-drawn ray and laughs.

name: Ellti
summary: Ellti is a holographic copy of a shaved-headed giant, used as a training dummy against young students. He regenerates and shrugs off hits, and the session ends when a student objects.

feats.scene: Ellti hurls a training pillar across a practice hall.
Ellti takes a student's blast and re-forms at once.

name: Corcorias
summary: Corcorias is a grey-haired god-king of a fractured world, who wears a destroyer's armour and crushes the previous emperor with little effort. This ruler is a dream experienced by another tyrant.

feats.scene: Corcorias shears a mountain range in half with one sweep.
Corcorias takes a god-emperor's strike and answers with a laugh.

name: Vavercil
summary: Vavercil is a corporate hired giant sent to storm a rival tower. The attack is a figment imagined by a bystander.

feats.scene: Vavercil rips open a lobby door and tosses a desk through it.
Vavercil laughs off a guard's volley.

name: Iarvinto
summary: Iarvinto is a showboating arena champion who smashes opponents while the crowd roars. He doesn't recall how he arrived at the pit.

feats.scene: Iarvinto slams a giant insect warrior into the sand.
Iarvinto takes a hundred spear blows and plays to the stands.

name: Seroroni
summary: Seroroni is a grey-haired ruler who goes mad, enslaves his world, and cuts down heroes to cement his rule. He is stronger, faster, and tougher than any of his foes.

feats.scene: Seroroni levels a fortress with a single overhead strike.
Seroroni takes a squad's heaviest missile fire and keeps talking.

name: Eolnense
summary: Eolnense is a green hero who pulls civilians from the swell of a giant tidal wave. Nobody drowns while he stands in the surf.

feats.scene: Eolnense splits a sea wall to open a path for a fleeing crowd.
Eolnense plants himself against an oncoming wall of water.

name: Iltel
summary: Iltel is a bright cartoon green giant who needs coaxing from two smaller heroes to help trapped people under a crumbling bridge. He leaps across the gap and holds up the span.

feats.scene: Iltel props up a falling bridge with both arms.
Iltel takes a rockslide on his back and grins.

name: Costelri
summary: Costelri is a time-hopping rebel recruited to stop a dark tyrant in his cradle. He is cut down by a flaming rider before the plan can work.

feats.scene: Costelri punches through a strike craft and leaves it burning.
Costelri stands in the first flare of a cosmic gunship's blast.

name: Eonni
summary: Eonni is a rotting zombie giant with red eyes who joins a hive-minded undead invasion. He smashes through a fortified wall until a clever drone stops him, and he dies when the hive does.

feats.scene: Eonni tears through a fortified wall and leaps after survivors.
Eonni is blasted by an automaton and keeps coming.

name: Ritiases
summary: Ritiases is a green champion swept into a patchwork battlefield along with a squirrel-powered hero. He stands in a crowd of the stranded.

feats.scene: Ritiases lifts a toppled statue off a trapped child.
Ritiases takes a flung rock to the jaw without flinching.

name: Eotarcos
summary: Eotarcos is a bald, grey-haired tyrant who survives an alien invasion that breaks his friends and renames himself a lord of the ruins. He hires mercenaries and brags about being the strongest.

feats.scene: Eotarcos kicks a hovering craft out of the sky.
Eotarcos takes a salvo from a squad of gunships and sneers.

name: Leovalce
summary: Leovalce is a zombified giant who joins a swarm that invades a world of intelligent apes and devours its people. He feeds as he walks.

feats.scene: Leovalce tears down a treetop village with his bare hands.
Leovalce stumbles through a hail of arrows with a grin.

name: Rntuser
summary: Rntuser is a bald, green living weapon owned by a secret conspiracy and hurled at enemies of a nation. One rampage leaves a whole port city in ruin, and a god of thunder drowns him at last.

feats.scene: Rntuser stamps once and a harbour city collapses in dust.
Rntuser is hit by a barrage of lightning and rises from it.

name: Telarci
summary: Telarci is a silver-skinned messenger sacrificed to a planet-devourer and gifted with its cosmic power. He designs evacuation ships for doomed worlds until a quarrel with an old friend wrecks one.

feats.scene: Telarci cracks a world's crust with one outstretched palm.
Telarci is crushed against a colony hull and walks away from the dent.

name: Saveva
summary: Saveva is a physicist and middle-school teacher who learns to keep his green other half in check around the kids. He bonds with pupils and shows that being steady matters more than being strong.

feats.scene: Saveva lifts a collapsed gym wall to free a trapped class.
Saveva stands through a failed lab blast shielding a pupil.

name: Oliont
summary: Oliont is a tattooed giant who enters a nightmare realm with two companions and must retreat after being outmatched. He returns with new allies to rescue the lost.

feats.scene: Oliont pounds a dream-fortress wall and cracks it from foundation to roof.
Oliont is struck by a nightmare lord's bolt and staggers back.

name: Tumaunstu
summary: Tumaunstu is a bored survivor in a nearly empty world, sharing a quiet planet with only one other soul. Nothing happens for a very long time.

feats.scene: Tumaunstu kicks a can down an empty avenue.
Tumaunstu shrugs off a long fall from a bored stunt.

name: Iniumtu
summary: Iniumtu is a green giant whose clothes never keep up with his growth, so he is forever bare in a crowd. His defining trait is an unlucky wardrobe.

feats.scene: Iniumtu bursts out of his shirt and sends buttons flying.
Iniumtu shakes off a thrown tomato with dignity.

name: Ntiar
summary: Ntiar is a volunteer who gains massive strength from a flawed army experiment. A rogue machine's new body kills him along with the rest of the team.

feats.scene: Ntiar rips a drone fleet apart with a spinning throw.
Ntiar takes a machine's beam and keeps standing a moment.

name: Neoserse
summary: Neoserse is a crowned gladiator king with many nicknames, who weds a shadow warrior and loses her when his adopted city is destroyed. His sorrow drives him to a world-breaking rage.

feats.scene: Neoserse slams the ground and a whole district sinks into rubble.
Neoserse is buried under a collapsing tower and climbs out.

name: Necente
summary: Necente is a fighting-game brawler who catches a flying friend mid-fall and shields another from a floating head. He announces proudly that he is the strongest.

feats.scene: Necente grabs a falling ally with one hand and sets her down.
Necente swallows a magnetic push and skids to a halt.

name: Nescori
summary: Nescori is struck by a stray missile on a weapons range and tears into soldiers until a mob of heroes drags him off. Needles tipped with a strange metal finally calm him.

feats.scene: Nescori heaves a launcher truck into a hangar wall.
Nescori takes a dozen heroes at once and stays on his feet.

name: Tellu
summary: Tellu is a grey-haired conqueror who keeps a sharp mind and a monster's power, roams the worlds taking trophies, and claims to clean up evil. His lies fall apart once his allies learn the truth.

feats.scene: Tellu cleaves a rampart tower from its base and tosses it aside.
Tellu takes a whole school's volley and stays standing.

name: Vellon
summary: Vellon is a mischievous green kid from a parody tale, who torments the neighbours with pranks. He is a cheerful menace, nothing more.

feats.scene: Vellon dumps a bucket of paint over a fence.
Vellon bounces off a garden gate and laughs.

name: Valir
summary: Valir is a green hero who joins a doomed band when a planet-eater turns mad, and is killed by the devourer before he can matter. His story lasts a page.

feats.scene: Valir hammers a herald's armour with both fists.
Valir is struck by a stellar beam and is lost in the glare.

name: Uliseium
summary: Uliseium is a green giant killed by a dropped bomb, and his death leaves a bystander transformed into something even stronger. The bomb is meant to end him for good.

feats.scene: Uliseium swats a gunship out of the air.
Uliseium stands in the heart of a vast radiant blast before it takes him.

name: Taraulon
summary: Taraulon is a space-suited giant who joins other heroes to fight an invading fleet after their home planet is devastated. None return.

feats.scene: Taraulon wrenches a hull plate loose in vacuum.
Taraulon takes a cruiser's strafing run and presses on.

name: Amemene
summary: Amemene is a green killer-on-a-rampage cut down by a smart-mouthed raccoon in an imagined timeline. His speed and toughness are legendary but not enough.

feats.scene: Amemene flattens a runway with a sweeping blow.
Amemene takes a point-blank cannon blast and shrugs.

name: Iseni
summary: Iseni is a sapling-bodied giant, part green titan and part walking tree, who joins a crowd of heroes asking a gentle plant for help against a hungry cosmic foe. His fate is unknown.

feats.scene: Iseni uproots a boulder with his root-fingers and tosses it aside.
Iseni takes an axe blow on his bark and leaves only a scratch.

name: Rirco
summary: Rirco is a black-haired giant lying under the knife of an eccentric surgeon when a band of hoppers snatches him away. The operation went well enough.

feats.scene: Rirco flexes a strapped wrist and snaps a leather cuff.
Rirco endures a scalpel's slice with only a twitch.

name: Teslonium
summary: Teslonium is a giant in the ranks of a team secretly founded by a hidden cabal, serving a false order without knowing it. His strength is the cabal's lever.

feats.scene: Teslonium shoves a barricaded door through a lobby.
Teslonium is hit by a loyalist's blast and keeps marching.

name: Elliumne
summary: Elliumne is a giant exiled into space and long gone, but a time-lost elder arrives in his place and fools a parade of heroes into thinking he is back. The mix-up costs them dearly.

feats.scene: Elliumne is said to have thrown a rock out of orbit.
Elliumne is said to have survived a launch pod's crash.

name: Rnseste
summary: Rnseste is a grey-haired giant who leaves his rampages to study peace as a mountain monk. He is lured back to smash a hole in a sentry-making machine.

feats.scene: Rnseste drives a fist through a factory-sized machine and opens a way in.
Rnseste takes ambushing gunfire without breaking his meditative stance.

name: Resseron
summary: Resseron is a giant shown in a memory device, fighting a silent king in a clash of titans. His entry is a flicker.

feats.scene: Resseron tackles a soundless monarch through a rock face.
Resseron stands through a storm of shouted shockwaves.

name: Ororva
summary: Ororva is a video-game giant who teams with heroes to stop a frost-giant invasion and meets a robot copy made by two troublemakers. He shifts between a green brute and a grey suit-wearing tough.

feats.scene: Ororva smashes a frost giant's ice club to powder.
Ororva stands in a robot copy's tackle without moving.

name: Vilnerno
summary: Vilnerno is a hero who avoids a fungus outbreak and turns into a giant with skin nothing can pierce. He is guided by a talking tree until a scratch from a raccoon infects him.

feats.scene: Vilnerno slams a tower door and cracks the frame.
Vilnerno's skin turns aside every bite and bullet in a long chase.

name: Lleonan
summary: Lleonan is a green hero whose image is commercialised in a far-future city, printed on lunchboxes and toys. His past is a sales pitch.

feats.scene: Lleonan is drawn flexing on a plastic lunchbox lid.
Lleonan is stamped onto metal and bends not at all.

name: Misval
summary: Misval is a doctor and giant who outlives a short, cruel war and is bent to the will of a petty king as a guard. A time-hopping hero breaks the spell, and Misval builds a device to undo that future.

feats.scene: Misval clubs a castle gate off its frame.
Misval is hit by a blast that should flatten a house and stays on his feet.

name: Inrosori
summary: Inrosori is a retired giant in a peaceful golden age where crime has all but vanished, spending his days in labs and council halls. He rarely lifts anything heavier than a clipboard.

feats.scene: Inrosori slides a heavy council chair into place.
Inrosori laughs off a wave of lab sparks.

name: Llull
summary: Llull is a green giant who rampages through a city and easily bats aside an ageing masked hero, which prompts a retirement and a changing of the guard. His own plans are unknown.

feats.scene: Llull swats an old hero through a shop window.
Llull strolls through a police barricade of cars.

name: Sereneo
summary: Sereneo is a scientist who once held a brute inside him until a gifted teen drew it off. He joins a council of geniuses against a world-ending machine, and what became of him is unknown.

feats.scene: Sereneo heaves a wrecked server rack out of a doorway.
Sereneo is knocked over by a shockwave and rises coughing.

name: Ulionti
summary: Ulionti is a green rabbit in a cartoon parody who squares off against a gruff general. His ears flap when he gets angry.

feats.scene: Ulionti thumps his foot and rattles a carrot cart.
Ulionti tumbles through a hedge and hops up grinning.

name: Lalleaun
summary: Lalleaun is a quiet salt-miner whose body swells into a lumbering slate-skinned giant when pressure builds underground. Its rage cracks tunnel walls but fades once daylight returns.

feats.scene: Lalleaun drove both fists into a collapsing shaft and held the ceiling apart long enough for the crew to flee.
Lalleaun walked out of a rockfall that buried a freight cart.

name: Siser
summary: Siser is a wandering drover who turns monstrous after a night of insults and wrecks whatever stands nearby. Its strength is feared across the river towns.

feats.scene: Siser hurled an ox wagon across a frozen pond in a single throw.

name: Stutol
summary: Stutol is a brash drummer for a band of smugglers, hardy enough to shrug off wounds that close almost at once. He dies young anyway, to a rival with longer claws.

feats.scene: Stutol shattered a harbour crane with a swing of a steel drum stand.
Stutol stood up after a warehouse door fell flat on top of him.

name: Lesoncel
summary: Lesoncel is a green brute who knows he lives inside a printed booklet and grumbles about it. Anything sketched on a poster can calm him down.

feats.scene: Lesoncel tore a whole panel border out of the page in a fit of temper.

name: Roseoleo
summary: Roseoleo is a gunslinging giant who rides the dry plains with a pair of oversized revolvers. Ranchers pay him in beans to keep outlaws away.

feats.scene: Roseoleo fired both revolvers at once and split a fence line in half.

name: Sorsia
summary: Sorsia is a warped engineer whose bomb tower and bitter grief opened a gate to a swarm of imps. Corrupted, it hunts the sorcerers who try to seal that gate.

feats.scene: Sorsia levelled a stone bank vault with one overhead blow.

name: Ialliva
summary: Ialliva is one of many evolved beings who leave their home world together and fuse into a single mind. That mind eventually devours two cosmic principles and slips out of reality.

feats.scene: Ialliva and the fused chorus snuffed out the twin powers of ending and eternity in one collective act.
Ialliva held its shape through the collapse of a whole fleet's reactors.

name: Nosvelll
summary: Nosvelll is a worn-out physician called in to a long and difficult birth. He is calm, skilled and entirely without powers.

feats.scene: Nosvelll pressed down on a failing pulse with both palms until it steadied.

name: Neoru
summary: Neoru is a hollow sailor puppet, strung up by a bored trickster who treats a whole sea as his toybox. Its crew duties are scripted and it has no will of its own.

feats.scene: Neoru hauled an anchor chain overhead and flung it at the deck.

name: Rumiuaun
summary: Rumiuaun is a rotting titan who conquered a ruined planet before the hungry dead caught him. He is the hungriest creature of his age and unstoppable until tiny machines unmake him.

feats.scene: Rumiuaun brought down a crater wall onto the swarm in a single stamp.
Rumiuaun kept walking while a lunar garrison poured fire into his back.

name: Lusnti
summary: Lusnti is a green bounty hunter in a patchwork realm of stitched-together domains. Hired to drag a fugitive home, he is the first of his team to fall.

feats.scene: Lusnti smashed through a cargo gate with his shoulder to corner a fleeing target.
Lusnti shrugged off a barrage of rifle fire for a full minute.

name: Orsiu
summary: Orsiu is a jade giant and gifted physicist whose fury is a dependable force of ruin. A returning wave of lost life carries it home after a cosmic crisis.

feats.scene: Orsiu cleared a rubble-clogged avenue by sweeping an arm along it.

name: Telri
summary: Telri is a battered survivor in a world ruled by a time-travelling emperor. Fitted with a suppressing collar, he is later freed to make one last desperate strike.

feats.scene: Telri hammered a tyrant's war machine into scrap before the collar was cut loose.

name: Iarniser
summary: Iarniser is a scientist mentioned only in passing, blamed by soldiers for a trashed desert camp and expected at a meeting with a newspaper boss.

feats.scene: Iarniser overturned a jeep that blocked a narrow canyon trail.

name: Amcen
summary: Amcen is a single body shared by two rivals, a scientist and a teenage friend, fused whenever either one loses patience. Only the death of one of them could end the bond.

feats.scene: Amcen flipped a patrol truck onto a ridge while the two minds argued inside.

name: Tesell
summary: Tesell is a shambling mash of marsh corpse and rampaging giant, a thug for a gang of misfits. Its swamp-green fists are wasted on a mystery foe who burns the city to ash.

feats.scene: Tesell hurled a rowing boat through the roof of a pawn shop.

name: Olinauor
summary: Olinauor is a gentle professor whose temper turns him into the strongest fighter on his team. Between battles he builds machines, teaches and jokes with his students.

feats.scene: Olinauor caught a falling aircraft carrier deck and slowed it to a stop with his back.
Olinauor took a gauntlet-driven blast squarely in the chest and stayed standing.

name: Aurauoro
summary: Aurauoro is a green giant bitten by a glowing arachnid, who sells photos to a grumpy editor. Climbing walls, ruining webs, it brags about being the mightiest crawler there is.

feats.scene: Aurauoro pulled a billboard off a roof and used it as a shield against a swarm of hunters.

name: Viron
summary: Viron is an aged recluse who keeps his monster locked down for decades. Called out by a younger generation, he lets it loose one last time against a machine tyrant.

feats.scene: Viron tore the core out of a towering robot with both hands.

name: Ntcenis
summary: Ntcenis is a stranded pilot who rules a primitive a primitive people across many lifetimes, then spends his power to turn them against an invading army. Its descendants never forgive the loss.

feats.scene: Ntcenis lit a plain with radiant energy and wiped out an invading host in a breath.

name: Iumtasval
summary: Iumtasval is a green giant who shields a boy from a blast and shares his thoughts afterwards. Grief for the boy's death turns him savage until a storm god ends him.

feats.scene: Iumtasval crushed an armored suit in his grip and cast the wreck aside.
Iumtasval absorbed lightning from a hammer for several seconds before falling.

name: Viltes
summary: Viltes is a gaudy giant in a star-spangled cape who exists as a joke in an artist's sketchbook. Even in that tiny role he leaps far and hits hard.

feats.scene: Viltes bounced between rooftops and cracked each one with his landing.

name: Ntosta
summary: Ntosta is a background brute from a cartoonish action game, repeating the same angry cycle for every player. Little about him is spelled out.

feats.scene: Ntosta punched a plywood crate and sent splinters across a stage.

name: Tesrin
summary: Tesrin is a green titan sent through a series of side-scrolling levels to stop a scheming genius. He bounds over pits, clubs robots and wrecks the villain's getaway craft.

feats.scene: Tesrin smashed a hovering escape craft to scrap with one overhead swing.

name: Aunlumeo
summary: Aunlumeo is a spirited green hero who joins a mob chasing a tyrant, only to learn that the tyrant is the player controlling the story.

feats.scene: Aunlumeo lunged at a masked despot and hit the floor behind him hard enough to crack it.

name: Tanteeo
summary: Tanteeo is a dependable green bruiser in a team that defends the planet from shapeshifting invaders. He is voiced with a deep growl and plays the muscle of the squad.

feats.scene: Tanteeo slammed an alien trooper through a barricade of steel drums.

name: Onaulon
summary: Onaulon is a hero listed among those lost when a ruthless goblin lord overran the city. Nobody records how he fell.

feats.scene: Onaulon pushed a stalled bus off an intersection before the final assault.

name: Antutiu
summary: Antutiu is a fanged tyrant who rules a night-bound kingdom beneath an artificial green cloud. Only daylight and blessed water can hurt him.

feats.scene: Antutiu ripped a stone gate from its hinges to storm a rival's keep.
Antutiu laughed off a volley of wooden stakes fired point-blank.

name: Eoise
summary: Eoise is an immortal giant kept as a pet by a conqueror. Starved and broken, it begs for an ending that arrives by a single dark sword.

feats.scene: Eoise burst from his chains and flattened a courtyard in a last frenzy.
Eoise endured millennia of feeding and torture without dying.

name: Seollnau
summary: Seollnau is a vessel for an ancient hateful god, a heap of limbs and mouths that devours selves and wants everything hollow. It kills celestial beings and howls as the cosmos runs down.

feats.scene: Seollnau tore apart a world-eater and a child of reality while an eon ran out.
Seollnau stayed whole while the dying cosmos collapsed around it.

name: Lllus
summary: Lllus is a green guest who drinks tea in a kitchen while the city burns outside. The aunt of the house insists on it.

feats.scene: Lllus lifted a dining table so a dish of biscuits could be slid beneath it.

name: Aunco
summary: Aunco is a green brawler at an awards party in a lost jungle, one of many guests who gang up on a cheating winner.

feats.scene: Aunco hurled a banquet table at a gloating trophy-hoarder.

name: Vieostos
summary: Vieostos is a captive gladiator on a scrapyard moon, made to brawl in an arena before turning on the tyrant who owns him. Later he helps a ragtag crew recover shards of a doomsday device.

feats.scene: Vieostos hauled a rusted gantry down onto a line of guards.

name: Ontler
summary: Ontler is a champion remembered only through a carved stone head in a gallery of arena winners. Nobody can say how he arrived there.

feats.scene: Ontler faced a pit challenger in a bout the audience never saw.

name: Nuniu
summary: Nuniu is a captured giant taken to a hilltop base to be talked into serving. Nuniu escapes a crash, fights a spread of hostile specialists and finally flings a time-lost tyrant into the blast that created him.

feats.scene: Nuniu seized a distorted future tyrant and hurled him back through a time-tear.

name: Costar
summary: Costar is a big green hero who is booed by teammates in a holiday greeting for readers. Its diction is plain and chatty for once.

feats.scene: Costar thumped a lectern in protest at a noisy carol.

name: Ausrnsau
summary: Ausrnsau is an unlucky scientist who survives a bomb unchanged while everyone else mutates into giants. A hug from a friend ends him.

feats.scene: Ausrnsau pushed himself upright in a bandaged bed to greet his friends.

name: Stuviltel
summary: Stuviltel is a rampaging brute who kills a string of masked heroes in a fit of blind rage and leaves wreckage behind.

feats.scene: Stuviltel collapsed a rooftop garden onto a squad of costumed defenders.

name: Niamnto
summary: Niamnto is a stage actor playing a boastful version of himself, who bursts into laughter when a tyrant spills juice on a white cloak.

feats.scene: Niamnto slapped his knee so hard a prop rattled off the shelf.

name: Tirsor
summary: Tirsor is a physicist who dosed himself with an experimental serum and became an enormous green brawler. He now fights beside a team of heroes and warns people not to anger him.

feats.scene: Tirsor drove a fist through the hull of a flying fortress.
Tirsor weathered a barrage of heavy cannon fire without a scratch.

name: Anaulel
summary: Anaulel is a green bruiser who helps a glowing golden menace kill rows of costumed heroes in a darkened fortress.

feats.scene: Anaulel pinned a masked fighter to the floor with one palm.

name: Ornen
summary: Ornen is a hulking veteran of a far-future crew who watches a rival-time hero thaw out of ice in a burger joint. Its toy-like body comes from a collector line.

feats.scene: Ornen swung a mechanical fist at a vending machine and flattened it.

name: Seriu
summary: Seriu is a lab scientist locked in a cell alongside a rock-skinned friend until rescuers arrive. Afterwards he joins a coalition fighting a swarm of nanite invaders.

feats.scene: Seriu broke a reinforced cell door and strode into the corridor.

name: Incenam
summary: Incenam is a green guest who smashes a banquet hall after enduring ten minutes of tasteless jokes at a roast.

feats.scene: Incenam swept every plate and chair in the hall into the wall.

name: Ontvalte
summary: Ontvalte is a green soldier in a rotating alliance that tangles with a secret war, a civil dispute and a machine plague.

feats.scene: Ontvalte leapt onto a walking cannon and folded its barrel in half.

name: Auntumval
summary: Auntumval is a mild genius who turns into a mountain of jade muscle whenever his emotions boil over. Between tantrums he wears a stabilizing belt and quotes poetry to himself.

feats.scene: Auntumval clapped his hands and the shockwave shook bridges loose from their pylons.
Auntumval lost no ground against a column of armored tanks.

name: Ntoor
summary: Ntoor is a gifted scientist exposed to a blast of radiation while saving a friend, now a green giant who aims to beat a purple conqueror on a second try.

feats.scene: Ntoor sent a ruined skyscraper crashing into a street full of attackers.

name: Nisneo
summary: Nisneo is a stuffed toy that a boy imagines as a furious giant, one who bursts through doors and flattens whole school buildings in daydreams.

feats.scene: Nisneo knocked down a pretend schoolhouse in the boy's drawing.

name: Stacost
summary: Stacost is a green giant provoked by a stray lunch arrow and out for whoever fired it.

feats.scene: Stacost lunged across a city block to grab a startled archer.

name: Iseroni
summary: Iseroni is a green fighter whom a flame-wielding teen and a masked inventor mention as the old enemy of a gadget-obsessed villain.

feats.scene: Iseroni crumpled a steel barricade in a past brawl.

name: Veleon
summary: Veleon is a furious green giant who storms through a crowded district while a spy trails a killer elsewhere. A line of costumed heroes gathers to stop him.

feats.scene: Veleon flattened a row of parked cars with a sweeping arm.

name: Tolmaeo
summary: Tolmaeo is a quick, tough, green-skinned teammate who helps response-suit pilots stop a rogue machine mind.

feats.scene: Tolmaeo punched a rogue drone out of the sky over a plaza.
Tolmaeo shrugged off a volley of missiles.
Tolmaeo sprinted across a parking structure to intercept a falling pilot.

name: Rosulitor
summary: Rosulitor is a card-sized hero who appears as three different forms in a tabletop game: a green giant, a grey enforcer and a gladiator. The same mild scientist hides behind each.

feats.scene: Rosulitor slammed a board piece through a cardboard wall.

name: Soeoste
summary: Soeoste is a bald, grim tyrant from a ruined future, hurled back to the day of his own birth by a rival and erased there.

feats.scene: Soeoste tore a vault door apart before he was cast into the blast.
Soeoste endured a pounding from his younger rival for an hour.

name: Rauce
summary: Rauce is a stage-show giant on a touring arena production, billed as eight feet tall and a thousand pounds. Foes are smashed on cue and bows to the crowd.

feats.scene: Rauce burst through a painted wall in front of a cheering audience.

name: Loreoeos
summary: Loreoeos is a green brute and researcher who joins a crowd of heroes and villains against a roaring sea monster.

feats.scene: Loreoeos lifted a tram car and hurled it at the beast's flank.

name: Iumontlum
summary: Iumontlum is a guardian posted around a seed on a goofy theme-planet. Warped by an invader, he is beaten and the chain reaction ends the universe.

feats.scene: Iumontlum fell when the seed was stolen and its collapse burned through the cosmos.

name: Rnliucol
