summary: Rnliucol is a brilliant doctor who becomes an eight-foot behemoth when angry and a still bigger beast on a worse day. A hand-clap throws a wave of green force, and his leaps clear a thousand feet.

feats.scene: Rnliucol clapped once and a pulse of green light levelled a block of shopfronts.
Rnliucol took a collapsing tower on his shoulders and kept walking.

name: Tirelu
summary: Tirelu is a wicked giant in a team of villains, defeated by two young agents in a mobile-game episode. A bad day in a dream sequence is his only other appearance.

feats.scene: Tirelu hurled a boulder at the pair of agents and missed.

name: Titelru
summary: Titelru is a scientist who doses himself on purpose and becomes a walking atomic bomb, a government agent of chaos. Titelru detonates wherever the army needs fear spread.

feats.scene: Titelru burst in a flash of white heat and erased a whole port district.
Titelru reformed unharmed from the glowing cloud of his own explosion.

name: Vianist
summary: Vianist is a savage green titan met in a deep dungeon of a monster-collecting game, known as the strongest there is.

feats.scene: Vianist smashed a dungeon gate flat with a downward blow.

name: Monvavel
summary: Monvavel is a green helper who joins a thunder-wielding friend to repair a cottage in a board-game promotion. He calls himself a fixer and carries the tools.

feats.scene: Monvavel hammered a roof beam into place with one fist.

name: Narnuaun
summary: Narnuaun is a failed duplicate of a scientist, brewed in a lab and dismissed as useless. Narnuaun heals from death, grows spider-like and tries to take his original's place before dying for good.

feats.scene: Narnuaun ripped a lab door from its frame to chase his original.
Narnuaun rose from a fatal wound within minutes.

name: Antus
summary: Antus is a dead scientist replaced by a nocturnal monster who has overpowered his rivals and made even gods nervous. Daylight leaves a lifeless husk, and darkness crowns him.

feats.scene: Antus plunged a hand into a battle arena and tore a god's armor in two.
Antus rose after being blasted into rubble.

name: Soranles
summary: Soranles is a grey, well-dressed enforcer who runs gambling dens and shoots anyone who crosses him with twin tommy guns. Soranles is weaker than his green counterpart but craftier.

feats.scene: Soranles emptied both guns into a rival's limousine.
Soranles took a car crash in stride and straightened his tie.

name: Rallelia
summary: Rallelia is a green giant in a joke timeline, tough but outmatched in a newspaper headline that says a shield-bearer is stronger.

feats.scene: Rallelia stood up from a brawl without a bruise.

name: Tesorrni
summary: Tesorrni is a bald and balding despot from a bleak future who runs a ruined city once atomic fire has swept the land. Radiation made him stronger, and he fights with a stolen round shield.

feats.scene: Tesorrni split a collapsing overpass in two with a single swing.
Tesorrni lived through a blast that levelled his palace.

name: Stvalser
summary: Stvalser is a green tyrant who appears only as a power-up card in a fighting game, boosting a team's attacks.

feats.scene: Stvalser flashed on screen and added a bonus to a combo.

name: Eoami
summary: Eoami is a cunning, insane baron of a ruined city, the smartest of all green giants, who allies with a strike force against an invader.

feats.scene: Eoami levelled an armored tower with an upward blow.

name: Oraausmar
summary: Oraausmar is a dictator who conquered a vast arena region, enslaving people and controlling a friend with a collar. He is finally cut down by a warrior woman.

feats.scene: Oraausmar crushed a rebel's war engine in his hands.

name: Lesmor
summary: Lesmor is a robot built by a trap-maker, dressed in a festive red suit and set to chase teenagers around a deadly shopping centre.

feats.scene: Lesmor kicked down a shuttered shop door in pursuit.

name: Leroses
summary: Leroses is a younger, saner conqueror who carries a borrowed shield, a cosmic surfboard cleaver and a glove copy that holds a wishing cube.

feats.scene: Leroses split a mountain range with a swipe of the board.

name: Ernolina
summary: Ernolina is a shapeshifting infiltrator wearing a green giant's costume. It can fire optic beams, but it cannot breathe in orbit.

feats.scene: Ernolina blasted a wall to cinders with beams from its eyes.

name: Seriatiu
summary: Seriatiu is a spy who copies a green scientist as part of an invasion plot, until the heroes catch on and the whole force scatters.

feats.scene: Seriatiu overturned a bench in a park to cover a retreat.

name: Cosine
summary: Cosine is a warrior of a shapeshifting empire, a strengthened infiltrator wearing green skin to hold off a masked hero.

feats.scene: Cosine wrestled a lamppost out of the street to use as a club.

name: Marne
summary: Marne is a bald, grey giant who leads a hidden society in a floating mountain city and massacres a band of rivals before time unwinds and erases his whole line.

feats.scene: Marne sank the walls of a sky citadel with one downward fist.
Marne kept fighting through a barrage of heavy fire.

name: Ontulnum
summary: Ontulnum is a wolf in disguise, one of many fake green giants sent to attack a clawed hero for a television stunt, until a trio of friends turns the tide.

feats.scene: Ontulnum lunged out of a costume and snapped at the target's arm.

name: Seentia
summary: Seentia is the half-wild son of a green giant, raised by a gruff wanderer in a ravaged land. Bold and loud, he joins a gang of cousins and later a band of heroes.

feats.scene: Seentia ripped a gate off a desert fortress to free his adoptive father.

name: Ninti
summary: Ninti is a furry bear who was once president, a clawed and fanged rampager who attacked bystanders until two soldiers stopped him. A collector later cages him.

feats.scene: Ninti swiped a street vendor's stall to pieces.

name: Sessere
summary: Sessere is a lab volunteer who gains the knack of spinning like a top after a lightning strike. He busts bank thieves and rescues crash survivors.

feats.scene: Sessere whirled into a gang and knocked the whole lot down.
Sessere spun across a rail yard to reach a derailed carriage.

name: Estsi
summary: Estsi is a famous film star cast in an invasion picture that a spy keeps sabotaging. He is an ordinary man caught up in a plot.

feats.scene: Estsi shoved a prop door open to escape a faulty set.

name: Ronvo
summary: Ronvo is a nuclear-plant tour guide who gets nipped by a glowing marsupial. Ronvo plays dead on cue and resists wandering onto the highway.

feats.scene: Ronvo swatted a stack of brochures off a counter with his tail.

name: Llvor
summary: Llvor is an enormous green rabbit who steals a set of cosmic gems and schemes to rule everything with a gang of silly animals. Probably he died when the cosmos fell apart.

feats.scene: Llvor hopped through a bank wall to reach the vault.

name: Cirace
summary: Cirace is a lanky doctor spotted in a distant town, mentioned only because a devourer is hiring a new messenger.

feats.scene: Cirace stretched an arm across a diner to snag a menu.

name: Riave
summary: Riave is a bullied teenager killed in a desert blast and reborn as a grey undead giant, bitter enough to spread chaos and raise the dead.

feats.scene: Riave shattered a bridge with a downward blow and raised its victims to walk again.
Riave stepped through a sheet of flame and kept walking.

name: Eonicor
summary: Eonicor is a photographer murdered in a blackmail plot, found out by a flame hero and his young sidekick.

feats.scene: Eonicor tripped a shutter on his last roll of film.

name: Ellniune
summary: Ellniune is a swedish carnival lifter with huge biceps and sturdy teeth. Ellniune works for a band of criminals.

feats.scene: Ellniune lifted a loaded barbell with one hand and tossed it at a rival.

name: Carri
summary: Carri is a strongman in a crime troupe, beaten by a teleporting mutant and a pack of young heroes.

feats.scene: Carri flung a trunk across a big-top ring.

name: Teriava
summary: Teriava is a bald strongman in a ringmaster's troupe of thieves, working a show where nothing is quite what it seems.

feats.scene: Teriava hoisted a stack of crates and carried them to a getaway van.

name: Sates
summary: Sates is a circus strongman and petty criminal rounded up by a wall-crawler.

feats.scene: Sates bent an iron bar over his knee for the crowd.

name: Eosorse
summary: Eosorse is a strongman for a new ringmaster's crime show, big and brawny with a talent for weights.

feats.scene: Eosorse tossed a barrel at a policeman.

name: Rilevil
summary: Rilevil is a stadium singer whose songs are loved across the world. Even a grieving giant plays along on a saxophone to a cassette of his tune.

feats.scene: Rilevil struck a final chord and the crowd roared.

name: Leolle
summary: Leolle is a masked vigilante in a dark suit who fights alongside a young partner against a patchwork of oddities.

feats.scene: Leolle launched a kick that dropped a thug from a rooftop ledge.

name: Ntteleo
summary: Ntteleo is a caped crusader among the many heroes wiped out in a flood of crossovers during a mutant tyrant's rise.

feats.scene: Ntteleo hurled a small gadget and snared a runaway.

name: Orsorveo
summary: Orsorveo is a graveyard thief who dies of fright when a sleeper rises from a tomb, after his partner is beaten.

feats.scene: Orsorveo dropped his shovel at the sight of the rising figure.

name: Nator
summary: Nator is a farcical professor who is accidentally changed into a giant monster by a distracting teen, then lands a cushy job selling vegetables for an ad firm.

feats.scene: Nator lobbed a stack of billboards with a bored shrug.

name: Meoten
summary: Meoten is a bruised green clown who switches sides and joins a goofy band of heroes against a gang of rival teams. He leaps high above the roofs.

feats.scene: Meoten bounced off a clock tower and landed on a pack of rivals.

name: Tusseo
summary: Tusseo is a hulking green passerby glimpsed wandering through streets in the background of a parody comic.

feats.scene: Tusseo knocked over a mailbox while wandering.

name: Nesar
summary: Nesar is a boxing-trained henchman who left crime for warehouse work, then was dragged back by old foes and blown apart by a bomb strapped to his belt.

feats.scene: Nesar landed a heavy cross on a masked foe.
Nesar endured a beating from three villains before the blast.

name: Cotiront
summary: Cotiront is a bully who shakes down a neighbourhood until a butler duels him and the whole street turns on him. Later he is reformed and hired as an assistant.

feats.scene: Cotiront smashed a shop window with a thrown trash can.

name: Colservo
summary: Colservo is a hairless racketeer who runs a ring that forges inheritance papers for rich victims. Colservo relies on hired thugs and a cunning broker, and collapses the moment a real hero walks in.

feats.scene: Colservo slammed a heavy ledger across a clerk's jaw to force a signature.
Colservo took a thrown ashtray to the head and only blinked.

name: Tuslu
summary: Tuslu is a horned bronze-hided bull from an island of old legends, famous for tearing up farmland and trampling heroes who dare to wrestle it. Tuslu is remembered more in stories told by a strongman demigod than in any record of its own.

feats.scene: Tuslu charged through a stone barn wall and carried the rubble across a field.
Tuslu stood still while a chariot rammed its flank and the wheels shattered.
Tuslu galloped across a plain faster than any horse in the royal stable.

name: Elltiuter
summary: Elltiuter is a small-time thug in a parody city who is famous only for his stout pet hound. Elltiuter has no skills beyond bullying passers-by and a loud, rude laugh.

feats.scene: Elltiuter shoved a kid off a stoop with one meaty palm.
Elltiuter bounced off a parked bus and complained about the paint.

name: Taranne
summary: Taranne is a silent contract killer who throws darts, knives and loose coins with uncanny accuracy. Taranne takes jobs for a crooked syndicate and prefers distance to any close fight.

feats.scene: Taranne pinned a fleeing courier's sleeve to a door from across a ballroom with a single dart.
Taranne rolled off a second-floor balcony and rose without a limp.
Taranne sprinted down an alley and over a fence in four seconds.

name: Tiunumlus
summary: Tiunumlus is a sorcerer's apprentice who helped murder a tyrant, then grabbed a glowing relic from the corpse. Tiunumlus was burned to ash when the relic detonated in a bright burst.

feats.scene: Tiunumlus triggered a relic blast that gutted a throne room.
Tiunumlus held up a ward against falling masonry for a moment before it cracked.

name: Niateloli
summary: Niateloli is a bald street punk who ambushes a masked vigilante at her own front door. Niateloli runs off after a beating and swears revenge from the nearest rooftop.

feats.scene: Niateloli swung a chain at a window and the glass exploded outward.
Niateloli took two kicks to the ribs and still scrambled over a wall.

name: Ntostium
summary: Ntostium is a fair-haired veteran freed from a prison camp who picks up a rifle and never misses a target. Ntostium leads a ragged rebel crowd against a fortified tower in a ruined future.

feats.scene: Ntostium emptied a belt of ammunition and dropped every sentry on the airstrip tower.
Ntostium ran through a hail of return fire with only a grazed arm.

name: Neulise
summary: Neulise is a mercenary killer for hire who joins a rebel strike on a squad of piloted robots. Neulise falls to a swarm of cloned lightning-wielders after the plan stalls.

feats.scene: Neulise fired point-blank through the viewport of a piloted robot.
Neulise took a fall from a collapsing gantry and rolled upright.

name: Llionros
summary: Llionros is a rotting, hungry corpse of a once-famous marksman, staggering into a feast on a giant visitor. Llionros keeps throwing sharp scraps at anything that moves, never tiring and never feeling pain.

feats.scene: Llionros flung a rusty blade through the eye of a giant's guard.
Llionros kept walking after half his torso was blasted away.

name: Ritutia
summary: Ritutia is a dead sportsman rebuilt over and over by a cult of ninjas with sorcery and cold machinery into a perfectly obedient killer. Ritutia obeys every order and never misses the mark.

feats.scene: Ritutia sent a thrown ball through a vault door and into the safe behind it.
Ritutia stood up after a car hit him at full speed and resumed the hunt.
Ritutia vaulted a rail and across a rooftop gap in one stride.

name: Eosseror
summary: Eosseror is a villain who leads drones to a floating fortress's launch bay and fires a rocket at a distant skyline. Eosseror is later controlled by tiny machines in his blood and forced to serve the other side.

feats.scene: Eosseror launched a missile whose warhead flattened a whole intersection and several shops.
Eosseror took a shield blow to the chest and stayed on his feet.

name: Nenco
summary: Nenco is a reformed hitman recruited into a government strike team stationed in a mountain base. Nenco has unusually sharp reasoning and a flawless throwing arm.

feats.scene: Nenco snapped a throw that disarmed a possessed man across a crowded street.
Nenco survived a hard tackle through a plate-glass door.

name: Oraceleo
summary: Oraceleo is a former contract killer whose body was warped by a plague into a shifting golden and black giant. Oraceleo grows or shrinks at will and crushes steel with bare hands.

feats.scene: Oraceleo punched through the wall of a skyscraper lobby and brought down the ceiling.
Oraceleo walked through a tank barrage with only scuffs on his golden hide.

name: Rnonum
summary: Rnonum is a wanted man in a silly parody city who hides in a pub in disguise while his own face is on the television. Rnonum used to pelt a neighbor kid with baseballs for sport.

feats.scene: Rnonum hurled a bar stool at a gang of patrons chasing him.
Rnonum took a mug to the forehead and ordered another round.

name: Velnoleo
summary: Velnoleo is the soul of a murdered killer who woke in a gloomy afterlife and refused paradise to live out his old habits there. Velnoleo once swapped bodies with a hero and was killed by his own stolen hands.

feats.scene: Velnoleo drove a spectral dagger through a ghost guard's ribs.
Velnoleo took a mob's blows in the underworld with no lasting harm.

name: Siriaun
summary: Siriaun is a gun-for-hire sent on a mission to a jungle plateau where nearly every creature has died overnight. Siriaun does not return from it.

feats.scene: Siriaun dropped three lizard-riders with a burst from a rifle.
Siriaun waded through a toxic fog before collapsing.

name: Cornicil
summary: Cornicil is a paid assassin caught up in an invasion by shapeshifting aliens after a disaster wipes out a city's heroes. Cornicil is cut down in one of the last battles.

feats.scene: Cornicil threw a pen-sized spike through a disguised invader's visor.
Cornicil survived a thrown car door before the invaders overran him.

name: Llveornu
summary: Llveornu is a blue-eyed contract killer who serves a crime lord until a resurrected avenger ends them both. Llveornu never gets to land a final shot.

feats.scene: Llveornu sank a steel dart into a doorframe an inch from a rival's head.
Llveornu absorbed a body slam from a bodyguard without losing his grin.

name: Ciritus
summary: Ciritus is a hired killer who joins a villain gang to spring a green-masked madman from jail and storm a hero tower. Ciritus fights on until reality itself unravels around him.

feats.scene: Ciritus pelted a web-slinger with a hail of thrown shards on a rooftop.
Ciritus was flung through a window and got up cursing.

name: Neste
summary: Neste is a mercenary hired to wear another man's costume in a villainous parody of a hero team. Neste carries a bow and trick arrows and has a quick mind for angles.

feats.scene: Neste launched an arrow that knocked a gun from a guard across a courtyard.
Neste dove behind a toppled pillar as a fortress collapsed and walked away.

name: Oncau
summary: Oncau is a contract killer who appears inside a hallucination, cut down alongside a team of famous vigilantes. Oncau is just one of many casualties in a dream conjured by a demon.

feats.scene: Oncau threw a blade that bit into a stone gargoyle in the dream city.
Oncau absorbed a vicious kick before the nightmare swallowed him.

name: Iumnau
summary: Iumnau is a shaved mercenary posing as an archer on a tyrant's roster of fake heroes. Iumnau dies when a real archer breaks into the fortress.

feats.scene: Iumnau fired a barbed bolt into a doorframe to block a pursuer.
Iumnau took a punch from a clawed brawler and stayed upright.

name: Amasauium
summary: Amasauium is a blond, blue-eyed killer who finally corners an old rival after many quiet years. Amasauium has the sharpest aim among rooftop killers and a mind quick enough to plan every move.

feats.scene: Amasauium flung a thin spike across a courtyard and into a man's chest.
Amasauium hit a skylight with his back and was up in seconds.

name: Nosllil
summary: Nosllil is an unhinged killer with strips of metal bonded to his bones, able to turn almost any object in reach into a deadly missile. Nosllil takes freelance work from crime lords and loves a good chase.

feats.scene: Nosllil hurled a paperclip that cut a bank camera in two.
Nosllil dropped four floors onto concrete and strolled off on reinforced bones.

name: Leolo
summary: Leolo is an archer-for-hire in a team of imitation heroes who ends up as one of many victims when a purple titan arrives to take back a glove of power. Leolo never loses his smirk until the end.

feats.scene: Leolo let loose a volley that pinned a courier's coat to a wall.
Leolo tumbled down a stairwell and rose cheerfully.

name: Nesete
summary: Nesete is a shaved assassin with a painted ring on his forehead who tracks down a lawyer's wife on a rainy night. Nesete works alone and answers to no one.

feats.scene: Nesete threw a card that sliced a taxi's tyre mid-turn.
Nesete got up after a stairwell tumble and walked out into the rain.

name: Eoiar
summary: Eoiar is a phantom conjured by a trickster to trouble an aging gunslinger. Eoiar is nothing more than a smoke-and-mirror copy of a feared killer, and vanishes when the illusion ends.

feats.scene: Eoiar flung an illusory blade that left a real scratch across a boot.
Eoiar flickered and reformed after a strike passed through his chest.

name: Sorlean
summary: Sorlean is a killer for hire who bonded with an alien slime and was later devoured by a swarm of tooth-mouthed hunters. Sorlean's blades hit harder with the slime on his arms.

feats.scene: Sorlean smashed a stone pillar to chunks with a slime-wrapped fist.
Sorlean shrugged off a car hurled by a hunter before the swarm caught him.

name: Rneter
summary: Rneter is a parody version of a sharp-shooter who strikes the same dramatic stance, but only to open a rain umbrella on a sunny afternoon. Rneter is harmless and a little silly.

feats.scene: Rneter flicked open an umbrella with a theatrical flourish.
Rneter tripped over a curb and brushed himself off.

name: Tiuce
summary: Tiuce is a gentle parody of a deadly gunman who copies a famous pose to release a wounded sparrow back to the sky. Tiuce is kind to every animal he meets.

feats.scene: Tiuce lofted an injured sparrow with a flick of his wrist.
Tiuce slipped on wet grass and walked it off.

name: Lonteaun
summary: Lonteaun is a bald gang boss covered in pins he uses to fight a constant tremor. Lonteaun hides a bomb in his tooth and takes his enemy with him in one last gamble.

feats.scene: Lonteaun bit down on a hidden trigger and turned a rooftop into a crater.
Lonteaun fell off a roof onto a parked van and kept fighting.

name: Orcolmi
summary: Orcolmi is a killer who exists mostly as a story whispered by a priestly figure while a cursed rider faces something vast and nameless. Orcolmi has almost no deeds of his own to speak of.

feats.scene: Orcolmi flung a dart through a candle flame in a recounted vision.
Orcolmi shrugged off a thrown chair in the retelling.

name: Uliumnt
summary: Uliumnt is a boss in a street-fighting video game, a villain with metal strips in his bones who waits for challengers in a skyscraper lobby and a crime lord's tower. Uliumnt attacks in a pattern that rewards patient players.

feats.scene: Uliumnt hurled a ring of darts that peppered a whole row of pillars.
Uliumnt took a full combo from three players and had health left.

name: Tiurimeo
summary: Tiurimeo is a collectible plastic figure of a marksman, sold in a small block-shaped set with posable limbs and a tiny prop. Tiurimeo is chiefly valued by hobbyists who display it on a shelf.

feats.scene: Tiurimeo flicked a plastic dart off a desk when a child snapped his arm forward.
Tiurimeo survived a drop from a shelf with only a scuffed knee.

name: Rauleoor
summary: Rauleoor is a hired killer who is first fought in an early season of a vigilante's story, a man blessed with fast reasoning and a perfect throw. Rauleoor works for whoever pays best.

feats.scene: Rauleoor threw a coin that cracked the lens of a streetlamp.
Rauleoor took a kick to the gut and spat a tooth before running.

name: Rnironnum
summary: Rnironnum is a card in a mobile battle game, a lean mercenary who fights with a borrowed pair of curved prongs. Rnironnum has no known past and a strong appetite for rare contracts.

feats.scene: Rnironnum drove both prongs through a training dummy in a single lunge.
Rnironnum took an arena fall and slid to a stop unharmed.

name: Rntesau
summary: Rntesau is a dark-haired killer drafted into a heroes' school after switching sides in a lord's war. Rntesau prefers hunting the lord's soldiers to the original job.

feats.scene: Rntesau flung a handful of coins that stunned three ninjas at once.
Rntesau shook off a thrown staff and kept on going.

name: Tescel
summary: Tescel is a mercenary who joins an unsteady alliance against a world-eating conqueror, mocking enemies who try to run. Tescel is a deadly shot and sharp thinker, and carries a pouch of throwing spikes.

feats.scene: Tescel dropped a fleeing drone with a thrown spike from a hundred paces.
Tescel walked out of a smoking vehicle wreck with a smile.

name: Viastva
summary: Viastva is a peasant from a feudal kingdom who joins a loud rebellion against a queen and her knights. Viastva is a farmer with a pitchfork and nothing more.

feats.scene: Viastva swung a pitchfork and cracked a gatepost.
Viastva took a shield bash and stayed on his feet.

name: Tiustu
summary: Tiustu is an imitator and sidekick of a famous electrical foe, forming a goofy duo who try to join a team of vigilantes. Tiustu copies everything he sees and is pushed off a roof for his trouble.

feats.scene: Tiustu tossed a razor card that sliced a billboard rope.
Tiustu dropped from a rooftop and came up bruised but laughing.

name: Tuameium
summary: Tuameium is a criminal who tries to stop a band of heroes from gathering colored gems for a purple conqueror. Tuameium is beaten when the team throws him out a window.

feats.scene: Tuameium hurled a handful of spikes that shredded a curtain.
Tuameium hit a street from three floors up and groaned.

name: Iaameiar
summary: Iaameiar is a foe from a cartoon-style mobile game who battles a squad of cheerful heroes and later joins a team of impostors. Iaameiar is more of a nuisance than a threat.

feats.scene: Iaameiar fired a rubber-tipped bolt into a rival's helmet.
Iaameiar was flattened by a giant mallet and popped back up.

name: Tusnauni
summary: Tusnauni is a bearded, bald marksman who was erased from his own timeline by bureaucrats and exiled to an empty wasteland, where he serves a scheming telepath. Tusnauni throws steel stars in battle.

feats.scene: Tusnauni flung a star that stuck deep into a rusty pillar.
Tusnauni took a card-wielding rival's hits for a full round.

name: Ororsum
summary: Ororsum is a boss in an old home-computer game, a crime lord's lieutenant who appears in a few pixelated levels. Ororsum falls to a gun-toting player after a short fight.

feats.scene: Ororsum tossed a pixel dart across a sprite warehouse.
Ororsum took a stack of hits on his health bar before dropping.

name: Nansarte
summary: Nansarte is a mercenary who kills a woman warrior, is hunted by her until she wins, and then returns to kidnap her. Nansarte is later hired by a trickster and an armored monarch to stall two heroes and loses every time.

feats.scene: Nansarte flicked a spike that pierced a hero's glove.
Nansarte endured a flurry of blows before collapsing.

name: Cotesmeo
summary: Cotesmeo is a killer who won a deadly tournament in a possible future and ends a young heroine with a single playing card. Cotesmeo's future is erased when a vision is averted in time.

feats.scene: Cotesmeo flicked a card that drove into a young hero's throat in the vision.
Cotesmeo took a tournament beating and stood back up smiling.

name: Nesnia
summary: Nesnia is a corrupted conqueror who rules a whole continent as a puppet of a cosmic invader, and is eventually killed by a squad of rebels. Nesnia's reign lasts years but his own fighting power is modest.

feats.scene: Nesnia threw a gilded spike that skewered a rebel scout from across a throne hall.
Nesnia took a rebel's blast to the armor and sneered.

name: Eosleser
summary: Eosleser is a cartoon crook in a board-game spinoff who is a suspect in the case of a missing rubber toy. Eosleser plays a part in a small mystery solved by a few gentle sleuths.

feats.scene: Eosleser tossed a game token across a table to distract a detective.
Eosleser bounced off a game board and spun around the corner.

name: Raiais
summary: Raiais is a drone of a parasite hive, a slime-bodied hunter that devours hosts and joins a swarm to spread across worlds. Raiais is destroyed when a rival hero's bomb goes off in the middle of the nest.

feats.scene: Raiais tore through a bulkhead and flung two guards across a corridor.
Raiais was caught in the blast of a planted bomb that gutted a whole docking bay.

name: Vaiuval
summary: Vaiuval is a jungle deity of a layered sky realm who rules the upper heavens and is worshipped by priests in stepped temples. Vaiuval hurls storms across forests and rewards those who bring offerings.

feats.scene: Vaiuval brought a thunderhead down on a rebel hill and flattened the grove.
Vaiuval stood unharmed as a temple pyramid collapsed on his shoulders.

name: Teuli
summary: Teuli is a primordial sky father who wove the world from dream and thunder and now sleeps beyond the clouds. Teuli is worshipped under many titles by peoples of dry savannas and green coasts.

feats.scene: Teuli split a continent into two seas with one breath while forming the first world.
Teuli endured the collapse of his own dream-sky without a mark.

name: Saaunsau
summary: Saaunsau is a sky-god seated on a council of divine rulers in a world where every myth is true. Saaunsau mediates quarrels between the heavens and the deeps and wields the power of the first dawn.

feats.scene: Saaunsau shattered a rogue moon with a single decree to end a divine feud.
Saaunsau sat unmoved as a rival god's storm broke on the council hall.

name: Ontsan
summary: Ontsan is a grey-haired veteran warrior of a northern realm, guarding a fortress gate with a heavy axe. Ontsan has seen many wars and trusts few younger knights.

feats.scene: Ontsan split a shield and the arm behind it with one swing of his axe.
Ontsan took a mace blow to the helm and finished the duel.

name: Sanserliu
summary: Sanserliu is a gifted young student from a future school, a buzzing, cheerful boy who senses danger before it happens. Sanserliu plays pranks on classmates and flits through crowded halls.

feats.scene: Sanserliu launched a fast jab that dented a locker door.
Sanserliu bounced off a hallway wall and giggled.

name: Tiate
summary: Tiate is a teenaged insect-themed hero, a bumbling but earnest member of a gang of buzzing cousins. Tiate stumbles through rescues and always lands on his feet in the end.

feats.scene: Tiate stung a thug with a stun-spike that sent him sprawling over a dumpster.
Tiate crashed through a hedge and a fence and brushed off the leaves.

name: Tiurir
summary: Tiurir is a hairless, green-skinned mutant who works as a chauffeur for a school of young misfits. Tiurir drives anything on four wheels and is quietly proud of the stunt-skills he picked up on dangerous roads.

feats.scene: Tiurir shoved open a jammed van door that three students could not budge.
Tiurir climbed out of a flipped limousine and straightened his cap.

name: Artumses
summary: Artumses is a brown-haired man in a rough part of a cobbled-together city, a petty crook and bystander in an ugly war between monsters. Artumses shrugs and takes whatever coin he can find.

feats.scene: Artumses punched a vending machine until it spat out a can.
Artumses staggered off a hard shove into a brick wall.

name: Aulorte
summary: Aulorte is the long-suffering sidekick of a pious parody hero, a boy who gets blamed for everything his chaplain partner botches. Aulorte answers to a pet name and eventually quits.

feats.scene: Aulorte tossed a hymnal at a mugger and caught him on the nose.
Aulorte took a sermon-length beating and still straightened his cap.

name: Vilvain
summary: Vilvain is a gag-comic sidekick in a team of mock heroes, a lad known by a childish nickname who always trails his leader. Vilvain narrates his own mishaps in loud captions.

feats.scene: Vilvain bonked a robber with a rolled-up flag.
Vilvain was squashed by a falling anvil and got up flat as paper.

name: Lleeos
summary: Lleeos is a crime boss rebuilt as a machine-limbed enforcer, with a snake-themed glove that hisses when he threatens a victim. Lleeos runs a nightclub and sees every rival as prey.

feats.scene: Lleeos drove a servo-fist through a steel door and into a bodyguard.
Lleeos took a delivery truck's bumper to the chest and stood tall.

name: Llsaau
summary: Llsaau is a black-and-white flightless bird kept as a pet by a cold-loving villain. Llsaau waddles around an icy lair and sneaks fish from the pantry.

feats.scene: Llsaau flapped a flipper and knocked a teacup off a table.
Llsaau slid down an ice ramp and bounced up.

name: Tossa
summary: Tossa is a widow with brown eyes and black hair who works beside a hard-fisted hero and a ruthless soldier of fortune. Tossa carries grief quietly and is braver than she looks.

feats.scene: Tossa slapped an intruder hard enough to leave a handprint.
Tossa tripped over a rug and got back on her feet.

name: Tueonama
summary: Tueonama is a grey-haired servant of a dark dimension, loyal to a young sorceress and haunted by his brother's choices. Tueonama conjures wards and murky bolts against invaders.

feats.scene: Tueonama blasted a gate of shadow off its hinges with a dark bolt.
Tueonama raised a ward that held for a breath against a fiend's claws.

name: Sosser
summary: Sosser is a primeval being at the root of a royal family of gods, born from a cosmic cow licking salt from frost. Sosser sired a line of rulers and then faded into legend.

feats.scene: Sosser shaped a great hall from the first ice in a single sweep of his arm.
Sosser stood in the first dark as the void tried to unmake him.

name: Lusilva
summary: Lusilva is a purple-eyed immortal with a long memory who hires out to ancient factions for centuries. Lusilva heals from nearly any wound and calmly tells younger recruits to expect little.

feats.scene: Lusilva cracked a stone altar with a downward fist.
Lusilva took a car crash at speed and was back on his feet in a minute.

name: Isece
summary: Isece is a hulking brown alien shaped like molten rock, born on a volcanic world and drawn to forge-fires. Isece walks through lava and crushes iron plates in his fists.

feats.scene: Isece slammed a fist on a bridge and dropped a hundred meters of road into a gorge.
Isece waded through a blast furnace and came out steaming.

name: Isell
summary: Isell is a rugged sailor who happens to be a talking animal in a parody seaport, a dock-hand who sings badly and boasts of storms he has weathered. Isell is gruff and kind.

feats.scene: Isell swung a coil of rope and flipped a smuggler off the pier.
Isell was tossed into the harbor and climbed out singing.

name: Cenamcen
summary: Cenamcen is a gray-haired outcast who lives in a hidden warren under a city, a boy-turned-man whose body can ignite and pool like fuel. Cenamcen is easily overlooked until he strikes a spark.

feats.scene: Cenamcen burst into a sheet of flame that gutted a warehouse floor.
Cenamcen soaked up a thug's volley and re-formed on the cobbles.

name: Niuntse
summary: Niuntse is a green-skinned entity with a serpent's lower body and snakes for arms, serving a trio of cosmic rulers as a living torch. Niuntse hisses fire across the field of battle.

feats.scene: Niuntse breathed a blaze that scorched a mountainside to glass.
Niuntse coiled through a collapsing peak and rose unscathed.

name: Cenlu
summary: Cenlu is a guard in a rust-colored suit of powered armor, working for a firm that builds weapons and killed in a street battle by a deranged killer. Cenlu follows orders and dies without ever knowing why.

feats.scene: Cenlu fired a gauntlet shot that cracked a concrete barrier.
Cenlu shrugged off a car-hood slam before the killer reached him.

name: Iaraunoli
summary: Iaraunoli is a father marked with a letter tattoo, a quiet man whose wife and daughter die young and whose son grows into a time-hopping soldier. Iaraunoli is plain and stoic.

feats.scene: Iaraunoli swung a hammer at a stubborn fencepost until it cracked.
Iaraunoli took a rifle butt to the jaw and stayed standing.

name: Tiali
summary: Tiali is a lumpy blue creature with no eyes and a round body, a doctor of sorts who patches heroes in a hidden clinic. Tiali pops from place to place and chirps at patients.

feats.scene: Tiali bounced against a stack of crates and sent them tumbling.
Tiali was squashed under a falling cabinet and rolled out unhurt.

name: Animeau
summary: Animeau is a dark-haired cyborg mercenary who plugs into a vicious corporation's feed and charges into walls to open breaches. Animeau works for a masked commander and takes the loudest jobs.

feats.scene: Animeau overloaded a power cell and blew a door off its frame.
Animeau tanked a vehicle ram with his steel ribs and fired back.

name: Lerri
summary: Lerri is a warrior prince of a conquering alien dynasty, bred for battle by a famous father and allied to a vast intelligence and a warlike emperor. Lerri blasts enemy fleets with bright beams from his gauntlets.

feats.scene: Lerri fired a beam that vaporized a tank column and the ridge behind it.
Lerri stood in the wreck of his own warship and walked out unburned.

name: Tator
summary: Tator is a brown-haired beat cop on a big-city police force who gets pulled into a farcical clash between costumed heroes and talking pets. Tator mostly writes reports and keeps order at the scene.

feats.scene: Tator swung his baton at a rowdy suspect and dropped him cold.
Tator got knocked down by a runaway cat and shook it off.

name: Leosesar
summary: Leosesar is an eccentric actor who loves to do impressions of film heroes, a man with a loving aunt and a rival brother. Leosesar acts out daring rescues in the street and sometimes ends up in real danger.

feats.scene: Leosesar cracked a bullwhip at a pretend villain and dented a mailbox.
Leosesar slid down a roof in costume and hit a trash bin.

name: Renrumsi
summary: Renrumsi is a bald former soldier whose green skin faded back to normal, a riot-squad officer who held a grudge against a giant monster. Renrumsi once changed into a brute form and still fears the shift.

feats.scene: Renrumsi punched a wall in anger and left a fist-sized hole in the plaster.
Renrumsi took a battering from a brute and kept on his feet.

name: Iumtia
summary: Iumtia is a plain man in an old suspense tale, caught in a plot of betrayal that ends with a cruel twist. Iumtia has little power and relies on luck to get through the night.

feats.scene: Iumtia shoved a lamp onto a pursuer in a dark hallway.
Iumtia ran into a door and kept running.

name: Niuortel
summary: Niuortel is a self-styled king of a horned-horse cult who commands a band of costumed followers in wartime. Niuortel wears a gaudy mask and relies on bluster and sabotage.

feats.scene: Niuortel lashed out with a spiked cane and snapped a lamp post's glass.
Niuortel was hit by a pistol butt and glared on defiantly.

name: Amatianiu
summary: Amatianiu is a grey-furred, red-eyed rat living in the walls of a housing block, scurrying through pipes and gnawing cables. Amatianiu is clever for a rodent and keeps an eye on the tenants.

feats.scene: Amatianiu gnawed a wire in half and darkened a stairwell.
Amatianiu fell off a pipe and scampered away.
Amatianiu bolted across a kitchen floor in a blink.

name: Ontnave
summary: Ontnave is a red-skinned warrior with a hair-style of flame who serves a dimension-hopping agency and a band of sky pilots. Ontnave ignites fuel and torches whole squads.

feats.scene: Ontnave burst a fuel tank and set a hangar ablaze.
Ontnave walked out of a burning wreck unscathed.

name: Ruleoru
summary: Ruleoru is a black-haired strongman of a traveling tent show, a bruiser who lifts barrels and guards the wagons. Ruleoru works for a crooked ringmaster and enjoys the applause.

feats.scene: Ruleoru hoisted an anvil over his head and hurled it into a wagon.
Ruleoru was knocked from a tightrope and bounced off the sawdust.

name: Stuteser
summary: Stuteser is a bald meat-cutter who joins a post-war gang as a thug, carrying a cleaver and a loud laugh. Stuteser is put down by a pair of masked defenders in the end.

feats.scene: Stuteser brought his cleaver down and split a butcher block in two.
Stuteser shrugged off a crowbar swing and swung back.

name: Nanvalaul
summary: Nanvalaul is a green-haired winged man of a cloud-top city, a loyal mate and scout who rides high winds above his home. Nanvalaul dives on intruders with sharpened spears.

feats.scene: Nanvalaul plunged from a thermal and drove a spear through a raider's shield.
Nanvalaul clipped a crag at speed and flew on.
Nanvalaul stooped through a canyon faster than a falcon.

name: Leostam
summary: Leostam is a dim-witted green giant created when a lab accident bathed him in strange rays, now a brute who laughs at everything he smashes. Leostam wrecks a diner while looking for nachos.

feats.scene: Leostam stomped a parking structure into powder while hunting for snacks.
Leostam laughed through a tank barrage and a collapsing overpass.

name: Usorco
summary: Usorco is a blue-eyed girl with brown hair growing up with a family curse, a sweet teen who senses a beast stalking her neighborhood. Usorco keeps a diary of the strange nights.

feats.scene: Usorco swatted a bat from the air with a rolled-up map.
Usorco fell from a tree and brushed off her knees.

name: Cerne
summary: Cerne is a goofy copy of a wisecracking mercenary, made by a vain god as a joke and stuck with a ridiculous costume. Cerne regrows limbs, tells bad jokes and fights badly.

feats.scene: Cerne fired two pistols wildly and hit a chandelier by accident.
Cerne grew back an arm in time to wave at a camera.

name: Saulico
summary: Saulico is a low-ranking demon with a ridiculous posture, serving a hell-lord as a lackey and spitting sulfur at slow riders. Saulico is a coward and sulks in the boiler rooms of the pit.

feats.scene: Saulico spat a gout of brimstone that melted a gate hinge.
Saulico fell down a stairwell of rock and clambered back up.

name: Cortos
summary: Cortos is a pop-music mogul with a flowing robe who leads a hidden mountain hideout, a dancing villain who feuds with his old partner. Cortos shouts catchy threats to a bored crowd.

feats.scene: Cortos swung a stage prop and cracked a spotlight.
Cortos slid off a rolling platform and stayed in rhythm.

name: Rosva
summary: Rosva is a brown-haired, brown-eyed man with a one-word nickname, a footnote in a story about duplicates and doubles. Rosva appears briefly in a crowd and is easy to forget.

feats.scene: Rosva shoved a stalled door open with his shoulder.
Rosva walked off a tumble down subway stairs.

name: Teteeo
summary: Teteeo is a hairless, scavenging possum with wings who joins a rogue gang of talking animals as a getaway pilot. Teteeo glides over rooftops and steals shiny things from pigeons.

feats.scene: Teteeo dive-bombed a hot dog stand and scattered the buns.
Teteeo smacked a pigeon coop and shook it off.
Teteeo swooped across a plaza in a hurry.

name: Luvelte
summary: Luvelte is a brown-haired young mutant with a spinning disc of metal around his body, a cultist who left a divine movement after a doubt. Luvelte slices cables and rubble when angry.

feats.scene: Luvelte spun a whirling disc that carved a steel girder into slices.
Luvelte took a punch from a bigger cultist and kept spinning.

name: Ntueotan
summary: Ntueotan is a vast, many-armed elder being from the black between stars, a bearded shambling horror who stirs when his name is spoken. Ntueotan sends ghostly mouths to swallow towns.

feats.scene: Ntueotan ripped a small moon from orbit and let it crash into an ocean.
Ntueotan shrugged off a stellar flare that scorched a planet's face.

name: Leomonan
summary: Leomonan is a young attendant in a royal hall of gods, a servant of a sky-realm who pours drink and sings at feasts. Leomonan carries a sword on holy days and enjoys the music.

feats.scene: Leomonan cleaved an oak table in half during a toast gone wrong.
Leomonan took a ram's charge in a brawl and laughed.

name: Risesrnu
summary: Risesrnu is a blue-skinned, red-eyed giant of the frozen realm, a brother among the ice kings and a cold-hearted hunter. Risesrnu exhales a freezing wind that locks rivers solid.

feats.scene: Risesrnu froze a valley river and shattered a village's bridge with an ice club.
Risesrnu stood under an avalanche and shook off the snow.

name: Tiacolus
summary: Tiacolus is a fallen angel of rank, clipped of his wings and cast into a bleak underworld, now a bitter tempter whispering to the damned. Tiacolus hurls bolts of dark light at the pure.

feats.scene: Tiacolus hurled a dark bolt that blew a chapel dome to ash.
Tiacolus shrugged off a holy flare that scorched a whole street.

name: Valis
summary: Valis is a pink-eyed lord of a small kingdom of space-faring folk, a proud father who lost a son and a sister-in-law to war. Valis fights with a ceremonial blade and old pride.

feats.scene: Valis cleaved a drone's casing with a ceremonial blade.
Valis weathered a blaster hit on his breastplate and stayed regal.

name: Titil
summary: Titil is a balding, black-haired henchman of a big crime lord, a suit who counts money and breaks fingers when told. Titil is loyal but not especially bright.

feats.scene: Titil punched a shopkeeper's counter and cracked the glass.
Titil took a bat to the arm and complained about his suit.

name: Tenrense
summary: Tenrense is a hired scout who reads trails across ruined highways faster than any hound. Tenrense carries a thin blade and trades quick footwork for a quiet kill.

feats.scene: Tenrense cuts through a rusted gate in a single running slash.
Tenrense shrugs off a fall from a collapsing gantry onto packed gravel.

name: Nantiucal
summary: Nantiucal is a gaunt, clawed wanderer who sniffs out hidden people in sewers and tunnels. Nantiucal has been laid low and brought back more than once, and keeps returning to the same dark corridors.

feats.scene: Nantiucal rips a steel hatch off its hinges to reach the people sheltering below.
Nantiucal survives a volley of rifle fire at close range and stands up again.

name: Stureont
summary: Stureont is a pale, bald drifter who learns late in life that his body is different. Stureont helps gather scattered strangers into a safer group in a cold port city.

feats.scene: Stureont shoves a heavy cart across a loading dock to block a doorway.
Stureont takes a hard beating from a street gang and keeps walking.

name: Leran
summary: Leran is a prisoner in a fortress built to hold the unusual, with yellow eyes and a patient stare. Leran walks out when strangers from other worlds smash the cell doors, then vanishes from every record.

feats.scene: Leran hurls a stool through a cell window to signal the rescuers.
Leran endures weeks of shock treatment in a bare concrete cell.

name: Rosrnoama
summary: Rosrnoama is a clawed brute seen standing in a line of fighters gathered to face mechanical hunters. Rosrnoama is never heard from again after the muster ends.

feats.scene: Rosrnoama rakes a steel drum open with a swipe of curved claws.
Rosrnoama stands unmoved as a mob swings clubs at his ribs.

name: Renauas
summary: Renauas is a pale seeker who can feel other gifted people from miles off, and who burns badly in daylight. Renauas hides in shaded rooms and ends his own life rather than lead hunters to his friends.

feats.scene: Renauas detonates a handful of grenades in a dark storeroom to deny his captors.
Renauas endures a day tied in open sunlight without breaking.

name: Aluannu
summary: Aluannu has chalk-white skin and lives through a grim timeline where a leader falls and cities turn on the gifted. Aluannu is rounded up and kept behind wire with thousands of others.

feats.scene: Aluannu bends a fence post to open a gap for children.
Aluannu survives a winter in the open camp without shelter.

name: Tumiumir
summary: Tumiumir is a mad ruler who owns a cursed book whose presence warps his judgment and his court. Tumiumir sends a patrol to a far desert outpost, where one of his men finds a fallen star-ship and a suit that bends the world around its wearer.

feats.scene: Tumiumir orders a column of soldiers to level a hill fort with rams.
Tumiumir survives a poisoned banquet and a knife in the dark.

name: Inecian
summary: Inecian rules a walled desert city with sleepy confidence and an unwise taste for flattery. Inecian adds a duck and two strangers to his household and then sends them home on a ship.

feats.scene: Inecian slams a heavy gavel and a hall of courtiers falls silent.
Inecian waves away a thrown cushion and a dropped tray of sweets.

name: Ntellval
summary: Ntellval is a mountain sorcerer who dresses his followers as hairy beasts to lure a silver wanderer into a trap. Ntellval throws bolts of raw force and weaves false scenes, and falls only when four heroes strike together.

feats.scene: Ntellval hurls a crackling bolt that splits a boulder the size of a house.
Ntellval takes four heroes' combined blow before finally going down.

name: Lltarti
summary: Lltarti is a brown and white puppy given as a winter present to a lonely boy. Lltarti bites the leg of a brutal intruder to defend the boy and pays for it with its life.

feats.scene: Lltarti clamps its small jaws on the leg of a bearded intruder.
Lltarti tumbles down the porch steps and scrambles back up.

name: Viaulval
summary: Viaulval is a young science student at an agent academy who sees a frozen pool and answers questions about it. Viaulval has no special talents and returns to lectures afterward.

feats.scene: Viaulval slams a lab door shut against a gust of cold air.
Viaulval slips on the icy tiles and walks away with a bruise.

name: Nevaan
summary: Nevaan is a blonde researcher stationed on the moon who sends a warning down to a metal-suited inventor. Nevaan relies on radios and logbooks rather than fists.

feats.scene: Nevaan throws a switch and a warning beacon lights the crater rim.
Nevaan rides out a hard landing in a cramped lunar shuttle.

name: Eovelvi
summary: Eovelvi is a goddess of verse and the mother of a famed lyre player, heard only as a distant song at dusk. Eovelvi sits among nine sisters on a sacred hill and mostly keeps to tales and echoes.

feats.scene: Eovelvi raises her voice and a hillside of olive trees shudders and sheds its leaves.
Eovelvi stands unharmed as a storm over the sacred hill breaks upon her.

name: Teces
summary: Teces is one of a batch of artificial brawlers grown from jelly in a scheming vat-keeper's workshop. Teces fights a clawed rival until a spiral-powered gust flings the whole batch beyond the horizon.

feats.scene: Teces swings a chunk of rubble at a clawed rival and dents his shoulder.
Teces is hurled across a field by a magic gust and bounces unhurt.

name: Tasnanor
summary: Tasnanor is the dark-haired chief of a tunnel community and has two outsiders carried below to answer for old grudges. Tasnanor rules by fear and by loyalty from the people sleeping beneath the city.

feats.scene: Tasnanor drives a spiked staff into a concrete pillar to claim the tunnel.
Tasnanor takes a thrown pipe to the ribs and keeps giving orders.

name: Siaunes
summary: Siaunes is a scarred freighter captain who drops her passengers into freezing water and calls it business. Siaunes duels a stranger with a blade in a graveyard of ships, then falls to a rival with a pistol.

feats.scene: Siaunes hammers a cutlass down on a bulkhead and splits the plate.
Siaunes is flung against a deck rail and stays on her feet.

name: Ilama
summary: Ilama once modelled, then lost an eye standing up for a friend and left the coast to shelter the lost. Ilama hides her gift in a rain-soaked northern town and lives under a shaved head.

feats.scene: Ilama tears a heavy locker from a changing-room wall to block a pursuer.
Ilama takes a beating in a back alley and refuses to scream.

name: Lleaunal
summary: Lleaunal is a one-eyed rebel who wears a patch and helps a free district hold out against a cruel regime. Lleaunal is struck down by the regime's leader in a final skirmish.

feats.scene: Lleaunal hurls a crate of munitions over a barricade into a patrol.
Lleaunal absorbs a rifle butt to the face without dropping her post.

name: Seoterte
summary: Seoterte has a single eye and sharp senses and dies in a dreadful plague year. Seoterte's head is later carried on a pole by the hungry crowds that swarm the tunnels.

feats.scene: Seoterte swings a lead pipe at a lunging cannibal and drops him.
Seoterte takes a bite on the shoulder and fights on for a minute.

name: Amora
summary: Amora is a one-eyed outcast of the lowest rank in a mountain city, shunned for her injury. Amora helps a wandering fighter hide, then sells the hideout to a tyrant for acceptance.

feats.scene: Amora shoves open a heavy shutter to slip out of the hideout at night.
Amora weathers a long march over snow in thin sandals.

name: Ausauce
summary: Ausauce is a tunnel dweller who hosts a band of young guests during a holiday feast. Ausauce keeps the peace by sharing food and stories with the new arrivals.

feats.scene: Ausauce slams a ladle on a stove and calls the tunnel to dinner.
Ausauce shakes off a stumble down a flight of stone steps.

name: Tuiarra
summary: Tuiarra is a founding councillor of an island refuge raised by gifted people. Tuiarra sits at the table when a hunting machine descends on the floating station.

feats.scene: Tuiarra hauls a councillor's chair across the chamber to brace a door.
Tuiarra is thrown against a wall by the shaking station and walks away.

name: Tireslli
summary: Tireslli is an ordinary eldest son in a large scottish family, raised alongside a twin and a sister. Tireslli grows up, has children of his own, and appears only in a single old photograph.

feats.scene: Tireslli lifts a crate of apples onto a farm cart.
Tireslli takes a tumble from a hay loft and brushes off the dust.

name: Sesvo
summary: Sesvo is a schoolboy whose touch spreads sickness, taken on a holiday trip with a twin sister. Sesvo does not return, and his gift is a curse to everyone near him.

feats.scene: Sesvo shoves a campfire log aside and sparks fly across the sand.
Sesvo wades into freezing surf and finishes the swim.

name: Lorosu
summary: Lorosu is a pale, inhuman killing tool kept in a briefcase and unleashed on rival crooks at a father's command. Lorosu is a twisted child of a warping energy, and a masked hero ends the run in a warehouse.

feats.scene: Lorosu bursts from a case and lunges across a warehouse floor in one bound.
Lorosu is hit by a thrown cargo hook and keeps coming.

name: Temiva
summary: Temiva is a smooth-talking schemer who sells his own son to a secret company's science team. Temiva meets a cold end after he chases the boy and tumbles into a freezing vat.

feats.scene: Temiva slaps a contract onto a desk and demands a signature.
Temiva is knocked flat on a factory floor and curses.

name: Lueoncel
summary: Lueoncel is a smooth businessman and politician in a postwar film town who protects company secrets from a sharp-eyed agent. Lueoncel later falls to his own wife's strange weapon.

feats.scene: Lueoncel slaps a racetrack rail while arguing with an agent.
Lueoncel shrugs off a cold glass of water thrown in his face.

name: Velvieol
summary: Velvieol is a proud young inventor who builds a gate between realities for a corporate boss and unleashes disaster. Velvieol lives to regret it and gives his life years later to shut the gate.

feats.scene: Velvieol overloads a gate machine and a tower floor ruptures in a blinding flash.
Velvieol is flung across a lab by the surge and stays conscious.

name: Amaontel
summary: Amaontel is a nervous blond clerk who worked for a plague-spreader and cracks under pressure. Amaontel gives up what he knows when a gifted woman leans on him.

feats.scene: Amaontel pushes a desk drawer shut with a trembling hand.
Amaontel is slammed against a wall and slides to the floor.

name: Miseo
summary: Miseo is an orphaned magic student who bounces between rough foster homes and finally finds a seat in a school for sorcery. Miseo becomes a vessel for a grief-eating spirit hidden in a jacket until a classmate swallows the spirit whole.

feats.scene: Miseo casts a clumsy bolt that cracks a classroom floor.
Miseo is possessed and thrown through a stone wall without a scratch.

name: Ontsi
summary: Ontsi is a prisoner kept in a lab beside a great waterfall and exposed to a sickness that covers his skin in sores. Ontsi dies from the exposure while the lab-keeper watches.

feats.scene: Ontsi pounds on a cell door until his knuckles split.
Ontsi fights the fever for two days before it overwhelms him.

name: Llllisan
summary: Llllisan borrows the gifts of whoever stands near him, growing wings or oversized hands to match. Llllisan joins a teacher's team of young heroes and is drawn into a dangerous plot he does not see.

feats.scene: Llllisan copies a nearby fighter and swings a boulder-sized fist at a bridge pylon.
Llllisan takes a hard blow in his borrowed shape and recovers within seconds.

name: Telniuon
summary: Telniuon has feathered wings and a catalogue of stolen gifts, all of which he uses for a rough brotherhood in a besieged world. Telniuon marches into battle against giant hunters with others from rival camps.

feats.scene: Telniuon fires a lance of light that blows a wide hole in a hunting machine.
Telniuon is slammed by a machine fist and stays airborne.

name: Nauviatia
summary: Nauviatia lives a peaceful life with a wife who can blink across rooms and two small children. Nauviatia exists only as a dream glimpsed by a counterpart in a stranger world.

feats.scene: Nauviatia hauls a basket of laundry up a flight of stairs.
Nauviatia trips over a toy truck and laughs it off.

name: Viatum
summary: Viatum is aged and withered along with his companions when they meet a fleeing woman and a scheming doctor. Viatum falls to the doctor's hand in a vision dreamed by someone from another place.

feats.scene: Viatum reaches out a frail hand toward the fleeing woman.
Viatum endures decades of decay in a single long night.

name: Ircosteo
summary: Ircosteo is a lawyer grown in a vat for a showman's chaotic court and sent to hunt small mischief makers. Ircosteo wears a smooth blond haircut and a courtroom smile.

feats.scene: Ircosteo hurls a heavy brief case at a fleeing child.
Ircosteo is knocked off a podium and straightens his tie.

name: Laras
summary: Laras is a drug-fuelled brute who is caught and locked away by a team of heroes during an age of tricks. Laras is freed only when a conqueror's plan unravels.

feats.scene: Laras smashes through a brick wall and wrecks a parked van.
Laras is struck by a thrown shield and merely grunts.

name: Tumtorna
summary: Tumtorna is a jeering prisoner in the high-security block of a vault, taunting a visitor searching for a missing friend. Tumtorna is no more than a face behind glass, but the cell doors are built for brutes.

feats.scene: Tumtorna pounds a glass wall until it spiders with cracks.
Tumtorna takes a stun jolt meant for a bull and just laughs.

name: Tiaanrn
summary: Tiaanrn is a chemist turned brute whose brawn is rated in dozens of tons and who joins a gang of four criminals. Tiaanrn schemes to hold a big city for ransom and runs into a webbed hero and a small dragon-like helper.

feats.scene: Tiaanrn lifts a loaded truck over his head and flings it into a bridge pier.
Tiaanrn is hit by a speeding bus and shakes it off.

name: Leoolsor
summary: Leoolsor is a chemist and criminal mentioned on a list of people a reporter wants to question for a long retrospective. Leoolsor never appears in person and is only a name on a page.

feats.scene: Leoolsor bends a steel rod over his knee while arguing with a guard.
Leoolsor takes a baton across the back and snarls.

name: Rniorva
summary: Rniorva is a brown-haired thug turned monster by a potion and known to the police for his rampages. Rniorva is defeated by a god of thunder and a soldier in a shield.

feats.scene: Rniorva rips a lamp post from the pavement and swings it at a taxi.
Rniorva takes a hammer blow to the chest and staggers.

name: Orviin
summary: Orviin is a grey-haired doctor awaiting transfer to a secure prison who stirs up a flood of enemies for his own rescue. Orviin dies with his rescuer when a burning rider hunts them down.

feats.scene: Orviin shoves a wheelchair into a guard and sets off an alarm.
Orviin is flung across a cell block by an enraged rider and gets up.

name: Anontor
summary: Anontor is one of many villains who seem to storm a mansion in a single mass assault. Anontor is cut down by a clawed fighter, who learns later that the whole attack was a trick of the mind.

feats.scene: Anontor kicks in the mansion door with a single heave.
Anontor takes a slash across the chest and keeps charging.

name: Sesesium
summary: Sesesium is a priestess who raises the dead for love, performing a nightly rite with a stolen fragment of an ancient tablet. Sesesium loses her gift when a webbed hero snatches the fragment away.

feats.scene: Sesesium sends a ring of pale fire out across a rooftop and wrecks its chimney.
Sesesium is thrown against a water tank and stands up chanting.

name: Rivilel
summary: Rivilel is a white-haired soul thief rescued from a collapsing timeline by an ultimate performer and recruited into a six-person troupe. Rivilel carries a time-bending relic and hunts rival versions of a masked heroine.

feats.scene: Rivilel drains the life from a crowd and flings it back as a shockwave.
Rivilel is struck by a machine blast and flickers back into place.

name: Leeoium
summary: Leeoium is a striped white-furred prisoner in a bleak complex who loves sport, study and old films. Leeoium is quick and wary, and is slowly softened by a devoted partner.

feats.scene: Leeoium vaults a courtyard wall and kicks a guard's baton clear.
Leeoium takes a tumbling fall onto concrete and rolls to a stop.

name: Coanor
summary: Coanor is a schoolboy with black hair who carries an old spirit of the land inside him. Coanor studies in a quiet country boarding school and slowly learns what the spirit wants.

feats.scene: Coanor stamps a foot and a ripple of turf and root heaves across the playing field.
Coanor is struck by a falling oak and the land itself seems to hold him up.

name: Cevinia
summary: Cevinia is a brown-haired government operative who works for a quiet agency and is killed by a hired assassin. Cevinia appears in a few panels and is remembered only by the people who find the body.

feats.scene: Cevinia fires a sidearm across an office and shatters a window.
Cevinia is thrown across a desk and gets back up.

name: Tevane
summary: Tevane is a grey bat-winged tyrant who thinks himself a god in an old jungle realm, descended from people changed by tainted water. Tevane towers over the treetops and hungers to rule the whole world.

feats.scene: Tevane brings both fists down on a temple pyramid and caves in its top tier.
Tevane is hit by a barrage of siege fire and fans his wings in contempt.

name: Ntuauam
summary: Ntuauam is a faceless woman in a tight dress who wears any face she chooses and carries a golden pistol. Ntuauam tortures a young man by planting terrible pictures in his head and shoots his boss at point blank.

feats.scene: Ntuauam fires a gilded pistol into a chair and sends it crashing to the floor.
Ntuauam takes a hard shove into a bookcase and re-forms her face.

name: Tiano
summary: Tiano is a heavenly being who falls from grace after a rebellion in the clouds. Tiano wanders the lower realm, and rumor puts him among the rebels without proof.

feats.scene: Tiano calls down a spear of white light that fells a stone tower.
Tiano tumbles out of the sky and lands on a mountainside unharmed.

name: Marti
summary: Marti is a patrol officer in a big city who is kept at a barrier while a machine causes chaos inside a tower. Marti follows orders and waits for the sergeant to go in alone.

feats.scene: Marti shoves a barricade into place with both arms.
Marti is bumped aside by a panicked crowd and keeps his post.

name: Siasemar
summary: Siasemar is a brown-haired agent on a flying command ship, keeping watch for the agency. Siasemar is a background hand in a long chase between two rival killers.

feats.scene: Siasemar fires a pistol across a hangar and drops a runaway crate.
Siasemar is knocked over by a pressure door and rises quickly.

name: Alunto
summary: Alunto is a club leader who calls on demons to snatch a captive for a sacrificial rite. Alunto's plan fails when two teams of heroes crash the ceremony, and only a great fiery power saves his life.

feats.scene: Alunto raises a ceremonial knife and drives it into an altar of oak.
Alunto is carried out of a burning hall and survives.

name: Vaanlle
summary: Vaanlle is a grey-haired soldier who climbs into a heavy suit for a militant order hunting the gifted. Vaanlle borrows a captured girl's trick to hop between two spots and is finally dropped from a high platform.

feats.scene: Vaanlle slams an armored fist through a factory conveyor and splits it in two.
Vaanlle takes a hanging bridge section on his shoulders and keeps fighting.

name: Morrnitiu
summary: Morrnitiu is a casual acquaintance whose number sits in a bodyguard's phone. Morrnitiu has no scenes of his own and never does anything but exist in the contact list.

feats.scene: Morrnitiu taps a screen to answer a call.
Morrnitiu bumps his shin on a coffee table and shrugs.

name: Rnever
summary: Rnever is a divorced former teacher in a big city who is shot while shielding a student and falls into despair. Rnever is saved by that same student and follows her into a dangerous night.

feats.scene: Rnever slaps a hotel room door open with her palm.
Rnever lives through a bullet wound and weeks in a hospital bed.

name: Rosaun
summary: Rosaun is a youth raised in the wild by a clawed foster father and trained to hunt among patrolling machines. Rosaun learns who his parents are only after his family is freed from internment camps.

feats.scene: Rosaun drives a spear through a hunter drone's cooling vent.
Rosaun is knocked down a ravine by a sentry blast and walks away.

name: Amstaci
summary: Amstaci runs a family restaurant in a lively neighborhood and gets kidnapped by thieves she argued with. Amstaci is rescued by a local masked hero and thanks him with free dinners.

feats.scene: Amstaci swings a heavy cast-iron pan at a thief and sends him back a step.
Amstaci is shoved into a van and keeps arguing all the way.

name: Luamius
summary: Luamius is a black-haired girl taken from a small northern town by a big green traveller and turned into a space-faring outlaw. Luamius flies with a pack on her back, fires a plasma gun and lays mines across a hull.

feats.scene: Luamius sets a cluster of mines and levels a patrol barge's engine.
Luamius is slammed against a bulkhead by a blast and keeps shooting.

name: Iareo
summary: Iareo is a sadistic head doctor at a secure hospital who mocks a patient with fiery powers. Iareo is killed by that patient's partner and nobody mourns her.

feats.scene: Iareo slams a clipboard on a cell bar and sneers at a patient.
Iareo is shoved against a wall in a corridor and gasps.

name: Siaserine
summary: Siaserine is a foreman who oversees the building of a new headquarters for a famous family. Siaserine uses a wheelchair and directs crews with a firm voice.

feats.scene: Siaserine thumps a blueprint on a table and sends crews back to work.
Siaserine rolls over a heap of rubble and a bumpy slab without complaint.

name: Amliusor
summary: Amliusor is a black-haired barracks soldier of an old war who stands in line at roll call. Amliusor watches a sergeant crash into a bunk when a doorway opens at the wrong moment.

feats.scene: Amliusor snaps a salute so hard his boots echo on the floor.
Amliusor marches through a full drill in the rain without a break.

name: Litel
summary: Litel is a young black-haired boy in a surreal city and the younger brother of a bounty hunter. Litel appears for a single panel and is not much more than a sibling.

feats.scene: Litel tugs at his brother's sleeve to stop a fight.
Litel trips on a curb and bounces up.

name: Iumtesniu
summary: Iumtesniu is a stoic swordsman who wanders a neon city with a small child in tow. Iumtesniu is a parody of a famous wandering blade tale and fights with grim calm.

feats.scene: Iumtesniu draws a long sword and cleaves a heavy door in a single stroke.
Iumtesniu takes a sword blow on a forearm wrap and presses on.

name: Ulitesi
summary: Ulitesi is a robotic warrior with claws on cables and a beam cannon in its mouth and a red-eyed face. Ulitesi flies and trades blows with an armoured genius, but is soon shot through and scrapped.

feats.scene: Ulitesi fires its mouth cannon and blows a crater in the hull of a ship.
Ulitesi takes a direct repulsor blast on its shell and stays standing.

name: Luntumeo
summary: Luntumeo is a mercenary who wears a crab-like suit and signs on with a star-themed gang. Luntumeo joins just in time for a raid on a secret government base.

feats.scene: Luntumeo snaps a steel door brace with a pincer gauntlet.
Luntumeo is struck by a flying chair and his shell dents but holds.

name: Tolniso
summary: Tolniso is a hacker in a masked gang who decodes stolen data for a boss with a water motif. Tolniso loses the data when a hero and his pal raid the base and the whole place self-destructs.

feats.scene: Tolniso smashes a console with a chair when the alarm trips.
Tolniso is blown into a wall by a self-destruct charge and gets up.

name: Ronnise
summary: Ronnise is a brown-haired government officer and the old flame of a masked vigilante. Ronnise helps expose a sinister scheme from within her agency.

feats.scene: Ronnise slides a folder of secret files across a desk with a flick.
Ronnise is pushed down a stairwell during a chase and keeps moving.

name: Tecorria
summary: Tecorria is a waitress at a lively club who helps frame an innocent man and tries to confess too late. Tecorria is shot dead by a calm hitman before she can talk.

feats.scene: Tecorria slams a tray down at the bar and spills a round of glasses.
Tecorria is dragged across a sticky floor and gets back on her feet.

name: Numont
summary: Numont is the right hand of a ruthless general and a loyal soldier of a hidden order. Numont carries messages and orders across a hard-line base.

feats.scene: Numont fires a sidearm across a briefing room and chips a map.
Numont takes a punch to the jaw and straightens her uniform.

name: Ontniu
summary: Ontniu is an immortal blonde with eyes like blank glass who runs a thieves' ring in a river city before joining a doom-bringing cult. Ontniu moves objects with her mind and fights a rival telekinetic in the open before an old comrade ends her.

feats.scene: Ontniu lifts a parked bus with her mind and drops it on a gate.
Ontniu is thrown through a storefront by a rival's mind and stands again.

name: Veloneo
summary: Veloneo is a blond ageless mutant who betrays a secret club to impress a group of scholars. Veloneo is thought to die when a flaming bird burns a capital to the ground.

feats.scene: Veloneo flings a crate of ammunition into a charging guard and floors him.
Veloneo is engulfed by a firestorm and vanishes in smoke.

name: Tessiam
summary: Tessiam is a red-haired android built to amuse a rich man and then woken by a trolley-car lightning strike. Tessiam joins a team of heroes and rages that she cannot die even when she wants to.

feats.scene: Tessiam discharges a bolt of stored lightning and fuses a trolley's cables.
Tessiam is struck by a speeding tram and stands without a dent.

name: Seorosos
summary: Seorosos is the owner of a body shop in a sunny coastal city and boss to a gifted young mechanic. Seorosos lets the mechanic's brother help with accounts on slow afternoons.

feats.scene: Seorosos tightens a wheel nut with a long wrench and groans.
Seorosos takes a slip on an oil patch and laughs it off.

name: Servatu
summary: Servatu is a red-haired thief with a visor-shaped mouth who claims a demon lives in him and leads a gang of six. Servatu is doused in a clever solution that mutes the red thing wrapped around him and is bound with his gang.

feats.scene: Servatu whips a tentacle across a cathedral aisle and splinters a pew.
Servatu is cut by a pointed blade and the wound seals around the red mass.

name: Tetasen
summary: Tetasen is a humanoid dog bred by a mad geneticist, who flees to a mountain stronghold with a cat companion. Tetasen befriends a young team of heroes when his maker begins to cull his creations.

feats.scene: Tetasen bounds across a mountain ledge and tackles a pursuing hunter.
Tetasen tumbles down a scree slope and shakes the dust off.

name: Cornesco
summary: Cornesco is a villain with both a male and female body, recruited by a claw-handed schemer to storm a hidden kingdom. Cornesco is one of many foot soldiers in a large mercenary line.

feats.scene: Cornesco hurls a spear across a plaza and pins a banner to a wall.
Cornesco is knocked off a ledge and lands in a heap, unhurt.

name: Numniuam
summary: Numniuam is a rocket-bodied guardian from a distant century who vents heat from his skin to fly. Numniuam serves a legion of defenders and dies when the timeline collapses.

feats.scene: Numniuam vents a plume of burning gas that melts a hangar door.
Numniuam is struck by a chunk of falling ceiling and keeps on rocketing.

name: Cosiri
summary: Cosiri is an employee of a vast corporation who raises its pollution output on a superior's order. Cosiri is murdered by that superior to hide the blame.

feats.scene: Cosiri signs a heavy ledger and slides it across a desk.
Cosiri is struck down in an instant by a single blow.

name: Tevalres
summary: Tevalres is a northern guide who leads a ship toward the pole and finds a frozen giant. Tevalres protects a crewman, survives a wreck and a mutiny, and later turns on the revived creature.

feats.scene: Tevalres hauls a sled loaded with supplies over a ridge of ice.
Tevalres endures a night in a freezing lifeboat and rows through dawn.

name: Tesnire
summary: Tesnire is a dark-haired outlaw who lays a false rail line to hijack a gold shipment. Tesnire is undone by a cowhand's horse, which kicks his pistol away, and is shot dead.

feats.scene: Tesnire fires a revolver across a canyon and splits a signal post.
Tesnire is thrown from a saddle into a gravel bed and gets up.

name: Sesinva
summary: Sesinva is a ring performer in a loud costume who wrestles for a living. Sesinva is fondly recalled by an old friend with a bad blood clot.

feats.scene: Sesinva slams an opponent onto the canvas with a bodyslam.
Sesinva takes a folding chair across the back and finishes the bout.

name: Soteaus
summary: Soteaus is a white-haired retired killer who reads the next move in an opponent's mind and hides from the guild he fled. Soteaus holds off a squad of hired blades in a polar hideout, then returns to help his son.

feats.scene: Soteaus fires a pistol and a rifle at once and drops two attackers in the snow.
Soteaus takes a blade across the arm and keeps fighting.

name: Enveose
summary: Enveose is a purple, smoky spy who answers to a discreet agency in a famous riverside capital. Enveose is knocked out with her team by a raid and wakes with a headache.

feats.scene: Enveose coils into a mist and chokes a guard until he drops his gun.
Enveose is hit by a stun round and her smoke body holds together.

name: Elltuin
summary: Elltuin is an ageless head of a vast firm who survives as a ghostly spirit and takes over body after body. Elltuin passes through walls, grows blades from his wings, and is ended after a last transfer.

feats.scene: Elltuin slices a stone column in half with a winged blade of light.
Elltuin lets a hail of gunfire pass through him as if through smoke.

name: Rosantum
summary: Rosantum is a grey, horned agent in a star-themed gang who stutters between words. Rosantum releases a deadly germ in a plot and is killed by a spy in a later raid.

feats.scene: Rosantum lunges with a pointed staff and pins a door to the frame.
Rosantum is kicked across a corridor and shrugs it off.

name: Amaronaun
summary: Amaronaun is a goat-faced artificial copy built by a gang leader and woken before it was ready. Amaronaun is rebuilt, climbs a rooftop in a battle and is finally destroyed by an armoured hero.

feats.scene: Amaronaun jabs a pointed staff into a steel rooftop hatch and wrenches it loose.
Amaronaun is thrown from a ledge and clatters to a halt.

name: Auoraan
summary: Auoraan is a dim, brawling drinker from a big borough whose body is altered and who wades into any fight. Auoraan leads a shouting, swearing team and promises to fight dirty and make a joke afterward.

feats.scene: Auoraan heaves a mailbox through a window and swings after it.
Auoraan takes a point-blank blast and laughs through the smoke.

name: Tartuses
summary: Tartuses is a brash leader of a squad who rides a thunderous wave of force and plans a huge explosion. Tartuses and his team are overrun by a plague of the dead in a cruel final scene.

feats.scene: Tartuses rigs a bomb and levels a section of a street in one blast.
Tartuses is bitten and clubbed by a mob and fights on a little longer.

name: Rnorn
summary: Rnorn is a rumpled courier who stumbled into a borrowed streak of starlight and now cannot find the road back to his own street. He fights best when he is confused, which opponents mistake for strategy. Each glow-fuelled leap leaves scorch marks on pavement.

feats.scene: Rnorn slams a glowing fist into a parked freight trailer and folds it around a lamp post.
Rnorn walks out of a collapsing parking deck with only dust on his jacket.

name: Rnaltol
summary: Rnaltol is a street-level adventurer who relies on a pulsing chest gem that lets him shrug off blows and hit back with concussive light. He joined a rotating crew of misfits and mostly tries to keep up with them.

feats.scene: Rnaltol fires a burst of gem light that blows the doors off a delivery van.
Rnaltol takes a speeding taxi to the ribs and merely coughs.

name: Lesaun
summary: Lesaun is a barnyard burrower who woke up one morning with powers nobody could explain and a taste for brawling. He patrols the farm fence line and swings a bent shovel handle with great confidence.

feats.scene: Lesaun swings a shovel handle through a wooden gate and splinters it.
Lesaun bounces off a haystack that fell from the loft and shakes his snout.

name: Tenisaur
summary: Tenisaur is a weathered whaling skipper with a stubborn streak and a good heart. He sails out to kill a monster and comes home owing it a favour. Nothing about him is supernatural, only his nerve.

feats.scene: Tenisaur hurls a harpoon across the deck and pins a rope to the rail.
Tenisaur holds a rope through a lurching swell without letting go.

name: Vanis
summary: Vanis is a swaggering champion of a puzzle-box reality, adored by a cheering crowd of sidekicks. Everything he does is staged, so his strength depends on how the audience feels that day.

feats.scene: Vanis smashes a prop vault door that was never meant to open.
Vanis laughs off a falling stage light the size of a refrigerator.

name: Ialtus
summary: Ialtus is one of an endless line of identical flag-bearing guardians, each assigned to a single city district. He throws a round shield with a practiced flick and always arrives a little late.

feats.scene: Ialtus ricochets a disc off three walls and knocks a drone out of the air.
Ialtus is tossed through a shop window and gets back up for the next round.
Ialtus sprints down a boulevard to reach the next robot.

name: Lescen
