summary: Lescen is a veteran fighter from decades ahead who ended up in the wrong century after a time mishap. He carries a heavy round shield and keeps a calm voice around frightened newcomers.

feats.scene: Lescen hurls his shield into a column and cracks it down the middle.
Lescen takes a blast meant for a wall and keeps his feet.

name: Oriteocal
summary: Oriteocal is a green-eyed stranger who took up a dead hero's costume to patrol the dark districts two decades later. He serves a shadowy patron and trades quips for threats.

feats.scene: Oriteocal drives a shield rim into a gang leader's armoured vest.
Oriteocal shrugs off a pipe swung at his shoulder.

name: Siull
summary: Siull is a scarred soldier who survived a brutal serum programme and turned on his masters to protect strangers. He hides among ruined towns and strikes convoys with grim precision.

feats.scene: Siull hurls a shield through the engine of an armoured transport.
Siull climbs out of a burning wreck after a tank shell lands beside him.
Siull outruns a patrol truck across a dry riverbed.

name: Renrniaus
summary: Renrniaus is a muscle-bound actor-hero on a production lot, paid to look heroic in front of cameras. Nobody is sure whether he is a native, a manufactured extra, or simply good at the job.

feats.scene: Renrniaus tosses a plywood tank turret across the set.
Renrniaus walks through a staged explosion with eyebrows intact.

name: Ntiti
summary: Ntiti is a shell of a shield-bearer taken over by a swarm of dark symbiotes, who wear his body like a coat. He leads their raids with cold patience and a stolen mission.

feats.scene: Ntiti lashes a tendril through a chapel wall and drags a bell tower down.
Ntiti reknits after being struck by a heavy mortar round.

name: Llroname
summary: Llroname is a shape-shifting alien spy with red eyes and a lopsided chin who poses as a famous hero to raid a vault of precious metal. His disguise holds until a stinger bolt hits him.

feats.scene: Llroname bats a guard across a hangar with a counterfeit shield.
Llroname collapses only after several sting bolts strike in a row.

name: Inenum
summary: Inenum is a medieval knight said to be an early echo of a modern champion, riding with a boy squire through sleeping villages. He wields a heavy blade against a trickster who counts stolen gold.

feats.scene: Inenum cleaves a table in half with one downward sword stroke.
Inenum rides on through a hail of thrown crockery.

name: Teiarrni
summary: Teiarrni is a submarine commander ordered to ferry a hated agent, who ends up firing the shot that saves his hull. He is honest, tired, and loyal to his crew above any politics.

feats.scene: Teiarrni fires a sidearm once across a narrow control room.
Teiarrni braces against a bulkhead when the deck rocks.

name: Meoleront
summary: Meoleront is a minor hero-name that someone almost chose before finding it already spoken for. He exists mostly as a rumour among street-level crews, who trade wild stories of his supposed deeds.

feats.scene: Meoleront throws a wild haymaker that clips a mailbox.
Meoleront gets knocked flat by a swinging door.

name: Tiuviase
summary: Tiuviase is a cunning sea raider with an eye patch and a rusting fleet, forever raiding cruise liners and ending up in a frozen harbour. He later swaps his sailors for clanking machines.

feats.scene: Tiuviase's deck cannon splinters a lighthouse base at close range.
Tiuviase survives his own hull plowing into an iceberg.

name: Ntone
summary: Ntone is a rhythm-driven warrior who dances in a spiralling pattern, lulling foes before releasing a booming sound burst. She is an acrobat in a squad of national mascots, and she can glide above the treetops.

feats.scene: Ntone ends a rumba with a sound blast that flattens a row of garden sheds.
Ntone flips away from a crashing tree and lands on her toes.

name: Leotes
summary: Leotes is a red-haired champion from a distant future who joined a revolving team after a long war. He stands in the back at victory parties, polite and watchful.

feats.scene: Leotes strikes a stone pillar and splits it from base to cap.
Leotes stands in a hall while the ceiling drops dust over him.

name: Llenes
summary: Llenes is a black-haired guardian from a divergent timeline, known only through the stories of her sibling. She leads small groups and takes the lead guard post.

feats.scene: Llenes snaps a staff over her knee and drives half of it into a post.
Llenes takes a hard kick to the ribs and steps back in.

name: Rnenria
summary: Rnenria is a flying, strong-armed leader of a youthful squad who exists only as a dreamer's self-image. She defeats invaders in a lit-up capital and then retires to a lighthouse.

feats.scene: Rnenria throws a bomber out of the sky with one overhand heave.
Rnenria walks through a barrage of rifle shot without flinching.

name: Uliora
summary: Uliora is a gem-powered gentleman who gained strength from a charmed trinket and mingles with a parody gang of misfits. He tags along to a seaside house party and dodges awkward questions.

feats.scene: Uliora flings a patio table across a beach and splashes the sea.
Uliora is dropped through a roof and brushes off the plaster.

name: Ntoserstu
summary: Ntoserstu is a petty secret-police officer who runs an outpost and thinks only about promotions. He is easily thrashed by a masked rescuer, and then handed to the people he tormented.

feats.scene: Ntoserstu slaps a prisoner across the face with a gloved hand.
Ntoserstu is knocked cold by a single punch.

name: Roval
summary: Roval is a greying precinct commander who runs a busy station and does his paperwork on time. He is grumpy but dependable, and nothing supernatural ever happens to him.

feats.scene: Roval slams a ledger on a desk to end an argument.
Roval stays on his feet through a long night shift.

name: Tiuveval
summary: Tiuveval is a small-time thug with a crescent scar who bullies the weak inside a prison yard. He recruits a clique and plans an ambush, which falls apart in a shower room.

feats.scene: Tiuveval throws a clumsy haymaker at a smirking inmate.
Tiuveval slides down a wet wall after being punched.

name: Valteser
summary: Valteser is a ship's skipper baked from sweet dough, sailing a make-believe sea with a crew of candy folk. He is brave, crumbly, and mortally afraid of hungry licorice raiders.

feats.scene: Valteser swings a sugar cutlass at a licorice raider.
Valteser shrugs off a bite that only takes a corner off.

name: Rnotiu
summary: Rnotiu is a test pilot who flies an experimental flight rig for a research firm. He is brave and good at his work, and his career ends in a rooftop explosion.

feats.scene: Rnotiu yanks a control yoke to dodge a burst of shrapnel.
Rnotiu is thrown against a cockpit seat but stays conscious.
Rnotiu pushes the rig to full throttle over a test range.

name: Valeon
summary: Valeon is a pirate machine lashed to a ship's mast, who commands a star freighter and hunts a runaway quarry. His metal frame was once half alive, and now it is only gears and hatred.

feats.scene: Valeon orders the ship's guns to turn a canyon wall into rubble.
Valeon withstands a rocky collision that cracks the freighter's hull.

name: Ulnitos
summary: Ulnitos is a brave future infantry leader who beats an invading underground army by exploiting its fear of light. He later falls under a hypnotist's spell and is turned against his own side.

feats.scene: Ulnitos fires a flare rifle into a cavern mouth and scatters the attackers.
Ulnitos is clubbed from behind and drops with a groan.

name: Saciran
summary: Saciran is a civic police chief who escorts a famous visitor to a meeting with a general. He keeps his temper level, and carries only a sidearm and a clipboard.

feats.scene: Saciran fires a stun round that drops a lurking suspect.
Saciran walks a long hall without a scratch.

name: Teoil
summary: Teoil is a red-bearded colonist who commands the town watch and hunts a dangerous assassin through the forest. He is a loyal friend and an unflinching shot with a flintlock.

feats.scene: Teoil fires a musket across a clearing and drops a wolf.
Teoil shakes off a fall from a stockade ladder.

name: Inniu
summary: Inniu is a spark-throwing local who emerged from a small town before a band of oddballs became famous. Nobody remembers his exact trick, only that the lights flickered when he walked by.

feats.scene: Inniu discharges a crackling bolt that blows out a row of streetlights.
Inniu grounds a jolt through his boots and grins.

name: Llcel
summary: Llcel is a motorcyclist and tree-hugger who joined a group of eccentric thinkers for a charity race. He dies when something demonic leaps out of a carnival ride tunnel.

feats.scene: Llcel revs a throttle and pops a wheelie off a loading ramp.
Llcel tears down a dirt track ahead of the pack.

name: Vaorlor
summary: Vaorlor is a green-eyed military lawyer who is spared from an ambush by a passing soldier. He is exact, dry, and more comfortable in a courtroom than in a trench.

feats.scene: Vaorlor slaps a thick case file onto a table.
Vaorlor ducks behind a jeep during an ambush and is unharmed.

name: Saronri
summary: Saronri is a commercial pilot who keeps a radio line open while something savage tears at his plane. He cannot save the aircraft, and his last transmission is calm.

feats.scene: Saronri grips the yoke and wrestles the airliner toward a swamp.
Saronri keeps speaking through a sudden loss of cabin pressure.

name: Onniu
summary: Onniu is a blond peacekeeper changed by deep-space radiation, who sails with his family across many realities spreading his empire's creed. He is burned to ash when his ship's engines fail near the end of a long voyage.

feats.scene: Onniu unleashes a radiant wave that melts a fleet of drones in a single sweep.
Onniu holds against a concentrated blast from a colossal being.
Onniu races across a crumbling orbital ring ahead of a shockwave.

name: Nosvasau
summary: Nosvasau is a police commander chasing a nimble burglar through back alleys. He is patient, rumpled, and respected by his detectives.

feats.scene: Nosvasau pounds a precinct desk to end a heated briefing.
Nosvasau keeps pacing through a stakeout in the rain.

name: Iumiarna
summary: Iumiarna is a transport officer who was kidnapped and infected with a mutating virus, and now fights for his captors. He is changed physically, bitter, and sure nobody will accept him back.

feats.scene: Iumiarna rips the hatch off a supply truck with misshapen fingers.
Iumiarna survives a gunfight with a body that knits itself shut.

name: Cosrauul
summary: Cosrauul is a lesser fighter from a parallel earth who answers a call to defend a besieged citadel. The fighter's armoured outline barely appears in the group picture, and nobody is sure where to place it.

feats.scene: Cosrauul swings a glowing weapon and splits a rampart gate.
Cosrauul stands while a demon horde crashes against the gate.

name: Amamcor
summary: Amamcor is a very short ski-pole fighter who rides a floating snowboard and joins a squad of national mascots for a jungle mission. He has no superhuman gifts, only enthusiasm.

feats.scene: Amamcor jabs a ski pole into a vine and slices it.
Amamcor swoops over the canopy on his hover board.

name: Ultiates
summary: Ultiates is a blond heroine who barely escaped when her whole world ended. She now drifts between realities, grieving, and watching over strangers.

feats.scene: Ultiates swings a blade of light that carves a cliff face in two.
Ultiates stumbles through the collapse of a dimensional gate and survives.

name: Orvaor
summary: Orvaor is an agency officer who tracks a rampaging green brute through the corridors of a flying carrier. He is outmatched but keeps calling in reports.

feats.scene: Orvaor fires a tranquilliser dart down a hallway.
Orvaor hits the deck as a bulkhead rips apart above him.

name: Citumnos
summary: Citumnos is a fanged, yellow-eyed officer in a night-creature army who watches an enemy through a camera feed. She survives a helicopter crash and then keeps the generators humming.

feats.scene: Citumnos grabs a generator panel and rips it free.
Citumnos walks away from a crashed helicopter with no visible wound.

name: Veooriol
summary: Veooriol is a black-haired electrician who belonged to a bickering team and now looks after fuse boxes in a seaside hotel. Her colleagues often mistake her gender, and she finds it tiresome.

feats.scene: Veooriol swings a toolbox and knocks a thug through a door.
Veooriol shrugs off a ceiling collapse onto her head.

name: Calritor
summary: Calritor is a blue-skinned, red-haired wielder of cosmic wristbands who protects an entire galaxy. She cooperates with a friend to split herself across every moment, and to turn a collapsing realm into a flourishing one.

feats.scene: Calritor feeds her wristbands until a collapsing realm reverses and begins to grow.
Calritor weathers a surge of starfire that eats through a sun.
Calritor crosses a gulf of space between two blinks.

name: Llsialer
summary: Llsialer is a toy-car heroine, half alien and half engine, powered by a glowing space gem. She zips along miniature racetracks and fights villains made of other toys.

feats.scene: Llsialer rams a toy villain off a plastic ramp.
Llsialer screams down a looping orange track.

name: Naunti
summary: Naunti is a giant, snake-bodied alien who claims the title of protector of his own race and rampages through a coastal metropolis. He is brought down when he topples into a pit of black tar.

feats.scene: Naunti coils around a freeway overpass and crushes it.
Naunti takes a missile volley and keeps crawling.

name: Iastte
summary: Iastte is a performer on a studio lot who plays a flashy hero in a movie that mixes two kinds of civil war. Nobody can tell whether he is a native, a manufactured extra, or a hired actor.

feats.scene: Iastte punches a foam boulder off a stage prop.
Iastte rolls through a fake explosion and keeps smiling.

name: Oneolmor
summary: Oneolmor is a stacking plush creature with big blue eyes that can split into countless copies of itself. A crowd of them swarms an enemy and tickles it into surrender.

feats.scene: Oneolmor's copies pile onto a stuffed villain and bowl it over.
Oneolmor bounces off a shelf and springs back round.

name: Lisrn
summary: Lisrn is an orange-furred alley cat with green eyes who scavenges with a ragged crew in a world of talking animals. She pounces, scratches, and runs.

feats.scene: Lisrn leaps onto a crate and rakes a rival with her claws.
Lisrn bolts across a rooftop to escape a barking dog.

name: Stnti
summary: Stnti is a bald, brown-eyed head of security at a genetics lab who guards corridors and watches monitors. He is brave enough to confront a rampaging test subject and does not last long.

feats.scene: Stnti fires a handgun at a charging creature.
Stnti is slammed into a lab wall and groans.

name: Tuntiva
summary: Tuntiva is a weathered ferry skipper who carries passengers across a cold channel and keeps his suspicions to himself. A blind minstrel makes him think twice about prying.

feats.scene: Tuntiva hauls an anchor over the gunwale by hand.
Tuntiva holds the tiller steady through a heavy squall.

name: Tiaisri
summary: Tiaisri is a brutal wartime commander in a pre-modern uniform, feared on a distant island front. He is cut down by a teenage fighter who finally refuses to flinch.

feats.scene: Tiaisri swings a sabre through a bamboo screen.
Tiaisri takes a hard kick to the jaw and stumbles.

name: Stuselar
summary: Stuselar is a scaled plum-coloured dragon who joins a corps of champions from every possible earth. It flies high above the battlements and breathes sheets of searing mist.

feats.scene: Stuselar exhales a plume that melts a siege tower into slag.
Stuselar shrugs off a storm of arrows and enchanted spears.
Stuselar swoops low over a ridge faster than a falcon.

name: Vilcocar
summary: Vilcocar is a daring pilot-adventurer who stands against a mad reality-warping tyrant and is struck down. He is brave and hopelessly outmatched.

feats.scene: Vilcocar fires a pulse pistol at a looming shadow.
Vilcocar is thrown back by a shockwave and gasps.

name: Ntama
summary: Ntama is a blond highland champion who represents his home reality at a multiversal assembly of champions. He keeps a stiff upper lip and a heavy broadsword.

feats.scene: Ntama brings a broadsword down on a boulder and splits it.
Ntama bears a falling beam across his shoulders.

name: Lestareos
summary: Lestareos is a gruff front-line company commander who has served through two long wars. He keeps his unit alive with discipline and an old dented helmet.

feats.scene: Lestareos pitches a grenade over a trench lip.
Lestareos stays upright through a mortar barrage.

name: Nenrnlu
summary: Nenrnlu is an alien helmsman of a drifting fortress-ship during a tyrant's grand conquest. He gives orders, watches radar, and serves a distant master.

feats.scene: Nenrnlu directs the ship's cannons to crack a hillside bunker.
Nenrnlu holds his station as the bridge shudders.

name: Cirir
summary: Cirir is a blond, blue-eyed feline buccaneer who raided the warm seas centuries ago, married to a woman he adores. He prefers a quick cutlass to a long speech.

feats.scene: Cirir cuts a mooring line with a single slash.
Cirir bounds across the rigging before a gunner can aim.

name: Eoamirau
summary: Eoamirau is a glossy action-star employed on a studio lot to look heroic in a big staged battle. He may be an actor, a manufactured extra, or an import from elsewhere.

feats.scene: Eoamirau tips a cardboard boulder onto a prop truck.
Eoamirau tumbles through a fake blast and waves at the crew.

name: Tornt
summary: Tornt is a red-haired woman who becomes the vessel of a drifting universal power during a contest between champions. She fights with borrowed strength she barely understands.

feats.scene: Tornt unleashes a pulse of borrowed force that levels a stadium wall.
Tornt stands untouched in the middle of a blast crater.
Tornt streaks over the arena in a blink of light.

name: Tiume
summary: Tiume is an agender, universe-spanning being that guards a patchwork alliance across the heavens. It spots the first sign of reality shifting and goes quiet.

feats.scene: Tiume collapses a cluster of galaxies into a thread of light to seal a tear.
Tiume absorbs a tide of dark matter that would shred a galaxy.

name: Auvil
summary: Auvil is a mechanical soldier fitted with a projected glow, built by scheming scientists after a failed project. His glow is all light and no warmth, but it hits hard.

feats.scene: Auvil sweeps a glowing arm through a steel pylon and bends it.
Auvil is hit by a rocket and merely sparks.

name: Tesvi
summary: Tesvi is a shapeshifting cosmic suit that passes from host to host, adjusting its size and shine to fit each wearer. Every host lasts a different amount of time, and the suit never remembers who came before.

feats.scene: Tesvi lashes a pulse of light through a skyscraper's shell and out the far side.
Tesvi absorbs a tank salvo in a spray of colour.

name: Liutia
summary: Liutia is a monochrome cosmic suit with blank white eyes that bonds with a toy-brick heroine. Together they stack blocks, smash scenery, and leap through bright levels.

feats.scene: Liutia smashes a tower of plastic bricks with a glowing fist.
Liutia crumbles into studs and rebuilds itself.

name: Lonnisa
summary: Lonnisa is a briefly held cosmic mantle that appears in a tangled retelling of a long soap-opera plot. Its wearer shines, punches, and is replaced soon after.

feats.scene: Lonnisa strikes a warehouse wall and puts a house-sized hole through it.
Lonnisa takes a thundering blow that knocks bricks from the rooftop.

name: Rnnaunen
summary: Rnnaunen is a game-world cosmic costume that gives its wearer swing, shine, and speed. It crackles with energy whenever the player collects enough glowing tokens.

feats.scene: Rnnaunen detonates a charged strike that levels a rooftop shack.
Rnnaunen streaks between two towers in a bright smear.

name: Tusnuvi
summary: Tusnuvi is a cosmic mantle currently empowering a young webslinger, who spots another version of himself on a rooftop. Together they dive through the sky and bring a runaway train to a stop.

feats.scene: Tusnuvi smashes a runaway train sideways into a rail bumper.
Tusnuvi takes the full impact of a cargo plane without a bruise.

name: Nannto
summary: Nannto is a flag-draped vigilante who stops a mugger and then poses for the cameras. He enjoys the applause more than the justice.

feats.scene: Nannto tackles a fleeing mugger onto a sidewalk.
Nannto dusts himself off after a clumsy fall.

name: Ulisor
summary: Ulisor is a white-haired, blue-eyed antiquities hoarder from a coastal city, who pays dearly for one prized object. He is wealthy, fussy, and finally outmatched by his own purchase.

feats.scene: Ulisor hurls a glass paperweight at a burglar.
Ulisor collapses in a heap beside his display case.

name: Oruantol
summary: Oruantol is a city police commander who tells a detective to let a suspect walk. He is political, tight-lipped, and never raises his voice.

feats.scene: Oruantol slaps a file folder against a desk.
Oruantol sits through a long hearing without blinking.

name: Viate
summary: Viate is a mutant soldier in a future command unit, standing guard when a new commander arrives. He then marches off to bring a fugitive to justice.

feats.scene: Viate blasts a barricade apart with a burst from his palms.
Viate shrugs off a concussive grenade and keeps marching.

name: Seonetum
summary: Seonetum is a patched-together clone made from a famous soldier's template and bathed in strange rays. He lives in a pocket dimension, loyal to his maker, and fights with a grim grin.

feats.scene: Seonetum hurls a shield through a rock wall.
Seonetum walks through a cave-in with only dust on his boots.
Seonetum sprints across a fungal plain.

name: Auvatia
summary: Auvatia is a blue-eyed hairless robot who serves a deep-sea kingdom, sent to fetch a wayward prince. He is obedient, literal, and quite durable.

feats.scene: Auvatia clamps a pincer on a hull and peels it open.
Auvatia resists a depth charge blast.

name: Sorortus
summary: Sorortus is a spoken word of power, whispered by a sorceress to call a killing blizzard out of the dark. It has no body of its own, only a chill that follows the speaker.

feats.scene: Sorortus sweeps an iron-hard frost over a dozen soldiers in the pass.

name: Oriuleo
summary: Oriuleo is a teenage tunnel-dweller with a hard, chitinous hide and loyal friends in the underground crowd. Little else is known about her.

feats.scene: Oriuleo shoulder-barges a gate off its hinges.
Oriuleo takes a pipe swung at her back with a scraping sound.

name: Liutil
summary: Liutil is a man whose body is wholly carbon, able to turn soft like charcoal or hard like a gem. He fights beside a gang of elemental villains.

feats.scene: Liutil hardens a fist into a diamond block and smashes a car door.
Liutil takes a cannon shot while in gem form and shows only a scratch.

name: Tetum
summary: Tetum is a skinless, pink-glowing demon who once served an agent of disorder and attacked the halls of the dead. He tries to undo everything, and he is thwarted.

feats.scene: Tetum rakes a wave of pink fire across a cavern and brings the roof down.
Tetum stands up from a wall of collapsed stone.

name: Coamaoro
summary: Coamaoro is a young mutant with a gambler's flair, summoned alongside a gang of teen heroes. He flicks glowing cards that explode on impact.

feats.scene: Coamaoro flings a charged card that blows a crater in a lawn.
Coamaoro stumbles off a ledge and lands on a hedge.

name: Nauniora
summary: Nauniora is a criminal with a shark-like set of teeth who nearly eats an innocent bystander. A gaping hole in space swallows him instead.

feats.scene: Nauniora bites through a lamp post at street level.
Nauniora hits the pavement hard and spits out gravel.

name: Stoveul
summary: Stoveul is a woolly-jumper adventurer from a snowy northern country, who flies with a squad of animal heroes. He dies early in a single comic story.

feats.scene: Stoveul throws a snowball at a stunned guard.
Stoveul shivers through a blizzard in a thin coat.

name: Rinorare
summary: Rinorare is a three-fingered, red-haired, tailed clone grown from several donors for a future squad. He moves with an acrobat's grace and jumps through shadows.

feats.scene: Rinorare slashes a blade through a steel door in one move.
Rinorare takes a point-blank blast and teleports clear.

name: Auntu
summary: Auntu is a bald, brown-eyed groundskeeper with a quiet manner and a nasty secret. He grunts in a hallway, hauls a body, and keeps his mouth shut.

feats.scene: Auntu drags a heavy sack across a basement floor.
Auntu shrugs off a shovel to the back.

name: Iliaami
summary: Iliaami is a black-haired researcher in an underground resistance, working against an authoritarian state formed after a city was levelled. She mends gadgets and tracks drones.

feats.scene: Iliaami pries a jammed hatch open with a crowbar.
Iliaami crouches behind a desk during a raid and survives.

name: Cenvalan
summary: Cenvalan is a veteran night-radio host who spent decades chatting about conspiracies. He tells a documentary crew that nobody believed in people with powers back then.

feats.scene: Cenvalan taps a desk bell to open his broadcast.
Cenvalan sits through a long overnight shift with coffee.

name: Nanterleo
summary: Nanterleo is a pink-skinned, red-haired assistant on a remote station who frees the creatures held in cages. She serves a hoarder until she cannot stomach it anymore.

feats.scene: Nanterleo throws a lever and shatters a row of cage locks.
Nanterleo is flung into a display case and rises unhurt.

name: Rernior
summary: Rernior is a masked thief who steals cars and runs, until a tribunal of strange judges finds him guilty and does away with him. His body is later found in a dump.

feats.scene: Rernior wrenches a door handle and hotwires the engine.
Rernior floors a stolen coupe along an empty highway.

name: Orsite
summary: Orsite is a grey-haired drug dealer in a southern river city, surrounded by relatives who all end badly. He is stubborn, greedy, and underestimates his visitor.

feats.scene: Orsite fires a shotgun through a screen door.
Orsite flinches and drops behind a couch.

name: Meisis
summary: Meisis is a dark-haired security guard at a busy research tower, who checks badges at the door. He is honest, bored, and has seen a few odd inventions.

feats.scene: Meisis shoves a turnstile bar and blocks a gate.
Meisis stands a double shift on a hard floor.

name: Naueoria
summary: Naueoria is a hairless rainy-weather mutant who is killed and brought back by a group of five. He shapes storm clouds over his school and soaks his enemies.

feats.scene: Naueoria summons a downpour that floods a courtyard in seconds.
Naueoria gets shot and slumps, then is revived later.

name: Iumulllor
summary: Iumulllor is a state department official with greying temples who attends a formal summit. He distrusts the ocean prince at the table and says so.

feats.scene: Iumulllor raises a hand and stops a speaker mid-sentence.
Iumulllor sits through a tense debate without blinking.

name: Vosam
summary: Vosam is a brown-haired network boss who pushes a reporter to run unfair stories about a daredevil. He is petty, ambitious, and unremarkable in a fight.

feats.scene: Vosam shoves a stack of scripts off a desk in anger.
Vosam stumbles back into a swivel chair.

name: Ntitostar
summary: Ntitostar is a green-eyed widower with thinning hair and a long list of lost relatives. He is bitter, estranged from his son, and unremarkable in a fight.

feats.scene: Ntitostar swings a belt in a cold rage.
Ntitostar stays on his feet after a hard shove.

name: Ntrne
summary: Ntrne is a harsh father in a gloomy house whose cruelty shaped his boy. He appears only in recollection, yelling and stomping.

feats.scene: Ntrne slaps a table hard enough to rattle a plate.
Ntrne bumps a door frame and swears.

name: Valseront
summary: Valseront is a blond mercenary and cannibal infected in an outbreak, with a plastic skin and an arm that reshapes into blades. He kills for pay and hunts the weak.

feats.scene: Valseront shapes his arm into a blade and cleaves a car roof.
Valseront shrugs off a burst of gunfire and keeps coming.

name: Lleeose
summary: Lleeose is a scarlet living armour that swallows whoever tries to stop it, wearing their body like a stolen coat. Freed hosts remember every blow it struck while it wore them.

feats.scene: Lleeose drives a hardened claw through a parked delivery van and flips the wreck across the lot.
Lleeose shrugs off a speeding truck that clips its host at full tilt.

name: Amtucor
summary: Amtucor is a hunger-demon sewn into a lapsed priest, speaking through his mouth in a voice no chapel wall can muffle. Barbed ribbons of flesh are its weapon, and it heals from anything short of consecrated acid.

feats.scene: Amtucor whips a barbed tendril through a stone arch and brings the whole doorway down on the street.
Amtucor absorbs a collapsing bell tower on its host and crawls out still grinning.

name: Amilortar
summary: Amilortar is a blood-coloured arena fighter whose jaw and claws unfold mid-combo, turning every round into a slaughter of the crowd's favourite. Its taunts about dessert wind up rivals before the opening bell.

feats.scene: Amilortar chains a dozen clawed strikes into a single launcher that sends a rival through the arena wall.
Amilortar closes the length of the ring in a lunging dash faster than a sprinting cheetah.

name: Elniu
summary: Amid a government convoy gone wrong, Elniu slipped out of its cage and wormed into a student desperate to cure a sick parent. It hunts in rooftop chases, abducting what its victims love most.

feats.scene: Elniu smashes a billboard frame loose and hurls it at a pursuing teen on the next roof.
Elniu bounds across rooftop gaps faster than a galloping horse.

name: Cilsa
summary: Cilsa is a star-sailing board rider whose silver shell was stripped away and replaced by seething red tissue. Mad with borrowed cosmic power, it flattens defenders for sport until one flicker of its rider's will steers it into the nearest sun.

feats.scene: Cilsa dives into a blazing star and burns itself out in a flare that scorches the whole inner system.
Cilsa crosses interplanetary gaps at a sizeable fraction of light speed.
Cilsa shakes off a barrage of cosmic fire that would crater a planet.

name: Siiasaun
summary: Siiasaun began as a cutting taken from a fallen meteor and grown in a corporate lab, then stolen by a prophet who thought it had been sent to him. Hosted, it carves its own blades from living flesh.

feats.scene: Siiasaun slices a steel girder in half with a blade grown from its own forearm.
Siiasaun takes a point-blank police cannon round and closes the wound in seconds.

name: Tevean
summary: Tevean is a mercenary's crimson partner on a team of rival-turned-allies, trading quips while pounding robots in a war between factions. It has few lines of its own and a famously short fuse.

feats.scene: Tevean punches a hovering drone so hard it folds around the fist.
Tevean keeps fighting through a collapsing catwalk without slowing.

name: Rneviaor
summary: Rneviaor stalks a mirror planet after a stray astronaut carried it there by accident. It stretches into ropes and whips, and a sharp whistle at the right pitch sends it recoiling.

feats.scene: Rneviaor lashes a stretched arm across a rooftop and tears the water tank from its stand.
Rneviaor stretches around a swung girder and snaps back undamaged.

name: Iueoslia
summary: Iueoslia was dragged from its host by a tyrant's ultrasonic hum and stitched onto a scientist with too many arms. Wearers come and go, but it keeps the memories of each one it has worn.

feats.scene: Iueoslia lashes four metal limbs at once and wrecks a lab bench and the wall behind it.
Iueoslia shrugs off a thrown vending machine without a dent.

name: Nicorrau
summary: Nicorrau was bred by a stage-show industrialist as a spectacle that got out of the rigging. Its tentacles knock down set pieces while audiences keep singing, convinced it is part of the act.

feats.scene: Nicorrau sweeps a tentacle across the balcony and snaps a row of seats from their bolts.
Nicorrau falls from the flies onto the stage floor and rises unhurt.

name: Rialuma
summary: Rialuma is a hired killer's parasite that sharpens a cellmate's craving into a trade, taking contracts for anyone who can feed it. It keeps count of kills the way others keep a diary.

feats.scene: Rialuma impales a steel shutter with a spear of black flesh in one stab.
Rialuma takes a falling air conditioner on its shoulder and goes on hunting.

name: Stuso
summary: Stuso is a swarm of silver nanites poured into an armour suit and then into a killer, so its scarlet lines never grow tired. Heat and ultrasound jam its repairs, leaving its wearer suddenly human.

feats.scene: Stuso reshapes a fist into a blade and cuts a parked sedan clean through.
Stuso rebuilds itself after a rooftop slam that cracks the concrete.

name: Celri
summary: Celri is a card on a puzzle board, a clawed pawn that swaps places with enemies for points. It is flat on the screen but fearsome in the little arcade of matched colours.

feats.scene: Celri matches three red tiles and sends a claw swipe that shatters the opposing token.
Celri survives a cascade of falling tiles that wipes out the rest of its row.

name: Anseran
summary: Anseran is only light, a projection a prankster uses to rattle a masked hero. It cannot touch anything and vanishes the instant the projector is switched off.

feats.scene: Anseran lunges at a hero and passes through him in a puff of static.

name: Lartumse
summary: Lartumse was buried deep in rock by a conqueror who wanted a fallback weapon, and it woke hungry. Wearing him, it tears through rival champions and almost drags the whole company into its grip.

feats.scene: Lartumse splits a mountain ridge open with a single overhand blow from its tyrant host.
Lartumse stands up inside a collapsing crater without a mark.

name: Velse
summary: Velse crept inside a flaming pumpkin-bomber and turned him into something redder and meaner. It lets the host rant while it flings fire-grown spikes at every pursuer.

feats.scene: Velse hurls a cluster of barbed fire-bombs that blow out the front of a warehouse.
Velse glides between towers faster than a stooping falcon.

name: Morannum
summary: Morannum is a hive-mind issued to soldiers in the hope of ending a vigilante, and it ended a city instead. Each wearer spreads its love of ruin to the next until no street is unclaimed.

feats.scene: Morannum's swarm of armoured hosts raze the skyline block by block in a single night.
Morannum shrugs off a missile strike on the barracks and keeps spreading.

name: Iasaul
summary: Iasaul is a dark crown of tissue that sits on an elderly aunt's brow and tells her that choice is an illusion. Together they hunt their own alternate selves across a thousand worlds.

feats.scene: Iasaul flings a veteran fighter across a street with the swing of one thin arm.
Iasaul ignores a collapsing brick facade that buries its host to the waist.

name: Serneani
summary: Serneani is a mobster's pet horror in a patchwork city on a flat-earth shard, always one rooftop ahead of the local vigilante. It chews through gang warfare until a crew of masked rivals corners it.

feats.scene: Serneani smashes a loading dock door with a tentacle and drags a rival out by the ankle.
Serneani absorbs a thrown crate and keeps charging.

name: Anllvil
summary: Anllvil joined a squad of killers in a raid on a coastal power plant, and perished in a safety field that overloaded the reactor. That leak fused the survivors to their gear and ended the plan.

feats.scene: Anllvil tears open a reactor hatch and rips out the cooling pipe by hand.
Anllvil is atomized by the containment field in a flash that floods the plant with radiation.

name: Leroaul
summary: Leroaul clings to a convict like a second skin in a grim alternate prison tale. It does what it must: pull, bite, and carve a path to the exit.

feats.scene: Leroaul pulls a cell door off its hinges and hurls it down the corridor.
Leroaul stays upright after a guard's whole magazine hits its chest.

name: Rumlose
summary: Rumlose is a raid boss in a loot-grinding hero game, with a health bar longer than the street it spawns on. Players farm it for drops and a few fight on after their party dies.

feats.scene: Rumlose slams a whole row of parked cars into a pileup with one swing.
Rumlose endures a full raid group's volley and only then drops to its knees.

name: Stanes
summary: Stanes followed a fanatic across the sky to a ruined wasteland and served as his claws against the wardens there. A burning rider ripped it from its host with a dark whip.

feats.scene: Stanes carves a gully through a canyon wall in a single sweep of its blade.
Stanes is hit by a burst of hellfire that would level a hillside and keeps standing.

name: Sannauces
summary: Sannauces serves in a hive's invasion fleet as a shock trooper, leaping between rooftops and spinning webbing from its own palms. A team of masked heroes finally halted it.

feats.scene: Sannauces leaps from a billboard and lands through a bus roof with both fists.
Sannauces bounds along a skyline faster than a speeding train.

name: Orritia
summary: Orritia is the middle child of a warlord who values peace and a rival nation's honour. It entered a quiet home on a mission of revenge and learned, too late, to let go of its host.

feats.scene: Orritia flattens a kitchen wall with a backhand while hunting for a stolen child.
Orritia absorbs a full-body tackle from an enraged father and holds its grip.

name: Leronaul
summary: Leronaul is a dread presence in a world overrun by multiplied versions of one parasite, remembered only through a grieving commander's report. Soldiers fell to it with ease before it died when a prank bomb found it.

feats.scene: Leronaul rakes its blades through an armoured transport and shreds the hull.
Leronaul is caught in the ship blast that finally ends it.

name: Celnanses
summary: Celnanses was claimed by a showman's cabal that wanted a monster with good marketing prospects. It turned on the cult's leader the moment the host managed to stab him.

feats.scene: Celnanses crushes a metal stage prop in one fist for the cheering cameras.
Celnanses keeps stalking after a thrown knife lodges in its shoulder.

name: Onleo
summary: Onleo exists only as a wistful memory, the nightmare a dying hero wishes had finished him in place of a petty thief. It never acts on the page, yet it haunts the last lines.

feats.scene: Onleo lingers as a drawn shadow in an old man's memory, a promise of violence that never lands.

name: Niiumsia
summary: Niiumsia fused with a cloned fighter in a lab accident and the two became a single, shouting monster. A sealed rift ended it by vaporizing the host along with everything stitched to him.

feats.scene: Niiumsia hurls a clone-sized punch that cracks a lab wall and the floor beneath it.
Niiumsia is consumed when it leaps into a unstable portal and the room blazes white.

name: Cauni
summary: Cauni is a scrolling brawler's boss with a roster of cousins, each demanding a different button combination. Beating it takes patience with its jumps, claws and a thunderous rampage across three levels.

feats.scene: Cauni slams a pixelated fist into the ground and sends rubble skipping across the screen.
Cauni soaks up a dozen combo hits before the health bar finally empties.

name: Nimarlor
summary: Nimarlor is a two-inch collectible with posable arms, sold in a blister pack beside its rival. Kids stage battles with it on the carpet until the glue gives way.

feats.scene: Nimarlor topples a tiny plastic lamp when a child flicks it across the playmat.

name: Anonium
summary: Anonium commands a hive-nation's raiders with a quiet, hungry cheer, passing from fighter to fighter as the war needs. Its veterans remember the grudge long after the host changes.

feats.scene: Anonium rips the front off a transit bus and uses the door as a shield.
Anonium stands in a burning hangar for a full minute before stepping out unscathed.

name: Sannisiu
summary: Sannisiu is a free-to-play hero unit with unlockable costumes and a bonus for matching teammates. Its blades regrow after each fight and its cooldown is the only thing that stops it.

feats.scene: Sannisiu fires a volley of grown spikes that punches holes through a squad of drones.
Sannisiu keeps fighting through an explosion that scatters its team.

name: Tuvine
summary: Tuvine ascended to godhood in its home reality and now plays basketball with other multiversal oddities for sport. It keeps trying to eat the new recruits, and a few have been eaten.

feats.scene: Tuvine dunks so hard the court cracks and a whole arena skyline wobbles on the horizon.
Tuvine shrugs off a teammate's half-court cannon pass that cuts through a tower.

name: Eoval
summary: Eoval is a collectible card with a flashy art border, a mid-range cost and a game-breaking passive. Whoever draws it can make the other player's best fighter throw away its hand.

feats.scene: Eoval's card art lunges off the foil and a rival's champion folds under its slash.
Eoval survives a full chain of area effects on the board.

name: Iarernmon
summary: Iarernmon sits in a cell in a school for heroes, refusing to be separated from the man it bonded to. It leads a breakout army until a flame weapon scorches it into surrender.

feats.scene: Iarernmon leads a charge that flattens a campus gate and the guards behind it.
Iarernmon endures a rooftop explosion that shatters the whole glass atrium.

name: Ausul
summary: Ausul appears in a single panel of a samurai-era comic as one clan among many in the vague background. Nothing is shown of it besides its name on a family chart.

feats.scene: Ausul is named in a dialogue bubble and never swings a blow.

name: Costesru
summary: Costesru lived a life much like that of its mainline twin until a sky-eating god marched on its world, and then its path drifted. Its sinister chapel of followers still sings its name.

feats.scene: Costesru cuts a bus in two with a scythe of tissue as parishioners cheer.
Costesru takes a police barricade crash and walks off bleeding black ink.

name: Numsumtu
summary: Numsumtu is a mid-boss in a buddy-brawler game, with fangs, a grab move and a short tantrum when it loses. A former host sometimes drops in as a friend-or-foe pick.

feats.scene: Numsumtu pounds a console-sized crate into splinters in front of the player.
Numsumtu soaks up a full combo chain and stays on its feet.

name: Tutiast
summary: Tutiast hid as a child's toy doll, causing mischief the boy always took the blame for. Once a counselor stopped believing in the boy, the doll grew to full height and quieted him.

feats.scene: Tutiast swells from doll-size to man-size and crushes a counselor's desk.
Tutiast is hurled across a classroom by a panicked adult and bounces back to its feet.

name: Tusia
summary: Tusia is a squat chibi enemy in a kids' online brawler, with oversized claws and a goofy grin. Players beat it in seconds, then trade stickers of its face.

feats.scene: Tusia bonks a rival so hard it spins into the sky with a cartoon star.
Tusia bounces off a falling anvil and wobbles back up.

name: Terorin
summary: Terorin was hauled into a sorcerer's scheme to open a doorway for a dark overlord, and when the plan failed it was banished with its host into a burning plane. Its boasts about wreaking glory still echo.

feats.scene: Terorin opens a rift with a screaming claw swipe that tears through a laboratory ceiling.
Terorin is dragged into a hell dimension and keeps swinging for hours.

name: Tesern
summary: Tesern is a drifting parasite from some other dimension that crashed into an unfamiliar world and wrapped around a clone. Fused, the pair became something taller and angrier before a portal erased them.

feats.scene: Tesern rips a streetlight from its base and hurls it clear across an intersection.
Tesern is vaporized when its host dives through an unstable gateway.

name: Neniumnt
summary: Neniumnt runs a chapel of death for a god of the dark, hosting a gathering for its very large and very odd family. It is soft with relatives and stubborn with strangers.

feats.scene: Neniumnt tosses a pew at a rude visitor and cracks the aisle.
Neniumnt laughs off a hymn-book volley and keeps preaching.

name: Leoesiar
summary: Leoesiar is a Saturday-morning villain born in a prison break and given a laugh track, a rhyming catchphrase and one episode to fail. Its menace is bright and loud and never lasts through the commercial.

feats.scene: Leoesiar swats a cartoon taxi off a bridge as the credits music swells.
Leoesiar is flattened by a rolling safe and inflates back to normal.

name: Leoontri
summary: Leoontri is a console-era boss with a pinched, comically squeaky voice and a habit of leaping at the camera. It once wore a many-armed scientist, and the sequel keeps the same attack pattern.

feats.scene: Leoontri belly-flops onto a crate stack and flattens it under a shout.
Leoontri absorbs a rocket from the player and only flinches.

name: Celilalu
summary: Celilalu leads the villains in a haunted theme-park night, a stage-managed takeover of an island of heroes' rides. Guests scream on cue and the cast reset the props at dawn.

feats.scene: Celilalu smashes through a fake storefront in a spray of foam brick and flashing lights.
Celilalu takes a pyrotechnic blast from the show crew and keeps its pose.

name: Nansiast
summary: Nansiast wrapped a masked industrialist in red flame and spikes, then started rejecting him when his rage grew too self-centred. Left alone, the parasite wandered off to find a better fit.

feats.scene: Nansiast tears a fire escape from a brick wall and swings it like a club.
Nansiast takes a hero's full-force charge and slides back only a few steps.

name: Cevaltor
summary: Cevaltor reformed, joined a team of redeemed monsters and was sent to guard a prison world. A space-suited newspaper tycoon cut it down in the very first hour.

feats.scene: Cevaltor springs along a prison wall and smashes a turret into the sand.
Cevaltor withstands a barrage from a rival squad before the final stand.

name: Cecoleo
summary: Cecoleo shows up as a cameo at a mercenary's roast, tossing insults at the guest of honour and eating the rest of the buffet. Nobody takes it seriously, which suits it fine.

feats.scene: Cecoleo swats a heckler's chair across the banquet room in a clattering heap.

name: Corvatu
summary: Corvatu is a sentient suit that wraps a criminal and shrinks back at the sound of a shrill pitch. It keeps losing to the same hero, and keeps coming back convinced the next fight will end differently.

feats.scene: Corvatu lashes a clawed arm through a phone booth and drags the wreck down the alley.
Corvatu keeps charging through a hail of thrown bricks until a shrill whistle makes it cringe.

name: Lenen
summary: Lenen lurks on a phone map as a spawning enemy, popping up on street corners for players to chase on foot. It is a glowing red marker with a short fight and a loot box.

feats.scene: Lenen lunges out of the screen glow and smashes a virtual bus stop for points.
Lenen absorbs a crowd of tapping players before the timer ends.

name: Leoaul
summary: Leoaul is a card-battler champion whose host is slowly losing the contest to the thing riding him. Its strength grows with each win, and so does the crack in its borrowed mind.

feats.scene: Leoaul sweeps a claw through a squad of rivals and cracks the arena floor.
Leoaul takes a full volley of match-ending cards and stays standing.

name: Rnean
summary: Rnean stands in a quiet doorway telling a neighbour to keep out of her garden, since it has already ruined everything growing there. That warning is polite and utterly sincere.

feats.scene: Rnean flattens a picket fence and the shed behind it with one sweep of its arm.
Rnean walks through a swinging screen door without so much as a scratch.

name: Sinieo
summary: Sinieo hijacks a stolen jet and rakes a fleeing crowd, then stops for a drink in a nearby bar and kills everyone in it. It has a very limited list of hobbies, and tends to repeat them.

feats.scene: Sinieo strafes a crowded square with a stolen jet's cannon in a single pass.
Sinieo banks the stolen aircraft in a tight roll at near-supersonic speed.

name: Ternili
summary: Ternili was torn apart in orbit by a radiant powerhouse and still pulled itself back together, both halves crawling toward each other across the dark. Everyone it fights says the same thing, that it should have stayed gone.

feats.scene: Ternili rakes a talon down a hull plate and opens a seam a ship-length long.
Ternili is ripped in half by a radiant titan in orbit and regrows within the hour.

name: Neomalar
summary: Neomalar is a rumour of a dread, an illusion cast by a crooked trickster so that cops will flinch before it has done anything. It leaves behind only smoke, noise and the smell of ash.

feats.scene: Neomalar leaps from a fake shadow and knocks a bystander's hat off before fading.

name: Saaunias
summary: Saaunias is a gleaming, hair-product sentient who hosts a talk show and bickers with her cosmic guests. A surprise pregnancy announcement leads to an on-air brawl between two titans that nearly ends the world.

feats.scene: Saaunias slaps a rival guest's wig clean off with a blast of hairspray.
Saaunias is deleted from the page when a reality eraser wipes the whole studio.

name: Corvotum
summary: Corvotum is a black-and-crimson abyss-thing glued to a young woman by accident, speaking as a choir about a new name for itself. It still follows the old command of a vanished god and still hates its borrowed home.

feats.scene: Corvotum hurls a car through a shop front with a claw that grows out of a shoulder.
Corvotum is crushed under a fallen awning and slides out in pieces that reknit.

name: Roteter
summary: Roteter was a choir angel who left the high gates after a rebellion and, as the story goes, was never seen again. Few scribes will confirm the details and none will go looking.

feats.scene: Roteter hurls a bolt of pale fire down a cloud-bridge and scorches its whole length.
Roteter falls from the high gates and lands without breaking a single wing.

name: Cosoro
summary: Cosoro is a hulking toy-brick hybrid built from two rival monsters by a goblin engineer. It strides through a block-built city with spikes down its back and a head full of conflicting orders.

feats.scene: Cosoro stomps a brick tower and sends studs raining across the whole avenue.
Cosoro takes a wrecking-ball swing and snaps the chain.

name: Iariar
summary: Iariar is a widow in a district of mutants who can light herself up like a torch, though she is burnable too. Using the gift is something she dislikes, and she refuses to discuss it with the detective she once hired.

feats.scene: Iariar ignites her forearm and singes the curtains of a kitchen in one flash.
Iariar is scorched by a stray flame from her own hand and yelps.

name: Meoonam
summary: Meoonam is a schoolgirl pulled into an old spy plot when her father is kidnapped by a masked agent. She waits in a derelict mansion for a team of boys to come and fight their way in.

feats.scene: Meoonam kicks a loose chair at a gang member and misses.
Meoonam is bound hand and foot yet shows no sign of giving up.

name: Rnamses
summary: Rnamses is a flier whose abilities were wiped away by a scientist's invention meant to end an old registration law. She lives out her days among the powerless and wonders what the sky looked like.

feats.scene: Rnamses punches a locker and bruises her own knuckles in her first fight without powers.
Rnamses survives a rooftop stumble that would once have been nothing.

name: Raucaurn
summary: Raucaurn is a star-eyed flier on a team led by an iron-armoured successor, one of the longest-serving members of an old guard. She spends most of her days in the air above a crowded skyline.

feats.scene: Raucaurn drops from the clouds and punctures a rogue freighter's hull with one punch.
Raucaurn pulls out of a power dive faster than a fighter jet.

name: Coramasor
summary: Coramasor is a pilot-turned-cyborg with mechanical wings, once chief guard of a space agency and later a mercenary who guarded a vital teleporter in a ruined future. She was cut down by a rival with cold eyes.

feats.scene: Coramasor slices a barricade with a wing blade and clears a path through the ruins.
Coramasor holds a collapsing doorframe long enough for a teleporter to escape.

name: Staneva
summary: Staneva is a fighter drawn into a battlerealm tournament after losing her memory in a crash. She has since learned to channel stellar power at a pace that would alarm a naval gunner.

feats.scene: Staneva focuses a golden pulse into a single shot that levels a whole arena district.
Staneva walks out of the rubble of a collapsed colosseum with a smirk.

name: Letumros
summary: Letumros kneels with the rest of a transformed planet before a youthful god who remade everything to his liking. She adores him sincerely, which is the only power she has left.

feats.scene: Letumros bows in a crowd of worshippers and does nothing more.

name: Taaunser
summary: Taaunser is the hub of a cosmic career: pilot, soldier, star-powered flier and team leader with a long list of aliases. Her strength, sturdiness and sense for danger make her a regular fixture in stories about the safety of whole worlds.

feats.scene: Taaunser unleashes a blast of star-fire that cracks a continent's crust from orbit.
Taaunser flies through a stellar flare and emerges with only singed sleeves.
Taaunser races a comet across the system at a thirtieth of light speed.

name: Nesiasal
summary: Nesiasal fought a bitter war of conscience over a young boy's fate and lost to an old friend's misread panic. Her last energy blast was meant to free the kid, not hurt him.

feats.scene: Nesiasal fires a clean blast of light and cracks a prison field wide open.
Nesiasal takes a devastating beam in the chest and drifts silently to the floor.

name: Serloiu
summary: Serloiu is a fairground-era flier with the strength of a sentinel in a bright suit, rescuing a golden hero from a hungry giant. Next she remade a swallowed train with a wave of the hand and then tricked the monster to a frozen pole.

feats.scene: Serloiu hurls a ravenous giant back across the horizon with a single blow.
Serloiu races polar winds to the ice cap in a shrieking blur.

name: Rannescos
summary: Rannescos is a fusion of a ruling mind and a star-pilot, leader of a vast army and enemy of a rival alliance. Her plan is to set off a bomb meant to end every other people, failing only when a sacrifice softens the blast.

feats.scene: Rannescos detonates a nullifying bomb that threatens to erase an entire empire's reality.
Rannescos is the heart of a collapsing sphere of space and walks out of it.

name: Tumresrne
summary: Tumresrne was a veteran flier of a bright age that ended when a tyrant took the throne. She appears only in a flashback, a face in a long line of the fallen.

feats.scene: Tumresrne vaults over a roofline in a flashback panel and blasts a drone out of the air.
Tumresrne takes a heavy slug on her shoulder-plate and keeps flying.

name: Aunti
summary: Aunti sided with the rebel faction when an overbearing registry law was passed, and fell in battle against giant robot hunters. Her reasons were simple and her last stand was loud.

feats.scene: Aunti blasts a hole in a hunter-robot's chest and keeps on punching through the next.
Aunti takes a metal fist to the ribs and fights on until the last giant falls.

name: Seveltor
summary: Seveltor was a winged warrior who could drink in energy and spit it back, and who died to a pharaoh-turned-monster. Her body was displayed on a gruesome shelf beside her teammates.

feats.scene: Seveltor drinks in a lightning bolt and returns it with a punch that levels a billboard.
Seveltor is struck down by a monarch-sized fist and is left lying in plain sight.

name: Isecos
summary: Isecos is a flier whose fate is unknown after a warrior queen came to avenge her fallen emperor. The record says only that she faced the invader and may not have lived.

feats.scene: Isecos rams a charging gladiator in the air and sends them both tumbling.
Isecos takes a crushing grip around the ribs and still struggles to get free.

name: Nosviau
summary: Nosviau relishes her warrior roots on a crossover world of shape-shifting machines, calling herself more herself than ever. Flying from tower to tower, she fights alongside both teams.

feats.scene: Nosviau punches a transforming truck so hard it unfolds into scrap.
Nosviau tanks a giant robot's cannon and keeps laughing.

name: Celtum
summary: Celtum is a cartoon watchwoman for a team of legends, greeting alien visitors and sending them home with a warning. Her strength and flight serve a vigilant, no-nonsense temper.

feats.scene: Celtum throws an alien raider through a hangar wall with a single swing.
Celtum crosses the sky above the base in a few seconds flat.

name: Corninan
summary: Corninan is a body-swapped tangle of two lives: a mutant who absorbed too much and a hero who clung too hard. The result carries both minds and neither is certain which one is driving.

feats.scene: Corninan lifts a transport bus overhead and hurls it down the block with a laugh.
Corninan tanks an energy blast that would flatten a block and checks her sleeve.

name: Rnstule
summary: Rnstule hangs in the sky among thousands of heroes held in a deathlike stasis by a storm of cosmic fire, waiting for the doom to lift. Presumably she was released with the rest when the fire was driven off.

feats.scene: Rnstule absorbs an energy surge before the freeze and releases it in a single pulse.
Rnstule hangs suspended in a field of stellar fire, unmoving and unharmed.

name: Neeoern
summary: Neeoern is a crossbow-wielding hunter in a gloomy gothic city, a rogue agent who might just be undercover. Her bolts were engineered by an archer friend for a league of reunited heroes.

feats.scene: Neeoern fires a bolt that pins a thug's coat to a brick wall.
Neeoern lands in a roll after a three-storey drop with only bruises.

name: Sesllo
summary: Sesllo is a half-alien soldier who left her ruined world to look after the remnants of a homeworld ravaged by endless war. She wears a title taken in honour of a fallen friend and lives in a lonely paradise.

feats.scene: Sesllo rips a missile from the air and crushes it in her glowing fist.
Sesllo is thrown through a stone colonnade and rises with a grin.

name: Rauus
summary: Rauus is a guerrilla fighter in a free-nation alliance a year after a covert alien invasion succeeded. Her side is called terrorists by the new rulers and heroes by everyone else.

feats.scene: Rauus blasts a patrol hover-tank out of the sky above a hidden valley.
Rauus shrugs off a shape-changer's ambush and fights through to the extraction point.

name: Relusium
summary: Relusium turned in a world-wide plague and joined a pack led by a rock-skinned brawler. Later slain, she ended up as a trophy on a gruesome rack.

feats.scene: Relusium claws a barricade apart in a mad dash for fresh meat.
Relusium keeps lunging after a thrown crowbar bounces off her skull.

name: Ulirne
summary: Ulirne is one of the many fliers cut down by a talkative blade-for-hire during a massacre at a mansion. Noticing that the roster looks thin, she asks where everyone is, then is stopped for good.

feats.scene: Ulirne blasts at a masked intruder from across the foyer and dents the marble.
Ulirne is felled by an ambush from behind in a quiet corridor.

name: Eocesan
summary: Eocesan is a brick-built hero with a pet cat, chasing villains through a toy city and gathering a squad of pilots around her. Flying with studs pinging off her helmet, she builds a bridge when it breaks.

feats.scene: Eocesan punches a brick tower and watches it collapse into a neat pile of bricks.
Eocesan shrugs off a crushing hit and snaps her head back into place.

name: Serntu
summary: Serntu briefly wore the power of a firebird and was among those sent to stop it before it reached the planet. Her bright borrowed strength lasted until a master of magnetism struck her down.

feats.scene: Serntu channels a borrowed firebird surge into a single burst that melts a mountain range.
Serntu is torn through by a magnetic storm and fades from the sky.

name: Verleo
summary: Verleo is a holographic copy of a flier used in a school's drill room, hurled against students as a practice rival. Brawling stops when a fussy trainee complains and the session shuts down.

feats.scene: Verleo throws a hologram-hard punch at a student and the drill room floor trembles.
Verleo flickers out of existence when the session is switched off.

name: Niiaront
summary: Niiaront is a liaison between two peoples at a council of worlds deciding whether to ally with a titan against builders. She teleports into the enemy flagship with a strike team and fights beside the old enemy.

feats.scene: Niiaront fires a flare that burns through the shield of a builder landing craft.
Niiaront steps out of a ruined shuttle after its wall folds around her.

name: Tilllre
summary: Tilllre lifted a storm-god's hammer and took on his title, then whisked an old ally off to the skybound palace to trade secret names. Her lightning is borrowed and her laughter is her own.

feats.scene: Tilllre swings the hammer and brings down a lightning bolt that levels a whole district.
Tilllre whirls the hammer overhead and carries her friend skyward at storm speed.

name: Leanni
summary: Leanni patrols a sealed paradise with a band of fellow heroes until a giant sea beast breaks the routine. Leanni holds the line while the team's leader argues with the sheriff over an arrest.

feats.scene: Leanni flings a gigantic sea beast across a moat in one heave.
Leanni absorbs a thrashing tail that cracks a harbour wall.

name: Stucor
summary: Stucor is a cartoon team-player who keeps a pet that eats the furniture, and who disappears into deep space after a monster army marches through town. Her best friend rounds up some star travellers to help her fight a hive of aliens.

feats.scene: Stucor smashes through an alien warship's door with a glowing fist.
Stucor shrugs off a battery of cannon blasts from a hive ship.

name: Nenmeo
summary: Nenmeo is a grey-haired veteran who fought in a distant world war and answered a young thief's call for help years later. Her humour is dry and her timing is perfect.

feats.scene: Nenmeo blasts through a fortress gate with a gleaming fist and quips about being late.
Nenmeo withstands a guard-bot barrage that levels half the courtyard.

name: Nosasli
summary: Nosasli is a rotting stalker with red eyes who leads a hive of the undead and mocks a clawed rival for not understanding the new world. She was destroyed when the hive-mind behind her was shattered.

feats.scene: Nosasli tears the roof from a bus with decaying hands and snarls at the survivors.
Nosasli keeps walking after a tank shell tears through her chest.

name: Larserst
summary: Larserst is a comic-strip teenager version of a star-flier who squabbles with her friends and tosses off a quip. Her trouble in school matters more than any cosmic threat.

feats.scene: Larserst launches a lunch tray across the cafeteria with a flick of her wrist.
Larserst bounces off a locker door and shakes off the dent.

name: Tarose
summary: Tarose stands in a nightmare scenario where a feared entity is real, fighting beside others until a lone genius finally stops it. That battle turns out to be a dream, but the blows still ring.

feats.scene: Tarose fires a golden blast that breaks off an arm of a colossal extinction beast.
Tarose takes a crushing tendril to the chest in a dream and flies on.

name: Amaontrn
summary: Amaontrn was written into being from every human imagination at once when a web-slinger rewrote the divine text. She flies in an ordinary suit and does little more than appear on the page.

feats.scene: Amaontrn crosses a dream sky and blasts a floating specter out of the picture.
Amaontrn tumbles through a collapsing dream wall and shakes herself free.

name: Lesval
summary: Lesval was brainwashed by a cabal of tinkerers and now serves them as an agent in a city that has become their showpiece. Her former friends hide in a mountain base and plan to snap her out of it.

feats.scene: Lesval blasts open a barricade in the occupied downtown and strides through.
Lesval shakes off a thrown shield and heads for the base.

name: Seornama
summary: Seornama takes a break from saving the world to chase down a spam email about a deposed foreign prince. She and her teammates trace the scam to a machine that never learned about filters.

feats.scene: Seornama shatters a scam server rack with a single energy punch.
Seornama is zapped by a surge of junk-mail static and brushes off her sleeve.

name: Iumron
summary: Iumron is a stubborn air-force pilot who never gained any power, getting reprimanded in each posting for talking back. She watches a daring rider whiz past overhead and can only stare.

feats.scene: Iumron slams her palm on the console of a jet and nothing else happens.
Iumron flies a fighter at the speed of sound on a routine exercise.

name: Orrote
summary: Orrote is a scaly sky-guardian who patrols a swamp-bound world of talking reptiles. Orrote trades blows with raiders high above the treetops, fists glowing white.

feats.scene: Orrote hurls a burst of white light that collapses a stone watchtower into the mud.
Orrote shrugs off a falling timber beam the size of a house without a scratch.

name: Sautus
summary: Sautus is a test pilot bonded to a hungry living suit that wears her face like a mask. Sautus sprouts fangs and a rope-like tongue, and bursts of raw energy sometimes erupt from her body.

feats.scene: Sautus rips the door from a bank vault using ropes of black flesh.
Sautus walks out of a burning fuel depot with her skin already knitting back together.

name: Viliri
summary: Viliri is a veteran flier whose borrowed alien blood lets her brawl at skyscraper scale. Viliri is quickly outmatched by a rage-fuelled giant, which humbles her pride.

feats.scene: Viliri slams into a freight ship hard enough to fold its hull in half.
Viliri is knocked senseless by a single backhand and drops out of the sky.

name: Valvian
summary: Valvian appears only inside a nightmare conjured by a haunted suit of armour, offering kindness to a drinker who cannot accept it. Valvian is a half-alien flier in that dream, though her strength is never tested.

feats.scene: Valvian lifts a fallen girder off a trapped worker as the dream shudders around her.
Valvian is slapped aside by a drunken swing and tumbles through a dream wall.

name: Amseran
summary: Amseran is a blazing warrior who answers a call to defend a besieged city-world from a murderous machine. Amseran fires lances of light and flies faster than any craft, yet falls in the end.

feats.scene: Amseran fires a dazzling lance of light that melts a hangar roof and the ships beneath it.
Amseran weathers a barrage of missiles that levels the street around her.
Amseran streaks across the skyline faster than any pursuing fighter.

name: Iueovos
summary: Iueovos is a flier admired in a crowded cartoon metropolis, known for hauling stalled trucks out of traffic. Iueovos shares the spotlight with a clever child and her huge pet.

feats.scene: Iueovos punches through a collapsing overpass to keep it from crushing a bus.
Iueovos stands in the path of a runaway tram and stops it dead.

name: Ilauor
summary: Ilauor is a masked flier drafted into a military hunt for a rampaging green brute. Ilauor keeps her identity quiet while she soars over the battlefield.

feats.scene: Ilauor dives into a tank column and sends the lead vehicle spinning across the road.
Ilauor takes a tank shell to the chest and keeps flying.

name: Strno
summary: Strno is a pilot-turned-champion who loses her gifts to a power-stripping wave and fights on in a borrowed iron suit. Strno's armour copies what she lost, and she uses it to break an invading army.

feats.scene: Strno blasts a hole through an armoured gate with a repulsor palm.
Strno survives a rooftop fall inside the suit and climbs out laughing.

name: Rnovilse
summary: Rnovilse is a one-armed woman who runs a dusty frontier town on a patched-together continent. Rnovilse leads marches for fair treatment and settles hecklers with a rock or a punch.

feats.scene: Rnovilse knocks a hired thug flat with a single swing of her prosthetic arm.
Rnovilse takes a hard fall from a wagon and stands up bruised but unbowed.

name: Salusus
summary: Salusus is a portrait of a blazing-haired star-warrior hanging above a bunk in a shared bedroom. Salusus gives off nothing but memory, a reminder of a fighter who never appears in person.

feats.scene: Salusus catches the lamplight so brightly that a roommate squints and looks away.

name: Roanam
summary: Roanam is a teammate of a bulletproof street fighter, flying with him against thieves and cults. Roanam is later mentioned as lost in a grim future.

feats.scene: Roanam smashes a delivery van into a gang hideout wall from a hundred metres up.
Roanam is thrown through a brick facade and is up before the dust settles.

name: Aunnumte
summary: Aunnumte is a gold-eyed ace who trades a pilot's seat for a duelling-card career. Aunnumte flies, hits like a battering ram and throws bolts of stored light.

feats.scene: Aunnumte flings a golden bolt that levels a warehouse block.
Aunnumte absorbs a rival's finishing combo and grins through the smoke.

name: Netorso
summary: Netorso is a fast-flying officer in a world overrun by a machine mind that remakes cities in its own image. Netorso joins a ragged coalition to slip past its drones and meets a bad end.

feats.scene: Netorso rams a sentry drone through three floors of a parking structure.
Netorso weathers a swarm of laser fire long enough to cover a retreat.

name: Laont
summary: Laont is a flier who studies at an orbital school for young heroes and rushes to a crashed ship to help. Laont's hair ignites when she taps her deepest power, a blaze visible across a district.

feats.scene: Laont ignites in star-fire and clears a field of wreckage in a single sweep.
Laont flies through a collapsing airlock and shakes off the debris.

name: Eovalvos
summary: Eovalvos is a hero with a single glaring eye in the middle of her forehead. Eovalvos crosses a torn gap in space with a band of strangers and is yanked home by a newborn's cry.

feats.scene: Eovalvos stares down a bridge span and cracks its deck with a pulse from her eye.
Eovalvos is flung through a shop front and shrugs it off.

name: Ntiasle
summary: Ntiasle is a hand-picked enforcer for a president-turned-armoured-tyrant. Ntiasle is tricked into a gladiator contest and has her memory twisted so she believes it is a routine arrest.

feats.scene: Ntiasle drives a lamp post through a rebel barricade and scatters its defenders.
Ntiasle absorbs a rocket volley while shielding a parade float.

name: Riaus
summary: Riaus is a crested, long-tailed flier who answers a distress call with her team. Riaus cannot understand the strange visitors she finds and cages them until a translator settles things.

feats.scene: Riaus tail-whips a steel gantry apart to pin a pair of intruders.
Riaus shakes off a thrown crate of machinery without flinching.

name: Amiase
summary: Amiase is a flier whose body is overrun by a creeping fungal infection that turns allies on each other. Amiase is cured with a shot of current from a small walking plant.

feats.scene: Amiase flings a fungus-ridden truck across a plaza at her teammates.
Amiase is dropped cold by a jolt of electricity.

name: Isaunrni
summary: Isaunrni is a radiant fighter sent to evict a boisterous thunder-prince from a party. Isaunrni fires photon bolts and moves faster than the eye can follow.

feats.scene: Isaunrni blasts a ballroom wall into sparks with a column of light.
Isaunrni takes a hammer swing to the ribs and only slides back a few paces.
Isaunrni crosses the venue in the blink of an eye.

name: Tustorll
summary: Tustorll is a winged brawler dragged to a stolen patchwork world by a power-hungry tyrant. Tustorll is killed and brought back as a bargaining chip, then escapes with other abductees.

feats.scene: Tustorll smashes a star-powered rival into a canyon wall and splits the cliff.
Tustorll takes a mind-blasting hit from the tyrant and falls only after several seconds.

name: Nansum
summary: Nansum is a masked flier left comatose after a stranger drains her life force. Nansum's mind survives inside the thief and fights her host from within.

feats.scene: Nansum overpowers her host in a dream-corridor and shoves her through a wall of thought.
Nansum's mind holds against a day of pressure from the host's crumbling will.

name: Amavaon
summary: Amavaon is a veteran flier in a mixed squad of heroes and their furry sidekicks. Amavaon drinks in energy, fires concussive bolts and helps hold off a visitor from across the sky.

feats.scene: Amavaon fires a concussive bolt that levels a stone arch.
Amavaon takes a direct blast and absorbs it, glowing brighter.

name: Onran
summary: Onran is a flier in a toy-box cartoon who takes the side of the armoured inventor in a playground dispute. Onran's feats are small and silly, measured in sandcastles.

feats.scene: Onran knocks over a sandcastle and a swing set with a single flying tackle.
Onran bounces off a slide without a scratch.

name: Resam
summary: Resam is a masked hero whose gifts were once siphoned away by a touch. Resam's story diverges from there into an unknown state of recovery.

feats.scene: Resam bursts through a warehouse roof and flattens a stack of crates.
Resam is left drained and shaking after a hand brushes her wrist.

name: Annis
summary: Annis is a gene-altered heroine attending a rigged awards party in a jungle valley. Annis joins a mob punishing a cheating winner.

feats.scene: Annis knocks a trophy table over a ravine rim with a wild swing.
Annis is clawed across the chest and brushes it off.

name: Calin
summary: Calin is a flier who survives a monstrous insect empire's conquest and joins a cosmic resistance. Calin is cut down on a barren moon after a grand plan collapses.

feats.scene: Calin blasts a drone swarm from a crater rim and levels the ridge behind it.
Calin holds a collapsing tunnel up long enough for survivors to escape.

name: Nanos
summary: Nanos is a yellow-eyed lieutenant bent to the will of a fire-crowned sorcerer who conquered her world. Nanos leads packs of mindless brutes and is seen as too strong to beat.

feats.scene: Nanos pours dark flame over a ridge and glasses a whole slope of rock.
Nanos is struck by three attackers at once and only loses a step.

name: Cotulu
summary: Cotulu is a flier present in a staged vision meant to trap a shrinking scientist's mind. Cotulu is not real, a figure in an illusion crafted by a villain's will.

feats.scene: Cotulu slams a phantom door shut on a wall of illusory flame.
Cotulu fades like smoke when the illusion cracks.

name: Vilvornos
summary: Vilvornos is a flier killed by an enraged giant in a city park. Vilvornos barely gets a punch in before the end.

feats.scene: Vilvornos lands one solid punch that shifts the giant's jaw an inch.
Vilvornos is hurled through a row of trees before the final blow.

name: Llvalvel
summary: Llvalvel is a heroine in a game alliance who joins a secret war and a civil conflict over who must register. Llvalvel sides with the rule-makers and trades blows with former friends.

feats.scene: Llvalvel punches a hideout door off its hinges mid-brawl.
Llvalvel takes a double-team charge and stays on her feet.

name: Sertesta
summary: Sertesta is a colonel who runs a school for young heroes and leaves daily chores to her deputy. Sertesta's reputation rests on organisation more than raw force.

feats.scene: Sertesta throws a training dummy through a gym wall to quiet a rowdy class.
Sertesta absorbs a stray practice blast with a sigh.

name: Rosvi
summary: Rosvi is a fighter pilot reworked into a flier who soaks up and fires off energy. Rosvi answers a desperate call and joins a doomed uprising against a purple tyrant.

feats.scene: Rosvi hurls a concentrated blast that cracks a landing pad into pieces.
Rosvi takes a volley of cannon fire and stays aloft.

name: Ontrivia
summary: Ontrivia is a kid-friendly prankster in a cartoon strip who loves tricking a web-slinging friend. Ontrivia holds out a card and yanks it away at the last second.

feats.scene: Ontrivia trips a friend and sends him skidding across a rooftop.
Ontrivia bounces off a lunchroom wall and keeps giggling.

name: Veoroern
summary: Veoroern is a green-streaked penguin who dons a cape to defend a snowy island from pranksters. Veoroern waddles into a crowd of schemers and waddles out the winner.

feats.scene: Veoroern flipper-slaps a crab scheme off a pier.
Veoroern slides down an ice slope into a snowdrift and pops up unhurt.

name: Moorn
summary: Moorn is a flier stranded in a land of retired and cancelled heroes. Moorn joins a band of women who defeat a spirit of endings.

feats.scene: Moorn smashes a cardboard wall and the hall behind it in one swing.
Moorn is crushed under a pile of discarded scripts and shrugs free.

name: Colterte
summary: Colterte is a green-skinned impostor trained to copy a heroine and sow chaos in her life. Colterte changes shape on a whim and ends her own life rather than lose the game.

feats.scene: Colterte tears a cell door off its frame while disguised as a guard.
Colterte takes a stun round to the shoulder and stays in character.

name: Oramaoru
summary: Oramaoru is a flier whose body is rewritten by a scheming scientist who copies himself onto an entire world. Oramaoru fights in a final war and falls to former friends.

feats.scene: Oramaoru dives through a command tower and leaves a crater where it stood.
Oramaoru weathers a squad's combined fire for a full minute.

name: Ameco
summary: Ameco is a masked flier snatched into an arena where collected heroes serve as pieces in other people's contests. Ameco fights for a summoner who treats her like a trading card.

feats.scene: Ameco rams an arena statue and topples it into the stands.
Ameco shrugs off a chain of special moves that would floor a tank.

name: Alucaror
summary: Alucaror is a shape-shifting soldier brainwashed into believing she is a famous flier. Alucaror attacks the very heroes she thinks are impostors, until a gadget exposes the truth.

feats.scene: Alucaror wrenches a fallen tree off a ridge and hurls it at her enemies.
Alucaror survives a ship crash with only a limp.

name: Eocarori
summary: Eocarori is a flier in a covert strike squad who is fooled by a false recording into attacking her own ally. Eocarori crushes a glowing chest-reactor and nearly kills him.

feats.scene: Eocarori punches through a power core and darkens a wing of a base.
Eocarori sways, dizzy, after an illusion lifts.

name: Liavel
summary: Liavel is a sharp-eyed campaign manager running a congressional race for a former street hero. Liavel keeps secrets and a tight schedule, with no powers beyond persuasion.
