feats.scene: Liavel slams a clipboard on a desk and silences a noisy office.
Liavel trips on a podium step and climbs back up unbothered.

name: Rinto
summary: Rinto is a young woman whose boyfriend's car swerves when a glowing visitor tries to make contact. Rinto is an ordinary bystander in a cosmic event beyond her control.

feats.scene: Rinto slaps the dashboard and shrieks as the car lurches off the road.
Rinto endures a rolling crash with a cracked rib.

name: Rnamne
summary: Rnamne is a quiet lab scientist in a north-country project that turns men into weapons. Rnamne logs vitals and tries not to ask what the tests are for.

feats.scene: Rnamne shoves a rolling cart across the lab floor to block a door.
Rnamne is knocked into a bench and keeps typing.

name: Ranen
summary: Ranen is a lab scientist who kidnaps children off city streets to run grim bone experiments. Ranen's cruelty is cold and clinical, and a young captive escapes her grasp.

feats.scene: Ranen swings a steel tray at an escaping boy and misses.
Ranen is shoved to the tile floor and scrambles for the alarm.

name: Ellamcor
summary: Ellamcor is a lab scientist who watches the vitals of a test subject who becomes a berserk killer. Ellamcor freezes in horror when the beast rampages and a clawed intruder breaks in for the files.

feats.scene: Ellamcor drops a clipboard and flings a chair at the lab doors.
Ellamcor is shoved against a monitor bank and slides to the floor.

name: Celmis
summary: Celmis is a teenage girl whose grades slip when she falls in with the wrong crowd. Celmis and her boyfriend wise up in time and return to their studies and track meets.

feats.scene: Celmis shoves a hallway locker door shut with her hip.
Celmis trips on the track and scrapes both knees.

name: Colresse
summary: Colresse is a sleeper agent whose dormant genes are triggered by a nursery rhyme, turning her into a winged, insect-limbed monster. Colresse had been a loving mother in a quiet house for years.

feats.scene: Colresse's arm-cannon blows a hole through a living-room wall and the garage beyond.
Colresse takes a hail of bullets on leathery wings and keeps advancing.

name: Ronrnin
summary: Ronrnin is a terrorist in a power suit that makes heat and cold, teleports her short distances and fires energy bolts. Ronrnin is the only one to survive when her leader detonates their bunker.

feats.scene: Ronrnin sears a gap through a steel door with a jet of heat.
Ronrnin teleports out of a collapsing bunker just before the blast.

name: Iariuse
summary: Iariuse is a grey-haired traveller marooned with a crew of wall-crawling aliens on a strange planet. Iariuse shoots sticky lines from wrist gadgets and leaps rooftops with the agility of a cat.

feats.scene: Iariuse swings a loaded cargo crate into a pursuer and sends him tumbling.
Iariuse drops three storeys onto a car roof and walks away.

name: Lliel
summary: Lliel is a chatty schoolkid who gushes about a flame-bodied celebrity's television appearance. Lliel has no powers and spends the day in hallways and classrooms.

feats.scene: Lliel shoves a locker closed and rushes to class.
Lliel trips on a stair and catches the rail.

name: Sarse
summary: Sarse is a woman who dies young, leaving her inventor husband bitter and lonely. Sarse is remembered only in a single mention that explains his later turn.

feats.scene: Sarse slaps a stuck window open on a hot afternoon.
Sarse stumbles on a kitchen step and catches the counter.

name: Siusarnan
summary: Siusarnan is a devoted wife in the 1940s who never gives up hope of seeing her missing husband again. Siusarnan dies of a failing heart before he returns.

feats.scene: Siusarnan hangs a photograph on the wall with a firm tap of her palm.
Siusarnan climbs a steep staircase with a weak heart and finishes it.

name: Rntesna
summary: Rntesna is a gifted engineer who inherits her late mentor's harness of mechanical limbs. Rntesna uses it to lift loads and fight a masked teenage vigilante, losing in the end.

feats.scene: Rntesna hurls a parked van across a street with her harness limbs.
Rntesna is webbed into a wall and cannot pry free.

name: Ntanvo
summary: Ntanvo is a low-rank schemer with a mechanical-limb rig who ends up among the early casualties of a ritual killing spree. Ntanvo is only mentioned, never seen in the act.

feats.scene: Ntanvo swings a steel limb into a lab door and dents it.
Ntanvo falls to a cult's blade without a chance to raise her arms.

name: Valulsum
summary: Valulsum is a pink-haired college student who nearly collides with a hovering camera drone. Valulsum cheers her classmate on as a flying champion zooms past.

feats.scene: Valulsum waves down a drone and bats it away with her backpack.
Valulsum is knocked down by a loose drone and brushes off the grass.

name: Telussta
summary: Telussta is a furred, bat-winged blood drinker who works for an ancient ruler only for his next meal. Telussta joins a raid on a prison and slips away to a ruined forest.

feats.scene: Telussta tears a prison gate off its hinges and tosses it across the yard.
Telussta takes a shotgun blast to the chest and keeps feeding.

name: Iumcos
summary: Iumcos is a petty thief referenced in a fighting game who slips away when a teenager hesitates. Iumcos later kills the teenager's guardian.

feats.scene: Iumcos shoves a clerk aside and runs for the door.
Iumcos tumbles over a fence and keeps running.

name: Corornam
summary: Corornam is a blond thief who plants a seed of lifelong guilt in a masked hero by getting away. Corornam is ultimately found by his pursuer in a warehouse and dies of fright.

feats.scene: Corornam fires a pistol and breaks a window across the street.
Corornam trips over a crate and scrapes both hands.

name: Iameotel
summary: Iameotel is a common criminal who shoots a kindly old man during a break-in. Iameotel's single act of violence ripples across a whole timeline.

feats.scene: Iameotel pulls a trigger and a single round cracks a kitchen cabinet.
Iameotel falls off a fire escape and rolls to his feet.

name: Inliuvi
summary: Inliuvi is a small-time crook whose memory is dragged into a dream-world by a daughter trying to wake her father. Inliuvi never leaves the realm of recollection.

feats.scene: Inliuvi shoves a drawer shut in a remembered kitchen.
Inliuvi fades like smoke when the memory is replayed.

name: Vatumor
summary: Vatumor is a crook who flees a television palace and is knocked flat by a showman with a wave of an arm. Vatumor's capture spares a life and changes a destiny.

feats.scene: Vatumor shoves a guard and bolts down the corridor.
Vatumor is knocked unconscious by one swing of an arm.

name: Rnicalli
summary: Rnicalli is a thief who runs off from a crime scene while a bystander looks on. Rnicalli later commits a murder that sets a young man on his path.

feats.scene: Rnicalli slams a stolen satchel into a hedge as he flees.
Rnicalli dives over a low wall and rolls into a gutter.

name: Oraran
summary: Oraran is a brown-haired criminal who breaks into a family home and leaves tragedy behind. Oraran appears only as the cause of a young man's grief.

feats.scene: Oraran pries a window latch with a crowbar.
Oraran drops from a sill onto concrete and limps off.

name: Valnile
summary: Valnile is a blond criminal who loots a palace and is arrested by an off-duty guard. Valnile never meets the hero his counterpart does and lives a smaller life.

feats.scene: Valnile snatches a cash box and sprints through the lobby.
Valnile is tackled onto marble and cuffed.

name: Ontti
summary: Ontti is a brown-haired criminal who breaks into a home and commits a killing that haunts a young man. Ontti is tracked down later and recognised as the thief who got away.

feats.scene: Ontti swings a flashlight at a doorframe and splits the wood.
Ontti slams into a stack of tires and sits up dazed.

name: Aniol
summary: Aniol is a comic-parody thief in a sketch anthology that lampoons old origin tales. Aniol follows the same beats as the original and gets laughs for it.

feats.scene: Aniol bonks a guard with a rubber mallet in a cartoon alley.
Aniol is flattened by an anvil and springs back like a pancake.

name: Vavites
summary: Vavites is a grey-eyed thief who appears in a hero's dream of revenge, laughing at his own face. Vavites dies of a heart attack and is replaced in the vision by a beloved elder.

feats.scene: Vavites tosses a bag of loot over a fence and sprints after it.
Vavites clutches his chest and collapses in a dim warehouse.

name: Reneuli
summary: Reneuli is a winged being who once lived in a bright heavenly court and was cast down for joining a rebellion, according to dubious sources. Reneuli drifts through legend, a name on a list of fallen things.

feats.scene: Reneuli hurls a spear of pale fire that scorches a mountain track.
Reneuli plummets from the clouds and crashes into a valley floor, still alive.

name: Amaanvil
summary: Amaanvil is a purple-streaked teenager who stands up for a classmate against a bully. Amaanvil keeps a hero's secret and starts a gentle romance.

feats.scene: Amaanvil pushes a bully's hand off her friend's shoulder.
Amaanvil stumbles off a curb and scrapes her palm.

name: Saium
summary: Saium is a strict aunt who raises a niece after the girl's mother vanishes. Saium is devout, stern and eventually forgiven by a girl who left home.

feats.scene: Saium raps a wooden spoon on a kitchen table to end an argument.
Saium tumbles on a porch step and brushes herself off.

name: Seontsi
summary: Seontsi is a young woman with a rare inherited illness who is rescued from a hired killer by a masked acrobat. Seontsi's sister works for a famous inventor in a neon-lit future.

feats.scene: Seontsi pushes a heavy door open with both hands.
Seontsi collapses from weakness and is caught by a stranger.

name: Sercoan
summary: Sercoan is a corporate executive at a meat-packing giant who is humbled by a spiky vigilante. Sercoan has wealth and arrogance but nothing in a fistfight.

feats.scene: Sercoan slaps a conference table and storms out of a meeting.
Sercoan is knocked off his feet by a single shove from a masked rival.

name: Rilon
summary: Rilon is a one-eyed ranger who guards a wild jungle valley and its beasts from a greedy corporation. Rilon lives with his wife and a small pet and knows every trail.

feats.scene: Rilon fires a hunting rifle and drops a charging boar.
Rilon falls down a muddy ravine and climbs back out.

name: Amarntum
summary: Amarntum is a greedy ivory trader who bullies a gentle tribe into selling at ruinous prices. Amarntum cares only about profit and is eventually outwitted.

feats.scene: Amarntum slams a ledger on a market stall and demands a lower price.
Amarntum is thrown from a mule and lands in the dust.

name: Lumaul
summary: Lumaul is a security guard posted at a lawless free-city in a far-future metropolis. Lumaul keeps watch over a gate and gets no thanks.

feats.scene: Lumaul cracks a baton across a trespasser's shoulder.
Lumaul takes a blow from a thug and stays upright.

name: Levosau
summary: Levosau is a bald steel-mill owner who hires saboteurs to wreck a rival plant and win a contract. Levosau's scheme collapses when his stepdaughter warns a pair of flame-bodied heroes.

feats.scene: Levosau pounds a mahogany desk to order a night raid on a rival factory.
Levosau is dragged out of his office and cuffed by police.

name: Stosoror
summary: Stosoror is a small boy whose half-grown gifts trap his mind in a twisted double of a teacher. Stosoror befriends a tentacled classmate and leaves a school after a massacre.

feats.scene: Stosoror presses his hands to a sleeping man's temples and the man's mind quivers.
Stosoror collapses unconscious after a surge of mental backlash.

name: Tianeest
summary: Tianeest is a deeply withdrawn child whose mind builds solid castles and people from nothing. Tianeest ages and de-ages the world around him, and dies in an invasion.

feats.scene: Tianeest conjures a stone castle in a classroom and fills it with living toys.
Tianeest is cut down by an invading blade before his gift can respond.

name: Taressor
summary: Taressor is a government research scientist who builds hunting-insect powers into soldiers. Taressor is bribed to design a deadly operative and is poisoned for his trouble.

feats.scene: Taressor slams a lab drawer and locks away his notes.
Taressor staggers under a venomous injection and collapses.

name: Valonser
summary: Valonser is a bald lab director who oversees a northern weapon program. Valonser is a calm and clinical presence over the tests.

feats.scene: Valonser taps a monitor to signal the next round of tests.
Valonser is thrown to the floor and gets up with a sigh.

name: Citeo
summary: Citeo is a bionic-limbed patient who kills his nurses and lures a famous teacher into a trap at a desert lab. Citeo loses his gift and his sanity in the end.

feats.scene: Citeo fires a shuddering beam that knocks a lab door off its rails.
Citeo flinches as a cannon blast cracks the armour he wears.

name: Vaauneo
summary: Vaauneo is a masked rider from an old-fashioned town who races a roster of heroes to prove he is the fastest. Vaauneo loses but keeps practising.

feats.scene: Vaauneo swings a lasso and snags a rival's belt loop.
Vaauneo charges a flying mount across a plain in a cloud of dust.

name: Aultaeo
summary: Aultaeo is a racer bonded to a flame-wreathed spirit and forced to compete in a deadly arena for freedom. Aultaeo guns his engine through hellish tracks and breaks away when a rival's spirit escapes.

feats.scene: Aultaeo sprays a rival's car with a fiery wake that melts the track behind him.
Aultaeo crashes into a barrier at full speed and revs again.

name: Iaeona
summary: Iaeona is an elderly graveyard keeper who once bargained with a devil to become a blazing rider. Iaeona later rides one last time beside his successor and rides away into the dusk.

feats.scene: Iaeona lashes his flaming steed and leaves a molten trail across a dry riverbed.
Iaeona holds his ground against a charging mob in his fiery form.

name: Inortel
summary: Inortel is a masked rider in a land where retired and cancelled heroes gather to wait. Inortel runs away when a spirit of endings arrives.

feats.scene: Inortel fires a pistol into a painted sky and watches the paint flake.
Inortel tumbles off a horse made of paper and lands in a heap.

name: Ntiause
summary: Ntiause is a hired gun and building guard who meets his end at the hands of a deadly fighter. Ntiause is competent with a pistol and no match for a ninja.

feats.scene: Ntiause fires a pistol and chips a plaster wall.
Ntiause takes a blade through his vest and falls.

name: Vater
summary: Vater is an aging father in the 1930s who votes against his party for a new economic plan. Vater cares for his lobotomised son with the help of the boy's sweetheart.

feats.scene: Vater raps a newspaper on a table to make a point.
Vater sinks into a kitchen chair under the weight of grief.

name: Lloteoles
summary: Lloteoles is an air force pilot whose jet breaks the sound barrier inside a strange corridor and fades from sight. Lloteoles is trapped in a time loop until his plane is shot down by his own side.

feats.scene: Lloteoles crashes a transparent jet into a desert and leaves a wide scar.
Lloteoles breaks the sound barrier and vanishes from the radar.

name: Seseolse
summary: Seseolse is a sharp army officer who graduates near the top of her class despite doubters. Seseolse learns to calm a rage-prone giant with patience rather than force.

feats.scene: Seseolse fires a service rifle and drops a target at two hundred paces.
Seseolse is knocked down by a shockwave and shakes it off.

name: Colliia
summary: Colliia is a person who lives in a big river-and-lakeside city and appears only once. Colliia has no powers and no known history.

feats.scene: Colliia pushes open a heavy shop door with her shoulder.
Colliia slips on a wet curb and catches herself.

name: Caser
summary: Caser is a black-haired cyborg mercenary who runs with a gang of augmented street toughs. Caser gets stopped by a rider on fire who wants to know who paid for a hit.

feats.scene: Caser punches a steel shutter with a cybernetic fist and dents it.
Caser takes a hard kick and keeps his feet.

name: Cornauiu
summary: Cornauiu is a cyborg gang member hired to recover a stolen robot body from rivals. Cornauiu dies in a workshop when a young woman turns on him.

feats.scene: Cornauiu breaks open a workshop door with a cybernetic shoulder.
Cornauiu is struck down by a surprise attack and does not rise.

name: Iumserlar
summary: Iumserlar is a bald teenager changed by a green serum who joins a masked gang and refuses to be rescued. Iumserlar prefers the rough crowd to anyone who offers to save him.

feats.scene: Iumserlar punches a car door and leaves a deep fist-shaped dent.
Iumserlar shrugs off a swung pipe across the back.

name: Masiu
summary: Masiu is a blue-dyed teenager who learns a few simple spells from a wounded sorcerer after a baseball game goes wrong. Masiu abuses a banishing trick and finds out where the vanished things go.

feats.scene: Masiu mutters a spell that sends a folding chair spinning through a crack in the air.
Masiu is yanked into a lower realm and shaken until she promises to stop.

name: Nuontva
summary: Nuontva is a gruff fairground promoter who keeps a ragged troupe of riders paid and alive. Nuontva trusts a worn notebook over any omen, and is forever hauling lost performers out of trouble.

feats.scene: Nuontva shoves a stuck gate open with a shoulder charge.
Nuontva shrugs off a hard tumble from a fence rail onto packed dirt.

name: Aluorcor
summary: Aluorcor runs a card-sharp crew out of a hollowed canyon outpost and holds grudges like debts. Aluorcor is cunning but reckless, and a lost hand of cards turns a charmer into a kidnapper.

feats.scene: Aluorcor fires a revolver round that splinters a saloon post.
Aluorcor takes a barstool across the back and keeps grinning.

name: Neserran
summary: Neserran is a meek clerk by day who paints on a grin by night and stalks the harbor district with trick gadgets. Neserran's prized toy is a handshake buzzer wired to a car battery.

feats.scene: Neserran jolts a lamp-post thief with a wired handshake buzzer.
Neserran tumbles down a fire escape and limps away unbroken.

name: Auntelar
summary: Auntelar is a rift-born soldier whose power swells whenever the bleed between worlds widens. Auntelar wears a spiked war helm with a tail of braided cord and borrows the bodies of the unwary.

feats.scene: Auntelar cracks a city intersection by slamming a possessed fist into the tarmac.
Auntelar walks out of a collapsing arcade with the armor barely scratched.

name: Niaorar
summary: Niaorar is a disciplined officer on a frontier station who reports bad news without flinching. Niaorar keeps a sharp tactical mind and a worn sidearm.

feats.scene: Niaorar fires a pulse sidearm that drops a corridor door.
Niaorar rides out a deck-shaking blast braced against a bulkhead.

name: Lonter
summary: Lonter is a teenager who helps his family haul nets and fix boats on a bayou dock. Lonter is quick with a wrench and has no powers at all.

feats.scene: Lonter hurls a full crab trap across the dock.
Lonter takes a hard fall off a slick pier into a shallow skiff.

name: Amesan
summary: Lonter's cousin in crime, Amesan is a nervous racketeer who loots restricted labs and sells fire-starting goo to the highest bidder. Amesan flees at the first sign of a masked pursuer.

feats.scene: Amesan swings a briefcase of stolen vials into a guard's helmet.
Amesan crashes through a skylight and keeps running.

name: Nuvos
summary: Nuvos is a royal seer whose warnings are laughed off by every court that hears them. Nuvos sees ruin well before it arrives and can only watch it happen.

feats.scene: Nuvos unleashes a burst of raw sight that shatters every window in a feast hall.
Nuvos stands unharmed in a city wall breach, guided by a vision of where the spears will fall.

name: Telnoco
summary: Telnoco is a lamp-lit seer in a golden city who watches the sky turn blue with flame. Telnoco begs the crowd to leave, and none listen.

feats.scene: Telnoco hammers a bell with a bare fist to raise the alarm.
Telnoco keeps standing through a wave of scorching blue heat.

name: Eolrni
summary: Eolrni is a lighthouse oracle on a drifting island who foretells a rising wave. Eolrni pleads with the fishers to board boats, but the sea arrives before belief does.

feats.scene: Eolrni rings a ship's horn with a lung-bursting blast.
Eolrni clings to a mast through a crushing surge of water.

name: Telcetiu
summary: Telcetiu is a smooth spy-broker who hires out mercenary crews for her patron and takes the blame when they flop. Telcetiu is loyal to a fault and learns what loyalty costs.

feats.scene: Telcetiu fires a compact pistol that spins a guard round.
Telcetiu takes a heavy slap from her patron and calmly straightens her coat.

name: Colelrne
summary: Colelrne is a prim front-desk gatekeeper at a talent office who screens visitors with icy politeness. Colelrne scorns loud clients and an overeager bodyguard alike.

feats.scene: Colelrne slams a heavy ledger on a desk to end an argument.
Colelrne tumbles over a chair and gets up without a hair out of place.

name: Cotesia
summary: Cotesia is a worried mother who leaves a dangerous marriage to protect her spiky-skinned child. Cotesia endures a long illness and learns to accept help from strange allies.

feats.scene: Cotesia swings a heavy handbag at a would-be kidnapper.
Cotesia endures a night of hospital-corridor chaos on weakened legs.

name: Valannti
summary: Valannti is a spirited exchange student who tours a foreign city with her tinkering father. Valannti has no powers and a lot of curiosity.

feats.scene: Valannti throws a sprinting punch at a stuck vending machine.
Valannti tumbles down a few steps and bounces back up laughing.

name: Liuolinau
summary: Liuolinau is a young adventurer cut down by her own parent on a tyrant's order after refusing to kneel. Liuolinau's story is a short and bitter footnote in a future team's history.

feats.scene: Liuolinau swings a staff in a doomed last stand.
Liuolinau holds the line against an armored attacker for a few breaths.

name: Taniter
summary: Taniter is a girl whose body begins to change after a drifting mist spreads across the world. Taniter hides in a sealed mansion with her father, hoping that clean walls will stop the shift.

feats.scene: Taniter's growing frame splits a bolted steel door from its hinges.
Taniter's changing skin turns aside a falling shelf of iron tools.

name: Olivalnan
summary: Olivalnan is a time-lost rescuer who grows and shrinks at will through borrowed particles in her blood. Olivalnan arrives on a far planet mid-battle with a team that fled the timeline.

feats.scene: Olivalnan swells to the height of a tower and stamps a street flat.
Olivalnan shrinks to the size of a bee and drifts unharmed through a barrage.

name: Iuorana
summary: Iuorana is a hero of a ruined timeline whose likeness is copied by a sneaky parasite. Iuorana's double fools a trusting ally into a fatal embrace.

feats.scene: Iuorana grows a few meters and swats a hovering drone from the air.
Iuorana weathers a long volley of small-arms fire.

name: Osecate
summary: Osecate is a wing-suited teen who soaked herself in strange particles to join a young crew. Osecate flies on synthetic wings and trades blows in a toy-brick world.

feats.scene: Osecate lands a size-boosted kick that dents a delivery truck.
Osecate bounces off a wall of toy-brick rubble unharmed.

name: Sanrirn
summary: Sanrirn is a scientist and retired adventurer who can swell and shrink, and who joins a last resistance as her world falls. Sanrirn helps plan a doomed leap through time to save a friend.

feats.scene: Sanrirn swells to giant height and flattens a patrolling walker.
Sanrirn tanks a collapsing hideout ceiling at full size.

name: Stausont
summary: Stausont is a high schooler gifted with size-shifting particles who finds her island besieged by an immortal conqueror. Stausont is sent to help with a siege far above her age.

feats.scene: Stausont grows to roof height and bats a bomber out of the sky.
Stausont shrinks and slips through a wall of splintered glass.

name: Rnilersau
summary: Rnilersau is a cheerful child entering a school contest with a homemade volcano. Rnilersau never learns her father's secret, and has no powers of her own.

feats.scene: Rnilersau stirs a bubbling model so hard the foam sprays the hall.
Rnilersau is bowled over by a wave of foam and giggles.

name: Valeoni
summary: Valeoni is a kid who appears only in passing as the offspring of a famous tinkerer. Valeoni has no stated powers and no recorded battles.

feats.scene: Valeoni throws a playground ball at a target.
Valeoni slips on a wet floor and bounces right back up.

name: Tustiurn
summary: Tustiurn is a bright scientist who marries into a ruling family, lectures about captured sunlight, and lives a long life beside her husband. Tustiurn is never a fighter in her own telling.

feats.scene: Tustiurn fires a bench-top lamp so bright it scorches a test dummy.
Tustiurn weathers a laboratory flash with her goggles cracked.

name: Eolniuse
summary: Eolniuse is a casual friend of a teenage archer who lives in a big city. Eolniuse has no stated feats of any kind.

feats.scene: Eolniuse tosses a snowball that bursts on a lamp-post.
Eolniuse slips off a curb and shrugs it off.

name: Lliarse
summary: Lliarse is a size-changing teen who bounces between schools and timelines while chasing a time-meddling tyrant. Lliarse stays free when her friends are stuck in a limbo and sets out to rescue them.

feats.scene: Lliarse grows to the size of a house and shoves a battle-wagon into a river.
Lliarse wades through heavy cannon fire at full size.

name: Ranessia
summary: Ranessia is a towering secret agent from a patchwork world who is wiped out when the sky-ruler erases her land. Ranessia rises again on a stitched-together island and falls alongside her allies.

feats.scene: Ranessia grows to skyscraper height and topples a tower with one swing.
Ranessia tanks a column of cannon fire and keeps advancing.

name: Uliaul
summary: Uliaul is a glitzy casino owner who trades a favor to a lab-coated schemer and loses far more than she bargained for. Uliaul sits by a sick child's bed and counts the hours.

feats.scene: Uliaul flings a stack of chips across a table in anger.
Uliaul keeps a straight face through a hard shove in a crowded lobby.

name: Sanval
summary: Sanval is a spirit-twin born of a great mind's shadow, who rebuilt herself cell by cell over decades. Sanval wields a mirror of her sibling's thought-power and vows to unmake all he has built.

feats.scene: Sanval crushes a bridge to powder with one pulse of thought.
Sanval holds her form together as a collapsing tower rains down on her.

name: Tacoraur
summary: Tacoraur is a bald psychic who fuses two mighty minds in an alternate timeline. Tacoraur's merged power sets a hard limit on what any rescuer can stop.

feats.scene: Tacoraur tears a coastal cliff loose with a mental heave.
Tacoraur absorbs a battery of rockets behind a psychic shield.

name: Viaresma
summary: Viaresma is a bald terrorist born of a shadow-twin who survived being strangled before birth. Viaresma hates the bridges her sibling built between two peoples and bends minds to tear them down.

feats.scene: Viaresma hurls a fleet of cars through the air with a glance.
Viaresma shrugs off a collapsing skyscraper floor on her shielded head.

name: Cicarses
summary: Cicarses is an exiled tyrant who rules a barren wasteland and perfects her mental power with no one to stop her. Cicarses mocks every visitor and dies when a time machine collapses around her.

feats.scene: Cicarses lifts a ruined mountainside and throws it across the void.
Cicarses absorbs a blast that levels a city district around her.

name: Vaalan
summary: Vaalan is a nameless bystander mentioned among the many lost to a spreading plague. Vaalan has no feats and no recorded actions.

feats.scene: Vaalan swats away a buzzing fly in a waiting room.
Vaalan bumps a doorframe and rubs the bruise.

name: Sevos
summary: Sevos is a stern queen of a war-scarred sister world who inherits a fractured planet and rules it with a firm hand. Sevos rides a metal bird into combat and guards a people reborn from their ancient wars.

feats.scene: Sevos cleaves a wooden barricade with a heavy blade swing.
Sevos takes a glancing spear blow in her breastplate and presses on.

name: Amorces
summary: Amorces is a clawed lieutenant of a shadowy order, her reflexes and recall tuned in a lab. Amorces serves a cruel baron and fights with talons in her gloves.

feats.scene: Amorces rips a steel locker door open with her gloved claws.
Amorces shakes off a pistol volley with a lab-tuned body.

name: Cosamimi
summary: Cosamimi is a former paramedic who was born with a deadly illness and saved by the venom of tiny spinners. Cosamimi foresees dangers before they happen and gathers young girls to protect them.

feats.scene: Cosamimi shoves a crash victim clear of a swerving cab.
Cosamimi takes a hard tackle from a pursuer in a diner corridor.

name: Roeosleo
summary: Roeosleo is a leader of a small crew of girls who loses a bloody fight in a roadside diner. Roeosleo grabs a bottle and then a blade against a faster, stronger killer.

feats.scene: Roeosleo smashes a glass bottle over a rival's shoulder.
Roeosleo is hurled across a booth and gets back up.

name: Tuvoses
summary: Tuvoses is a red-eyed warrior with orange face markings from a wild island nation, aggressive by nature. Tuvoses can swing a parked scooter like a club and joins a losing war.

feats.scene: Tuvoses punches a patrolman so hard he flies across a tavern roof.
Tuvoses takes a point-blank beam to the face and lives.

name: Civil
summary: Civil is a twin warrior-prince, son of a thunder-throwing sky king and a mortal queen. Civil sails with a hero crew and rests beside his brother in the earth of their homeland.

feats.scene: Civil heaves a boulder through an enemy ship's mast.
Civil is struck by a lightning bolt and laughs it off.

name: Tuseon
summary: Tuseon is a city hair stylist who braids a detective's hair into waves and chats about nothing. Tuseon has no powers and no battles to her name.

feats.scene: Tuseon slaps a hairbrush down on a counter.
Tuseon bumps a chair and shrugs.

name: Lonrne
summary: Lonrne is a faith-driven net rider with pale tattoos who glides through glowing data streams. Lonrne perishes when the end-of-age wave sweeps the city.

feats.scene: Lonrne cuts a locked data door with a bright stroke of code.
Lonrne weathers a neon feedback surge.

name: Osunttum
summary: Osunttum is a lanky burglar who steals a rival's gear and wears it in a fit of nerves. Osunttum accidentally kills a guard, flees frightened, and is dragged into a bigger crook's plot.

feats.scene: Osunttum punches through a pane of window glass.
Osunttum drops from a high ledge and rolls to his feet.

name: Rneiara
summary: Rneiara is a furry hammer-wielder in a realm of cat gods who swings a mighty mallet. Rneiara beat a frosty chieftain and sneers at any visitor who cannot lift the hammer.

feats.scene: Rneiara calls down a fuzzy bolt that levels a village-sized hill.
Rneiara shrugs off a falling tree trunk and licks a paw.

name: Orsesniu
summary: Orsesniu is a gloved gang boss in the war years who hires out as a killer for spies. Orsesniu cuts down factory owners with hidden claws and flees from a winged hero.

feats.scene: Orsesniu rakes a steel safe door with her glove blades.
Orsesniu jumps off a balcony onto a party table and runs.

name: Corani
summary: Corani is a blue-haired petty thief who sees a flood of stray animals as a chance to rob corner shops. Corani is no match for any real hero.

feats.scene: Corani smashes a shop window with a crowbar.
Corani trips over a stray and tumbles into a rack of cans.

name: Soriar
summary: Soriar is a small-time crook in a powered suit who runs with a team of beast-themed goons. Soriar helps organize a convention for lowly henchmen during a world-ending war.

feats.scene: Soriar claws a lamp-post in half with his powered gloves.
Soriar bounces off a brick wall in his padded suit.

name: Vaesor
summary: Vaesor is a masked jewel thief in the postwar years who prefers to die than be taken alive. Vaesor is a skilled climber who dies when her getaway car meets a wall.

feats.scene: Vaesor fires two shots at a night watchman.
Vaesor crashes a coupe head-first into a brick wall.

name: Osutu
summary: Osutu is a green two-mouthed warrior from a hidden undersea city who poses as a sports brawler. Osutu is judged flawed by his priests and sentenced to a long, mindless sleep.

feats.scene: Osutu hurls a wrestling ring post through a stadium wall.
Osutu takes a falling girder in the chest and rises.

name: Nissi
summary: Nissi is a mountain thunder god of a high-sky pantheon who slings enchanted stones into clouds to stir storms. Nissi was created by a pair of ancient parent powers and has been impersonated by lesser beings.

feats.scene: Nissi slings a glowing stone into the clouds and a storm levels a valley town.
Nissi stands in the heart of a lightning storm unburned.

name: Eoncor
summary: Eoncor is a grey-haired senior officer at a jungle firebase who is mocked by a sharp-tongued private. Eoncor is stiff and proud, and no match for the humid war around him.

feats.scene: Eoncor fires a service pistol at a ridge line.
Eoncor is knocked flat by a mortar shock and stands back up.

name: Cosres
summary: Cosres is the kind keeper of a snowbound children's home who shelters a ragged stranger on a holiday eve. Cosres watches a bright flash in the sky and senses something good has happened.

feats.scene: Cosres slams a window shut against the wind.
Cosres slips on ice and shakes it off.

name: Rnneslon
summary: Rnneslon is a jewel thief who commands a flock of mind-steered drones and frames a young hero with a quick bluff. Rnneslon is elegant, slippery, and always one step ahead of the cameras.

feats.scene: Rnneslon sends a swarm of drones to clip a guard's wrist.
Rnneslon tumbles through a skylight into a hotel corridor.

name: Intos
summary: Intos is a poisoner-witch at a king's court who sells dark charms and deadly drafts. Intos lived centuries ago and still turns up in tales of cursed bargains.

feats.scene: Intos hurls a curse that rots a stable door to splinters.
Intos stands unharmed after a thrown candlestick.

name: Lusrum
summary: Lusrum is a dreamy farm woman lifted into godhood to stand for her whole kind. Lusrum bends minds, weaves false scenes, and carries a steel spine under a gentle manner.

feats.scene: Lusrum wraps a whole city block in a false vision until its people lay down their weapons.
Lusrum stands calm as an artillery barrage turns her field to craters.

name: Neulon
summary: Neulon is a young mother in an old harbor city who loses her husband to a monster of iron and dies giving birth. Neulon's child will become the first of a new kind of mind.

feats.scene: Neulon hurls a vase at an intruder.
Neulon stays on her feet through a rattling quake.

name: Valvos
summary: Valvos is a girl who walks through walls and is cast adrift across timelines to fight for a team of dimension hoppers. Valvos can even slip into another body without touching its mind.

feats.scene: Valvos phases her fist through a vault door and into a guard's chest.
Valvos turns intangible and lets a rocket pass through her.

name: Tusrum
summary: Tusrum is a worried mother who runs from a failing lab with her child. Tusrum dies when a tunnel of unstable light bursts in a faraway country.

feats.scene: Tusrum drags a stuck door open to reach her daughter.

name: Niaterne
summary: Niaterne is a girl who cannot walk until alien visitors, grateful for shelter, heal her with a pulse of energy. Niaterne finds a gold bar under her pillow and a living doll that has gone home.

feats.scene: Niaterne pushes a creaky shack door open with her crutch.
Niaterne stumbles in the weeds and laughs it off.

name: Amlonar
summary: Amlonar is a mischievous house cat who joins a mad club of masked pets. Amlonar gets into scrapes with a dog and a mouse and ends up on the winning team of a silly feud.

feats.scene: Amlonar swats a toy off a shelf with a flick of the tail.
Amlonar lands on all fours after a fall from a roof.

name: Eolvaul
summary: Eolvaul is a walking war machine built in a hidden desert lab to replace a tank. Eolvaul will not harm bystanders or smash property without need and obeys its own safety code.

feats.scene: Eolvaul fires a cannon that levels a brick barn.
Eolvaul takes a missile salvo on its plated chest.

name: Ontmosor
summary: Ontmosor is an ex-factory hand turned folk-hero killer who leads a cult of followers. Ontmosor grabs whatever is at hand as a weapon and preaches about rich men's feasts.

feats.scene: Ontmosor swings a pipe wrench into a door lock.
Ontmosor takes a hard kick to the ribs and keeps preaching.

name: Titum
summary: Titum is a once-bright sky servant said to have been cast out for backing a failed revolt. Titum is known only through hearsay and has no clear deeds.

feats.scene: Titum drops a shaft of pale flame that levels a hilltop fort.
Titum falls from the clouds and lands on a stone plain unhurt.

name: Sermon
summary: Sermon is a green-skinned cartel heir who arranges quiet murders and flees across the stars with hunters in tow. Sermon is tracked to a gamma-glowing world and caught after a final killing.

feats.scene: Sermon hurls a human across a parking lot.
Sermon takes a heavy club blow and sneers.

name: Llstan
summary: Llstan is a future queen who raises a young heir and warns her not to repeat old mistakes. Llstan helps hunt for a kidnapped diplomat decades after her own prime.

feats.scene: Llstan strikes a spear shaft against a guard's helm.
Llstan shrugs off a hard shove in a palace corridor.

name: Lento
summary: Lento is a country-born trucker with a homey rig who hauls a tired duck across the plains. Lento stumbles upon a plot to replace the land with fakes and helps drown a giant mutant rodent.

feats.scene: Lento wrenches a jammed hatch open with a tire iron.
Lento tumbles into a sinkhole and climbs out grinning.

name: Aneoia
summary: Aneoia is a balding lawyer who switches from one crime boss to another. Aneoia questions his new client about a murder and is finally taken in by a federal agent.

feats.scene: Aneoia slams a briefcase on a desk.
Aneoia is shoved against a wall and straightens his tie.

name: Ntvel
summary: Ntvel is a hard-bitten crook who hides from the law through a magic looking glass into a second world. Ntvel is beaten by a masked hero and a young sidekick.

feats.scene: Ntvel punches a guard and bolts for the glass.
Ntvel is hurled through a doorway and keeps running.

name: Nesam
summary: Nesam is a green scholar of the deep who mutates into a many-armed horror with a gem in his chest. Nesam is gutted by a clawed fighter and caught in a blast far above the city.

feats.scene: Nesam lashes four tentacles through a skyscraper face and tears out a floor.
Nesam shrugs off a tank volley across his hardened hide.

name: Llaunleo
summary: Llaunleo is a bespectacled preacher in a future city who dresses as a storm god and was once part of a corporate hoax. Llaunleo's replica hammer powers his strength, and a bad signal can switch him off.

feats.scene: Llaunleo hurls a masked wall-crawler across a rooftop.
Llaunleo stands through a hail of rounds without bleeding.

name: Neiumus
summary: Neiumus is a green-eyed lobby clerk in a tall glass tower who greets visitors for a bonding firm. Neiumus has no powers and plays no part in any fight.

feats.scene: Neiumus drops a stapler on a desk.
Neiumus bumps a counter corner and winces.

name: Ciaus
summary: Ciaus is a university student who is saved from a mugger and then turned into a bloodsucker by her rescuer. Ciaus now hungers in the foggy streets of an old city.

feats.scene: Ciaus throws a man a few meters through a fogbound alley.
Ciaus is shot at close range and shrugs it off.

name: Tuiastia
summary: Tuiastia is a woman bonded to a fallen alien warrior to survive a prison plague, and she becomes a poisonous vigilante. Tuiastia dies twice and is lost to a clawed hunter.

feats.scene: Tuiastia drives a toxic fist through a car door.
Tuiastia shrugs off a hail of small-arms rounds.

name: Eomeam
summary: Eomeam is a treasure hunter's daughter who is threatened by mutineers aboard a hired ship. Eomeam is rescued by a sea-king in a diver's disguise who asks only for a donation.

feats.scene: Eomeam shoves a deckhand off balance.
Eomeam stumbles against a rail and recovers.

name: Ntirau
summary: Ntirau is a skilled emergency doctor with a force bubble she raises around herself and patients. Ntirau treats the wounded while an alien armada storms the home of her team.

feats.scene: Ntirau pops her bubble outward and flings a soldier across a ward.
Ntirau's bubble stops a rifle volley point-blank.

name: Orcoltu
summary: Orcoltu is a force-shield doctor who flees into the sewers with her team and is wiped out by a demon horde. Orcoltu falls in a battle that leaves nobody standing.

feats.scene: Orcoltu shoves a possessed ally across a tunnel with a sudden force burst.
Orcoltu holds a shimmering bubble against a swarm of claws.

name: Neslarcau
summary: Neslarcau is a corner-shop owner and adoptive mother who raises an injured star girl in a busy neighborhood. Neslarcau begs her daughter in vain to stop fighting for strangers.

feats.scene: Neslarcau slams a heavy shop shutter down.
Neslarcau braces against a heavy crowd at closing time.

name: Stene
summary: Stene is a spendthrift heir in colonial times whose lavish living ruins his descendants. Stene is erased from history by a future inventor with a time viewer.

feats.scene: Stene hurls a wine goblet at a servant.
Stene trips on a rug and curses.

name: Seoeon
summary: Seoeon is a grey-haired killer-for-hire under the thumb of a menacing master. Seoeon has quiet habits and a steady hand.

feats.scene: Seoeon fires a silenced pistol through a window.
Seoeon takes a hard shove into a bookcase and stays calm.

name: Sianumsi
summary: Sianumsi is an alien hired blade who joins a guild of killers to ambush a strongman. Sianumsi loses the fight and triggers a self-destruct that wounds a comrade.

feats.scene: Sianumsi detonates his own body in a crowded plaza.
Sianumsi takes a crushing punch and stays on his feet.

name: Inlonnto
summary: Inlonnto is one of seven sisters, a star-daughter of an old sky-bearing titan. Inlonnto is known only by lineage and has no recorded deeds.

feats.scene: Inlonnto flings a bolt of starlight that splits a stone pillar.
Inlonnto stands unharmed in a roaring storm.

name: Nesell
summary: Nesell is a green-haired clerk who once stretched his body like rope until a sword took the gift away. Nesell now works a government desk on a floating platform.

feats.scene: Nesell stamps a form so hard the desk shakes.
Nesell bumps a rail and shrugs.

name: Ontcori
summary: Ontcori is a girlfriend of a bruiser who gets a brief mention. Ontcori has no powers and no scenes of her own.

feats.scene: Ontcori slaps a table in annoyance.
Ontcori stumbles on a stair and recovers.

name: Mator
summary: Mator is a blonde psychic, one of a set of identical sisters, who helps a leader scan the land for a mighty mind. Mator links with her sisters to amplify her reach.

feats.scene: Mator and her sisters collapse a stone watchtower with a joint mental shove.
Mator shrugs off a glancing blow behind a thought-shield.

name: Ontlaror
summary: Ontlaror is a blonde psychic who merges the minds of five sisters into a single awful will. Ontlaror shuts down a beast army one thought at a time, until a killer breaks her link.

feats.scene: Ontlaror silences a battalion of snarling beasts with a single merged pulse.
Ontlaror sustains a hard blow and keeps her link intact.

name: Sesco
summary: Sesco is a blonde sister of a psychic set who is kidnapped by a hoarder and displayed in a museum. Sesco watches visitors drift by from behind glass.

feats.scene: Sesco lifts a display case with a mental heave.
Sesco takes a rough shove from a guard and holds her focus.

name: Onttaeos
summary: Onttaeos is a faceless titan sent to infect a cosmic being and wreck what it can. Onttaeos tears a rift into a city and leads an army of drones against a coalition of heroes.

feats.scene: Onttaeos stomps the earth and cracks a whole coastline.
Onttaeos stands through a joint barrage of every hero in a city.

name: Rnvaor
summary: Rnvaor is a great star-mother who carries a new kind of life and burns herself out to give it birth inside a sun. Rnvaor speaks in layered phrases and starts a cycle that will end her.

feats.scene: Rnvaor releases the heat of her birthing and sears the surface of a star.
Rnvaor wades into the core of a star and does not flinch.

name: Totiu
summary: Totiu is a nearly 2000-foot living vessel, an ancient program that tutors a young conqueror and teleports across the stars. Totiu reluctantly follows its master's orders and hops a team to a distant station.

feats.scene: Totiu fires a spire cannon that boils a mountain lake.
Totiu shrugs off a salvo of missiles across its hull.

name: Liaanrnu
summary: Liaanrnu is a child of two agents in a grim alternate world who dies alongside her family. Liaanrnu is the only one with no recorded action at all.

feats.scene: Liaanrnu stomps a puddle in frustration.
Liaanrnu falls off a bed and cries.

name: Cover
summary: Cover is a scientist's sister who stands against his dark allies and gives her life to shield a hero from a bullet. Cover's sacrifice turns her brother against his masters.

feats.scene: Cover shoves a gunman's arm aside.
Cover takes a round to the chest in a final act of courage.

name: Niniorn
summary: Niniorn is a purple mutant whose body fused into a single goo-like cell after a street shooting. Niniorn soaks up bullets, hides in the tunnels, and joins a gang of outcasts.

feats.scene: Niniorn slams a dripping fist into a sewer pipe.
Niniorn soaks a rifle volley into his gooey body and reforms.

name: Eonoeo
summary: Eonoeo is a robot partner in a pocket world of endless adventure who is smashed by a jealous intruder. Eonoeo's remains are found by a heroine afterward.

feats.scene: Eonoeo zaps a flying drone with a short arc of current.
Eonoeo takes a heavy blow before breaking apart.
